input: This place was so chill and relaxing. When I come back it'll definitely be in my list if stops. Not to mention the artist performing was fun and eclectic  (I mean really, a country version of "Let It Go", what's not to love?)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place was incredibly relaxing and chill. I will definitely include it in my list of stops when I return. The artist performing added to the fun and eclectic atmosphere, with their unique country version of "Let It Go". How could you not love it?

input:
Id you haven't been to the Smoothie King center since it was know as the New Orleans Arena, you are in for a nice surprise. The arena has had a face lift and, while the seats are the same,  everything else has been refreshed.   

Most importantly,  the food options are far more varied and appeal to many tastes.  The quality of the food is very good and significantly improved from a few years back. The drink options are much improved as well and include full service bars, spiked lemonade,  bottled and draft beer and of course, smoothies.  There is even a spot for sweets. You can get funnel cake, cotton candy, and all kinds of delicious things I was too full to take in.  

The venue finally feels a bit swanky and top notch.  We are moving on up!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: If you haven't been to the Smoothie King Center since it was the New Orleans Arena, you'll be pleasantly surprised. The arena has undergone renovations and while the seats remain the same, every other aspect has been refreshed. The food options now cater to a wider range of tastes and have greatly improved in quality. Additionally, the drink selection has expanded to include full service bars, spiked lemonade, bottled and draft beer, and of course, smoothies. They even have a sweets section offering funnel cake, cotton candy, and more. Overall, the venue now has a more upscale and impressive feel.

input: Don't know what it is but If my tummy's feeling icky, I can count on Chipotle's stake to fix me up. I just have to remember not to go during full on lunch time. I usually go between 2 & 4 when it's peaceful and calm. Busy or not the service is always friendly and fast!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Chipotle's steak never fails to cure my upset stomach, especially when I visit between 2 and 4pm, avoiding the lunchtime rush. Regardless of how busy they are, the service remains friendly and efficient.

input: I must admit, I wasn't expecting much. This place totally blew us away. This has to be one of the best Indian restaurants in the Tampa Bay. The ambience is wonderful including white table linens. The best part was the food, OMG. The chicken 65 was to die for, and the hot sour soup was rich and flavorful. The waitress (Angel) was friendly,  attentive and very pleasant. They opened just a week ago. I'm sure this will soon be the place foodies seek out for real Indian food.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was pleasantly surprised by this place. It exceeded my expectations and is definitely one of the top Indian restaurants in Tampa Bay. The ambience is great with white table linens and the food was amazing. The chicken 65 was delicious and the hot sour soup was flavorful. Our waitress, Angel, was friendly and attentive. Despite only being open for a week, I'm confident this will become a go-to spot for authentic Indian cuisine.

input:
Had to wait until my third trip to NOLA to actually get in the door.  First two times I tried waiting in line, this time around we got smart and bought reserved seats so we could be on the benches. Well worth the extra $20 to not hassle with waiting in line for an hour. It goes toward the preservation of Jazz so it's a good cause...just splurge.

The show was fantastic.  True musicians and great personalities to boot. I can only imagine that this is what concerts were like 50 years ago. The band members were dapper, engaging and insanely talented.  It's in a tiny hole in the wall space that only holds maybe 200 people? So it's very intimate and nice to see the smiles on the faces of the musicians as they share their craft with you. This is a must do while in NOLA!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: On my third trip to NOLA, I finally got in the door without waiting in line. We bought reserved seats and avoided the hassle of waiting for an hour. It was worth the extra $20, which goes towards the preservation of Jazz. The show was fantastic, with talented musicians and great personalities. It felt like a concert from 50 years ago. The band members were dapper, engaging, and insanely talented. The venue was small, holding only around 200 people, creating an intimate atmosphere. It was wonderful to see the smiles on the faces of the musicians as they shared their craft with us. This is a must-do in NOLA!

input: A GREAT EXPERIENCE!!!!!!!!!  I was a completely new customer.  I did not have an appointment because my other plans got rained out and my dealership was too busy to take me.  I needed a PA State & Emissions  inspection which I dread because they can be a total ripoff at some places when they add things on and I just wanted to get it over with.  I saw that this place had much better reviews on Yelp than many other shops in the area.  Keystone Discount Tire took my 2008 Pontiac Torrent in for inspection while I waited and had some free coffee.  I only had to get up once to look at some irregular outer front tire wear on my car when it was on the rack during inspection.  I always appreciate it when the technician lets me look at the problem.   It was nothing major.  Easily correctable with an alignment sometime in the future.  Bill was very friendly, knowledgable, and straightforward with his overall analysis of my car.  My car was fully inspected and stickered in less than an hour without my bill being jacked up with add-ons.   I recommend getting on their mailing list for their coupons!!!!!!!!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a great experience at Keystone Discount Tire. As a new customer without an appointment, they took my 2008 Pontiac Torrent in for a PA State & Emissions inspection while I waited. The shop has better reviews than others in the area, which put me at ease. During the inspection, I only had to get up once to look at some irregular outer front tire wear on my car, which the technician pointed out. It was nothing major and can be easily fixed with an alignment in the future. Bill, the technician, was friendly and knowledgeable, providing a straightforward analysis of my car. My car was fully inspected and stickered in under an hour, without any additional charges. I highly recommend signing up for their mailing list to receive their coupons.

input: Wow! I never thought my sons phone could be repaired after he dropped it but it is and it took less than a half an hour! Very professional and excellent service! I'm thrilled!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I'm thrilled! My son's phone, which I never thought could be repaired after he dropped it, was fixed in less than half an hour. The service was very professional and excellent.

input: Service and management terrible... After messing up all 4 of our orders the waiter got mad and started cursing... The manager offered our drinks to be free.. What a mess. The food was cold and nasty didn't even eat half of it and waited over an hour... I will never dine in any cracker barrel again after this experience...
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Service and management were terrible. Our orders were all messed up and the waiter became angry and started cursing. The manager offered us free drinks, but it was still a chaotic situation. The food was cold and unpleasant, so we only ate a small portion and had to wait over an hour. This experience has completely turned me off dining at any Cracker Barrel in the future.

input:
I have been to a number of dog friendly hotels...just not in the city and did not know what to expect. Usually they are motel like.  This one was in the heart of the city.

I walked tentatively into the hotel lobby as i have a labrador/golden mix who is not easy to hide.

We got to the front desk to register and i was still feeling uneasy although my  bf had assured me it was a dog friendly hotel. Reception was so nice immediately putting us at ease. As we checked in an attendant asked if Bentley could have treats which she fullly enjoyed. The Reception person also asked if we would like a welcome kit for Bentley. Holy moly. Of course. Dog dishes, a mat, treats, etc. I was blown away.  

Plus the guests at the hotel all stopped to compliment and pet "queen Bentley". Our room was on the top floor. Awesome!

Even when i went to walk her the car attendants greeted her by name. We were so impressed with the service we decided to come back an extra night. 

Thank you Loews. I didnt realize a hotel could be so dog friendly especially to a big dog.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
I have visited several dog friendly hotels before, but they were usually more like motels and not in the city. This particular hotel was located in the heart of the city. Initially, I was hesitant because I have a Labrador/Golden mix who is not easy to conceal.

Upon entering the hotel lobby, I felt unsure, but my boyfriend assured me that this hotel was indeed dog friendly. The receptionist immediately made us feel welcome and at ease. While checking in, an attendant even asked if our dog, Bentley, would like some treats, which she thoroughly enjoyed. Additionally, they offered us a welcome kit for Bentley, which included dog dishes, a mat, treats, and more. I was pleasantly surprised by this level of accommodation.

Furthermore, other guests at the hotel stopped to compliment and pet Bentley, referring to her as "queen Bentley." Our room was located on the top floor, which was fantastic. Even the car attendants remembered Bentley's name when we went out for walks. We were so impressed by the exceptional service that we decided to extend our stay by an extra night.

I am sincerely grateful to Loews for their incredible dog friendly accommodations, especially for a large dog like Bentley.

input: Sometimes this food is very very good.  Unfortunately it's not consistent.   Ordered something I've been getting for years and every other time it tastes incredible. It's like they have different people in the kitchen and you don't know who you will get. So 50 % of the time it's excellent.  UGH.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food is occasionally excellent but lacks consistency due to different chefs in the kitchen, making it a hit or miss experience. Around 50% of the time, it tastes incredible, while the other times are disappointing.

input:
Been to this location twice and will never go back again!!!!

First time was mediocre, the second time was so very disappointing it beggars belief. I ordered some ribs and had to send them back because one half was warm and the other half was refrigerator cold. They came back and one side was really hot and the other side was still cold, third time it was edible. The manager came over the third time to apologize, never once offered to comp anything. I'm not the kind of guy to cause a fuss to get something comped, but to send something back three times to get it cooked properly and only get an insincere apology really pisses me off, enough for me to write this review.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Visited this location twice, but will not return again. The first visit was average, while the second visit was extremely disappointing. Ordered ribs and had to send them back twice due to half being warm and half being cold. The third attempt resulted in an edible dish. The manager apologized on the third try, but did not offer any compensation. I am not one to create a scene for freebies, but the lack of sincere apology after sending back the dish three times frustrates me enough to write this review.

input:
After trying a few ramen places with crazy variety in their selections and stellar broth, I was not too excited about the ramen I got at Cheu.  Maybe it's a matter of taste, but personally, I was not a fan of their thick noodles, and extremely salty broth.  

The service was great, and they had a nice selection of beers!  The friend I went with loved it, and has been many times.  Honestly, I'm just sorry I wasn't a bigger fan.  But I hope others try it for themselves.  I might just be an oddball out on this one.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I didn't enjoy the ramen at Cheu due to their thick noodles and extremely salty broth, despite trying other ramen places with great variety and delicious broth. However, the service was excellent and they had a good beer selection. My friend, who has been there multiple times, loved it. Though I personally wasn't a fan, I encourage others to give it a try as my opinion may be an outlier.

input:
Federal Doughnuts is a new concession at the ballpark -- who doesn't love some doughnuts and fried chicken?  

Also, there is now a concession stand near 136 that is gluten-free dedicated.  They offer pizza, cheesesteaks and even brownies and cookies.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Federal Doughnuts is a new concession at the ballpark, serving both doughnuts and fried chicken. Additionally, a gluten-free dedicated concession stand is now available near 136, offering a variety of items such as pizza, cheesesteaks, brownies, and cookies.

input:
Looks like there is a second Red Kings restaurant in Chinatown and it did not disappoint! Since this place just opened yesterday, I'm not exactly sure if it's replacing the other Red Kings down the street, or if it is just a second helping of spicy, Szechuan food.

We ordered takeout and picked up the Dan Dan Noodles and a shredded Pork in Garlic sauce dish. The spice level in both dishes was perfect.  Extremely mouth-burning, but with delicious flavors that were sweet, earthy, and fresh. The portions were very generous and will make for great leftovers for us. I can't wait to try some of the other dishes and come back here for a sit-down dinner. They also have karaoke rooms upstairs, plus they are BYOB.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: There is a new Red Kings restaurant in Chinatown that opened yesterday. It is unclear if it is replacing the other Red Kings or if it is a second location. We ordered takeout and got the Dan Dan Noodles and shredded Pork in Garlic sauce, both of which had the perfect level of spice. The flavors were sweet, earthy, and fresh. The portions were generous, providing leftovers. We are excited to try more dishes and return for a sit-down dinner. Additionally, the restaurant has karaoke rooms upstairs and allows BYOB.

input: This is one of the busiest Chick fil A's I've seen but they always manage to be quick and have exceptional service! I seriously don't know how they can be so quick and great all the time! One of my favorite places!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This busy Chick fil A consistently delivers outstanding service with impressive speed. Their ability to maintain this level of excellence is astonishing. Truly one of my favorite places.

input: Best place for salads! I go there every time I'm in town for lunch. It's fast and veggies are always fresh.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The best place for salads in town! Fast and always fresh veggies. I go there for lunch every time I visit.

input: My parents and I took the Oak Alley and Laura Plantation tour on September 26th, 2015.  I forgot the name of our driver-he was very informative on our drive to the plantations.  The schedule is perfect!  We were dropped off where we had time before and after the tour for free time to walk around the properties.  They are very flexible with drop off locations on the return drive.  We got off near Jackson Square and got to enjoy the rest of the afternoon in the French Quarter.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: On September 26th, 2015, my parents and I took the Oak Alley and Laura Plantation tour. The driver was knowledgeable and provided us with valuable information during the drive. The schedule allowed ample time for exploring the plantations before and after the tour. Additionally, the drop off locations on the return drive were flexible. We were dropped off near Jackson Square, giving us the opportunity to spend the rest of the afternoon in the French Quarter.

input: We have been here twice for brunch and have enjoyed it immensely. Everything we have tried has been delicious, particularly the grits with scallions and sour cream. But the room is always freezing so be sure to bring a sweater!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We've been here twice for brunch and loved it. The food is delicious, especially the grits with scallions and sour cream. However, don't forget to bring a sweater as the room is always freezing.

input: Love this place...best hot dogs and chili dogs around...i go here as many times as i can..yum
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I absolutely love this place! It has the best hot dogs and chili dogs around. I make sure to visit as often as possible because they are so delicious. Yum!

input: Sweet spot in the Waterline. Came for some live music with friends on Saturday. Very cool. Best local beer in town by far. Seems like the concept is a few notches up from Fig Mountain. Definitely prefer Topa. Even cooler is that you can order incredible food from the Nook Restaurant, and walk two feet into Lama Dog which is part of the Waterline. I love it!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The Waterline has a sweet spot with live music, making it a cool place to hang out with friends on Saturdays. They offer the best local beer in town, especially when compared to Fig Mountain. Personally, I prefer Topa. What's even better is that you can order amazing food from the Nook Restaurant and conveniently walk just a few feet to Lama Dog, which is part of the Waterline. I absolutely love it!

input:
Great customer service! We were a little out of their pick up area but they were very accommodating and came and got our group of 7. When we got there we realized we were billed for 8 instead of 7. I called and he refunded my money for the extra ticket in minutes!

The tour itself was SO much fun! We were laughing and smiling and our tour guide was funny! We saw lots of alligators! From babies swimming in the water to full grown ones! We saw turtles and birds too! Our tour guide had a baby alligator we could hold that he's raising until it's a little bigger since it was a late hatch that would have died because of when it was born. The ride back was fun too because we went fast and the guide did some "tricks" with the boat! I highly recommend this tour!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
Excellent customer service! Despite being slightly outside of their pick-up area, they went out of their way to accommodate our group of 7. Upon arriving, we noticed an overcharge for 8 instead of 7 tickets. A quick call and they promptly refunded the extra ticket cost.

The tour itself was incredibly enjoyable! Our tour guide was hilarious, and we had a great time laughing and smiling throughout. We had the opportunity to see numerous alligators, from adorable babies swimming in the water to majestic, full-grown ones. Turtles and birds were also a part of the experience. Additionally, our guide had a baby alligator that we could hold, which he was raising until it grew a little more. This alligator was a late hatch, and it would not have survived had he not intervened. The return boat ride was equally thrilling as we sped along, and the guide even treated us to some impressive boat tricks. I highly recommend this tour!

input: Westfall replaced our roof in April. We could not be more pleased with the entire process. Quality roof, excellent communication and excellent follow up. Very happy we chose this company to replace our roof.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We are extremely satisfied with Westfall's roof replacement services in April. Their exceptional communication, quality roof, and excellent follow-up made the entire process a great experience. We are glad we chose this company for the job.

input: Good food, reasonably priced, and nice staff. Not ideal for eating in, but since they are going for a fast food approach to vegan food, that makes a lot of sense. I know the buffalo bella is the dish that they push the hardest, but for my money the Cheesesteak is the way to go. And pro-tip: Get the sweet potato fries.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great value with tasty vegan options and friendly staff. While it may not be the best spot for a sit-down meal, their fast food approach suits their concept well. The buffalo bella is their recommended dish, but I personally recommend trying their delicious Cheesesteak. Don't miss out on their fantastic sweet potato fries!

input: The ramen is okay, nothing spectacular. Service is okay. Good place for a quick stop but wouldn't go if there were other choices. Been here twice, will continue to go.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The ramen is average, with nothing exceptional about it. The service is also satisfactory. It's a decent place for a quick meal, but I wouldn't choose it if there were other options available. Despite that, I have been here twice and plan to visit again in the future.

input: A menu that satisfies everyone's cravings! Clean, trendy, and delicious! I definitely recommend going early (before 9 am) as the wait tends to get longer after 9 am! But honestly, it is soooo worth the wait. You will leave there feeling so incredible satisfied!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Satisfy all cravings with our clean, trendy, and delicious menu! For the best experience, we recommend going early (before 9 am) to beat the wait, as it tends to get longer later on. But trust us, the wait is absolutely worth it! You'll leave feeling incredibly satisfied.

input: Had the brisket sandwich with two sides and a drink for 9.99 - Great barbecue at an affordable price. Wonderful side such as potato casserole cream spinach baked beans green beans
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Had the brisket sandwich with two sides and a drink for 9.99 - Affordable price with great barbecue. Amazing sides like potato casserole, cream spinach, baked beans, and green beans.

input: The food and service was amazing! I only wish they had any vegetarian/vegan options. Can't wait to come back!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Food and service were amazing, though it would be even better if they offered vegetarian/vegan options. Can't wait to return!

input: Great food. Terrible customer service. I've been three times and I've had two different older waitresses. Not pleasant to deal with whatsoever. The owner on the other hand is lovely.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Good food, but poor customer service. Experienced this twice with two older waitresses who were unpleasant to deal with. However, the owner is lovely.

input: I first heard about this place on the plane ride over from a Franklin local.  He recommended that we brave the line and try one of Nashvilles best breakfast spots.  HE WAS RIGHT.  Holly cow this place kicked butt and we didn't even have to wait in line!! We were lucky to miss the rush said our waitress.   I had this super savory corn pancake with bacon, salsa, and sour cream. So good. This place will always be a stop when I get back to the south~~~
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: During my plane ride, a local from Franklin recommended a popular breakfast spot in Nashville. He was right - the place was amazing and we didn't have to wait in line. Our waitress mentioned that we were lucky to avoid the rush. I tried a delicious savory corn pancake with bacon, salsa, and sour cream. This place has earned a permanent spot on my list when I return to the south.

input: OMG!!! I can't believe this kind of service exists!  My husband called to make an appointment for full detailing for next Sat with Michael, he called again to confirm on Fri before we head there since it's a distance from our home.  Michael said he didn't know we wanted to do full detailing thou we specifically mentioned that.  He advised us to come the following sat instead.  We agreed and we reached there at 8am on the following week.  Guess what?  Nobody is at the workshop, it's closed!  We called him and he said he is busy and will call back.. We waited for half an hour in our car and there is still no call from him.  We headed for our breakfast and came back again at 9:30am hoping to give him another chance.  Here comes Alex, his partner opening the shop at 9:30am!  1.5 hours away from our appt time and still no sight of Michael.  Alex tried calling Michael and couldn't get hold of him.  We gave up!!! What a horrendous experience!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had a terrible experience with a detailing service. After calling and confirming our appointment for full detailing with Michael for the following Saturday, we arrived to find the workshop closed. We called him and he said he was busy and would call back, but never did. We returned later and his partner, Alex, opened the shop 1.5 hours after our scheduled appointment time. Michael was still unreachable. It was a horrendous experience.

input: I had numerous things happen during my move and required additional services from this office. The guys in this office are top notch and are very trustworthy. I'd say more about how they took great care of me, but they may have gone above and beyond what they should have and afraid to say too much. I would recommend this office to my mother!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I needed extra services during my move and the office staff was excellent, trustworthy, and went above and beyond to take care of me. I highly recommend them, even to my mother!

input: We stayed at The Saint last year for a girl's trip. The lobby is lovely, they have a cool bar and restaurant that you can't help but to "ohh and ahh" over when you walk in.  All the things I'm accustomed too when I stay at a hotel anywhere...ambiance, a little sexy but not overkill! Everyone is so friendly, etc.  I'm thinking "oh shhhh this is going to be a great weekend!"  I checked in a few hours before my girl arrived because I had a ton of work i needed to do. So I set up my laptop ordered some room service and worked for about 4 hours straight. Left out to buy a bottle and get a mani/pedi.  My girl arrives...its about to be some trouble in NOLA... the two of us and no supervision...we pop out for dinner, come back in giggling as usual and we see it...a HUGH flying roach.  I'm freaked out.  I literally walk right out of the room down to the front desk.  I CANNOT!!!! They tell me they're sending a maintenance worker to handle it.  NOT GOOD ENOUGH! If there's one that's bold enough to show itself, he has other cohorts that prefer to live behind the scenes. They give us another room but tell me they can't do more until 8am.  No the room the move us too also has small spiders and other dead small bugs in the corners of the window. The TV doesn't work and one of the lamps doesn't have bulbs in it! COME ON!  At this point its about 3am and I know I'm not staying here past 8:15am. I dont want to sit my purse let alone my luggage in this hotel! I go online to my normal go to hotel, The W and book us there for the rest of the trip! 8am comes and goes no manager comes to our room. I go down and demand to see someone immediately.  This younger gentlemen comes out and apologizes.  I thank him for his apology and politely request ALL of my money back immediately.   He obliged and asked if  I would consider coming back after changes have been made! Bless his heart. NO dear!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We stayed at The Saint last year for a girl's trip. The lobby, bar, and restaurant were lovely and impressive. The hotel had a friendly ambiance. However, I encountered some issues during my stay. When I checked in early to work, I found a huge flying roach in the room. The front desk sent a maintenance worker, but I wasn't satisfied. They moved us to another room, which had small spiders and dead bugs in the window corners, a non-functional TV, and a lamp without bulbs. Disappointed, I decided to book another hotel. The next morning, I demanded a refund from the hotel manager, who apologized and complied. I declined their offer to return after improvements.

input:
Say you decide that you need a new door...and you only have $35.  Where do you go?  the Green Project. 

Or you have a bunch of left over building supplies, random bits of lumber, some roofing materials, maybe even some paint?  Where can you bring it so it doesn't end up in a landfill?  Again, the Green Project.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: If you need a new door with a limited budget of $35, you can find it at the Green Project. Additionally, if you have extra building supplies like lumber, roofing materials, or paint that you don't want to dispose of in a landfill, you can bring them to the Green Project.

input:
Worst place I've ever visited. The bouncer was rude and he didn't have to be. This place thinks just cause your on broadway you can treat people bad and over charge. 
 I'm not a tourist I live here and will never visit or recommend
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Terrible experience at a place on Broadway. Rude bouncer and unjustified high prices. Despite being a local, I will never visit or suggest going there.

input: Stopped in for the lunch menu with my girlfriend, place was extremely clean, food was ON POINT!  And AFFORDABLE Can't wait to go back!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Visited for lunch with my girlfriend. The place was very clean, the food was excellent, and reasonably priced. Looking forward to returning soon!

input:
So disappointing on so many levels. Have been coming here for years - and the quality of food has fallen off a cliff. Strike one - we shared an artichoke to start - and clearly it had been prepared beforehand (eg, cold on the inside - but the flesh was cooked through)  Strike two - my wife had a Greek salad - and it clearly all came from a bag and was extremely overdressed with tasteless dressing.  Strike three - I had grilled yellowtail which was basically execrable - could not even finish it (overcooked and an inferior-frozen piece of fish - unacceptable for SB). 

In short - great setting, good service - but with such horrible food - not worth the visit. This place really needs to up the quality of food - or it's going to end up just another lower State dive for the tourists.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is highly disappointing on multiple levels. Despite being a longtime customer, the quality of the food has drastically declined. First, the artichoke we shared was clearly prepared in advance and served cold on the inside, with only the flesh being properly cooked. Then, my wife's Greek salad seemed to have been entirely made from a bag and was excessively dressed with a tasteless dressing. To add to our disappointment, the grilled yellowtail I ordered was overcooked and of poor quality, likely a cheap frozen piece of fish. This is completely unacceptable, especially considering the reputation of Santa Barbara (SB) for its food. Although the setting is great and the service is good, the subpar food makes it not worth visiting. Unless they improve the quality of their dishes, this place is at risk of becoming just another mediocre spot for tourists in the lower State area.

input:
Milktooth is the place to go if you want a good breakfast cocktail and a twist on traditional brunch. At first glance of the menu, you may think you've never heard of any of these foods for breakfast, and you may be right. I guarantee no matter what you order, you're going to enjoy it. 

Milktooth is one of the most popular brunch places in Indy, which means you will typically have a wait. Trust me, it's worth the usual 30 minute wait (on weekends). To make it go by a little faster, they've got a walk up bar for their coffee drinks and pastries. Snack on one of those to give you a preview of the amazing meal you're about to have.

Their menu changes from time to time but they have a few things that stay one the menu but change ingredients. I love all of their variations on a Dutch pancake, and their raclette grilled cheese is to die for.  If you're making this a boozy breakfast, don't pass up on the michelada. And sit outside if it's warm enough!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Milktooth is a popular brunch spot in Indy known for its unique breakfast cocktails and twist on traditional brunch. Despite the wait, usually around 30 minutes on weekends, it is definitely worth it. They have a walk-up bar for coffee and pastries to help pass the time. The menu changes occasionally, but they have delicious variations of Dutch pancakes and a mouthwatering raclette grilled cheese. For those looking for a boozy breakfast, the michelada is a must-try. If the weather permits, sitting outside is a great option.

input:
The bar and staff are AMAZING. we got a room upgrade for have been being on our honeymoon and the view was gorgeous. But, the room was not any better than a hilton. It had rust in the tub floor, and some weird stains on the tile. But this was only in the bathroom, so i give it 4 stars! Great staff, but too much for valet so we parked a couple streets down. That was the only other con I would say. 

Would recommend if you want to be literally in the working downtown area of st. louis. Lots of cool bars and restaurants on a friday night.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The bar and staff were amazing. We received a room upgrade for being on our honeymoon with a gorgeous view. However, the room was not better than a Hilton and had rust and stains in the bathroom. Despite this, I would still give it 4 stars. The valet parking was too expensive, so we parked a few streets away. Overall, I would recommend it if you want to be in the downtown area of St. Louis with plenty of cool bars and restaurants on a Friday night.

input: I took the beginning class there, and I loved it. It was perfectly paced, and though the moves weren't difficult, they really stretched me in places I didn't know existed! I even broke a small sweat! But I felt great afterwards! The studio is clean, and I like that I can buy some Beyond Organic food items there too.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I enjoyed taking the beginning class at the studio. The pace was perfect and the moves challenged me in unexpected ways. I even worked up a sweat! After the class, I felt great. The studio is clean and I appreciate the option to purchase Beyond Organic food items there.

input: Not sure why it took until now for us to find this place. We started out going to the chain lobster restaurant but wanted something more authentic. A friend recommended Lobster Haven and I checked it out online. Looked like a type of place we would eat at in Massachusetts when we visit family. We were not disappointed! Service was great, fast and very friendly. Huge selection of all of the favorites. You have to visit this place if you want authentic New England seafood. You can also purchase live lobster and fresh seafood to go and cook it yourself.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We were initially going to a chain lobster restaurant but decided to find something more authentic. A friend suggested Lobster Haven, which had a similar vibe to the places we eat at in Massachusetts when we visit family. We were pleasantly surprised by the great and fast service, as well as the friendly staff. The menu offered a wide selection of New England seafood favorites. Additionally, if you're interested in cooking your own seafood, you can purchase live lobster and fresh seafood from here. It's definitely worth a visit for those seeking authentic New England seafood.

input: Fabulous! Best happy hour, fresh menu, Delish- drinks, if I had the time, I'd come here every day!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Best happy hour with a fresh and delicious menu. If I had more time, I'd come here daily!

input: Men's clubs is the tits, plain and simple. All the barbers got skills enough to hook it up fresh. Been coming here for 3 years and I've never had any problems. Except for maybe that one time when this dude tried to steal my cut. Tim kept it real though and said "I can't give you the same cut as Ryan." Thanks Tim.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Men's clubs is a fantastic place with highly skilled barbers who always provide fresh hairstyles. I have been a loyal customer for 3 years without any issues, except for one incident where someone attempted to take my haircut. Thankfully, Tim, one of the barbers, was honest and explained that he couldn't replicate Ryan's cut. Grateful for Tim's honesty.

input: My husband and I come here often. We love the food here, it's always fresh and the service is great. We highly recommend this place to anyone who loves sushi & hibachi.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We frequently visit this place and absolutely love it. The food is consistently fresh and the service is exceptional. We highly recommend it to sushi and hibachi enthusiasts.

input:
Oh Chickie's and Pete's, you are the perfect place to watch some sports and indulge. 

No doubt this is not the best food I've ever had but, if you can get a seat, grab some beer with mussels red and crab fries, there's no way not to thoroughly enjoy this place during a game or any time you're down by the stadiums. 

My favs are the crab fries, mussels red (white is overloaded with garlic that I can't always take it), the spicy pull and peel shrimp, steamers, and if the mood is right the blue crabs (it's a lot of work but tasty). This place also makes getting down and dirty with your food easy. There are sinks all over so you can rinse the mess off your hands once you're done....good touch.

To sum it up, Chickie's and Pete's is a Philadelphia institution and always a good time. I strongly suggest going at least once to enjoy the experience. 

Please note: Make sure to remember two things before coming during major sporting events. 1. You'll never get a table and 2. You'll deal with a ton of drunk people. I've absolutely been one of these people before and we can get annoying unless you're in the right frame of mind. :)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Chickie's and Pete's is a great place to watch sports and enjoy some indulgent food. While the food may not be the best, the crab fries, mussels red, spicy pull and peel shrimp, steamers, and blue crabs are favorites. The restaurant is also equipped with sinks for easy clean-up. Overall, it is a Philadelphia institution and highly recommended to visit at least once. However, during major sporting events, it can be difficult to get a table and there will be a lot of drunk people.

input:
Prompt and professional. On a Saturday.
Simple mirror fix, but they made it easy for me. I have used them in Charlotte and they were great then, too.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Effortless mirror fix. Exceptional service in both Charlotte and now.

input: Good choice in Union Station St. Louis.  I had the Ponchartrain (server said it is same as Tilapia, though that was also on the menu, so why two names for the same fish, I have no clue).  The Ponchartrain was quite good with mushrooms and a cream sauce.  We also had the shrimp cocktail and lump crab cake appetizers....both fine, but not wonderful.  Drinks and service were perfectly acceptable.  We dined outside on the patio since the weather was nice - inside looks comfy and a bit less casual.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Union Station St. Louis is a good choice for dining. I had the Ponchartrain which was quite good, similar to Tilapia although it was listed separately on the menu. The dish came with mushrooms and a cream sauce. We also tried the shrimp cocktail and lump crab cake appetizers, which were decent but not exceptional. The service and drinks were satisfactory. We opted to dine outside on the patio due to good weather, but the interior looked cozy and slightly more formal.

input: I stopped in for a drink yesterday and have to say the atmosphere gets an A+ from me.  Such a unique concept for the St. Pete area.  The attention to detail with the remodel was outstanding, it almost feels like you are in a Harry Potter movie or something.  There is background music that is set at a low volume so you can clearly hear your friends or not have to shout for them to hear you - perfect for the old library-esque environment. Working behind the bar were Michael and Peggy - both couldn't have been more friendly and were overall just interesting people to talk to.   I had eaten dinner already before I came so can't speak on the food but will definitely be back to try - the prices for meat/cheese trays are much better than comparable places in the area.  I would definitely recommend checking this place out...
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I visited yesterday and was very impressed with the atmosphere. It's a unique concept for St. Pete, with outstanding attention to detail in the remodel. It feels like being in a Harry Potter movie. The background music is played at a low volume, allowing for easy conversation without shouting. Michael and Peggy, the bartenders, were friendly and interesting to talk to. Although I didn't try the food, I plan to return because the prices for meat/cheese trays are better than other places in the area. I highly recommend checking this place out.

input: Yes! I love this place! Maple Street Patisserie is the bomb.com! I've never been disappointed. Best blueberry muffin I've ever had in my whole entire life. Delicious breakfast and lunch spot. They also do specialty cakes so swing by during Mardi Gras and grab a king cake. Also the owner, Ziggy, is the man. He's always running around working crazy hours to make all these scrumptious baked goods. Can't beat this place :)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I absolutely love Maple Street Patisserie! It's the bomb.com and I've never been disappointed. Their blueberry muffins are the best I've ever had. They serve delicious breakfast and lunch, and even have specialty cakes. During Mardi Gras, don't forget to grab a king cake. The owner, Ziggy, is amazing and works tirelessly to make all the scrumptious baked goods. You can't beat this place!

input:
Really good burger. I had the Bourbon Black and Bleu. It was cooked like I wanted and very tasty. 

I gave them 3 stars for the wait. We had a big party - 4 adults and 5 kids - and it took over an hour to get our food. Shouldn't have taken that long, regardless of how many people were at our table.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great burger in the form of the Bourbon Black and Bleu, cooked to perfection and incredibly flavorful. However, the service fell short as we had a large party with 4 adults and 5 kids, and it took over an hour to receive our food. Regardless of the size of our group, the wait time was excessive. Rating: 3 stars.

input: It seems to me that whenever we have out of towner guests, our go to place is consistently Katie's. The variety of food wonderfully prepared is 2nd to none. Reasonably priced and delicious, Katie's never disappoints. Whether you choose the grilled ersters, the shrimp and grits, the Cuban sandwich, pizza, or soup & salad you will be very pleased and have a great meal. Daily specials hi-lite local seasonal offerings that keep things fresh. The service staff are warm and friendly. On Sunday's, you will want to time your arrival before church let's out or you will have a bit of a wait. That said, you can always manage while enjoying bottomless Mimosas!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Whenever we have out-of-town guests, our go-to place is consistently Katie's. The variety of deliciously prepared food is unmatched, and the prices are reasonable. Katie's never disappoints - whether you choose the grilled oysters, shrimp and grits, Cuban sandwich, pizza, or soup and salad, you will have a fantastic meal. The daily specials highlight local seasonal offerings, keeping things fresh. The service staff is warm and friendly. On Sundays, make sure to arrive before church lets out to avoid a wait. However, you can always enjoy bottomless mimosas while waiting.

input:
Came in after attending the Zurich Classic golf tournament. It was a warm and a bit humid so what tastier then a ice cream cone? I lucked out and found a parking space on the street. The interior is quite cute and comfy.

The selection here is crazy huge but after sampling a couple of unusual flavors I went with the scoop of cookie monster ice cream on a cone. The ice cream hit the spot and I enjoyed it BC it wasn't overly sweet.

Creole Creamery was definitely worth checking out!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Visited Creole Creamery after attending Zurich Classic golf tournament. The interior is cute and comfy. Huge selection of flavors, but ended up choosing a scoop of cookie monster ice cream on a cone. Not overly sweet and hit the spot. Creole Creamery is worth checking out.

input: I LOVE this place!  I have been coming here for a few years now.  Its a little funky, and I would never order say the escargot, for safety reasons, but when it comes to lots of Saki, great rolls, and mountains of rice and Sashimi, this is the way to go.  Young atmosphere, loud dance music, and SAKI!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love this place! I've been coming here for a few years. It's funky, but great for lots of Saki, delicious rolls, and plenty of rice and Sashimi. The atmosphere is young and lively, with loud dance music. And did I mention SAKI?

input: We absolutely love everything we have tried here. Our favorite thus far has been the Backyard Bowl, although there are several more that we still need to try. My husband and I are always full after we each get a kids size, or split a large. The ingredients are good quality,  filling foods. For the quality of ingredients, the price is very reasonable. It can get pretty busy here, but have patience, it is worth the wait.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We love everything we've tried here, especially the Backyard Bowl. We always leave full after getting a kids size or splitting a large. The ingredients are high quality and filling. The prices are reasonable considering the quality. It can be busy, but it's worth the wait.

input: It's was okay service was a bit on the interesting side as the person was new. Food presentation was good though they need to either add rice or more potato salad to the gumbo. Sprite was flat but I didn't need it anyways.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Service was average, the person serving seemed inexperienced. Food presentation was good, but the gumbo could use either more rice or additional potato salad. The Sprite was flat, but it wasn't necessary for me.

input: This is a pretty good pancake place, but it's a little disorganized in the way it's run when it's really busy. The pancakes are pretty good but super sweet, so you have to be in there. Good price point. Serves breakfast all day so that's definitely a plus, but not anything particularly special that you couldn't get anywhere else.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This pancake place is decent, but lacks organization during busy times. Pancakes are tasty but overly sweet. Prices are reasonable, and they serve breakfast all day. However, there's nothing outstanding or unique compared to other places.

input:
Great finds and wonderful staff! 
LOVE our finds and will definitely be back!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We love the great finds and wonderful staff! We will definitely be back!

input: We've been coming here since I was a kid. The staff has watched me and now my kids grow up. They're personable and so nice. They're also very prompt with service. Yoli and frank are the absolute best! The food is amazing! I absolutely love their shredded beef burro and cheese crisp. I feel they have true authentic Mexican food.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We've been loyal customers here since my childhood. The staff has witnessed the growth of both me and my kids, and they have always been friendly and attentive. Yoli and Frank stand out as exceptional individuals. Additionally, the prompt service is praiseworthy. The food offered here is simply amazing, especially their shredded beef burro and cheese crisp, which are my personal favorites. I genuinely believe that they serve authentic Mexican cuisine.

input:
Dine-in gets 2 stars. Disappointing service & venue falls short. 

The food was ok; so if you were to do take out, maybe this place would get 3 stars. 

I ordered the lamb kebab, which tasted ok; but it was very plain. No sauces, lettuce or anything - just meat.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Dine-in receives 2 stars due to disappointing service and a venue that falls short. The food is okay, making it possible to give this place 3 stars for takeout. Specifically, the lamb kebab lacked flavor and accompaniments such as sauces or lettuce, being just plain meat.

input: The best middle eastern restaurant in this area!! Food is great and consistent!! Makes my tummy happy!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The top Middle Eastern restaurant in the area with consistently delicious food that always satisfies.

input: I cannot even believe someone gave this place one star. Here's the scoop. They have the BEST cannoli in the city. Termini's are no where NEAR as good, and Isgro's is far too hyped up for the quality. Potito's is my go to for cannoli, i wouldn't even THINK about going anywhere else. I'm there every xmas eve, and will be for the rest of my days. I stood in line for isgros for TWO HOURS this year for a tirimisu, i walked right into potito's and picked up my bambino cannoli stuffed cannoli. it's as good as it sounds, trust me.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I can't believe someone gave this place one star. Potito's has the best cannoli in the city, far better than Termini's or the overrated Isgro's. It's my go-to spot for cannoli, especially on Christmas Eve. I waited two hours at Isgro's for tiramisu this year, but at Potito's, I walked right in and got my delicious bambino cannoli stuffed cannoli. Trust me, it's amazing.

input: Truly, I cannot say enough good things about this tiny, authentic, perfectly delicious eatery!  Growing up in the panhandle of Texas, we had plenty of authentic Mexican food in our home, and I'm always searching for good Mexican restaurants. El Limon is the best I've ever had in the state of Pennsylvania!  Sopes, tostadas, enchiladas, fajitas, burritos, fish tacos....all excellent and sooooo reasonable!  Waitstaff is always pleasant and attentive.  Best two features: homemade tamales and free margaritas!!  Bring the entire family for an amazing Mexican feast!  Ole!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: El Limon is a tiny, authentic, and delicious eatery. It is the best Mexican restaurant in Pennsylvania. They serve excellent dishes such as sopes, tostadas, enchiladas, fajitas, burritos, and fish tacos. The prices are very reasonable. The waitstaff is pleasant and attentive. The best features are their homemade tamales and free margaritas. Bring the family for an amazing Mexican feast at El Limon! Ole!

input:
I'm giving this joint 4 stars because they have earned it, but they are definitely 5 star material, if they work out a few kinks. Granted, they just opened, so some of the errors I've experienced (I work in the area, so I've been there several times) will probably get worked out and they are more than willing to make corrections and accommodations when they mess up. 

But over all, the food is REALLY good. Unlike my fellow Yelp-ers, I would say that ther pizza is not their strong suit - its kinds greasy and not sure if they use 100% mozzarella - tastes like its cut with something cheaper. However, so far I've had:  

The Quaker (Chicken version) - Delicious. They make their chicken steaks with the chunky chicken, which I like much more than the shredded version. They could season the chicken more, but the cheese was melted perfectly and the veggies were fresh. 

The fries - crisp and flavorful. I didn't even need ketchup, and I always eat ketchup on my fries

The onion rings - a little greasy, but very tasty and crisp. The onions stayed in the breading and didn't slide out when you bit them (which I hate). 

Spanakopita - mine was a little over cooked, but the flavors were really good

Baklava - VERY GOOD! 

Signature Salad - The veggies they use are very fresh which will make or break a salad. Their balsamic is great too!

The (turkey) Greek Burger - one of the best turkey burgers I've ever had! The patty was moist and flavorful all on its own, but then they top it with what must be homemade tzatziki. I could eat a bowl of that stuff! My burger had romaine instead of the advertised arugula, but it was very fresh, so I didn't mind as much. I also asked for feta, which I didn't get, but that sauce made me forget all about it. 

Overall, this place is great! Provided they don't stray from the high quality standard they are setting, I will keep going back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I'm giving this joint 4 stars because they have earned it, but they are definitely 5 star material, if they work out a few kinks. They are a new establishment, so some errors I've experienced will likely be fixed over time. The food is really good overall. The pizza is not their strong suit, as it is greasy and the cheese may not be 100% mozzarella. However, the other dishes I've had so far have been delicious. The Quaker (Chicken version) was tasty with perfectly melted cheese and fresh veggies. The fries were crisp and flavorful, and the onion rings were greasy but tasty and had good texture. The Spanakopita had good flavors, although it was slightly overcooked. The Baklava was very good. The Signature Salad had fresh veggies and great balsamic dressing. The (turkey) Greek Burger was one of the best turkey burgers I've had, moist and flavorful, especially when topped with homemade tzatziki. Even with a few minor issues, this place is great overall. I will continue going back as long as they maintain their high quality standard.

input:
Planet fitness gets four stars just because it is open 24 hours. If you are looking at cheapest it's cheapest best bang for your buck . Not much motivation since bodybuilders don't go there much mostly big women . No pun intended . No discrimination I myself used to be big, although I changed that . 
Tanning bed and massage chairs and a sculpt machine and everything. Else for 20.00 a month . 9.99 - the massage and stuff and can't bring friends . All the employees are polite and helpful .
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Planet Fitness receives a four-star rating due to its 24-hour availability. It offers the best value for the least cost, making it affordable. While it lacks motivation for bodybuilders who do not frequent the gym, it is popular among larger individuals. The gym provides amenities including tanning beds, massage chairs, sculpt machines, and more for a monthly fee of $20. However, for $9.99, access to these amenities is restricted, and bringing friends is not allowed. Additionally, the employees at Planet Fitness are known to be polite and helpful.

input:
Very disappointed. We went to eat  at 2:15 on Saturday and were told the kitchen closed at 2. Their website says: Sat & Sun all day. Their website claims that they are open until 5.
I'm always a bit suspect of places that can't manage simple details like their hours on their website. It makes me wonder about the awareness to quality and other "small" items.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We were extremely disappointed when we went to eat at 2:15 on Saturday and were informed that the kitchen had closed at 2. This was contradictory to their website, which stated that they were open all day on Saturdays and Sundays until 5. input: These guys do good work, on time, and warranty their work.  I would highly recommend them!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: These guys offer exceptional, on-time services, and provide a warranty for their work. I highly recommend them.

input: Eat here at least 2 times a week. Servers are always friendly and the food is amazing. I never leave disappointed & always leave with a full stomach
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Come eat here twice a week for friendly service and amazing food that never disappoints, leaving you with a full stomach.

input:
A truly delightful find! This is the transformed Carrow's Restaurant on Plumb and Kietzke that was saved by the wrecking ball by its beautiful redwood beams and fascia. The food was fantastic. My wife had the tri-tip salad -- greens on one side of the plate with a balsamic vinagrette balanced by four good-sized slices of medium-rare tri-tip and potato "croutons" --
little heavenly bits of crunchy potatoes. I had the tri/tip/chicken combo, selecting the fresh corn salad and potato salad as my two sides. It was so good that we ordered dessert as well (not something I do regularly). The offering was lemon meringue, mudd pie, apple pie, and ice cream. We shared the first -- again delicious, with real, perfectly set and browned meringue. The prices were very reasonable for the quality of food and the experience. We've already recommended to family and friends locally, and expect to return soon. Well done!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The recently renovated Carrow's Restaurant on Plumb and Kietzke, with its preserved redwood beams and fascia, proved to be a delightful discovery. The food surpassed expectations, with standout dishes like the tri-tip salad featuring balsamic vinaigrette, medium-rare tri-tip slices, and delightful potato "croutons." I opted for the tri/tip/chicken combo, accompanied by delectable fresh corn salad and potato salad as sides. The experience was so enjoyable that we couldn't resist ordering dessert, which included lemon meringue, mud pie, apple pie, and ice cream. We shared the tasty lemon meringue, topped with perfectly set and browned meringue. The prices were reasonable considering the quality of the food and overall experience. We have already recommended this restaurant to our local family and friends, and plan to revisit soon. Kudos on a job well done!

input:
Rebecca didn't Doula my birth.  BUT, she was our nanny to our first born daughter.  Over the months of her being in my home, I realized that I looked forward to talking to her before & after work.  I was big & pregnant with Baby #2, and her information & suggestions hit home with this expectant Momma!  She was always easy to talk with, yet honest and extremely truthful!  (A trait I LOVE!!!).  She loves the special role she plays as Doula to laboring woman!!  She finds beauty and strength in that magical time.
Bec would be a great addition to your support team!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Although Rebecca didn't Doula my birth, she was our nanny and her presence in our home made a big impact. I found myself eagerly anticipating our conversations before and after work. As I was expecting my second child, her information and suggestions resonated with me as an expectant mother. Rebecca is easy to talk to, but also honest and remarkably truthful, a quality I greatly appreciate. She truly loves her role as a Doula for laboring women and sees the beauty and strength in that special time. I believe adding Rebecca to your support team would be a fantastic choice.

input: Recently had my car tinted by Orange Tint and Tune and had fantastic service.  They offer a car pick up service if you live within 4 miles of their shop which is extremely convenient.  Carlos was my technician and went over all the tint options with me and even adjusted the grade of the tint after I expressed the look that I was trying to achieve.  That's the kind of customer care that deserves 5 stars.  In addition, the receptionist was very pleasant and the owner Dustin even followed up to see how my service was.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had my car tinted by Orange Tint and Tune recently and received fantastic service. They offer a car pick up service within 4 miles, which is very convenient. Carlos, my technician, explained all the tint options and adjusted the grade to achieve the desired look. The customer care displayed deserves 5 stars. The receptionist was pleasant and the owner, Dustin, even followed up to check on my service.

input: Stayed here three nights on business.  The property is located very close to the airport but you really don't hear it.  The rooms are standard TownePlace Suite rooms with a refrigerator, stove, etc..  The area in which the hotel is located is quiet with a combination of other hotels and office buildings.  It's about a 20 minute drive to the downtown or university area.  About 5-10 minutes from Pima Air Museum.  There are not too many restaurants close by but there are some fast food options and a sandwich place called Baggins that was really good and within walking distance.  The staff of the hotel was really friendly and helpful.  The breakfast is standard continental with a couple of hot options. They also have a reception on weekday evenings.  My only complaint is that the food and drink go quickly so get there early.  You could use this as a dinner if you wanted.  I got there about 45 minutes after it started and although there was food left there were very few soft drinks left (no diet).  They could improve by keeping the area stocked throughout the period.  Anyway, the rooms are nice, beds are comfortable and area is safe.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Stayed here three nights for business. Close to airport but no noise. Standard TownePlace Suite rooms with fridge, stove, etc. Quiet area with other hotels and offices. 20 min drive to downtown and university. 5-10 min from Pima Air Museum. Limited restaurants nearby, but fast food and Baggins sandwich place within walking distance. Friendly and helpful staff. Continental breakfast with hot options and weekday evening reception. Food and drink go quickly, arrive early. Nice rooms, comfy beds, safe area.

input:
We got diverted to Tampa and decided to make the drive to Orlando but first we needed somewhere to eat. Wanting to avoid chain restaurants, yelp steered us towards this little local gem!

The ladies had the 7 oz. Tampa strip and the gents both had a 14 oz. ribeye. They grill their steaks over oak and citrus Wood and the smoky flavor is to die for! We are big fans of our smoker back home and cook our steaks this way as well, it's rare to find steak cooked over woodsmoke in most places and this was worth the side trip!  Sides were veggies and sweet potatoes. The wines on offer were so reasonably priced- most under $20 a bottle but a decent selection. They just don't mark them up 5x like most places! 

Our waitress Lisa also made great recommendations and her service was welcoming, friendly, and excellent. We are so glad we went local instead of to a chain. Bookmarking this place for a return trip next time I am in Tampa for sure!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We diverted to Tampa but decided to drive to Orlando. Using Yelp, we found a local restaurant to eat at. The ladies had the 7 oz. Tampa strip and the gents had the 14 oz. ribeye, both cooked over oak and citrus wood for a delicious smoky flavor. The sides were veggies and sweet potatoes. The wine selection was reasonably priced, with most bottles under $20. Our waitress, Lisa, provided great recommendations and excellent service. We're glad we chose a local spot and will definitely return next time we're in Tampa!

input: The owner of this location (and two others including Southampton) reached out to me after my previous review. We ended up talking for half an hour and I was very impressed with his approach to business... he's definitely the type of person I want to do business with. I returned to Saladworks on two separate occasions and the service had vastly improved. The new summer salads are wonderful!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The owner of this location, along with two others including Southampton, contacted me in response to my previous review. After a 30-minute conversation, I was impressed with his business approach and would like to engage in business with him. On two subsequent visits to Saladworks, I noticed a significant improvement in service, and I thoroughly enjoyed the new summer salads.

input: By far the best deli I have ever been to in the US. YEP, the US. Lots of crazy choices and oh it is hard to pick!! The Muffalata is so big 4 people can share. It is so tasty and amazing! Go on Saturday or Thursday night when they have live music! The special is always a good pick and don't worry there are plenty of sides to choose from. Great Chili, potato salad and of course chips. GO NOW...
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Best deli in the US with a wide range of choices. The Muffalata is huge and delicious, good for sharing with four people. Live music on Saturdays and Thursdays. The special is always a great choice, with plenty of sides available like chili, potato salad, and chips. Don't miss out, go now!

input:
My dad and I are on a cross country trip and one of our first stops was Saguaro National Park. 
We did a quick tour with Park Ranger Carolyn and loved it. She was incredibly enthusiastic and passionate about her studies on the saguaro and she was very knowledgeable. Definitely recommend both the tour and Carolyn.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: During our cross country trip, my dad and I had the opportunity to visit Saguaro National Park. We had an amazing experience with Park Ranger Carolyn, who led us on a fantastic tour. Carolyn's passion and expertise in studying the saguaro were evident, making the tour both educational and enjoyable. We highly recommend both the tour and Carolyn's guidance.

input: Came here after my husband bought home their lemon pepper wings. They have plenty of flavors. Ranging from ones you've heard of (lemon pepper, mild) to New Orleans flavors (yaka mein, noonie bird). They also have their drinks. The watermelon is to die for. I don't know what they put in it but lord help them. The location isn't the best but they're trying to put something back in the community. It's in the same section with the daiquiri shop so it's really not that bad during the day. I probably wouldn't come at night by myself. Definitely give this place a try. Hey you might even see Skip.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I tried the lemon pepper wings at this place my husband brought home. They offer a variety of flavors, including ones you're familiar with like lemon pepper and mild, as well as New Orleans flavors like yaka mein and noonie bird. I highly recommend their watermelon drink, it's incredibly delicious. The location isn't the best, but they're making efforts to contribute to the community. It's situated near a daiquiri shop, so it feels safe during the day. I wouldn't recommend going alone at night though. Give this place a try, you might even see Skip.

input:
Back to Tom Jones and time to update my review. I didn't see that odd ATM type machine that only lets you withdraw money to apply to your check. It's no longer there-used to be next to restrooms. There is still a payphone back there which I love. There are now ATM's at front entrance.
  The blue ribbon is now $3.79, but still a bargain since it includes everything: pancakes, 2 eggs, toast, sausage, bacon,juice & coffee. I ate here with my kids. My daughter's choice. Says she "loves Tom Jones". Our meals included blue ribbons, french toast, chicken, club sandwich & baked potato . Everyone gets what they like. 
   I don't smell stale smoke and would not call it dirty.  I like the "loud" orange booths. I feel like I went back in time with these and the payphone. Service is always fast and I always seem to get a different waitress. Don't know where they find these young ladies but they're good. I've seen different managers there and they are all quick and on top of things-which makes a good manager.
   Since it's my daughter's fave I'm bumping it up from 4 to 5 stars.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Updated review of Tom Jones: The odd ATM-type machine that only allowed withdrawals for checks is no longer there, but there is still a payphone at the back, which I love. They have added ATMs at the front entrance. The blue ribbon dish now costs $3.79 but still includes everything - pancakes, 2 eggs, toast, sausage, bacon, juice, and coffee - making it a bargain. During my visit with my kids, we enjoyed a variety of dishes including blue ribbons, french toast, chicken, club sandwich, and baked potato - everyone found something they liked. The restaurant does not smell of stale smoke and is not dirty. The "loud" orange booths give a nostalgic feel, as does the presence of the payphone. The service is always fast, and there seems to be a different waitress each time, all of whom are good. The different managers I have seen are quick and efficient. Since it is my daughter's favorite place, I am giving it a 5-star rating, up from 4 stars.

input: I am an amateur athlete. I first met Dr. Ferrel when I was playing softball. He was watching my game when I was severely injured.  He treated me on the field by relocating my ankle and then told me to come to his office for treatment. I told him I could not afford that as a single mom on a teacher's salary. Instead, I saw a physician. He said it would be months before I would play again. Depressed and without much hope, I reached out to Dr. Ferrel again. He did treat me as he promised. Not only did he treat me, he healed me within weeks instead of months. Over the years Dr. Ferrel has worked on me with amazing results each time. He will always be my hero...
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: When I was an amateur athlete playing softball, I met Dr. Ferrel. He was watching my game when I suffered a severe injury. Dr. Ferrel provided immediate treatment on the field by relocating my ankle and urged me to visit his office for further treatment. However, due to financial constraints as a single mom on a teacher's salary, I opted to see another physician. Despite their diagnosis that it would take months for me to recover, I felt hopeless. Eventually, I reached out to Dr. Ferrel once again out of despair. True to his word, he treated me and remarkably healed me in just a few weeks instead of the initially anticipated months. Throughout the years, Dr. Ferrel has consistently achieved exceptional results whenever I sought his expertise. Without a doubt, he will always remain my hero.

input: Always fun to go to their shows.  Entertaining and relaxed atmosphere. For a good time and good food at a fair price this is the place to go.

input: Cindy is the best! Great food and service. Food is authentic and so is the staff. Everything is made fresh and you can taste the difference from other Mexican restaurants at first bite. I would recommend to anyone that enjoys Mexican cuisine.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Cindy is the best! Authentic food, excellent service, and a staff that embodies the culture. The freshness of their dishes sets them apart from other Mexican restaurants. Highly recommended for all Mexican cuisine lovers.

input:
I've been wanting to try Trust Me BBQ for over a year now.  I stopped in there about 3 months ago and waited in line for 10 minutes with no service and left.  After reading reviews, I figured I'd give it a chance again just to see what all the fuss is about.  The food was 50/50 but the service was horrible so I'll likely never return.  The gentleman behind the counter didn't speak, smile or engage with us at all, I felt like I was at a vending machine.  Once we finally ordered, he didn't even listen to the order and put the wrong sides in our meals, we had to correct him while he was serving.  All in all, I will just stick with Down to the Bone BBQ

Pros:  BBQ Sauce is delicious, macaroni salad was different and interesting, "pulled" pork was moist.

Cons:  Chicken was more dry than a sheet of paper, inedible even with the BBQ Sauce.  Mac & Cheese was served from a pan that has probably been on the steam table for 2-3 days.  Collard Greens were very mildly flavored.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I've wanted to try Trust Me BBQ for over a year. I stopped by about 3 months ago but left after waiting in line for 10 minutes with no service. Despite reading reviews, I decided to give it another chance. The food was 50/50, but the service was horrible and I don't think I'll go back. The gentleman behind the counter didn't engage with us at all, and he made mistakes with our order. The pros were the delicious BBQ sauce, the unique macaroni salad, and moist pulled pork. On the other hand, the chicken was extremely dry, even with the BBQ sauce. The mac & cheese seemed old, possibly sitting out for days, and the collard greens lacked flavor. Overall, I prefer Down to the Bone BBQ.

input: Was in town for a week and came by this little hole in the wall.  The pa nang chicken was excellent.  I ordered one star spicy and it came quick.  Will definitely return.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Visited a small, hidden gem while in town for a week. The pa nang chicken was excellent, and my one star spicy order was served promptly. Will definitely be coming back.

input: Cinco de mayo means margaritas and sangria and all things fried... this great place does a nice job with combining flavors of several different ethnicities and backgrounds and develops recipes that are unique.  Although not touted as a "Mexican" destination they know how to rock the rock salt and pour that tequila.  They also just opened a wine bar a couple doors down for overflow and specialty bottles.  A high five for the on the rocks margaritas and house made white or red sangria - definitely worth the trip!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place excels in combining flavors from various ethnicities and backgrounds, creating unique recipes. While not strictly Mexican, they excel in making margaritas and are skilled in pouring tequila. Additionally, they have recently opened a wine bar nearby for overflow and specialty options. The on the rocks margaritas and house made white or red sangria deserve a high five and make the trip worthwhile.

input:
This small little donut bakery is located in one of Hermitage's oldest shopping centers! 

I can imagine baking donuts is a hard job, let alone running the business...it's one of those jobs that starts in the wee hours of the morning so that the donuts are freshly made daily!

Yeu, the owner, serves not only your common popular donuts, but he also serves donuts with bacon on top, apple fritters, pigs in a blanket, breakfast pastries, and  kolaches....in addition to these yummy treats...he makes doughssants....they are what seems to be a scandalous marriage of a donut and a croissant...!!!!!!!! Need I say more? Yeah...you heard me. A doughssant! Worth the trip just to eat one of these! 

Prices are considerably cheap! The doughssants are only $1.99 each! The regular donuts are about $.60 each! 

These sweet donuts are my favorite treats to buy for my kid's school teachers...and they love them! 

Coffee also served here!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This small donut bakery is located in one of Hermitage's oldest shopping centers. They start baking the donuts in the early morning hours to ensure they are fresh daily. Owner Yeu offers a wide variety of donuts, including unique options like bacon-topped, apple fritters, pigs in a blanket, breakfast pastries, and kolaches. Their specialty is the doughssant, a delectable combination of a donut and a croissant. Prices are affordable, with doughssants priced at $1.99 each and regular donuts at approximately $0.60 each. This bakery is a favorite of mine for gifting treats to my kids' teachers, who love them. They also serve coffee.

input: We have had a blast to each event we've been to.  We've been to concerts and basketball games and other were a lot of fun.  The food is really good, also.  A lot of local favorites are offered.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had a great time at all the events we attended, including concerts, basketball games, and more. The food provided was also delicious, with a wide variety of local favorites available.

input: Excellent food. We tried three appetizers and five entries and all of them were a hit. This prices are reasonable and the service is good. I'd go back again and again.

input: The service here has gone down. We used to go here a lot but now we go to another one. The service was slow and forgotten about.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The service has deteriorated causing us to switch to another place due to slow and neglectful service.

input: Hands down the worst chicken and rice plate I've ever had. When I ordered I was told there was no sauce on the chicken (as I wanted, healthy). I ordered to go, by the time I reached the car the bag was full of oil spilling out of the container. There was easily 5-7 tablespoons of oil on the dish. Not what I was told and not what anyone would ever want to eat. Horrible.   Their slogan even has the word healthy in it. What a joke.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The chicken and rice plate I had was the worst ever. Despite requesting no sauce on the chicken, I received a bag full of oil spilling out of the container. There was an excessive amount of oil, approximately 5-7 tablespoons, on the dish. It was not as described and definitely not appetizing. It's ironic that their slogan mentions "healthy." It was a disappointing experience.

input: Great experience purchasing a washer and dryer.  I just bought a new home and needed all new appliances. Iam so glad I decided to go even though the reviews were not great which I don't understand since I had no issues whatsoever. There was an excellent selection, knowledgeable salespeople and timely delivery. The level of service we received was beyond expected! I was given honest feedback and all of my questions were answered. I am very happy with Sears and I would highly recommend!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Had a great experience purchasing a washer and dryer for my new home. Despite negative reviews, I encountered no issues. The store had an excellent selection and knowledgeable salespeople. Delivery was on time and the level of service exceeded expectations. They worked hard to give me the best price and multiple budget-friendly options. Took the extra step to find additional sales prices or discounts. Honest feedback and thorough answers to my questions. Highly recommend Sears.

input: The food here is great. They're quick and the staff is so nice, seriously. I always feel welcome when I place my order here.
