Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food is amazing, the service is fast, and the staff is extremely friendly. I always feel welcome when I order here.

input: I finally got to try them. Wow..they did a great job with the remodle. I loved the mushroom cheese steak
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I tried them and I must say, the remodeled place was impressive. The mushroom cheese steak was delicious.

input: The espresso here is excellent. My favorite place to come for an Americano. The staff is polite and friendly and vibes are mellow. It is important to know that there is no access to power outlets, but unlimited wifi access. The bathrooms and the rest of the establishment are always clean.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The espresso here is excellent, my favorite place for an Americano. The staff is polite, friendly, and the vibes are mellow. Please note, there are no power outlets, but wifi is unlimited. The bathrooms and the rest of the establishment are consistently clean.

input:
Went here based on the high ratings and raves from people.  The entire experience was underwhelming from start to finish.  Their website which is fairly useless if you want to figure out the menu before going, you have to pick your location choice out of 3 locations and then drill down to the bottom to see the weak descriptions of their menu offering, no explanations and no price, just this

    Roast Beef
    Roast Beef Combo
    Roast Pork
    Roast Pork Combo
    Baked Ham
    Baked Ham Combo
    Roast Turkey
    Roast Turkey Combo
    Broccoli Rabe
    Broccoli Rabe Combo


No explanation of whats in a combo (its just where they add cheese by the way)

The table placecard (instead of menu) had a more detailed description than the website.  

When I walked in, its more bar than restaurant, no big deal, but there were tables.  Since I couldnt decide and the sandwiches werent too expensive at $6.85, I got the roast beef and roast port combos.

I got my two sandwiches fast enough, but the roast beef was cold and the roast pork was hot.  Not sure how a cook (for lack of a better word) could serve 2 things at the same time with such a temperature differential, one was obviously sitting for awhile.  I asked the waitress to reheat the roast beef while I finished the roast pork, and supposedly it was reheated, since it was warmer, but it was still cold-ish compared to my roast pork I had just finished.  The waitress did offer to replace it when she inquired, but I was in a hurry and didnt really care for a hot version of this sandwich.

The sandwiches were very skimpy on meat, but they "made up for it" by adding too much gravy to make it overly messy and the bread was disintegrating.  The menu place card mentions the "wet meat" option where you get less gravy, I strongly recommend you get it that style, especially if the gravy overpower the meat and structural integrity of the sandwich.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
I went to this place based on high ratings and raves from people. However, the entire experience was underwhelming. Their website is not helpful for figuring out the menu, with weak descriptions and no prices. The combo options have no explanations, but it turns out they just add cheese. The table placecard had more detailed descriptions than the website. 

The place itself was more like a bar than a restaurant, but I didn't mind. I couldn't decide, so I ordered the roast beef and roast pork combos since they were reasonably priced at $6.85 each.

The sandwiches were served quickly, but the roast beef was cold while the roast pork was hot. It's strange that they couldn't serve two things at the same time with the same temperature. I asked for the roast beef to be reheated, but it was still not as warm as the roast pork. The waitress offered to replace it, but I was in a hurry and didn't want a hot version of the sandwich.

The sandwiches were lacking in meat, but they compensated by adding too much gravy, making it messy and causing the bread to fall apart. The menu place card mentioned a "wet meat" option with less gravy, which I highly recommend because the excess gravy overpowered the meat and made the sandwich structurally weak.

input: Picked up takeout from Village Whiskey (so I can't review the actual restaurant). The Whiskey Burger is pricy ($26) but is amazing if you're ok with a greasier burger. Super tender, the bacon is awesome and it's pretty big. If you can get past the price then highly recommend it. The Duck Fat fries are also rich and delicious.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Village Whiskey takeout: The Whiskey Burger ($26) is amazing - super tender, bacon is awesome, and it's pretty big. It's a bit greasy though. Highly recommend if you can overlook the price. The Duck Fat fries are also delicious and rich. No review on the restaurant itself as it was takeout.

input: Blew $80 on food for the family was worth it food was hot and orange chicken best I've tasted in a awhile..now it will be the place we get Asian food!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Spent $80 on delicious food for the family. The hot and flavorful orange chicken was especially amazing. Definitely our new go-to place for Asian food!

input:
I typically do my laundry at my boyfriend's house, but I had family who recently stayed with me and had a bunch of towels, sheets, and comforters to wash.  I was searching for a laundry mat that would be safe, clean and not full of questionable people.  I was so happy to find this facility.  It is clean, well-lit, and the staff is so friendly and helpful.  I was amazed at the speed of the laundry and dryer.  I completed 4 oversize loads ( probably equal to 8 regular loads) in just under 2 hours!

This place has security cameras, flat screen T.V's, magazines, wi-fi, clean bathrooms, vending machines.  It is a wonderful atmosphere to do your laundry.  It was not overly busy, there are plenty of washers and dryers.  I am so happy that I found this place.  Thank you LAUNDROMAT!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I usually do my laundry at my boyfriend's place, but when my family stayed with me, I had a lot of laundry to do. I was looking for a safe, clean, and reputable laundry mat and was thrilled to find this facility. The facility is clean, well-lit, and the staff is friendly and helpful. I was amazed by the speed of the machines and managed to complete four oversize loads in under two hours. This place also has security cameras, amenities such as TV, magazines, Wi-Fi, clean bathrooms, and vending machines. It provides a wonderful atmosphere for doing laundry, with plenty of washers and dryers and not too crowded. I am extremely happy that I found this place. Thank you, LAUNDROMAT!

input:
We ran in for a late night dinner last night. The prices are definitely high. Both couples decided to split a plate (you could tell the annoyed our server), and the food was good- but not worth the price for sure.
I will say the garlic bread they bring out before the meal was AH-MAZING! I could have probably eaten my weight in just the bread. 

Overall - I probably wouldn't eat there again myself. But it could have been an off night. There is just too much competition in the food world around St Louis!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Last night, we went for a late night dinner and found the prices to be high. To save money, both couples decided to split a plate, which seemed to annoy our server. The food itself was good, but not worth the price. However, I must mention that the garlic bread they served before the meal was incredibly delicious. I personally wouldn't dine there again, as there is a lot of competition in the food scene around St. Louis.

input:
Stopped by to munch a burger during today's Seahawks/Saints game, and the place was, unsurprisingly, packed. For good reason, too: the Haven burger I ordered was fantastic.

I sat right next to the door, so I didn't get the chance to get more than six feet into the place; as soon as I got my meal, the place started getting busier and busier until I had to work my way through the World's Shortest People Maze to get out. Guess that means I wasn't the first person to hear about the place.

I will be going back to the Haven. Might go for, say lunch on a Tuesday, so it's less busy.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I stopped by the Haven during the Seahawks/Saints game. It was packed, but for good reason - the Haven burger I ordered was fantastic. I didn't get far into the place since I sat next to the door, as it quickly became busier. I had to navigate through a crowded maze of people to leave. I will definitely be returning to the Haven, perhaps for a less busy lunch on a Tuesday.

input:
I can only comment on the vermicelli bowls because I have never had the Pho. 

The vermicelli are a decent size and a fair price. Conveniently located if you live in the Alberta Ave neighbourhood, my orders have always been ready in 15 minutes - even on a Friday night.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I've only tried the vermicelli bowls, not the Pho. The vermicelli is a good portion size and reasonably priced. The restaurant is conveniently located in the Alberta Ave neighbourhood, and my orders are always ready in 15 minutes, even on a busy Friday night.

input: I had the Chicken Marsala recommended by our waiter. The chicken was very thin, tough, and dry. The pasta was under cooked and stuck together. There was absolutely no flavor. My friend ordered the lasagne and did not like it all. There was only a thin layer of pasta and no flavor. My other friend was still eating her dinner and they cleared her plate when she went to the restroom, after she told the waiter she was not finished. They did bring her a new meal in a doggie bag. The positives are a Great atmosphere and live music. I enjoyed dancing with my husband. However, very expensive for awful food.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had the Chicken Marsala recommended by our waiter, but it was thin, tough, and dry. The pasta was undercooked, stuck together, and had no flavor. My friend ordered the lasagne and found it equally disappointing with a thin pasta layer and no flavor. Additionally, our other friend's dinner was prematurely cleared while she was in the restroom, despite her informing the waiter she was not finished. They did provide her with a replacement meal to take home. On a positive note, the restaurant had a great atmosphere and live music, which allowed my husband and I to enjoy dancing. However, considering the terrible food, the overall experience was marred by the high prices.

input: This place is a gem.Attractive space, great location near Broad Street line, plenty on street parking. BYOB. I've been twice and enjoyed every dish. Highlights were the chaats, beef short ribs, lamb vindaloo, beet salad, breads/pickles, and chai. We got the chocolate cake for the table to share each time and everyone loved it. Can get takeout beer at the corner bar. We'll be back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is a gem with an attractive space and a great location near the Broad Street line. There is plenty of street parking available and it is a BYOB establishment. I have been here twice and enjoyed every dish, especially the chaats, beef short ribs, lamb vindaloo, beet salad, breads/pickles, and chai. We also got the chocolate cake to share at the table, which everyone loved. Takeout beer is available at the corner bar. We will definitely be returning.

input: This is my favorite restaurant!  I always order their ceviche, which is delicious.  The atmosphere is fun, and the service is great.  Alex was our server, and he was friendly, attentive and thoughtful.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love this restaurant! The ceviche is delicious, the atmosphere is fun, and the service from Alex was friendly, attentive, and thoughtful.

input: Love this store!  Who doesn't!  The salad bar is fresh and they have all types of ethnic food to try.  N-JOY
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Love this store! They have a fresh salad bar and a variety of ethnic food options to try. N-JOY!

input: Called in a Mediterranean chicken shawarma. Good flavor and they were generous with the amount of chicken in the pita. The food was ready to go when I arrived. Good service. I would revisit the next time I am in the area.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Mediterranean chicken shawarma had great flavor and generous amount of chicken in the pita. Food was ready upon arrival and service was good. I would revisit when in the area again.

input: I love this place.  The food is great and the space and staff are very pleasant.  Highly recommended for vegetarians and non-vegetarians alike.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I highly recommend this place for both vegetarians and non-vegetarians. The food is excellent and the atmosphere, as well as the staff, are very pleasant.

input: Took a while to get actual service but once we did I was happy. The gumbo was awesome and loved the chicken & waffles. Friendly staff and right on Bourbon St for good people watching!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite a delay in receiving initial service, I was pleased with the overall experience. The gumbo and chicken & waffles were impressive. The staff was friendly, and the location on Bourbon St provided ample opportunities for enjoyable people-watching.

input:
As airport grab-and-go restaurants are, Earl does a decent job with a variety of sandwich options including turkey, tuna and even a Hawaiian. But today I could smell the roast beef and so I got that one. Yum. Good portion of sliced beef that was beyond medium cooked with cheddar cheese and a yummy horseradish sauce. Nope, don't get lettuce or tomatoes on it. It's perfect the way it is.

And since it's right between the security station and the top of the D gates (right near the Delta SkyClub!), it's easy to get and eat at the gate or on board.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Earl's airport grab-and-go restaurant offers a decent variety of sandwich options, including turkey, tuna, and Hawaiian. The aroma of roast beef caught my attention today, leading me to choose that option. The sandwich consists of a generous portion of sliced beef cooked beyond medium, topped with cheddar cheese and a delightful horseradish sauce. It does not include lettuce or tomatoes, but it is perfect as is. Conveniently located between the security station and the top of the D gates, near the Delta SkyClub, it is easy to grab and enjoy at the gate or on board.

input: WOW!  What a fantastic place!  Food A+, Service A+++  We started with an appetizer of cheese curds served with a red pepper jelly.  LOVED IT!  I ordered the fish tacos and the wife ordered a beer brat for dinner.  We both thoroughly enjoyed what we ordered!  The portions were huge and priced just right for the portion size.  Our server was on it!  Very attentive and was very knowledgeable about the menu and made us feel very welcomed.  The manager stopped by and asked how everything was.  I let him know that I am pretty sure I have found a cool new place to hang out, have a beer and watch football.  He said they have great deals on game days and let us know about their brunch on the weekends.  Everyone said goodbye as we walked out and reminded us to grab a rootbeer candy on our way out.  I will be back!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Wow! What a fantastic place! Food A+, Service A+++. We loved the cheese curds appetizer with red pepper jelly. I ordered the fish tacos and my wife had the beer brat for dinner, both of which were thoroughly enjoyable. The portions were huge and reasonably priced. Our server was attentive and knowledgeable, making us feel very welcomed. The manager checked in and mentioned great deals on game days and their weekend brunch. Everyone said goodbye and reminded us to grab a rootbeer candy on our way out. We will definitely be back!

input:
I stopped in for dinner and a drink & was thoroughly pleased! I rarely order a burger when I go out to eat, because why order "out" what you can make easily a home, right? Well..... when I go back I'll have a hard time NOT getting another burger. Oh, they also have a decent beer selection and the wait staff/bartenders made me feel very welcomed too.  My food was prepared exactly as I ordered and was served quickly.  The restaurant has a nice atmosphere and the restrooms were clean.  All in all I was very happy!
.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I enjoyed dinner and a drink at the restaurant and was thoroughly pleased. Although I rarely order burgers when eating out, I was impressed and would have a hard time not getting another one. The restaurant also has a good beer selection and the staff made me feel welcomed. My food was prepared as ordered and served quickly. The atmosphere was nice and the restrooms were clean. Overall, I was very happy.

input:
Too big, too expensive and too far from Downtown.  

I was here for a conference, which seemed like an awesome idea. It wasn't.  I'm in Direct Sales and (like most people at this conference) don't have tons of extra money to spend on mediocre meals when I'm traveling.  $10 for a slice of generic pizza, small side salad and a soda for lunch.   I understand it's a hotel but there weren't any options close by.  Just getting your car from valet was a hassle and took a lot of time.  Being such a big property, it made getting to restaurants off the property really time intensive.  Since you're so far out of Nashville (out near the airport), the good little holes you find when you're in a city are pretty nonexistent.  

The property itself was great.  The hotel is HUGE but really pretty.  I enjoyed walking around but was really happy when I found what I didn't know existed...a shortcut between my room and the Convention Center.  It took my 10-15 minute walk down to about 3 minutes!  BONUS!  Like I said, this place is ginormous.  

Room: Our room was great.  I shared a wonderful suite in the Garden Conservatory with 2 other girls.  We were under a group rate and my friend was quoted $200/night, which is awesome for the space we had.  We had a large room (probably used as a hospitality suite for groups) for socializing.  It had a great bar area set-up and a nice big fridge and lots of drawer space.  Our bedroom was separated by doors that could be locked from either side (like an adjoining room), so it looked like the hospitality suite could be reserved without reserving the room.  It was different than what I was expecting, but whatevs.  It was fine.  So, I wasn't there at check-in.  The girl who reserved the room checked in a couple days earlier than my friend and I.  So, Sunday comes, and the bill was waiting for us when we woke up.  Our friend was charged $1200 for one room (I'm guessing the suite) and $1400 for the other room.  YEP.  She reserved what she thought was a 2 room suite for $200.  The bedroom door was closed when she got there and she asked them to open it up. It was all arranged by the bellman.  She was never told that the bedroom wasn't included....kind of necessary if you're staying over for 6 nights, dontcha think???  So, she's being charged $2600 for what was supposed to be $1200.  Last I heard, the Gaylord's legal department was investigating what she was told, what she wasn't told and if they should charge her the entire amount.  

Checkout:  A FREAKING NIGHTMARE.  Between the money situation, which was not resolved as of late this week, and the 45 minute wait for a cart (in a hotel that holds thousands of people, you'd think they'd be plentiful and they aren't) and a 25 minute wait for the car, my friend and I decided to sweat it out and schlep our goods to the door where our car would be delivered to us.  It was not a short walk and we had a TON of stuff, which meant multiple trips.  UGH.

I'm sure I'll be back for another conference (I am pretty sure my company has booked this for at least one more year....) but I'm not going to be happy about it.  I might even consider driving down, staying in a hotel somewhere downtown and driving out to the Conference stuff.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The hotel for the conference was too big, too expensive, and too far from Downtown. It was difficult to find affordable dining options and getting the car from valet took a lot of time. The property was large and walking around was enjoyable, but finding good places to eat nearby was challenging. Despite this, the room itself was great, with a shared suite in the Garden Conservatory at a group rate of $200/night. However, there was a billing issue, with one room being charged $1400 instead of $1200. Checkout was a nightmare, with long waits for carts and cars. Although the person may have to come back for another conference, they are not looking forward to it and may consider staying in a downtown hotel and driving to the conference.

input:
This was my first time dining at Ava and I enjoyed most of it. We ordered the Ricotta cheese & toasted bread and although the flavor was excellent, I thought the bread to cheese ratio was off quite a bit. The ricotta came in a tiny ramekin typically reserved for flavored butters, so I expected more for an appetizer. 

The two pizzas split among a couple of people were the sausage and the potato with rosemary. They were both tasty but I think they forgot the Rosemary on ours. Still yummy, tho! Another entree was the grouper w/Israeli couscous. Scrumptious!

Dessert was a must and the zeppoles, or sugared donuts, were amazing. The cherry tart a little less so, but one person at our table loved it, so maybe it was just not my cup of tea. The cherries were a sort of candied cherry-interesting, but sweet with a very dense crust. Again, just not my personal fave. 

I will definitely return to try other menu items that looked great-like the pastas made in-house daily...that's next!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I enjoyed my first dining experience at Ava. The Ricotta cheese & toasted bread had excellent flavor, but the bread to cheese ratio was off. The pizzas, sausage and potato with rosemary, were tasty, although our pizza seemed to be missing the rosemary. The grouper w/Israeli couscous was scrumptious. For dessert, the zeppoles were amazing, but the cherry tart was not my personal favorite. Overall, I will return to try other menu items, such as the daily homemade pastas.

input: 1st time eating here. Very clean, nice folks and very good sushi.  Would and will go back. Service was spot on, sushi was very fresh and reasonably priced .
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: First visit, clean, friendly staff, great sushi. Will return. Excellent service, fresh and affordable sushi.

input: This place is just the best. If you really have to ask why it's all in the name itself. If u don't like chicken then don't come here bc their birds are fly! Don't forget to try their fried corn on the cobs. It's dank!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is the best, as the name suggests. If you don't like chicken, avoid coming here because their birds are exceptional. Additionally, be sure to try their delicious fried corn on the cobs. It's amazing!

input: REALLY below average food.  Akin to waffle house.  I wanted this to be good based on the reviews but not so.  The pancakes tasted like a frozen processed version, "homemade" maple syrup was watery/sugary with fake flavoring.  Trees make authentic syrup, not people.  The hash browns were greasy and fairly tasteless. The bacon overcooked, hard and chewy.  Obviously had been sitting awhile. Overall, very uninspired food.  Unfortunately, this is one of those places that is living on an outdated "must go" reputation.  There are much better offerings in Nashville.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food at this place is well below average, similar to Waffle House. Despite positive reviews, I was disappointed. The pancakes tasted like frozen processed ones and the "homemade" maple syrup was watery and sugary with artificial flavoring. Authentic syrup comes from trees, not humans. The hash browns were greasy and lackluster, while the bacon was overcooked, hard, and chewy, indicating that it had been sitting for a while. In summary, the food lacked inspiration. Unfortunately, this restaurant relies on an outdated reputation and there are better options in Nashville.

input: Excellent.  Went there for lunch (the budget option).  Prix fixe menu was tempting.  Wife had the prime rib po'boy with the soup of the day (tomato fennel).  Both were excellent (the po'boy being an upscale interpretation, with gruyere and a really good horseradish sauce).  I had the seafood jamabalaya and seafood gumbo, also excellent (probably the best I've had).
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Went for lunch and opted for the budget-friendly prix fixe menu. Wife enjoyed the prime rib po'boy with tomato fennel soup, both were excellent. The po'boy had a delicious upscale twist with gruyere and horseradish sauce. I had the seafood jambalaya and gumbo, which were also excellent and the best I've had.

input:
We recently used Pure Design for a large event in a nearby hotel. Pure staff met with me to discuss my budget and offered beautiful, unique flower and arrangement selections. Their estimate came in well within my budget. Their staff was always professional and their expertise was obvious. The day of the event, they created such a gorgeous space with all the beautiful arrangements - our guests raved about them, even days after the event was over! I was also able to take home/give away the arrangements, which is not always the case with other florists. And the flowers lasted several days after the event.

I would highly recommend Pure for a large event.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We highly recommend Pure Design for large events. Their staff met with us to discuss our budget and provided beautiful and unique flower and arrangement selections. Their estimate was within our budget and their staff was always professional and knowledgeable. On the day of the event, they created a stunning space with gorgeous arrangements that received rave reviews from our guests. Additionally, we were able to keep/give away the arrangements, and the flowers lasted several days after the event.

input: My husband and I are not "spring chickens", but we love to Par-Tee. The server immediately welcomed us and asked about our drink preferences.  He was very knowledgeable and helpful. The beer selection was wonderful, the liquor selection divine.  The bar food, even though it was a small selection, was excellent. I had never wanted to try pork bellies (the name turned me off.) Dan ordered it, I tried it,and we now have a convert.  WE highly recommend their pork belly sliders! I hope they continue to add a few more delicious tapas.  These folks have it together and are very engaging.  We'll be back often.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite not being spring chickens, my husband and I still enjoy partying. The server immediately greeted us and inquired about our beverage preferences. He was highly knowledgeable and provided great assistance. The beer selection was impressive and the liquor selection was top-notch. Even though the bar food options were limited, they were still excellent. Initially hesitant about trying pork bellies, I gave it a shot after Dan ordered it, and we were pleasantly surprised. We highly recommend their pork belly sliders! Hopefully, they will expand their tapas menu with more delicious options. The staff is well-coordinated and engaging, making us regular customers.

input:
Average or slightly above, despite the hype.  On the expensive side.  For $10 or $12 you should get fries with your burger, not a large to share for $8.  I had a bison burger. that was the only reason I went there.  Seems we had 1 beer, 1 iced tea, 1 burger, 1 bison burger and split a large fry, for about $37.  Rather ridiculous. And they try to hard to be different or interesting, but ruin a good meal.  The bison burger was tainted with unnecessary slaw and BBQ on it to call it a Carolina bison burger.  Not worth $12 on its own.

Been there.  Done that.  No reason to go back.  Next...
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Overall, the restaurant has average or slightly above average food, despite all the hype surrounding it. However, it is on the expensive side. The pricing is unreasonable, as $10 or $12 should include fries with the burger rather than having to pay $8 extra for a large fry to share. The only reason I went there was for the bison burger, but it was disappointing, as it had unnecessary slaw and BBQ on it, making it far from a Carolina bison burger. Our bill came to around $37 for a single beer, iced tea, regular burger, bison burger, and shared large fry, which I find ridiculously high. The restaurant tries too hard to be different or interesting, but ends up ruining the overall dining experience. Consequently, there is no reason for me to go back. Next...

input:
Before I share the main issue, I want to share the reason I give any stars is because of our awesome server, LaToya. She was thoughtful and engaging! 

The black bean burger was dry. Sweet potato fries were good. 

Today while at lunch with a group of colleagues the most disturbing thing happened. I noticed the manager in a green sweater lingering around the entrance and then two cop cars with lights flashing pulled up and 3 officers rushed in walked to the table next to us that the manager was pointing to and one of the officer's proceeded to pull out their handcuffs and tell the guy delivering food to put food down at the table and hands behind his back. They escorted him near the front door and had him sit down for a moment before taking him outside in freeZing cold with no jacket where he stood for a few minutes while cops came in and out of restaurant. 

This entire thing was poorly handled, disturbing and unsettling not only to the customers but the other staff. They should have had the cops walk back away from where customers were and deal with it there. Then all the managers disappeared not available to talk to any of the customers let alone apologize or acknowledge people being unsettled. 

No one needs to know why the arrest happened but there needed to be more care for customers and staff in how it was handled. 

Not ok!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Our server, LaToya, was wonderful and provided great service. However, we found the black bean burger to be dry, while the sweet potato fries were good. During our lunch with colleagues, we witnessed a disturbing incident involving the manager and the police. The manager directed the police to a nearby table, where a delivery person was handcuffed and escorted outside in the freezing cold. This whole situation was poorly handled and unsettling to both customers and staff. The managers were unavailable and did not address the situation or apologize to those affected. It is unacceptable how this was handled, as more consideration should have been given to the customers and staff.

input: Fantastic sliders!! Perfect size that you can try more than one!  Fried chicken slider, BLT slider, monte cristo and Cuban were all fantastic!  Now for Donuts to go!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Amazing sliders in perfect size that allow you to try multiple options - fried chicken, BLT, monte cristo, and Cuban, all were fantastic! Don't forget to grab some donuts to go!

input:
They reopened up derived new management.. this was our 3rd time there. They have daily specials, which is a pretty good price, $7.95 for a plate, ice-tea and soup. Todays (Friday)special, they had Carne Asada with rice n beans, fried fish plate and 2 chicken enchiladas with rice n beans, all come with tea n soup. 

We both had the Carne asada plate but they let me substitute my rice n beans for a salad. Steak was pretty good. 

I think their specials are different everyday. So for the most part it was good all around. Oh service was good n attentive.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: They reopened with new management on our 3rd visit. They have daily specials, offering a plate, ice-tea, and soup at a reasonable price of $7.95. Today's (Friday) specials included Carne Asada with rice and beans, fried fish plate, and 2 chicken enchiladas with rice and beans, all served with tea and soup. We both opted for the Carne Asada plate, with me substituting my rice and beans for a salad. The steak was enjoyable. The specials change daily, but overall it was a good experience. The service was attentive and good.

input: Love this little shop so much for so many reasons. First off, whenever I'm on my way to Sweet Divas, I can smell the spices wafting from this little, inviting shop. Second, they have such a large range of spices that you can smell, taste a little, and purchase. Yes, there's a large overwhelming variety of spices, but fear not! Their knowledgeable staff is available and more than happy to assist you in finding the right spice you are looking for all your cooking needs. Over the years I've purchased many items from here and I can attest that they do last a long time (about a year, year and a half, including some stuff I use often!). I see all kind of specialty salts for example (onion salt, celery salt) as well as sugars and powders (lavender vanilla sugar, vanilla bean powder). Their products even seem to taste fresher (I can taste a difference between their cinnamon and nutmeg and what I can get at a dollar store, for example). The prices aren't too bad and they last long. My three bottles pictured cost about $19, but that will last a good year, so its worth it to me.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love this shop for several reasons. Firstly, the inviting aroma of spices from the shop always lures me in when I'm heading to Sweet Divas. Secondly, they offer a wide range of spices to smell, taste, and purchase. Despite the overwhelming variety, their knowledgeable staff is readily available to assist in finding the right spice for your cooking needs. I have bought numerous items here over the years, and they have proven to last a long time, typically around a year or more. They even offer specialty salts, sugars, and powders, such as onion salt, celery salt, lavender vanilla sugar, and vanilla bean powder. Additionally, their products taste fresher compared to those found at a dollar store, evident in the difference in flavor between their cinnamon and nutmeg. Although the prices are reasonable, my recent purchase of three bottles only cost around $19, which I believe is worth it considering their long-lasting quality.

input: Steve & his partner are the best! Love that he'll do a bunch of demo racquets! Great prices with lots to choose from. If you're a player this is the place to go!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Steve and his partner are the best! They offer a wide selection of demo racquets at great prices. If you're a player, this is the place to go for all your needs.

input: We went around 6 and it was more packed than I expected. I knew it would be busy but I was surprised. The staff was amazing. We waited in line for about 8 minutes regardless of it being a huge line going out side. Found a table and had our food in less than five minutes. Even with the amount of people they had, it ran so smoothly. One sandwich was messed up but it was very loud in there so I don't think she heard me correctly but someone came to our table and had a new correct sandwich almost immediately. I love that they made time to go around asking if we needed refills and how the food was. So glad to have a chick fil a in Reno. They upheld the chick fil a standards even with all the chaos of opening day.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We arrived at around 6 and the place was more crowded than expected. Despite the long line, the staff was amazing, ensuring we waited only 8 minutes. We quickly found a table and received our food in less than five minutes. Despite the large crowd, the operations ran smoothly. Though one sandwich was made incorrectly due to the noise, a staff member promptly replaced it. The attentive staff also checked in on us for refills and food satisfaction. Overall, we are delighted to have a Chick-fil-A in Reno, as they maintained their high standards even on their chaotic opening day.

input: Great, beautiful spot to do wine tasting. I loved all the wines I tried, great prices as well as service. I had a good
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: experience overall and would definitely recommend it to others.

input:
A wee bit pricey for the portions they serve. I come to Beck's for their gator gumbo over jambalaya. The whole thing is just so savory and the spices are just right. It's not overly spicy and not too salty as well. It's a great meal. The gator is in a sausage form. All chopped up into the gumbo. During this visit, I had to order their pasta. Chicken alfredo, for my 2 year old son. It was alright. The whole pasta tasted a bit dry. It's something I wouldn't get twice.

Verdict - Gator gumbo, end of story.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Beck's is a bit pricey for the portion sizes, but their gator gumbo is excellent. The flavors are savory and the spices are just right, not too spicy or salty. The gator is chopped up into sausage form and added to the gumbo. On a recent visit, I also tried their chicken alfredo pasta for my son, but it was just okay and a bit dry. Overall, the gator gumbo is the standout dish and definitely worth trying.

input: I was a little worried about seeing the reviews but everything. Was great! Not long wait time. Staff was nice from walking in the lobby and asking which way to the office, to the office staff.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was concerned about the reviews, but everything turned out great. The wait time was short, and the staff was friendly from the moment I walked into the lobby until I reached the office staff.

input: Hipsters unite!  I've never had a good time at The Taint, despite several people's attempts top tell me otherwise.  I'm not impressed by the apathy here, or the dirty-headed Garden District crapfest of regular clientele.  Boo.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Hipsters unite! I've had no fun at The Taint, despite others' claims. Unimpressed by apathy and dirty-headed Garden District crowd. Boo.

input:
Yea! Another Chick-fil-A!

Just happened to be driving down (up?) Bloomingdale looking for a new spot to eat, and saw this. OK, it's not new food, but it is a new location (opened yesterday).

The parking lot is crazy, like many in FL, but the staff outside kept the drive-thru lanes flowing. I was in line for less than ten minutes. *Every* last employee I talked to, and I talked to six, were pleasant and welcoming, just like every Chick-fil-A I've ever been to.

The food was good of course, although the fries could have been cooked a bit longer. Chick-fil-A sandwhcih was on poojnt, and so was the sweet tea.

Welcome to Bloomingdale CFA!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Just discovered a new Chick-fil-A on Bloomingdale. Despite the busy parking lot, the efficient staff kept the drive-thru lines moving smoothly. All six employees I interacted with were friendly and welcoming. The food was generally good, although the fries could have been cooked for a little longer. Overall, a warm welcome to the new Chick-fil-A in Bloomingdale!

input: Cute lil spot on Germantown Ave. I came in craving something sweet and they did not disappoint. There was an array of cookies and bars to choose from, if my memory serves me right. Behind the display of goodies there was a table with clear plastic cups filled with yumminess, labeled "cake scrapple" I was intrigued. They were different kinds of cakes and icings, most likely left over from a bake. There were about 5 different flavors to choose from and I went with my favorite Red Velvet with cream cheese frosting. I also ended up with an M&M cookie, my other fave! It was a nice day so I sat outside on their bench and had a couple bites of goodness! The cookie was great, soft & chewy with those hard candies for texture. The cake was also delicious and moist!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Located on Germantown Ave, this cute little spot surpassed my craving for something sweet. The selection included a variety of cookies and bars. Intriguingly, behind the display, there was a table with clear plastic cups filled with delicious cake scrapple, likely leftovers from a previous bake. With 5 different flavors available, I opted for the classic Red Velvet with cream cheese frosting - my personal favorite. Alongside that, I couldn't resist indulging in an M&M cookie, another beloved treat. I took advantage of the pleasant weather and enjoyed my delectable bites on the bench outside. The cookie was delightful, offering a soft and chewy texture with the added crunch of the candy. The cake was equally pleasing, moist and delicious.

input: Lots of improvements to this place. Much more comfortable environment now.  The chairs could be a bit more comfortable as it'd be nice to sit through an entire football game. Otherwise, this place has really improved.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place has undergone significant improvements, resulting in a much more comfortable environment. However, slight improvements could be made to the chairs to enhance the comfort for sitting through a complete football game. Overall, this location has greatly improved.

input: Three stars not because of food, the food is good but, the service is slow. I think they need 1 or 2 more people up front when placing an order if your waiting and not using the kiosk to order.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Three stars due to slow service. The food is good, but additional staff members are needed at the front counter during ordering to reduce wait times for those not using the kiosk.

input:
Went here when they first opened. They only had one flavor... it wasn't that great. Everything was overpriced and we left spending about 70-80 dollars for three people and it wasn't filling. 
*it is not Cajun style seafood. The sauce tastes like a mixture between buffet style sauces with fish sauce. 
Giving them a solid three because there are better places to eat at
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Visited this place when it first opened. Disappointed with the limited flavor options and the taste wasn't great. Prices were high and didn't feel satisfied after spending around 70-80 dollars for three people. Not Cajun style seafood, as the sauce tasted like a combination of buffet style sauces with fish sauce. Overall rating of three, as there are better dining options available.

input:
My mother, aunt and myself went on this walking tour of Ybor with stops for good food.  What a nice time!  Our guide,  Raymond was very knowledgeable and friendly.  
It was about 3 hrs long,  we passed that 3 hr mark because we were sidetracked a few times and chit chatted quite a bit, lol. 
We learned great details and background about the early days of tampa, the culture, people and ybor in general,  very informative! Along the way we stopped for food tastings . Everything was great,  especially the stone soup company Cuban sandwich!  I would recommend everyone to go on this tour,  visiting or lived here for years this is a fun adventure.  And for the step counters we chalked up over 5000 steps ! It will help offset all the wonderful calories you take in on the tour haha
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My mother, aunt, and I had a fantastic time on the walking tour of Ybor with our knowledgeable and friendly guide, Raymond. The tour lasted about 3 hours, but we ended up going over time due to some distractions and enjoyable conversations. We learned interesting details about the early days of Tampa, the culture, people, and Ybor itself. The food tastings along the way were delicious, particularly the Cuban sandwich from the Stone Soup Company. I highly recommend this tour for both visitors and long-term residents as it is a fun adventure. Additionally, we logged over 5000 steps for all the step counters out there, which helps balance out the delightful calories consumed on the tour.

input: Love the sweet spiral plain pies at Franzones.  Can't go wrong with plain.  I tried the white pizza with onions in addition and it was a pleasant surprise.  The onions were a great addition to the pizza.  Same Franzone's as the Bridgeport one I grew up with.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love the sweet spiral plain pies at Franzones. Can't go wrong with plain. Also tried the white pizza with onions, and it was a pleasant surprise. The onions were a great addition. It's the same Franzone's as the Bridgeport one I grew up with.

input: My18 year old daughter had a severe soar throat. We had seen another fast clinic in a CVS. A few days earlier and recieved a miss diagnosis of a fungus infection. She was prescribed an oral medication that made the condition much worse. We were the only patients at this clinic the entire visit and it took us over 1 hour. The staff were very robotic like in there behavior. I tried to ask a question on the way out and was told I was not aloud to be there. Very strange since I was already there. It felt like I was being hurried out the door. Keeping in mind there were no other patients in the facility during our visit I was confuses about the wait time and gruf  behaviour. I found the experience to be very unfriendly. It is best to have a good primary care physician and avoid these places at all cost.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My 18-year-old daughter had a severe sore throat. We visited a fast clinic in a CVS a few days ago for a diagnosis and were mistakenly told it was a fungus infection. She was given an oral medication that actually worsened her condition. During our visit, we were the only patients at the clinic, yet it still took over an hour. The staff seemed very robotic in their behavior and when I tried to ask a question on our way out, I was abruptly told I couldn't be there, which felt strange since I was already inside. It felt like they were rushing us out the door. Considering the lack of other patients, I was confused about the long wait time and the unfriendly demeanor. This experience has taught us the importance of having a reliable primary care physician and avoiding such clinics in the future.

input: The chicken sandwich was phenomenal. Great food for a very industrial area.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The chicken sandwich was phenomenal, perfect for an industrial area with great food.

input: We set up an online appt, meeting and transaction was very simple and painless. We opted for a 2hr side by side ride where we had a four-seater with our guide Matt (who by the way was super awesome and informative).  Throughly enjoyed our ride with some superb views.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had a hassle-free experience with setting up an online appointment for a 2-hour side by side ride. Our guide, Matt, was extremely knowledgeable and provided excellent information during the ride. The four-seater vehicle offered great views, making our experience thoroughly enjoyable.

input: Great bar Happy Hour 4-7 every day. Wine & Drafts $3, $5 pizza, $4.50 apps. To-go Dinners and lunches are very reasonable and fast. Staff are as friendly as it gets.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Happy Hour at our bar is from 4-7 every day and offers great deals such as $3 wine and drafts, $5 pizzas, and $4.50 appetizers. We also offer reasonably priced and speedy to-go dinners and lunches. Our staff is known for their exceptional friendliness.

input:
I had a horrible experience here. The waiter was great but as I got my appetizer, there was it has a hair in it.
Next the noodles came out mine was fine but my friend has a huge hair in his. I thought he was joking until he told me. After that it ruined my appetite, I gave the noodles back and they didn't even give me a new one, I thought I should've got the food for free at that point.. never eating here again
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a terrible experience at this place. The waiter was good, but there was a hair in my appetizer. My friend also found a huge hair in his noodles. It ruined our appetite, and although we returned the noodles, they didn't replace them. I expected to get the food for free at that point. I won't be eating here again.

input: Went here with a friend after having an incredible experience at Laurel and was hoping for more of the same at a slightly less bulgy pricepoint, and oh my, is it worth it...    ITV is the kind of place that i dream about, beautiful small room, dimly lit but you can see ( as opposed to some places) and you want to see everything.  Everything in the room is beautiful including a lot of the staff, (im trying to give you the full picture here).   First thing to hit the table (or bar in this case) was a three dollar beef fat biscuit that was the best thing ive eaten in this city all year.  I verbally communicated that message to Chef Nick Elmi who graced us with his presence in the dining room (just as before at Laurel).    We went on to eat many more things which i will try to name now... Stars were Foie with Apricot Miso, Pork Cheeks with some insanely good vegetables, trout pumpernickel soldiers and one of the best cocktails ive had in a damn long time, the ouroboros.   The are playing around with cold smoking things in there and on their BAR MENU!   Honestly, place is just terrific and i meant to write this review sooner but hey... better late than never.  Now that i think of it, im getting hungry... maybe ill head to East Passyunk for some of the best this city has to offer!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Went to ITV after a great experience at Laurel. The place is beautiful and the staff is great. The three dollar beef fat biscuit was amazing and Chef Nick Elmi was there. Also had foie with apricot miso, pork cheeks with great vegetables, trout pumpernickel soldiers, and a fantastic cocktail called ouroboros. They cold smoke things and even have it on their bar menu. Overall, it's a terrific place and I should've written this review sooner. Thinking of going to East Passyunk for more great food.

input:
I absolutely love this place!

Great hours, impeccably clean, so relaxing.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love this place! Great hours, impeccably clean, and so relaxing.

input: Buckingham Pizza makes the best pizza around, particularly its plain pizza and a few of its specialities -- try the cool ranch pizza. This is a pizza parlor. Don't get fancy....order the pizzas and maybe some sides. While some of the entrees are good (chicken piccata), stay with the pizza and you'll love it.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Buckingham Pizza is a top-notch pizza parlor known for its delicious plain pizza and speciality options like the cool ranch pizza. It is recommended to stick with their pizzas and maybe order some sides, as their entrees like chicken piccata are not as impressive. But overall, if you choose their pizzas, you are guaranteed to love them.

input: Best iced latte and beignet we tried. The live music also creates a great atmosphere. We also visited Cafe du Monde but in our opinion Cafe Beignet is much better. The service is also very good and there are hardly ever lines.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Cafe Beignet offers the best iced latte and beignet we've tried, with the added bonus of live music creating a great atmosphere. In comparison to Cafe du Monde, we found Cafe Beignet to be superior. The service is excellent and there are rarely any long lines.

input:
Fun, no-frills atmosphere, right on the water, where you can watch passersby and dolphins alike, while enjoying great food and accommodating service.

Members of our dining party ranged from a picky 7 year old, to two 40 somethings and a 72 year old grandmother. Captain Bill's had menu choices for everyone in our party, and they even made some ingredient substitutions for us. 

The food arrived hot, fresh, and exactly to our specifications. Wait service and wait time were on point, and we all left the restaurant satisfied and having enjoyed the experience. We'll be back to Captain Bill's next time we visit John's pass. I hope you consider it too!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Captain Bill's offers a fun and casual atmosphere with a prime waterfront location. Guests can enjoy watching people and dolphins while enjoying delicious food and friendly service. The restaurant caters to a diverse age group, accommodating picky eaters, young children, middle-aged adults, and even seniors. The menu has options for everyone, and the staff is willing to make ingredient substitutions. The food is served hot, fresh, and exactly as ordered. The wait service is excellent, ensuring a timely and enjoyable dining experience. Overall, our dining party left Captain Bill's satisfied and happy, and we plan on returning during our next visit to John's Pass. We highly recommend considering this restaurant.

input: Very good sushi. The peanut avocado roll is a must try. Delicious! I ordered the Volcano roll as well and it was amazing. The service was also great, very friendly customer service. I will definitely visit again even though it's far from where I live. If you find yourself near Valrico, then definitely visit this restaurant. You will not regret it.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great sushi, especially the peanut avocado roll. Also loved the amazing Volcano roll. Excellent service with friendly staff. Despite the distance, I'll definitely come back again. Don't miss out on this restaurant if you're in the Valrico area. Highly recommended!

input: It's really a run of the middle as far as Cuban food goes. Not bad but not great either. I work close by so I end up there for lunch quite a bit. It's definitely worth checking out for lunch as their specials change every day and prepared freshly.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The Cuban food is average, neither excellent nor terrible. I frequently go for lunch since I work nearby. They have daily changing lunch specials, which are freshly prepared.

input: My husband had the 6 oz pepperloin meal and was very happy with it. I had the shrimp kabob meal. There were only 4 shrimp and they were more then well done and very small.  The service was good. The restaurant was not busy.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My husband enjoyed the 6 oz pepperloin meal, while I found the shrimp kabob meal disappointing with only 4 small, overcooked shrimp. Nevertheless, the service was good and the restaurant was not busy.

input:
The line was out the door, but I had a sandwich in my hands 7 minutes later, and I'm guessing it took longer because I didn't know what I wanted right away.  In fact, I felt a little rushed.  All the locals were running in, saying hi to the owner and ordering up their usual's.  No place for a rookie, but they were extremely patient with us and a few others that wandered in not knowing what they were doing either.

As soon as you cross the threshold, you know you have made a good choice, the smell makes your mouth water.  The Punk agreed so we decided to sit inside (everyone else was outside).

Typically, I would never ever order pastrami, but the menu said it was lean, so I tried something different for me.  Lean indeed.  Best pastrami I have had in a very long time.  In fact, maybe ever.  

The punk was amazed at all the bottle caps glued to every surface in the place.  It is a visual feast to keep you busy and entertained while you eat, if you choose to eat inside.  You cannot see the walls for all the nostalgic fodder.

She was especially thrilled when they brought out her sandwich. When he set it down she exclaimed with delight, "He knew exactly what I wanted!"
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The line was long, but I got a sandwich in 7 minutes. It took longer because I was unsure at first. The locals were friendly to newcomers. The smell inside was mouthwatering, so we sat inside. I tried the pastrami, which was the best I've had. The punk was amazed by the bottle caps on the walls. The server knew exactly what the punk wanted.

input: Can't tell you how happy I was to see see Heather finally open a shop...I've followed her as a client for years. She is a color wizard, a genius at crafting a look with flair just for you, and can make a tasteful and creative suggestion if you're stumped, or roll with your personal vision. On top of that, Heather has created a shop vibe that is unstuffy, chill, and totally comfortable. I trust her and the staff she hires when I recommend friends and family, and love that she's made a home in the heart of E. Passyunk. Ask her for tips on caring for cactus houseplants, or chat about vintage bikes when you visit.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I am thrilled to see Heather open her shop after being a loyal client for years. She is an incredibly talented color wizard who can craft a personalized and stylish look just for you. Whether you're in need of inspiration or have your own vision, Heather can provide tasteful and creative suggestions. Her shop has a relaxed and comfortable vibe, making it a welcoming space. I have complete trust in Heather and her staff when recommending them to friends and family. It's also great to see her establish her shop in the heart of E. Passyunk. Don't hesitate to ask her for tips on caring for cactus houseplants or have a chat about vintage bikes during your visit.

input: I like that Sally's has more options for hair supplies than any other beauty store in the area. The staff is nice and friendly and everything is usually well stocked. Sally's is my go to when I feel like experimenting with my hair due to the wide array of products they carry. I do wish the staff was a little more knowledgable on what they carry but I understand that that's a lot to ask. I also wish that the store was bigger, brighter and cleaner. The cramped aisles, dust bunnies and flickering, yellow fluorescent lights don't exactly give that same "beauty/trendy" feeling that other beauty stores have. If I could give one piece of advice to management it would be to work on the appearance of the store, other than that I'm pretty happy with Sally's.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I appreciate the wide selection of hair supplies at Sally's compared to other beauty stores in the area. The staff is friendly, and the store is usually well stocked. When I want to experiment with my hair, I rely on Sally's because of their diverse range of products. However, it would be beneficial if the staff had more knowledge about the products they carry. Additionally, I wish the store was larger, brighter, and cleaner, as the cramped aisles, dust, and flickering lights detract from the desired beauty/trendy atmosphere. My advice to management would be to focus on improving the store's appearance. Despite these concerns, I am generally satisfied with Sally's.

input:
Let me preface by saying that I have been getting my hair cut by a guy in Austin for seven years, even though I've lived in other cities for half that time. He is that good. The couple of times that I've strayed, I have been severely disappointed in the outcome. But I wasn't planning a trip back to Austin for a while and badly needed a cut, so I decided to bite the bullet.

My friend walks in a few weeks ago with *srsly* the cutest short hair cut. And so I ask her who and where, and she says Rodney Mitchell. I figured that this place would be too expensive, but she corrected my thinking on the matter. So I called to make an appointment with her guy (whose name I sadly cannot remember at the moment) and Rodney answered the phone. Turns out the guy my friend had seen didn't do morning appointments and all my afternoons were filled, so Rodney said "look, I'm the owner, I can absolutely vouch for Allison who has several openings in the next few days." So I thought, alright, he's the owner so he knows his stuff--I'll do it.

Allison absolutely did not disappoint. First off, she's a total sweetheart, but not super chatty (I appreciate stylists who can be content to both hold and not hold a convo while working) so there was no pressure there. I came in with my laptop and several photos I'd found that approximated what I wanted in a haircut, as I couldn't find exactly the right one. We talked about it a bit, discussed front and back length, bangs, etc. and she said alright and went to it. What she gave me was the cutest damn shaggy bob that I never thought possible. I seriously can't wait to go back.

One of the other awesome things about RMS is that they give you a discount for your first visit and I believe they have some kind of discount for students and teachers. They also will give you *another* discount when you refer people. So I got my friend a discount, and then referred a friend, so I'll get another discount when I go back for my next cut. All good things when you're trying your best to be a frugal  grad student.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I have been getting my hair cut by a guy in Austin for seven years. He is really good. However, I couldn't go back to Austin and needed a haircut, so I decided to try a new place. My friend recommended Rodney Mitchell and I made an appointment with one of his stylists named Allison. She did an amazing job and gave me a cute shaggy bob. The salon offers discounts for first-time visitors, students, and teachers, and also provides referral discounts. I referred my friend and will get another discount on my next visit. It's great for someone like me who is on a budget as a grad student.

input:
So much to like about this place--the beautiful Mercer Building location, the spaciousness, the lovely, friendly baristas. But there are a couple of important cons for me. Biggest being, the music is constant and too loud, ruining everything you go to a coffee shop to do: read, work, reflect, or enjoy a good conversation. When I asked for it to be turned down, they told me they can't--it just plays at one level all the time, and the speakers  are everywhere so you can't get away from it. It sucks.

Secondly, if you're a tea drinker, you're out of luck. They don't serve the tea in pots, but huge, sloppy individual filters--it makes your beverage totally ungainly, hard to drink and is really off putting.

Pros: gluten free goodies and yummy Italian sodas. I'd love to spend more time here, but the music usually drives me out after 10 minutes.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place has many positives: a beautiful location in the Mercer Building, spaciousness, and friendly baristas. However, there are a couple of drawbacks. The biggest issue is the constant and excessively loud music, which disrupts activities like reading, working, reflecting, or having conversations. Despite my request, they cannot lower the volume as it plays at a fixed level with speakers scattered throughout the space. Additionally, for tea drinkers, the serving method using individual filters is inconvenient and unappealing. On the positive side, they offer gluten-free treats and tasty Italian sodas. Although I would like to spend more time here, the music usually forces me to leave after just 10 minutes.

input:
Spice n Grill has the best Indian food in St. Louis. We had the beef nihari, palak paneer, and naan. The palak and beef were perfectly spiced, adequately spicy, and crave-worthy. I've never had a nihari dish before and I will be sure to try it again. 

The restaurant doesn't have great seating  in the store, so I will take food to go next time. The owner served us and he was very nice, but I don't think people eat in the restaurant very often. 

I was so excited to see that the previous owners of 'Indian Food' have opened a new restaurant and I would recommend it if you're in the mood for delicious take-out.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Spice n Grill in St. Louis is the go-to place for the best Indian food. We tried the beef nihari, palak paneer, and naan, all of which were perfectly spiced and adequately spicy. The palak and beef were incredibly flavorful and left us craving for more. Even though the restaurant lacks great seating options, the friendly owner served us and made our dining experience enjoyable. Next time, I will opt for take-out as the seating isn't the best. It's worth noting that the previous owners of 'Indian Food' have opened this new restaurant, and I highly recommend it for delicious take-out.

input:
I've come from Cali where boba is very common there. However I was thinking this place would have had the same feel. After being told this place branched off from California, I was disappointed. 

I'm more of a natural person. I enjoy real flavor, real fruits, and of course the perfect boba. I notice that some flavors were used by real fruits but others were just powder which I could definitely taste the different. Especially the taro flavor, being one of my favorites. 

But, if you're not too concern about natural vs powder flavor then this place could be good for you. They ask what level you would like you sweetness and any additional add-ons you would like. I always get boba but sometimes the grass jelly is pretty good too! I'd recommend you try. 

This is also a good place to catch up, talk, play board, card games and even do homework. I know it's always busy with students from the U of A and being told from them it's a nice area to just hang out, that's a pretty good sign. 

Maybe I'm just too picky, but I think it could be better. 

"See it, taste it, Yelp it"
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I'm disappointed that this place doesn't have the same feel as the boba shops in Cali where I'm from. I prefer natural flavors and real fruits, but some of the flavors here use powder instead. The taro flavor, one of my favorites, didn't taste authentic. However, if you don't mind the difference between natural and powder flavors, this place could be good for you. They let you choose your sweetness level and additional add-ons. I always get boba, but their grass jelly is also pretty good. It's a great place to hang out, play games, and do homework, especially for U of A students. Overall, I think it could be better, but others might enjoy it. "See it, taste it, Yelp it."

input: This is an updated review. I've been ordering from silver mine's at the same location for the last 4-5 years and they have only gotten progressively worse. Don't ask for anything to be added to your soup or chili; they'll charge you for the additions but will not include them in the order. They'll also most likely to include the free side such as the bread. It literally takes at least an hour to get your food delivered, maybe they should call Jimmy Johns and ask the what their secret is. This business is in major trouble with all of the other options available. The service is worse than if you had a bunch of kindergarteners running the business, at least they would be nice. You guys are right next to Eller Business School, why don't you ask them how you can improve??? Currently, this place is an embarrassment to their industry, and a waste of space on University Blvd. NEVER ORDERING FROM THIS PLACE AGAIN.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I have been ordering from Silver Mine's at the same location for the last 4-5 years and they have progressively gotten worse. They charge for additions to your soup or chili but do not include them in the order. The free side, such as bread, is also often missing. Delivery takes at least an hour, unlike Jimmy Johns. With better options available, this business is in major trouble. The service is worse than if kindergarteners were running it. They should ask Eller Business School for improvement suggestions. This place is currently an embarrassment to their industry and a waste of space on University Blvd. I will never order from here again.

input:
Bought my beautiful new bike from this shop a few weeks ago then promptly crashed it (curse you, trolley tracks!). I brought it back to the shop this afternoon to see if there was any way they could try to fix the front basket, which was pretty mangled, and to give the bike a once-over to make sure it was safe to ride. I was expecting to have to leave the bike with them for a few days, but the whole process took less than a half hour. Not only did they fix the basket (not perfect, but pretty damn close), but they also fixed the gear shifter that was a little out of whack... FOR FREE.  I couldn't believe it. 

I also want to note that everyone in the shop- from the owners, to the sales people on the floor, to the mechanics, to the dog that greets you at the door- is so friendly and welcoming. I am so happy I found them.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I recently bought a new bike from this shop and unfortunately crashed it shortly after (thanks to trolley tracks). I brought it back to the shop today to get the mangled front basket fixed and have the bike checked for safety. Surprisingly, the entire process took less than half an hour. Not only did they fix the basket almost perfectly, but they also repaired the gear shifter for free. I was amazed. It's worth noting that everyone in the shop, from the owners to the salespeople, mechanics, and even the friendly dog at the door, is incredibly welcoming. I'm thrilled to have found such a great shop.

input: I love going in there just to look around. The prices are a bit high, but the store is like a Disneyland for adults. I LOVE IT!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite the high prices, I love going to that store; it feels like an adult Disneyland to me.

input:
Underrated burger alert!!

Randomly came into Pag's during a stroll around Doylestown. The menu wasn't super appealing, actually, so I just went with a cheeseburger. Legitimately, one of the best cheeseburgers I've had in a while! Tasted like a quality Big Mac! Patty wasn't too thick, bun didn't overshadow the burger and whatever sauce they used - YUM.

We were in the wine bar section - ambiance is really nice; def not very kid friendly (we had our son with us.) but staff was friendly and accommodating.

We will totally be back next time we are in the mood for a good burger!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Underrated burger alert! Stumbled upon Pag's in Doylestown while taking a stroll. The menu didn't catch my eye, so I ordered a cheeseburger. It turned out to be one of the best I've had in a long time! Reminded me of a quality Big Mac, with a perfectly sized patty and a delicious sauce. We sat in the wine bar section, which had a great ambiance. Not very kid friendly, but the staff was friendly and accommodating. We're definitely planning on returning next time we crave a tasty burger!

input: Absolutely wonderful food & service! Go there for lunch/dinner with my boyfriend at least once every two weeks. Prices are very much reasonable. Weekends get pretty packed so may have to wait a little bit but that's never an issue for us. Always get the Indian Pancake & the Hainanese Chicken or Curry Chicken. Other dishes are delicious as well. Never get tired of it!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great food and service! My boyfriend and I go for lunch or dinner every two weeks. Prices are reasonable and weekends can be busy. We love the Indian Pancake and Hainanese Chicken or Curry Chicken, but all the other dishes are delicious too. We never get tired of it!

input: Pretty slow service and the waitresses aren't very kind. I guess I was expecting something different at a diner with high ratings but I understand it's in the middle of a tourist area. However, service should be a priority. Something that really bothered me was how much trash was left on the floor of the outside deck- it all has the potential to blow right into the ocean. NOT OKAY. I had to stand up several times to grab straw wrappers and napkins before they blew into the water. If you're going to have a waterfront/beach front business, be responsible about it. It would be a very easy fix-just a screen on the bottom of the fence. The food was good but I won't be back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Service was slow and the waitresses were unkind. The diner, despite having high ratings, did not meet expectations. There was a concerning amount of trash on the outside deck, which could blow into the ocean. It is important for a waterfront/beach front business to be responsible for their surroundings. While the food was good, I will not return.

input:
I recently had the pre fixe meal for $22 and I enjoyed the combination of tastes on my plate. The chicken was moist my veggies were tasty but a little too greasy....overall is was a great meal. 

I also use them for take out/delivery. I have always enjoyed the way the package their food, in plastic containers that I use over and over again until they look too worn out and I recycle them. I hate take out places that use so much boxes and cups and card board - it's extremely eco-unfriendly. 

The food here is never spectacular but is a good standby you will always come away enjoying. The prices seem a little steep but the restaurant atmosphere is contemporary, the service has always been splendid and the food is dependable.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I recently had a $22 pre fixe meal that included a moist chicken and tasty, albeit slightly greasy, veggies. Overall, it was a great experience. Additionally, I appreciate the eco-friendly approach of using reusable plastic containers for take out/delivery. Although the food is not exceptional, it is reliably enjoyable. Despite the slightly high prices, the contemporary atmosphere, excellent service, and dependable food make it a good choice.

input: It's no different than any other Chinese place. Same menu, etc. this place does have some good lunch specials though, and the food is always ready when I go to pick it up.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This Chinese restaurant is similar to others in terms of menu options. However, it has noteworthy lunch specials and ensures that the food is prepared and available promptly for pickup.

input: Finally got to eat here last night. Eclectic foodie menu. I had their onion tart as an app and Kerry had the veal meatballs with sauce on polenta, very delicious. The red gravy tasted like my own. We both ordered the special of citrus short ribs with fat noodles and brussel sprouts, peas. couldn't finish we will be back to try other interesting items. Small crowded but great friendly atmosphere
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Finally tried this place last night. Eclectic menu for foodies. I had the onion tart and Kerry had the veal meatballs with polenta, both delicious. The red gravy tasted homemade. We also tried the special, citrus short ribs with fat noodles, brussel sprouts, and peas. Couldn't finish it all but definitely coming back for more. Small and crowded but great atmosphere.

input: Last night we tried to get into the oldest Italian Restaurant in South Philly. Thankfully, they couldn't fit us in, so our son said lets try Angelina's  so we walked around the corner and into a small Italian Restaurant.  Immediatly we felt at home.  Angelina is cooking in the front of the resaurant and her husband is servicing. There were 3 of us and we started off with Eggplant and roasted pepper appetizer.  One bite and we were hooked.  We ordered the Veal Osso Bocca, Carbonara and lasagna.  Everything was absolutly DELISH!!  Can't wait to go back!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Last night, we attempted to dine at the oldest Italian Restaurant in South Philly, but they were unable to accommodate us. Luckily, our son suggested Angelina's, a small Italian Restaurant just around the corner. As soon as we entered, we immediately felt a sense of comfort. Angelina herself was cooking in the front, while her husband took care of the service. With just three of us, we began our meal with the Eggplant and roasted pepper appetizer, which had us instantly captivated. We then proceeded to order the Veal Osso Bocca, Carbonara, and lasagna, all of which were absolutely delicious. We are already eagerly anticipating our next visit.

input: great food, great view. Try the lobster mac and cheese
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Lobster mac and cheese—great food with a great view.

input: Super tasty and enormous portions. Some unique flavors too. Not much else to say but an amazing ice cream store that others should try to emulate.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Super tasty, massive portions, and offering unique flavors. It's simply an incredible ice cream store that others should strive to replicate.

input: The food is average. Drink specials are great but the place is rarely crowded. Last time I was there it was a Friday night at 10 pm. There were maybe 3 other parties at the bar. About 5 minutes after ordering our first drink, they announced it was last call...at 10:15 PM on a Friday night! Needless to say we left for a different bar in the area and have removed it from our options of places to go past 6 pm for drinks.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food is average, but the drink specials are great. However, the place is rarely crowded. Last time I went on a Friday night at 10 pm, there were only about 3 other parties at the bar. Surprisingly, they announced last call at 10:15 pm, which is quite early for a Friday night. Consequently, we decided to go to a different bar and have removed it from our list of places to go for drinks past 6 pm.

input: A good place to order from when its late and you have the muchies... for whatever reason ;-)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: A great late-night spot to satisfy your cravings, no matter the reason!

input:
You think Value City, you think cheap value, right? Wrong! 

Think Rothman prices with Ashley Furniture pieces. Not a Broyhill in sight. 

Negatives:
- Entertainment centers and TV stand selection is small, and over priced selection.
-Their "Clearance" section is laughable and not much of a sale. No one is going to pay $299 for a nicked up coffee table that was originally $350. Go lower. 
- Sectionals by themselves average around $1,000 by brands I've never heard of. 
- The staff hangs out like a clique chatting in the middle of the store rather than helping customers. 
-Dining sets are nothing special and overpriced as well. I've seen the same selection everywhere else at a lower price. 
-5% military discount? Ooooh you're going to knock $20 off my sofa! 

Only Positive:
-They have a few modern pieces. 

Overall:

I think they're high for low quality-mediocre furniture. Shop around town. Or if you do find something you must have here, wait for a holiday sale.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Value City may not live up to its reputation for cheap value. With prices comparable to Rothman and furniture pieces similar to Ashley Furniture, there's no sign of Broyhill here.
