However, the selection of entertainment centers and TV stands is small and overpriced. The "Clearance" section is underwhelming, with high prices for damaged items. Sectionals by unknown brands are around $1,000. The staff seems more interested in chatting than helping customers. Dining sets are nothing special and overpriced, available at lower prices elsewhere. The only positive is a small collection of modern pieces. Overall, the high prices for low quality-mediocre furniture would warrant shopping around or waiting for a holiday sale.

input: I really like Franzone's. The owner is typically around, super friendly, and seems to really care about the product. While I'm not a big fan of sweet sauce, they also do a decent cheesesteak, fries, etc. Honestly, they may have been closer to a 4 if not that it's always just a really pleasant experience going in, which boosts their rating for me.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love Franzone's because the owner is always there, super friendly, and genuinely passionate about the product. Although I'm not a fan of sweet sauce, they still have delicious options like cheesesteaks and fries. Overall, my rating would have been closer to a 4, but the consistently pleasant experience I have when visiting really boosts their rating for me.

input:
Finally had the chance to stop by Bab Cafe...what took us so long!  Both of us being Asian food fanatics, we are so happy to have Bab Cafe part of our ever expanding culinary experience here in Reno.

With the guidance of the very friendly and knowledgeable staff, we quickly got a hang of what to order, though there will be many more choices on our future visits.  Liking things a little spicy, we both ordered the Jeyuk Top-Bab (spicy pork).  What incredible flavor!  There is nothing that compares to this place in Reno.  The sauce bar gives you the opportunity to mix things up and the included miso soup is a definite bonus.  Great value for such a fresh, enjoyable meal.  Convenient downtown location to take away, dine in or have it delivered via UberEats.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Finally tried Bab Cafe and loved it! As Asian food fanatics in Reno, we are thrilled to have this place as part of our culinary experience. The staff was incredibly friendly and helped us navigate the menu. We both ordered the Jeyuk Top-Bab, and it was packed with amazing flavor. The sauce bar and included miso soup were great bonuses. The meal was fresh and enjoyable, and the price was reasonable. Convenient downtown location for takeout, dine-in, or delivery via UberEats. Can't wait to go back and try more dishes!

input: First meal in New Orleans. I had the $15 lunch special, a seafood stew (with oyster meat, crab claws, shrimp, and redfish) that came with a surprisingly thoughtful salad. Yeah, it's weird: I'm not even a fan of seafood and, to be honest, I wasn't even really that hungry. Still, before I knew what I was doing I had wolfed down the entire thing. The spice, consistency, tenderness of the meat -- all was precisely just right. Well worth your while.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: First meal in New Orleans; $15 lunch special seafood stew with oyster meat, crab claws, shrimp, and redfish. Surprisingly thoughtful salad included. Despite not being a seafood fan and not very hungry, I couldn't resist and devoured the entire dish. Perfect spice, consistency, and tenderness of the meat. Definitely worth trying.

input: Totally worth the wait despite the heat!  I had the Vegan grits with a biscuit on the side. OMG!  So good. My 3 sisters each enjoyed their choices as well. Caution, the bloody Mary's are spicy!  The service was excellent. Really considering the wait was 45 mins, the line moved fast and then there was no long wait for our food. They have their process perfected!  Thanks Biscuit Love for a Delish breakfast!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite the heat, the wait at Biscuit Love was totally worth it. I ordered the Vegan grits with a side biscuit and it was amazing. My three sisters also enjoyed their choices. However, be cautious as the bloody Mary's are quite spicy. The service was excellent, considering the wait of 45 minutes. The line moved quickly and the food came out promptly. Biscuit Love has perfected their process. Thank you, Biscuit Love, for a delicious breakfast!

input:
Ichicoro Ane gets lots of things right and the best part about it is the combination of the ambiance with the food choices and whiskey selection. I'm very happy with this location and the servers I have encountered so far have been helpful and pleasant.

The katsu is great and I highly recommend it to people looking for a more filling dish on the menu. The bao buns were also good for a lighter fish. I haven't had anything I really regretted trying, but definitely ask your server about the portion sizes of each dish since they vary across the menu.

The cocktail selection is excellent. I even had a special Japanese Old Fashioned last time which was a little expensive, but well worth it for some quality Japanese whiskey. 

I'm looking forward to exploring the menu little by little. The best way to experience this is in a group setting so you can try more things and it really reminds me of Izakayas or Japanese pubs I visited in Japan and Korea.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Ichicoro Ane gets everything right, from the ambiance to the food choices and whiskey selection. The servers have been helpful and pleasant, making my experience even better. The katsu is a must-try if you want a filling dish, while the bao buns are perfect for a lighter option. The portion sizes vary, so it's best to inquire with your server. The cocktail selection is excellent, including a special Japanese Old Fashioned that was worth the price. Exploring the menu gradually is enjoyable, especially in a group setting, giving it an authentic Izakaya feel.

input: Love this bakery!! Great breakfast sandwiches, coffee, and donuts! My friend and I love coming on weekend mornings
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We love this bakery for its delicious breakfast sandwiches, coffee, and donuts! It's our go-to spot on weekend mornings.

input: There is a great selection of whiskey/bourbon to suit anyone's taste. We had burgers with the fried egg on it and it was soo good and probably one of the best burgers I've ever had. The duck fries are a MUST if you come here. It is a cute atmosphere although we went with a party of 4 and it was a tad awkward the way our seating was and made it difficult to have conversation with everyone at our table. Overall, a nice place to go. We will be going back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The whiskey/bourbon selection is great and caters to all tastes. The burgers with fried eggs are incredibly delicious and among the best I've ever had. The duck fries are a must-try at this place. The atmosphere is cute, although the seating arrangement for our party of 4 was a bit awkward, making conversation difficult. Nonetheless, it's a nice place to visit and we plan on returning.

input: A++ for ambience. Very cozy English pub feel. Great drinks too - the bartenders here know how to mix 'em. That being said, the prices are steep (I paid $7 for a standard mixed drink) and the seating is limited.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Ambience: A++ with a cozy English pub feel. Bartenders are skilled at mixing great drinks. However, prices are steep (e.g., $7 for a standard mixed drink) and seating is limited.

input: Very cozy place to have a drink with friends.  The drinks were tasty and were served in very pretty glasses reminiscent of those some of our grandmothers had in their china cabinets. On the downside, all of the drinks seemed to have some combination of ginger, lime, and honey with the main difference being the kind of liquor you wanted in your drink.  So the choices felt limited.  I ordered the bacon wrapped dates, and have to admit that I was choking them down because I was hungry.  They tasted like they were double dipped in sugar.  Also, once another 10 or so people came in, it was very hard to hear each other because the noise level skyrocketed, which is surprising with so much fabric in the room.  The servers were nice and left us alone except to check on us every so often.  I don't recall being offered a second drink when my glass was taken away.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Cozy place with tasty drinks served in pretty glasses reminiscent of grandmother's china cabinets. Limited drink choices featuring ginger, lime, and honey with different liquors. The bacon wrapped dates were overly sweet and hard to eat. Noise level rose significantly when more customers arrived despite the fabric in the room. Friendly servers checked on us occasionally but did not offer a second drink.

input: This place always delivers. Yet another great year with hayrides, pumpkin picking, and lots of other activities.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Consistently delivering, this place offers yet another great year filled with hayrides, pumpkin picking, and a plethora of other activities.

input: Called in to get service information on my 2015 $110K AMG. Was told since I didn't purchase the vehicle at their dealership that I would have to pay for a loaner car for warranty work. Will be staying far away from here.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Called for service information on my 2015 $110K AMG. Was informed that I would need to pay for a loaner car during warranty work because I didn't buy the vehicle from their dealership. Will avoid this place.

input: Like wholefoods but much smaller. They have all sorts of stuff from Salad bar, to a small selection of fresh fruits, juice bar. Great lil grocery store. Couldn't really find any other in the city. They have a parking lot. Great walking, just a couple blocks from clothing stores
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Similar to Whole Foods but smaller, this grocery store offers a variety of items including a salad bar, a small selection of fresh fruits, and a juice bar. It is a fantastic little store in the city, and it has a parking lot. Conveniently located just a few blocks away from clothing stores, it is also easily accessible for pedestrians.

input: I absolutely love coming here. Great outdoor place with a wine selection you can't find anywhere else (not your typical wines you find in the grocery). The live music today was fabulous - and on a Thursday afternoon! Come here, get a few cheeses and wine and you will be satisfied. Oh, and the regular menu is crafty and artistic. It's a beautiful place with ambiance and on the palate.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love coming here. It's a great outdoor place with a unique wine selection. The live music today was fabulous, even on a Thursday afternoon. Enjoy a few cheeses and wine here and you'll be satisfied. The regular menu is crafty and artistic, making it a beautiful place with great ambiance and palate.

input: I love coming here to do my smog on my cars great service and chipper then most!!! I totally recommend this place.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I highly recommend this place for getting my car's smog done. The service is great and the staff is friendly.

input: Outstanding! They have great gluten-free and vegan options too. The salad, pizza, and root beer were just perfect.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: They have excellent gluten-free and vegan options. The salad, pizza, and root beer were outstanding.

input: My group of 6 all got burgers and were very satisfied. Very clean and nice place. Sweet potato tots are a must.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My group of 6 thoroughly enjoyed our burgers at this clean and pleasant place. The sweet potato tots are a must-try.

input: This is a convenience store deli, so don't expect a neat restaurant setting or drink service (that's the only reason I give 4 stars instead of 5). I've had a Cuban press one time, and a breakfast sandwich at another time. Sandwiches are prepared upon your order and I was very happy with the food. Delicious! There are some tables inside and some outside on the dock, overlooking ocean. There is a more popular breakfast place (Maggie Mae's) in the same strip mall but taste-wise I must say I like this deli much better.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This convenience store deli may not have a fancy restaurant setting or drink service, which is why I give it 4 stars instead of 5. However, I have tried their Cuban press and breakfast sandwich, and both were delicious. The sandwiches are made to order, and I was very satisfied with the food. They have tables inside and outside on the dock, with a view of the ocean. While there is a more popular breakfast place (Maggie Mae's) in the same strip mall, I personally prefer the taste of this deli.

input:
My 2nd experience here was even better than the first.  I do believe there were some kinks during the grand opening.  This time around they seemed to have more than 1 beer bottle opener, and the portion size of the garlic noodle did improve.  
The place still looked like it would get drafty at certain tables but we were seated at a better table this time around and I was not bothered by it.  Food was amazing as ever and I am looking forward to my next visit!
We had no problem getting seated on a sat evening at 5pm.  So glad to have these guys in the local neighborhood.  :D
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My second experience here was better than the first. The grand opening had some issues, but this time they had multiple beer bottle openers and the garlic noodle portion size improved. The draftiness was still present, but we were seated at a better table and it didn't bother me. The food was delicious as always, and I can't wait to come back again. We had no trouble getting seated on a Saturday evening at 5pm. I'm grateful to have this place in our local neighborhood. 😃

input:
I love Skyline Chili.  I first had this stuff in Cincinnati, and I was thrilled to when a location opened in Clearwater. 

This particular Skyline, however, is not great.  The service is generally poor, and the food comes out very slowly.   It seems like every time that I go, they are "out" of something, or some equipment isn't working.  Sometimes it's baked potatoes, sometimes it is french fries, sometimes it is something else.

Love the cheese coney hot dogs all the way!

I hope this location can get their act together.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love Skyline Chili, first tried it in Cincinnati, and was excited when a location opened in Clearwater. However, the service and speed of the food at this Skyline are generally poor. They frequently run out of certain items or have faulty equipment. Despite this, I still enjoy their cheese coney hot dogs all the way. I hope this location improves soon.

input:
So I no longer go here which is a shame because The eyebrow waxing here is fantastic. I am giving this 2 stars because when I have contacted for an appointment via the phone, it usually has taken days for me to get a response. The online booking is useless because I rarely have found appointments within 2 weeks of when I need it (and I'm very flexible with time of day). 

I give up on this place. Unless you book out weeks in advance, you will not get an appointment. I'm now paying $10 more elsewhere which sucks but I'm able to get seen when I need to be seen.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I no longer go here because the eyebrow waxing is fantastic. However, I am giving this place 2 stars due to slow response to appointment requests via phone and limited availability within 2 weeks using online booking. I have given up on this place as appointments need to be booked weeks in advance. I am now paying $10 more elsewhere to ensure I can be seen when needed.

input: great taco's, nacho's, atmosphere and margarita's.  wednesday is triple special day.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great taco's, nacho's, atmosphere and margarita's are available at our place. Don't miss out on our Triple Special Day every Wednesday.

input:
I don't think they have enough staffs here. Always you can see customers waiting. It took them about an hour and more to have my car ready. Even worse, in the next morning before I was gonna take my family out for a trip, I found my car had no wiper fluid; hence I had no choice but went back and waste another hour waiting them to refill it.

The car was not thorough cleaned (either outside or inside). I rent the car on May 18th, extremely close to my 25th birthday (June 6th), and still, I was still charged for underage fee, which is extremely expensive -- $20 BEFORE TAX PER DAY. There was just no way to waive it. I should have gone for, and I will recommend others in the future to find another rental company such as Hertz, at which you can always find codes to waive this crazy fee.

The last thing is DO NOT buy the fuel option. Although it claims $1.99 per gallon, this is before tax. You will find the price after tax to be very closed to what you can find outside. And, you will NEVER return the car on empty. This is nothing good but a trick for rental companies to steal 3- to 4-gallon sales from you.


*** Final note:
Not about this location but where I returned my car.

"Return Location Address and Phone Number :
PORT JEFFERSON STATION
320 ROUTE 112
PORT JEFFERSON STATION, NY 11776-1010
Tel.: (631) 474-2100"

This address is totally WRONG!!! I kept asking people around this address for the right location and wasted another hour when returning my car!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The lack of staff at this location leads to long wait times for customers. My car took over an hour to be ready and the next morning I discovered it was lacking wiper fluid. The car was also not thoroughly cleaned inside or outside. Despite renting the car close to my 25th birthday, I was still charged an expensive underage fee. I recommend using a different rental company like Hertz to avoid this fee. Additionally, the fuel option is not worth it as the price after tax is similar to outside prices and rental companies often try to overcharge for unnecessary gallons. Lastly, the return location address provided is incorrect, causing me to waste an additional hour trying to find the correct location.

input:
Thanks yelp reviewers...you didn't let me down!  And neither did Todd and Roberta!  They just left my house and I am in awe of what an amazing job they did!  Carpet and couch looks great...spots where my dog a some accidents the other day are all gone! Everything just smells fresh...no chemicals to inhale and nothing has that "wet" smell.  And I can't believe how dry it all is so soon after!  Plus they are the
NICEST people with tons of knowledge and tips on how to care for your home.  Worth every penny and not only recommending them but definitely will be using them in the future!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Thank you, Yelp reviewers! Todd and Roberta did an incredible job on my carpet and couch. They removed all the spots from my dog's accidents and left everything smelling fresh without any chemicals or wetness. I am amazed at how quickly everything dried. They are also incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and provided great home care tips. I highly recommend them and will definitely hire them again in the future. Well worth the money!

input: Love it here! Their sips mocha is my go-to. Staff has always been so nice! Absolutely love that they have a drive thru too, helps not to unload my kiddos. Oh and their cakes are amazing too!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love it here! The sips mocha is my go-to drink. The staff is always incredibly nice. Having a drive-thru option is so convenient, especially when I have my kids with me. Additionally, their cakes are absolutely amazing!

input: I have been a fan of Chateau La Vin for a few years. It has been fun to watch the place evolve. At first it was more of a wine store with only a few tables. Now it has been transformed into a wine bar. He offers cheese and crackers and people order from the local restaurants and some of them even deliver. He had two guys playing music. He offers so many different wines and is willing to share his knowledge. My friend is a beer drinker and he has a nice variety for them as well. He does have a few tables out in front. This is a great place.....
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I have been a fan of Chateau La Vin for a few years. Initially a small wine store, it has now transformed into a lively wine bar. With a selection of cheese and crackers, customers can also order from local restaurants, some of which offer delivery services. The establishment features live music from two musicians, providing a pleasant atmosphere. The owner offers a wide range of wines and willingly shares his knowledge with patrons. Moreover, there is also a nice variety of beers available for beer drinkers. Additionally, there are a few outdoor seating options in front of the wine bar. Overall, Chateau La Vin is a fantastic place to visit.

input:
We used The Hollander Hotel for our wedding hotel and it was an absolutely incredible experience.  I will never get tired of raving about our experience.  We were honored to use the Hollander not only for our room block and wedding night suite, but we also used the Tap Room as our after-party location and we hosted a brunch for our guests on the beautiful patio on Sunday morning after the wedding.  Everything was perfection and if we could do it all over again, we wouldn't change a thing!

The hotel property is absolutely charming.  The décor in the lobby is beautiful, eclectic, and very welcoming.  The Tap Room is a great place for people to gather with intimate booths and large tables for bigger parties.  The Bar has an amazing selection of local and craft beers and the servers and bartenders are all professional and fast! We were able to use the Lobby and Tap Room for some of our wedding photographs too, and they all look wonderful!

The rooms are very pleasant and quaint and our guests all complimented on how clean and cozy they were.  The prices were also wonderful and our guests were able to enjoy downtown St. Pete because of the great location.  The shuttle is also very convenient and a great experience for guests!

The brunch was perfect.  Not only was the price great for an all-you-can-enjoy feast, but the food is delicious and homemade.  The wonderful gentleman who makes the omelets is friendly, fast, and takes great pride in his work.  He is also a talented baker and I couldn't get enough of the chocolate muffins he made!  The service at the new coffee/dessert café was wonderful!  The Patio was a great place to visit with our guests and enjoy the beautiful St. Pete weather. We look forward to many more brunches there in the future! 

Finally, the best part of all is the management and team at the Hollander.  Nick and Will treated us like their own family.  They went above and beyond to ensure that each of our guests felt like they were at home and comfortable.  Zach at the front desk was so friendly and patient with me as I called checking on our room block.  The entire team was just a delight and so very accommodating.  They take great pride in ensuring that every guest has a wonderful experience.  We just adore everyone there!  I absolutely loved working with them and would recommend this beautiful hotel to anyone!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had an incredible experience using The Hollander Hotel for our wedding. We used the hotel for our room block, wedding night suite, after-party, and brunch for our guests. The hotel property is charming, with beautiful decor in the lobby. The Tap Room is a great gathering space with intimate booths and large tables. The bar offers an amazing selection of local and craft beers, and the service is professional and fast. The rooms are pleasant and cozy, and our guests were impressed with their cleanliness. The prices were reasonable, and the hotel's location allowed our guests to enjoy downtown St. Pete. The shuttle service was convenient and enjoyable. The brunch was perfect, with delicious homemade food and friendly service. The patio provided a great space to enjoy the St. Pete weather. The management and team at The Hollander were exceptional. They treated us like family and ensured the comfort of all our guests. We had a delightful experience working with them and highly recommend this beautiful hotel.

input: I got the gyro "platter" for lunch, which was dry, uninspired, and nothing like a deconstructed gyro. Worst of all, it came with "vegetables" which looked more like poop. Tasted that way, too. There are better places in Fairmount for lunch, and they won't serve you poop, either.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The gyro "platter" I had for lunch was dry, uninspired, and nothing like a deconstructed gyro. To make matters worse, it was served with vegetables that resembled and tasted like poop. Fairmount offers superior dining options where you won't encounter such unappetizing food.

input: I went there for drinks and found the environment really nice with the brewery right there. The beer was good and the waiter was very knowledgable and kind
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I enjoyed visiting for drinks at the brewery, where I found the environment pleasant and the presence of the brewery added to the experience. The beer was of high quality, and the waiter impressed me with their knowledge and kindness.

input: OMG! What an amazing dinner experience. A friend recommended this place and it was incredible. We had two of their signature dishes -- the BBQ shrimp and bread pudding. This is a fantastic restaurant with great ambience and fantastic service. Highly recommend it if you're visiting New Orleans. Their fried green tomato appetizer was a great way to kick off the meal.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Had an incredible dinner experience at a highly recommended restaurant in New Orleans. Tried their signature BBQ shrimp and bread pudding, both delicious. Atmosphere and service were fantastic. Don't miss out on their fried green tomato appetizer, perfect start to the meal.

input:
Great store. Insane selection. Incredible customer service.

Wish they could come to Ft. McMurray. 

:(

input: LYING SCAMMERS. BAIT AND SWITCH. Will try and take advantage of you! Online coupon says 15$ for unlimited tanning any bed for a week for first time customers. Went to Chippewa location, The lady behind the desk acted like she had no idea what I was talking about. Then I pulled up the coupon and she said it's only for students and that I needed a student ID. However the coupon said nothing about this. Then she switched to saying the coupon is expired, yet it's still on YELP and they're website. She also said they won't honor the $75 for 45$ coupon you can literally purchase on yelp either. Just bullshit line after bullshit line. I then left And called creve coeur location and the lady there says, "yes you can still use that coupon, but you must go to the same location each time for that week once you choose a location." I knew this as my girlfriend used it last week. DO NOT GO TO THIS PLACE!!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Deceptive scammers. False advertising and attempt to exploit customers. Advertised online coupon for $15 unlimited tanning for a week. Visited Chippewa location, staff denied knowledge of the offer and claimed it was only for students with no mention on the coupon. Staff also claimed the coupon was expired despite its presence on Yelp and their website. Refused to honor another coupon available for purchase on Yelp. Called Creve Coeur location and confirmed the coupon was valid but required sticking to one location for the week. Avoid this place at all costs.

input: Very impressed with this place! The food was amazing. Quick service chipotle style line ordering but with high-quality Indian food. Also the staff was super helpful in helping me decide what to get since I'm an Indian food newbie. Can't wait to eat there again!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I'm very impressed with this place! The food was amazing and high-quality, with quick service and a chipotle style line ordering system. The staff was super helpful in assisting me, as I'm new to Indian food. I can't wait to eat there again!

input:
Although there are countless little Mexican places below Washington Avenue, I never get sick of them and always look forward to trying the new kid on the block. This time it was El Sabor Poblano on Federal, which could not look less special if it tried.

I liked that there were 3 fish tacos on the menu.  I picked the fried and battered version, though the tortilla chip covered fish could have been awesome. I was instantly impressed when I opened one of my three and found that El Sabor puts an entire filet of fish in each taco! The flakey meat had no fishy taste. These tacos came with the more American toppings of lettuce and, tomato, and cheese. I bet I could have gotten cilantro and onion if I asked. The sole staff member in the place seemed happy to accommodate us- well, we were the only ones dining in.

Another taco filling option that comes with more traditional toppings is the super crispy chorizo, only $8 for 3. There was no detectable gristle here, something I have often come across at this little places.

As unassuming as it looks, this particular South Philly Mexican place is worth stopping by.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: El Sabor Poblano on Federal in South Philly is a hidden gem among the many Mexican restaurants. Despite its unimpressive appearance, the food at this place is worth a visit. I was delighted to find that they offer three fish taco options, and I chose the fried and battered version. The tacos exceeded my expectations with a generous portion of flakey fish in each one. The use of American toppings like lettuce, tomato, and cheese added a unique twist. The staff was accommodating, and there were no disappointments with the super crispy chorizo taco filling either. For just $8, you can enjoy three delicious tacos without any gristle. So, make sure to check out El Sabor Poblano for a satisfying Mexican dining experience in South Philly.

input: I met a buddy mine at this spot that I have always wanted to go to, but have never had the time. I walked in and sat at the bar. The police were investigating a burglary from the overnight it seemed some dirt bags broke in on a side door and stole a bunch of liquor from the bar. The bartender was great and service was prompt. I ordered a pint  of dark ale and my buddy and I split a order of wings. The beer was cold and the wings were very tasty. I remembered meeting the owners of the establishment at the last Italian Fest at the Farmers Market so I really wanted to like this place as they were very friendly folks. I will continue to patronize this spot as it was a great spot close to home and work. I also like the locally non franchised making it work attitude that this place gives. I really was very comfortable at this establishment and well tell the rest of fellow Yelpers to hit this spot!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I finally got the chance to visit a spot I've always wanted to go to. There had been a burglary overnight, but the bartender provided great service. I ordered a pint of dark ale and split some wings with my buddy. Both were delicious. I had met the owners before and wanted to support their friendly establishment. It's conveniently close to home and work, and I appreciate their locally owned non-franchised approach. I felt very comfortable there and will definitely recommend it to others.

input: Found this place on Yelp. The reviews speak for themselves and are so true. The sandwiches are really tasty. Definitely worth the wait in line. Fast and friendly service. We waited about 15 minutes in line, ordered 4 different sandwiches, filled up our sodas, walked out to our table, and our sandwiches were delivered to us as we say down. We enjoyed our meal.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Discovered this place on Yelp, the reviews are accurate. Sandwiches are delicious. Waited in line for about 15 minutes, ordered 4 sandwiches, and received fast and friendly service. Filled up our sodas, sat down at our table, and the sandwiches were promptly delivered. Overall, enjoyed our meal.

input: By far some of the most comfy theater recliners. My only complaint is that you have to put your feet down if someone wants to pass by you on the aisle. The bartender at the little lounge next to the theaters is a delight. And being able to drink in the theater is a nice plus. The drawback comes with concessions. At a peak time on a Saturday, there were 5-6 employees at the counter but utter disorganization and no hustle whatsoever. The popcorn was also burnt. Next time I'll eat beforehand and stick with the bar.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The theater recliners are extremely comfortable, but you have to put your feet down for someone to pass by on the aisle. The bartender at the adjacent lounge is delightful and it's great to be able to drink in the theater. However, the concessions counter was disorganized and slow, with burnt popcorn. Next time, I'll eat beforehand and just visit the bar.

input: This is one of the best hotels I have ever stayed at.  Clean, polite staff, nice pool and grand entrance.   I can't wait until next year to come back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This hotel is superb. It's exceptionally clean with friendly staff, a beautiful pool, and a stunning entrance. I'm eagerly anticipating my return next year.

input: I went here when if first opened, and have never desired to go back again, I was so very disappointed at the quality and the taste of the food. I would absolutely not recommend dining here.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a disappointing experience when I visited this place right after it opened, and I have never had the desire to return ever since. The food quality and taste were both extremely disappointing, and as a result, I do not recommend dining here.

input:
Went on a Sunday afternoon and there were only a handful of people there.  We sat at the bar and were greeted by a bartender who started by telling us they were out of most food items.  No worries, we just wanted a couple of beers.  We sampled several varieties, all of which were average.  Nothing memorable about any of the six styles we tried.

Tried six different styles, all average with no standout. Staff seemed disgruntled due to late relief, having a loud discussion that dampened the atmosphere. While the location and place appear cool, we may not return as there are better options nearby.

input: Hate to be harsh but dang! After having a limited selection at terminal F I finally decided to go with Tony Luke's. I was looking forward in trying there Philly Cheese Steak been in Philly and all. input:

input: It's my first time here and the service is slow. The employees don't have good attitude but the food it's good.

input: I was here a few times before and didn't review. I come here for the food, NOT the service. The establishment is lacking in its service. Their food is always great though! Very delicious for a dive bar.

input: I've been to many art museums and was surprised to see a museum this beautiful with such a great collection to be FREE! I was so happy to have had discovered this museum in my short time in Indianapolis. I loved the African Art and the Modern Art sections (although I did make a mistake taking out my camera for the Modern Art museums.. that's a no no). The outdoor sculpture garden and gift shop was awesome as well. Highly recommended!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was pleasantly surprised by the stunning beauty and impressive collection of this free art museum in Indianapolis. Despite my short time there, I was able to appreciate the African Art and Modern Art sections, although I made a mistake by taking out my camera in the Modern Art museum. The outdoor sculpture garden and gift shop also added to the overall awesome experience. I highly recommend visiting this museum.

input:
You would think from the size of the place it would be good for groups, but in my experience with 9 people on Saturday at 11am it was about a very hungry, tiring wait to get a seat. 

We tried to make reservations, but they do not take them. And I think we were too small to be put in the side meeting room. So hangry we stood, hoping for just the right table to leave.

The manager was nice enough to offer to fill cups of coffee for us while we waited. But I thought it was odd that they just didn't refill the pot for everyone who was waiting. 

Now for the food...They have these 1/2 and 1/2 combos. Which I love! I got a turkey Reuben and salad. I asked for lots of sauerkraut, and they charged $0.50 for it.. Which is no biggie but I'd expect a lot of kraut. Sadly there was not a lot of it.. But it was still a delicious sandwhich.  :) My friend got the sunrise chile rellenos. If I come back with a smaller party, that is what I would get.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
Despite its size, the restaurant is not ideal for larger groups, as experienced during a visit with 9 people on a Saturday at 11 am. Reservations are not accepted, and the group was too small to be accommodated in the side meeting room. Consequently, there was a long wait for a table. While waiting, the manager offered to refill cups of coffee but did not refill the pot for everyone waiting. 

Regarding the food, the restaurant offers 1/2 and 1/2 combos, which the reviewer loves. They ordered a turkey Reuben and salad but found the amount of sauerkraut to be lacking despite being charged an additional $0.50 for it. However, the sandwich was still delicious. The reviewer suggests trying the sunrise chile rellenos if visiting with a smaller party in the future.

input: The Shop is an amazing space! Their attention to detail and services are unbelievable. Plenty of places to have private meetings as well as post up and get work done.

input: My husband took me here for our Anniversary and it was such a delight! Hats off to the chef for the amazing dinner that melted in my mouth. And the customer service was top notch. Definitely will be back!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My husband brought me here for our Anniversary and we were delighted! The chef prepared an amazing dinner that simply melted in my mouth. The customer service was exceptional. We will definitely return!

input: Terrace Lounge appears to want to have a great cocktail venue, but they fall short.  One bartender didn't even know there was a new cocktail menu.  The cocktail was weak and watery, and the liquors they have here and throughout Peppermill are the most unfortunate corporate types.  The service is also very spotty.  It confounded me how four bartenders could not seem to handle about 45 customers.  They didn't have any bar areas, so they all floated around the circle, but then they'd stop, often just short of me and go to the waitress stations to fill their orders.  You can't really build up any rapport with four bartenders floating around trying to serve everyone.  I also hated the people there.  Sorry, but many were your run-of-the-mill casino gamblers.  Why don't you just sit at a machine and play?  You didn't come here for the drinks or to smooze with the bartenders, so seriously, go sit at a machine.  One just sat next to me and lite up a cancer stick and the smoke just blew in my face.  Look, if I walk into a bar and sit next to someone, it's their turf.  They can smoke, fart, vomit on themselves, if I don't like it I can leave.  But if I'm there, it's my turf.  Don't come sit next to me and smoke, fart, or vomit all over yourself.  Or at least be frickin thoughtful and if you see your smoke wafting in my face, put your cancer stick and tray on the other side of the bar so it wafts in your face.  Oh, you don't like smoke in your face???  Me neither moron.  Your life revovles around throwing away your pension money in a mindless electronic game of cards and killing yourself with carcinogens and toxins, well go kill yourself in private, seriously.  You don't see me walking up to a bar and slitting my wrists and burning my money.  It's gross.  I probably just realized this, but I really enjoy Cin Cin not only because they have the best cocktails in town, but they have no machines at the bar.  Peppermill, if you want to create a cool cocktail bar, ditch the machines, train your staff, or hire bartenders with better service skills, and buy some independent liquors.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Terrace Lounge falls short as a cocktail venue. One bartender was unaware of the new cocktail menu, resulting in weak and watery drinks. The liquor selection, similar to other Peppermill locations, is disappointing. Service is inconsistent, with four bartenders struggling to handle a moderate number of customers. Additionally, the lack of designated bar areas makes it difficult to establish a rapport with the bartenders. The atmosphere is unappealing, as the majority of patrons are typical casino gamblers. The presence of smokers is especially bothersome, as they invade personal space with their smoke. Cin Cin is a preferable option due to their superior cocktails and absence of gambling machines. For Terrace Lounge to improve, they should eliminate machines, train their staff or hire more skilled bartenders, and feature independent liquor options.

input: Awesome service (ask for Amanda, resident comedian); very friendly staff.  Food was really good and beer was cold.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great service - ask for Amanda, the resident comedian. Very friendly staff. Delicious food and cold beer.

input: This is my favorite nail shop in the city I've been going here for years....I enjoy the quiet serene atmosphere...the staff is very friendly and efficient....the price of $25.00 for a pedicure in the South....you can't beat it!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My favorite nail shop in the city. I've been going here for years, enjoying the quiet serene atmosphere. The staff is friendly and efficient. And the price of $25.00 for a pedicure in the South is unbeatable.

input:
Thank you for a lovely morning!  I was in NJ early and decided to stop in for a delicious diner breakfast.  I got a taylor ham, egg, and cheese and a short stack of blueberry pancakes (I simply couldn't decide between sweet or savory, plus leftovers are never a bad thing).  

The egg sandwich was fantastic.  I was nervous when they said they didn't have kaiser rolls so I went with a hamburger roll.  It was an excellent decision.  The roll was excellent - not just an average cheap hamburger roll.  They layered the cheese on the sandwich, which to me is a must for a true egg sandwich.  It was served with home fries, which were sauteed with large slices of peppers and onions.  I'm not the biggest breakfast potatoes fan, but these were great and I appreciated that they didn't clearly just scoop some food from a huge pile of pre-cooked home fries.

The pancakes were great and fluffy.  My one gripe was their use of smuckers pre-packaged syrup.  I realize that if they put syrup in a container, it probably wouldn't be real maple syrup, but I sort of wish I didn't know that they were giving me sub-par syrup.

The server was friendly and very attentive.  The coffee refills were constant, and the coffee was actually good (so many diners fail at coffee).  Bonus points for the server agreeing not to judge my decision to get two breakfasts.

All around, I loved this place and hope to go back soon.  Long live the Jersey diners!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Had a great morning in NJ with a delicious diner breakfast. Couldn't decide, so I got a taylor ham, egg, and cheese sandwich along with blueberry pancakes. The egg sandwich was fantastic, served on a hamburger roll. The home fries were sauteed with peppers and onions. Pancakes were fluffy, but could've done without the pre-packaged syrup. The server was friendly and attentive, constantly refilling the good coffee. Loved this place and can't wait to go back. Long live the Jersey diners!

input: Our server was awesome. Very tentative and extremely nice! That is the only thing saving this place plus the maple wings were delicious. Now for the bad part. We paid 35 dollars for the "piano guys" to sing a song to the birthday girl. We had 3 options of songs that we wanted to hear. They called our birthday girl on stage and began to sing a rendition of Aladins whole new world. (Which was not one of the songs we had picked) The song quickly turned to a absolutely disgusting remake. The piano guy sang so our birthday girl about opening her thighs,tying her up, filling holes, splurging on her face, and cumming in her hair. It was even worse than that. Her husband and family including parents were in the crowd but luckily couldn't hear to well because the sound system is terrible. Our birthday girl even stopped the piano man and told him to stop and he continued and made it even dirtier. It was disgusting, offensive, and embarrassing. Trust me we are not prudes by any means but this was way too far. It completely ruined the experience and we all immediately left. We spent our time and money there only to have the birthday ruined. Also for 35 dollars we paid we only heard 1 of the songs which they only sang  part of.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Our server was excellent, extremely friendly and attentive. The maple wings were delicious. However, we were disappointed with the entertainment. We paid $35 for the "piano guys" to sing a song for the birthday girl, but they performed a rendition of Aladdin's "A Whole New World" instead of the songs we had chosen. The lyrics turned extremely inappropriate and offensive, making the situation uncomfortable and embarrassing for everyone, including family members present. The sound system compounded the problem. We decided to leave immediately, as the experience was ruined. Additionally, we only heard a partial rendition of one song despite the price we paid.

input:
The new Han Dynasty took over the spot where the old Mid-Atlantic restaurant (with the unchanging menu) was. I like the Han Dynasty here a lot more than the one in Olde City even if I give both 4*. Maybe I'm biased, because I love the service here. They've always been very nice, and came over to check in with me and just make some small conversation when they heard I had a peanut allergy (even though they had no peanuts in any of the dishes I ordered; I think it was Han's sister?). I've been to this Han Dynasty more times in a month than the number of times I've been to the other.

Note though, that the different branches have different specialties. I heard the dan dan mian in Olde City is the best, but the one in UC isn't so good (I wouldn't know since it has peanuts). Overall, I think it;s okay food wise, still not spicy enough as with the other branch. But I like the layout and atmosphere a lot more.

Next, if you go during lunch, you can ask for lunch portions, that are smaller than the dinner portions, and half the menu price! So it's a great lunch place too, alone, or in a group of 2 or 3.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The new Han Dynasty has replaced the old Mid-Atlantic restaurant in the same location. I prefer this Han Dynasty to the one in Olde City, probably because of biased reasons, such as the great service. The staff here is always friendly and accommodating, even going out of their way to check in on me and make conversation when they learned I have a peanut allergy. I have frequented this Han Dynasty more than the other branch. However, it's important to note that each branch has its own specialties. The dan dan mian in Olde City is highly recommended, but unfortunately, the one in UC isn't as good for me due to my allergy. The food here is decent overall, although I find it not as spicy as the other branch. Nevertheless, I appreciate the layout and atmosphere of this restaurant more. Additionally, if you visit during lunch, you can enjoy smaller portions at half the price, making it a great choice for a solo lunch or a small group gathering of 2 or 3 people.

input:
We went to Carisma Restaurante again tonight. It has become our "go to" spot. The food is excellent and the service was great. The owner Jose is very friendly and tries to visit every table to make sure everyone is satisfied.  Tonight we had 2 Paellas, salmon and a filet mignon. Everything was made to order, cooked to perfection and came out hot.  

The family also opened a cafe in front of the restaurant. Jose gave us a tour and introduced us to his daughter that runs the cafe. The baked goods and coffees at the cafe are just as good as the meals at Carisma. Good, fresh food prepared and served by nice people. Try Carisma, it's so much more than just the normal tacos and burritos. You wont be disappointed!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We went to Carisma Restaurante again tonight, our favorite spot with excellent food and great service. The owner, Jose, is friendly and personally ensures everyone is satisfied. We had 2 Paellas, salmon, and filet mignon - all made to order, cooked perfectly, and served hot. Additionally, the family recently opened a cafe in front of the restaurant where we met Jose's daughter. The cafe offers delicious baked goods and coffees. Carisma offers more than just tacos and burritos, it's a must-try experience that won't disappoint!

input: This is a small hole in the wall in the African section of Woodland Avenue.  Though it might not look like much, there is some good food coming out of its kitchen representing Senegal and West Africa.  I enjoyed the national dish of Senegal - Thiboudienne - although note that here they do a version without the usual tomato sauce.  I also took home a Jollof Rice which is often called the mother dish of Jambalaya.  There are a few hightop tables inside for dining or you can order the food to-go.  Either way, service is friendly.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This small hole in the wall located on Woodland Avenue in the African section serves delicious Senegalese and West African cuisine. Despite its unassuming appearance, the food is excellent. I particularly enjoyed the Thiboudienne, the national dish of Senegal, which is prepared here without tomato sauce. I also recommend trying their Jollof Rice, often referred to as the mother dish of Jambalaya. The establishment offers a few hightop tables for dining in, as well as the option to order the food to-go. The friendly service adds to the overall experience.

input: Had a falafel wrap here a few years ago. Not bad, so tried it again today. No flavor, except extreme saltiness! The falafels & pita = no flavor. I was hoping the tzatziki sauce would pull it all together, nope! It had no flavor either. It wasn't like the sauce you'd imagine, but more like a thin tasteless glue. Only good part about the wrap were the fresh diced cucumber & tomato, too bad that was underneath the icky white sauce that doesn't even deserve to be called tzatziki : (
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Had a falafel wrap here a few years ago. Second time today. No flavor, very salty. Falafels and pita lacked flavor. Tzatziki sauce had no flavor and resembled tasteless glue. Only good parts were fresh diced cucumber and tomato, unfortunately covered by poor tzatziki.

input: Exactly as bougie and casual at the same time as you need it to be. Come with your Gucci bag or in your yoga pants and slam a delicious cocktail or three.

input:
Our group of 6 decided to try something different.  So,  we gave this place a shot.   Very happy with our decision. 

The wife and I shared the special,  which was a massive amount of food for the two of us.   It was a great sampling of all their food options. 

The chicken, steak and rice/beans were pretty amazing.  I could do without the egg,  but it was easy enough to push over to the side.   I'm not a fan of Yuca, but this wasn't bad.   The plantains were delicious.   I didn't try the salad... Just wasn't in the mood for it. 

All in all,  the place is a must visit if you are up for trying something new.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Our group of 6 tried this place and were very happy with our decision. The wife and I shared the special which was a large portion of food and a great sampling of their options. The chicken, steak, and rice/beans were amazing. The egg was not to my liking but easily put aside. The yuca was okay, and the plantains were delicious. I skipped the salad as I wasn't in the mood for it. Overall, it's a must-visit if you want to try something new.

input: Out lunch today was pulled pork, smokehouse bowl, and delicious sides of sweet potato casserole and red beans and rice.   Red beans and rice was spicy but good. Sweet potato casserole yummy and meat was smoky juicy and plentiful. Definitely a must.

The pulled pork was smoky, juicy, and generously portioned, making it a definite must-try.

input: Tried the pulled pork, green beans, Mac n cheese and cornbread. It was all pretty mediocre barbecue. Not bad, not great. The pork was a little overdone/dry, but had a nice smoky flavor. The original bbq sauce is pretty sweet/syrupy. Ill probably go back, but I wouldn't if there was a better option as close to my house.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Tried the pulled pork, green beans, Mac n cheese and cornbread at this barbecue place. It was mediocre overall, not bad but not great. The pork was slightly overdone/dry, but had a nice smoky flavor. The original bbq sauce was on the sweeter side. I may return, but only if there isn't a better option nearby.

input: Husband and I made a mistake and came here on a Lenten Friday. The wait was forever. But since we were already there, might as well suck it up and see what's it all about. We ordered the blackened alligator and oysters for appetizers, the alligator came out within 15 minutes, and it was alright. A bit too greasy. Then another 15 minutes later, our raw oysters came out, I wanted mine char grilled but the waitress didn't mention they don't have char grilled oysters and still took my order, so I thought I was waiting for mine to be cooked the entire time. When she brought out the two half-dozen raw oyster trays, that's when she told me they only have raw oysters there. SMH. I have sensitive stomach so I only had 3 then gave the rest to my husband. Regardless, the oysters were really fresh. We waited for at least another 20 minutes later for our entrees to come out. At this point, I was really hungry and had hoped we were at home eating ramen noodles instead. My husband had the roast beef po-boy, and I had the tuna and shrimp kabob. My husband told me his roast beef was really salty and while ironically, my kabob was very bland. The kabob came with exactly 3 pieces of cubed tuna, 2 medium size shrimp with plenty of bell peppers and onions in between, and baby shrimp creole with rice. For the ok price, I shouldn't complain too much about this place. Didn't try their seafood boil, but it looked like that would have been a better choice.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We made a mistake by visiting on a Lenten Friday and had to endure a long wait. Despite that, we decided to stay and try the food. We ordered blackened alligator and oysters as appetizers. The alligator arrived quickly but was slightly greasy. However, the raw oysters took longer to come out. I had mistakenly ordered char grilled oysters, which they didn't have, and ended up only eating three because of my sensitive stomach. The oysters were fresh though. We waited another 20 minutes for our entrees. My husband found his roast beef po-boy too salty, while my tuna and shrimp kabob lacked flavor. It had only three pieces of tuna and two medium shrimp with plenty of bell peppers and onions. The price was okay, and we didn't try their seafood boil, which seemed like a better option.

input:
im going to have to give this place one star for its horrible customer service:

i called in to ask about the 50% off for tulane students they were advertising, the woman assured me if i came with an id it would be half off and made an appointment for me, only once i got there did they tell me it's only on certain days, "it says it right on the sign," i was perturbed by the inconvenience and said so you're not going to honor it even though you just made an appointment with me and told me it would be 50% off, they said no flat out at first even though the error was blatantly on their side, after my nagging, she eventually called john jay himself and he told the woman that he would not honor what i was told even though i had been inconvenienced by someone in HIS staff because it might cause a 'domino effect,' i said how will there be a domino effect unless you continue to give people incorrect information, there will be no other 'dominoes' as long as you remember what day it is from now on... they began to treat me somewhat patronizingly as i explained that usually businesses make concessions when they are the one at fault, that the customer is supposed to always be right, yadda yadda yadda, i left pretty upset and with ~45 minutes of my life having been wasted - empty handed but for a lame excuse from someone who owns at least 3 businesses over 10 dollars...

i have not received a haircut from them so if you're one of those people who ONLY cares about the product and you think you'll get a good cut go right on ahead, but if you're like me (principled) and you don't like handing profits to people who care nothing about their customers this is a good place to skip next time you need a cut
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I'll give this place one star for their terrible customer service. I called to inquire about the 50% off offer for Tulane students that they were advertising. The woman on the phone assured me that if I came with my ID, it would be half off and made an appointment for me. However, when I arrived, they informed me that the offer was only valid on certain days, which was not mentioned before. I expressed my frustration, pointing out that they had made an appointment with me and promised the discount. Initially, they flat out refused to honor it, despite the mistake being on their side. After much insistence, the woman called the owner, John Jay, who also declined to honor what I had been told. He mentioned something about a "domino effect" and refused to make an exception. I argued that there could be no "domino effect" if they just started giving correct information from now on. They patronizingly treated me as I explained that businesses usually make concessions when they are at fault and that the customer should always be right. I left upset and with around 45 minutes wasted. I have yet to receive a haircut from them. If you only care about the quality of the product and believe you will receive a good cut, go ahead and give them a try. But if you're like me - principled and dislike supporting businesses that disregard their customers - I recommend skipping this place for your next haircut.

input: Awesome food, great place to split a bunch of delicious spicy, ultra flavorful dishes with a large group. It's the Chinese restaurant a lot of people know about for good reason - I haven't had a single bad dish here, and it's always a crowd-pleaser.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This Chinese restaurant is known for its amazing food. It's a great place to enjoy a variety of delicious, spicy, and flavorful dishes with a big group of people. Every dish I've had here has been fantastic, making it a must-visit for anyone looking for a crowd-pleasing dining experience.

input:
My friend and I visited Tampa for a concert, and about ten minutes away from the Atlanta airport he realized that he had purchased tickets for the wrong day. We had already made hotel reservations and bought the concert tickets, so he just had to pay same-day price for airfare: all in all about $800 more. "It was totally worth it," he later told me, "Because I got to have the best sandwich of my entire life."

All because we randomly picked the Bricks of Ybor from Yelp. I can't vouch for the peanut butter or meatless menu, but the meat sandwiches that we bought were absolutely phenomenal. I had the pulled pork, which was flavored with ponzu and served on Hawaiian sweet bread. It was one of the best meals I've had in a long time. We spent a few hours hanging out and drinking, during which time Brian, the owner, came out and talked to us, comped us a drink, let us try new appetizers he was developing (all for free) and generally made us feel really welcome. 

I kept my eyes open to the kind of crowd that came in and out of the restaurant. It seemed to draw everything from hipsters to geriatrics and strait-laced families with young kids. I think it speaks to both the diversity of the menu and the pleasant environment. We went back for drinks before and after the concert. It got very crowded but we still received excellent food, drinks and service. I give this restaurant my strongest recommendation, and it's the first place I'm going when I next visit Tampa.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My friend and I visited Tampa for a concert. However, he realized at the Atlanta airport that he had bought tickets for the wrong day. Despite the extra cost of about $800, he said it was worth it because he had the best sandwich ever at the Bricks of Ybor. The meat sandwiches, like the pulled pork with ponzu on Hawaiian sweet bread, were amazing. The owner, Brian, made us feel welcome, comped us a drink, and let us try new appetizers for free. The diverse crowd, ranging from hipsters to families with kids, speaks to the restaurant's appeal. We went back for drinks before and after the concert, and despite the crowd, the food, drinks, and service were still excellent. I highly recommend this place and it will be my first stop when I visit Tampa again.

input: So worth the wait! The crepes are amazing! I also loved the grits, which is rare. Tried my hubby's pancakes....awesome!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The crepes are amazing and worth the wait! I also enjoyed the grits, which is a rarity. Additionally, I tried my husband's pancakes and they were awesome.

input: My sister-in-law and I visited this restaurant on 8/28/15 mid afternoon.  We were seated after requested 3 times that the hostess speak a little louder because we couldn't even hear her with the background music.  We were seated in a booth with a never ending Larry King vitamin commercial on the TV - really?  Our waitress introduced herself and a new trainee and then we never saw her again.  Two other wait staff seemed to be sharing our table, but no idea who was responsible for our table.  We got our drinks and ordered, but food took forever considering there was not more than 15-20 filled tables in the entire restaurant.  Burgers were not bad - I ordered the blue cheese burger and it would have been better with less blue cheese, way too much!  Fries and onion sticks were very good.  But no one came to see if we were satisfied, needing anything, etc and took two requests and waiting to get a carry out box.  There was a family seated across the aisle from us when we arrived and we assumed they had finished their meal and were "hanging out".  Only after we received our food did we understand they had already ordered and still did not have their food!  I doubt I will return to this restaurant in the future.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My sister-in-law and I visited this restaurant on 8/28/15. We had difficulty hearing the hostess and had to request multiple times for her to speak louder due to the background music. We were seated in a booth with a continuous Larry King vitamin commercial on the TV. Our waitress introduced herself along with a trainee, but we never saw her again. It was unclear which wait staff was responsible for our table. Despite only a few filled tables in the restaurant, our food took a long time to arrive. The burgers were decent, but my blue cheese burger had an excessive amount of blue cheese. The fries and onion sticks were very good. We had to make two requests and wait for a while to receive a carry out box. We noticed a family seated across from us who had ordered before us but still did not have their food. Overall, based on this experience, I am unlikely to return to this restaurant in the future.

input:
In short, the food was decently good, but completely overpriced.  The guacamole and my Mojito were probably the highlight of the meal. I had the peach pork medallions, which were nicely cooked, but lacked flavor. I tried the corn cakes with Barbacoa and that was pretty good.  

The atmosphere was inviting with a hip feel if that's what you're looking for.  What was really annoying was the parking situation. For a place with price points such as these and limited parking spaces, a valet service should be provided either at a cost or complimentary.  Don't even try and park in the back of the building, it's tight and dangerous even getting there and back.  I ended up parking three blocks away and broke a sweat walking in the dead of summer to the front entrance.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Overall, the food was decent, but overpriced. The guacamole and Mojito were the highlights. The peach pork medallions were well-cooked but lacked flavor. The corn cakes with Barbacoa were pretty good. The inviting atmosphere has a hip feel. However, the parking situation was annoying and there was limited space. A valet service should be provided, given the high prices and parking difficulties. Parking at the back of the building is tight and dangerous. I ended up parking three blocks away and walked in the hot summer, which was tiring.

input: Had dinner Saturday night for the first time at rusty pelican. Called ahead and made a reservation and requested a table next to the window overlooking the water. Hostess went to seat us away from the window, when we questioned her she huffed off and left us staying in the middle of the dining room!! She did return and sat us by the window. The rest of the evening was great, drinks, food and wait staff was excellent. Liz was our server and went above and beyond. Still have to say the hostess was very disappointing!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Had dinner at Rusty Pelican for the first time on Saturday night. We made a reservation and specifically requested a table by the window with waterfront view. Initially, the hostess tried to seat us away from the window. When we confronted her, she walked away and left us in the middle of the dining room. Eventually, she returned and accommodated our request. The remainder of the evening was enjoyable, with great drinks, food, and excellent service from our server, Liz. However, we were disappointed with the hostess's behavior.

input:
This was a tough one!   On the merits of the wine, fairly average... I understand that the winery has more than one lable and other label is their premium wines.  I look forward to when that is available (I went two weeks ago so maybe it already is)     Location..   what's not to like?  On the pier!  A wonderful outdoor patio,  couldn't have a nicer setting to enjoy your tasting....   The staff were super, super nice,  I would give them an A+!  

So why only three stars?  It is because of the wine club!  Very expensive for the quality of the wines and stingy as HELL with the benefits to the members..   Most wine clubs will give you a free tasting every time you come in (after all, we are your best customers... we are the ones who buy your wine time and time again).  Some wineries will give their members a complimentary glass in leau of a tasting (Carr).   Most wineries allow you to bring guests which is how you get new wine club members.   This system works folks!  The way this wine club works is that you are given a very limited number of passes per quarter, five as I recall.   If I come with my wife once a month we wouldn't even be covered... let alone if we bring a guest!   

So go to this winery if you want to enjoy a tasting in one of the most beautiful settings on earth.   But avoid the wine club!  For that you can pretty much go to any of the other wine tasting rooms on the Urban wine trail.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The wine at this winery is average, but they have premium wines available. The location on the pier is fantastic with a wonderful outdoor patio. The staff is extremely nice. However, the wine club is expensive and the benefits are not worth it. Most wine clubs offer free tastings, complimentary glasses, and allow guests, but this wine club only provides a limited number of passes per quarter. Visit this winery for the beautiful setting, but avoid the wine club.

input:
I got a cheap haircut in NY for next to nothing and what do you know. it looks like some crazy chimp chewed up my hair and spat  it back on my raw scalp.

Since I'm going for job interviews, I needed to look better and went to Domenick's. The guys were great, Robert cut my hair and did a clean job. Bill came out to $35. I'd give it a 4, but it was a little pricy for my taste, but I look human again. Don't know what you guys in Philly normally pay for a haircut.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I got a cheap and poorly done haircut in New York, making my hair look messy. However, I needed to improve my appearance for job interviews, so I went to Domenick's in Philadelphia. Robert did a clean job cutting my hair, and the cost was $35. While a bit pricey for me, it was worth it as I now look presentable for interviews. I'm unsure of the usual haircut prices in Philadelphia.

input: Very unhappy, you lost a valued customer. We had a problem where Monro Muffler underfilled our engine by 3 quarts of oil and caused damage to the engine. Monro's insurance company said they would pay for damages if we brought to the dealer, we were frequent customers of Bergeys so we brought it here. They discovered the timing chain needed to be replaced, a chain that lasts the life of the car unless you don't change the oil or have low oil pressure the tensioner can lock and stretch the chain. Joe the service associate that took the car in specifically said I told the insurance company as little as possible and told them he couldn't tell if it was from the oil and there was no way to tell. And on top of that, was extremely rude and unprofessional to my wife bringing her to tears the way he spoke to her. My wife and I just bought a house in the area, only 26 years old and you lost a life long customer. Over the past year we spent about $7000 in repairs here, and Joe went out of his way to be unhelpful and leave us in a terrible spot. I brought it to another mechanic who was able to help us prove more it was from the oil and do what Joe told us and the insurance company they could not do. So on top of losing a service customer, I'm on the market for a new car and can tell you for sure where I will not be getting it.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I am extremely dissatisfied and disappointed with the service I received from Monro Muffler. They underfilled our engine with 3 quarts of oil, causing damage. Despite their insurance company offering to cover the damages if we took the car to the dealer, we chose Bergeys where we are frequent customers. Bergeys determined that the timing chain needed replacement, even though it should last the lifetime of the car unless there are oil-related issues. Joe, the service associate, purposely downplayed the issue to the insurance company and was disrespectful to my wife, even making her cry. We recently purchased a house in the area and have spent approximately $7000 in repairs at Bergeys, but due to Joe's unhelpful attitude, we have lost faith in their service. We have turned to another mechanic who was able to prove that the damage was indeed caused by the oil, contradicting Joe and the insurance company. As a result, we will not only withdraw our service from Bergeys but also look for a new car elsewhere.

input:
Beautiful clean shop with knock your socks off Everything ...
Homemade breakfast tarts and chicken pot pies .
All sweets looked well beyond beautiful and delish.
I felt some of the items were a tad pricey considering the sizes being on a smaller size. But I know premium quality costs more .. 
It's a great place for locals and worth a trip if traveling from center city etc .
I found counter staff to be most friendly and engaging 
Will be back and certainly will recommend
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Beautiful, clean shop with delicious homemade breakfast tarts and chicken pot pies. All the sweets looked absolutely stunning and tasted incredible. Although some items were a bit pricey due to their smaller sizes, the premium quality justified the cost. Locals will love this place, and it's definitely worth a visit for those traveling from center city. The counter staff was friendly and attentive. I will definitely be returning and recommending it to others.

input: Definitely get in line before 8:30am. We waited about 30 minutes. Pancakes were fine. My friends got the raspberry pancakes, the sweet potato pancakes and the san antonio. I got the sugar and spice pancakes. All were well and fine, a bit dry. I don't understand the hype, but if the line isn't too long it's not bad for normal breakfast food. If the line is longer I would highly recommend skipping this place and heading down the street to Fido - insanely good coffee and great breakfast food.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Arrive before 8:30am to avoid longer wait times. We waited around 30 minutes and found the pancakes to be decent, albeit slightly dry. My friends tried the raspberry, sweet potato, and San Antonio pancakes, while I had the sugar and spice variety. Though we didn't quite understand the hype, the food was still alright for a regular breakfast. However, if the line is longer, I highly suggest going to Fido down the street for amazing coffee and breakfast options.

input: They have the WORST service advisors! Used to be good before Kelly and her team left. Unfortunately, it's convenient to work if I need oil change before I can make it to another Honda dealer.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The service advisors at this Honda dealer used to be good before Kelly and her team left, but now they have the worst service. However, it is convenient to work with them if I need an oil change before I can reach another Honda dealer.

input:
The best soon-dubu in the city!  This place is tucked away and once you walk in, it's like you've stepped into a Korean home.  Very welcoming, warm and inviting.

It's very vegetarian friendly!  The soft tofu is stewed and put into the dol sot pots which each and every stew feels like it's custom made for you. 

You can select from beef, seafood or mixed meats (seafood & beef), mushroom, and just plain.  They can adjust the spice as needed too.  I always get the extra hot with the hot temperature, can't beat it.  The rice also comes in a dol-sot which is great if you leave it in for a while, it burns the rice into a nice crispy shell.  DROOL.

Just thinking about this place makes my mouth salivate!  

If you're not into tofu, they also offer korean bbq meats (cooked in the back), with other soup/stew items.

Love this place!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The best soon-dubu in the city! This tucked-away restaurant gives you the feeling of stepping into a warm and inviting Korean home. It is very vegetarian-friendly, offering custom-made stewed soft tofu in dol sot pots. Options include beef, seafood, mixed meats, mushroom, and plain, with adjustable spice levels. The extra hot and hot temperature combination is a personal favorite. The dol-sot rice is also a highlight, developing a crispy shell when left in. For non-tofu lovers, they also serve Korean BBQ meats and other soup/stew items. This place is a must-visit for all Korean food enthusiasts!

input:
As motels go this one is very nice for the rate. Clean, comfortable and well-managed. You get what you pay for so the breakfast buffet is just OK. The pool is too small to swim laps (disappointing). The lobby area is spacious and comportable. 

If you are looking for a moderately priced place to sleep that is clean and comforable this will suit you just fine.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This motel is clean, comfortable, and well-managed. The rate is reasonable and while the breakfast buffet is just average, the overall experience is satisfying. The pool may not be suitable for swimming laps, which could be a disappointment. However, the spacious and comfortable lobby compensates for it. If you're in search of a moderately priced, clean, and comfortable place to sleep, this motel is a suitable choice.

input:
The only reason I mentioned the media or attorney was out of frustration after he would not provide the owner's contact info so I could appeal to her about keeping the area clean and cleaning or painting the columbarium.  That older area that is out of sight has been that way for years but we finally got tired of it and complained.  He never admitted it could be cleaned up.  As for the vase, I didn't demand just one for my Dad.  I stated he should replace the cheap plastic vases on ALL the niches as they were falling off and disintegrating.  There are not very many of them. I simply thought it would be the right thing to do.  

If there was empathy, I did not hear it.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I mentioned the media or attorney out of frustration as the owner's contact info was not provided to appeal for cleanliness and maintenance of the columbarium. The older area has been neglected for years and despite complaints, the issue was not addressed. I suggested replacing the falling and disintegrating plastic vases on all niches, not just for my Dad. I did not perceive any empathy in the response.

input:
From the second you walk in the door, you're greeted by the adorable woman at the counter. It seems if you come in here more than once a week, she'll know you're name but I haven't been so lucky since my visits are a bit more sporadic.

My most recent discovery are the vegetarian breakfast sandwiches, which are served all day! I particularly enjoy veg. sausage w/ havarti on an everything bagel. I could actually go for one right about now... I've also had the veggie club sandwich and my other half has enjoyed the chicken cheesesteak hoagie and the chicken salad on a croissant. Everything always taste fresh, they are priced really well  (I think my favorite bagel sandwich I mentioned is $2.09-2.99- cheaper than wawa!). The people at the deli are super helpful, offering menus if you can't read the one on the wall and will make great suggestions and accommodations to your needs and want.

Don't forget to grab a really great snack too while you're there- they have amazing chocolate bars, an incredible drink case, tons of chip varieties and those addictive hi-chew candies in every flavor.
