Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had a great private tour today with Carrie despite the rain and limited visitors. Her captivating knowledge and passion for the Civil War made it an enjoyable experience. The Battle of Franklin truly deserves a remarkable memorial.

input: Best service in town and best prices. Even the phone call just felt good. I called fast glass and they wanted to charge me 200$! About 80$ more than last time. So i looked around and found these guys. Called them and from the moment someone picked up i was treated wonderfully, they charged 165$ and it was worth the price too. I chip in my windshield spidered out and i was worried about a ticket, they fit me in that day. They vaccumed, wiped down the inside of my car and washed the windows. Waiting area is cozy and has tea, water and free suckers. They all treated me like a person, not a dumb girl like fast glass does. Ill definitely be going back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Found the best service in town with the best prices at this place. Called Fast Glass initially and they quoted me $200, $80 more than last time. Found these guys and called them, they treated me wonderfully and charged $165, worth it. They squeezed me in the same day for a windshield repair and even vacuumed, wiped down the inside of my car, and washed the windows. Cozy waiting area with tea, water, and free suckers. Unlike Fast Glass, they treated me like a person, not a dumb girl. Will definitely return.

input:
I am positively LIVID.

I went to check my account balance and what do I see? An overdraft fee of $220.
How could this happen? My card was never declined and there are two large fees deducted from my account.

I called TD and sat on hold for 45 MINUTES. I don't have that kind of time. Granted, the guy that was with me was nice and helpful, but never mentioned anything about the wait time until I brought it up. I asked about these fees and he said "Just so you are aware, TD Bank's new policy is that when you have insufficient funds, your card will not be declined. It will be run through, and you will be charged an overdraft fee."
OH THANK YOU FOR TELLING ME NOW, JERK.

I have too many salty words that are unacceptable in the public domain, so I'll stop now.

Needless to say, I am switching banks.

Sort of UPDATE:
I thought you Yelpers would like to know that last night, when I was depositing the cash that I didn't have into my account via ATM, I flipped off the cameras.
TAKE THAT, TD.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I am extremely angry. When I checked my account balance, I discovered a $220 overdraft fee. Despite never having my card declined, I was charged these fees. After being placed on hold for 45 minutes when I called TD, I finally spoke to a helpful representative who didn't mention the wait time. He informed me that TD Bank's new policy charges overdraft fees instead of declining insufficient funds transactions. I am very frustrated with this lack of transparency and will be changing banks. Additionally, I want to mention that last night, I expressed my frustration towards TD Bank by gesturing at the cameras while depositing cash into the ATM.

input:
We stayed at the Four Points for 3 nights in November, while here on business.  Nice hotel, and a good experience. 

Check in was a breeze.  We had a good price on the room via my Sheraton/SPG member and AAA discount, which included the free breakfast.  The hotel is literally 5 minutes from the airport, and there are several other hotels right on the same block.

Staff was friendly and helpful.  Room was fine, parking easy, quiet at night.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had a pleasant 3-night stay at the Four Points in November for business. Check-in was quick and we enjoyed a good price on the room with my Sheraton/SPG member and AAA discount, which also included complimentary breakfast. The hotel's convenient location only took us 5 minutes from the airport and there were other hotels nearby. The staff was friendly and accommodating, the room was satisfactory, parking was hassle-free, and we experienced a peaceful night's sleep.

input: Located right at the Union Station Metro stop (walking distance to all of downtown but metro-able too), this place was a good deal on the weekend.  Prices spike during the week when business-peeps fly in and their companies are paying the bill.  The room was clean, the bed was super comfy with TONS of pillows (one sure way to my heart).  The bathroom was large with a tub and too many white towels for two people.  Subtracted one star cause the coffee machine in our room sucked and the door was thin so you could hear people/children in the hall at WAY too early in the morning.  The main lobby is really a cool place tho.  Definitely worth checking out if you're in the area.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Located right at Union Station Metro stop, this place offers a convenient location within walking distance to downtown and easy access to the metro. It is a good deal on weekends, with prices increasing during weekdays when business travelers arrive. The room was clean and the bed was exceptionally comfortable, featuring an abundance of pillows. The spacious bathroom had a tub and provided an ample supply of white towels for two people. However, one star was deducted due to the poor coffee machine in the room and the thin door that allowed for noise from the hallway in the early morning. Nevertheless, the main lobby is impressive and definitely worth a visit if you're in the area.

input:
Some of the finest Mexican food I've had. The fried fish taco is WONDERFUL, as is all of the other food. My biggest regret is not buying their red sauce and birria to take home. 

Also-there is no air conditioning. They do have ceiling fans, but we all know those aren't necessarily helpful in the monsoon season. The food is definitely worth the trip though!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The Mexican food here is excellent, particularly the fried fish taco. I regret not purchasing their red sauce and birria to take home. However, it's worth noting that there is no air conditioning, only ceiling fans which may not be effective during the monsoon season. Despite this, the food is definitely worth the visit.

input: As an active runner my shoes are my life force. Endurance House has a fantastic selection of shoes for all runners.  The staff are always nice and helpful. What sets them apart from other stores is how they check for what shoe will best suit your stride and reduce injury.  I will happily keep coming back and know that I will get a good price, a great pair of shoes, and have personalized help.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Endurance House offers a superb range of shoes for all runners. Their friendly and helpful staff stands out by providing personalized assistance to find the perfect shoe for your stride, minimizing the risk of injury. With great prices and excellent shoe options, I am a loyal customer who will continue to return.

input:
Super lunch option
Watch out for the yoga mats
You won't miss the meat

Lunch has been very strange for me since HipCity opened. Because here's the thing: I am a meat eater. I mean like my last meal on earth would be a burger. Or, just maybe, the fajita wrap. Because it's that good.

Haven't had everything on the menu yet, but everything I have had has been great. The buffalo bella and crispy hipcity ranch are amazing sandwich alternatives, especially paired with the green lemonade. The groothie is also delicious, and can stand on its own to get you through an afternoon if you only want to spend a few bucks.

Okay suffice it to say that the food is great. The staff is also very friendly, and when they get busy someone will come out along the line and take orders so congestion doesn't get too bad at the register itself.

My only issue with HipCity is that it is at times nearly impossible to figure out where to stand when you're waiting to order or waiting for your food. People kind of convene everywhere and it can get awkward when there's a line out the door. In such a small space it's hard to rectify, but if I see a line out the door I tend to walk on by not because it's a long wait (they're really efficient), it's just difficult to navigate the interior.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: HipCity has become my go-to lunch spot, even though I'm a meat eater. The menu offers delicious alternatives like the buffalo bella and crispy hipcity ranch sandwiches. Pair it with the green lemonade or the groothie for a refreshing treat. The staff is friendly and efficient, but the small space can make it difficult to find a place to stand during busy times. Despite this, the food is worth it and I highly recommend giving it a try.

input:
This place's posted hours include a 10PM closing time. 

I walked in at 8:30 and, as soon as I got to the counter, the guy said to me "kitchen's closed." The grill, fryers, etc were all being covered up. 

First of all, if your kitchen is closed, why is the door to your restaurant unlocked? 

Secondly, I could see this being the case if I walked in at, say, 9:55PM. But 8:30? That's ridiculous.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The posted hours of this place indicate a closing time of 10PM. However, when I arrived at 8:30PM, the kitchen was already closed and the staff was in the process of covering up the grill and fryers. It is puzzling why the door to the restaurant was unlocked if the kitchen was closed. Furthermore, considering it was only 8:30PM, it seems unreasonable for the kitchen to be closed at such an early hour.

input: no contest best Chinese good in the area. owners are incredibly nice and the wontons while you wait for take out are a treat.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Best Chinese food in the area with incredibly nice owners. Wontons served while you wait for takeout are a delicious treat.

input:
Rosemary's Grill is my favorite resaurant.  My wife and I take my Mother in law to Rosemary's Grill often for many reasons.  Their menu is extensive.  You can get Classic American food in many categories prepared fresh and delicious with great care and attention to detail that is lacking in common chain restaurants.  You can also get traditional Turkish cuisine that is the very best kebab that I ever had.  Rosemary's is a family owned business and they treat you like you are part of that family.  We are making Rosemary's our Saturday night place.  last weekend my wife and I took my. Mother in law to Rosemary's Grill for dinner.  It was even better that the time before.  I tried the Mixed grill kebab platter.  Lamb, Chicken, Adana, and gyro kebab meats, so tender and expertly spiced and grilled, along with a shepherds salad, grilled half tomatoes, rice, and of course flat bread.  The Adana kebab was particularly tender, juicy, and tasty.  I had never had Adana kebab before and will be ordering it again.  I shared a taste with my Mother in law and she loved it too!  mom in law had crab cakes and she enjoyed them very much.  My wife had the French onion soup, which she raves about and always orders.  She also had the roast turkey, mashed potatoes, cranberry sauce, and corn.  She loved everything on that platter.  She commented that the gravy was especially good.  The portion sizes are huge and we love to have the left overs again at home.  I have honestly not been to a restaurant in the area that has such good quality in all there entrees, sides, salad bar, and drinks, and you have to try the rice pudding.  We have eaten a few times here for breakfast, lunch, and dinner and it continues to be our very favorite place.  The waitstaff and owners make you feel right at home and are warm, welcoming, and friendly.  I can not say enough good things.  

Sent from my iPad
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Rosemary's Grill is my favorite restaurant. They have an extensive menu offering Classic American food as well as traditional Turkish cuisine. The food is prepared fresh and delicious with great care and attention to detail. It is a family-owned business that treats you like part of the family. My wife and I frequently take my Mother in law there. Recently, we had dinner and it was even better than before. I tried the Mixed grill kebab platter and it was amazing. The Adana kebab was particularly tender, juicy, and tasty. My Mother in law loved it too! My wife had the French onion soup and roast turkey, which she raved about. The portion sizes are huge and we often have leftovers. The quality of the food, including the entrees, sides, salad bar, and drinks, is unmatched in the area. The waitstaff and owners are warm and friendly, making you feel right at home. Overall, Rosemary's Grill is our favorite place to eat.

input: Very friendly staff and nice environment although the crowd was light surprisingly the both times I went there. Get yourself a $3.50 margarita after 4 on Tuesdays, they are pretty good.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Staff and environment are very friendly. Despite the light crowd, both times I went there were enjoyable. On Tuesdays after 4, they offer a delicious $3.50 margarita.

input: I can walk here and won't go back even if they were the only place open at 2am.  I got the basic general tso's and it didn't come close to passing the test.  Go to East Cuisine.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I can walk here and won't go back even if they were the only place open at 2am. The basic general tso's didn't pass the test. Go to East Cuisine.

input: If not for the pretentious, haughty, superior attitude of our waiter, I would have given this place four stars or possibly more... Seriously. That kind of attitude is exactly why I left New York. We wanted to order a bottle of wine, asked for his suggestion, and he answers with, "How much do you want to spend?" Ummm... Excuse me? How about, "I'm happy to make some recommendations. Let's find a price point you're comfortable with..." He didn't smile ONCE during the meal service and also found it necessary to correct us on several points of preference. Snob. The food is GOOD. The only thing that was great was the blueberry lasagna. And it is superb. So was the chocolate confection for dessert. I'd say go. And I hope you don't get that waiter.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food at this place is good, but unfortunately, the waiter's pretentious and haughty attitude ruined the experience. He was unhelpful when we asked for a wine recommendation and corrected us on our preferences. The only standout dishes were the blueberry lasagna and chocolate confection for dessert. I would recommend going, but hope you don't encounter that waiter.

input: The flavors continue to surprise me. I had Bananas Foster, Pear Champagne Sorbet, Blueberry Fig Sorbet, and Cassis sorbet. All flavors were good but the Cassis started off quite subtly and then the flavor gradually made itself known; the more I ate of it the better it tasted. It was well worth coming back with another group of friends to sample some frozen happiness.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was pleasantly surprised by the variety of flavors I tried: Bananas Foster, Pear Champagne Sorbet, Blueberry Fig Sorbet, and Cassis sorbet. While all the flavors were good, the Cassis had a subtle start and gradually became more flavorful the more I ate. It was so delicious that I plan to return with another group of friends to enjoy more of this frozen happiness.

input:
Best pizza ever... hands down.

Love the peeps running the place - former hockey player (ask him to pop his nose) and adorable, but tough as nails wife... very funny.

They make their own sausage and mozzarella here.  And God help you if you mispronounce Ricotta!!

Any of the pizzas are fab... we even eat the crusts - which is a rarity in our family.  Just dab it in the olive oil, and mayb ask for some of their viniagrette to dip too!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This pizzeria serves the best pizza hands down. The owner, a former hockey player, and his adorable tough-as-nails wife run the place. They make their own sausage and mozzarella. Be careful not to mispronounce Ricotta. All the pizzas are great, even the crusts. Try dabbing them in olive oil and maybe ask for some vinaigrette to dip as well.

input: Friendly sales staff ; ) mike was very helpful ! Took us for a ride in one if the Razors ; ) never know we might get 1 ; )
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Friendly sales staff; Mike was helpful and took us for a ride in one of the Razors. Considering getting one ourselves.

input: I actually eat here at least once a month . The food is good and the service compliments it. You will fall in love with there zucchini muffins. I always leave with some stashed in my purse, you know for later. The prices are cheap and they have a fantastic frozen yogurt bar . with unlimited toppings. Have fun !! yum yum
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I eat here monthly, the food and service are good. Try their zucchini muffins - they're amazing. I always take some for later. Prices are cheap and they have a fantastic frozen yogurt bar with unlimited toppings. Enjoy!

input:
Came for all-you-can-eat, and ended up waiting for over half an hour to get our order in. The servers completely ignored us, while taking orders from the tables around us. And on top of that, all of the rolls contain "extras" not listed on the menu. One roll surprised us by having sweet mustard sauce on it, which did NOT taste very good....
On the bright side, once we actually got our orders in they didn't take all that long to make them.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had a long wait and were ignored by servers when we came for all-you-can-eat. The rolls contained unlisted "extras," including one with sweet mustard sauce that didn't taste good. However, once our orders were placed, they were made quickly.

input: The restaurant was very nicely decorated , and clean. There were six of us and everyone enjoyed their meals . I had the fried green tomatoes. They were perfectly seasoned and the sauce served with them was delicious. The down side is they arrived after everyone else had their meals . My friends had the chicken salad , the fried bologna sandwich and a cheeseburger. We shared the peach cobbler dessert and were not disappointed, get it with the ice cream !!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The restaurant was beautifully decorated, clean, and we all enjoyed our meals. I had the deliciously seasoned fried green tomatoes with a flavorful sauce. However, the only downside was that they arrived after everyone else had finished their meals. Our friends ordered the chicken salad, fried bologna sandwich, and cheeseburger, all of which were satisfying. We also shared the peach cobbler dessert and highly recommend getting it with ice cream.

input: Food is good, but the cafe itself is extremely dirty. I will probably not return unless they clean the place up.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The cafe's food is good, but it is very dirty. I may not go back unless they improve cleanliness.

input: We really liked this place. Everything we had was delicious. Portions were big. Chicken parm was so yummy. Can't wait to go back and try more stuff !
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We thoroughly enjoyed this place. The food was delicious, especially the chicken parm which was exceptionally yummy. The portion sizes were generous. Looking forward to returning and exploring more of their menu options!

input: not a bad little burger joint. i got the bacon cheeseburger. bacon was cooked perfect and had the perfect thickness. bun had a really great toasted crust. fries were good, as well as the chocolate shake I had. 3 complaints, i wish the burger was more juicy, I wish I wasn't paying so much for the tiny burger portion I was served, and I wish I didn't leave the place smelling like burger grease.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Decent burger place with good bacon. Perfectly cooked bacon with ideal thickness. Great toasted bun crust. Fries and chocolate shake were also good. Three minor complaints: burger could have been juicier, portions were small for the price, and left smelling like burger grease.

input: So I decided to give this place a shot after reading all the reviews on yelp. The place was dead but I have it a shot. The food was okay at best. I actually left there and went across the street to Charlie's. The place was packed and one bite of the redtop pizza and I cursed myself for not coming here first. If you want a sit down meal this place is nice. If you want good pizza go to Charlie's.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: After reading reviews on Yelp, I decided to try this place but found it to be empty. The food was average at best, so I left and went to Charlie's across the street. It was packed and their redtop pizza was so delicious that I regretted not going there in the first place. If you're looking for a sit-down meal, this place is decent, but for good pizza, go to Charlie's.

input:
We've been shopping here since this location was a Wild Oats. Perhaps I'm just imagining things, but I'd swear it has gotten better since the merger of these two chains.

I love the produce, seafood and cheese here. But it's the personal care section with tons o' natural cosmetics, handmade soaps and the like that brings us in most often. Well, that and the salad bar. In the cooler months, nothing beats hitting Whole Foods for a post-yoga lunch of soup and salad or the deli salad sampler plate. The Carrot Ginger, Split Pea and Corn Chowder soups are the best! Other sure bets: the curried tofu salad (or pretty much any of the deli-made tofu items), sushi to-go boxes and the everything cookies. My most recent find: lavender soda - kinda' dry and really does relax you :-)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We've been shopping here since it was a Wild Oats and it has improved since the merger. We love the produce, seafood, cheese, and personal care section with natural cosmetics and handmade soaps. The salad bar is another favorite, especially during cooler months for post-yoga lunches. The Carrot Ginger, Split Pea, and Corn Chowder soups are delicious. Other recommendations include the curried tofu salad, sushi to-go boxes, and everything cookies. Recently discovered lavender soda is a refreshing and relaxing option.

input: OMG the Mediterranean chicken quesadillas what awesome sauce. Definitely recommend to anyone who enjoys fresh Greek food
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The Mediterranean chicken quesadillas are incredible and highly recommended for anyone who loves fresh Greek cuisine.

input: So so in love with this place & it is gorgeous. A very spacious & modern design & most of all CLEAN!!!! Love Will, Amanda & Sal! I have made several purchases to include some mods and atty's and being a newbie I have issues from time to time with the devices. Not because the devices aren't working but I may take something apart and can't figure out how to put it back together (newbie ish) lol They always help me and get me back to vaping!!! They have a wide variety of juices, mods, atty's and i'm always in there tasting something. You've got to try it! You will not be sorry! In love with this spot!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is truly stunning, spacious, modern, and impeccably clean. We, Will, Amanda, and Sal, absolutely love it here! As a newbie, I've made several purchases and sometimes struggle with the devices. However, the staff is always incredibly helpful and gets me back to vaping in no time. The variety of juices, mods, and atty's is impressive, and I'm always sampling something new. Don't miss out on this amazing spot - you won't regret it!

input: So this is what you need to know. Everything taste great, well at least what I had. I practically tried everything for breakfast and have come to the conclusion that this is the spot for breakfast. I have one gripe though, the monte cisto is not worth the price and is way over priced. I know truffle oil is used but that should not be the reason its so damn expensive. one egg, one piece of toast and some sauce. Don't ever order it, not worth it unless they drop the price $5. everything else is worth it taste great. Jebbs open face and the huevos rancheros are my favs. Enjoy. oh and the coffee is addicting. Also there are no reservations, so get there early or go about 30 min before u think u may be hungry.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Everything tastes great at this breakfast spot, and I've practically tried everything. The only downside is that the monte cisto is overpriced for what it includes - one egg, one piece of toast, and some sauce with truffle oil. I wouldn't recommend ordering it unless they lower the price by $5. The Jebbs open face and the huevos rancheros are my favorites. The coffee is addicting and be aware that there are no reservations, so it's best to arrive early or around 30 minutes before you anticipate being hungry. Enjoy!

input: Only had one experience with this place and it will be my last. I called in the night before to ask if they sell deboned duck and the man on the phone said they could but I would have to request it the day of. I called the following morning to ask to pick up a plain deboned duck and whoever the incompetent girl who answered had trouble getting my order clear. I picked up my order and came home to find that not only did they gave a whole duck with stuffing I never asked for. I called the place back and thy never offered any compensation of any sort except a trade in right as it's a hour before dinner time and the butcher shop is more than thirty minutes away for me. Shame that food from this place is overshadowed by their terrible customer service.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My only experience with this place will be my last. I called the night before to inquire about deboned duck, and was told that I could request it the next day. When I called the following morning to place my order, the person who answered had difficulty understanding my request. Upon receiving my order, I discovered that they had given me a whole duck with stuffing, which I had not asked for. When I contacted the restaurant to address the issue, they offered no compensation, only suggesting a trade-in. This was not feasible for me as it was already close to dinner time and the butcher shop was a significant distance away. It is disappointing that their terrible customer service overshadows the quality of their food.

input:
Visited the preserve today based on reviews and was VERY pleased.  

The hikes are great! Lots of wildlife and nature to see on clearly marked paths. 
The birds of prey aviary is wonderful and the learning center not only presents educational information in a beautiful manner, but the AC was a nice break after the hike.  

If you make your way over in the mid afternoon you may be lucky enough to see the birds up close with the handlers. 

All the staff and volunteers are friendly and helpful.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Visited the preserve today based on reviews and was very pleased. The hikes are great with clearly marked paths and lots of wildlife to see. The birds of prey aviary is wonderful and the learning center is both educational and a nice break from the hike. If you visit in the mid afternoon, you may have the chance to see the birds up close with the handlers. The staff and volunteers are all friendly and helpful.

input: One of the few diners in North Wilmington, and the only one that probably isn't really bad. I've had totally ordinary diner fare here, and used to come by after swim meets. Nothing particularly good or bad about this place.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This is one of the few diners in North Wilmington, and it stands out as being decent among the options. The food here is typical diner fare, nothing extraordinary. I used to visit after swim meets, and overall, there's nothing remarkable or terrible about this place.

input: We loved the food, service and decor! The minute we walked in for a late lunch we were greeted with a huge smile and a warm welcome from the manager. Our server, Christina (i think that was her name) was delightful. The beer selection was great. We had the chicken rabe sandwhich and pepperoni pizza. The sandwhich was very good, on tasty foccacia bread. The pizza was superb!  We love the "well done" taste. We will definately be back. One problem we may have is our 7 year old is very picky and we didn't see a chidren's menu.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We thoroughly enjoyed the food, service, and decor at this restaurant. Upon our arrival for a late lunch, the manager greeted us with a friendly smile and warm welcome. Our server, Christina, was delightful. The beer selection was excellent. We ordered the chicken rabe sandwich and pepperoni pizza, both of which were delicious. The sandwich was particularly enjoyable, served on flavorful focaccia bread. The pizza exceeded our expectations with its perfectly cooked crust. The only minor issue we encountered was the absence of a children's menu, which may pose a challenge for our picky 7-year-old. Nonetheless, we will definitely return to this establishment.

input:
I regularly go to student salons for hair cuts and styling. 

I have long, fine, mostly straight Asian hair, and have had mixed results from the Aveda Institute -- to be expected considering I had a different stylist in every case.

Just know that if you haven't had a student stylist before, don't expect perfection. Do expect the cut to take an inordinately long time compared to a seasoned professional -- most of my cuts/styles have taken around 2 hours. The basic cut price includes massaging wash, cut, and blowdry style, plus the stylists do take the time to check in with their teachers and make sure the cut is going the way you want it to. Another plus: all of the stylists I've had at the Aveda Institute have been professional and committed to their service, which isn't always the case at other schools. And the prices are right.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I regularly visit student salons for hair cuts and styling. The Aveda Institute has given me mixed results due to different stylists each time. It is important to note that perfection should not be expected with student stylists. The cuts often take longer, around 2 hours, compared to experienced professionals. The basic cut price includes a wash, cut, and blowdry style, with the stylists ensuring the cut meets your expectations. Additionally, the stylists at the Aveda Institute are professional, committed, and offer affordable prices.

input:
Good food friendly folks
Don't come in full.
Quick and good portions
Get the tips seating outside
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great food, friendly staff, fast service, generous portions. Limited seating indoors, but outdoor seating available. Don't miss out!

input: Great food and friendly service. I will definitely be back. Menu variety is great.  I had the Monte Cristo crepes, absolutely amazing
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food and service were excellent. I will definitely return. The menu has a great variety. The Monte Cristo crepes were absolutely amazing.

input:
A nice alternative to Cafe du Monde, the beignets were as good if not better. But the real kicker was NO line! 

It was a calm little oasis on Bourbon St. Granted at 8:30 am the street is empty besides garbage men & street washers.

We were there early on a holiday, so we didn't get to experience any live music, sadly.

We did have a full breakfast as well, sharing a crawfish omelet & Cajun hashbrowns. Neither was anything to write home about, but really when your name has Beignet in it, does the other stuff really matter?
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: An excellent alternative to Cafe du Monde, this place served beignets that were just as good, if not better. The best part? There was no line! Located on Bourbon St., it provided a peaceful escape, especially in the morning when the street was quiet except for the garbage men and street washers. Unfortunately, since we visited on a holiday, there was no live music. Although the full breakfast we had, including a crawfish omelet and Cajun hashbrowns, was not outstanding, let's be honest – when a place has "Beignet" in its name, who cares about the other food?

input: Not the best prepared sushi inthe city by a longshot, but for quick (and I mean quick), cheap sushi with a long menu, Mixx is great.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Mixx offers a wide variety of affordable sushi options for those looking for a quick meal. While it may not be the city's best-prepared sushi, its extensive menu makes it a great choice for a speedy and budget-friendly dining experience.

input: Completely unprofessional and pathetic. I called last week to get price quotes on a battery and brakes. I spoke to someone very nice- he gave me two quotes, fairly low but close to other shops. I call today to schedule a time to come in and the prick who answers the phone, his name is either Mike or Nick (and quite frankly I don't care what he's called), tells me there is no battery even close to that price. He "blames" the quote on me, saying "I don't know how you came up with that price?" Then I told him I'd like to speak to someone else and he says "no, we won't do a battery for that price, so bye-bye" and he HUNG up the phone. NEVER NEVER call these people. I can go to Walmart before I deal with these assholes.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Extremely unprofessional experience. Last week, I called to inquire about pricing for a battery and brakes. The person I spoke to was friendly and provided me with two quotes that were reasonably low compared to other shops. However, when I called today to schedule an appointment, an unpleasant individual, possibly named Mike or Nick, answered the phone. He immediately dismissed the previously quoted battery price and put the blame on me, questioning how I arrived at that price. When I requested to speak with someone else, he rudely declined and abruptly ended the call. I strongly advise against contacting these individuals. I would rather go to Walmart than deal with such disrespectful behavior.

input:
I would NOT recommend this place to anyone. Their biggest mistake is not having a customer service department. They rely on their sales team to provide customer service meaning every time you call in to try and get something done, you get put into a voicemail because the sales guy is out selling - which should be their only job. This left me on numerous occassions incredibly frustrated that I could not get an answer. I even left the manager a voicemail (big surprise I couldn't get them to answer) and they never had the decency to call me back - Just made my sales person call me back.

I purchased my car last July and was promised numerous things would be done to the car before I purchased it. One of which being the tint on the rear window would be removed as the view out of the back was blurry. Somehow, that passed thru inspection and when I came to sign the papers, I noticed that it was still on the back windshield. I was told that they would have it removed by the time we were done the paperwork. Also, I was told that the price was going to be higher than the original agreement because the sales manager did the math wrong the previous day when we ran numbers. I told him that wasn't my fault and I would only pay the agreed upon amount and he spoke with the manager and got it sorted out. 

After sitting in the office for 2.5 hours, they finally told me that they were unable to even start taking off the tint and I would have to bring the car back. I dropped it off that Friday and let them keep it for the weekend. My sales guy called me on Saturday night to tell me that they never got to finish it and I would have to bring it back again and leave it. I live 45 minutes from the dealership so this isn't something I can easily do. I insisted on them giving me a loaner car for whatever day they would do this as I was sure this wouldn't be a one day process from my previous experience. 2.5 weeks later they were able to provide me with said car and I dropped off my vehicle. When I went to pick up my "finished car" there was still tint left on the bottom of the windshield. 

After all of that I knew I would never bring my car back for service there if that's the kind of service they provide. Now with all the rain we've been having, my trunk is leaking and when I called to check with the service department to see if it would be covered under warranty, I got the same run around with the service department who just said "I don't know" - OK well give me someone who will be able to tell me. Once they forwarded me to the correct person, I again got "I don't know". We need you to bring it in and look at it then submit to our warranty company to see if it gets accepted. No thanks after my previous experience of bringing my car in there to get "serviced". 

Invest in a customer service department to handle complaints in a professional and timely matter. This should not in any way be left upon the sales department to do. My sales guy did the best he could and I appreciated the help he gave me, but no one else would help me throughout the entire process. Not a good look on managements part.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
I do not recommend this place to anyone. Their biggest mistake is not having a customer service department. Whenever you call in for assistance, you get put into a voicemail because the sales team is busy selling. Even the manager never bothered to call me back, instead making my sales person do it. 

When I bought my car last July, I was promised that certain things, like removing the tint from the rear window, would be done before the purchase. However, the tint was still there when I signed the papers. They said it would be removed later, but it took multiple visits and weeks to finally complete the job. 

Furthermore, the sales manager initially miscalculated the price, but I stood my ground and only paid the agreed amount. 

The lack of customer service became even more apparent when my trunk started leaking. When I called the service department to see if it was covered by warranty, I received no helpful answers. They simply asked me to bring it in and submit a warranty claim. After my previous experience with their service, I declined their offer. 

This whole experience has made it clear that they need a dedicated customer service department to handle complaints and provide professional and prompt assistance. Relying on the sales team for everything is not effective. Although my sales person did his best, no one else was willing to assist me throughout this entire process. It reflects poorly on the management.

input: I love this restaurant. The owners are the nicest family. The food is delicious!!. My favorite is bacon pizza. I love that there is a play room for my kids to play while we wait for our food.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This restaurant is amazing! The owners are incredibly friendly and the food is absolutely delicious, especially their bacon pizza. What I appreciate the most is that there is a playroom for my kids to enjoy while we wait for our food.

input: Omg this is sooooo good, the fried rice is gorgeous,   Good price good food, one of the best Asian restaurant on the town.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The fried rice at this Asian restaurant is amazing and reasonably priced. It's definitely one of the best in town.

input:
Harry's blue bell is a nice spot. We stopped a few days ago for a quick dinner. It's tucked in the corner of a shopping center and it's very easy to miss. It was packed and seemed like the place to be for locals. The inside is nice but small, only a few tables in the entire place. The service was just okay. 

The beer selection is very good as are the prices on the beer. The food menu was a bit limited with you're basic bar food. The wife went with the bbq pulled pork and I went with the chicken and honey mustard wrap. The bbq pork was good, the bun was nicely toasted but the sauce was overly sweet for our liking. The wrap was fresh and good but nothing spectacular. The fries were hot and crispy. The kale slaw was fantastic but a very small portion.

Overall it was a decent meal. I wouldn't go out of my way to go back. If I were in the area I'd stop though. Solid 3 stars.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Harry's blue bell is a nice tucked-away spot in a shopping center that can easily be missed. It's a popular place for locals, always packed with a small but pleasant interior. The service was average. The beer selection is great with affordable prices. The food menu is limited to basic bar food. The bbq pulled pork was good, but the sauce was too sweet. The chicken and honey mustard wrap was fresh but unremarkable. The fries were hot and crispy. The kale slaw was fantastic but came in a small portion. Overall, it was a decent meal. Not worth going out of your way for, but worth stopping by if in the area. Solid 3 stars.

input: Just an update regarding the only complaint in my first review of Kajuns: the smoke. They've since installed a couple of smoke eaters that have made the air extremely breathable for people who, like me, have sensitivities to cigarette smoke. I previously would get headaches because of the smoke if I stayed at Kajuns too long, as I am wont to do, but now I can hardly notice that people are smoking while I'm sitting inside the bar! (When I leave, it's a different story as my clothes still smell like smoke, but that's a compromise I am willing to make.) Just goes to show you how dedicated the Kajuns staff is to improving the experiences of their customers. Thank you Kajuns!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The smoke issue in my previous review of Kajuns has been resolved with the installation of smoke eaters. These have significantly improved the air quality, making it much more comfortable for those who are sensitive to cigarette smoke. Previously, I would often get headaches from the smoke, but now I hardly notice people smoking inside the bar. However, my clothes still smell like smoke when I leave, but that is a compromise I am willing to make. This update demonstrates the dedication of Kajuns staff to enhancing customer experiences. Thank you, Kajuns!

input: My friends at work (connoisseurs of good food in the St. Louis area) introduced me to yet another very nice restaurant and that's Brio's!! I like everything about it - starting from the complimentary bread and chips to the bruschetta, pasta and salads !! Beautiful place.. The service adds to the charm !!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My friends at work recommended Brio's, a great restaurant in St. Louis known for its delicious food. From the complimentary bread and chips to the bruschetta, pasta, and salads, I enjoyed everything about it. The restaurant is beautiful, and the service adds to its charm.

input: One of the worst places in Tucson!  Cold food , rude service. They have the right idea but fail to deliver
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Terrible place in Tucson with cold food and rude service. They lack execution despite having good intentions.

input:
I am a huge fan of Gennaro's. It's got a thin crust, sweet and rich tomato sauce along w fresh mozzarella cheese. Also, the meatballs are excellent. Can't say enough about how much I love it here. Also, the decor is vintage and adorable. 

I have yet to be disappointed with Gennaro's
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I am a huge fan of Gennaro's because of its thin crust, sweet and rich tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella cheese, and excellent meatballs. The vintage and adorable decor only adds to the overall experience. I have never been disappointed with Gennaro's.

input:
Stopped in on a Monday around 7pm and the place was pretty full.  The bartender was friendly and attentive.  The bar seemed well stocked, not a drinker so take that as you will.  Now the food...THE FOOD was fantastic!  I ordered the Pear Gorgonzola Melt.  How they fit all that amazingness on one plate is impressive.  The clientele is all ages and backgrounds, which is great.

Nutshell:  Definitely check this place out for a good sandwich at a good price (~$10) and to catch up on the footy games.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Stopped in on a Monday around 7pm and the place was full. Friendly and attentive bartender. Well stocked bar. The food, specifically the Pear Gorgonzola Melt, was fantastic. Impressive portion size. Clientele includes people of all ages and backgrounds. Check this place out for a good sandwich at a good price (~$10) and to watch sports games.

input: Great atmosphere, service was very friendly and prices were very reasonable however I found the food a bit bland, not bad just bland. My husband and I were starving after a long drive to Philly and this filled the spot but it wasn't overly enjoyable and we most likely won't be back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The restaurant had a great atmosphere and the service was friendly. Prices were reasonable, but the food was bland. It filled our hunger after a long drive, but wasn't overly enjoyable. We probably won't return.

input: Great place for a drink, nice friendly staff.  Didn't eat there though and would be hesitant to as it doesn't look to be the cleanest place.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great place for a drink with friendly staff, but cleanliness could be a concern for dining.

input:
Freedom toast = check, freedom fries = check, awesome breakfast food = check.

The is a greek owned pancake house (hence the over doing it on naming the food) and is a great alternative to your larger chain pancake houses such as Robert Evans, IHopity hop, and Mr. Dennys. 

We eat here every new years day, typically around 2 pm when we drag ourselves out of a drunken slumber to brave the bitter cold. They never have a problem seating our group of about 12-15 and are pleasant and quick service. 

The energetic owner likes to roam around making sure everything is going well. In my opinion, the food is also better than the chains. The secret ingredient is love.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This Greek-owned pancake house is a fantastic alternative to larger chain options like Robert Evans, IHopity hop, and Mr. Dennys. They serve freedom toast and freedom fries, and their breakfast food is simply awesome. We always come here on New Year's Day around 2 pm after recovering from a night of drinking, and they always accommodate our group of around 12-15 people with pleasant and speedy service. The owner is energetic and personally ensures everything is going well. The food is delicious, possibly because it's made with a secret ingredient: love.

input:
After going there several times going to Fresh I am sad to report my last visit was not up to par.  I went with a group of people and the service / product was not how it used to be and the price was outrageous to say the least.  I entered and was not greet by the staff  and I do understand that the group I was meeting with was taking up most the inside of Fresh, but a little acknowledgement would have went a long way.  Also, I ordered the Vienna Latte with an extra shot.  It not only was one of the worst espresso based drinks I have ever had, but it was EXPENSIVE $7+ for a coffee?!?!  After realizing the price for the drink I was put off by ordering any products.

I really love Fresh and obviously from prior posts I do praise their products, but this time it was one of the worst experiences I have had.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My recent visit to Fresh was disappointing. The service and product quality have declined, and the prices were exorbitant. The staff did not acknowledge me when I entered, possibly due to a large group occupying most of the space. The Vienna Latte with an extra shot that I ordered was not only the worst espresso-based drink I've had, but it was also expensive at over $7. This experience has tarnished my previous positive views of Fresh.

input:
We have big group of 12 for the office outing lunch. I would said for the number of people we have, the service is not the best but good enough. Only one of our members get the food late. The close out may need to work on it. Tip was added since we have large group which may my bill easy. 

I have order the lamb kebab (Shish Kebab) plate. It come with two choices of side. I got the rice and the babaghanoush. The rice was well cook and nice aroma. The babaghanoush was well prepared and great with extra olive oil. The presentation of the dish is pleasant. However, the meat did not measured up. It was too dry and the marinated is not over the top. They need to improve on this area. 

I have been here several time. My previous experience is better. During the month of Ramadan, they serve the buffet that are plenty of choices and attractive. I would said try them during this time. The buffet of Ramadan usually start at 8:30. Go early because is a lot of customers.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
We had a group of 12 for our office outing lunch. Despite the large number, the service was satisfactory, although one person received their food late. The bill was made easier with the added tip for a large group. 

For my meal, I ordered the lamb kebab (Shish Kebab) plate, which came with two side choices. I chose rice and babaghanoush. The rice was well-cooked with a pleasant aroma, and the babaghanoush was well-prepared with extra olive oil. The presentation of the dish was pleasing. However, the meat was disappointingly dry and lacked sufficient marinade. This area needs improvement.

I have visited this restaurant multiple times before, and my previous experiences were better. During the month of Ramadan, they offer a buffet with a wide variety of choices that are appealing. I would recommend trying the restaurant during this time. The Ramadan buffet typically begins at 8:30, but it is advisable to arrive early due to high customer demand.

input:
This was a cool place to stop by and check out the birds on a Sunday morning.  

My daughter and I have stopped in here a couple of times so she can look at the birds.  Very friendly staff.

If you're a bird person this is the place to go.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This is a great place to visit on Sunday mornings to see and admire birds. My daughter and I have been here a few times and enjoyed looking at the birds. The staff is very friendly. If you're a bird enthusiast, this is a must-visit place.

input: So it's an old club and I think it still maybe a club at night but me and my family including our 5 year old went there for dinner! The food was good we received a sashimi plate and was very pleased with it. My some received a burger and fries which he ate and was happy with. But my biggest complaint is the SERVICE it was horrible. I had to get my own plates, sauce bowls and napkins, they bought out two glasses but didn't bring my son one. I had to request one for him, I don't know maybe they thought he was invisible. I had a groupon certificate so it was a good dinner I would come back if someone was treating.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: It's an old club, possibly still operating at night, but my family, including our 5-year-old, went there for dinner. The food - sashimi plate and burger with fries - was good. However, the service was terrible. We had to get our own plates, sauce bowls, and napkins, and they even forgot to bring a glass for my son until I requested one. Despite this, thanks to a groupon certificate, it was a decent dinner. I would consider returning if someone else was treating.

input:
This review is mainly chicken talk as Cuenelli's Peruvian Style Rotisserie Chicken brings to the table. Pollo a la brasa.... Rotisserie chicken.... Whatever you wanna call it.... I call it a technique done here with love and pride. Lets be clear, you will find no comparison coming from your grocer deli section or at the checkout isle.

Why do I think this chicken have some TLC put into it? On biting down of this chicken you can note seasoning flavors down to the bone. This is an inclination that prior to even getting into the rotisserie oven, these birds spend some time in some form of marinating process. Building flavor, the chicken also has a seasoning rub all over the skin.

Lets go to this rotisserie oven. Another unique element is this oven has a charcoal or grill like component. This gives the chicken a smoky element in the flavor build. As these birds turn in this oven, they keep moist from the natural drippings dropping from bird to bird as they rotate through this oven. In turn, this a reason why some people may note some pieces the skin end up dry and crispy and others get moist or soggy skin on their chicken In the end, you end up with this tender, smoky, well seasoned, fall off the bone goodness. Wait.... how can they add more flavor? Cuenelli's serves it with two dipping sauces, a chimichurri  which gives a herbaceous and slightly spicy flavor, and an aioli which has a garlicky - lemony element.

Round out this meal with some solid sides. Must haves for me would be the cilantro rice. Another herbaceous addition that works well with this meal. I got to use the word herbaceous a few times in this review, it has reflects such great imagery for food talk:) Must have beans with rice no? I pick the spicy pinto beans over the black beans at this establishment but lets be clear these beans are pretty spicy. I also love the maduros here. These sweet plantatains are cooked to perfection where the outsides has this caramelization from the natural sugar of the sweet plantain, leaving you with this toffee-like, stick to your tooth exterior and soft and sweet interior. 

Wash all down with Inca cola or a bottle of chicha limena.  Inca cola is almost like a cola champagne or a cream soda type of drink. Chicha Limena I say is Christmas in a bottle. This juice has a floral base blended with cinnamon and cloves.

Though Cuenelli's Peruvian Style Rotisserie Chicken have many other notable Latin dishes, the one thing that comes to mind to me is this chicken made with love. This chicken gives new meaning to all who thought they knew what rotisserie chicken is. I say, go to Cuenelli's and taste again for the very first time.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Cuenelli's Peruvian Style Rotisserie Chicken offers a unique and delicious dining experience. The chicken is marinated and seasoned, resulting in flavorful bites down to the bone. Cooked in a rotisserie oven with a charcoal or grill element, the chicken has a smoky taste and stays moist from the natural drippings. The meal is complemented by two tasty dipping sauces - chimichurri and aioli. The sides, including cilantro rice, spicy pinto beans, and sweet maduros, complete the meal perfectly. Wash it all down with Inca cola or chicha limena, a floral juice with cinnamon and cloves. Cuenelli's chicken is made with love and surpasses expectations of rotisserie chicken. Visit Cuenelli's to experience it for yourself.

input: fuck yes. meat, bourbon libations, and a salad (to round things out aka make myself feel better about ingesting the aforementioned two items.) i took myself on an early birthday date with myself and was not disappointed (neither in the food nor the company). i had a medium rare plain burger to see if it was worth all the fuss...no cheese, bacon, dressing, etc to disguise the quality of the meat. (of course, no bread either since i'm gluten free.) the burger was great - perfectly cooked and seasoned... though, i felt like a bit of a freak sitting at the bar eating my burger with a knife and a fork. i'd like to come back to try a fancypants burger since the extras look pretty tasty.  the salad was so-so; it was no frills with the perfect amount of dressing. the bartender-cum-waiter was super attentive but not cloyingly so. he made delicious sazeracs to accompany my repast.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Had an amazing early birthday date with myself – enjoyed meat, bourbon libations, and a salad to balance it all out. Tried a medium rare plain burger and it was worth the hype – perfectly cooked and seasoned. A bit of a spectacle eating it with a knife and fork, but still delicious. Looking forward to coming back for a more elaborate burger. The salad was alright, simple with just the right amount of dressing. The bartender/waiter was attentive and made delicious sazeracs to accompany my meal.

input: Came here on a Monday at lunch time. I sat at the bar and received fast service. Ordered their carne asada taco lunch special which were better than average. More than pleased with this place
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Arrived on a Monday for lunch, sat at the bar, and received fast service. Ordered the carne asada taco lunch special, which exceeded expectations. Highly satisfied with this place.

input:
I love these guys. Tony is one of big help. Had flat tire and he got it fixed less that what his estimation expectation. 

Thank you!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I really love these guys, especially Tony who was a big help. I had a flat tire and he fixed it for less than what he had initially estimated. Thank you!

input: My hairdresser was very thorough in getting details of what I wanted. Then she checked frequently during the haircut to make sure I liked it.  I did!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My meticulous hairdresser carefully discussed all the details of my desired style and consistently checked during the haircut to ensure my satisfaction, which I indeed was.

input: Sweet and sour chicken and chicken chow mein were both excellent. I like the chicken cuts in the chow mein. Have also tried the sushi a few times and enjoyed it. A little pricey, but at least it's great food.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Both sweet and sour chicken and chicken chow mein were excellent. Specifically, I enjoyed the chicken cuts in the chow mein. Additionally, I have tried their sushi multiple times and found it enjoyable. Although slightly pricey, the quality of the food makes up for it.

input: Here's an update for my further Comcast experience. Our bill was increased to 250.00 a month. We called and removed some luxery items which brought our bill to 225.00 a month. Called 4 time a to see how we could get our bill lowered, as we have been a loyal customer for 14 years. "Nothing we can do" was all I heard. We decided to no longer be raped by this company and set up service with Verizon. Called Comcast to cancel once we got hooked up with Verizon. All of a sudden, they can do better and reduce my bill to 140.00 a month....which I would have been extremely happy with. Unfortunately, it should have been offered the four previous times I called.  I have Verizon now and have been quite happy with the installation, customer service, and overall product.  I wish Comcast would go under because they don't care about quality customer service. They could offer me a years free of service, yet I wouldn't take it on principle. Screw you Comcast!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: After our Comcast bill was increased to $250 a month, we called to remove some luxury items and bring it down to $225. Despite being loyal customers for 14 years, multiple calls to lower our bill were unsuccessful. Frustrated, we decided to switch to Verizon. When we called Comcast to cancel and informed them of our new service, suddenly they were able to offer a reduced bill of $140 a month - an offer they should have made earlier. We are now happy with Verizon's installation, customer service, and overall product. We have no desire to continue with Comcast due to their disregard for quality customer service.

input:
This place is a little harder to find but worth the hunt. B's Diner is a little hole-in-the-wall joint populated by neat antiques, funny posters, and the warmth and personality of their staff. They do incredible work in the community and they are worth supporting.

If you are looking for an affordable meal or are looking to have a hearty bite at somewhere chill- this is your spot. It's got that great diner feel and the personality is all in the food.

I think part of the fun is the people-watching at this joint. Whyte ave bar staff the morning after, hipsters, musicians- never a dull moment.

I've heard the Elk sausage and perogie poutine is amazing, but I've yet to try it.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: B's Diner is a hidden gem worth discovering. This cozy hole-in-the-wall eatery is adorned with charming antiques and amusing posters, and exudes a welcoming atmosphere through its friendly staff. Not only does the diner provide incredible food, but they also actively contribute to the community, making supporting them even more rewarding. Whether you're seeking an affordable meal or a satisfying bite in a laid-back setting, B's Diner is the perfect spot. The diner's vibrant ambiance adds to the enjoyment of people-watching, from post-bar staff to hipsters and musicians. While I haven't personally tried it, the Elk sausage and perogie poutine comes highly recommended.

input:
I'm not sure what changed over the last year at this restaurant, but now it's just terrible food. Before, when I first started coming, it was decent: nothing fancy, but filling and palatable. Now, though, the food is disgusting. 90% of their buffet offerings are WAY too salty. The pulled turkey was tough, the fish tasted like licking a bottle of meat tenderizer, and the vegetables cooked to a putty-like state. The only thing vaguely edible was the corn pudding and mashed potatoes. The desserts are ok, almost store-bought quality. 

The service at least was good. Our waitress refilled our drinks promptly and removed plates often. The only good I saw all night.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Recently, there has been a noticeable decline in the quality of food at this restaurant. Previously, the food was decent and satisfactory, although not particularly fancy. However, now the food is simply terrible. A majority of the items on their buffet are excessively salty, and the pulled turkey is tough. The fish has an unpleasant taste, akin to licking a bottle of meat tenderizer, and the vegetables are overcooked and mushy. The only items that are somewhat edible are the corn pudding and mashed potatoes. The desserts are passable, comparable to store-bought quality. On a positive note, the service provided by the waitress was good, as she promptly refilled our drinks and regularly cleared our plates. That was the only positive aspect of the entire dining experience.

input:
Last time:  This is the second and last time my wife and I visit this place.  We were the ONLY table, yet it took the waitress at least 15 minutes to get our order.  From then our pizzas took about 45 minutes (they were both small).

While waiting for our pizza I had to move us to the bar are a.  I couldn't stand listening to one of the other waitresses bitching about the place non-stop while our waitress was sweeping.  Her bitching was amplified in that echo chamber.

And after all that waiting my pizza was barely warm.

This place has now earned a spot on my short list of PLACES TO AVOID.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My wife and I visited this place for the second and last time. Despite being the only table, it took the waitress at least 15 minutes to take our order. Our small pizzas then took about 45 minutes to arrive. During the wait, we had to move to the bar area due to another waitress constantly complaining about the place, which was amplified by the echo chamber effect. Furthermore, after all the waiting, my pizza was barely warm. This experience has firmly placed this restaurant on my list of places to avoid.

input:
The long and the short of it: A romantic little BYOB in Newtown Square that hits the mark in several areas. Big portions at decent prices. You won't leave hungry!

And now for a full review:

I have been to this Fellini's Cafe and the one in Bryn Mawr several times and each time I've visited there have been some memorable moments...and there have been speed bumps that keep this place from reaching its full potential.

On my latest visit this past Friday night, I made reservations for 730. My beautiful wife and I arrived right at 730. Although there were two vacant tables available, it took them at least 10 minutes or so to seat us. And when they did, they broke up a table for 6 instead of putting us at the 2 seater. Odd.

Being out and away from the kids for a few hours, we wanted at least a little bit of privacy, instead of sitting next to (pretty much connected to) a table of four. We asked the manager if we could be moved to the 2 seater...he said fine. Another 5-10 minutes (too long!) later a member of the wait staff came and, without any indication as to his intentions, whisked up our bottle of wine and silverware and ran off to the other table. Not a problem, but some eye contact and a simple 'follow me please' with even a hint of a smile would have been lovely. We shrugged and just rolled with it.

The interior is quaint, and the lighting is dim. It's a nice place for a romantic meal. But it is LOUD. So loud I would say this place is kid friendly despite being in such close quarters with your neighbors. Not sure if we'd ever try taking our four kids there (actually I'm certain we won't) but one or two can be done without much trouble.

Our waitress was extremely polite and offered the energy and enthusiasm that our other friend lacked.

For dinner, we ordered a caesar salad to share and for our main courses my wife opted for her usual tagliatelli with mushroom cream sauce and i had what i always have, the tortellini pasticiatti.

Complimentary with the meal were two pieces of bruschetta (very nice) and a small loaf of crusty Italian bread, which is served with butter packets (which perhaps only I find strange for an Italian restaurant?). 

Overall the food was delicious, except for a few somewhat minor hiccups: 

1. The caesar salad was served on a warm plate. The salad was excellent and would have been legendary had it been served on a chilled (or at least not warm!) plate.

2. I am pretty sure they used frozen peas in the tortellini dish, which is fine with me as long as you make sure the peas are thawed before you serve it! Only a few peas were not quite thawed, but it marred what was otherwise a perfectly crafted masterpiece of a dish.

When we paid, the manager allowed us to use an expired gift card. That was a very nice gesture and one that required no push from us to induce.

All in all, I'll keep visiting Fellini because it's relatively inexpensive and they do most everything well.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Fellini's Cafe in Newtown Square is a romantic BYOB with big portions at decent prices. Despite some speed bumps, it has the potential to be great. On a recent visit, we had to wait to be seated and were initially placed at the wrong table. The atmosphere is quaint but loud. Our waitress was polite and energetic. The food was delicious, except for a warm plate for the Caesar salad and possibly frozen peas in the tortellini dish. The manager kindly accepted an expired gift card. Overall, Fellini's is worth visiting for its affordability and overall good quality.

input:
Pretty bummed I didn't try out the Catbird Seat, because this place was totes underwhelming. When you enter, there is a large, awkward entrance and you have to go upstairs to be seated. It was probably only half full, but since it was strange weather, we decided to sit indoors. I'll just say again, walking up towards the hostess as she watches you approach just feels....weird. 

Our server was nice, and we joked with him about the silly flower in a very knock-over-able vase. We got two drinks--julep and one of their other ones with gin, both of which were utterly average to bad. 

The crowd was sort of stuffy. The bread was blah. The food was pretty forgettable. The tenderloin was good because it was a good cut of meat. The Amish chicken was pretty average, with a not so flavorful and slightly MSG-y twang jus. Their signature grits was underwhelming as well. 

All in all, stuffy and so overpriced. Bummed out!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I'm disappointed I didn't try the Catbird Seat because it was underwhelming. The entrance was large and awkward, requiring you to go upstairs to be seated. Despite being only half full, we chose to sit indoors because of the strange weather. Approaching the hostess felt strange. Our server was nice, but the drinks (julep and a gin-based one) were average to bad. The crowd was stuffy, the bread was unremarkable, and the food was forgettable. The tenderloin was good due to the quality of the meat, but the Amish chicken had a slightly MSG-y twang in its jus. Even their signature grits were underwhelming. Overall, it was stuffy and overpriced, leaving me bummed out.

input:
This review is LONG overdue!  I visited Stitch-It in June 2013

In brief: Stitch it did an EXCELLENT job on my dress and I was extremely pleased.  I needed it done in a rush and they were able to accommodate me.  Given the tight turnaround, and the work that needed to be done, I didn't mind paying a premium.  The service and results far exceeded my expectations.

Complete Experience: I was attending a convention in Nashville, TN and had ordered an evening gown online a week before (admitted procrastinator tendencies).  The gown was a navy blue Tadashi Shoji evening gown with sequins and an intricately designed lace and sheer layered bodice. The gown was a tad bit too long and there was a bulge in the back. The dress arrived a few days before I was scheduled to fly out to Nashville and I knew I wouldn't have time to get it tailored before leaving.  I found a few Nashville area tailor shops on Yelp, read the reviews and decided I might try Stitch-It.  I also saw a few cleaners that advertised they performed tailoring services, but they (quite frankly) didn't give me the warm and fuzzies.  

Stitch-It was about a 30 minute drive from the Gaylord Hotel where I was staying, so before taking a taxi that far, I decided to check with the hotel to see if they had an in-house tailor.  When I took the dress to the Gaylord tailor/seamstress (who was the nicest lady ever), she looked at the gown and said "I can hem the bottom....I'd have to do it by hand.  The top part though....I won't touch that with a 10ft. pole!"  I laughed, but appreciated her honesty in not being able to handle the work that I needed done.  

I contacted Stitch-It and sent pictures of the dress via text message to a nice young man who's name I can't remember (I think it was Cameron...I could be wrong).  They assured me that they should be able to accommodate me, so I hopped a cab and visited Stitch-It.  When I arrived I was greeted by courteous and professional staff.  I was shown to the dressing room and changed into my gown.  My personal tailor was Maggie O'Neill and she was AWESOME!  After the fitting and pinning, I left the gown and picked it up in two days.  It fit perfectly and was well worth the fee.  If I lived in Nashville, I would DEFINITELY use Stitch-It on a regular basis.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I visited Stitch-It in June 2013 when I needed a rush alteration on my dress. Despite the tight turnaround and the complex work needed, Stitch-It did an excellent job and the service and results exceeded my expectations. I had ordered an evening gown online for a convention in Nashville and found Stitch-It after being dissatisfied with other tailoring options. The Gaylord Hotel, where I was staying, didn't have an in-house tailor, so I visited Stitch-It, which was a 30-minute drive away. The tailor at the hotel was unable to handle the work needed on my gown, but Stitch-It assured me they could accommodate me. The staff at Stitch-It were professional and courteous, and my personal tailor, Maggie O'Neill, did an awesome job. The dress fit perfectly when I picked it up two days later, and I would definitely use Stitch-It regularly if I lived in Nashville.

input: This place is nothing short of astounding.  I went in for my first Brazilian and decided to get a blow-out as well.  These women are incredible in every way, from their work to their personalities. I've never felt more comfortable and relaxed under such intimidating circumstances (THANKS JENNE!).  Oh, and they're both comedians, so be ready to laugh the whole time you're here :)  Can not wait to go back!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is absolutely amazing! I came for my first Brazilian and also got a blow-out. The women here are incredible in every aspect - their work and their personalities. Thanks to Jenne, I felt so comfortable and relaxed even in intimidating circumstances. Plus, they're both hilarious comedians, so get ready to laugh throughout your visit. I can't wait to come back!

input: I will get straight to the point..... If you are ever anywhere near Camden NJ, In fact if you are anywhere in the State of NJ, get to Santana's for breakfast and pastries.   Their coffee puts Starbucks, DD, Micky D's and all the rest to shame!!   Their pastries are INCREDIBLE!!  You would have to fly to Boricua ( Puerto Rico) to even come close!!    My business is in neighboring Pennsauken, and we are there every morning!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: If you're ever near Camden, NJ or anywhere in the state, go to Santana's for breakfast and pastries. Their coffee is better than Starbucks, Dunkin' Donuts, and McDonald's. Their pastries are incredible, rivaling those in Puerto Rico. As someone with a business in Pennsauken, we go there every morning.

input: This place was so yummy and decently priced. I felt that the escargot would have been better as traditional escargot but the playing was nice. You can dine with the ghost (former owner of the mansion who killed himself on their 2nd floor) for an additional $50. The table is by itself in a cold dungeony room.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food was delicious and reasonably priced. The escargot could have been improved by being more traditional, but the presentation was satisfactory. For an extra $50, you have the unique opportunity to dine with the ghost of the former owner, who tragically took his own life on the second floor of the mansion. The table is located in a chilling dungeon-like room and offers a truly unique experience.

input:
One of the best burgers in Philly!

Low key joint with just a few tables and the kitchen in the dining room. But, don't let the modest face fool you, this place rocks!

Menu is creative and fully customizable. Burgers are cooked on a flattop, perfectly seared, juicy, slightly charred. Fries are hand cut, fried fresh, perfectly crispy and salty. What more could you ask for from a burger place? 

Pro tip - Download the SPOT app for a rewards program and some good coupons (aka free fries!).
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Philly's best burgers served at a low key joint with limited seating. Don't be fooled by its modest appearance, this place is amazing! The menu offers creative and fully customizable options. Burgers are perfectly seared, juicy, and slightly charred on a flattop. The hand-cut fries are fresh, crispy, and salty. For added perks, download the SPOT app for a rewards program and great coupons, including free fries!

input:
I really like these guys! I needed to get replacement keys made for my car since the existing ones were worn and not opening the doors consistently. I was referred by my mechanic, who said "go see these guys. They'll take good care of you". He was right!

My car has transponder keys that cost a mint if you get them from the dealership, or a lot less from eBay (always go eBay). While evaluating my key, they made a test copy before risking cutting on the blanks I brought them. I appreciated that caution. Even after cutting the keys, he checked that they both worked in all doors and the trunk before giving them to me. Very thorough job and great attitude. Highly recommended.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I highly recommend these guys for getting replacement keys made for my car. My mechanic referred me to them, saying they would take good care of me, and he was right. They were cautious by making a test copy before cutting the blanks I provided. After cutting the keys, they made sure they worked in all doors and the trunk. I appreciated their thoroughness and great attitude. Plus, they offer transponder keys at a much cheaper price than the dealership. Overall, highly recommended.

input:
This is the most beautiful salon I have ever seen. It very clean an organized with an amazing friendly staff. I was given a tour by the owner Doug he is one cool dude.

Doug has an extensive resume of accomplishments as a stylist, he teaches and trains all over the world and brings his expertise and share with his salon staff by holding a weekly training in his salon to ensure his staff is up to date with the latest technique and fashions. If I would trust anybody with my hair it would be here at this place.

I would recommend this place to anybody local or is from out of town.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This salon is the most beautiful and clean place I have ever seen. The staff is amazing and friendly, and the owner Doug is a cool dude. He has an impressive resume as a stylist, teaching and training worldwide. He holds weekly training sessions in the salon to keep his staff up-to-date with the latest techniques and fashions. I highly recommend this salon to both locals and visitors.

input:
So delicious! I am so happy Reno is getting more variety in it's restaurants. 
Bab Cafe has a great menu, service was quick even during the lunch rush. 
I had the Dak-Galbi Bibim-bab "teriyaki chicken." The meat was tasty, veggies were fresh, sauces were awesome. I also ordered a side of potstickers (because I can never resist potstickers) and they were so great. 
Only wish it were a little easier to get to, being downtown parking can be a challenge.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Bab Cafe in Reno offers delicious food with quick service even during the lunch rush. The Dak-Galbi Bibim-bab "teriyaki chicken" is flavorful and the fresh veggies and sauces are impressive. The side of potstickers is also great. However, the downtown location makes parking challenging.

input:
If you're looking for a great brunch place in New Orleans, definitely come here!

My boyfriend and I had brunch here on Sunday, and we loved it! We both started with the Brandy Milk Punch, which was divine.  If you are of age, order this drink!  It is an alcoholic milkshake, and I could literally go here just to drink that because it is so good.  

They bring out fresh bread and butter, and then my boyfriend and I ordered the trio of appetizers.  The trio is quite small, but it includes a duck springroll, fried chicken livers and a fried oyster.  The duck springroll came with a wonderful tangy sauce, which I greatly enjoyed.
