My boyfriend enjoyed the fried chicken livers and the fried oyster, but those are not two of my favorite things.

For my entree, I ordered the shrimp and grits.  Oh my goodness... so good! The shrimp are bacon-wrapped, and the grits are true Southern grits.  I will definitely order this dish again when I get the chance to return.  My boyfriend ordered the fish of the day, which was blackened Mahi Mahi, and he loved it.  

Definitely go to Mr. B's!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: If you're looking for a great brunch place in New Orleans, definitely come to Mr. B's. The Brandy Milk Punch is a must-try, an alcoholic milkshake that is divine. The trio of appetizers includes a duck springroll, fried chicken livers, and a fried oyster, served with fresh bread and butter. For entrees, the shrimp and grits are amazing with bacon-wrapped shrimp and true Southern grits. The fish of the day, blackened Mahi Mahi, is also highly recommended. Overall, Mr. B's is a fantastic choice for brunch in New Orleans.

input:
Came there again because of yelp reviews!
Just want to tell you the way the salon looks like already giving you feeling that they know what are they doing! Very clean, simple, professional. Two ladies met me at the front room, ask me about my preferences, tell me about the packages and prices they have - very understandable.  They put some information about me in the computer and i am all set for waxing!  They goes by appointments - always!!

The staff were friendly and explained their packages and prices. They took some information about me and I was ready for my waxing appointment. I also bought a treat for ingrown hair. Overall, I had a great experience and trust this salon. Today, I had a painless bikini wax and will come back for a full bikini wax. Thank you again, Despina.

input:
After trying twice unsuccessfully to get there early enough to get a meal within 20 minutes, I finally was able to break away from work and was 5th in line. I had heard of the "food truck nazi" and that it was the best in town and found Gus, the falafel nazi, as he called himself, lived up to his reputation and more. 
As my turn came up, I approached the cart tenuously, for I did not want to blow it by asking too many questions. He immediately recognized me as a new customer and told me all about the fresh ingredients he uses.
Chicken is cooked over coal and was tender on the inside and perfectly cooked on the outside. Falafel was delicious, as were the grapes and his homemade pasta that went along with it.
There was enough food for 2 people.
Well worth the wait!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Finally, after two unsuccessful attempts, I managed to break away from work and was fifth in line at the famous "food truck nazi," Gus the falafel nazi. As I cautiously approached the cart, I learned that Gus lived up to his reputation. He recognized me as a new customer and eagerly told me about his fresh ingredients. The chicken was tender and perfectly cooked, while the falafel, grapes, and homemade pasta were absolutely delicious. The portion was generous, enough to satisfy two people. It was definitely worth the wait!

input: SRS is truly an exceptional management company. They have been extremely accommodating with very specific requests that I have made. Recommend.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: SRS is an exceptional management company, highly accommodating and responsive to specific requests. Highly recommended.

input: Another five-star dining review!  Fresco serves-up wonderful fresh and tasty pizza.  We tried this store as a change in our usual fare when we visit Tucson during the gem shows.  For what you get, their prices are very reasonable.  My husband and I were new, and the friendly young man behind the counter told us about their pizza, how it is made from all fresh ingredients, etc.  The restaurant was very clean and inviting.  We ordered the meat-special pizza, which included chunks of chicken besides the usual sausage, pepperoni, ham and bacon.  The pizza was GREAT!  Crispy AND tender crust, plenty of toppings, and a "multiple-napkiner."  We also had a nice talk with the young owner, and you can tell his business is his passion and only wants to serve the best and highest quality food to his customers.  We will definitely return next year!  Do I recommend Fresco?...YOU BETCHA I DO!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Fresco is a five-star dining review for their delicious and fresh pizza. Their prices are reasonable and the restaurant is clean and inviting. The friendly staff explained their fresh ingredients and we tried the meat-special pizza which was fantastic. The young owner is passionate about serving high-quality food. We will surely return next year and highly recommend Fresco.

input:
We went to this restaurant after running in the Philadelphia marathon.  We had a large group (12) with us including kids (ages 10-14), parents and grandparents.   The place is very clean and looks fairly new or at least newly decorated.  The service was excellent and friendly.  The food was very good for the parents but everything was on the spicy side which was not so great for the kids and grandparents.  The lighting was very dim which was an issue for the grandparents reading the menu.  

The Veggie wings were great as were the cactus and sweet potato burritos.   The guacamole was very good although the spicy chips were a little too much.

They offer pitchers of margaritas which was great for our large group.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: After running in the Philadelphia marathon, our group of 12, including kids (ages 10-14), parents, and grandparents, went to a clean and recently decorated restaurant. The service was excellent and friendly. The food pleased the parents but was too spicy for the kids and grandparents. The dim lighting made it difficult for the grandparents to read the menu. We enjoyed the great veggie wings, cactus, and sweet potato burritos. The guacamole was very good, but the spicy chips were overwhelming. Thankfully, they offered pitchers of margaritas, which worked well for our large group.

input:
First of all, I think this might be my first Yelp review about "fast food." It's not a genre I ever eat unless I'm forced to on a road trip.  However, I am from Buffalo, NY, and am a chicken-finger connoisseur, so I decided to give this place a chance.  Additionally, it was on a road trip of sorts.  We had been at the beach all day and were halfway back home to central Tampa.

The service is amazing!  I have never seen fast-food workers who take so much pride in their jobs.  These people were drinking the Zaxby's cool-aid!  They seemed more like Disney employees than fast-food workers.  Both a female counter gal and a male (possible the manager/franchisee) went out of their way to make sure we liked everything.  

The food was a solid 4 stars, but my review overall is rounded up for the above mentioned points.  We had the chicken finger sandwiches on Texas toast.  While the chicken fingers themselves were super juicy and moist, the Texas toast was too greasy to eat them on.  I love sauce and enjoyed the variety.  We tried the Zax, hot honey mustard, insane hot and ranch.  What is missing from the sauce variety, for me, is a spicy bbq and blue cheese.  Serving ranch with hot sauce is an insult to the folks in Buffalo that created the cuisine.  Aside from the bread and sauce small issues, I really enjoyed our meal.  Additionally, it was so cheap!!  $12 and change for 2 meals with drinks.  

I am a fan!  This place doesn't quite hit all the marks of Buffalo-Inspired food, but it does a pretty good job of putting a southern twist on chicken fingers!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I rarely write Yelp reviews for fast food, but being a chicken-finger connoisseur from Buffalo, NY, I decided to give this place a try. We stopped here during a road trip after spending the day at the beach. The service was exceptional, with employees taking great pride in their work. The food, particularly the chicken fingers, was delicious, although the greasy Texas toast was a downside. The sauce variety was good, but lacked a spicy BBQ and blue cheese option. Despite these small issues, the meal was enjoyable and incredibly affordable. While it doesn't fully capture the Buffalo-inspired flavor, this place puts a nice southern twist on chicken fingers. Overall, I'm a fan.

input: I can't say enough great things about the baked goodies that come out of this kitchen.  I have YET to have anything that is 'subpar'.  Everything comes out with full flavor and with the right texture! Then the delicate and decorative detailing--just phenomenal.  You can tell that TIME and LOVE goes into each piece of goodness!!  I love all of the signature flavors.  I am a 'classic' cupcake person- and absolutely love her signature cream cheese frosting.  Talk about melt in your mouth! If you are looking for any sort of cake, cupcake, pie, cookie, or ALL THE ABOVE...do yourself a favor and treat yourself and loved ones to Sugar Coated! (no pun intended!) =)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I can't praise enough the exceptional quality of the baked goods from this kitchen. Every item is consistently delicious, bursting with flavor, and perfectly textured. The attention to detail in the delicate and decorative designs is absolutely phenomenal. It is evident that each creation is made with a combination of time and love. Among the remarkable assortment of flavors, I particularly adore the classic cupcakes with their heavenly signature cream cheese frosting. They simply melt in your mouth. If you crave cakes, cupcakes, pies, cookies, or any combination of these, I highly recommend treating yourself and your loved ones to the delectable treats from Sugar Coated. You won't be disappointed!

input:
It is unfortunate that with such a unique location and such a brand and product offering this specific store offers such lousy service. The wait is endless, no one is available to help and at Christmas time getting a gift wrap is act of God that requires endless wait. I bought gifts and knew that the wait for wrapping would be long SO I even left my items at the store to be gift wrapped at their leisure. They were not even moved from the counter where I bought them when I returned almost two hours later ready for pick up. This was a gift that needed to be given and The staff COMPLETELY "dropped the ball" on my time constraints! 

I love their stuff, but today was my last shopping experience at this location: couldn't get a gift wrapped after being assured that it could be done in a timely fashion???  I'll  cancel my card, do everything online and try not to go there if I can. It's really a shame!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite having a unique location and attractive brand with a variety of products, the specific store in question disappoints with its poor service. The wait times are excessively long and there is a lack of available assistance, especially during the busy Christmas season when obtaining gift wrapping becomes a frustrating ordeal. To accommodate the long wait, I even left my purchased items at the store for later gift wrapping, but upon returning after almost two hours, they had not been attended to at all. This impeded my ability to give the gift within my desired timeframe, and the staff completely failed to meet my time constraints. Despite my appreciation for their merchandise, this experience has compelled me to make this my last shopping trip to this location. I am now inclined to cancel my card, shift to online shopping, and avoid visiting the store whenever possible. It is truly disheartening.

input: They have a couple of really nice ladies, that go out of their way to help you. But there's one that will rip your head off if you're not careful. It won't take ya long to figure this out on your own though.  Jus' sayin'......
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: They have helpful ladies, but one can be extremely rude. You'll quickly realize it. Just a heads up.

input: Hendricks is a must try in St.Louis. The meats,sauces,and sides are better than most barbecue places.Onion rings are huge and the coleslaw is tasty and finely shredded. Service is good and very friendly. Takes awhile to get the meal,but it gives you time to check out the unique decor.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Hendricks in St. Louis offers a must-try BBQ experience with exceptional meats, sauces, and sides. Their onion rings are notably large and the coleslaw is delicious with finely shredded ingredients. The service is excellent, characterized by friendliness. While the meal may take some time to be served, it provides an opportunity to admire the unique decor.

input: Found there to be a good variety of food for a late night dinner with young kids. Wish we had one this good near us in upper PA. Person that rang us in was friendly and helpful. Two things  made our experience top notch. First was out waiter Eric, who was friendly, observant, went out of his way to get odd requests, and quick to getting back to us.  Eric is the type of waiter you would find a quality sit down restaurant.  The other were the 2 people at the grill house station. When I asked to have shrimp not basted due to a pepper allergy that offered to get different tings to remove them from the grill. I appreciated their thoughtfulness.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Found good variety of food for late night dinner with young kids. Person who rang us in was friendly and helpful. Excellent experience with waiter Eric, who was friendly, observant, accommodated odd requests, and quick to respond. The 2 people at the grill station were also thoughtful, offering alternative options to accommodate a pepper allergy.

input: i was looking forward to a new coffee spot, but this won't be it for me.  they dont have a menu first off, and im not a coffee connoisseur, so i was a little thrown off.  i kept it simple, asked for an iced tea, but they did give me hot tea w/a cup of ice.  v. artsy crowd here, great for people watching, but not for studying.  its a little loud, my headphones were not enough to block out the noise, so i was stuck listening to watever they chose, which wasn't my preference.  the servers were all really nice, and they kept cleaning the tables quite often.  all in all it wasnt a bad experience, but not one to keep me coming back either...
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was disappointed with this new coffee spot as it didn't meet my expectations. They didn't have a menu, which made it difficult for someone like me who isn't a coffee expert. I ordered an iced tea, but they served me hot tea with a cup of ice. The place attracts an artsy crowd, making it great for people-watching but not ideal for studying due to the loud noise. Despite this, the servers were friendly and the tables were regularly cleaned. Overall, it wasn't a terrible experience, but not enough to make me want to return.

input: lit!!!!! just wanna give a shoutout to my g, kyle. he was such a chill waiter and deserves a raise or somethin. he recommended me the honey hot sauce and it was some of the best hot sauce i had eaten in ages. kyle from milk and honey changed my life and i will forever owe him. also the biscuits brought me to heaven. i didn't even order one i just stole from my friends but they were just that. good. so yeah def come here and ask about kyle. tell him i miss him and that i hope we get reunited soon.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Shoutout to Kyle, the chill waiter at Milk and Honey! He deserves a raise for recommending the amazing honey hot sauce, which is the best I've had in ages. Kyle changed my life and I'll always be grateful. The biscuits were heavenly too, even though I stole them from my friends. So definitely come here and ask about Kyle, let him know I miss him and hope we reunite soon!

input:
Went here before a show we were seeing in the University City area.  It is just across the street from 30th Street Station, and just down the street from Drexel University.  We we able to get street parking about 2 blocks down the street, so that is always a plus.  

Service was sufficient for dinner.  We tried the mac and cheese appetizer that had just the right amount of breadcrumbs on it.  It was served hot, but with average taste.  We also tried the cheeseteak egg rolls - decent, but not a lot of meat in them.  Some of the bites I had of the egg roll were merely the fried dough without getting to any of the cheese and meat.   They were served with ketchup and a special mustard that had some horseradish in it for a bit of a kick!  I must say, it is a neat thing for a Philadelphia Pub to have on a menu.  

For our main entrees, we both had the chicken pot pie.  The vegetables were plentiful, and the chicken was all white meat, though there was not that much of it.  The crust was somewhat flaky, but there was a section of my pot pie crust that didn't seem like it was cooked all the way through.  

Dessert portion sizes were huge!  We had the bread pudding which was average in taste, and served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.  The brownie was served ala mode with vanilla ice cream as well.  The brownie was definitely dry and lacking in taste, though I consider myself to be a brownie snob, so maybe I'm being overly picky.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
We went to this restaurant before a show in the University City area, conveniently located across the street from 30th Street Station and down the street from Drexel University. We found street parking just 2 blocks away, which was a plus.

The service for dinner was sufficient. We tried the mac and cheese appetizer, which had a balanced amount of breadcrumbs but had an average taste. The cheesesteak egg rolls were decent but lacking in meat. Some bites were just fried dough without cheese or meat. They were served with ketchup and a unique mustard with horseradish for a kick, a fun addition for a Philadelphia Pub.

For our main course, we both had the chicken pot pie. It had plenty of vegetables and all white meat, though not much of it. The crust was somewhat flaky, but there was a section that seemed undercooked.

The dessert portions were large. The bread pudding had an average taste and came with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. The brownie, served a la mode with vanilla ice cream, was dry and lacked flavor. However, it's worth noting that I am selective when it comes to brownies.

input: Went for a bachelorette party on a Saturday night in April. Definitely try to arrive on the earlier side! We got there at 8 and there was no line (by the time we left at around 11 there was a line down the street). The cover band is awesome. There were at least 10 other bachelorette groups there and a few 50th birthday parties too. Their signature cocktails are great but overpriced in my opinion. I would go back though for another bachelorette party or birthday. Probably wouldn't try if it was any regular night out. Gets very crowded.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I went to a bachelorette party at a popular venue on a Saturday night in April. Arriving early is recommended as there was no line when we got there at 8, but it grew significantly by the time we left around 11. The cover band was fantastic and there were many other bachelorette groups and 50th birthday parties in attendance. The signature cocktails were good, but I found them to be expensive. I would consider returning for another bachelorette party or birthday celebration, but it might not be worth it for a regular night out due to the crowd.

input: Hands down best fall off the bone BBQ I've ever had.Excellent pulled pork everything had that great smoky flavor.Very creamy mac and cheese.Service was fast and friendly. Dessert was equally as good walnut brownie and ice cream delight.Such a great find.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The BBQ here is the best I've ever had, with fall off the bone tenderness. Their pulled pork and other dishes have a delicious smoky flavor. The mac and cheese is creamy and the service is fast and friendly. Don't miss out on the walnut brownie and ice cream for dessert. This place is a fantastic find.

input: It's a good thing I've had a few weeks to cool off from my experience at Copabanana before writing this review or it might not have been pretty. Anyhow, I came during university city restaurant week and will never return. We sat outside and there were kids playing football right near the tables and being loud. We moved to the other side of the restaurant (still outside) and the kids made there way over to us and continued playing. We couldnt get away. We went to a table inside. Food was terrible. Steak was fatty and overcooked and mashed potatoes werent fresh. The waitress was about the only thing good about this place. She agreed on the steak and took it back. Came back with chicken as I asked for and it was like biting into rubber bands. All in all it was a disaster and I'll never return. 1 star for the waitress.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: After a few weeks to cool off, I can confidently say that my experience at Copabanana during university city restaurant week was unpleasant. We sat outside where a group of loud kids playing football disrupted our meal. We attempted to move to a different outdoor area, but the kids followed us. Eventually, we sought refuge inside, but the food was disappointing. The steak was fatty and overcooked, and the mashed potatoes were not fresh. The only positive aspect was the attentive waitress, who acknowledged the steak issue and replaced it with chicken. Unfortunately, the chicken was tough and unpleasant to eat. Overall, it was a disastrous visit and I will not be returning, except for the commendable waitress who deserves 1 star.

input: Best shrimp and grits in NOLA! Delicious fresh juices too. This is my fiance's second time here in two years and he still thinks it's the best he's tried.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Best shrimp and grits in NOLA with delicious fresh juices. Even on his second visit in two years, my fiance still believes it's the best he has ever tried.

input: Finally! A good tapas place in Nashville. Friendly staff, nice open kitchen, delicious food. I can't wait to go back and try more.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Finally, a great tapas spot in Nashville! With a friendly staff, an open kitchen, and mouth-watering food, I can't wait to go back and sample more.

input: Super delish!! No frills! Just great sea food, sour dough bread was great! And I loved the 80s music playing!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Delicious seafood, fantastic sourdough bread, and awesome 80s music!

input: Dr. Curtis Dechant has an excellent chair-side manner, and he establishes a good rapport with his patients. The office is very comfortable, and the latest high-tech equipment makes eye appointments much easier to bear. I also appreciate their selection of eyeglass frames and the friendly staff.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Dr. Curtis Dechant has a great chair-side manner and establishes a strong rapport with patients. The office is comfortable and equipped with the latest high-tech equipment, ensuring a more pleasant eye appointment experience. Additionally, they offer a wide selection of eyeglass frames and boast a friendly staff.

input: Very cute place and good food. Pear cider beer was really good the service was really good and great ambiance and the price was very reasonable
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Cute place with good food, excellent pear cider beer, great service, and ambiance, all at a very reasonable price.

input:
I really enjoy this little restaurant full of goodness. Primarily a dessert place, Seasons also serves up some wonderful food dishes which are largely modernized updates on traditional classics. 

I always enjoy the shaved ice when I come here. The kind Seasons offers is a different type of dessert that I haven't seen anywhere else. The variety of boba tea that they have is also very 
good. Among my favorite shaved ice are the hula and the koko loco. If you want half and half flavors of shaved ice in your cup there is an additional $1.50 charge for a large size. There are pre-designed concoctions or you could create your own configurations of toppings and flavors. The pre designed concoctions are a better deal.

Seasons is situated on the end of a strip mall (across from a large shopping plaza with Regal Cinemas and Marshalls) with plenty of parking. The store itself is clean, bright, and modern and is kid-friendly as there are high hairs available for use. 

The service has always been friendly, fast, and efficient. Seasons employs an order at the counter, take number, and food is borough out to you when ready model. 

I can't comment on the food exactly but my boyfriend loves the quail and our friends enjoy the chicken wings which Boon touts as "the best food item" there. The quail is small and very flavorful and the wings are a good size and seasoned with five spice which was enjoyed by all. 

I look forward to many more visits with friends at this location. Check Seasons out and enjoy!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Seasons is a wonderful little restaurant that specializes in desserts but also offers delicious modernized versions of traditional food dishes. One of their standout desserts is the unique shaved ice, with flavors like hula and koko loco. They also have a great variety of boba tea. If you're looking for variety in your shaved ice, you can mix flavors for an extra $1.50, and the pre-designed options are a better deal. Located in a strip mall with ample parking and a clean, bright, and kid-friendly atmosphere, Seasons provides friendly and efficient service. While I haven't personally tried their food, my boyfriend loves the quail and our friends rave about the chicken wings seasoned with five spice. I can't wait to go back and enjoy more visits with friends. Definitely give Seasons a try!

input: Overpriced for what you get. I think this is a cute spot to meet up with a friend, but that's about it. I prefer my own homemade coffee to be honest. Adorable concept, just could use some improvement to products offered and prices.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite being a cute spot to meet up with a friend, the products offered and prices at this place are overpriced for what you actually get. Personally, I prefer my own homemade coffee. While the concept is adorable, there is room for improvement in terms of both the products offered and their prices.

input: This place was absolutely awesome. 75 cent oysters. After 2 dozen I moved to the excellent cheesy grits. Great place to eat. Even better during happy hour.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is amazing with its 75 cent oysters and delicious cheesy grits. It's a great spot for dining, especially during happy hour.

input: Love it!! I go to this place whenever I am in town and have NEVER been disappointed. The food is organic, fresh and delicious. I love that they buy from local farmers and fishermen. They also grow a lot of their own veggies! You can't get much fresher than that. There's lots of variety so I haven't even come close to trying everything. My favorite breakfast item is Carly's breakfast. Avocado on sourdough toast with a fried egg and sweet potatoes. Sooo good! Highly recommend this place!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Highly recommend this place! The food is organic, fresh, and delicious. They buy from local farmers and fishermen, and even grow their own veggies. There's plenty of variety, and my favorite breakfast item is Carly's breakfast - avocado on sourdough toast with a fried egg and sweet potatoes. Love it!

input: The burgers were very good very flavorful. I had the El Mariachi. As with what other reviewers have said the portion is not big. But I believe it makes up in flavor. I also have salted caramel ice cream it was very good homemade style. I do recommend the rooster sauce.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The burgers at the restaurant were incredibly delicious and full of flavor, especially the El Mariachi. Although the portion size is not huge as some reviewers mentioned, the taste compensates for it. Additionally, I had their homemade-style salted caramel ice cream, which was also delightful. I highly suggest trying their rooster sauce.

input: Just had a late dinner there on a Sunday night and was really surprised at how good the sushi was and how low my ticket was. I had a plate full of sushi and it cost me $13.00. The staff seems to be having a good time too. Very friendly place. I really enjoyed it and will be back soon!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the sushi and the affordable price at the restaurant I visited for a late dinner on a Sunday night. Despite ordering a plate full of sushi, my bill only came out to $13.00. The staff was friendly and appeared to be enjoying themselves. Overall, I had a great experience and will definitely be returning in the near future.

input:
I had to write an order after coming here a couple of times because this place is just terrible. I tried their hoagies and they are so greasy i got nauseous after eating them... Then yesterday i accidently ordered from here instead of angelinos and i got the buffalo chicken sandwhich and it was just covered in blu cheese and greasy sauce it was so Disgusting.  All their food is terribly greasy and over seasoned its too much.. Back off on it a little and use freasher ingredients it will be much better!

Ill also add that their desserts suck, taste bland and a waste of money. Their sodas are usually expired and flat. I hate everything about this place!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is terrible. The hoagies are greasy and made me feel nauseous. The buffalo chicken sandwich was covered in blue cheese and greasy sauce, making it disgusting. All their food is greasy and over seasoned. They need to use fresher ingredients and reduce the seasoning. The desserts are bland and not worth the money. The sodas are usually expired and flat. Overall, I hate everything about this place.

input: Paid for non-smoking room but there was a smell and ashtrays in the room. Since all we were doing was sleeping there we didn't say anything. Shower was crazy slow to drain. input: Maybe caught the staff on a bad day, but the people in the pharmacy were not friendly. Was told my prescription be ready in 15, when i showed up 20 minutes later they said it would be ready in a half hour. If your in a hurry dont bother filling up your prescription here. Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The pharmacy staff I encountered did not seem friendly, perhaps because they were having a bad day. They initially told me my prescription would be ready in 15 minutes, but when I arrived 20 minutes later, they said it would take an additional half hour. If you're in a hurry, it's best to avoid filling your prescription here. You might as well go to the Walmart pharmacy next door.

input:
I loves me some seitan, and that's why I keep going to El Camino. The seitan wings & seitan nachos are so good! Unfortunately, the service is not. It can be extremely slow. On one occasion it took them so long to get my seitan nachos out to me that they had to give them to me on the house. All of my friends were done eating and ready to leave and I was JUST getting my food! 

As for the rest of the food at El Camino, the only other thing I've tried would be the fried pickles. I have to say, I was not impressed. I love both pickles and fried things but these were not good. The coating was too grainy and I just didn't like the taste. 

The seitan is so good that it keeps me coming back. And the margaritas are pretty good too.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love the seitan at El Camino and keep going back for their delicious seitan wings and nachos. However, the service can be extremely slow. Once, they took so long to bring out my seitan nachos that they had to give them to me for free. Sadly, the fried pickles were a disappointment. The coating was too grainy and the taste wasn't enjoyable. Despite these shortcomings, the amazing seitan and decent margaritas keep me coming back.

input: Excellent place to get a tattoo. I have had two done at B13 and am really pleased with both. One was with a group of people and the owner was able to fit all 4 of us in with a great sketch on really short notice. If you aren't sure who to go to, I've seen especially awesome work by Amanda, though everyone is great I'm sure.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: B13 is an excellent place to get a tattoo. I have had two tattoos done there and am extremely satisfied with both. On one occasion, the owner was able to accommodate a group of four of us at very short notice and provided us with a fantastic sketch. If you're unsure about who to choose, I've personally witnessed Amanda do some particularly amazing work, although everyone there is talented.

input:
We went on a Friday night and the place was full, but even so there was only a 20 minute wait. 
The service was ... Hit and miss. I don't want to rip on our server too much because our server was obviously trying but just not hitting the mark. The food was Ok, but I don't believe I'll be back. It just wasn't great.

input:
I would recommend Twisted Twig to everyone - excellent service, very friendly, and create amazing arrangements!

You will not regret working with Jen! I reached out to a few different florist 2 weeks before my wedding. I was frantic my wedding was only 2 weeks away and didn't have a florist, even though it was a small wedding. I got a hold of Jen, who I might say was very responsive.

I got on the phone with Jen and she was so nice and very genuine. We spoke about what I was looking for and I texted her some pictures of inspiration and my dress. She asked me if there were certain flowers I was looking for and my budget. I didn't have any flowers in mind, as long as the colors are what I wanted and told her my budget. She sent me a quote, staying within my budget, noting the flowers she would use for the bouquet, boutonniere, and floral arrangements for the arch I had. It was nice that Jen works with you to stay in your budget yet still get what you want.

On the wedding day, Jen arrived at my hotel door right on time with my beautiful bouquet. The floral arrangements at the site was gorgeous also. Jen really hit the mark on what I wanted for my wedding. She also was very sweet and added some roses on the chairs by the aisle to my surprise, which was not on the quote. That was very special because it pulled the whole ceremony look together and I felt Jen really wanted everything to look perfect for me.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I highly recommend Twisted Twig for their excellent service, friendly staff, and amazing arrangements. Working with Jen was a great experience. Despite reaching out only two weeks before my wedding, she was very responsive and accommodating. Jen took the time to understand my vision and budget, and provided a quote that stayed within my budget while still incorporating the flowers I wanted for my bouquet, boutonniere, and floral arrangements. On the wedding day, Jen arrived on time with a beautiful bouquet and the floral arrangements at the site were stunning. She even added some additional roses on the chairs by the aisle, which was a pleasant surprise and pulled the whole ceremony look together. Jen's attention to detail and desire for perfection made my wedding day extra special.

input: I deducted one star because the service was not great. Our waiter wasn't friendly at all. The first question was "soup or salad ". I wanted to order appetizer and lunch special, but he assumed we were having lunch. Seaweed salad was really good. Shiomay was small but good. The sashimi was fresh. Banzai roll was great and unique. Raw salmon and white fish with avocado and fish egg wrapped in cucumber with some sweet sauce. Perfect for those who is looking for no-rice roll. Salad dressing was more like carrot purée.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I deducted one star due to poor service. The waiter was unfriendly and assumed we were ordering lunch when we wanted an appetizer and lunch special. However, the food was excellent. The seaweed salad was delicious, the shiomay was small but tasty, and the sashimi was fresh. The banzai roll was unique and great, consisting of raw salmon and white fish with avocado and fish eggs wrapped in cucumber with a sweet sauce. Additionally, the salad dressing resembled more of a carrot puree. Overall, the experience was mixed due to the lackluster service but enjoyable food.

input: I honestly didn't know this place existed until my friend suggested it for brunch over the weekend. I can't believe I live four blocks away and haven't been here before! I ordered the honeybee crepe and an almond croissant. I'm one to typically bring leftovers home but the food was so delicious there was nothing left to take much to the surprise of my friends. There is a small seating area downstairs and some window seating on the first floor. I'd recommend getting there on the earlier side if you're with a group and want to sit. I'd also recommend this for smaller groups. Will definitely be going back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I discovered this place thanks to a friend's brunch suggestion. Despite living just four blocks away, I had no idea it existed. I tried the honeybee crepe and almond croissant, both of which were incredibly delicious. Surprisingly, I didn't have any leftovers to bring home. The seating options include a small downstairs area and window seating on the first floor. Arriving early is advisable for groups looking for seats. I would suggest this place for smaller groups and definitely plan on returning.

input: This is the best location EVER. The donuts are made to order I believe after 5pm. They are always super hot you can barely eat them . Even the next day they are delicious.

input: This place is super cute! I love how sustainable they are. Definitely recommend. The people are awesome and pretty! Not to mention the food and coffee are extraordinary!

input: I loved this place.  Walking by, I almost didn't go in, because Im a vegetarian and it looked like there was only meat on the menu. I'm glad that I looked closer. They have an excellent veggie burger, a terrific selection of local microbrews and they even make their own ice cream. I would definitely go back here again the next time I visit St. Louis.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite initial hesitation due to the meat-centric menu, I was pleasantly surprised by this place. Their veggie burger is excellent and they offer a wide variety of local microbrews. Additionally, they have their own delicious homemade ice cream. I would definitely revisit when I'm in St. Louis again.

input:
After a long hiatus from reviewing I have awaken from my 6 mouth yelp hibernation and my tummies a grumbles with an insatiable hunger for the cacophonous symphony of flavor that is Indian food. Like an all too familiar pattern, I go back to Mohammad Butt, my main man for marsala.
But whats this? 
There are whispers that he no longer cooks for "Best Taste of Asia," that he is gone, never to return; some sort of falling out.

No.
No, it can't be! 
I need to score - one .. final .. hit..

Life ceases to have meaning, existential murmurings dog the mind. Who am I?
Why am I here?
What is Cheeze Wiz?
Its done, over, a round falls into the chamber and just as I prepare to end it all and pull the trigger- steps in ZAIKA.

Zaika - meaning the art of taste -  stays to to its name. This is a place where the Paneer (cheese) is made fresh in house, resulting in a cheese that's silky in texture. Especially when in contrast to the prepackaged rubbery bone-white LEGO blocks most small Indo-Pak places purchase from Indian Grocers in attempts to reduce prep-times. While at Zaika such shortcuts are not taken,  the Chef takes the extra steps needed to ensure a dish comes together as a whole. For example, the Chicken Makhani uses Smokey Tandoori Chicken, which I have never seen done before but it certainly aids the chicken to cut though the rich buttery tomato sauce and elevates the dish as a whole. Even entrées like Dall Fray or  Palak Paneer  have so much flavor that they will leave you not missing animal protein in the least should you choose to go the vegetarian route. 

Zaika 's appetizers, like the Veggie Samosa and Aloo Tikki, (spiced potato patties) are generally large, peppery and well spiced - the latter of which remind me of something my own mother would make. Though I must warn others to avoid the items that occasionally pop-up as specials like the potato stuffed chili peppers, unless they have a iron stomach or are a gluten for punishment. These peppers are spicy, not deveined or even seeded. Further, I find the fish pakora to be far too fishy.
 
I've become rather taken by Zaikia. Even the simply things such as the naan are good there. Just right in elasticity, the bread does not have too much give and yet isn't too soft. It's nothing elaborate, just properly risen with a light texture and  no egg or yeast flavor. The only complaint being that it lacked that signature faint sweetness naan has. But hey, I use it mostly for mopping up the other good stuff on the plate anyway and the sweetness gets lost in the mix, so I don't mind at all.

The menu has nearly 120 different items, all numbered to order by, making take-out phone orders convenient and should eliminate any fears anyone should have of a language barrier problem. Furthermore, it has short descriptions of each dish - something all ethnic places like this should have.
Though some items like Lassie (a frothy yogurt drink) do not appear on the menu, that too is offered - both a salty and sweet mango verities. 
The head chef speaks English quite well and should be easy to deal with should you want to inquire more or want to setup large orders.

I have already noticed parties negotiating catering for Ramadan as I anxiously awaited my own order.

The bottom line here is this, Mohammad Butt has expanded on the menu he once created for "Best taste of Asia," and taken an all HALAL meat approach. 

Only good things can come of this, only good things.

P.S.
ZAIKA is right behind Nifty Fifties on Grant Ave., so you are all set for dessert should you want a milkshake. 
However, I would suggest getting the Ras Malai if available. These riccotta cheese dumplings flouting in soaked in sweetened, thickened milk are delicately flavored with cardamom, a very some amount of rose water and then garnished with pistachios. They are ungodly good.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: After a long hiatus, I have returned to reviewing Indian food. My go-to chef, Mohammad Butt, is no longer cooking at "Best Taste of Asia." In my search for a replacement, I stumbled upon Zaika, a place that lives up to its name, meaning "the art of taste." The fresh-made paneer (cheese) is silky, unlike the rubbery prepackaged ones other places use. The Chef at Zaika goes the extra mile to ensure each dish comes together perfectly. Even vegetarian options like Dall Fray and Palak Paneer are flavorful enough to satisfy. The appetizers, such as Veggie Samosa and Aloo Tikki, are large and well-spiced. However, I advise against trying the occasional special items like potato stuffed chili peppers and fish pakora. The naan bread at Zaika is simple and perfectly elastic. The menu has a wide variety of dishes, each numbered for easy ordering. The head chef speaks English well and is helpful with inquiries and large orders. Zaika is now serving all halal meat. For dessert, Nifty Fifties on Grant Ave is nearby, but I recommend trying the Ras Malai at Zaika. These ricotta cheese dumplings soaked in sweetened milk are delicately flavored and garnished with pistachios. Overall, Zaika is a great find.

input: Busy place, but we were offered extra- special coffee while we waited. No sooner than it was ready, so was our table. The server was welcoming and offered suggestions for us after we made her aware of some dietary restrictions. My daughter and I shared a salad, entree, and Special grits. Every bite was delicious, beautifully presented, and reasonably priced as downtown prices go. We like this restaurant a lot.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite being a busy place, we were offered extra-special coffee while we waited. Our table was ready as soon as the coffee was. The server was welcoming and accommodating of our dietary restrictions, offering us suggestions. My daughter and I shared a salad, entree, and Special grits, all of which were delicious, beautifully presented, and reasonably priced considering downtown prices. We really enjoy this restaurant.

input: I love this place. Super friendly staff. Great with kids. And the food is amazing. Especially the hash browns. You can also get tomatoes and grits on the side. Yum! And on top of it all it's not hard on the wallet.

I encountered at least 6 dogs off leash and away from their owners. Please follow the rules, or they might make it a no dog spot!

input:
Like many other reviewers I passed by this place a number of times before looking it up on Yelp and realizing that I really did need to give it a shot...
Wow... I was not disappointed!
We started out with the crab cake appetizer- it was very well portioned (2 large crab cakes) and the sauce with it had an interesting hint of dill (just lovely and refreshing and a little different).
We were feeling like comfort food and had the chicken tenders-  The portions were very generous and the food was just solid.  Not fussy or stuffy or trying hard... just good, wholesome and good to eat.
The service was fine- however there is only one waitress for the tables and the bar, so i can imagine that if it is full that would cause some delays.  Overall it was just a lovely meal and the prices were unbelievably reasonable (most places have crabcakes 1/2 that size for twice that price)...
The ambiance is nice, nothing crazy but it is just a very nice option with reasonable prices and lovely food!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I found this place on Yelp after passing by it several times. I decided to give it a try and I was not disappointed. We ordered the crab cake appetizer which was well portioned with a refreshing hint of dill in the sauce. We also had the chicken tenders for comfort food, and the portions were generous and satisfying. The service was good, although with only one waitress it may cause delays when the place is full. The prices were surprisingly reasonable compared to other places. The ambiance is pleasant, making it a nice option for a good meal at a reasonable price.

input: Always excellent service and amazing food. The staff is is always friendly and there are many promotions that always keep us coming back. The quality of the fish is amazing and the perfect portion size of the rolls allows you to try many different kinds. Out favorite sushi in town!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Excellent service, amazing food, friendly staff, frequent promotions, high-quality fish, perfect portion sizes, best sushi in town.

input:
My boyfriend and I both decided to try Jesse's for the first time after we'd both grown up in the Brandon area and neither of us had ever been, and really hadn't heard much about the restaurant. 

We dined on a Saturday night and even though the parking lot and restaurant was packed, we were sat right away at a 2-top next to a window facing SR-60. 

Our server, Nikki, greeted us in a reasonable amount of time. We ordered our beverages and she brought them shortly after that. Something I did not like was there was not a drink menu on the table, but Nikki was able to tell us what beers were on draft and non-alcoholic drinks. She took our appetizer and entree order all at once. 

We ordered crab stuffed mushrooms and a French onion soup to share. These items came out together. The crab stuffed mushroom was basically a giant thing of crab stuffing on a TINY mushroom, which was almost laughable, but had a good flavor nonetheless. The French onion soup had a great flavor and wasn't scalding hot, which was super nice to eat right away. 

After our appetizer came out and we finished it, our Caesar salads came out as well as a loaf of bread and some butter. This was also really great pacing of our meal! Nikki never let empty plates sit on our table, was very attentive, and always made sure we had drinks in front of us. The Caesar salads were good. I gave the bread two chances... once dipped in the French onion soup and once just with butter on it... the bread could have definitely been better - it just didn't have a good flavor to it. 

I ordered the 6 oz filet and he ordered the 16 oz Delmonico - both cooked medium rare. The steaks are served with sautéed mushrooms, your choice of side, and a salad or soup of the day, which isn't mentioned anywhere on the menu. I got broccoli as my side and my boyfriend got a sweet potato with all the fixings. I saw three tables sat after us receive their entrees before us - I don't know if it was a kitchen issue or something else, but we were sat at least five minutes before each of those tables - I tried to make sense of the delay, but it honestly wasn't a big deal to me. Our steaks came out on hot metal plates that were inserted into a cooler outer shell. My filet was nice and thick and cooked perfectly and the broccoli was steamed very tenderly, but there were not enough sautéed mushrooms on the plate, in my opinion. If I had known it would have been like five mushrooms with the steak, I totally would have gotten them as a side. My boyfriend's steak was cooked perfectly as well, but being on the hot metal dish led the steak to cook more at the table, which he wasn't particularly pleased with. He enjoyed his sweet potato with butter, but it didn't come out with cinnamon on it like he requested. 

Anyway, I am sure we will return! Our server, Nikki, was fabulous. She was extremely attentive, had a great attitude, and was knowledgeable!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My boyfriend and I tried Jesse's for the first time. The restaurant was busy but we were seated quickly. We had a good server named Nikki who took our drink order and told us the available options. We ordered crab stuffed mushrooms and French onion soup as appetizers. They came out together and tasted good. Our Caesar salads and bread were served after the appetizers and were also enjoyable. I ordered a 6 oz filet and my boyfriend had a 16 oz Delmonico, both cooked medium rare. The steaks came with sautéed mushrooms and sides. The food took a bit longer to come out than other tables, but it didn't bother us. The steaks were cooked perfectly and my side of broccoli was tender. However, there weren't enough sautéed mushrooms on the plate. My boyfriend's steak continued to cook on the hot metal plate, which he didn't like. He enjoyed his sweet potato, though it didn't have the requested cinnamon. Overall, we had a great experience thanks to our server Nikki, who was attentive and knowledgeable. We would definitely return.

input: Friendly staff, good selection, fair prices.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Friendly staff, good selection, fair prices.

input:
This was my very 1st time in New Orleans. It's been an amazing experience and so far, every single place I've eaten at has been AMAZING. So... I took a chance with The Praline Connection and walked in. Why? The ambiance and the restaurant, overall, looked nice. 
However... I would NEVER return to this place again, nor would I Ever RECOMMEND it to Anyone. 

APPETIZERS:
I ordered the BBQ Oysters and..wow.. fucking wow...1st of all the oysters not in their shells. Instead they placed in a soup cup filled with  "BBQ sauce" that tasted like cheap Ketchup and Chef Boyarde! Disgusting! The oysters themselves were gooey.

The garlic bread was God awful! It tasted like stale frozen garlic bread. To make matters worse, when I received these appetizers, they were cold.. It tasted and looked like they had been microwaved and left out.  

I also ordered the Chicken wings. They were under cooked, cold and the sauce was nasty.  

The other members of our party ordered entrees. They all said, "This Sucks!"

PROS: The service was great. The servers were all very polite and attentive. 
Restaurant was clean, nice tables, nice ambiance.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My first time in New Orleans has been amazing, with every place I've eaten at being fantastic. However, my experience at The Praline Connection was disappointing. The BBQ oysters were served in a soup cup with a BBQ sauce that tasted like cheap ketchup, and the oysters themselves were gooey. The garlic bread tasted stale and frozen, and the appetizers were cold and seemed microwaved. The chicken wings were undercooked and the sauce was unpleasant. The other members of our party also disliked their entrees. On the positive side, the service was great and the restaurant had a clean and pleasant ambiance. Overall, I would not recommend this place.

input: This is the McDonalds closest to my home, but I will forever drive any distance to find another bc it's a terrible restaurant. Even though it's not politically correct to say "I love McDonalds", every now and again and during lent we go to McDonalds and this one is really bad. Bad food, always cold or wrong items.  Bad service, and no offense to anyone but I cannot even communicate with most employees bc they don't speak any ENGLISH!!  I do not know much Spanish either but when I'm trying to spend my money in Fishers Indiana at a business I at least expect to be able to communicate in some way!  Their service is the slowest from any McDonalds in this area!  My advice: pass on this location unless you have allot of time and can speak Spanish !!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This McDonald's location near my home is terrible and I will go any distance to avoid it. The food is bad, often cold or incorrect. The service is slow and the employees mostly don't speak English, making it difficult to communicate. I recommend passing on this location unless you have a lot of time and can speak Spanish.

input: Very good breakfast. Within walking distance of our hotel. Had the crepes with fruit. Would get again for sure. Not sure about the tea. Had a hint of fennel seed to it.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great breakfast within walking distance of our hotel. The crepes with fruit were delicious and definitely worth getting again. However, uncertain about the tea as it had a hint of fennel seed.

input:
Holy Mole!
That was good. 

Enjoyed a wonderful evening here as part of a Yelp Elite event. Got to sample a wide variety of their food, and each dish was better than the next. The cocktail -- created special for the event, I think -- was fantastic (and I'm not usually a cocktail kind of guy...). The manager and staff are as attentive, knowledgeable, and friendly as could be. 

Basically, I consider the whole event an enticing appetizer for a much-anticipated main course: coming back for a full meal!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Had a great time at a Yelp Elite event at Holy Mole! Sampled a wide variety of delicious food, with each dish surpassing the next. The specially crafted cocktail was fantastic, despite not usually being a cocktail person. The attentive and friendly staff made the evening even more enjoyable. Overall, it was a great appetizer for a future visit to have a full meal. Can't wait to go back!

input:
Ick.  That sums up my experience at Dinardo's in one "word."  Dinardo's gave me that "Ick" vibe the minute I set my foot in the door. THough we were greeted by a very friendly hostess, the place looked like a run down diner on the interior--and it wasn't very clean or charming.  This would have been fine because a lot of times the "run down" places have the best "authentic food," but this was not the case at Dinardo's.  At Dinardo's you do not get what you pay for as the prices are rather high and the food quality is rather low.    Our server hated his life and made snarky, mean comments throughout our time there which, though entertaining, was kind of unwelcome and unpleasant.  My friend had the mussels which were puny and in an unimpressive sauce--unimpressive being the general adjective I would use to describe any given dish my party ordered.  I had a soup which was extremely salty and bland beyond that and the broiled flounder and "seafood imperial" dishes were OK at best. 

I'd say if you're looking for good seafood you'd be better off at any BYOB; little fish, audrey claire, ANYWHERE but Dinardo's.  I don't understand how this place is still in business, to be honest.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My experience at Dinardo's can be summed up with one word: "Ick." The interior looked like a run-down diner and wasn't clean or charming. Despite a friendly hostess, the food quality did not match the high prices. The server made mean comments throughout our time there, which was unpleasant. The mussels were small and served in an unimpressive sauce. Overall, the dishes were unimpressive and bland. If you're looking for good seafood, it's better to try any BYOB or other seafood restaurants, like Little Fish or Audrey Claire. I'm surprised this place is still in business.

input:
Drum-roll please! Review #100 coming right up! 

I chose to review Starbucks as my 100th review because it is a guilty pleasure. Something that I only allow myself once a week. But something that I crave everyday! 

This particular Starbucks is great. The baristas are always friendly and welcoming. The drinks are made correctly and quickly. I usually go with a Salted Caramel Hot Chocolate or Mocha. I also occasionally order the White Mocha. If you can't tell, I enjoy coffee that doesn't taste like coffee! In the summer their iced teas are the perfect thirst quencher! Their breakfast pastry items are always delicious. Try the Cranberry-Orange Scone and you will not be disappointed! Their breakfast sandwiches are unique and pretty tasty as well.

I always choose to go in and place my order over sitting in the drive thru. The line for their drive thru is always ridiculously long. It's usually quicker to go in!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Review #100 is for Starbucks, a guilty pleasure that I indulge in once a week. This particular Starbucks is amazing, with friendly baristas and fast, correct drink preparation. My personal favorites are the Salted Caramel Hot Chocolate and Mocha, though I occasionally order the White Mocha too. Their iced teas are perfect for quenching your thirst in the summer. Breakfast pastries like the Cranberry-Orange Scone are always delicious, and their unique breakfast sandwiches are pretty tasty as well. I prefer going inside to place my order instead of waiting in the long drive-thru line.

input: My wife and I loved everything about this diner. The decor is lovely & the food was great. I had the cheese steak and it was much better than Geno's.  Our server was awesome
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We thoroughly enjoyed this diner with its delightful decor, great food, and wonderful service. The cheese steak, in particular, surpassed our expectations and was superior to Geno's.

input:
Don't judge a book by it's cover.  Looked like a any similar bar food type chain like Friday's, Bennigan's, or Ruby Tuesdays... JB Dawson's is far better.
Awesome experience from the second we stepped in, hostess greeted us with a smile and time to table waiting expectation.  We were promptly seated, and tended to right away with a smile and good attitude by a server, Nancy, who helped us with a beverage and app order.  

For our app we shared the twisted shrimp as it was Twisted Tuesday.  Nancy told us this dish far surpassed Bone Fish's Bang Bang Shrimp, to our surprise, it clearly did.  Our beverage and app shortly followed. 

Shortly there after another server stopped by, Kyle, who was our designated server.  Boy, smile, great greeting, great attitude, engaging.  We talked a bit, figured our way through the menu and placed our order.

For our dishes, my wife selected the Four Cheese Mac & Cheese side -- Sharp Cheddar, Pepperjack, Mozzarella & Reggiano dusted with bread crumbs with cornbread as she had large lunch.  Very good.  Unexpected, light, not overly creamy, not burnt, just right.  And the corn bread with maple butter..... ahhhhhh that was really nice.

 I ordered the fish tacos-- 3 Flour tortillas, seasoned tilapia, chimichurri sauce, mango cilantro salsa & a lime cream drizzle.  Passed on starch sides and had their asparagus that was cooked to perfection.  To my surprise the they were filling, nice size portion (see photo)  not a two bite app.  Very moist and super fresh fish.

Great first experience all around expect one key aspect.  Their so called craft beer menu was really limited and did not contain a variety of types; focused more on IPAs.  Limited thinking for the bar manager I must say.  Kyle our waiter also bar-tends.  We got to talking and he offered with no questions to swap out my beer for another option --- Stoudts Scarlet, which is a reddish beer.  For my beer palette it was better then the others limited options had a nice taste at the swallow then waned off.   Kyle informed us that they buy for all 4 restaurants and try to find a middling that works across the 4 guest demographics.  Not a great decision honestly.  There are so many great craft brewers in the Bucks County region and even Bristol area that should be showed cased and tested through.  For me a bad or poor beer selection stunts the overall experience.

We'll be back but I may need to sneak in my own beer selections from my craft collection.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Don't judge JB Dawson's by its appearance, it surpasses similar chain restaurants like Friday's, Bennigan's, or Ruby Tuesdays. The experience was great from the moment we walked in, with a friendly hostess and minimal wait time. Our server, Nancy, was prompt and had a positive attitude. We ordered the twisted shrimp as an appetizer, which was recommended by Nancy and turned out to be better than Bone Fish's Bang Bang Shrimp. Kyle, our designated server, also provided excellent service and recommendations. My wife enjoyed the Four Cheese Mac & Cheese side and cornbread, while I had the fish tacos with asparagus. The portions were satisfying and the food was delicious. The only downside was the limited craft beer menu, which mainly offered IPAs. However, Kyle kindly offered to swap my beer for a reddish beer called Stoudts Scarlet. Despite this, I think JB Dawson's should showcase and explore more craft beers from the local region. We plan to return but I may bring my own craft beer selection next time.

input:
Stopped here for lunch on the way to drop some people off at the airport. It's a bit unexpected and a tiny bit off the beaten path on a residential street just behind a business district.

I chose the vegetarian plate and a Greek salad. The salad was the absolute best I've ever had. The cheese was absolutely fresh, the vegetables were fresh and chopped just for the salad, and the dressing and seasoning was perfect. The salad was quite large on its own and could easily make a light lunch by itself.

The vegetarian plate came along with their fresh pita-like bread that is baked fresh every morning, seasoned, pan fried vegetables, rice, and a tzatziki-like sauce drizzled on top. The flavors were astounding, and despite a lack of desire to stuff myself silly, I did anyway. Plenty of food for lunch and very reasonably priced.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Stopped for lunch while dropping people off at the airport. Unexpected and off the beaten path on a residential street behind a business district. Had the vegetarian plate and a Greek salad. The salad was the best I've ever had, with fresh cheese, vegetables, and perfect dressing. The salad alone could make a light lunch. The vegetarian plate came with fresh bread, seasoned vegetables, rice, and a drizzle of tzatziki-like sauce. The flavors were amazing and the portion was generous. Reasonably priced.

input:
Again for those that see my review I only give 5 stars after multiple trips.   This local pho shop has an eclectic regular clientele that is loyal for a reason.   Great food and very nice staff. 

The ingredients are so fresh.   I had bun beef because I was not phongry. That is pho hungry.   

Highly recommend stopping in.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Only give 5 stars after multiple trips. Local pho shop with loyal clientele. Great food, nice staff. Fresh ingredients. Had bun beef, not phongry. Highly recommend.

input: Great food love the atmosphere in the place. . .  the carne asada tacos are just like back home !!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great food with a great atmosphere. The carne asada tacos here remind me of home!

input:
Every time we go to this place, we go because of the enticing beer selections, but time after time we leave disappointed by a complacent bar staff that makes you feel like an inconvenience. It's such a shame. The beer selection is second to none, but this time we had one drink and decided to spend our money elsewhere for dinner. This place has been consistent for sure, every time we go, we get a miserable bartender who seems like they'd rather be working on a slow night when they don't have to talk to people. All of the enticing beer in the world won't bring us back. 

The owners brother has a great place a few miles away, Brickside Grill, we went there instead...good beer, excellent food and the staff is consistently friendly and engaging!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite the impressive beer selection, we have repeatedly been disappointed by the indifferent and unaccommodating bar staff at this place. It is unfortunate because the beer options are unmatched. However, after having just one drink, we ultimately decided to go elsewhere for dinner. Every visit to this place has resulted in encountering a dispirited bartender who appears to prefer working during slow nights when they do not have to interact with customers. Although the beer selection is enticing, it will not be enough to convince us to return. Coincidentally, the owner's brother owns another establishment called Brickside Grill, just a few miles away. We opted to go there instead, where we found both great beer, excellent food, and consistently friendly and engaging staff.

input: My friend and I came here around 2pm on a Monday. It happened by default, as most of the restaurants on Main Street were closed. We sat ourselves down at the bar and got to drinking. After a few drinks, I ordered the pulled pork tacos and my friend had a burrito. Not bad, not stellar. Just a standard very place to drink and eat Mexican food. It's got a very college feel even in the middle of the day, so keep that in mind if that's not your thing.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My friend and I arrived at around 2pm on a Monday due to the majority of restaurants on Main Street being closed. We found a seat at the bar and started drinking. Later on, I ordered pulled pork tacos while my friend opted for a burrito. The food was average, neither outstanding nor exceptionally good. The atmosphere had a strong college vibe, even during the day, so consider this if it's not your preference.

input:
Wow!!  That really sums up, in a very good way, my interactions with Delicious Designs and Leigh Anne!  Our wedding was only planned two months out and was supposed to be very very small so no cake was needed.  As the weeks went by, the guest list increased, so I decided I wanted a cake.  With probably less than a weeks notice, Leigh Anne stepped up and made the exact cake I had in my head.  I asked for a simple two tier lemon cake with no decorations.  Not only did she make this happen beautifully, she made chocolate vegan cupcakes for my daughter at the last minute.    I'm attaching a picture of the cake "table".  My daughter did the decorating and I must say, for someone with not much in the decorating department, everything came out better than I could ever imagine.  And not only was the cake perfect, it was yummy delicious.  I can't wait for my one year anniversary to dig in to that top layer! 

If you are in need of any bakery needs in Reno and you don't use Leigh Anne with Delicious Designs, well then all I can say is I'm sorry!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Delicious Designs and Leigh Anne exceeded all expectations for my wedding cake. Despite a last-minute request, she flawlessly created the simple two-tier lemon cake I envisioned. Additionally, Leigh Anne also prepared chocolate vegan cupcakes for my daughter. The cake table, beautifully decorated by my daughter, turned out better than anticipated. Not only was the cake visually pleasing, but it was also delicious. I highly recommend Leigh Anne with Delicious Designs for all bakery needs in Reno.

input: I have been going to this nail salon for years off and on. I came here back when it was called Tropical Nails and Tom was the owner. Now its Grant Nails and has a different owner. When I started getting my nails done again I lucked out and found an experienced technician named Amy. I stuck with her because she did good nails. Then about 2 months ago Amy left. So I let the owner Angela do my nails. The first time was ok. Then the second time she did them the gel polish (which she talked me into getting instead of regular polish) started to chip within a day. I called and complained, she redid the polish and again within one or two days it was chipping. Now my nails look at mess. I don't trust her to correct the problem. Unfortunately, I'm going to have to find a new nail place. Very upsetting and disappointing.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I have been a customer at this nail salon for many years, although off and on. Initially known as Tropical Nails under the ownership of Tom, it is now called Grant Nails with a different owner. During my recent visit, I was fortunate to discover a skilled technician named Amy, whom I continued to request due to her excellent nail work. However, Amy left approximately two months ago, and I reluctantly allowed the owner, Angela, to do my nails instead. The first visit with her was satisfactory, but on the second occasion, she persuaded me to opt for gel polish instead of regular polish. Unfortunately, the gel polish started chipping within a day, so I called and expressed my dissatisfaction. Angela agreed to redo the polish, but once again, it chipped within a very short time frame. As a result, my nails are currently in poor condition, and I have lost confidence in Angela's ability to rectify the issue. It is disheartening and disappointing, but I have no choice but to search for a new nail salon.

input:
Awefull!!!! 
If I could give zero or negative stars I would!
I've never wrote a review before, but I am going out of my way to say that I had the absolute worst dining experience at the Sake House!! 
And esp families, stay clear! 
So first off, I decided to take my 15 month old son out on a sushi date. We arrive at the Sake House at 4pm. There is only one other table and they were closing out. We sit down, and I immediately ask for a simple ice water with lemon. Waiter comes back 20 minutes later (no water). I order a simple roll for my son, to get him started  and a cold Sake. I said I will wait to order mine to get him settled. Another 30 min later, still no water, no food. Waiter comes back with hot Sake, instead of cold. 20 minutes later, the roll for my son (not how I asked) finally some cold Sake, then I have to request water, and then only one cup for my son, no lemon. When I see 2 going on a third table had come in and ordered, and a "to go" order is being placed, all with food and water, I became perturbed. The waiter never came back to see what I wanted. Never came back to check on the order. Finally after  nearly 2 hours of waiting and trying to deal with my antsy son, who waited so long to be served, and seeing one chef trying to make everyone's order I decided it was time to go. Finally after waiting another 5/10 minutes I had to walk up and ask for my check , which was only a $6 drink. Which I reluctantly paid. After being in the hospitality industry for years, I know what to expect, and I know what to forgive. I also know that English being a second language must be tough...BUT since he was able to wait in other tables i know that wasn't the issue. After 2 hours of waiting, and dealing with a fussy/hungry toddler as a single mother I feel like the least they could have done is offer a free drink, to say "we understand we couldn't accommodate you, but we tried." It's principal above all else. ...I just waisted 2 hours! And had to leave and take my baby somewhere else. Time is money! And I waisted 2 hours here! 
Time that is rare and I had to plan being a busy mother.
I should have listened to the other reviews about the shitty service here. 
Don't waste your time or money!!!
Stay away! Any other place is better than here!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Terrible experience at the Sake House! I took my 15-month-old son for a sushi date, but the service was awful. After waiting 20 minutes for water, I ordered a simple roll for my son and a cold Sake, but the waiter brought hot Sake instead. The food took forever to arrive, and the waiter never checked on us. Despite seeing other tables getting served, I had to ask for my check after waiting nearly 2 hours. As a single mother dealing with a hungry toddler, the least they could have done was offer a free drink or acknowledge their failure. I wasted 2 hours and had to go somewhere else. Don't waste your time or money here!

input:
The only good part.... 

Their stage is really cool! Raised up, lights that move around, good sound system, a fog machine, and a pretty big dance floor. 


But their food service.... crappy both times Ive been there. 

The last time I was there I walked in, hadn't been greeted by anyone at the empty front podium, and just found a table. I figured once I sat down Id wait for an employee to get back to the menus and go up and ask for one. So I saw a lady working up at the front and went up and asked her.  She said that they stopped serving food at...... I cant remember if it was 9 or 10 pm.... but she gave me a certain time that the kitchen closed. I went back to my table and looked at the time. It was 10 minutes before the time she told me the kitchen closed. I thought that was kinda dumb, but oh well.... maybe they stopped taking orders 10 minutes ahead or something. The next thing I see the SAME EXACT LADY seat four people RIGHT NEXT to our table and give them menus. Then she takes their order, and brings out their food. All I wanted were some freakin french fries and I had to sit there and watch the people who got there long after me eating french fries instead. RUDE!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The stage setup and ambiance is cool, with a raised stage, moving lights, good sound system, a fog machine, and a spacious dance floor. However, the food service at the venue has been consistently poor. On my last visit, I wasn't greeted at the front podium and had to find a table myself. When I asked a staff member for a menu, I was informed that the kitchen had already closed, despite it being 10 minutes before the time I was told. To make matters worse, the same employee seated and served others right next to us, including the food I wanted. It was a frustrating and rude experience.

input: My hair is a work in progress. I have been trying to get an A-line bob for a bit over a year now with little success until today! Jenna Moore was referred by a friend and on my god I'm so glad she did. Jenna is amazing.
