I would recommend to someone who wants a friendly atmosphere with decent food in a sports bar setting.  They actually do have sports playing on the tvs.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Went there with a gift card and was pleasantly surprised by the delicious food. I had the sauteed stirfry over spinach while my girlfriend enjoyed a generous portion of nachos. The menu offers a variety of other tasty options and the daytime bartender was friendly. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a welcoming sports bar with good food and actual sports playing on the TVs.

input: Horrible experience, pizza was soggy and cold when I received it, took 2 hours until I actually received my order as well. Absolutely no communication on my order, even after calling twice. Once I finally received the pizza I called to get my money back, which was communicated that I would not be charged, soon to find out that I was charged the very next day. I highly recommend never ordering from here, service was horrible and they were extremely rude. I won't be ordering from here again and either should you.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Terrible experience: pizza arrived cold and soggy, took 2 hours to be delivered with no communication. After calling twice, no updates were provided. When I finally received the pizza, I was assured a refund, but was charged the next day. Unprofessional and rude service. Strongly advise against ordering from here.

input:
Incredible service and incredible food! The black bean ravioli is succulent! The bone-in steak was flavorful and amazingly juicy and delicious. And the best of all, service was perfect. From the friendly hostess to the waiter to the chef who personally came over to make sure we enjoyed our food, everyone really made us feel at home. 

As an added bonus, the ambiance is beautiful. Decor, lighting, and fireplace makes the place very homely. 

Highly recommended. I went as a group of four and had an excellent time.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Outstanding service, food, and ambiance! The black bean ravioli is succulent, and the bone-in steak is flavorful and amazingly juicy. The friendly staff, including the hostess, waiter, and even the chef, went above and beyond to ensure our satisfaction. The beautiful decor, lighting, and fireplace added to the cozy atmosphere. Highly recommended for a great dining experience. Went as a group of four and had an excellent time.

input:
I've been driving by this location for several weeks anticipating their opening.  With the established Legends Sports Bar directly across the street I thought this place must have something very special to feel they can compete.

They took over the building that was prevriously used by the Ruby River Steakhouse.  The owners apparently opted not to change a thing about the indoor seating.  Gone are all the cowboy boots, up are various team jerseys. It looks like somebody went to Pro Image at the mall to decorate the place.  Nothing appears to be autographed or evoke a sense of authenticity.

Video games are available for the kids, so bring your quarters.  No dart boards, shuffleboard, air hockey or pool tables.  This is pretty much a dine and drink only establishment.

More TV's in the place than I could count (I figure at least 20), all tuned to ESPN or ESPN2.  No clue at this time if they are choosing to use Direct TV, Dish, or Cable One for their service.  However, they already have made one of the biggest mistakes I think most wannabe sports bars make; they broadcast music rather than sound from a live sporting event.  With live sporting events available almost everyday from 12pm - 12am, you would think they would want to try to emphasize that rather than muzak (tuned to a country station; still feels like the Ruby River).

A word of advice here, if you want people to stay and eat and drink, you gotta give them something on which to focus their attention.  The sounds of the game will get their attention.  They came to a sports bar to think about sports, not Conway Twitty.

Typically, when I see the word pub in a restaurant name, I think it is just beer and wine, but it looks like Timeout has a full bar with several specialty drinks.  With a designated driver, it may be fun to experiment.

The food is typical sports bar fare; salads, burgers, pasta.  Most items will cost $9 - $11, with entrees running more.  A few twists on their offerings will ensure that I stop in to try something different, but unless the atmosphere improves, I think I will always leave a little disappointed. 

Those staying at the nearby motel may like the proximity, but I think they might find the walk across the street to Legends worth the extra steps.

Happy Hour 2pm - 6pm Monday -  Friday; Late Happy Hour 10pm - close Monday - Thursday.  Happy Hour all day Sunday.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I've been driving past this place for weeks, excited for its opening. It's located across from Legends Sports Bar, so I expected it to offer something unique to compete. It took over the building previously used by Ruby River Steakhouse and didn't change much about the indoor seating. The decor is like something you'd find at Pro Image in the mall, with team jerseys instead of cowboy boots. There are video games for kids, but no dart boards, shuffleboard, air hockey, or pool tables. It's primarily a dine and drink establishment. They have a lot of TVs, at least 20, all tuned to ESPN or ESPN2, but I'm not sure what cable service they use. Unfortunately, they make the mistake of playing music instead of live sports event sounds, which doesn't match the atmosphere. If they want people to stay and enjoy the food and drinks, they should focus on the sports experience. They do have a full bar with specialty drinks, so it might be fun to try them with a designated driver. The food is typical sports bar fare, with prices ranging from $9 to $11 for most items. There are some unique twists on the menu, but the atmosphere needs improvement. Although the nearby motel guests might appreciate the proximity, I think they would find Legends Sports Bar worth the extra steps to walk across the street. They have happy hour from 2pm to 6pm Monday to Friday, a late happy hour from 10pm to close Monday to Thursday, and all-day happy hour on Sunday.

input: If you like onion rings order them here. Some of the best I have ever have. I also had a Reuben which was very good also.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: If you enjoy onion rings, order them here - they're some of the best I've ever had! Additionally, I tried the Reuben and it was also delicious.

input: The cutest and definitely the friendliest coffee shop in Boise! The coffee is great but the staff is even better. Love this place!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The cutest and friendliest coffee shop in Boise, with great coffee and an amazing staff. Love it!

input:
Hubby and I were eager to try this establishment due to a rave review from some close friends. We decided for our date night we would give it a try on Saturday. We pulled up about 8pm and the open sign was turned off. We thought maybe the light was burnt out or someone just forgot to plug it in. So we proceeded to the door. There were people inside and the sign said open till 11pm, so we walked inside. It was like walking into the Twlight Zone, everyone stopped and stared at us. The woman behind the bar came over and told us they were closed. HUH! Ok.... so we left. It was very akward and unpleasant. If they were closed then the door should of been locked or a sign on the door stating private party or something. 
Not sure if we will attempt to try to dine there again.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We were excited to try this place after hearing a rave review from friends. Despite the open sign being off, we entered around 8pm, assuming it was just a technical issue. To our surprise, there were people inside but they stared at us like we were in the Twilight Zone. The barwoman informed us they were closed, which was awkward and unpleasant. Perhaps they should have locked the door or put up a sign if they were closed. Uncertain if we'll give it another shot.

input: Awesome food! It was so fresh and delicious. The papaya salad was delicious! Try the curry..simply spicy and beautiful. The service was great too! They have take out!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Amazingly fresh and delicious food, especially the papaya salad. Don't miss out on their simply spicy and beautiful curry. The service is great and they also offer take-out options.

input: I have new dental insurance and had to find a dentist in network and came across Music City Dental. Dr. Spurlin and her staff are great! They are very gentle and make sure the patient is comfortable at all times. I had to get a filling and am terrified of shots. I didn't even feel when Dr. Spurlin gave me my shot. I was offered a pillow, blanket and choice of watching a movie or listening to music. I had a pleasant experience and am definitely a permanent patient!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I found Music City Dental, a dentist in my new insurance network. Dr. Spurlin and her staff are excellent - they prioritize patient comfort and are very gentle. Despite my fear of shots, I didn't even feel it when Dr. Spurlin gave me one for my filling. They offered me a pillow, blanket, and the choice to watch a movie or listen to music. Overall, I had a pleasant experience and will definitely be returning as a permanent patient.

input:
The beef noodles was a bit too salty and the fried rice was a bit oily. But overall they are good. We liked the shrimp spring rolls a lot. It is one of the best we have tried. 

The place could have earned higher points. But I have to give it a three stars because of the chaotic seating arrangement. The owner gave tables to people behind us despite we reminded the him and the staff. Perhaps that is what you get when you go to a teeny tiny Chinese restaurant during a long weekend.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The beef noodles were too salty and the fried rice was oily, but overall they were good. We really enjoyed the shrimp spring rolls, they were some of the best we've had. However, the seating arrangement was chaotic and the owner gave tables to people behind us despite our reminders. We can only give it three stars due to this. This may be expected when visiting a small Chinese restaurant during a busy long weekend.

input:
Great community vibe... i've run into friends and struck up conversation with new ones each time i've been in.  Its nice to have new hang within walking distance of my house.  I've stuck to the classic burger and love it... everything from the buns to the ketchup is made in-house and has unique taste. The bar had pretty much whatever i wanted... last night the bartenders made some homespun watermelon concoction.

To touch on some other reviews... i understand everyone has a different experience, but to say the place is 'too hipster' seems like someones still jaded from feeling left out in high school...  and personally attacking the owner is tasteless and has no place in a review.  We should be glad we don't all have someone looking over our shoulder attacking our motives. I like what Burger Up is trying to do and i like that they hired a bunch of folks representative of our Nashville community... if you need a non-musician wait staff who dresses just like you and takes you to prom, you're probably in the wrong town.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great community atmosphere with opportunities to run into old friends and make new ones. Conveniently located within walking distance of my home. The classic burger is my go-to choice and I appreciate the fact that everything from the buns to the ketchup is homemade, giving it a unique flavor. The bar offers a wide selection of drinks, including a delicious homemade watermelon concoction I recently enjoyed. Regarding other reviews, labeling the place as "too hipster" appears to stem from personal feelings of exclusion, which seems unfair. Criticizing the owner personally is also uncalled for and should not be a part of a review. Burger Up aims to create a positive experience and has employed a diverse staff that reflects the Nashville community. If you're looking for a cookie-cutter experience, you might be in the wrong town.

input: I am not an indian food type of person but this place lives up to the hype. When you go, just let Hassan make something for you, don't try and overwhelm yourself with the different options. Make sure to get a chaat and a lassi as the two really complement one another.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite not usually enjoying Indian food, I highly recommend this place as it truly lives up to the hype. Instead of being overwhelmed by the numerous options, allow Hassan to select a dish for you. Don't forget to try the chaat and lassi together, as they perfectly complement each other.

input:
Excellent food, good service, great location. 

My wife had shrimp and grits, I had the barbecued shrimp -- both were outstanding. The appetizers were good. The bread pudding was a tad dry in the city that is supposed to be the mother lode of bread pudding. 

Mr. B came close to snagging the fifth star but the service could have been more attentive and the place is freezing - - in July in New Orleans. Wear long sleeves or bring a jacket.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great food, good service, great location. Wife had amazing shrimp and grits, I enjoyed the barbecued shrimp. Appetizers were satisfying. Unfortunately, the bread pudding was slightly dry, which was unexpected for a city known for it. While Mr. B came close to earning a fifth star, the service could have been more attentive and the restaurant was cold even in July. It's recommended to wear long sleeves or bring a jacket.

input:
Wow. We visited NOLA last week and took the truly awesome and informative  Steamboat Natchez trip on March 30. Can't tell you how interesting it was and pleasant. Plus these people are so well-organized and nice. JoJo reserved us a window seat - just could not believe the kind and excellent service. 
Very very nice.  Recommend!!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had an incredible and informative experience on the Steamboat Natchez trip in NOLA last week. The organization and service were exceptional, with JoJo reserving us a window seat. Highly recommend!

input: Quite possibly the perfect business model to fail if it wasn't for a sequestered clientel?  We visit New Orleans often, and it is an activity of ours to bet on how many beers or ingredients they are out of.  Bartenders rude and swearing. It's almost comical, we sit and listen to patrons asking for draft beers and mixed drinks and getting responses "can't do that".  They said "No mules", to at least 5 people as we sat for about 30 mins today.  2 out of 4 taps not working. What an absolute waste of opportunity.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This business model is on the verge of failure, saved only by a loyal customer base. When we visit New Orleans, it has become a habit for us to place bets on the number of beers or ingredients they are out of. The bartenders are consistently rude and use profanity, which has almost become comical. We often witness patrons asking for draft beers or mixed drinks only to be told they cannot fulfill their requests. Today, we heard at least five people being denied the option of ordering mules, while two out of four taps were not functioning. It's truly disappointing to see such a wasted opportunity.

input: We had a mixed experience at Mr. B's.  We started at the bar for drinks and a starter due to table wait. Bar was nice for a busy night. Our table was ready early so the bar staff transferred our starter to the table and things went down hill quickly. Starters were delivered and then we were ignored for over 45 minutes. No drinks, water etc. Finally a waiter in another section took out order. We ordered BBQ shrimp (best thing on our table), rabbit and wood plank grilled fish. Fish was a very small piece and not worth the $$$. Rabbit was good! Hit and miss service ruined the experience.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Our experience at Mr. B's was mixed. We initially started at the bar for drinks and a starter while waiting for a table. The bar was nice and bustling, fitting for a busy night. However, when our table was ready earlier than expected, the transition from the bar to our table was not smooth. Starters were delivered, but then we were left unattended for over 45 minutes without any drinks or even water. Eventually, a waiter from a different section took our order. We tried the BBQ shrimp, which was the standout dish, but were disappointed by the small portion and overpriced wood plank grilled fish. On the positive side, the rabbit was enjoyable. Inconsistency in service greatly affected our overall experience.

input:
This place is so cute. The interior is adorable and casual. There's some small booths and chairs and tables for hanging out and enjoying your food/drinks. It's all so clean, too, which is a huge plus.
There's a little section with baked goods, some Asian and some more American. They have mostly Vietnamese food, but I also saw some other types of food (e.g bulgogi).
I came in with two friends and the woman who helped us was really personable and friendly. We ordered banh mi and boba tea, and sat down waiting for our food to be brought to us. The banh mi was really yummy, especially the bread. I had boba milk tea, which was as good as any milk tea I've had before. 
They have a drink card which you can get stamped to receive a free tenth drink. Definitely an incentive to return. Also, their hours are awesome, which is a huge plus.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is adorable and casual with a cute and clean interior. It offers small booths, chairs, and tables for hanging out while enjoying food and drinks. They have a variety of baked goods, including Asian and American options. The menu mainly features Vietnamese cuisine, but also includes other dishes like bulgogi. The staff is friendly and personable. We ordered banh mi and boba tea, which were both delicious. The boba milk tea was particularly satisfying. They have a drink card offering a free tenth drink as an incentive to return. Additionally, their hours are convenient.

input: I stopped at Walgreens in hopes of seeing the new ELF Villain's collection. Sometimes Walgreens gets them before the holidays. Sometimes they don't. This particular one doesn't ever get them according to their cosmetics person. SAD. Really sad. I suppose I'll have to skulk other Walgreens to find them.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I went to Walgreens to find the new ELF Villain's collection, but sadly they didn't have it. According to their cosmetics person, this particular Walgreens never gets them. It's disappointing and makes me feel like I'll have to search other Walgreens to find it.

input: This is the best Italian food I've ever had. Very small elegant restaurant, entrees were really good and very tasty cheesecake. To top it off, the entire staff was super friendly. Highly recommended for date night.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Highly recommended for date night, this small and elegant Italian restaurant offers the best Italian food I've ever had. The entrees were incredibly tasty, and the cheesecake was simply delightful. Additionally, the entire staff was super friendly, creating a perfect dining experience.

input:
This is my favourite place to get fish tacos! It's all I ever order, along with the occasional queso or beans which are also delicious. My friend was visiting from out of town and he ordered the beef taco and chicken fajitas and thought they were pretty average. However, he agreed that the fish tacos were amazing. Since 2 full me up and they're only like $2.60 each it's a pretty happy visit all round for me! Plus the interior and patio are awesome
(And there's Ben and Jerry's right next door for dessert)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My favorite place for fish tacos is also a great spot for queso and beans. When my friend visited, he found the beef taco and chicken fajitas to be average, but agreed that the fish tacos were amazing. With 2 filling fish tacos priced at $2.60 each, it's a happy visit for me. The interior and patio are awesome, and there's a Ben and Jerry's next door for dessert.

input: Replaced a dive watch battery in less than 5 minutes for a very reasonable fee.  Prompt, friendly service.  Plenty of staff.  Convenient location.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Quickly replaced dive watch battery at a fair cost. Friendly service, ample staff, and convenient location.

input:
Stopped here last week while in the area from Burbank. Had read about it on Trip Advisor. It is in a great location, quiet, peaceful and cool under the shade of the big old trees. For its location and it being noon on a Thursday we were surprised to find there was literally only one table open when we walked in. Food is served pretty quick though so it didn't seem anyone was really waiting. 
Based on reviews we had read, my hubby had the tri-tip sandwich. I ordered the buffalo burger. I have to say that was one of the best burgers I have ever had in my life. As usual, we traded tastes of our orders. My hubby was so jealous of my buffalo burger and I heard about it several more times throughout the day, that he should've got the burger. The tri-tip was quite dry, and it was literally just the meat on bread, big bread.  The horseradish sauce (served on the side) was very tasty though.
For the tri-tip, I give a 3, hubby gives a 4. We both give the buffalo burger a definite 5++.

Either way, worth checking out if you want something with a unique atmosphere and that is away from town but not a long drive. Very peaceful.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Stopped here last week after reading about it on Trip Advisor. It's in a great, quiet location under the shade of big old trees. Surprisingly, there was only one table available for us, despite it being noon on a Thursday. However, the food was served quickly, so it didn't seem like anyone was waiting. My husband had the tri-tip sandwich, which was dry and just meat on bread, but the horseradish sauce was tasty. I ordered the buffalo burger and it was one of the best burgers I've ever had. My husband was jealous and regretted not getting the burger. We rate the tri-tip a 3 and the buffalo burger a definite 5++. Overall, it's worth checking out if you want a unique atmosphere and a peaceful location not far from town.

input:
I have frequented the Mad Mex, University City location for years.  I was pleased to see this new location which is closer to my home and I don't have to deal with the obnoxious students.  I have been here for Happy Hour and just for dinner at another time.  It has been busy both times and it seems that the staff need to be trained a little more in chaos and crowd management.  The best deals are during Happy Hour - the $3, $5 & $7 Margarita's.  I also believe wings are 1/2 off.  My friends seemed to enjoy their orders of Burritos, Gaucamole and enchiladas.  

The food is average and for the price of drinks - it would be a great place to hang if the service improves.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I have frequented Mad Mex, University City location for years. Happy to see this new location closer to my home, away from obnoxious students. Been there for Happy Hour and dinner, both times were busy and staff needs more training in chaos and crowd management. Best deals are during Happy Hour - $3, $5 & $7 Margaritas, and wings are 1/2 off. Friends enjoyed their Burritos, Guacamole, and enchiladas. Food is average, but if service improves, it could be a great hangout considering the price of drinks.

input:
I brought my boyfriend here on a Saturday for a tour and beer sampling since Yuengling is one of his favorite beers. We never knew it was so close!

Be sure to look on their website for tour times before going and read the FAQ's. 
- First note: There were many people wearing flip flops on our tours vs. the insisted closed toe shoe policy, but that could be because of the next note.
- Second note: There is no production/brewing on Saturdays so the brewery is quiet and empty.

We looked around the main waiting/lobby area and gift shop waiting for our 12p tour to begin.  We had quite a large group, which had to split into two smaller ones. The tour lasted about 40 minutes, starting with a ten minute video of the history of Yuengling and the rise to present day. Next, the guide takes you out to the brewery, and into the kettle room, around through the lab, the bottle line, and the holding tanks. The tour was informative and hands on. Our guide was informative and knew quite a lot about the history and brewing process. She did a great job!

Once done, you loop back into the lobby where the tasting room is and it's drinks galore. The BEST PART? FREE. Tips are encouraged! ;)
We tried the Premium Lager, Lager, and Black and Tan. Sadly they were out of the Lord Chesterfield this day and the Premium Light is not available here in FL.

Overall, a great tour and I will be revisitng with my parents when they are in town!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I brought my boyfriend here on a Saturday for a tour and beer sampling at Yuengling, one of his favorite beers. Be sure to check their website for tour times and read the FAQ's before going. Note that some people were wearing flip flops on the tour, despite the closed toe shoe policy. Also, there is no production on Saturdays, so the brewery is quiet. The tour lasted about 40 minutes, starting with a video on the history of Yuengling. Our guide was informative and knowledgeable. After the tour, we had a tasting in the lobby, where the drinks are free but tips are encouraged. We tried the Premium Lager, Lager, and Black and Tan. Unfortunately, the Lord Chesterfield was not available that day and Premium Light is not available in FL. Overall, it was a great tour and I plan to revisit with my parents in the future.

input:
Really disappointed. I've been to the Marathon at 18/Spruce and had excellent service, drinks and food. Thought that would transfer to this location - not at all.

To sum it up, our server was extremely energetic, but not in a good way. More like a frantic energy. I was there to enjoy a few drinks and dinner with a friend who was visiting (AKA looking to spend money AKA you will get a larger tip if you let us stay longer) and we were rushed out. Server brought boxes for food we were still eating, without asking if we wanted them. A few minutes later he physically put the food in the boxes at the tableside while mumbling something like "I don't like food sitting on the table." .....we didn't even want to take it home. Next, when we said we were having another friend join for another round or two of drinks he told us we couldn't stay at the booth we were at and we needed to go to the bar. What? I point blank asked him if he was kicking us out of the booth and he said "yes!" energetically. There was no one waiting for tables and there were numerous open tables/booths around the restaurant. I felt extremely uncomfortable and wanted to leave immediately. Our friend joined after all this happened, and when the server came over to ask if they wanted a drink, he seemed surprised when we told him we were just going to leave. YOU LITERALLY just told us we couldn't sit at this table any longer!! We then left.

I worked in restaurants for a long time and I'm pretty easy to please when it comes to restaurant service. I was not pleased at all during this visit.

On another note, the food was not that great.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a disappointing experience at the Marathon location at 18/Spruce. Despite having enjoyed excellent service, drinks, and food at another Marathon location, this one did not live up to my expectations. Our server was overly energetic in a frantic way, rushing us out even though we wanted to enjoy our drinks and dinner. They brought boxes for our food without asking and even put the food in the boxes at our tableside without our consent. When we mentioned having another friend join us for drinks, the server abruptly told us we couldn't stay at our booth and had to go to the bar. This made us uncomfortable, and we decided to leave. On top of the poor service, the food was also not that great. As someone who has worked in the restaurant industry and is usually easy to please, this visit was a major disappointment.

input: We arrived for lunch at 12p on a Friday - wasn't busy at all. It took FOREVER to get anything. We were really pleasant and kind but we had to complain several times to get any beverages that we ordered. It took them 40 minutes to let us know that a beer we ordered was no longer available. The food was great, but not worth the lengthy wait and slow service.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We arrived for lunch at 12p on a Friday. Despite it not being busy, it took an excessively long time to receive anything. Despite our pleasant and kind demeanor, we had to complain multiple times to get our ordered beverages. They took 40 minutes to inform us that a beer we ordered was no longer available. While the food was enjoyable, the extended wait and slow service made it not worth it.

input: Walked by this place and decided to check it out. Great beer and burger place, made even better knowing many things were organic. You can order from the menu, or create your own burger. They also have rotating beers and specials. Nice atmosphere and staff. Burgers don't come with anything, so order from the sides if you want some fries. (There's also sandwiches and salads if you don't want a burger) Vegetarian friendly.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Discovered a great organic beer and burger place while passing by. Menu offers both pre-made and customizable burgers, with rotating beers and specials. The friendly staff and pleasant atmosphere add to the experience. Sides can be ordered separately, including fries. Vegetarian options available, such as sandwiches and salads.

input:
First time I went to Earl's new American kitchen I liked the food it was good wasn't great but it was a ok 
 service not so great sat at the bar did not really care for a bartender tried it again second time bartender was really rude I would never go back there  or Recommend it to anyone
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had my first experience at Earl's new American kitchen and found the food to be good, although not exceptional. The service, especially from the bartender, was not great. On my second visit, the bartender was extremely rude, which has led me to decide never to return to Earl's or recommend it to others.

input:
I visited Jake's for the first time after learning that the small diner I used to go to in Delaware as a kid had become a franchise. I was so excited to experience the delicious burgers and fries that I craved as a kid.

I walked into the establishment and was frankly unimpressed by the ambiance. The restaurant was moderately clean and very open. The menu actually reminded my of a Five Guys. You get to choose your own toppings (all free) to put on 1, 2, or 3 patties.

I ordered the regular cheeseburger with a ton of toppings and a regular size french fry to share with my boyfriend. The burgers were delicious. The bread was soft and tasty and the burgers were succulent and juicy. The fries were disappointing. McDonalds fries taste better and usually aren't even as cold as Jake's were.

Man oh man, Jake's. I'll go back for the burgers, maybe, but I definitely will stick to the original location for a better experience.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I visited Jake's for the first time after finding out that the small diner I used to go to in Delaware had become a franchise. Despite my excitement to relive my childhood cravings for their delicious burgers and fries, I found the ambiance to be unimpressive. The restaurant was clean but lacked character, resembling a Five Guys with its customizable toppings. I ordered a regular cheeseburger with numerous toppings and shared a regular-sized french fry with my boyfriend. The burgers were satisfyingly juicy and flavorful, but the fries fell short, being colder and less tasty than McDonald's. Although I may return to Jake's solely for the burgers, I prefer the original location for a better overall experience.

input: I think its funny that my car needed a jump infront of their shop on broad street and i was told No because of not being able to leave the store. When asked if another employee could help he said no he is about to leave. I then asked if he can give me a jump when he leaves and i also got a NO. Funny how theycservice cars, help people with cars but cant even give me a jump. Lame service. Not customer oriented at all. Typical fat guy behind the counter surfing the web and playin on his phone. The worst
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: It's amusing to me that my car needed a jump in front of their store on Broad Street, but they refused to help because they couldn't leave the shop. Even when I suggested another employee could assist or offer a jump later, they declined. It's funny how they claim to service cars and help people with vehicles, yet couldn't even provide a jump. Their service is disappointing and lacks customer focus. It's the typical experience with an unhelpful staff member engrossed in personal activities instead of attending to customers. Overall, it was a bad experience.

input: I ordered the Pulled Pork Nachos.  They were delicious!  Instead of tortilla chips they are served with potato chips...perfect to share with a Beer or Bloody Mary
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I enjoyed the delicious Pulled Pork Nachos, which were served with potato chips instead of tortilla chips. They make a perfect sharing option with a Beer or Bloody Mary.

input: This place was cute and was in a great location!  It is one block up from the beach and wharf, two blocks over from State Street.  Parking was convenient, and our room was a King overlooking the courtyard and spa on the ground floor.  If there were people in the spa, they could be heard, but the noise didn't bother since the spa closed at 9pm.  The room was clean with a nice couch to lounge on, a refrigerator, a nice fireplace, ample closet and counter space, and a nice bathroom.  The wine and cheese at 5 was a nice touch as well.  Although this place didn't have a lot of extras, it was a pleasant stay, friendly and helpful staff, a good price, perfect location, and suited our needs just fine for a place in Santa Barbara.  My only complaint was that the room got a little stuffy, but was fine once we opened the windows and used the ceiling fan to air it out.  Would consider staying here again.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is cute and in a great location, one block up from the beach and wharf and two blocks over from State Street. Parking is convenient and our room was a King overlooking the courtyard and spa on the ground floor. There were some noises from the spa, but it didn't bother us as it closed at 9pm. The room was clean with a nice couch, refrigerator, fireplace, ample closet and counter space, and a nice bathroom. The wine and cheese at 5 was a nice touch. Although the place lacked extras, it was a pleasant stay with friendly and helpful staff, a good price, and suited our needs. The only complaint was a stuffy room, but it improved after opening windows and using the ceiling fan. Would consider staying here again.

input:
I've been to Mirna's about four times over the past few years and never been disappointed. The portions are HUGE, especially for the modest price tag. Do yourself a favor and get a pasta dish, I can assure you that you'll be glad you did. I've had fish there too, which wasn't bad by any means, but the pasta plates are definitely their specialty. A couple of the times I've been there they treated us to free hummus and pita, which is always a plus. BYOB!

Only knock on the place is that it's pretty small, so make sure to call ahead to reserve a table or check for a wait.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Mirna's is a small restaurant that I have visited about four times in the past years and it has never disappointed me. The portions are huge for the reasonable price and their pasta dishes are a must-try. Although their fish is also decent, pasta is definitely their specialty. Occasionally, they even offer complimentary hummus and pita, which is a great bonus. The only downside is its size, so it is recommended to call ahead for reservations or inquire about potential wait times. Additionally, it is a BYOB establishment.

input: While I generally support independent restaurants over chain places,I still don't buy into the overpriced center city Phila hype. The place was actually roomier than the south Philly closets we usually take my mother in law for her birthday,but the prices were jaw dropping...quite different from the online menu. The food and portions were ok,and the dessert was something different than the average places. The bus help was a bit out of sync with the waiter,as they were asking us if we were done with our plates just as the waiter was telling us the desserts,and as the Philly standard the bathroom was a bit small to accomodate the size of the place.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I generally prefer independent restaurants to chains, but I find the overpriced center city Philadelphia hype to be unconvincing. The restaurant was actually more spacious than the cramped south Philadelphia places we usually go to for my mother-in-law's birthday. However, I was shocked by the prices, which were quite different from what was shown online. The food and portions were average, but the dessert was unique compared to other places. The bus help was not well coordinated with the waiter, as they were asking about clearing our plates while the waiter was telling us about desserts. Additionally, the bathroom was too small for the size of the restaurant, which is typical for Philadelphia.

input: Platoon is awesome and you definitely want Steve C as a trainer. When I started platoon, I was going once a week and attending a different group exercise class the other days of the week. After a few months, I was only coming to platoon 3-5 days a week. I loved how my workouts were customized to what I could do and wanted to do instead of a group workout that was impossible to complete. Steve is a great listener and motivator and sets realistic goals. The staff at platoon are very nice and accommodating. I never had a problem with billing or scheduling.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Platoon is an amazing training program, and Steve C is an exceptional trainer. Initially, I only attended platoon once a week, while attending a different group exercise class on other days. However, after a few months, I found myself coming to platoon 3-5 times a week. What I loved about platoon was how the workouts were tailored to my abilities and preferences, unlike group workouts that were often too challenging. Steve is not only a great listener but also a motivational coach who sets achievable goals. Additionally, the staff at platoon are friendly and accommodating, and I never encountered any issues with billing or scheduling.

input: The Tater-Tots were good but not anything I haven't  had before. Burger was satisfactory.  Quick stop for lunch.  Staff was helpful with providing directions to local attractions.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The Tater-Tots were decent, but nothing new. The burger was okay. It was a convenient spot for a quick lunch. The staff was helpful in giving directions to nearby attractions.

input:
As a frequent customer who has come since the place opened, I had previously rated this place higher, based on a recent experience decided to downgrade.

Myself and both in-laws had visited, one of which was senior. Had a mail coupon for $5 off, which had no disclaimer.  I wanted to apply this to our party of three (2 adults, 1 senior). Cashier gave us a hard time stating that her management dictated that she wasn't allowed to apply the coupon if we were combining it with a senior discount. What logic is that? How would it be any different if I had paid for myself and my mother in law, applied the coupon. Then told my father in law, the senior, to pay on his own. Seriously, Retarded. 

This is on YOU management not that poor girl. Either for not creating a better customer experience or poorly training your staff.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: As a frequent customer, I had previously rated this place higher but based on a recent experience, I decided to downgrade. Myself and both in-laws visited, one being a senior, and we had a mail coupon for $5 off. However, the cashier refused to apply the coupon with the senior discount, citing management's rules. This logic is illogical, as it would make no difference if we paid separately. This reflects poorly on the management, not the cashier, for failing to create a better customer experience or effectively train their staff.

input: Our 1st visit here. We went through the drive thru & ordered 4 Chicago dogs. The total bill was $10.  The Chicago Dogs were great & the only place in a 28 mile radius that you can purchase one. The only 2 things missing were a poppyseed bun & celery salt. My last attempt for a Chicago dog locally was Sonic (yuck). SuperGyro uses 100% beef hot dogs, that neon green relish, sport peppers, onions, dill pickle tomatoes & onion. I'll be back for more & also to try the other menu items.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: First visit. Ordered 4 Chicago dogs through drive thru, costing $10. Only place within 28 miles to purchase one. Missing a poppyseed bun and celery salt. Previous attempt at local Chicago dog at Sonic was disappointing. SuperGyro's Chicago dogs include 100% beef hot dogs, neon green relish, sport peppers, onions, dill pickle tomatoes, and onion. Will return for more and to try other menu items.

input: Wawa is like a beacon in a cold, dark world.  I grew up around Sheetz locations, but I have to admit that I prefer Wawa.  The sandwiches are really good, and they have the typical snacks/drinks you would expect from a convenience store.  This particular location is not quite as friendly as the one I go to near the office, but whatever.  I can still walk out with all of my snacking requirements.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Wawa is a preferred convenience store for me over Sheetz. Their sandwiches are delicious and they offer the typical snacks and drinks. While this location is not as friendly as the one near my office, I can still find everything I need.

input: My dad and I stopped in on the way back to the hotel because we wanted a 2nd drink after being disappointed with our first at another place. We ordered the hand grenades rather than pore over the menu. There was a band playing so we decided to sit for a bit Holy cow on those drinks!! They were $9 each (with souvenir cup) and we were really feeling it towards the end of the drink. It was during the day and we were enjoying the nice weather and band playing. This place was on the corner of Bourbon, close to Jackson Square and there was lots of open air coming through. We were singing along with the band which is an indication of how good that drink made us feel, lol. We had a lot of fun, good atmosphere in that bar.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My dad and I stopped at this bar on our way back to the hotel. We were disappointed with our first drink at another place, so we decided to try a second one here. Without going through the menu, we ordered the hand grenades. To our surprise, they were $9 each and came with a souvenir cup. By the end of the drink, we were really feeling the effects. The bar was located on the corner of Bourbon, near Jackson Square, and had a lot of open air. There was a band playing, so we decided to stay for a while. We had a great time, enjoying the nice weather and singing along with the band. Overall, the atmosphere in that bar was fantastic.

input:
I went to this location because it's easy to get in and out even tho it is a busy corner. This is my second visit. My first visit was mediocre. The woman who assisted me was not really friendly (sorry I didn't get names at either visit) but was helpful and professional. My second visit I was assisted by a different woman who was also helpful, knowledgeable and professional. I realized the women were not being rude; they are just quiet. Neither woman made small talk but answered every question I had. 
Now my second visit deserved 5 stars. I normally pack things myself and just need it shipped, but I was shipping a skateboard and could not box it correctly. The woman went above and beyond to help me and she offered more assistance than was professionally required.  I will return to this location for all my shipping needs.
The store is clean, and packs (no pun intended) a lot of product into a small space. The staff is knowledgeable. They have boxes, packing materials, and offer copying services. You may not get a big smile and a lot of small talk, but you will get the highest level of service. In my opinion.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I went to this location because it's easy to get in and out, despite being on a busy corner. It was my second visit, and the first one was average. The woman who assisted me on my first visit was not very friendly, but she was helpful and professional. On my second visit, a different woman helped me, and she was also helpful, knowledgeable, and professional. I realized that both women were not rude, just quiet. They didn't engage in small talk but answered all my questions. My second visit deserved 5 stars because the woman went above and beyond to help me ship a skateboard that I couldn't box correctly. She offered more assistance than required and I will return to this location for all my shipping needs. The store is clean, packed with products in a small space. The staff is knowledgeable and they provide boxes, packing materials, and copying services. While you may not get a big smile or much small talk, the level of service is exceptional in my opinion.

input: I had chicken BBQ burritos with all kinds of stuff that I like. I love the it ! Good place to sit down with family & had a meal. I wish they had a place for kids to play that would be even better !
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I enjoyed a delicious chicken BBQ burrito with various toppings that I love at a family-friendly restaurant. While I appreciate the dining experience, I would have liked it even more if they had a designated area for children to play.

input: We stopped here for my Chai and Hubby's coffee and caffeine mania. The line went quite fast, they're quick with the service especially not a lot of people at the time. My Chai came out good, awesome! One thing I forgot to do is to purchase more coffee for the house. They have lots for sale. But not too worry because we still have plenty of Starbucks coffee at home. What would life be without Starbucks?
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We stopped here for Chai and coffee. The service was quick, as there weren't many people. My Chai was good, but I forgot to buy more coffee. They have plenty for sale, but it's not a problem since we still have lots of Starbucks at home. Can't imagine life without it.

input:
It's a young start up company. Patience is a virtue.
Many in the gun community lack this virtue, so be it.
Owner seems to be a stand up guy and has stood by his word in my dealings with him.
I met the owner, Jacob, at a gun show in Las Vegas where I purchased a Cerakoted billet lower.
Pretty quality work on the machining and Cerakote job.
Traded emails with the owner and always got a quick response with the information I requested.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The start-up company is run by owner Jacob, who seems to be trustworthy and reliable. I personally met Jacob at a gun show in Las Vegas where I bought a high-quality Cerakoted billet lower. The machining and Cerakote job were excellent. Whenever I reached out to Jacob via email, I always received a prompt and informative response. It is worth noting that many individuals in the gun community lack patience.

input: Very impressed with this place, particularly the menu (amazing) and the food. We ordered the fruit bruschetta (yum, what an awesome idea!) and the Popeye skillet and the Roadhouse sw. Great food, creative options! Couple areas of critique: it was FREEZING (every woman had a sweater on in July) and lack of ambiance. The latter could be easily remedied with some decent background music, and better lighting? (Overhead office lighting is a drag, but large windows a plus) Customer service was good not great, tad disconnected...but it was a holiday weekend. Overall, a keeper. I'll def be back!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Impressed with the place and menu. Fruit bruschetta and Popeye skillet and Roadhouse sw were great. Lack of ambiance and freezing temperatures were issues. Some background music and better lighting would help. Customer service was good, but slightly disconnected. Overall, a keeper. Will definitely return.

input: Great job on my fill and gel pedicure. Even though it was close to closing, they took their time and even accommodated every request I had (I'm VERY particular). Clean environment and very friendly staff. Way more than I could have expected for a nail salon in a mall. P.S. My foot and hand massages afterwards were heavenly. I will DEFINITELY be back!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Excellent service for my fill and gel pedicure. Despite being close to closing time, the staff took their time and fulfilled all my specific requests. The environment was clean and the staff was friendly. Surprisingly, the level of service exceeded my expectations for a nail salon in a mall. The foot and hand massages that followed were heavenly. I will definitely return in the future!

input: I can't recall the day I went but it was a memorial resturant experience.  I was greeted by an incredibly nice cashier. After a hard decision I ordered a Devils delight and the girl giggled ( of course I was confused) She explained it was Dev's Delight and named after her because it was her idea for a burger and me calling it Devils delight was a bit funny because her friends call her Devil Dev ( hard to believe such a nice girl could aquire such a nickname but cute). After she took my thorough of a medium burger, and truffle fires i didn't have to wait very long. Even before I ate the burger the smell it self had my mouth watering.  The burger was cooked to perfection and what was on the burger was amazing!  This burger was a standard beef foundation with mozzarella cheese tomato basil and a portobello mushroom, what great idea for a burger! For a mushroom lover this with a side of the delicious truffle fries is perfect. Excellent quality and service,  a bit expensive but worth every penny. No question about it I will be a return customer!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a memorable restaurant experience at a memorial restaurant. The cashier was incredibly nice and I ordered a burger called Devils Delight. The cashier, who friends call Devil Dev, giggled and explained the name. The burger was cooked to perfection with a beef foundation, mozzarella cheese, tomato basil, and a portobello mushroom. As a mushroom lover, this burger with truffle fries was perfect. The food had excellent quality and the service was great, though it was a bit expensive. I will definitely be returning as a satisfied customer.

input: I was trying to find a decent place for dinner tonight for my moderately health conscious self when I came across this place. After figuring out what I wanted and put the Be My Bison burger in my cart for the online order, I realized it would be over a two mile round trip excursion from my job. Defeated, I started to search elsewhere but I could not get that burger off of my mind. I came back a few hours later and submit my order. I hiked it there and it just came out of the kitchen as I walked in.  I grabbed my burger and continued on my way back to work. O-M-G! Absolutely in love with this place. It has been quite the task to try and find healthy places that fit my diet but this is a dream come true! Thank You!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I found a great place for dinner tonight that caters to my moderate health-consciousness. After considering my options, I decided to order the Be My Bison burger online. Although it was a bit inconvenient due to the two-mile round trip from my job, I couldn't stop thinking about it. Eventually, I placed the order and made the trek. Fortunately, the burger was ready when I arrived. I quickly grabbed it and headed back to work. Needless to say, I was absolutely amazed by this place. It's been a challenge to find healthy options that align with my diet, but this place is a dream come true. Thank you!

input:
this place was awful. the first time my mother and I went we were very excited because everyone had been talking about it and we want to support local business. The day we went it happened to be pouring raining. So we are standing there at the hostess stand cold and wet waiting to be seated. Not only was the hostess not there, no one even acknowledged that we were there. The bartender who was right next to he stand was on his blue tooth and only looked our way to flirt with me. My mom was so annoyed we just left. 

The second time we went was because we were going to be in the area and we decided to give it a second try. We were seated right away and the music was really good. The waiter could have cared less about our table. he acted like we were doing him a favor by even coming to the table. The menu was thin and nothing to really choose from. when he eventually brought the food it was decent. My mom hated her salmon cakes because they were overly breaded and poorly season. it honestly looked like two pieces of bread. 

It was overpriced for what we had. I WOULD NEVER RECOMMEND THIS PLACE. The take out makes great dog food though.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
This place was awful. The first time my mother and I went, we were excited to support a local business, but it ended up being a disappointing experience. We arrived on a rainy day and had to wait at the hostess stand, cold and wet. Neither the hostess nor anyone else acknowledged our presence. The bartender, who was nearby, was preoccupied with his Bluetooth headset and only seemed interested in flirting with me. Frustrated, my mom and I left.

We decided to give the place a second chance when we happened to be in the area again. This time, we were promptly seated and enjoyed the good music. However, the waiter showed complete indifference towards our table, making us feel like we were inconveniencing him. The menu was limited and not very appealing. The food itself was decent when it eventually arrived, but my mom was disappointed with her overly breaded and poorly seasoned salmon cakes, which looked more like two pieces of bread.

Considering the lackluster experience and the prices, I would never recommend this place. However, their take-out food can be repurposed as dog food, which is a positive aspect.

input: Service was good. Mesquite wings are very good  best to share or save some don't be greedy like me and try.and go back to work. Only downside was the weak lemonade. It was the weakest I ever had.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The service was good and the mesquite wings were excellent. They are best to share or save some for later instead of being greedy like me and trying to go back to work. The only downside was the weak lemonade, as it was the weakest I have ever had.

input:
I don't know how I lucked out with having this taqueria in our neighborhood, but this is the best Mexican food you'll get in New Orleans.

We discovered Taqueria Guerrero after finding that burrito joint down the street was packed, had a line wrapping around the buidling (you know which one!).

After finding street parking near the mattress store, we plopped down and ordered the 3-taco plate (al pastor, mmmm) with beans and rice on the side and a burrito (barbocoa). I am a creature of habit and order the same tacos, but the bf has ventured out to get other dishes such as the fajita plate or the really spicy shrimp (camarones del diablo?). All very tasty.

The rest is history. It's embarrassing how often I suggest this place when we want to go out/get take out.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Taqueria Guerrero is the best Mexican food in New Orleans. We discovered it after the burrito place down the street was packed. We ordered the 3-taco plate (al pastor) with beans and rice, and a burrito (barbocoa). The bf has tried other dishes like the fajita plate and spicy shrimp. I suggest this place frequently when we want to go out or get takeout.

input:
Came here with a group of 15 people on a Tuesday night. We had reserved a space in advance. 
While the food was good, what was lacking was good service and cleanliness. We sat down at our table and it was sticky, and there was a dirty and also sticky fork still on it...so the assumption was that the table simply hadn't been wiped down all the way. Yuck. 
We ordered and the food took a fair amount of time, understandable because of such a large party. Problem was, when the food came out, no server knew what we'd individually ordered, so it became a huge mix up with people eating others' food. 
I ordered the pork belly tacos which had a great caramelization on the outside and tender inside. I also ordered the spicy beef pho, which was perfectly balanced with flavor after adding the accompanying bean sprouts and limes. 
The wait for the check and processing payment was long and arduous, a problem again because we had a Lyft driver waiting outside for us. 
All in all, go for the food, not for the service.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Visited with a group of 15 people on a Tuesday night, having reserved a space in advance. Although the food was good, the service and cleanliness were lacking. Our table was sticky and had a dirty fork on it, suggesting inadequate cleaning. When the food arrived, there was confusion as servers didn't know our individual orders, resulting in a mix-up. I enjoyed the pork belly tacos with great caramelization and tender inside, as well as the well-balanced spicy beef pho with bean sprouts and limes. The wait for the check and payment was long, causing inconvenience as our Lyft driver waited outside. Overall, recommend for the food, not the service.

input:
