The guy called me back, told me he was making the pizza in a rush and wasn't charging me for it. 20 minutes later he came to the door himself with my Fresh, hot pizza and 2 brownies all for free. 
He was very apologetic. Customer service was fantastic and food was awesome. This is my new go to delivery joint.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: First time trying pizza today, ordered online. There was a slight system error, causing a delay in my order. However, the employee called me back, apologized, and rushed to make the pizza at no charge. He personally delivered it along with two free brownies. Excellent customer service and delicious food. This is now my preferred delivery place.

input: Came here for my 21st birthday dinner with my family and had a great experience! The food and drinks were to die for, but they were extremely overpriced. Even though the quality of food was good, I still don't think it was worth what we paid for. I recommend getting the lobster mac and cheese as an appetizer, it was probably the best mac and cheese I've ever eaten. At the end of the meal, they gave us some small complimentary desserts, even though we ordered a bunch of desserts to top off our meal. Had a great time, but definitely overpriced.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Celebrated my 21st birthday with family at this restaurant and had an overall great experience. The food and drinks were amazing, but quite expensive. Although the quality was good, we felt it wasn't worth the price. A standout dish was the lobster mac and cheese, the best I've ever had. Surprisingly, they still offered us complimentary desserts despite ordering several. Enjoyed the evening, but found it to be overpriced.

input:
I like this place a lot. I stopped in once with friends for drinks and was eager to return for food. We finally did over the weekend. 

The ambience is very nice -- somehow ideal for both a fun date as well as for a beer and sports crowd. 

I love the open kitchen. 

Great beer selection. 

I'll definitely return for the rosemary fries, and my fiancée will return for the very good house burger.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I really enjoy this place. I visited once with friends for drinks and couldn't wait to come back for food. The atmosphere is great for both a romantic date and a lively sports bar. The open kitchen is a standout feature that I love. They have an impressive selection of beers. The rosemary fries are a must-try and my fiancée loved their delicious house burger. I will definitely be returning.

input:
If you are going for the food, I would give it 5 stars, but since this is a brewhouse, I only gave it 3. 

I ordered the light flight since we went for lunch and I wasn't looking for a heavy meal. The beer was OK at best. It was bland, a little strange in after taste and uninspired. Light beers dont have to equal tasteless. My boyfriend had a "hoppy beer with citrus undertones". He could taste neither the hops or the citrus  (disclaimer - we are from VT and are used to very hoppy beers!)  

Now the food - that was great. We went at lunch time and was able to get a soup and salad for 8.95. We both had the same thing - Chicken Bruchetta salad and French Onion Soup. The portion was fantastic for a lunch size and the soup really flavorful! 

For a lunch downtown it was great, but I would go for the brews...
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I gave the brewhouse 3 stars because I only went for the food. The beer was mediocre and uninspired, lacking in taste. The light flight was particularly bland. My boyfriend had a hopped citrus beer but couldn't taste either flavor. However, the food was great. We had a soup and salad combo for lunch, both the Chicken Bruchetta salad and French Onion Soup were delicious and the portion size was generous. Overall, it's a good spot for lunch downtown, but not for the beer.

input:
This place just opened up near rivers edge apartments. It's a boutique style taqueria with a menu that anyone can enjoy. The head chef was nominated for a James Beard Award and it shows in his flavorful and diverse menu choices! The restaurant has both an outdoor and indoor setting with double doors that allow access to both, with a bar around the corner. 

I personally have tried every taco on the menu as well as the appetizers! Each taco uses fresh local ingredients with an option for vegetarians and meat eaters like myself. My two favorites are the mushroom taco and the short rib taco, both have unique and fantastic flavors. But I would recommend trying them all, you will not be disappointed! Overall a great place for lunch or dinner! I will definitely be going back soon!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: There's a new boutique-style taqueria near Rivers Edge Apartments. The head chef is a James Beard Award nominee, and the menu is flavorful and diverse. The restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor seating, with a bar nearby. I've tried all the tacos and appetizers, and they use fresh local ingredients. I especially love the mushroom and short rib tacos, but all options are worth trying. It's a great spot for lunch or dinner, and I'll definitely visit again soon!

input: Originally, our little group headed to Franklin Fountain and the line was around the block-- Capofitto was only a few steps away with no line (and bonus--cheaper/better dessert treat!). We only popped in for gelato, but I would love to come back for the pizza! It looked and smelled really good. Gelato was amazing, as capogiro gelato always is. Highly recommend chocolat scurio and pera as a combo--it was perfect!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Initially, our group intended to visit Franklin Fountain, but there was a long line. Fortunately, Capofitto, just a few steps away, had no line and offered a tastier and more affordable dessert option. Although we only tried their gelato on this visit, the pizza at Capofitto looked and smelled fantastic, making me eager to return. The gelato, as expected from Capogiro, was incredible. I highly recommend trying the combination of chocolat scurio and pera flavors – it was a perfect choice.

input: This hospital is by far the best for families on the East Coast. They make seeing multiple MDs on the same day very easy and the quality of care is incredible. The renovated wing is fantastic with good accommodations for caregivers and friendly and attentive staff. I wholeheartedly recommend A.I. DuPont and will continue to travel from NY for my child's care.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: A.I. DuPont hospital is the top choice for families on the East Coast. They provide convenient scheduling for multiple MD appointments in one day, along with exceptional care. The recently renovated wing offers excellent caregiver accommodations and a supportive staff. I highly recommend A.I. DuPont and will continue traveling from NY for my child's healthcare.

input: I highly recommend this place! This was our first "Chef Tasting"! It was exquisite!! We had 9 courses and all were truly delicious. Wine was amazing. If you are in Philly, I highly recommend Vetri.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I highly recommend Vetri in Philly! Our first "Chef Tasting" experience was exquisite with 9 delicious courses. The wine was amazing too.

input:
I'm pretty sure this place has been open since before I was born and it's no surprise as to why. 

The absolute classic of an American diner, polite and attentive waitresses and most of their food made entirely from scratch. I would definitely say their fried chicken is the best I've had before, and fresh! Bottomless coffee too, for $1.75 which I think is quite reasonable. Nice pie, too :)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This long-standing American diner has been open for years and continues to be popular for good reason. With friendly and attentive wait staff, they serve a range of homemade dishes. Their fried chicken is the standout, consistently delicious and made with fresh ingredients. Additionally, they offer bottomless coffee for just $1.75, an affordable treat. Don't forget to try their delicious pie as well!

input: Don't go here. They gave me grief over the groupon then didn't bother to actually change my oil filter or tell me that they hadn't changed it so I drove 5k miles on an old filter. Crappy customer service, rude attitude, find somewhere better.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Avoid this place. They provided poor customer service and had a rude attitude. They didn't change my oil filter as promised with the groupon and failed to inform me about it. Consequently, I drove 5k miles with an old filter. Look for a better alternative.

input: I attended the #welldoneTBO tweet-up at Anthony's Coal Fired Pizza last week and had a great time. The folks at Anthony's were amazing with the customer service. We got to try so many menu items, and all were amazing. The Philly Cheesesteak Pizza was my 10 year old's favorite. I loved the Cauliflower pizza...so buttery and garlicky and delicious (vegetarian). We also got to try the carmelized onion-smothered wings which were out of this world. Also tasted: meatballs, ribs, salad...all very good. We ordered off the menu a half and half pizza with pepperoni, sausage and mushrooms. So good. If they had liquor on the menu I would have given them five stars (I'm just not a beer or wine person). Thanks for a great evening Anthony's! We'll be back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I attended the #welldoneTBO tweet-up at Anthony's Coal Fired Pizza last week. The customer service was amazing and we got to try a variety of delicious menu items, including the Philly Cheesesteak Pizza, which was a hit with my 10-year-old. My personal favorite was the Cauliflower pizza, it was buttery, garlicky, and delicious. The carmelized onion-smothered wings were also exceptional. In addition, we enjoyed meatballs, ribs, salad, and a half and half pizza with pepperoni, sausage, and mushrooms. The only thing missing was liquor on the menu. Overall, it was a great evening and we will definitely be returning.

input: Awesome service and food.  Served with a dry ice fog thing that add a layer of coolness to the whole experience.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great service, delicious food, and a unique touch with dry ice fog to enhance the overall experience.

input: Come here for delicious, home style New Orleans cuisine. We went in the afternoon, and although it was full, we were lucky and a table was ready right away. We did the a la carte as opposed to the buffet. It was our favorite meal of the trip!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Delight in delicious, home-style New Orleans cuisine. Despite the restaurant being crowded, we fortunately secured a table without delay during our afternoon visit. Opting for a la carte instead of the buffet, we savored our most cherished meal of the trip.

input: A great restaurant to take people visiting from out of town. Very popular for breakfast/brunch on the weekends. Should expect to wait at least an hour any time after 9:30 AM and service takes a little while. But great menu options and delicious food. Also a great bakery, coffee and gelato counter that offers instant service or items to enjoy while waiting to get called.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Highly popular for weekend breakfast/brunch, this restaurant is a fantastic choice to bring visitors from out of town. However, one should be prepared for a wait of at least an hour after 9:30 AM. Although service might take some time, the menu offers excellent options and delicious food. Additionally, there is a convenient bakery, coffee, and gelato counter that offers immediate service or treats to enjoy during the wait.

input:
The food is really good!! The service is less than average; I felt very rushed, unimportant, and cheated. Was shocked that the waitress withheld my coins when she gave me my change! Do they withhold change from all of their customers?!! Very disappointed.  Would she have done that to a well known food critic?

Will probably go back one more time eventually but will have lots of change with me to pay the EXACT amount! When it came time to give her tip, I applied the coins she withheld from me -they became part of her tip. Also, her tip dropped from my standard 25% to 15%. Flabbergasted.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food is really good, but the service is below average. I felt rushed, unimportant, and cheated when the waitress withheld my coins while giving me change. I was shocked by this behavior and wondered if she does it to all customers. This experience left me very disappointed. I might give it another try in the future, but I'll bring exact change with me. I used the withheld coins as part of her tip, which lowered my usual 25% tip to 15%. I was flabbergasted by the whole situation.

input: Their sushi is pretty good. Mesa rolls are my fav here. They would be 4stars if they gave better estimations for pick ups. It is typical that they lag a lot and they seem to make it after you show up.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The sushi at this place is good, especially the Mesa rolls, which are my favorite. However, their estimation for pick-up times could be improved. Typically, they tend to lag and often make the order after you have arrived. Overall, they would be a 4-star establishment if their pick-up estimations were better.

input: If you want The Best burger in Philly, this is the right place to come. The bread was fresh, meat was nothing but juicy, service was a amiable, price was descent and affordable to everybody!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: For the ultimate burger in Philly, this is the spot. Fresh bread, juicy meat, friendly service, and affordable prices - it's got it all!

input: Great hangout for wine, cheese, and some music outside.  Tried some of the food - bacon-wrapped dates & brussel sprouts - all unmemorable.  Also tried the sardines which smelled and tasted past their prime - sent back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great wine and cheese hangout with outdoor music. Disappointing food, particularly the bacon-wrapped dates, brussel sprouts, and sardines, which were returned due to being stale.

input:
Excellent tasting Po-Boys but it could have had mire catfish, pretty skimpy.
Service, very good.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great Po-Boys with excellent taste, but more catfish would have been better; portion was a bit skimpy. Service was very good.

input:
Define the worst Mediterranean food I have ever had.  The hummus appeared to have a good texture, that is the little bit I could see under the ocean of olive oil.  The pita bread was burned- not just over toasted, but black on the majority of the wedges.  I went home and was sick the rest of the evening from the amount of oil it had in it. 

The manager was probably the worst of the experience. He told my gf he would "upgrade her hummus for no charge, because normally it's $1.00" but said it as if he was doing us this huge favor.  He then continued to yell at us from across the restaurant after we sat down  (instead of coming up to our table and actually having a conversation) and says, "please let me know how your food is because that's the only way I can know if we are doing a good job or not is when customers tell me."  But we agreed that the vibe he gave off would not be that of open mindedness and gratitude if we were to say anything about his plate of olive oil, er I mean hummus.  There is also a sign that advertises the "cleanest bathroom in town".... Ehhhh ok, good to know for our next road trip.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The worst Mediterranean food I ever had had several issues. The hummus was drowned in an excessive amount of olive oil, making it hard to even see the texture. The pita bread was burnt, almost entirely black on most of the wedges. The high oil content made me sick for the rest of the evening. Additionally, the manager's behavior worsened the experience. He condescendingly offered to "upgrade" my girlfriend's hummus for free, as if it was a generous gesture. Instead of approaching our table, he yelled at us from afar, requesting feedback on the food as his only way of evaluating their performance. We decided it was best not to mention the overwhelming oil in the hummus as his attitude didn't seem open to feedback. Furthermore, they advertised having the "cleanest bathroom in town," which was not particularly relevant to our dining experience.

input: Great bagels!  I wish they stayed open later in the day though.  Staff not very friendly but the bagels are worth it!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Bagels are great, but I wish they had longer hours. Friendly staff is lacking, but the bagels are worth it.

input:
This hotel was fantastic. I was in town for a week, working at my company's PA office in Wayne. Great location and easy to get in and out. Hotel staff was very friendly. Room was immaculately cleaned and very spacious for just one person. Kitchenette was fully stocked with dishes, silverware, utensils, a small dishwasher and a full size fridge. Windows surrounding the king size bed were great- lots of natural light. I liked that opting out of housekeeping got me a $5 credit at the restaurant. 

The pool is small but no one was there the two times I went to use the hot tub. The bar has a decent drink selection, although I was bummed they were out of mint and couldn't make a mojito (which was on the drink menu). Burger was okay. Dessert was mediocre (but free with my $5 credit, so nbd). Omelet station was a nice touch in the AM. Coffee frequently had coffee grounds in it/was very weak, but the breakfast spread overall was nice.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
This hotel in Wayne was fantastic. The location was great and easy to access. The hotel staff was friendly and the room was impeccably cleaned and spacious. The kitchenette had everything I needed, including a dishwasher and a full-size fridge. The windows around the king-size bed provided ample natural light. Opting out of housekeeping gave me a $5 credit at the restaurant.

The pool was small but not crowded when I went to use the hot tub. The bar had a decent drink selection, although they were out of mint for my desired mojito. The burger was okay and the dessert was mediocre, but it was free with my $5 credit. The omelet station in the morning was a nice touch, although the coffee sometimes had grounds and was weak. Overall, the breakfast spread was enjoyable.

input: Decent falafel wrap...but not exactly cheap. And the cave-like sitting area was cold and uninviting. There are better choices in Manayunk.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The falafel wrap is decent but not cheap. The sitting area feels cold and uninviting, resembling a cave. There are better options available in Manayunk.

input: This place was awesome! I am driving cross country and hit a busted tire on the road and something came off the bottom of my car.  I called and Brian told me to come in and he would take a look.  They put my car up right away and patched things up. He was really nice and had me on my way in less than 30 minutes.  Definitely recommend this place.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place was amazing! While driving cross country, I had a flat tire and something fell off my car. I contacted Brian, who quickly invited me to bring my car in for inspection. They promptly attended to my car, fixed everything, and Brian was extremely friendly. I was back on the road in less than 30 minutes. Highly recommend this place!

input: Friday, July 22 we decided to give this eatery a try.  It is definitely in a great location especially if you want to explore the Quarter afterwards.  We were a party of 8 people and out of the 8 dishes ordered only 2 were really good --the jambalaya and file gumbo were very tasty.  The other dishes --red beans/rice,  meatloaf, Mac and cheese,  shrimp po boy, and chicken wings were bland and a waste of money.  The staff was nice but overall the food was mediocre.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: On Friday, July 22, we decided to try this eatery, which is conveniently located, especially if you want to explore the Quarter afterwards. Our party of 8 ordered 8 dishes, and unfortunately, only the jambalaya and file gumbo were delicious. The red beans and rice, meatloaf, Mac and cheese, shrimp po boy, and chicken wings were bland and not worth the money. The staff was pleasant, but overall, the food was mediocre.

input: According to my experience, there is just one place in Tokyo at the fish market where you get your seafood a little fresher. Here in Santa Barbara, it does not get any fresher. Right from the fish tank in the cooking pot on your plate. Don't expect a fancy restaurant with a nice ambiance because this is not the reason you come here (though the outside seating has a nice ocean/harbor view). It is the variety of fresh shellfish prepared according to your appetite and taste buds. The wait can be long during peak hours but it is worth it. Put your name down and take a walk on the peer to free-up some extra room in your stomach - you'll need it!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: There is only one place in Tokyo's fish market where you can get seafood that is even slightly fresher. However, in Santa Barbara, the seafood cannot get any fresher. It goes straight from the fish tank to the cooking pot and onto your plate. While the restaurant lacks fancy ambiance, the outdoor seating does offer a pleasant ocean/harbor view. The real draw here is the wide variety of freshly prepared shellfish that will satisfy any appetite and taste buds. Expect a potentially long wait during peak hours, but it is definitely worth it. Leave your name and take a stroll on the pier to make room in your stomach - you'll need it!

input: I've always had good experiences here. The food is creative and tasty and the house wines are decent. Their cocktails are well made but small. I've never had a problem with service but also haven't been here during a super busy time. The patio is a great spot to hang out with friends.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Overall, this place has always provided positive experiences with creative and tasty food, decent house wines, and well-made, albeit small, cocktails. Service has been consistently good, although it's worth noting that I haven't visited during peak hours. Moreover, the patio is a fantastic spot for socializing with friends.

input:
tldr; Huge plates of food. Cheap. Delicious. Get the banana pecan pancakes.

Skyway Jacks is now Skyway Cafe. Same great food and service. I love the bovine decor. It really makes it feel homey. This is the kind of place that you think about when you imagine a local diner (at least my opinion of one). Everything I've eaten has been awesome. The service is good and the coffee keeps coming. 

They have a morning breakfast deal between 7 and 830 am. $2.89 for 5 different combinations such as 2 eggs, pancakes and sausage (when you buy a beverage). I might have to start grabbing a little breakfast before work!

Seriously, though.... get the banana pecan pancakes. You can thank me later.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Skyway Jacks is now Skyway Cafe, offering the same great food and service. The bovine decor creates a cozy atmosphere, embodying the essence of a local diner. The meals are huge, cheap, and delicious. The breakfast deal offers various combinations for just $2.89 from 7 to 8:30 am. Don't miss out on the delectable banana pecan pancakes.

input:
Worst experience ever!!!! 

I stood in line today for 1 hour and 20 minutes for 1 shot. They the walked up in front of me and closed the line. Told me they were done and leaving. There were 60 people behind me outraged as well. F*** this place
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Terrible experience today! Waited 1 hour and 20 minutes in line for 1 shot, then they closed the line just as they reached me. They said they were done and leaving, leaving 60 people behind me outraged. Absolutely frustrated with this place.

input: Good luck finding anyone to help you.  Poor poor customer service.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Customer service is lacking and assistance may be difficult to find.

input:
On my first day in New Orleans, I walked to Fair Grinds for a caffeine boost. It was a beautiful afternoon, and a handful of people were scattered around the shop and the outdoor seating area, working on laptops and visiting with friends. 

I ordered a small cold brew with vanilla, easy on the ice. I added a hunk of gluten free zucchini bread (the bread butt; the best part!) to my order and paid with a credit card. They have a fancy touchscreen register that lets you add tip to your card purchase. 

I topped off my drink with whole milk -- which in itself was a real treat. It's so rare to see whole milk at the mixing station! 

Before leaving, I asked what else they had in the way of a GF offering, and the young man behind the counter said "just the zucchini bread." That's a real bummer; the zucchini bread is great but I'd love to have more than one option. 

My drink was smooth and had a perfect flavor. I was happy with my choices. 

If I lived in the neighborhood, I'd be here all the time. I like the hipstery feeling of this place, and everything I've ordered has been delightful.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: On my first day in New Orleans, I walked to Fair Grinds for a caffeine boost. The shop had a few people on laptops and outside seating area. I ordered a small cold brew with vanilla and a piece of gluten-free zucchini bread. Paid with a credit card using their touchscreen register. The drink had whole milk, a rare find. I asked about other GF options, but they only had the zucchini bread. Despite that, I enjoyed my drink and the hipstery atmosphere.

input: This place is so lovely! I went for a sweet and was amazed at the variety. The gooey butter cookies were awesome and the German chocolate cupcake simply amazing!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is lovely! The variety of sweets amazed me - the gooey butter cookies were awesome and the German chocolate cupcake was simply amazing!

input:
Decent frozen yogurt with a lot of options for toppings. They have about 8 different froyo flavors to chose from. Lots of possible combinations. However, it can get expensive pretty quickly when you weigh the cup. 

There's not a lot of seating inside. Staff is friendly but not very active. I do want to try their bubble tea, but j wasn't very impressed.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Good frozen yogurt options with a variety of toppings. Offers 8 different flavors for froyo with numerous combinations. However, it can become costly when weighed by the cup. Limited seating inside. Friendly staff, though not particularly attentive. Bubble tea was underwhelming.

input:
I loved this place!  We drove down from Tahoe just to eat here!  The 90 miles round trip was worth it!  The food was that good!  The Chicken Basil was the best!  And they have good Boba Tea!

Don't believe the nay-sayer about this place.  The food was pretty authentic Taiwanese.  Try it and see for yourself!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I loved this place! We drove 90 miles round trip from Tahoe just for the delicious food - it was definitely worth it! The Chicken Basil was the best, and they also serve good Boba Tea. Ignore the nay-sayers, the food here is pretty authentic Taiwanese. Give it a try and see for yourself!

input:
Cru is such a cute quaint wine bar! In the front is a wine store and in the back ins the wine bar. The wine bar area is small but had a very modern atmosphere.

I started off with the Vina Vino wine flight and my friends ordered The Bold and the Beautiful. Both came on a cute wood/chalkboard board with the wine written in chalk. All the wines were very tasty but the Vespucci  Primitivo and the Il Fauno di Arcanum were my favorite.

We then ordered the fig jam and prosciutto, bleu cheese, arugula flatbread. A little heavy on the blue cheese for my liking but overall was really good. We also ordered the Farmers Platter. You can choose anything from 1-7 items and build your plate from a variety of cheese and meats. We selected the Brillat-Savarin, Cypress Grove "Purple Haze", Blue Brie, Spressata and the Italian Speck. The farmers plate also came with jam, mustard,  caramelized nuts and crostini. The Farmers plate by far was my favorite!

Overall I really liked CRU. Its cute, quaint and cozy. Can't wait to come back!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: CRU is a cute, quaint wine bar with a wine store in the front and a small, modern atmosphere in the back. I tried the Vina Vino wine flight and my friends ordered The Bold and the Beautiful, served on a wood/chalkboard board. The Vespucci Primitivo and the Il Fauno di Arcanum were my favorite wines. We also enjoyed the fig jam and prosciutto, bleu cheese, arugula flatbread, despite the heavier blue cheese flavor. We built our own plate with selections from the Farmers Platter, including Brillat-Savarin, Cypress Grove "Purple Haze", Blue Brie, Spressata, and Italian Speck, along with jam, mustard, caramelized nuts, and crostini. The Farmers plate was my favorite part of the experience. Overall, CRU is a cute, cozy spot that I can't wait to return to.

input: Great spot I've been coming here for years. Top 3 steaks in the city! Nothing has changed even after the name change. Try a chicken cheesesteak for something different
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is great! I've been a loyal customer for years. They serve the top 3 steaks in the city, and even after changing their name, the quality remains unchanged. If you want something different, give their chicken cheesesteak a try.

input:
Pina's is easily one of the mroe underated places to eat in Roxborough. They have great stromboli (which are HUGE) and thier sicilian pie is the best I have every had. Sandwiches and pizza are just ok. 

I stopped ina two occassions for a sit down dinner and came away very stisfied and full. Ordered the chicken park with was a huge chickem covered in cheese and sauce. Excellent.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Pina's in Roxborough is an underrated place to eat with delicious food options. Their stromboli, known for their generous portion size, is great, and their sicilian pie is the best the reviewer has ever had. However, the sandwiches and pizza are only okay. The reviewer had a satisfying and filling experience on two separate occasions, particularly enjoying the chicken park dish, which featured a large chicken covered in cheese and sauce and was excellent.

input: It may be a bit pricey, but it's good food in the cafe and a good selection in the grocery. I love their vegan sandwich and tofu melt and they always have a great selection of vegan sweets.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite the higher cost, the café offers delicious food and the grocery store provides a wide range of options. I particularly enjoy their vegan sandwich, tofu melt, and the ample assortment of vegan desserts available.

input:
These guys are awesome! Best burger restaurant in New Orleans. Service was on point, they made sure we had our food in a timely manner and food is fresh. We flew in from Atlanta, And this is the first place we went to. And we will definitely be back before we leave. 

My friends ordered the Gator burger and the deer burger. I personally ordered the buffalo wings, which was very good. We left super happy! Btw they're drinks are very good too!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is amazing! Best burger spot in New Orleans. The service was excellent, making sure our food arrived quickly and fresh. We came straight here after flying in from Atlanta and will definitely return before we leave. My friends tried the Gator and deer burgers, while I enjoyed the delicious buffalo wings. We left extremely satisfied and the drinks were also great!

input:
Went here with my boyfriend and we loved it!
Old school feeling, with 3 floors!!

We have been here twice, and each time was great!
The food was amazing, I got the veal since it had been recommended to me, as well as the clams casino, mussles, pasta with oil and garlic, and the home-made garlic bread. Staff was nice and helpful!

...Went here again recently while in the area and had this new dish of gnocchi with gorgonzola sauce in it, and it was delicious!!!!! My new favorite dish as this place. 

MUST EAT!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My boyfriend and I loved this place! It has an old school feeling with 3 floors. We have been here twice and each time was great. The food was amazing, especially the recommended veal, clams casino, mussels, pasta with oil and garlic, and the homemade garlic bread. The staff was nice and helpful. I recently tried their new dish of gnocchi with gorgonzola sauce and it was absolutely delicious! It has become my new favorite dish at this place. A must eat!

input:
First impression:

Home Wine Kitchen's "No Menu Monday" is a must-try for anyone interested in the St. Louis fine dining scene or good food more generally.  We came prepared with reservations, but the restaurant actually began quieting out while our delicious meal was ramping up; the tables offer more elbow room than the photographs online belie.  As the name of the evening suggests, no menu is in play here; you'll let your friendly server know if you have any food allergies or particular preferences, and before long watch your customized meal unfold.  That's a three-course meal, $30, plus $12 for three half-glass wine pairings.

As starters, we were served lamb meatballs -- likely the favorite of the night -- and goat cheese-stuffed poblano peppers.  The peppers had a good bit of spice offset by the chalkiness of the goat cheese, making an excellent pairing for my Soave (white wine).  The mains were a corvina fish delicately cooked in wax paper and a swordfish steak served over asparagus with homegrown tomatoes and "love sauce."  The corvina came out on the rarer side, perhaps a little too complex for this Midwesterner's palate, but the hearty swordfish was some of the best seafood I've tasted in Missouri.  Dessert comprised a champagne gelatin and a chocolate tart, both of which were topped by fluffy homemade whipped cream and quickly eaten.

The staff at Home Wine Kitchen made our visit pleasant, acting casual yet professional during our meal.  The restaurant patrons seemed to be largely industry types that oohed and aahed about the cuisine (perhaps a trifle self-importantly, but this Yelper is no saint himself).  I was surprised to note that other diners were served the same courses as we were (albeit in different configurations), when I was under the assumption there would be a little more variation; however, I can only imagine the challenge such an endeavor would pose to the talented kitchen.  The interior, lighting, and volume here were all very good.

By the end of the evening, we realized that putting yourself in the hands of the chef is not for the faint of heart, as evidenced by one conversation near us during the meal that all but stopped when a beautiful whole fish was served to the table.  Leaving the restaurant, I was glad that I had tried No Menu Monday, but did wonder what the meal would have been like had I ordered off the menu.  I guess that calls for a return visit, don't you?
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Home Wine Kitchen's "No Menu Monday" is a must-try for anyone interested in the St. Louis fine dining scene. The restaurant offers a customizable three-course meal for $30, with the option to add three half-glass wine pairings for $12. The starters included lamb meatballs and goat cheese-stuffed poblano peppers, both delicious. The main dishes were corvina fish and swordfish steak, with the swordfish being the standout. Dessert consisted of a champagne gelatin and a chocolate tart, both topped with homemade whipped cream. The staff was friendly and professional. The interior, lighting, and volume were all well-done. While some may prefer ordering off a menu, trying the chef's creations is a worthwhile experience.

input:
Went here with a few friends as the place to have our reunion dinner. We hadn't seen eachother since elementary school and got reacquainted through Facebook so this was a pretty special dinner. 

The restaurant is very swanky and the prices show this. I do think the food was worth the price although all of my party thought it was very expensive. I ordered the lobster bake which was delicious. It was not fantastic and there wasn't alot of seafood but it was adequate for me. I also ordered a Neopolitan Old Fashion which was made perfectly. 

My friends ordered the fritters, carpaccio, crab cake and fries. Plus 2 shots of tequila, a lemonade and 2 more old fashions. Bill was $170 which is not bad but some of my friends weren't expected it. 

And I must say something about our waiter. Unfortunately, I didn't remember his name but he was fantastic! Very attentive, nice and even bought out a dessert because it was also one of my friend's bday. He was just real cool. 

5 stars for service
3 stars for food
4 stars for ambience 
2 stars for price.  

But I was satisfied.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Had a special reunion dinner with friends at a swanky, albeit pricey, restaurant. The lobster bake was delicious but lacking in seafood. The Neopolitan Old Fashion was perfectly made. Friends ordered fritters, carpaccio, crab cake, and fries, accompanied by shots of tequila, lemonade, and more old fashions. Bill was $170, surprising some friends. The unnamed waiter provided excellent service, even surprising with a dessert for a friend's birthday. 5 stars for service, 3 stars for food, 4 stars for ambience, and 2 stars for price. Overall, I was satisfied.

input: My first trip to Susanna Foo was at 6 months old when the restaurant was still a hole-in-the-wall takeout joint owned by Susanna's parents. My parents have been taking my brother and I ever since. I have many fond memories of Susanna fashioning dolls for us out of the linen napkins and preparing Chicken with Cashew Nuts when we refused to eat anything else. The food has always been reliable, but now that I am an adult, I find it lacking excitement. The service is always impeccable and I have never been disappointed by the overall decor or ambience. I'd like to see Susanna improve upon some of her traditional recipes by either adding new flavors or perhaps returning to her Chinese roots with a more ethnic menu. I'm hoping there will be a revitalization and that I will come to love Susanna Foo as much as I did as a child.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I first visited Susanna Foo with my family when I was just 6 months old, back when it was a small takeout place owned by Susanna's parents. We've been going ever since, and I have fond memories of Susanna creating dolls for us from linen napkins and making Chicken with Cashew Nuts when we were picky eaters. The food has been consistently good, but as an adult, I find it lacks excitement. Nonetheless, the service is always excellent and the ambience and decor never disappoint. I hope Susanna can enhance her traditional recipes by adding new flavors or exploring her Chinese roots with a more diverse menu. I look forward to a revitalization and rekindling my childhood love for Susanna Foo.

input: I am from California and was looking for something besides the hotel dining room to have dinner at.  I usually use the Yellow Pages to find restaurants and judge them by the size of their ads.  Spiro's jumped out at me, not because of the size of their advertisement (small) but Greek food just sounded good to me tonight.  I wasn't disappointed at all.  The Greek lemon soup was excellent and I liked the Moussaka, although the waiter suggested the Sea Bass.  All in all, the dinner was terrific and if I am back in this area, I will head to Spiro's again.  Thanks Neil for the wonderful service!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I am from California and wanted to try a different dining option than the hotel. I usually use the Yellow Pages and judge restaurants by their ad size. Spiro's caught my attention due to its small ad, but the idea of Greek food appealed to me. I was pleasantly surprised as the Greek lemon soup was excellent and the Moussaka was to my liking. Although the waiter recommended the Sea Bass, I was still satisfied with my choice. Overall, the dinner at Spiro's was fantastic and I will definitely return if I come back to this area. Thank you, Neil, for the great service!

input: I'm a Barbecue judge and this ain't barbecue.  Not in Texas, not in the southeast.  Not in KC.  An earlier reviewer nailed it perfectly.  The brisket is fatty pot roast.  No evidence of smoke.  Mushy texture like long braised  meat.  My sandwich was 75 percent fat.  Big meatless chunks of fat.  Either the owner doesn't care or he's left the place in the hands of employees who don't know any better. Sorry.  But you can do much better elsewhere.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: As a barbecue judge, I can confidently say that this place does not serve authentic barbecue. It falls short in Texas, the southeast, and even in Kansas City. The brisket resembles fatty pot roast rather than true barbecue, lacking any smoky flavor. The texture is mushy, as if the meat has been braised for too long. My sandwich was predominantly fat, with large chunks devoid of meat. It seems like either the owner is indifferent or the staff lacks adequate knowledge. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this place when there are much better options available elsewhere.

input:
Our second favorite place to watch a sunset. It's way north of Tampa, so a bit of a drive. We love to join everyone to clap when the sun goes down...a wonderful way to end the day. 

The music is lively, as are the patrons. Don't expect to swim in the water, it's a rocky beach, not much sand. Have been taking our boys since they were babies...are fifteen now. The food and drinks don't make an impression either way, it's the view and atmosphere that draws you in. 

Never disappoints.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Our second favorite place to watch a sunset is located north of Tampa and requires a bit of a drive. It offers a lively atmosphere with music and patrons who join in clapping when the sun sets, providing a wonderful way to end the day. Although the beach is rocky with little sand for swimming, we have been taking our boys since they were babies, and they are now fifteen. While the food and drinks are not particularly noteworthy, it is the mesmerizing view and overall atmosphere that always leave a lasting impression. This place never disappoints.

input:
Obviously they are doing something right since they have been around since 1958. Great soft serve and scooped ice cream cones, boats, floats and sundaes.
Prices great too.  Enjoy!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: They've been around since 1958 and evidently doing things right. They offer delicious soft serve and scooped ice cream cones, boats, floats, and sundaes. In addition, their prices are affordable. Enjoy!

input: I decided to stop by since I was in the area and craving some authentic Mexican cuisine. I was literally by myself (late lunchtime on a tues) and really excited to try the pazole!! It was delicious ( granted my first and only time) I believe it's pork and has hominy, lettuce, radishes,onions and they give you a small container of dried oregano. Not the biggest fan of the lettuce cause it's gets all wilted but add some hot sauce and it's a meal in itself!!! I got also got the taco lunch special (2 pork tacos and rice) and that was good. Besides the amazing service from the sweet lady, the salsa was way sweet! Wasn't the biggest fan but everything is def fresh! And the pineapple water is a must. I don't like pineapples but I read reviews and just had to try it and thank u guys! Great reviews :) I'm excited to come back to try the burritos esp since I come out here for Costco shopping (soooo close by!) pretty dangerous when I find good food cause then I get cravings :/ enjoy this gem and eat up!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I stopped by a Mexican restaurant while in the area and craving authentic cuisine. I tried the pazole for the first time and it was delicious. It consists of pork, hominy, lettuce, radishes, onions, and dried oregano. The lettuce wasn't my favorite as it wilted easily, but adding hot sauce made it a satisfying meal. I also had the taco lunch special, which included 2 pork tacos and rice. The service was excellent, although the salsa was too sweet for my taste. Everything was fresh, and the pineapple water was a must-try, despite not being a fan of pineapples. I'm excited to return and try their burritos, especially since I often come to this area for Costco shopping. It's dangerous when I discover good food because it leads to cravings. Enjoy this hidden gem and indulge!

input:
by 3 stars, i really mean 3.5-

white brick walls, cool rustic furniture, seasoned, attractive employees. and the lighting is lovely.. nay, PERFECT. probably good for a blind date.  and service is good and timely.

but 3.5 could've been 4 if it wasn't so expensive for what i'm getting. and if the kitchen was more accommodating.

the first time i ever ate there, (around when it first opened), i ordered ravioli and received 3 or 5 pieces for $11-13.  another time i visited, i tried substituting a salad for fries with my burger. and my server said, "no, sorry, the kitchen won't do that." 

are you $^%ER@# kidding me??? it wasn't a super modification. it's not as if i asked for a burger with only one bun, no tomato, half piece of lettuce, two onion rings, and love. it wasn't like i wanted to substitute lobster for fries!!! needless to say, this is the first time i've been unable to substitute. i'm usually really easy to please, but this is the first time i've ever felt difficult. at least in my head. is this in my head?

unforgivable.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: 3.5 star rating for a restaurant with white brick walls, cool rustic furniture, and attractive employees. The lighting is perfect, making it great for a blind date. Service is good and timely. However, the expensive prices and lack of accommodation from the kitchen prevent it from being a 4 star rating. The portion sizes for dishes like ravioli were small for the price. Additionally, the kitchen refused to substitute a salad for fries, which was frustrating. This was the first time experiencing such inflexibility and left a negative impression.

input: I would eat here again, but mostly because it is an interesting destination in a town with a lot of bad restaurants. Great decor, noisy atmosphere, and funky vibe. Servers seem hip, but we were rushed through an inattentive service. (One of those dinners where you better ask for the check when you can because you don't know when you will see the waiter again). Note to Gluten Free folks, this place is not completely safe or knowledgeable and the GF buns were awful. The house catsup, which is apparently a thing here, is not GF. Note to anyone with a car: parking sucks.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I would eat here again due to the lack of good restaurants in town. The decor is great, but the atmosphere is noisy and the vibe is funky. The servers seem cool, however, the service was inattentive and rushed. Gluten Free individuals should be cautious as this place is not safe or knowledgeable, and the GF buns were terrible. The house catsup, a popular item, is also not GF. It's worth noting that parking is inconvenient for those with a car.

input: Good drinks and food. Had the pulled pork and fried chicken po boy. Mac and cheese was amazing. Very reasonable for the price. Great draft list as well. Serves food till1am.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great drinks and food, with a fantastic pulled pork and fried chicken po boy. The mac and cheese is amazing, and the prices are very reasonable. Additionally, they have a great draft list and serve food until 1am.

input: If you like to wait while several tables are open,  terrible service, a dirty restaurant, and very mediocre food that is overpriced for breakfast then you'll love this place! This was one of the worst breakfasts I've ever had. With First Watch around the corner and Pinky's up the street don't waste your time here. I know what you're thinking...but Todd First Watch and Pinky's are way more expensive....Bullsh#t. don't waste your time on this old broken down dump.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: If you enjoy waiting for multiple tables, experiencing terrible service and a dirty restaurant with overpriced, mediocre breakfast food, then this place is perfect for you! However, in my opinion, it was one of the worst breakfasts I've ever had. There are much better options nearby, such as First Watch and Pinky's, which may be perceived as more expensive but are definitely worth your time. Don't bother with this rundown establishment.

input:
So, I went back to El Arado on Monday with a group of six people. The staff seemed shocked about our 6 pm arrival, and "sanitized" a large table for us quickly. Yes, the table smelled like dirty sanitized rags, ugh, but, once you got buzzed on...I mean beyond, the smell, your waiter will appear and take your drink orders. 

We got beers and margaritas. The margarita drinker in the group declared that it "was good."  The prices for drinks weren't that bad.  ($2.95 for Mexican beers). 

We all ordered our food, which was brought out at a good time, fresh, and hot. Everyone snarfed - it was good and tasty and all our needs were met attentively by the quiet waiter. 

All of us were let satisfied, and our specific requests (i.e. "no beans" "light on the cheese") were met by the kitchen staff with no problems. We left with full bellies then went to the Red Garter for a mind-numbing strip club experience. 

What a way to wrap up a review..

El Arado has gotten a bad wrap - but, the staff is decent, the food wasn't too shabby and the drink prices are cheap. A good place to start out for affordable and filling eats before a night out in Fountain Square (or to strip clubs).
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I visited El Arado with a group of six people. Despite arriving at 6 pm, the staff accommodated us quickly. However, the table smelled like dirty sanitized rags. Once we got past the smell, we ordered drinks, including beers and margaritas. The margarita drinker in our group found it to be good. The prices for drinks were reasonable, with Mexican beers costing $2.95. The food was fresh, hot, and brought out in a timely manner. Our specific requests were met without any issues. Overall, we left satisfied and felt that El Arado is a decent place with affordable prices. It's a good option for a fulfilling meal before a night out in Fountain Square or visiting strip clubs.

input: The Loew's hotel is very clean and looks very nice. The service is amazing. My family and I wanted to stay for a whole month. The breakfast there is fantastic! My son said it looked like it was the future. That's how nice it was! The rooms were nice size and the parking is convenient. That's why I give the Loew's hotel 5 stars.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The Loew's hotel is exceptionally clean, with a pleasing aesthetic. The service provided is outstanding, prompting my family's desire to stay for an entire month. The breakfast offered is absolutely fantastic, with my son even remarking that it appeared futuristic. The rooms are spacious and the parking is conveniently accessible. For these reasons, I confidently award the Loew's hotel a five-star rating.

input:
Yayyy for honeygrow ! I honestly can 't believe it took me so long to try this place. It's awesome ! It is in the same complex as my gym and I always said I would give it a shot but didn't seem to make it over there. 

Well this past Tuesday it happened and I have a new spot to grab a healthy meal. I ordered the Sour Cherry BBQ stir fry with chicken instead of pork and parsley instead of shallots and it was amazing. Low calorie and OO so filling. While the line was long it went very quickly and my food was ready shortly after that. I love that you can order and pay right on the kiosk. 

The employees were friendly and efficient and all went smoothly. I'll definitely go back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I finally tried honeygrow and it's amazing! It's conveniently located near my gym. I ordered the Sour Cherry BBQ stir fry with chicken and parsley instead of shallots. It was low calorie and filling. Despite the long line, the service was efficient, and I loved the option to order and pay on the kiosk. The employees were friendly. I will definitely return.

input:
Pros:

-Superb cheeseburger - thick, evenly cooked, (almost) medium rare, nice sauce, soft bun
-Tasty (complimentary) zucchini bread
-Good service
-Good G+T selection
-Cool ambience
-Downstairs from my apartment

Pros:
- Superb cheeseburger with thick, evenly cooked, (almost) medium rare patty, delicious sauce, and soft bun
- Tasty complimentary zucchini bread
- Good service
- Great selection of G+Ts

input: Smokey (to be expected - minus a star as a non smoker with allergies), several dining options (prices varies), beverages (all sorts for a nominal fee, of course), hotel (pricey), parking (FREE), entertainment (various), ATM (scared for some people who may not have self control), and yes gambling (tip: don't gamble if you're bit willing to lose it). input: This place is disappointing for a 4.5 star rating. The burgers were so-so. The vibe felt very much like a chain restaurant like Red Robin. We did go on a Tuesday night so perhaps it's better on the weekends? Either way, we won't be back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place has a 4.5 star rating but is disappointing. The burgers were average and the atmosphere felt like a chain restaurant. Maybe it's better on weekends, but we won't be returning.

input: This is hands down my favorite brewery in The world!! My husband is from STL and every time we go back to visit his family we visit the brewery! Most recently, we didn't"Beer School" with some of our friends and it was AWESOME!! I would definitely recommend it! & if it's your first time visit do the Brewery tour first because seeing the Clydesdales and the ends and outs of this brewery was amazing!!! I can't wait to go back and do the "Brew Master"!! Until next time, Budweiser!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This is my favorite brewery in the world! Whenever we visit my husband's family in STL, we always make sure to go here. Recently, we attended the "Beer School" with friends and it was fantastic! I highly recommend it. For first-time visitors, I suggest starting with the Brewery tour to see the Clydesdales and learn about the brewery. I'm looking forward to going back and trying the "Brew Master" experience. Until next time, Budweiser!

input:
We arrived a few minutes early for a 7pm reservation. When we asked for our table, both hostesses looking at their paper, then said they'd have to go check and would be back. 5 minutes later, they returned and did not acknowledge us. Meanwhile, another large party arrived without a reservation and were told it would be a 40 minute wait. We then heard one hostess say to the other that she didn't want to seat them soon because the kitchen was backed up and people were waiting 40 minutes for their appetizers. So unprofessional.
We walked up again, after they continued to ignore us, and asked about our table. They weren't apologetic when they told us that the girl we spoke to earlier that day was new and never recorded our reservation. They continued to tell us that it would be at least a 20 minute wait before they could put our table together. We got a smug "I'm sorry, but she was new" and they brushed us off.
I really understand that sometimes things just don't go the way they were supposed to and that people make mistakes. However, a little customer service would have gone a long way. Offer us some water, or a seat at the bar or say that you're doing everything you can to get us in as soon as possible. They basically blew us off and blamed it on the new girl. 
Needless to say we left and I will not be returning.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We arrived early for a 7pm reservation, but both hostesses said they needed to check and left us waiting. After a 5-minute delay, they ignored us while seating another party without a reservation. We overheard one hostess mentioning a kitchen backlog causing lengthy appetizer waits. When we approached the hostesses again, they admitted the new girl hadn't recorded our reservation and told us to wait for at least 20 more minutes. Their apology lacked sincerity, and they failed to offer any form of customer service. Feeling ignored and brushed off, we decided to leave. I have no intention of returning.

input: Food was excellent but when asked to honor their yelp offer of 10% off our bill for checking in and reviewing their business, We were told that they would not honor the deal until our next visit even though the yelp countdown said we had 4 hours to redeem the deal. Great food, but bad business practice :(
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Food was great, but they refused to honor the Yelp offer of 10% off for checking in and reviewing their business. They claimed they would only honor it on our next visit, despite the Yelp countdown stating we had 4 hours left to redeem the deal. Disappointing business practice.

input:
I have only been here on a few occasions, mostly to send the random package, I like that this location has one of the automated machine (the post office closest to me does not...)

But what I wanted to highlight was the fantastic customer service my husband and I experienced when we went here to get our passport applications submitted, the representative we worked with was awesome. She was fast, friendly and knew exactly what needed to be done so we were in and out super quick! She even gave me the follow up forms and explained what I would need to do once I changed my name, perfect. I hope every experience here in the future is just as good. She should train everyone.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I have only been here a few times, mainly to send packages. What I like about this location is that it has an automated machine, unlike the post office closest to me. However, the highlight of my visit was the exceptional customer service my husband and I received when we came here to submit our passport applications. The representative we worked with was amazing. She was efficient, friendly, and knowledgeable. We were in and out very quickly because she knew exactly what needed to be done. She even provided me with follow-up forms and explained the process of changing my name. I hope all future experiences here are just as good. I strongly believe she should train everyone.

input: Oh my goodness if you ever want to start on a health "trip" this is the place to start. They have so many different vitamins (hence the name), healthy dietary supplements, beauty products and homeopathic items as well. The staff was super helpful in assisting me find some of the items i needed to make my very own moisturizer. They helped me locate the items they had and provided suggestions for items they did not have. They also have a rewards program for frequent shoppers - LOVE THAT! And they accept digital coupons- LOVE THAT TOO!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is perfect for starting a health journey. They offer various vitamins, dietary supplements, beauty products, and homeopathic items. The staff is incredibly helpful and assisted me in finding the products I needed, even providing suggestions for items they didn't have. They also have a rewards program for frequent shoppers and accept digital coupons.

input: I love this shoppe. I have been here a few times, but I have been coming more regularly. The staff is AWESOME and the atmosphere GREAT. THey have healthy tasty treats which is nice and a host of croissants and other tasty treats. They also have food for lunch and breakfast. I havent had anything here that wasnt fantabulous.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love this shoppe! I've been coming here regularly and the staff is awesome. The atmosphere is great and they offer a variety of healthy and tasty treats, including croissants and other delicious options. They also serve breakfast and lunch. I haven't had anything here that wasn't fantastic.

input: Great Cranberry Orange Muffin and Caffe Latte on a Saturday morning. Great ambience and fast service.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Enjoy a delightful Saturday morning with a delectable Cranberry Orange Muffin and a Caffe Latte. The atmosphere is great, and the service is quick.

input: My favorite place to eat sushi and the nicest people I know that work there! It'll always be my first choice and they have a great menu! It's always more than just good when you eat from there!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My favorite sushi place has the nicest staff and will always be my first choice. In addition to their great menu, the overall experience of eating there is always more than just good.

input: This might be my favorite coffee shop in the city. The food is unbelievable. Anything I have ordered has been fresh, delicious and so enjoyable. The place has a cool edgy vibe and lots of comfy seating and some great seats outside when the weather is nice. Definitely worth checking out especially if you want a some food as well.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This coffee shop is possibly my favorite in the city due to its amazing food, fresh and delicious, which I thoroughly enjoy. It has a cool edgy vibe, plenty of comfortable seating, and great outdoor seats for pleasant weather. It's definitely worth visiting, especially if you desire both coffee and food.

input: I absolutely love this place and think is easily the best burrito shop in town. Great salsas, relaxed atmosphere, excellent service and price,  Most importantly the burritos are delicious. The chicken and chorizo combo is  my personal favorite but the smoked brisket is great as well. The medium burrito is plenty unless you are training for an eating event.  Family owned, not a chain and it shows in the attention to flavor. Highest recommendation if you are interested in good, healthy food (unless you eat yourself into oblivion) at a reasonable price.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is the best burrito shop in town with amazing salsas, a relaxed atmosphere, excellent service, and good prices. The burritos are delicious, with the chicken and chorizo combo being a personal favorite. The smoked brisket is also great. The medium burrito is filling enough, unless you're training for an eating event. It's a family-owned establishment and their attention to flavor sets them apart from chain restaurants. Highly recommended if you want delicious and healthy food at a reasonable price, as long as you don't overindulge.

input:
This review is for their lunch menu as I have not tried their other offerings yet. If you are lucky enough to have lunch there during their 11-2 sandwich times, you are in for a real treat! The two sandwiches I have tried (the grinder and the southwesterner) were absolutely delicious! There wasn't a single taste bud that wasn't satisfied. It is pricey and sandwiches are a little on the small side but it is well worth it. 

Can't wait to try (afford) their steaks!!

Food: 5/5
Service: 5/5
Price: 4/5 - A little high but great quality
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This review is for the lunch menu at this restaurant. The two sandwiches I tried, the grinder and the southwesterner, were absolutely delicious. The lunch hours are from 11-2 and it's definitely worth trying. The sandwiches are a bit small and the prices are a little high, but the quality is great. I can't wait to try their steaks. Overall, the food and service were rated 5/5, and the price was rated 4/5.

input:
Tasty selection and very preppy! 

One cannot go wrong with the What's Up Doc omelet. One complaint with the omelets is the actual size, they seem to fluctuate. Clearly a difference in 4-5 extra bits worth of omelet. 

If you have a sweet tooth, any of french toasts are great! Fancy Breakfast Sandwich is great! I substituted the prosciutto with bacon and got great results! Great mimosas!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Tasty selection with a preppy atmosphere. The What's Up Doc omelet is a safe choice, although the size can vary. The french toast options are delicious for those with a sweet tooth. The Fancy Breakfast Sandwich, with bacon instead of prosciutto, is highly recommended. Also, don't miss out on the great mimosas!

input: Great store if you like 50's-Midcentury modern! The prices are a little high compared to my favorite stores in STL, but this store is one of a kind thats for sure!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This store is perfect for fans of 50's-Midcentury modern with a unique selection. Although prices are higher compared to my favorite STL stores, it is definitely one of a kind.

input: STAY AWAY! I am a gold member, so I stay at Hamptons frequently. I have stayed here before, and it seems to be under constant construction. My room was dirty. I came back to give them another chance as it is close to my appointments. I show up for a four night stay, and they send me away because they are booked, but tell me I can come back tomorrow night. Seriously? I couldn't believe that. I wont be back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Avoid this hotel! Despite being a gold member and frequent guest, my experience at Hamptons has been consistently disappointing due to ongoing construction and dirty rooms. On my recent visit for a four-night stay, they turned me away claiming to be fully booked, but offered me a room for the following night. Unbelievable! I have decided not to return.

input: The best fried rice ever! Also the best Pho I had while in Nashville. I'm from Seattle so I'm a little spoiled in that department. If you're looking for a good place to try it for the first time or just looking for a good Vietnamese restaurant, GO!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The best fried rice and Pho in Nashville! Coming from Seattle, I'm a bit spoiled in this department, but this place exceeded my expectations. Highly recommend for both first-timers and Vietnamese food enthusiasts.

input: Walked here from our condo and found this awesome place! Delicious sliders...donuts...unique drinks... Awesome atmosphere and the staff was sooooooo friendly! Will definitely be back!!!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Walked here from our condo and discovered an amazing place! Delicious sliders, donuts, and unique drinks. The atmosphere is awesome, and the staff is incredibly friendly. We will definitely be back!

input: As far as I know, this is the best video rental store in existence.  The staff is knowledgeable and friendly, but the selection really sets it apart.  Suppose you want to rent the newest release and a VHS of the best hockey fights of the 1970s...They would probably have both available at a very low cost.  I only wish that there was a place like Casa Video in Chicago.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Casa Video is the ultimate video rental store known for its top-notch service and extensive selection. The staff is incredibly helpful and the vast range of options is truly unmatched. Whether you're looking for the latest release or a vintage VHS of classic hockey fights from the 1970s, Casa Video is sure to have it, all at an incredibly affordable price. If only there was a similar place like Casa Video in Chicago, it would be a dream come true.

input:
That horrible angst - you want sushi, but you're not SO hungry that you can do AYCE or want to spend $25 for lunch. So we popped in on a weekend for a late lunch and decided to order a la carte.  I ordered a long roll and a hand roll, a drink and a chocolate mochi (OMG, I am officially in love with these things) and the total cost came to just under $20 with tip.  It filled my belly enough so that I was satisfied.  Had I gone for just one more roll, I probably would have broke even with the AYCE, but I probably would've been so stuffed to the point where I wouldn't have needed to eat anything else all day - not the plan for this particular day.

The rolls tasted fresh and delicious, but the surprise was definitely the mochi - so creamy and tasty.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We wanted sushi but weren't that hungry for all-you-can-eat or spending $25. So we went for a late lunch, ordered a long roll, hand roll, drink, and a chocolate mochi. The total came to just under $20 with tip. It filled me up, but if I had ordered one more roll, I would have broken even with all-you-can-eat. The rolls were fresh and delicious, but the mochi was the real surprise - creamy and tasty.

input: Not too sure why all the negative reviews. I was in and out within 5 mins. Maybe it was because I wasn't looking for something elaborate, who knows. Anyways, I got exactly what I needed and the employees were courteous. The store was organized, well stocked and clean. Unfortunately for this area however, I don't see them staying in business. So many other places near by closed.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a positive experience at the store, where I found what I needed quickly. The employees were polite, and the store was well-organized and clean. However, considering the numerous nearby closures, I am uncertain if the store will remain in business.

input: Best Pizza period. Love the staff and the beer is always cold and the taps are always maintained. If you want fresh beer and a slice it's only 5 bucks.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Best Pizza. Love the staff, cold beer, well-maintained taps. Only $5 for fresh beer and a slice.

input:
All of hype about Federal Donuts made me a little worried it wouldn't live up to it's reputation. But, it absolutely did. I'm a vegetarian so I can only personally comment on the donuts and coffee; however, my husband is obsessed with the chicken. His favorite is the buttermilk ranch.

The donuts are pretty amazing. Paired with an iced coffee and it doesn't get any better. The staff couldn't be nicer- even when they're busy.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The hype about Federal Donuts had me worried it wouldn't live up to its reputation, but it absolutely did. As a vegetarian, I can only personally comment on the donuts and coffee. However, my husband is obsessed with the chicken, specifically the buttermilk ranch flavor. The donuts are truly amazing, especially when paired with an iced coffee. The staff is incredibly friendly, even during busy times.

input:
Three chances and they are out! We tried to like this place as the location is easy and convenient. The bar is great, the staff friendly, but there is not a dish I have tried that is passable (although the asian shrimp wasn't bad, but very sweet). First visit we wrote off as a new restaurant working out the bugs. On our second visit I ordered a turkey burger and received a dry turkey patty. No one informed me that they were out of buns, but they could have at least tried to dress it up. It was seriously a lone piece of ground meat (to their credit, the manager did comp that meal). Today we received fish and chips that had to come out of a box and chicken salad that could have greased my axles!

We won't be back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We won't be returning to this place. We gave it three chances, hoping to like it due to its convenient location and great bar and friendly staff. However, we have not found a single dish that is passable, except for the asian shrimp which was overly sweet. On our first visit, we overlooked the issues assuming it was new and working out the kinks. On the second visit, my turkey burger was dry and served without a bun, accompanied by no attempt to make it presentable. The only positive was that the manager comped that meal. Today, we received fish and chips in a box and a greasy chicken salad.

input:
I could say that this is a touch of Italy in a strip mall, but even I recognize that is a little too precious. Stepping into the dark, cool interior of Sapore made for a refreshing change after the sweltering July heatwave. It was no problem for our party of three to be seated; the fact that we had a reservation helped, I am sure. We started out with drinks--bellinis for my two dinner companions and a classic vodka martini for me. I appreciated being able to customize my drink with a blue-cheese-stuffed olive and an anchovy. I would never have thought to put an anchovy in a martini, but it looks like this will be a new obsession for me. 

On to the food. We opted to skip the appetizers and go straight to soup/salad and entrees (all the better to save room for dessert). My mom went with the Italian soup and my other dining companion and I split the Caprese salad, a solid presentation that did not blow me away, but certainly does not provide grist for anything like the negative reviews of this establishment that I have seen on yelp. I didn't know what to expect in terms of pasta portions here, so I went with the Chicken Marsala. It might have been nice to have pasta to pick up some of the sauce, but I appreciated that the dish was hot by temperature and I even had enough for leftovers (to which I added pasta, in the comfort and convenience of my home).

The dessert selection was excellent. We went with the tiramisu. I understand Sapore also has an excellent cannoli which I would like to try on a future visit. I would be tempted to come back, if only for another excellent martini, appetizers, and another run through the dessert menu.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Sapore is a refreshing Italian restaurant in a strip mall. Despite some negative reviews, our party of three had no trouble being seated with a reservation. We started with drinks, including a customized martini. For food, we skipped appetizers and went straight to soup/salad and entrees. The Caprese salad was solid but not outstanding. The Chicken Marsala was enjoyable, with enough for leftovers. The dessert selection, particularly the tiramisu, was excellent. We would consider coming back for the great drinks, appetizers, and desserts.

input:
Due to it's location in a strip mall near Cool Springs, this version of the Twelve South hipster gourmet Burger Up is certainly not as trendy. But it makes up for it by delivering the goods. Awesomely tasty and messy burgers with fresh meat and fixings. The regular fries are delicious... until you try the truffle fries. They are truly outstanding, not greasy and finished with paresan cheese. The metaphorical cherry-on-top was the chocolate milkshake (which actually had no cherry on top). The shake was nothing fancy, but perfectly made, creamy, not too sweet or over-chocolatey. 
If you want your upscale burger experience but still want your burger-fries-shake holy trinity, come here.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Located in a strip mall near Cool Springs, this version of Twelve South's hipster gourmet Burger Up may not be as trendy. However, it delivers with delicious, messy burgers made from fresh ingredients. The regular fries are tasty, but the truffle fries are outstanding, finished with Parmesan cheese. To top it off, the chocolate milkshake is perfectly made, creamy, and not overly sweet. For an upscale burger experience that includes the holy trinity of burger, fries, and shake, this is the place to come.

input: I dropped my car off first thing in the morning for a simple "check engine" light appointment. I was told at the end of that day that my car had not been looked at and would not be ready until the following day. What was the point of making an appointment, if they didn't even touch my car? The next evening when I came to pick it up, after they called me to tell me it was ready, I waited for a full hour before my car was given to me. They had parked so many cars in front of it they couldn't get it out. That is an hour of my life I will never get back, all because someone called and told me to come pick up my car (...which was there for two full business days, unnecessarily. For the record, there was nothing wrong with the car. It needed no repair and no maintenance). There was a kind woman who asked how they could make it up to me, but I had to tell her that I will likely never return, so it wasn't worth her time.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I scheduled an appointment to have my car's "check engine" light looked at first thing in the morning. However, at the end of the day, I was informed that my car had not been examined and would not be ready until the following day. I was disappointed as there seemed to be no point in making the appointment if they didn't even touch my car. The next evening, when I went to pick up my car after being notified it was ready, I had to wait for a full hour because they had parked several cars in front of mine, making it inaccessible. This was an hour of my life wasted because of someone calling me to collect my car unnecessarily, even though it was there for two full business days without any repairs or maintenance needed. Although a kind woman asked how they could make it up to me, I had to decline as I don't intend to return to their service again.

input: For many years, RH&B was the place to go in south Jersey for great BBQ and blues. Sadly, after a recent sale, the restaurant has decided to cancel all live music. The food was decent at best, and in the absence of live music offerings  I can no longer recommend this restaurant. The only aspect I will miss are the people who worked there.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: RH&B was once a go-to spot in south Jersey for BBQ and blues. However, after a recent sale, the restaurant has sadly decided to cancel all live music. With just decent food and no live music, I can no longer recommend this restaurant. The only thing I will miss are the people who worked there.

input:
This use to be a reliable place for sandwiches but the last two were not good at all.  Cheesesteak was light on the meat.  There are so many good rolls to pick from in the Philly area but this roll was one of the worst and stale.

Hopefully it was just an off night. I'll try again but not for awhile.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place was once reliable for sandwiches, but the last two were disappointing. The cheesesteak lacked meat and the roll was one of the worst and stale, despite the many good options available in Philly. Maybe it was just an off night. I'll give it another try, but not anytime soon.

input: Maybe I just had bad luck at this property but I am a SPG gold member... quickly approaching platinum and made a reservation at this property.
