Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is fun with both an outdoor patio playing hip hop music and an indoor dance area with salsa. You can easily switch up the music and scenery whenever you want.

input:
Had not been for years.

We went for lunch. Great decor. Great wait staff. Personable and on the ball.

My bud had the fish special, serving was a bit small but delish he said.

I had the fattoush salad with chicken. Spicing was everything it should be. The chicken was good, just that. The lettuce was limp and so was the pita. Not an olive in sight.

Pricey, especially for lunch. We will not be rushing back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We went for lunch at a restaurant with great decor and wait staff. My friend enjoyed the fish special despite the small portion. I had the fattoush salad with chicken, which had good spicing but limp lettuce and pita, and no olives. The price was high for lunch. Overall, we won't be returning soon.

input: Our animals are an extension of our family.  So, we aren't going to take them to any old place for boarding, grooming and medical examinations.  I'm a big fan of the Animal Clinic because they treat the pets as if they were their own pets.  You can't ask for any more.  I would have given them 5* but the location is a little difficult to get out of when leaving.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We view our beloved animals as part of our family and prioritize their well-being. That's why we choose the Animal Clinic for boarding, grooming, and medical examinations. They provide exceptional care for our pets, treating them like their own. The only downside is the slightly inconvenient location when leaving, but it's a minor drawback. Overall, they deserve a rating of 4 out of 5 stars.

input: Literally, the worst Taco Bell I have ever been to. The restaurant is filthy, the service is awful, and they didn't make any of our order correctly, and really, how hard is that?  I won't be back and if I were you I would find a different place to go.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This Taco Bell is absolutely terrible. The restaurant is disgustingly dirty, the service is incredibly poor, and they couldn't even get our order right. It's honestly not that difficult to make a correct order. I definitely won't be returning, and I highly suggest finding an alternative place to go.

input:
I like the Neuvo-Latino-Americano grub here.  The place has moved locations and is now a bit larger.  Chips & Salsa are always fresh 7 tasty, too.

I wish I could give a more substanital review but I ate here so long ago - and at the old location - so I'd better just keep my mouth shut.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I enjoy the Neuvo-Latino-Americano food at this place which has recently moved to a bigger location. The Chips & Salsa are consistently fresh and tasty. I can't provide a detailed review since I ate here a while ago, at the previous location, so I'd rather not comment further.

input: Found Player's while driving by. Everyone is very friendly. The service is great. Atmosphere is very relaxed. Great experience overall. Oh and a great shave and cut for a great price!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Discovered Player's while driving by; friendly staff, excellent service, relaxed atmosphere, great overall experience, and a fantastic shave and cut at an affordable price!

input: terrible food and the manager was shockingly rude when I tried to return my food. I had the frogs legs and they were rubbery and tasted awful. I was disgusted by her behavior and she should be ashamed of herself. I have never been treated more horribly by someone.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food was terrible and the manager's rude behavior when I tried to return my rubbery and awful-tasting frogs legs was extremely shocking. Her conduct left me disgusted and she should be utterly ashamed of herself. I have never encountered such abhorrent treatment from anyone before.

input:
The location is pretty random (at the end of a long winding road with a bunch of other hotel off of the highway with no food nearby) and the building has seen better days.  

My room featured an unclean floor, torn wallpaper, dusty bathroom vents, and water spots in the bathroom.  The hallways might remind one of "red rum" and the building itself is ugly showing it's age as a product of the 70s (as am I so I can judge).

The bed was comfortable and the room serviceable but it was disappointing as I have grown accustomed to a higher level of quality in my Doubletree experience throughout the country.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The location is random, at the end of a winding road with other hotels off the highway and no nearby food options. The building is old and deteriorated, showing its age from the 70s. My room had a dirty floor, torn wallpaper, dusty bathroom vents, and water spots in the bathroom. The hallways resemble those in "red rum." Although the bed was comfortable and the room functional, it was disappointing compared to the high level of quality I have experienced in other Doubletree hotels across the country.

input:
The hotel is beautifully done. It has a boutique feel and not like just a normal hotel like the Hilton. I had my birthday party there at the restaurant and it was so very nice. The service was wonderful and the rooms are beautiful. The air conditioner was pretty loud in our room but that is my only complaint. It's very close to Printers Alley which is so cool! 
I would definitely stay in this hotel again!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The hotel has a boutique feel and is beautifully done. I had my birthday party at their restaurant, which was very nice. The service was wonderful and the rooms are beautiful. The only complaint is that the air conditioner in our room was pretty loud. The hotel is conveniently located near Printers Alley, which is cool. I would definitely stay here again.

input:
Cool spot in a great location.
We got there early, so didn't have the same crushing crowds others have talked about.
The bartenders are awesome.
Made me a Perfect Rye Manhattan on the rocks, never had one before...I'm hooked.
Easily the best burger I've ever had!
Will absolutely be back
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Awesome spot in great location, not crowded when we went. The bartenders are excellent and made me the best Rye Manhattan on the rocks. The burger was easily the best I've ever had. Will definitely return.

input: Excellent food and excellent service!  My new favorite breakfast place. I loved the biscuits and gravy, extra crispy bacon, sausage links and challah French toast!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great food and service! My new go-to breakfast spot. The biscuits and gravy, extra crispy bacon, sausage links, and challah French toast were all fantastic.

input: We hired Terra as the florist for our wedding and were very pleased with her work. We liked that she took the time to run through the venue with my husband and really tried to understand our needs and accommodate our budget. The florals for the wedding came out beautiful and we loved the draping for the ceremony and the reception. The only concern we had was that some of flowers in the bride's and the bridesmaids' bouquets started wilting during the day, but we understand that it is because the flowers were in full bloom and it could also have been due to the heat. Overall, we were happy we found Terra for our wedding!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We hired Terra as our wedding florist and were pleased with her work. She took the time to understand our needs, ran through the venue with my husband, and accommodated our budget. The florals were beautiful, and we loved the draping for both the ceremony and reception. However, some flowers in the bride's and bridesmaids' bouquets wilted throughout the day, likely due to being in full bloom and the heat. Despite this, we were happy to have found Terra for our wedding.

input: Excellent healthy options for NOLA dining with lots of to go choices. I had turkey meatballs and spaghetti. It is a wonderful lunch place.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great healthy options for NOLA dining, with plenty of to-go choices. I enjoyed the turkey meatballs and spaghetti for a fantastic lunch experience.

input: This is everything I want in take out food - fresh, yummy, and relatively healthy. I also love that there is a good to go place in Northern Liberties that is convenient - there is not enough of that!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love everything about this takeout food - it's fresh, delicious, and fairly healthy. I'm especially thrilled to find a convenient go-to place in Northern Liberties, as there aren't many options like that.

input:
We had an alumni event here and I really enjoyed it. It's dimly lit, very cozy inside - it's decorated kind of like an old library. It was a great quiet,casual spot if you're looking for a low key place to have good drinks. 

They have a few beers and wines, but we focused mostly on the happy hour cocktails - moscow mules, old fashioneds, etc. Everyone loved theirs, no complaints!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We recently had an enjoyable alumni event at a cozy, dimly lit venue decorated like an old library. It provided a great, quiet and casual atmosphere for those seeking a low-key place to enjoy good drinks. While they do offer beers and wines, we mostly indulged in their delightful happy hour cocktails, including moscow mules and old fashioneds. Everyone was pleased with their drinks, and we had no complaints.

input: The burgers are amazing! French fries are decent (so get the onion rings).
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Burgers are amazing, but the French fries are just decent. It's recommended to try the onion rings instead.

input: Ive eaten there twice and both times it was terrible. Steak was salty, fish dry, my salad was frozen , service awful. . Im really not sure how this place gets any good reviews.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The two times I've eaten there, the experience was terrible. The steak was overly salty, the fish was dry, and my salad was frozen. The service was also incredibly poor. I can't understand why this place receives any positive reviews.

input: Even after finding many great Spanish restaurants in the country (mostly NYC), Modesto is still one of my favorite Spanish place to eat.  This place is really good!  Too bad I don't live near St. Louis anymore since this is one of the places that I miss.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite discovering numerous exceptional Spanish restaurants in the United States, particularly in NYC, Modesto remains one of my preferred places to dine. It is truly exceptional! It is unfortunate that I no longer reside near St. Louis, as this is one of the establishments I truly miss.

input:
Wow what a terrible spa. I can only speak for the manicure/pedicure aspect because I did not get a massage. Typically, you go to a spa to escape and relax - you can not do that here. It is small, dirty, and the staff is terrible. 

I walked in and the receptionist was on the phone - he did acknowledge that I was standing there, but several staff walked by and did not offer to assist. Finally, after two other guests came in behind me, someone came up and took me back - just to get me out of the way. Asked what my name was and left. Did not offer me water/refreshments of any kind. I've had better reception at the local nail salon. Then I had to wait for 10-15 minutes for my technician to finish up her current client, which I didn't mind because I leisurely picked out my color. When it was my turn, the nail technician was shaky and rushed. She cut my cuticle and I bled. She was sick and kept blowing her nose into her shirt (gross!!) and took time outs to really blow/dig in her nose with a tissue right in front of me! Lady, you are touching my hands with yours, you are blowing bacteria into the air, if you are that sick don't come to work - *Management, if your employee is that sick do not make them come in! You will lose clients. 

She gave me the worst hand/arm massage I have ever had (that is usually everyone's favorite part, and the technician's opportunity to shine!). No pressure was applied, and she just basically rubbed lotion into my skin and made a snarky comment about how my skin was so dry is was just "drinking up all the lotion." Yes, I realize it's dry, probably due to the 20 degree weather and wind outside, but thank you for making me feel self-conscious. 

When I went to leave the receptionist was on the phone again, but did actually put them on hold to get me out of there. I opted to put everything on my room charge, which resulted in extra fees but I didn't care. There was a blaring sign saying how they preferred cash gratuity and that there would be extra fees associated with putting services on your room. Yes, everyone prefers cash gratuity - but how tacky can you be?!! 

Overall, it was an extremely disappointing experience. I have been wanting to stay at the Monteleone for years and made it a priority to experience their salon. My gel nail polish is already chipping and it hasn't even been a week. Spa Aria definitely needs a overhaul and I would recommend you go anywhere else but here.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The spa at Monteleone is terrible. It is small, dirty, and the staff is unhelpful. The receptionist was on the phone and did not offer assistance. The nail technician was shaky, cut my cuticle, and blew her nose in front of me. The hand/arm massage was poor, with no pressure applied. The receptionist was on the phone again when I was leaving. There were extra fees for putting services on the room and the gel nail polish chipped within a week. I would not recommend Spa Aria at Monteleone.

input: I got the hot shave and it did not disappoint. They do 6 towels and a facial massage with oils in between. Great shave, great environment.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had an amazing hot shave experience with 6 towels, a facial massage using oils, in a great environment.

input: We've been going to this place since it opened and it's always decent, not to mention super fast! TdM is owned by Subway and has a similar feel to it, but I think the quality is much better than Subway. It's a build-your-own burrito and taco place and the ingredients are always fresh and well-stocked. I usually eat vegetarian, so there are plenty of options for me to eat. I always get a veggie burrito and load it up with lots of veggies! I also like their chips and "medium" salsa. If ever around Delgado, check out Taco del Mar!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Taco del Mar (TDM) has consistently reliable and quick service since its opening. As a Subway-owned establishment, it shares similarities in ambiance but stands out with superior quality. TDM offers customizable burritos and tacos with consistently fresh and well-stocked ingredients. Vegetarians will find numerous appealing options. Personally, I recommend trying their veggie burrito loaded with an abundance of veggies. Additionally, their chips and "medium" salsa are enticing. When in the vicinity of Delgado, consider visiting Taco del Mar.

input: I only go here when I need something that Trader Joes doesn't carry. They are overpriced, and understaffed. Not a fan.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I go here for items not available at Trader Joe's. However, the store is overpriced and lacks sufficient staff. Overall, not a fan.

input: Listen up, people!  Fall off the bone mushy ribs are not what you get at a proper barbeque joint!  If you want that stuff, then go elsewhere.  Smoked ribs are meant to be a little tough.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Proper barbeque joints do not serve fall off the bone mushy ribs. Smoked ribs are intentionally a little tough.

input: Amazing place for lassi and chaat. The chaat is elegantly presented and tastes like traditional Karachi chaat. However, the chaat isn't as nearly as good as the lassi. It is soft and creamy and sweetened beautifully. Will be coming back for sure next time I'm in the area.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great spot for lassi and chaat. The chaat is elegantly presented and has a traditional Karachi flavor. However, it falls short compared to the outstanding lassi. The lassi is irresistibly soft, creamy, and perfectly sweetened. Definitely coming back next time in the area.

input: My husband and I held our wedding reception at Hendel's Cafe and it was gorgeous, just a beautiful night and a perfect place in which to spend with our closest friends and family!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had our beautiful wedding reception at Hendel's Cafe, a perfect place to celebrate with our closest friends and family.

input: Cockroach in my room, wifi is slower than aol in 1996, private beach costs $10 a chair. I'll never come here again.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Room has cockroach, wifi as slow as AOL in 1996, private beach charges $10 per chair - never returning.

input:
Our first visit to El Sol was to celebrate my daughter's birthday.  Needless to say, we were all BLOWN AWAY!   Our waiter was so attentive and polite, the pina colodas, margaritas and food was to die for, and at the end of the meal the whole staff came out with a very large cake, a desert for my daughter, sombreros and FIREWORKS!!  Birthday songs were played on the televisions and it was very festive.  
I'm so happy this gem is close enough to make regular dinner visits.  I'm also happy that an order of fajitas will feed me for dinner an lunch the next day. 
Good job, guys!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: During our first visit to El Sol to celebrate my daughter's birthday, we were blown away. The waiter provided excellent service, the pina colodas, margaritas, and food were fantastic. To our surprise, the staff brought out a large cake, a dessert for my daughter, sombreros, and even fireworks! The atmosphere was festive with birthday songs playing on the televisions. I'm thrilled that this amazing restaurant is close by for regular dinner visits. Additionally, the generous portion of fajitas made for dinner and lunch the next day. Great job, guys!

input: What a hidden gem of a restaurant.  While everyone else go to Taco Bus and stands in long lines I'll come here to Taco Son and get just as good of food without the lines. Everything here is made from scratch and you can taste the freshness of the ingredients.  The portions are big so you get your monies worth. Oh and their breakfast burritos are killer grab you one after a long night.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Taco Son is a hidden gem of a restaurant that offers delicious food without the long lines found at popular places like Taco Bus. Their made-from-scratch dishes are bursting with fresh flavors, and the generous portions offer great value for money. Don't miss out on their amazing breakfast burritos, perfect for a post-night-out meal.

input: We recently purchased a used car for my son, it was a 2006 and of course comes with no warranty because of the age, but I expected them to send it home with us in a safe condition. It was supposedly just inspected and had a brand new PA state inspection and oil change sticker from Conicelli. Needless to say we got it home and the next day the front left tire blew . It was completely dry rotted on the backside and the tire shop ended up replacing both front tires for $450. Money is one thing but after seeing how the tire just shredded we could have been killed on I95 on the way home. The tire just entirely fell apart. Never would recommend them now.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We bought a used car for my son, a 2006 model. Despite its age, we expected it to be in a safe condition, as it had supposedly undergone inspection and received a new PA state inspection and oil change sticker from Conicelli. However, soon after bringing it home, the front left tire blew out. The tire was severely dry rotted on the backside and had to be replaced, along with the front right tire, costing us $450. Besides the financial loss, the alarming incident could have led to a fatal accident on I95. As a result, we highly discourage recommending this dealership.

input: Food is on point.  I am deducting 1 star for the condition of the bathrooms on the Friday night I went.. Toilet didn't flush, no toilet paper or paper towels and overall gross.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food is great, but the condition of the bathrooms on the Friday night I went was terrible. The toilet didn't flush, there was no toilet paper or paper towels, and it was overall gross. This is why I am deducting 1 star.

input: Great food, awful service. I ordered online at 6:20, site said it would be ready at 6:40. I get there at 6:37 and i expected to wait a couple minutes but not the entire 20 minutes it takes to cook my food. They didn't even start cooking it till i got there. I leave at 7. They did nothing for the inconvenience and still made me pay full. Honestly, I'm so upset with how the whole situation was handled. Where is the customer service??
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Food is great but service is awful. Ordered online and expected it to be ready at 6:40. Arrived at 6:37 but had to wait the full 20 minutes for it to be cooked. They didn't start cooking it until I got there. Left at 7 with no compensation or apology. Extremely dissatisfied with their handling of the situation and lack of customer service.

input: Cute Japanese restaurant in Old City. Fresh sushi and amazing ramen. Wonderful customer service! This is my new favorite go to for sushi and ramen. There is a great selection on the menu.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Cute Japanese restaurant in Old City with fresh sushi, amazing ramen, and wonderful customer service. It is my new favorite go-to spot for sushi and ramen due to the great selection on the menu.

input: Loved the abvionce.. got pampered and relaxed. It was hard to get a drink order place. Was the only reason I did not give them a 5. Had to ask 4 people before I was told to go call roommservice on the white phone.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Loved the ambience and enjoyed being pampered and relaxed at the place. The only downside was the difficulty in placing a drink order. Had to ask multiple people before finally being directed to call room service on the white phone.

input:
Doctor Jeffers is one of the best vets I have ever dealt with, she shows compassion for all animals and can tell you within hours of literally anything that is wrong, plus very reasonable prices.

Dr Jeffers even accepts reptiles so being able to get that kind of service locally is great considering another vet on street road gouges you big time for just a vitamin shot ( 105.00 minimum charge )

Plus the practice has just about every type of machinery to insure that they know exactly what is going on with your pet. She even has animals for adoption. 

One great vet, as good as Dr Pol.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Dr. Jeffers is an exceptional and compassionate vet who can quickly diagnose any issue with animals. She offers reasonable prices and even accepts reptiles, which is a rarity locally. Unlike another vet on Street Road who overcharges for simple procedures, Dr. Jeffers provides excellent service at a minimum cost of $105. Her practice is well-equipped with modern machinery to ensure accurate diagnoses. Moreover, she also facilitates animal adoptions. Dr. Jeffers is truly an outstanding vet, comparable to the renowned Dr. Pol.

input: Mahi Mahi was great, large portion. You could split a meal.You must like smoked fish. Server was pleasant.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Mahi Mahi was great with a large portion, perfect for sharing a meal. It is recommended for those who enjoy smoked fish. The server provided pleasant service.

input: Melissa is by far the BEST! I've gone to two other lash lounges and I will tell you Melissa outdoes them all. She knows her craft. She doesn't double or triple stack lashes. She gets you in and out. 100% recommend going to Melissa.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Melissa is the best lash professional I've ever been to, surpassing all other lash lounges I've tried. She is highly skilled, efficient, and avoids overloading with lashes. I strongly recommend Melissa for an exceptional experience.

input:
Best casino in Reno.   4 deck and 2 deck blackjack, real drink glasses (no plastic fratboy cups), amazing decorum that will burn your retinas, and the restaurants inside are better the big casinos on the strip by a factor of a thousand.
The rooms are stellar for the price.  Get a hot tub and chilllllll.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The best casino in Reno offers 4 deck and 2 deck blackjack, real drink glasses, stunning decor, and exceptional restaurants that surpass those in big casinos on the strip by a thousand times. The rooms are also outstanding and affordable, providing the option to relax in a hot tub.

input:
My wife and I had been wanting to go here but just hadn't made it a priority.  

I had the fish and chips.  The batter wasn't thick, and it has a crispiness to it that was a great contrast to the moistness and juiciness of the fish.  I have to admit, when I'm not sure what to get I think of getting a burger or fish & chips, and there weren't any burgers on the dinner menu.  The serving size was 3 cod pieces, approx 4-6 oz, along with a generous serving of fries. Additionally, the tartar sauce appeared to be made in house, had a great flavor.  So, if you're in the mood for fish and chips, I would highly recommend getting them here...because while the serving size isn't as big as Great Basin's, it tastes way better.

My wife had the salmon tacos, and for the side she had the chicken tortilla soup.  While the tacos had some great flavors the salmon was a bit overcooked, thus making the tacos a bit overshadowed by the soup.  Similar to the fish & chips above, the serving size wasn't large, only 2 tacos, but again, the flavors were very good.

If you're starving and want a large meal with leftovers I'd recommend other places, but if you want a satisfying meal that's an appropriate size this place is very good.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had been wanting to go here but hadn't made it a priority. I had the fish and chips. The batter wasn't thick but had a crispy contrast to the moist and juicy fish. The serving size was 3 cod pieces with a generous serving of fries. The tartar sauce had a great flavor. My wife had the salmon tacos, which had great flavors but the salmon was slightly overcooked. The serving size was small, only 2 tacos. This place is great for a satisfying meal of appropriate size, but not for those looking for a large meal with leftovers.

input: The Lemon Cake is as good as it is heavy.    It was my second visit to Cake Life and I only chose not to get cupcakes because it would have been pure gluttony.   They ROCK!   Many more visits to come.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The Lemon Cake at Cake Life is delicious and satisfyingly heavy. On my second visit, I decided not to get cupcakes to avoid gluttony, but they are amazing! Definitely planning to visit again.

input: They sat us within 5 minutes and then took 40 minutes to even bring out sodas. The table next to us had the same server and got their good before their beverages came out. After almost an hour there with no drinks we tracked down a manager who told us our good never even got entered. I'm on my honeymoon and the friend we were there with had a date to make. Appetizer was the only thing to make it out and was decent boneless wings. Even with the manager begging us to let her get our food together free and not walk out, the service was beyond dismal and slow. First and last time coming to a Beef's. Made us all late. If we had waited at our table for the food we would have made our year anniversary before it came out. Better choices for food elsewhere. Avoid this place at all costs
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: They seated us within 5 minutes, but it took them 40 minutes to bring out our sodas. Meanwhile, the table next to us, who had the same server, received their food before their drinks. After almost an hour of waiting with no drinks, we had to find a manager who informed us that our order had never been entered. We were on our honeymoon and our friend had a prior engagement. Only the appetizer, which was decent boneless wings, made it to our table. Despite the manager's plea to allow them to comp our meal and prevent us from leaving, the service was extremely slow and unsatisfactory. This was our first and last time dining at Beef's. The delay made us all late, as even if we had waited for our food at the table, it would have passed our year anniversary. There are better dining options available elsewhere. We strongly advise avoiding this place at all costs.

input:
Wildflower is a super scrum, cute little restaurant. I've been here twice now for lunch, unfortunately I am always too late for breakfast. Fortunately though, their lunch is delicious! I took my mum here for her birthday for lunch and we were both so pleased!! 

Sad to say, but due to some health issues, I've had to really change my diet around. This was my first time going out to eat since being on this new regimen. I'm definitely limited, which is too bad, and there was a lot I couldn't have. The menu has good selections, but there is a lot with meat, and I've been a vegetarian for years. Regardless, they serve great food, I just like big menus. Everything is made in house and they use fresh and local ingredients. My mum got the Vermonter salad, which she LOVED!!! It had mixed greens, Vermont cheddar, applewood smoked bacon, pecans, and dried cherries. The dressing was a home made honey vinaigrette I believe. It came with two delicious pieces of muesli bread with a home made honey butter. YUM!! I had the tuna plate, which was great too. It had a very good portion of tuna salad, mixed greens, mixed veggies, and came with a biscuit with that delicious honey butter. It also came with a fresh fruit bowl!!!! I couldn't have the biscuit so I traded for muesli and man that stuff was delicious. My mum loves the biscuit too. Everything is definitely made with love and happiness here!!!

The patio is so cute, 4 tables on a nice little deck with fans and hanging lights. Our server was wonderful, SO kind and adorable. She even brought my mum
a homemade red velvet cupcake with a candle, which LOOKED amazing, and she thought was delicious. Another win at Wildflower, would love to come back for breakfast sometime.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
Wildflower is a cute little restaurant known for its delicious lunch options. Although I haven't had the chance to try their breakfast, I've been here twice for lunch and both experiences were fantastic. 
Unfortunately, due to my dietary restrictions, I had limited options on the menu since I'm a vegetarian. However, the food at Wildflower is made in-house using fresh and local ingredients, which made my dining experience enjoyable. My mom thoroughly enjoyed the Vermonter salad, which consisted of mixed greens, Vermont cheddar, applewood smoked bacon, pecans, and dried cherries, topped off with a homemade honey vinaigrette dressing. The dishes also came with two tasty pieces of muesli bread with homemade honey butter. 
I opted for the tuna plate, which was equally satisfying. It included a generous portion of tuna salad, mixed greens, mixed veggies, and a biscuit with honey butter. Additionally, a fresh fruit bowl accompanied the meal. Although I couldn't have the biscuit, I traded it for muesli bread, which was a delicious alternative. 
The restaurant's patio is adorable, with four tables on a nice little deck adorned with fans and hanging lights. Our server was exceptional, providing great service and even surprising my mom with a homemade red velvet cupcake on her birthday. The cupcake looked amazing and my mom thought it was delicious. I would definitely love to return to Wildflower for breakfast in the future.

input: Worst roast pork sandwich I've ever had. The broccoli rabe was lifeless and freezing. It was so cold my cheese didn't melt. The bread was soggy and wet. Horrible. If I wasn't in an airport, I'd bring this back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Terrible roast pork sandwich with lifeless, freezing broccoli rabe. Cheese didn't even melt due to extreme cold. Soggy, wet bread. Would return if not in an airport.

input:
I always walk pass this place but decided to finally give it a try because of the reviews and the price. Overall, as someone already stated they have great apps but the entrees are left to be desired.
Considering each entree costs ~$8, you get what you pay for. I ordered the Pad Thai and it was bad. Way too sweet with no spicy kick to it. We also ordered the Seafood Crispy Noodles, Pearl Noodles, and a Beef rice dish. All were really mediocre. The Indian pancakes and chicken satay apps were great though. Idk why the entrees were so lackluster. I'm sad I didn't enjoy it more but I'm glad the total was cheap for a night out.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite positive reviews and an affordable price, the overall experience at this place fell short. The entrees were disappointing, lacking flavor and quality, although they were reasonably priced at around $8 each. The Pad Thai was overly sweet and lacked spiciness, while other dishes like Seafood Crispy Noodles, Pearl Noodles, and Beef rice dish were mediocre. However, the Indian pancakes and chicken satay appetizers were delightful. While it is regrettable that the entrees were underwhelming, the low cost of the meal saved the night.

input: Oh man! This is the spot right here! Everything is made to order and sooo worth the wait. I'm from Chicago and have been a self proclaimed sandwich expert for most of my life...this place deserves every bit of those 5 stars! Well done guys!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This spot is amazing! Everything is made to order and definitely worth the wait. As a self-proclaimed sandwich expert from Chicago, I can confidently say that this place deserves its 5-star rating. Great job, guys!

input: Outrageous birthday cake! We chose the Devils Food Cake - with vanilla buttercream icing. It was delicious beyond words! 12 adults who typically shy away from high calorie sweets - ate every last bite! The staff were super friendly & accommodating (we probably could have ordered a bit more advanced) - can't say enough positives about our experience. So glad to know I also have a location closer to me in Old City. Wish I could have another piece of that cake!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The Devils Food Cake with vanilla buttercream icing was an incredibly delicious birthday cake that even attracted 12 health-conscious adults. The staff at the bakery were extremely friendly and accommodating, although it would have been better to place the order in advance. Overall, the experience was fantastic and it's great to know there's a closer location in Old City. I can't help but crave another slice of that amazing cake!

input:
Great talent but that is not important when time
Is more valuable. Sitting here on 3/23/18 at 11:28am. Supposedly opened at 11am. There are 5 of us waiting but no employee to provide service. Tsk, tsk Perfect Arch!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Talented staff doesn't matter if time is wasted. Currently waiting at Perfect Arch on 3/23/18 at 11:28am. The salon was supposed to open at 11am, but there are 5 of us waiting with no employee in sight. Disappointing, Perfect Arch.

input:
Had a great dinner at Spasso. My parents always request Oana and she is an awesome server-- answers questions, gives suggestions, and really knows the menu. We were quoted an hour wait, but were able to grab a high top in the bar area with no wait (they are full service).

Spasso is Italian, but has its own little spin; it's not just the classic dishes of a typical Italian restaurant.

They start you off with bread and this delicious eggplant/pepper topping that is so refreshing. I typically love oil for bread, but love this alternative.

I started with a Caesar salad which was perfect; just enough dressing, super fresh and I love the shaved Parmesan on top. For dinner I had pappardelle porcini which I think is the best item on the menu, it is thick pasta with sundried tomatoes, mushrooms and chicken with light sauce. It is totally delicious, and I had leftovers to have for lunch the next day.

Spasso is definitely recommended for a great dinner in Media!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Had a great dinner at Spasso. Oana, our server, was amazing with answering questions, giving suggestions, and knowing the menu. We were quoted an hour wait but found a high top in the bar area with no wait. Spasso has its own unique take on Italian cuisine, not just the classic dishes. They start you off with delicious bread and a refreshing eggplant/pepper topping. The Caesar salad was perfect with just enough dressing and shaved Parmesan on top. For dinner, I had the pappardelle porcini which is the best item on the menu - thick pasta with sundried tomatoes, mushrooms, and chicken in a light sauce. It was absolutely delicious, and I had leftovers for lunch the next day. Spasso is definitely recommended for a great dinner in Media!

input: My business, my parents, my ex-husband, my son and myself have accounts with this credit union. We have been with them for about 4 years and have been quite satisfied. With this many accounts and this many people there have been some errors however we go directly to the branch to have them corrected. So far that has worked out great for us.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My business, parents, ex-husband, son, and I have accounts with this credit union for about 4 years. Despite occasional errors due to the number of accounts and people involved, we have been satisfied with their services. Whenever there are issues, we directly approach the branch and have successfully resolved them.

input: After numerous visits here, we really wanted to like this place but each time there has been a number of issues, many repeating. No matter the time of day, it seems to get pretty rowdy and my friends and I have had drinks spilled on us on multiple occasions. Almost every time I have been here with my fiancé or friends, it has taken an abnormally long time to get service whether it be inside, outside at a table or bar. The food is mediocre for the price and a few times the food took MUCH longer to come out than what we were told, and when asking management what was going on, we were told that the estimate was wrong and it was "too bad". Staff is rude and far from attentive, though it seems like this place is always over-staffed when we have been here. Amazes me that management allows such a huge lack in customer service. No longer wasting our time and money here, and we advise our friends and family to do the same. It is too much of a hit-and-miss to come here and attempt to have a good time.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite multiple visits, we were unable to overlook the recurring issues at this place. Regardless of the time of day, it consistently gets rowdy, resulting in drinks spilled on us frequently. Moreover, service is consistently slow, whether inside, outside, or at the bar. The food, while pricey, is only mediocre, and there have been instances where it took significantly longer to arrive than promised. When expressing our concerns to management, they were dismissive and unhelpful. The staff is impolite and inattentive, despite the abundance of employees. It is astonishing that management tolerates such poor customer service. Consequently, we have decided to stop wasting our time and money here and strongly advise our friends and family to do the same. The inconsistency of having a good experience makes it not worth the effort.

input: Let me start by saying that the food here is by far the best Mexican I have had in St Pete.  It's nothing fancy and very small but if your looking for some good food and a beer this is the place to go to. Weekend nights do get a little hectic so I would recommend going on a weekday night or during the day so you can skip the long wait to place your order. For the meat lovers out there you can't go wrong with a chorizo taco and for the seafood junkies the fish tacos are amazing!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food here is the best Mexican in St Pete. It's not fancy or big, but if you want good food and a beer, this is the place. Go on weekdays or during the day to avoid the long wait. The chorizo tacos are perfect for meat lovers and the fish tacos are amazing for seafood fans.

input: Wings Wings and more Wings!  Chatham Tap is my favorite place to get wings in the Indianapolis area.  They are meaty, the sauce is great, and I usually always have to take some home for the next day.  I went with a fairly large group and got to sample different things on the menu.  I highly recommend the onion rings!  They have a large selection of beer as well.  Since I heard they were a "soccer bar" I did not know what to expect when I first arrived.  However, the atmosphere is great.  It is full of fans of all different sports and the staff is willing to show whatever sport you want to watch on TV.  The service was excellent.  No one in my group had to ask for one thing while we were there.  I highly recommend this place to anyone who is up for a great meal, great service and a great time with friends.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Chatham Tap in Indianapolis is my top pick for wings. Their meaty wings with delicious sauce always leave me satisfied. The onion rings are a must-try, and their beer selection is extensive. Despite being known as a "soccer bar," the atmosphere is welcoming to fans of all sports, with staff happy to accommodate your preferences on TV. The service is exceptional, with our needs anticipated before we even had to ask. For a fantastic meal, excellent service, and a fun time with friends, I highly recommend Chatham Tap.

input:
Very tasty sushi and very reasonably priced. Service was quick. 1 specific suggestions for improvement: menu photos

Authentic flavor and ultra healthy
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: sushi at affordable prices. Quick service. One suggestion: add menu photos.

input:
First time tonight. We enjoyed our evening with a great server, Alison. She knew we had not been here before and helped us through everything. Most of all we spent a lot of time catching up with old friends, and we never felt hurried.

The food was great, and we tried everything from steaks to meat loafs. All was prepared to our request and the meals were great.

Look forward to coming back. Hope it is just as good next time.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had a great first time tonight thanks to our server, Alison. She guided us through our evening since it was our first visit. We had a wonderful time reconnecting with old friends and never felt rushed. The food, including steaks and meatloaf, was fantastic and prepared to our liking. We're excited to return and hope for an equally enjoyable experience next time.

input:
I have been going to this dive bar for years. Jonny's has a great happy hour everyday and it's very laid back. The food is always on point though. You may think that a dive like this wouldn't have the best options but you are wrong my friend. They make all of their dough from scratch and their naked wings keep me coming back every time. Their Jon's salad with grilled chicken is also a staple of mine along with their pizza.
They also offer games such as trivia and even bingo. They are all free to play and you win some great stuff like gift certificates and even 1 cent pitchers of beer! Can't go wrong with that. 
It is a smoking bar so be aware of that and it gets pretty bad when they are busy. It does get  crowded on game days or nights. Overall it's a great place to grab a few cheap beers with friends and a half-price pizza (did I mention they have 1/2 off pizza on certain days?)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Jonny's is a dive bar that I've been going to for years. The bar has a laid-back atmosphere and offers a great happy hour every day. Surprisingly, the food options are amazing, as they make all their dough from scratch and have delicious naked wings. I particularly love their Jon's salad with grilled chicken and their pizza. Additionally, the bar offers free games like trivia and bingo, where you can win gift certificates and even 1 cent pitchers of beer. However, it's important to note that Jonny's is a smoking bar, which can be uncomfortable when it's crowded. Speaking of crowds, the bar gets busy on game days or nights. Overall, it's a fantastic spot to enjoy cheap beers with friends and indulge in half-price pizza on certain days.

input: Yummy food,  they will veganize things for you as well. The servers are friendly and the restaurant is spacious and has a bar and a stage area. We have had our work Holiday party here for the past couple years, both parties turned out great. The guacamole is awesome!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The restaurant offers delicious food, including vegan options. The servers are friendly, and the spacious establishment features a bar and stage area. It has been the venue for our work Holiday party for the last few years, and both parties were fantastic. Additionally, their guacamole is highly recommended.

input:
West Ave. Grill- Its a happy place in Jenkintown with a lot of locals eating outside under umbrellas with their dogs at their feet and kids on their lap.  Inside their is a large and small area with a bar to eat and look past the parking lot to nicer part of Jenkintown town square.  The wait staff is always nice and the owner is often around to talk to.  Free dum dum lolly pops at the counter as you walk out and news papers to read if you are eating alone or want to check in on the Phillies.
Food- always good. Great pancakes that are fluffy and crispy on the edges.  Kansas City  is a great breakfast too- for the most part great.
Big salads could have more Stuff in them- more of the things that are supposed to be there- as described etc.  But a complaint is readily heard and they always try to make you happy.  It's Nice- try it.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: West Ave. Grill in Jenkintown is a popular local spot where customers can enjoy dining outside with their dogs and kids. The restaurant has a large and small indoor seating area, including a bar with a view of the town square. The wait staff is friendly and the owner is often present and available for conversation. On the way out, customers can grab a free dum dum lolly pop and read newspapers provided by the restaurant. The food is consistently good, with fluffy and crispy pancakes and a highly recommended Kansas City breakfast. However, the salads could have more of the specified ingredients, but the restaurant is attentive to customer complaints and strives to ensure satisfaction. Overall, West Ave. Grill offers a pleasant dining experience and is worth a visit.

input: First time visit the other day, amazing!!!! Best hot chicken anywhere!!! Will def be a must stop every time we come to Nashville!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: First visit the other day, amazing! Best hot chicken anywhere! Will definitely be a must-stop every time we come to Nashville!

input: This was hands down the best tuna melt I have ever had. Very clean! This was also the best service I have ever had at a cafe. Awesome service and really on top of things. It's crazy because it is inside the grocery store! They should expand this cafe without the store attached!!! It would be amazing!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The tuna melt was the best I've ever had and the service at the cafe was outstanding. It's even more impressive because it's inside a grocery store. They should consider expanding the cafe separately as it would be amazing.

input: Finally there is a place in Stl to eat sautéed seafood in  plastic bag! The sauce is a big plus. Good service.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great news for seafood lovers in Stl - a new place that serves sautéed seafood in plastic bags has finally arrived! The sauce offered with the seafood is a huge plus, and the service is top-notch.

input: I know I shouldn't expect much but everything I asked for that was on the drive thru menu was not available. I was actually afraid of what I was going to get once I did get it. I saw the movie "waiting".  Word of advice stay clear of this arch. Just so you know I was only trying to order a beverage how pathetic is that.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had low expectations for the drive-thru, but unfortunately, none of the items I wanted from the menu were available. This made me anxious about the quality of the food I eventually received. I watched the movie "Waiting" and would advise avoiding this particular arch. It's worth mentioning that my order was only for a beverage, which highlights the disappointment in the situation.

input:
This place has a few good things going for it: 

1. REALLY good gravy fries...seriously, if you haven't had them yet - you haven't lived
2. The staff here is friendly and entertaining! Don't let it alarm you if a waitress and a member of the kitchen staff randomly have a lover's quarrel...its all part of the character of the place! lol!
3. It is the perfect bar to watch ANY Philly sports team...but especially the Phillies. 
4. Pretty good beer selection, too!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place has amazing gravy fries that you must try. The staff is friendly and entertaining, even if they have occasional disagreements. It's the perfect bar to watch Philly sports teams, especially the Phillies. They also have a pretty good beer selection.

input: My wife and I stoped in for a couple of glasses of wine in the bar area.  It was a nice festive atmosphere.  Santa and Mrs. Clause even made a brief appearance.  The service was a little slow but we were ok with it because we wanted to take our time anyway.  We had a good time and the ambience is nice for a drink or 2.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My wife and I enjoyed a pleasant time at the bar, savoring a couple of glasses of wine. The atmosphere was festive, with a surprise visit from Santa and Mrs. Claus. Although the service was slightly slow, it suited our intention to leisurely indulge. Overall, we had a great experience, appreciating the inviting ambiance for a relaxed drink or two.

input:
We found ourselves in South Tucson needing a good meal from somewhere other than the kitchens of the chain hotels surrounding the airport.  Thank you Yelpers for delivering another great place!

A reconverted 1960's era A & W chain fast food stand [I can detect those old bone shards still!], we enjoyed a wonderful meal at a reasonable price.

I had the catfish smothered in poblano sauce and melted cheese.  They told me it was farm catfish but it tasted like the catfish I used to catch out of a lake near my house as a little kid.  Farm fish never tastes this real.

My wife had chile relleno - fresh peppers, not surprising this time of year but definite kudos to the chef.

The late-stage adolescents with us enjoyed their enhiladas and chimichangas too.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We stumbled upon a hidden gem in South Tucson, thanks to the recommendations of Yelpers. This reconverted 1960's A & W fast food stand offered us a fantastic meal at an affordable price. I opted for the catfish smothered in poblano sauce and melted cheese, which tasted just like the catfish I used to catch as a child. My wife enjoyed the chile relleno made with fresh peppers. Our young companions also loved their enchiladas and chimichangas.

input:
I recently went here with the hubby and a friend and we got the vegetable pakora to start- which was like veggies and hushpuppies all in one- YUM! Then we each got an entree: chicken tikki masala, lamb roganjosh, and lamb vindaloo. Each dish was superb, authentic, and exactly what it should be. The sauces for each were so good I wanted to drink them. Had I saved any room in my tummy, I just might have! 

The place was reasonably priced and the staff/service was just okay. All-in-all, a great addition to Media's varied dinner spots. The lunch buffet looked promising, too, and is only $9.95 on weekdays, $10.95 on wknds.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I recently visited this restaurant with my husband and a friend. We tried the vegetable pakora as an appetizer, which was a delightful combination of veggies and hushpuppies. For our main courses, we ordered chicken tikki masala, lamb roganjosh, and lamb vindaloo, all three of which were excellent and authentic. The sauces accompanying each dish were incredibly delicious. Despite being reasonably priced, the staff/service was only average. Overall, this restaurant is a great addition to Media's dining options. Additionally, their lunch buffet looks promising and is priced at $9.95 on weekdays and $10.95 on weekends.

input:
Have only been once a couple of months ago, so maybe this was a one-off experience...Ordered a piece of carrot cake, which tasted fine. Certainly not the best I've ever had but good enough. The to go packaging was a bit overkill just for that one slice of cake, as was the $10 price tag. That being said, I'm sure the "fanciness" of the place is what makes it so appealing to folks. It really is quite unique and cute for our area and would be a good place to go with the gals (rather than my husband who hates all things trendy, lol). 

My problem, though, was with the service. We placed our order for the carrot cake with a nice young teenager, and then waited. And waited. I could see the carrot cake just sitting in the pretty covered cake stand, and I felt really tempted to just slice it myself. After a bit (felt like 10 minutes, although I'm sure it was more like 5 or 6), another employee came and sliced the carrot cake, setting the slice on the back counter with the ticket. And then we waited. And waited some more. After about another 5 to 10 minutes, I flagged the teenager down and asked if he could box up the cake for us. He seemed confused, and it took an awkward minute-long exchange for him to understand we hadn't yet received our order. He did apologize for the wait, which I do appreciate, boxed up the cake, and then we were on our way.

I should clarify that we did not go into the shop at a busy time. It was a relatively cool day and not many people were out. While there were maybe 2 to 3 tables seated, we were the only ones at the counter ordering. And while I'm sure the wait staff who repeatedly walked by our lonely piece of carrot cake sitting on the back counter had many important tasks...I just wanted to eat my $10 cake.

Four stars for the cake. Two stars for the service.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a decent experience at the fancy and unique local cake shop. The carrot cake was good, but not exceptional, and the $10 price seemed high. The service was lacking, with a long wait for our order and confusion about boxing it up. The cake gets four stars, but the service gets only two stars.

input: Excellent tasting food and great service. Best burgers and pulled pork we have had in reno/sparks area.  It will now be our new spot

input:
The gym part of City Fitness is better than most, good equipment, clean, variety, it's a nice gym. I find the rates reasonable and have been a member since they opened and will continue to be a member. So, for the rating I give the gym at CF a 3.5 star, I give MBSC a 1.5 star for an overall 2.5 star rating.

MBSC review: I thought I would kick it up a notch so joined the MBSC thrive program at CF on South Street and tried it for three months. Trainers really aren't "personal" trainers. They have a set program that they put people through and you have very little to say about what you like/don't like. The trainers work with several people in a session so depending on how many people are in a session you could be waiting for the trainer to get back to you or waiting for the person in front of you to finish. One of the things that frustrated me is they want you to push through the routine they have come up for you in the hour's time. The sessions are hard with ropes, sleds, balls, bands, cables, weights and the most uncomfortable stationary bike I've ever had to sit on (and they make you end every session on the thing). No two sessions are alike - so if you like variety then great, if you like consistency or at least enough repetition to get the moves and form down then not so great. I seldom found a session to be fun or enjoyable, rather I often felt like I was a contestant on the Biggest Loser. They also play hip-hop all day long and you either like it or you don't. The environment and training is designed (in my opinion) to appeal to 20-30yo demographic.

If you really want to push yourself beyond your limits and don't care how you get there then you might really enjoy the MBSC program. If you want a professional personal trainer to spend quality time with you in achieving your goals and if you want a training program that you actually learn what muscle groups you are working and not just to be pushed through a routine then you probably won't like MBSC. Definitely do a introductory program because the usual 30 day notice from the contract date applies if you cancel and it's $200+/mo program.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
City Fitness (CF) has a superior gym with good equipment, cleanliness, and a variety of options. The rates are reasonable, and I have been a member since they opened and will continue to be. I give CF's gym a rating of 3.5 stars. 

However, my experience with MBSC, specifically the thrive program at CF on South Street, was not as positive. The trainers are not truly personalized trainers, as they have a set program for everyone with little input from the individual. Sessions often involve waiting for the trainer or others to finish, and the focus is on pushing through a challenging routine. The sessions include various exercises with ropes, sleds, balls, bands, cables, weights, and an uncomfortable stationary bike. Each session is different, which could be great for variety but not ideal for consistency or learning proper form. The atmosphere and training style cater more towards the 20-30-year-old demographic, with hip-hop music playing throughout.

If you enjoy pushing yourself to the limit and don't mind how you get there, you may enjoy the MBSC program. However, if you prefer personalized attention, learning about muscle groups, and a more structured training program, MBSC may not be the best fit. I recommend trying an introductory program before committing to the monthly cost of $200+ and being aware of the 30-day notice period for cancellation.

input:
Four stars for price. 
I drive truck, so I've eaten bbq all over America. This place is better than most, but it's certainly not 4 star worthy. I'd say the food is more like 2.5 star. 
The cheeseburger was quite large and the meat was tasty. (Be advised: if you don't stop them they'll automatically put that disgusting invention called mayonnaise on it.) I got it plain so I can't comment on their lettuce/tomato game. 
The pork bbq sammich was soggy on the bottom. Moist is good, but this was just plain wet. The meat itself was bland but not bad. 
The bbq sauce is pretty good but not great. 
The Mac & Cheese tasted ok but the noodles were way overcooked. It'd be much better if it were baked and had a little crustiness to it. 

If I lived local I'm sure I'd come here occasionally.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Four stars for price. The food at this BBQ place is better than most places I've been to across America, but it falls short of being 4-star worthy. I would rate it around 2.5 stars. The cheeseburger was large and tasty, though they automatically put mayonnaise on it unless you ask otherwise. I didn't try their lettuce/tomato. The pork BBQ sandwich was soggy and wet, lacking flavor but not terrible. The BBQ sauce is good but not outstanding. The Mac & Cheese tasted okay, but the noodles were overcooked. It would be better if it were baked with a crust. If I lived nearby, I would visit occasionally.

input:
So we've been wanting to try the sushiritos since they opened up a location closer to us and we finally tried it last Friday. 

I got the slammin' salmon and my wife got the crunch. I'd say they both definitely had fresh ingredients, and definitely tasted fresh, but I think the balance of flavors wasn't quite right for the slammin' salmon. Way too heavy on the sauce, completely overpowering the crisp fresh veggies and salmon. 

We tried the Japanese fried chicken. Sauce is a little sweet and sour. And the chicken was a little dry. 

We also tried their green tea and lemonade, which were pretty good, but you don't come to a place like this because their green tea and lemonade are their best things on the menu. 

Overall, you pay a high premium for a gimmicky meal. With this location being essentially at a revolving door of new customers on the corner of Penn's campus, I think they have the potential to do well. But I don't think I'll be coming back. We'll take our $34 elsewhere.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We finally tried the sushiritos last Friday. I had the slammin' salmon and my wife had the crunch. The ingredients tasted fresh but the balance of flavors was off for the slammin' salmon, with too much sauce overpowering the veggies and salmon. The Japanese fried chicken was a bit sweet and sour, and the chicken was dry. The green tea and lemonade were decent, but not the highlight of the menu. Overall, it's a pricey meal for a gimmicky experience. Though they have potential, we won't be returning. Our $34 is better spent elsewhere.

input:

We tried Goober Vitis (peanut butter and jelly), Suzy's Cherry Pie, and the coffee one. All were PERFECT. Flavors are pure, beautiful nose, all around great. 

The space is very nice, nice big tables that seat 6-8 easily, an L-shaped bar, a stand-up bar around the tanks, then there are picnic tables outside.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Wow! Today, a new meadery opened up nearby, giving us the fortunate opportunity to have two meaderies within a short distance. Mead is a fermented honey beverage with an alcohol content typically ranging from 10-14%, similar to wine. We had the pleasure of trying their Goober Vitis (peanut butter and jelly), Suzy's Cherry Pie, and the coffee-infused mead, and they were all absolutely perfect. The flavors were pure and the aroma was delightful. The space itself is also impressive, featuring large tables that comfortably seat 6-8 people, an L-shaped bar, a stand-up bar surrounding the tanks, as well as outdoor picnic tables.

No one came and checked in if the work was done properly. I'm fine that it takes longer, they are there to learn. However, I shouldn't have been charged for the manicure (pedicure yes) or at least have someone else redo my nails. See the pictures for yourselves, this is 15 minutes out!

Edit: just wanted to add that when I removed my shoes, my pedi was ruined. I asked if it was ready to put shoes on and I was told yes. 2 stars only because at least my student was nice but 0 for the service (34$!)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a disappointing experience during my recent mani and pedi appointment. Despite friendly conversation with my student, the whole process took 3 hours and my hands ended up looking terrible. There was no follow-up to check if the work was done properly and my nails were left in a bad state. While I understand that the students need time to learn, I believe I should not have been charged for the manicure or at least offered to have someone else redo my nails. You can see the poor condition of my hands in the pictures I have included. Additionally, my pedicure was ruined when I removed my shoes, even though I was told it was ready to put shoes on. I rate my experience with 2 stars due to the student's friendliness, but the service itself deserves 0 stars, especially considering the $34 cost.

input: Very nice, quiet and dark restaurant. Chinese and sushi offered. Had szechuan chicken, hot and sour soup, and steamed rice. Hubbie had the prime rib and shrimp hot pot. Just the right amount of food. Didn't have to take any home. Service was excellent.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great, dimly lit restaurant serving Chinese and sushi cuisine. Our meal included delicious dishes like Szechuan chicken, hot and sour soup, steamed rice, prime rib, and shrimp hot pot. Portions were satisfying, and we didn't need any takeout. The service was excellent.

input: Frank is a great dentist and a very nice guy. He has a gentle manner, takes a sincere interest in his patients and in general is a top quality dentist and person. If you are in the market for a dentist he is an excellent choice. I've gone to him for years and know many others who have as well.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Frank is an excellent choice for a dentist. He is skilled, kind, and genuinely cares about his patients. I have been going to him for years, and so have many others.

input: This was a nice spot with sidewalk lounge seating. Even had a DJ outside Friday night. There was a walk up bar outside too. The decor inside was pretty sweet. We tried a few appetizers and they were both good! It is located in a trendy waterfront area.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This spot had sidewalk lounge seating and even featured a DJ outside on Friday nights. Additionally, there was a walk-up bar outside. The interior decor was stylish, and we enjoyed some delicious appetizers. It is conveniently situated in a trendy waterfront area.

input:
Our office went today for Friday's happy hour special.  Such a great deal, and it wasn't packed.  Didn't expect it, but the food and drinks on their specials-amazing!  Usually the happy hour offerings wouldn't be. Definitely try the pork sliders and the beignets for dessert.  Really fun time and great atmosphere.

Staff was very friendly too!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Our office enjoyed Friday's happy hour today. The deal was great and the place was not overcrowded. Surprisingly, the food and drinks on the specials menu were amazing. Highly recommend trying the pork sliders and the beignets for dessert. The atmosphere was fantastic and the staff was very friendly.

input: Stopped in tonight for a light bite to eat. I was so impressed! Great service, great fresh, fresh food and beautiful atmosphere- we sat outside in the warm October evening air.  Lisa was a great host, explaining the menu and checked in with us frequently - we ended up chatting with her quite a bit and that only made the whole evening more enjoyable. What a wonderful place- we will certainly be back for more!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Stopped in tonight for a light bite and was thoroughly impressed. Amazing service, delicious fresh food, and a beautiful atmosphere. We enjoyed sitting outside in the warm October evening air. Lisa, our host, was fantastic - she explained the menu and regularly checked in on us, which led to delightful conversations throughout the evening. A truly wonderful place, and we definitely plan on returning for more.

input: I've been to Lush in Arizona, S.F., San Jose and Maui. The one in New Orleans is My favorite one. I love how you can smell a Lush store from a block away. :) I've been to this one a few times, Always on Halloween. Always a fun time :)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I have visited Lush stores in Arizona, San Francisco, San Jose, and Maui. However, my favorite one is located in New Orleans. I love how you can smell a Lush store from a block away. I have been to this particular store multiple times, always on Halloween, and it is always a fun time.

input: Love love love this place for HH n dinner is good too! Its ok for brunch, not as great as what people praise it to be. The Asian Nachos are the dish to get for HH. Its an entree itself! The other HH dishes are great too. The creme brulee is amazing as with their other desserts. The blueberry mojito is awesome along with the mango sling. Great place to celebrate birthdays and such.  Nice feel to it. Bar area gets crowded as it gets later for HH. As usual around the mall, finding parking sux!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Love this place for happy hour and dinner, and the Asian Nachos are a must-try. Brunch is just okay, not as amazing as people say. The creme brulee and other desserts are delicious. The blueberry mojito and mango sling are fantastic. Perfect for birthday celebrations and has a nice vibe. The bar area gets crowded later in the evening for happy hour. However, finding parking around the mall is a hassle as usual.

input: Delicious top shelf pastries. I am outraged at the poor ratings. If you're looking for cheapness over flavor then go to Panera. Service has always been exceedingly pleasent when I go, and I am an obnoxious needy customer. We are so excited to have them make macaroons for our wedding.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Delicious top shelf pastries. Outraged by poor ratings. If you prioritize cheapness over flavor, go to Panera. Service is always exceptionally pleasant, even for demanding customers like myself. Excited to have them create macaroons for our wedding.

input: I could be craving pizza and be walking by and STILL not go in again. I will say the ingredients are definitely fresh and service was great however the pizza is just plain not good. The crust is so thin that the pizza is cold within a few minutes and it was just a little floppy and bland. I wanted to love this place but with so many other pizzerias in the area I won't be going back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite fresh ingredients and great service, the pizza at this place is plain and not good. The thin crust makes it cold quickly and it lacks flavor. Although I wanted to love it, with many other pizzerias in the area, I won't be returning.

input: Love the tap room, but I can't seem to get the hours of business right.  My first visit was a kinda a let down.  I had heard that bier was the place to go for great beers in Indianapolis, but I only found 2 that I liked and only 1 was memorable.  However, bier rotates their taps weekly and does not seem to have any regular taps, I like this because it means that they are constantly challenging themselves to create a better beer.   The tap room is a lot of fun too with people constantly revolving around the taps to taste and find their favorite for the week and then relaxing and talking in the lounge area.  I only gave them 3stars this time but I look forward to improving their score after future visits.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I enjoy the tap room, but struggle with their inconsistent business hours. My first visit was a bit disappointing as I was expecting a great variety of beers, but only found two that I liked and only one that stood out. Despite this, I appreciate that bier rotates their taps weekly, as it shows their dedication to constantly improving their beer selection. The tap room is lively and enjoyable, with patrons constantly trying different beers and then relaxing in the lounge area. Although I only gave them 3 stars this time, I am hopeful that future visits will warrant a higher rating.

input: Beautifully sweet ending to a sweet trip to NOLA with the girls. We stumbled upon this after a delicous savory lunch nearby at Cochon (review to follow). Sweet Confections is on Magazine St, around corner from the art gallery strip on Julia St.   We had a sampling of cupcake (chocolate with mocha filling) and truffles (raspberry, creme brulee, and orange).  Cupcake was good, mocha filling best part. Rasberry truffle was my fav, love the dark chocolate so it's not cloyingly sweet. The coffee was a wonderful chaser, not overly burnt, smoky, or acidic... I usually have coffee with milk n sugar, forgot this time, but I didn't even need it!  Seating was nice, with a few cafe tables inside. Enough for our 6-girl troop. And service was great, helpful with flavor suggestions and labelling.  Gave 4 of 5 stars because maybe they could benefit from one more equally gracious staff person.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Ended sweet trip to NOLA with the girls at Sweet Confections on Magazine St. Had a delicious lunch nearby at Cochon. Tried a chocolate cupcake with mocha filling and truffles in raspberry, creme brulee, and orange flavors. Cupcake was good, mocha filling was the highlight. Raspberry truffle was my favorite, not overly sweet. Coffee was excellent, didn't need milk or sugar. Nice seating with enough space for our group of six. Great service, although one more staff member would be helpful. 4 out of 5 stars.

input: Pulled pork sandwich was Delicious .. BUT! The lucky bun (Asian fusion style ) burger . Was a disappointment for the sole purpose of them using a frozen beef patty :/  the bread was good .. The toppings and sauces were great .. But just killed the flavors with a processed frozen beef patty .. If used a fresh ground meat .. It would have been a great gourmet burger ..
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The pulled pork sandwich was delicious. However, the Asian fusion-style Lucky Bun burger was disappointing because they used a frozen beef patty, which affected the flavors. The bread, toppings, and sauces were great, but the processed meat took away from its potential as a gourmet burger.

input: This is a great place to bring the kids to. They can have juice, a slice of cake, and homemade popsicles. They think it is a tea party. I have tried everything once and my favorites are the homemade doughnuts filled with read bean, the popsicles, the patbingsu, and even the good ol' coffee cream and sugar.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is perfect for kids. They can enjoy juice, cake, and homemade popsicles, feeling like they're attending a tea party. I've sampled various items and highly recommend the red bean-filled homemade doughnuts, popsicles, patbingsu, and even their classic coffee with cream and sugar.

input: Always awesome!  Best crust ever and super Fresh ingredients and nice staff.  Lots of yummy toppings that aren't offered at other pizza places.   Great salads too! Patio area is a cool place to kick back,have a beer or glass of wine and savor the best pizza in town.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Always awesome! Best crust, fresh ingredients, nice staff. Lots of unique toppings not found elsewhere. Great salads too! Enjoy the cool patio area to relax, drink beer or wine, and savor the best pizza in town.

input: I love this gas station. I work at a hotel on the beach and send guests here just about every day. Also it's the only one on Clearwater Beach that's open 27/7
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I frequently recommend this gas station to guests at my beachfront hotel as it is the only one open 24/7 on Clearwater Beach.

input: Holy bat crap, this place is amazing. Go to place in St. Pete, anything on the menu was good. Food coma!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place in St. Pete is absolutely amazing! Everything on the menu is delicious, and the food will definitely leave you in a food coma.

input:
This Chipotle location was great! I wanted to thank Chipotle for recognizing teachers for Teacher Appreciation Week! 
The line was very small and they served quickly as a pose to another location that had the line wrapped around the store! 
Their food is always fresh, tasteful and fulfilling! 
My go to is always the bowl with white cilantro lime rice,black beans, steak and all the toppings! 
Must eat with a bag of fresh tortilla chips!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Chipotle location was amazing! I'm grateful to them for recognizing teachers during Teacher Appreciation Week. The line was small and service was quick, unlike another location with a long line. Their food is always fresh, tasty, and filling. My favorite order is a bowl with white cilantro lime rice, black beans, steak, and all the toppings. Don't forget to enjoy it with a bag of fresh tortilla chips!

input: Standard Jimmy Johns fare: nothing especially good or bad about this one. Restaurant was very clean.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Standard Jimmy Johns fare; nothing remarkable, but no major flaws either. The restaurant was exceptionally clean.

input: I Recently vacationed in St. Petersburg with my family. Dooners was definitely my favorite meal of the trip. Great food and incredibly helpful and friendly staff. Would definitely recommend to anyone, and wouldn't hesitate to go again.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I loved my recent vacation in St. Petersburg with my family. As for meals, Dooners was hands down my favorite. The food was amazing and the staff was exceptionally helpful and friendly. I highly recommend it to anyone and would definitely go back without hesitation.

input:
Very cool bar attached to the Alexander Hotel. Several vintage cocktails from pre-prohibition are on the menu. None cooler than "The Elephant in the Room" a bourbon cocktail which comes in its own decanter filled with cherrywood smoke. You decide how long to let it infuse. Lots of comfortable seating and when it warms up a touch a large beautiful deck with seating and heating overlooks the street life. As an added bonus you can relax and watch people work out through the glass of the new CityWay YMCA. 
And yes the truffle oil and sea salt popcorn that greets every patron is as good as it sounds. Get a beer and start collecting bags, once you start you can't stop.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Cool bar attached to the Alexander Hotel with vintage cocktails from pre-prohibition on the menu. Must-try cocktail is "The Elephant in the Room" served in its own decanter filled with cherrywood smoke, allowing you to control the infusion time. Ample comfortable seating available, and a beautiful deck with seating and heating offers a street life view when it warms up. Additionally, you can watch people work out at the adjacent CityWay YMCA through the glass. Don't miss the truffle oil and sea salt popcorn, it's as delicious as it sounds. Grab a beer and start collecting bags, as this addictive popcorn will keep you coming back for more.

input:
This hotel is a gem in the heart of Philadelphia.

It's a cozy, quaint, and charming property. The rooms are spacious, modern and gorgeous. 
The decor is chic and attractive: big wooden desk, hardwood floors, couches and throw pillows: Looks more like a friend's apartment than a hotel. 

Free breakfast is always a plus for those of us with limited time.
