Luckily, they allowed me to exchange the products, but I had to spend additional money. Furthermore, I noticed that the new receipt had a prominent "FINAL SALE" stamp on it. Overall, I am still not impressed with the products and have decided not to shop there again. Fortunately, Sephora in KOP offers the same Make Up For Ever products and has a return policy that allows for returns of unopened or gently used items. Therefore, I will opt to shop there instead.

input:
My favorite happy hour spot. Discovered how amazing all the appetizers are back in summer 2011 center city sips (great time to check out all the different center city happy hour spots). The mac & cheese is great!

They have a great selection of beers on tap and bottles. The food is superb! If you're looking for a private party space, they have a cozy basement space with a personal bar. Only thing is occasionally you'll have some crashers who want to use the ATM and restroom (even though there is one on the second floor and 2 on the 3rd)

Just go! You won't be disappointed
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My favorite happy hour spot is a great place I discovered during summer 2011 called center city sips. It's a fantastic opportunity to explore various center city happy hour spots. The appetizers are amazing, especially the mac & cheese. They have an excellent selection of beers on tap and bottles. The food is superb, and they even have a cozy basement space with a personal bar available for private parties. The only downside is occasional crashers who want to use the ATM and restroom, despite there being multiple other options in the building. But overall, I highly recommend checking it out - you won't be disappointed.

input: There's been three times that I've ordered a green tea lemonade and got a peach tea lemonade and had to turn all the way back and go inside and have theme remake it.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I have ordered a green tea lemonade three times, but mistakenly received a peach tea lemonade. As a result, I had to return to the store and have them make the correct drink.

input:
This was mine and my fiancé's first time eating here because it not only just opened up, but I got a coupon for a free pizza, so why not right?

We weren't blown away with the experience or the pizza, but liked that it was fast and efficient. The staff that made that pizza was very friendly, but the cashier wasn't sharing that same enthusiasm. 

Wouldn't drive out of my way to go here, but if we are in the neighborhood and feel like some pizza, we may go back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My fiancé and I tried this place for the first time as it recently opened and I had a coupon for a free pizza. While the experience and pizza didn't impress us, we appreciated the fast and efficient service. The pizza-making staff were friendly, although the cashier lacked enthusiasm. We wouldn't go out of our way to come here, but if we're in the neighborhood and craving pizza, we might return.

input: My husband son and I went in for dinner last Friday night. Upon entering we were greeted by a friendly hostess. As we stood there waiting for her to grab the menus I couldn't help but to notice a strong dirty mop water stench. Thankfully when we left the entry way it didn't carry into the dining room. The remodel is impressive looking. We were sat at a booth. Looking over the menu I was surprised at how limited it was. As long as you make what you offer well no biggie. I ordered the mushroom swiss burger and a beer. My husband ordered the "knuckle sandwich", ( tri-tip sandwich served French dip style). My son ordered the chicken strips and we all got French fries as our side. Jesse, our server was nice enough but in the loud dining room you couldn't hear a word he said. I was more annoyed that he didn't take the initiative to speak up than about the noise. The beer came out, although tasty it wasn't cold enough at all. The food came out within a reasonable amount of time. My husband's "Knuckle Sandwich" was delicious! That is what the two stars are for. My burger was shockingly small and probably the blandest burger I have ever eaten. My son's chicken strips tasted like they floured them...and that was it... also, no hint of seasoning. The fries are your run of the mill freezer to fryer. I hope they step it up and are successful.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Last Friday night, my husband, son, and I went for dinner. We were greeted by a friendly hostess, but noticed a strong dirty mop water stench. Thankfully, it didn't carry into the dining room. The remodel looked impressive. We were seated at a booth with limited menu options. I ordered a mushroom swiss burger and a beer, while my husband ordered a "knuckle sandwich" and my son ordered chicken strips. We all got French fries as our side. Our server, Jesse, was nice but hard to hear in the loud dining room. The beer wasn't cold enough, but the food arrived reasonably quickly. My husband's sandwich was delicious, earning the two stars. However, my burger was small and bland, and my son's chicken strips lacked seasoning. The fries were average. I hope they improve and succeed.

input: I had a delicious breakfast at Tuttini a few months ago.  I went back for lunch recently and was excited by their sandwich offerings, however, I was not served.  It was 1:45 PM, and their sign states that they serve lunch until 2:30 PM.  I waited in line for 7 or 8 minutes before a woman came out to tell me that the kitchen was closing.  Closing over 30 minutes early!  She said she might be able to make something to go.  So, if you can make something to go, doesn't that mean the kitchen is not yet closed?  Besides, I wanted to have a few minutes to relax in the cozy restaurant and enjoy my sandwich, not gulf it down on the street, so I left.  I got a sandwich at North Star Coffee around the corner and gave them my $10 instead.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a delicious breakfast at Tuttini a few months ago. Excited by their sandwich offerings, I went back for lunch recently. However, despite their sign stating that lunch is served until 2:30 PM, I was not served when I arrived at 1:45 PM. After waiting in line for 7 or 8 minutes, a woman informed me that the kitchen was closing. It was disappointing to see them closing over 30 minutes early. Although she offered to make something to go, I preferred to relax in the cozy restaurant and enjoy my sandwich. Consequently, I left and went to North Star Coffee around the corner, where I purchased a sandwich with my $10 instead.

input: Quick& friendly service, great portion size for the price and the pancakes I ordered were the perfect consistency.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Quick and friendly service, generous portion size for the price, and the pancakes had perfect consistency.

input: I've eaten here numerous times and every time it's been absolutely fantastic. Great food, nice people, calm and quiet place. Their crepes are the best crepes I have ever had. Amazingly delicious. I recommend this place to my friends all the time. I've always heard great things from them as well.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I highly recommend this place - amazing food, friendly staff, and a peaceful atmosphere. The crepes are the best I've ever tasted. I have been here multiple times and always had a fantastic experience. My friends also love it.

input: I have purchased tires from Tires Plus in Flourtown at least 4 times. On this visit they mounted 4 new Michelins that I supplied. My car was worked on as soon as I arrived for the scheduled appointment at 9:00 and was returned to me within one hour.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I bought tires from Tires Plus in Flourtown four times. During my latest visit, they mounted four new Michelins that I provided. I arrived for my scheduled 9:00 appointment and my car was worked on immediately. Within one hour, my car was returned to me.

input:
Its a great place for Brunch.
We tried the Wildflower Triple where you can substitute any of the 3 items with sausage or biscuit or anything else. We couldn't figure out which one we wanted to try, so this choice was easy! 
The food was spectacular and the service was very friendly! 
We are here for two more days, so we might come back tomorrow or the day after.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great brunch spot. We had the Wildflower Triple, which allows substitutions. Couldn't decide on just one, so it was the perfect choice. Food was amazing and the service was friendly. Might return during our stay.

input: We had a great experience enjoying happy hour here! Vaughn and Mark are so kind, we will absolutely be back to get that same service. It's truly one of a kind. The free appetizer was awesome and the slot machines at the bar brought us luck. What a fun happy hour with amazing service!! It's a must!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had a fantastic experience at this place's happy hour! Vaughn and Mark were incredibly kind, and we will definitely be returning for their exceptional service. The free appetizer was wonderful, and we even had some luck with the slot machines at the bar. Overall, a must-visit for a fun and enjoyable happy hour with amazing service!

input: Finally warming up for yogurt!!! They have crepes here too! It's awesome come try them
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Yogurt and crepes now available - come try them!

input: The event started at 1 and we got there about 1:30. It was so packed you could not enjoy yourself. Most of tents were not even wine, either advertisment, beer, or food you had to pay for. By 3 o' clock most of the tables were out of everything... It was suppose to go till 5?! Definitely was not worth the money and probably will not be back next year.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The event began at 1:00, but we arrived around 1:30. Unfortunately, it was incredibly crowded, making it difficult to have a good time. The majority of the tents were not offering wine; instead, they were focusing on advertising, beer, or paid food options. By 3:00, most tables had run out of their supplies, even though the event was scheduled until 5:00. Overall, it was disappointing and not worth the money. We will likely not attend again next year.

input:
I've only eaten here twice and my experience has been great overall. The first time I went, they had just opened. There were some kinks but not anything I would complain about. After all, our group had 8 people so it was understandable. Second time was probably a month later and I noticed they figured out some of the kinks. Their servers are nice and I genuinely felt like they wanted to make my experience great. I know this because every time I made a request the waiter would literally run to get it. I've never seen a server so dedicated, kudos! Honestly most of the stars I'm giving them is because of their genuine service. Added bonus, they were playing Star Trek, hunger games, and iron man. Nice movie selections haha.

The seafood was ok. It's not their fault; it's Tucson so you know you really can't get fresh seafood. That's why I took off a star. They have 1 type of sauce with mild, medium, hot spiciness. It's similar to angry crab's "trifecta" or boiling crab's, "the whole shabang" but with an Asian twist. It was good in my opinion.

Lastly, if anyone has ever gone to angry crab, hot n juicy, boiling crab, should know that the price range is similar. Heck, if anyone has ever bought raw seafood at the store should know that it is on the expensive side. Expensive? Yes. Overpriced? No. I have been to many seafood places similar to this and it's a decent price for what you get. My advice for the Dungeness crab, since it did happen to me at other places and I saw a review on it here, is to share it or get their other selections that they can measure out. The dungeness crab is a full crab so finding a 1 lb dungeness crab is not common. 

Would recommend and go again.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
Overall, I've eaten at this restaurant twice and had a great experience. During my first visit, they had just opened and there were a few minor issues, which were understandable considering our large group of 8 people. However, on my second visit, about a month later, they had sorted out most of the kinks. The servers were friendly and went above and beyond to make sure I had a great experience. They were prompt in fulfilling any requests I had. The highlight for me was their genuine service. Additionally, they played movies like Star Trek, Hunger Games, and Iron Man, which was a nice added bonus.

The seafood was decent, given that it's Tucson and fresh seafood is hard to come by. I deducted a star for this reason. They offer a sauce with mild, medium, or hot spiciness levels, reminiscent of Angry Crab's "Trifecta" or Boiling Crab's "The Whole Shabang," but with an Asian twist. I personally found it to be good.

In terms of price, it is comparable to other similar seafood restaurants like Angry Crab, Hot N Juicy, and Boiling Crab. While it may be expensive, it is not overpriced considering the cost of raw seafood in general. I would suggest sharing the Dungeness crab or opting for their other portioned selections, as finding a 1 lb Dungeness crab is uncommon. 

Overall, I would recommend this restaurant and I would definitely go again.

input: Food was well prepared and fresh. I had the oso bucco ravioli. The ravioli were definitely homemade, they were a little light on the filling which made them less flavourful then they should have been. Service was great,  the place was so loud the wait staff had a hard time hearing us unless we raised our voice. Good place. Extremely tiny and tables are jammed in. Not recommended for a date night. With so many great places to eat in this neighborhood the only thing that would bring me back is the fact it's bring your own bottle. Otherwise I know I could find something as good or better with less noise, a tad more elbow room, and more flavor
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food was well prepared and fresh, particularly the homemade oso bucco ravioli. However, the ravioli were lacking in filling, resulting in less flavor than expected. Service was great, but the loud atmosphere made it difficult for wait staff to hear us without raising our voices. Although the place is good, it is extremely tiny and tables are tightly packed, making it not recommended for a date night. Despite this, the only reason I would consider returning is the fact that it is bring your own bottle. Otherwise, there are plenty of other great options in the neighborhood with less noise and more flavor, as well as a bit more space.

input:
I moved to Philadelphia from the midwest as a wide eyed 19 year old full of wonder. Yuengling lager was the first beer I've ever truly enjoyed and remains in my top five favorites of all time. Smooth, sweet, cheap, it's like me in a bottle. I love that the bottlecaps can be rusty, I like that the taste varies per batch, I even like its relatively low alcohol content. 

The tour was pretty great, the British tour woman was funny in a non canned way. She took a shine to my grandpa and was constantly begging him to sell her his hat (signed, sports, I haven't a clue). I was amazed at how close they let you get to the active equipment, I could've spit in the mash and no one would've been the wiser. The whole facility reminded me of St. Pete Catholic High, 50's cinderblock with a residue of toil clinging to the walls. 

The tasting, that's what you came for right? Fantastic. They were out of Lord Chesterfield, but who drinks that? I "tasted" the shit out of the lager, probably 6 times. It makes sense, the bar is next to the gift shop and I went a bit insane in there. 

The fact that Dick Yuengling made it a point to hire back the laid off workers after the last closure bumps it up a star. This is a family business, one that deserves support as Inbev has encroached upon everything else.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I moved to Philadelphia from the Midwest at 19 and fell in love with Yuengling lager. It's one of my top five favorite beers - smooth, sweet, cheap, and just like me in a bottle. I even appreciate the rusty bottle caps and the varying taste per batch. The tour was great, with a funny British tour guide who took a liking to my grandpa. The facility reminded me of my high school, and they let you get really close to the equipment. The tasting was fantastic, although they were out of Lord Chesterfield. But who drinks that anyway? I enjoyed the lager multiple times, thanks to the conveniently located bar. What I really admire about Yuengling is that they hired back laid off workers after a closure. It's a family business that deserves support, especially with Inbev encroaching on everything else.

input:
Came here with some friends during Mardi Gras. Even though it was a busy weekend and lots of people everywhere a lot of places aren't over crowded. The bartenders were just awful. The service was lacking and the pizza sucked. 

PROS:
-They had Port-O-Potty (2) put back which made it easier for a bathroom break
-Outdoor seating area
-Near the parade route (convenient) 

CONS:
-Bartenders don't take drink orders properly: they skip people, ignore you at the bar when you walk up (it wasn't that busy), lots of standing around
-Bartenders didn't know what microbrew meant or IPA beers (no joke)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
During Mardi Gras, visited with friends. Despite the large crowds, many places were not overcrowded. However, had a negative experience with the bartenders as they provided poor service and the pizza was subpar. 

PROS: 
- Convenient access to Port-O-Potties 
- Outdoor seating available 
- Located near the parade route 

CONS:
- Bartenders struggled with taking drink orders, skipped customers and ignored patrons at the bar 
- Lack of knowledge regarding microbrews and IPA beers

input: Really nice place to get a pedicure! People are very friendly and it is a relaxing environment. Definitely recommend if you are looking for a clean place to get your toes done!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Highly recommend this clean and relaxing place for a friendly and enjoyable pedicure experience.

input: Nice new burger spot downtown! They are apart of the harry & izzys chain. The burgers are pretty good. You do have to order a side separately which kinda sticks but seems to be a trend these days. They take reservations so that's always a plus. If you are looking for additional options besides a burger might not be your best spot to go. I'd like to see them do a lunch special during the week for those that go during the work day. I think it would help with costs and getting a bigger lunch crowd. Overall great experience and service. Check them out!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: New downtown burger spot, part of the Harry & Izzys chain. Good burgers, but sides are ordered separately. They take reservations. Limited non-burger options. Lunch special suggested for workday visitors. Great experience and service. Check it out!

input: Salad was good.  Pizza is not good!  Boring, tasteless and just unsatisfying.  Very disappointed.  Also on a chilly night it is a cold interior.  This was my third try there.  Won't go back
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The salad was good, but the pizza was disappointing. It was boring, tasteless, and unsatisfying. The cold interior on a chilly night added to the letdown. This was my third visit, and I won't be returning.

input: Not impressed at all. Sandwich bar was closed so I ordered a burrito. It was reheated in the microwave, cost 8 bucks, and nasty. Some sort of cream of chicken and old cheese on top. I'm amazed they can sell this and call it food. Could have had better at taco bell.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Very disappointed. The sandwich bar was closed, so I had to settle for a reheated microwave burrito, which was both expensive at 8 dollars and unpleasant. It had an unappetizing mixture of cream of chicken and old cheese on top. I am shocked that this is considered food and believe Taco Bell would have been a better alternative.

input:
I have visited the brewpub several times now, and I'm finally ready to write up a review.  I really like the decor here.  It's old-school brewpub with lots of games for children.  The beer is pretty good.  I wish they would do some more adventurous offerings, but I can still get a good beer here.  
The food can be a mixed bag.  I had a small pizza that was a gooey mess (mushrooms and hearty toppings need a thick crust for stability).  I love all the scotch egg offerings (you can get it on a pizza or burger here), but they are so salty.  The burgers are good. The desserts are great (please get the frangipane).  It's also great to get the ploughman's plate and a beer, and just relax for a bit.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I've been to the brewpub multiple times now and I'm finally ready to review it. The decor is old-school and they have plenty of games for children. The beer is good, but I wish they would offer more adventurous options. The food can be hit or miss - the small pizza I had was messy due to the lack of a thick crust for stability. However, they have delicious scotch egg offerings, though they can be a bit salty. The burgers are tasty and the desserts, particularly the frangipane, are great. I highly recommend getting the ploughman's plate with a beer and just relaxing for a while.

input:
I think if I could, I would give Zen Yai a 3.5 stars, but alas, c'est la vie. 

The prices for their curry are excellent, at less than $12. Zen Yai is a tiny place, which is both good and bad. Good if you don't have to wait, because it is nice and cozy, but bad if enough people eat here on a given evening -- because you may just have to wait a while.

I like the decor a lot, and the use of colors. The tables and plates are full of refreshingly bright colors. 

The service was fine, and the food was at our table in no time.

My Pineapple curry was excellent! And the rice is served in the shape of a pyramid, which is fun. 

All that being said, my girlfriend had a less than pleasurable experience. She is a seasoned green curry lover, and was disappointed with their green curry offering.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I would rate Zen Yai 3.5 stars if I could, but unfortunately, that's life. The prices for their curry are great, under $12. The small size of the restaurant is a mixed bag - good if there's no wait, but bad if it's crowded. The decor is visually appealing with vibrant colors on the tables and plates. The service was satisfactory and the food arrived quickly. Personally, I really enjoyed the Pineapple curry and the unique presentation of rice in a pyramid shape. However, my girlfriend, a green curry aficionado, was disappointed with their green curry.

input:
Having stayed here several times, it is my favorite hotel. The staff is excellent. Really exceptional. Everyone from housekeeping to front desk staff to valets.

Rooms are clean, heating and AC are quiet, beds are very comfortable and they make it feel special.

Special K is awesome. I cannot say enough about how wonderful and helpful he has been over all of our visits. One of the best reasons to visit this hotel. Did I mention the exceptional staff?

Turn-down service is Sucre chocolates on your pillow. Sweets for the sweet dreams.

The bathroom wasn't as slippery this time. 

This was the first time we used the valet service and it worked great. No more than a 10 minute wait for the car. You can text them from your phone and they text back with how long it will take.

They also hosted a Gold Status reception. We made a brief appearance on our way to a Mardi Gras ball.

Our only glitch was a mini-bar charge on our bill. We didn't consume any of their food or drink and they happily removed it from the bill.

We will be back. Note to hotel: please put Louis back in the elevator.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This hotel is my favorite because the staff is excellent, from the housekeeping to the front desk staff to the valets. The rooms are clean, with quiet heating and AC, comfortable beds, and a special touch. Special K is especially wonderful and helpful. The turn-down service includes Sucre chocolates on the pillow. The bathroom was less slippery this time. The valet service was efficient, with minimal wait times and convenient texting communication. There was also a Gold Status reception on our stay. The only issue was a mini-bar charge, which was promptly removed from our bill. We plan to return and request to have Louis back in the elevator.

input: Great rolls and sake. We sat in the bamboo room, which definitely added to the experience, if you are able and agile.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Delightful rolls and sake served in a bamboo room that enhances the experience, provided one possesses dexterity and flexibility.

input: First, I love that they offer food delivery! Second, THAT is a gyro! I got one delivered with fries, and actually I didn't need the fries! The gyro was so big I had to save half.  Both the fries and the gyro were very tasty. The tzaziki was spot on and the meat tender. I'll be back!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love that they offer food delivery, and I recently ordered a gyro with fries. The gyro was so big that I had to save half, and it was delicious. The fries were also very tasty. The tzaziki was perfect and the meat was tender. Overall, I was impressed and I will definitely be returning.

input: I stopped in to order take out and get a drink while I waited since it was happy hour. I am usually a beer drinker but I decided to step out of my comfort zone and ordered the dragonberry iced tea which was refreshing but not obnoxiously cocktail-ly, very pleasant. I had lemongrass chicken and crab rangoon, the lemon grass chicken and rice was fantastic. I do wish the crab rangoon had a little more filling but the dipping sauce was great. I've been here a few times and I have never been disappointed in the food or the service.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I ordered take out and a drink during happy hour. Although I typically drink beer, I decided to try something different and ordered the dragonberry iced tea, which was refreshingly pleasant. I had the lemongrass chicken and crab rangoon, and the chicken with rice was fantastic. However, I wished the crab rangoon had more filling, although the dipping sauce was great. Overall, I have never been disappointed with the food or service as I've been here multiple times.

input: Consistent quality and service.  Love the #1 Deluxe.  Props to Amanda for excellent customer service, above and beyond!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Consistent quality and service, especially with the #1 Deluxe. Special recognition to Amanda for going above and beyond with her excellent customer service.

input:
*note* I wrote a similar review on tripadvisor.
I really wanted to like this hotel- it was charming and in a great location, with cute, unique rooms. It was just my style. Unfortunately, some blood-sucking insects ruined that.
Yup- bed bugs. We found them the morning we were leaving, because they normally come out very early in the morning (we were up at 530). Bleck! The management let us stay as long as necessary to take care of the issue (ie throwing away a bunch of our stuff and bagging the rest in ziplocks to be boiled) but it didn't change the fact that it was gross and a huge inconvenience. I threw away about $300 worth of clothing, shoes and luggage and I'm still worried that we brought the creatures back to our house with us. 
I would never stay here again, and I would urge you to think twice about it. Without seeing every carpet and mattress in the place replaced, there's no way I'd trust that the bugs were gone.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I wanted to like this charming hotel in a great location with cute, unique rooms. However, my experience was ruined by the presence of bed bugs. We discovered them the morning of our departure, despite waking up early. The management allowed us to stay and take care of the issue, but it was still disgusting and highly inconvenient. I had to discard around $300 worth of belongings and I remain concerned about bringing the bugs back home with us. I would not stay here again and advise caution unless every carpet and mattress in the hotel is replaced to ensure the bugs are eradicated.

input: Still running on EST, we arrived @8:30 on a Saturday to find no wait to be seated OR helped, ordering up the sweet potato pancakes with cinnamon cream syrup (good topped with excellent) with some borderline awful hash browns (really, people??). Can't say I'd return even without a wait, though; would prefer to just buy a jar of the syrup and apply it at home. Ended up at $24.43 pre-tip; no paper towels in the restroom and the day had barely started, so that was probably a dogshow.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Arrived at 8:30 AM on a Saturday in EST time. No wait time to be seated or helped. Ordered sweet potato pancakes with cinnamon cream syrup, which was good but the hash browns were disappointing. Not likely to return, would rather buy the syrup and use it at home. Bill came to $24.43 pre-tip. Restroom lacked paper towels early in the day, indicating poor management.

input:
There never seems to be a crowd at this Marsh store...getting in and out is always easy.  I agree with the other reviewer on the state of red baskets...ick.  Fix please!

I like that they opened up aisles so you don't have to walk all the way to one end to go to the next (prob happened a long time ago but I just noticed today).  And always seems like they are one cashier short here.

Very good selection of products (as always) from Marsh.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The Marsh store is never crowded, making it easy to get in and out. I agree with another reviewer about the poor state of the red baskets, which needs fixing. I appreciate that the aisles have been opened up, allowing for easier navigation. However, it always feels like there is a shortage of cashiers here. Despite that, Marsh continues to offer a great selection of products.

input: Creative food and good. We get coffee or tea while we wait to be seated and even that is a cut above.  We love their Bloody Marys too.  Always interesting and an adventure.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Creative food and beverages, such as coffee, tea, and Bloody Marys, add to the enjoyable dining experience.

input: Wonderful atmosphere, great selection of beers.  We ordered the Asian chicken salads and the Cajun pasta and both were excellent. We will return again.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Amazing atmosphere and beer selection. Asian chicken salads and Cajun pasta were delectable. We'll definitely be back!

input: Love this place introduced almost 25 years ago when I enrolled at the UD and have loved ever since. For longest time it was basically just a Delaware treat but so happy it is so many more places now. Just want to know when you are coming to the Huntsville AL area. Sorry this review is not about this specific location but if it is half as good as others I have been to it will be great!!! This location has plenty of seating was real clean and playing good tunes as I waited. About only negative is it doesn't have Herrs chips like the Delaware locations but that is not really a problem.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I have loved Love this place ever since I enrolled at the UD almost 25 years ago. It was originally only in Delaware, but I'm happy it has expanded to many more places now. I'm just wondering when it will come to the Huntsville AL area. Sorry this review isn't about this specific location, but if it's half as good as others I've been to, it will be great! This location had plenty of seating, was clean, and played good tunes while I waited. The only negative is that it doesn't have Herrs chips like the Delaware locations, but that's not really a problem.

input: At first I thought the prices here were pretty decent, but then I realized that they charge for every add on- chips/salsa, rice and beans, etc. I would be fine with this if the food was exceptional, but it is subpar. Both times I've been here, my side order of rice has been hard and dry, and burritos sad and limp. Additionally, the waitress we've had the two times going there had a horrible attitude. The only thing that saves this place is the guac, and the strong margaritas. Their strategy must be to get people drunk enough to not care about what they're eating and the rude service.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Initially, I thought the prices were reasonable, but I soon realized that they charge for every add-on such as chips/salsa, rice, and beans. Unfortunately, the quality of the food is subpar. On both my visits, the rice was hard and dry, and the burritos were disappointing. Moreover, the waitress we encountered both times had a terrible attitude. The only redeeming factors are the delicious guacamole and strong margaritas. It seems their tactic is to get customers intoxicated enough to overlook the poor food and rude service.

input: My boyfriend and I have lived in trolley square for about three months now and tend to stick to the same restaurants.  We went out the other night planning on El Diablo and decided to try this cute little Italian restaurant. We are so glad we did! First off, the waiter was awesome, so friendly and on top of it.  He told us the history of the restaurant and gave us some good suggestions. The food was some of the best Italian food I have had in a long time. You can tell everything is made fresh.  The bread was delicious and a new recipe the owner received from his brother who lives in Sicily. We started off with the prosciutto wrapped Shrimp with a yummy sauce. I ordered the Penne Alla Vodka and my boyfriend ordered the traditional spaghetti and meatballs. The sauce in both dishes was excellent! The portions were a decent size with plenty of leftovers for my lunch the next day.  Finally, the cannoli was the best I have ever had! My boyfriend has been to Italy and said it was just as awesome as the ones he tasted there. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a delicious Italian meal for a good price.  The special he night we went was order two entrees and get any appetizer for free! Check this place out!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My boyfriend and I recently moved to trolley square and usually stick to our regular restaurants. However, the other night, we decided to try a cute little Italian place instead of our usual El Diablo. We were pleasantly surprised! The waiter was friendly and knowledgeable about the restaurant's history. The food was fantastic - the best Italian food I've had in a while. Everything tasted fresh, including the delicious bread, which had a new recipe from the owner's brother in Sicily. We started with the prosciutto wrapped Shrimp in a flavorful sauce. I ordered the Penne Alla Vodka and my boyfriend had the classic spaghetti and meatballs, both with excellent sauce. The portions were generous, and we had enough leftovers for my lunch the next day. And let's not forget the incredible cannoli - the best I've ever had. My boyfriend, who has been to Italy, said they were just as good as the ones he had there. Overall, I highly recommend this restaurant for delicious Italian food at a reasonable price. Plus, they had a great special that night - order two entrees and get any appetizer for free! Don't miss out on this place!

input: 3.5 stars because they don't serve alcohol (and I was in dire need of a drink after a veryyyy long week). Get the margherita pie - it is delicious and fresh. Also ordered the Greek salad for an appetizer which was filled with yummy veggies. Yum.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Overall 3.5 stars due to lack of alcohol service. Margherita pie is delicious and fresh. Greek salad appetizer filled with yummy veggies.

input: I love Mr. Wizard's because they offer frozen yogurt which is a  lot healthier than frozen custard. I like that they offer some pre-select combinations or you can create your own. The only part that sucks is that there is only outside seating so if it's cold outside, plan to eat in your car.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love Mr. Wizard's for their healthier frozen yogurt options compared to frozen custard. They have both pre-select combinations and the option to create your own. However, the downside is that there is only outdoor seating, so be prepared to eat in your car if it's cold outside.

input:
Not sure the significance behind the name and logo of the restaurant.  Unless it was three guys putting their money together to form this business 
The food was great/ staff friendly/ huge menu from breakfast /lunch/dinner to dessert.   Open 24 hours will definitely be back next time in town
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Unclear about the meaning behind the restaurant's name and logo, unless it relates to three individuals pooling their funds to establish the business. The restaurant offers fantastic food, friendly staff, and an extensive menu encompassing breakfast, lunch, dinner, and dessert. Additionally, it operates 24/7. Definitely planning to revisit when in town again.

input: I went to Spasso the other night with some friends. All four of us were SO pleased with our experience and our meals! We each had something different. I had the special for the evening, which was seafood (jumbo shrimp and jumbo lump crab) over pappardelle with tomato and asparagus. it was to die for, and my leftovers the next day were just as tasty :) service was amazing and wine was perfect. I live on state street and can't wait to visit again very soon!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a great time at Spasso with friends. We were all impressed with our meals and the overall experience. I had the special, which was seafood over pappardelle with tomato and asparagus. It was delicious and even tasted great as leftovers. The service was excellent and the wine selection was perfect. I live on state street and can't wait to go back soon!

input: Returned to get a fill and pedicure a week after getting a gel polish change, once I discovered the cost would be over $85 I canceled the pedicure and only wanted a fill. Originally the owner was very nice and attentive but when she sensed I refused to pay their ridiculous price, she turned her attention completely off of me and showed absolutely no regard. She no longer cared for my business and she had no problem showing it. She even reassigned the nail tech to someone else bc I refused to be over charged for service. I asked why the original nail tech was no longer doing my fill, I got no answer. I looked over and saw the owner catering to customers that had just walked in. I sensed flaky business so I ultimately walked out without being serviced. Horrible customer service from the owner. I understand they use quality products but not everyone is looking to spend hundreds of dollars in a nail salon regardless of how "high end" it's self proclaimed to be!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I returned to a nail salon for a fill and pedicure a week after getting a gel polish change. However, when I found out that the cost would be over $85, I decided to cancel the pedicure and only get a fill. The owner initially provided good service but once I refused to pay their exorbitant price, she completely ignored me and showed no concern. She no longer cared about my business and even reassigned the nail technician to someone else because I didn't want to be overcharged. When I asked why the original technician was no longer doing my fill, I received no answer. I observed the owner tending to customers who had just walked in, which made me feel like the business was inconsistent. Ultimately, I left without receiving any service due to the owner's poor customer service. While I understand they use high-quality products, not everyone wants to spend a significant amount of money in a nail salon, regardless of its self-proclaimed "high-end" status.

input:
Ice cream wasn't the best, and definitely not for the price. But it was there when I was passing through Belmawr, and it hit the spot when I needed to satisfy my sweet tooth! 

The service was friendly, albeit a little slow. And the place has a cute, quaint charm about it with the decor. If I lived in the area I'd probably return, but I wouldn't make any special trips to go back here.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Ice cream in Belmawr was decent, but a bit overpriced. It fulfilled my craving at the time, although the service was a tad slow. The establishment has a charming and cute ambiance. If I lived nearby, I might consider going again, but it's not worth a special journey.

input: Best auto body shop in Philadelphia in my opinion. My Honda Fit had accumulated all sorts of nicks, dents, scratches, and even some really ugly lime deposit stains on the hood of my car. I took it to Devlin's to get touched up, and what I got back was a car that looked like it just rolled off the assembly line. Honestly, if I told you my car was 3 years old and had gone through a few scrape-ups, I don't think you'd be able to tell. Ed Devlin is a miracle worker, and he does his magic at a super affordable price... I was shocked at how inexpensive the bill came out to be.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: In my opinion, Devlin's is the best auto body shop in Philadelphia. I had my Honda Fit with numerous nicks, dents, scratches, and lime deposit stains on the hood. After taking it to Devlin's, my car looked brand new, as if it just came off the assembly line. The owner, Ed Devlin, is a miracle worker who performs his magic at a surprisingly affordable price. I was shocked at how inexpensive the bill was.

input:
Even though theres nothing ostensibly stand-out about 45, I spend quite a bit of time here. This is definitely a "Cheers" bar, where everybody knows your name. If you can make out their face through the haze of cigarette smoke, that is. Personally, the smoke doesn't bother me, though i have plenty of friends who refuse to go here for that reason. 

I just love the laid back, dive-y vibe. On game days, theres always a spread of food to help yourself to, which is such a nice tradition that you rarely see in bars now. During baseball season, well, I hope you're a Red Sox fan. If not, keep your allegiances quiet, lol. And theres often a food truck parked out front. Yum! A great pre or post show stop if you're seeing music at Tipitinas, which is just down the street.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite its lack of standout features, I spend a considerable amount of time at 45. It has a "Cheers" bar atmosphere where everyone knows your name, albeit through a haze of cigarette smoke. The smoke doesn't bother me personally, but some of my friends refuse to come here because of it. The laid-back, dive-y vibe is what I love about this place. On game days, they always have a spread of food for guests to help themselves to, a tradition that is rare in bars nowadays. If you're not a Red Sox fan, it's best to keep your allegiances quiet during baseball season. Additionally, there is often a food truck parked outside, making it a great spot to visit before or after a show at Tipitinas, which is located nearby.

input: Please note: the coffee is excellent! However, you have to ask for cream and sugar. I find this pretentious and intimidating. It's coffee. I want it how I want it. It shouldn't be such a big deal.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The coffee is excellent but requesting cream and sugar can be pretentious and intimidating. Coffee should be customizable without any fuss.

input:
Is it okay to say this is my favorite brunch spot even though all I've ever had here is their grits? I would definitely try one of their other courses and I'm pretty sure they're amazing, but it is so hard to not get my favorite thing off their menu! Their portion is so huge, i usually share it with another person (if I'm not being greedy)! You can literally top anything onto your dish and they vary from .50 cents to 1.00 dollar.  I love to add on avocados, red bell peppers, bacon, cheddar, and mushrooms! Their grits are incredible, it is not grainy nor watery. It's just perfect. I can go on and on. but I'm pretty sure you get the point! 

Eventually, i will try their other dishes, but for now, it's all about their grits.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Is it okay to say this is my favorite brunch spot even though all I've ever had here is their grits? Their portion is huge, so I usually share it (if I'm not being greedy)! You can top anything onto your dish for an additional cost, and I love adding avocados, red bell peppers, bacon, cheddar, and mushrooms. Their grits are incredible - not grainy or watery, just perfect. Eventually, I'll try their other dishes, but for now, it's all about their grits.

input:
Great staff.  Nothing is ever disappointing - chili cheese etoufee is the BOMB.  It's a 4 instead of 5 stars because it's CASH ONLY.  But I love that you can also sit outside on nice evening.  

Don't forget the garlic sauce!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Staff is great, nothing disappointing. Their chili cheese etoufee is amazing. They only accept cash, hence 4 stars instead of 5. Outdoor seating available on pleasant evenings. Don't miss out on the garlic sauce!

input: Nice view from outside tables. It has typical beach food and typical beach service, but nice place to grab a drink with a view.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great view from outdoor tables, offers typical beach food and service. Perfect spot to enjoy a drink with a view.

input: Is there any way that I can give a sixth or even seventh star to this place? Perhaps I'll contact the Yelp! corporate offices in San Francisco to inquire about expanding the star system using Lou and All About Hair as the Exhibit A. I've been on a three year odyssey, which has included some of the worst haircuts and barbers this side of, well, anything, to find a place like All About Hair. It is simply fantastic. I was here early on a Friday morning and aside from doing an incredible to the follicles that rest atop my head, Lou provided fantastic conversation and an environment that was more than inviting. I haven't written a Yelp! review in a very long time, but after my experience at All About Hair, I felt compelled to fire off a five star review about this gem of a place. Needless to say, I've found my barber of choice and they've made a long-term customer out of me.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I am so impressed with All About Hair that I wish there was a way to give them more than five stars. I am considering reaching out to Yelp! corporate in San Francisco to suggest expanding the star system, using Lou and this salon as an example. I have been on a three-year journey trying different barbers and haircuts, but All About Hair is truly outstanding. My recent visit on a Friday morning was exceptional, with Lou providing not only a fantastic haircut but also delightful conversation and a welcoming atmosphere. This experience compelled me to write a five-star review on Yelp!, something I haven't done in a long time. I have finally found my go-to barber and will definitely be a loyal customer.

input:
Updating previous trip- I still would take my kids there but the derma bond sucked. Poor buddy has a scar. Yea, yea...it's in a bad spot. And he's not quite two (read: squirmy.) 

I don't think it's too much to want it all. 

 :-/
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Updated trip review: Despite the disappointing derma bond experience resulting in a scar for my young, squirmy child, I would still choose to take my kids there. It's just unfortunate that the scar is in a bad spot. I simply hope for a better outcome next time.

input: This hotel has wonderful views of the airport, and it has the only revolving rooftop restaurant.  It's connected to the airport that has several restaurants and shops.  From the revolving rooftop restaurant, I could see the runways, and the control tower.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This hotel offers stunning airport views and boasts the only revolving rooftop restaurant. It is conveniently connected to the airport, which features multiple dining and shopping options. The restaurant's unique rotating feature allows guests to observe the runways and control tower from above.

input: Love this place! The turkey, beans, and biscuits are amazing. Have had better pecan pie but that won't stop me from coming back :)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food here is great! The turkey, beans, and biscuits are amazing. The pecan pie could be better, but it won't stop me from coming back.

input: Large menu. Clean restaurant and restroom. Friendly staff. They were fairly busy in the middle of the day when we visited. This was my first time here and all we had was a sandwich so I can't give them 5 stars yet but for a family style restaurant and bar we enjoyed our meal. They had a decent draft beer selection and also serve wine and mixed drinks. There are crayons on every table and instead of a single place mat they put a large sheet of white paper on the tables for the kids to draw on.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The restaurant has a large menu, clean restroom, and friendly staff. We visited during a busy time in the middle of the day. Although it was our first time here and we only had a sandwich, we enjoyed our meal in this family style restaurant and bar. They offer a decent selection of draft beer, wine, and mixed drinks. Additionally, there are crayons on every table and the tables have large sheets of white paper for kids to draw on.

input:
Delicious crab cocktail and my husband loved his steamers. 

Only down fall is it is really humid in the restaurant itself. A fan would be nice.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The crab cocktail and steamers were delicious; my husband particularly enjoyed the steamers. The only drawback was the high humidity in the restaurant. It would have been great to have a fan.

input: Freddy's has the best fast-food style burgers I've ever had. Great toppings choices and fresh meat. Their fries are delicious with their "fry" sauce. Their custard is just as good as their food. It's rich and creamy, and did I mention how delicious it is.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Freddy's offers the best fast-food style burgers with fresh meat and a variety of great toppings. Their fries, accompanied by their tasty "fry" sauce, are delicious. Additionally, their custard is rich, creamy, and equally as delicious as their food.

input: This place had fantastic donuts! They were very well priced and so soft. We tried the blueberry cake donut and apple fritter. We will definitely be going back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place had amazing donuts at a great price. The blueberry cake donut and apple fritter were deliciously soft. We'll be returning for sure.

input:
I really had a wonderful experience at the Nashville location, and we found out that New Orleans had one now and should go to it. Last night we got there kinda late around 10pm. Sat there for 10min and not one person greeted us. Went to the bar to see about service and she informed that the kitchen was behind on completing orders. 
I had to apologize to my friends that we may not get any food after driving three hours down to enjoy the weekend. We did end up leaving the restaurant after 25 min wait for no service or an apology. 

I have to say this not what I expected from a big known place for adults to have fun along with kids also. Please do something about this. I hope this is not a reflection of how others could become.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a wonderful experience at the Nashville location and discovered that there is now a New Orleans location. Last night, we arrived at the New Orleans location around 10pm. However, we were not greeted by any staff members for the first 10 minutes. When we approached the bar for assistance, we were informed that the kitchen was behind on orders. Unfortunately, I had to apologize to my friends for the possibility of not getting any food after traveling three hours. After waiting for 25 minutes without any service or an apology, we decided to leave the restaurant. I was disappointed as this was not what I expected from a well-known establishment that caters to both adults and children. I urge you to address this issue, as I hope this experience is not indicative of future ones.

input:
Allegro's is great. The pizza is really cheap, and lightning fast. My favorite was the sicilian, followed by the, uh, meaty kind, followed in a close third by anything stuffed (sometimes the centers were cold). They also sell beer, but I can't comment much on that because when I lived in Philadelphia I was under 21.
The only downside is the service (occasionally rude) and the constant crazies that hang out there talking to themselves.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Allegro's is great - their pizza is delicious, cheap, and served quickly. My personal favorites are the Sicilian and the meaty kind, closely followed by the stuffed variety, although sometimes the centers can be cold. They also offer beer, but I can't comment on that as I was underage during my time in Philadelphia. The only downside is the occasionally rude service and the presence of some eccentric individuals who talk to themselves.

input:
This place treats you right from the moment you walk through the doors. I stay here every time I come to Reno, and the service seems to be getting better and better every time I return. On my last visit I stayed for free for 3 out of the 4 nights, and on top of that they gave me $120.00 of free play. The Peppermill is rated the casino with the loosest slots in casino. The rooms were clean,  the bathroom smelled great, and there weren't any bed bugs in our bed. The casino reminds me of old casino, when they relied on millions of lights bulbs, neon signs, and the smell of argon in the air. Happy hour everyday from 4-6 , you get mini apps and 3 dollar martinis at the fireside lounge. Also the Fish bar is awesome to go and relax, since they have a 40 foot aquarium that wraps around two of the walls. They have some excellent restaurants in the casino, that you don't even have to leave to satisfy any food craving you might have. The staff is extremely friendly and that is the top reason I keep coming back to this casino in Reno.
The only thing about this place is that the lights in the casino can really discombobulate you! Just remember that they key sleeve they give you has a map, so keep that in your pocket !
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place offers exceptional service from the moment you arrive. I always stay here when I come to Reno and the service keeps improving. During my last visit, I enjoyed three free nights and received $120.00 of free play. The Peppermill is known for having the loosest slots in the casino. The rooms are clean, the bathrooms smell great, and there are no bed bugs. The casino has a nostalgic charm with its bright lights, neon signs, and argon scent. Happy hour is daily from 4-6, offering mini apps and $3 martinis at the fireside lounge. The Fish bar is also great for relaxation with its 40-foot aquarium. The casino has excellent restaurants to satisfy any craving, and the staff is extremely friendly. The only drawback is that the lights in the casino can be overwhelming. Remember to carry the key sleeve with a map in your pocket.

input: Two very good experiences.  Excellent burger and very good pulled pork.  Wife loved her egg white and goat cheese omlette.  Solid beer list and a good spicy bloody Mary.  Also had great service and an ecclectic play list.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great experiences with excellent burger, very good pulled pork, and a delicious egg white and goat cheese omlette. Impressive beer list and a flavorful spicy bloody Mary. Friendly service and diverse music playlist added to the overall enjoyment.

input:
One of their guests went on a rampage and started punching random people, knocking one to the ground.  I told the bartender to call security, then I restrained the assailant as efficiently as humanly possible, causing no injuries, no striking, basically a bear hug, until security finally arrived.  Instead of a thank you I was told to go to my room or I would be trespassing--- fine, Did they look at the video and figure it out? Make it right later?  No.  I was treated poorly, and when I called days later, I got no response.  Spoke with Art in Security, and no call back. 

Not  the way to treat someone who helped you out. 

I will not be going back to Peppermill.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: One of their guests started attacking random people, so I asked the bartender to call security. I then efficiently restrained the assailant without causing any harm until security arrived. Instead of showing gratitude, they told me to go to my room or else I would be considered trespassing. I hoped they would review the video footage and correct the situation, but they did not. I received poor treatment and when I contacted them later, there was no response. Despite helping them, I was treated disrespectfully. Therefore, I have decided not to return to Peppermill.

input:
IF YOU ARE ON A STUDENT BUDGET, READ ON:

This is a 5 mile wide/long convention center. It has up to 2,000 guestrooms.  The conference I went to had 6,000 attendants. Of course I booked late and I didn't want to spend $200+/night on these hotel rooms! Otherwise this place is ginormous. The service (shuttle), lunch/drinks were really well done.  This place is immaculate; I do not know how many workers they staff.  

The food of course is overpriced (I had lunch/dinner at Wasabi. My bento box was $25.  Overpriced right?)  I also had lunch at the pizza place Paisano (forgot the name).   

If you decide to stay at the hotels across the street from the convention center (it is only 1 mile away - across from the McGovick Pwky).  They have Cracker Barrel, Apple Bees, Chillis?, McDonalds there.  The hotel I stayed in (being on a student budget) was crappy but I can't complain for $55/night.  It was Days Inn. It was walkable to shuttle pick up stop at Marriott Hotel (walk ~0.3 miles).  

They have Finleys pub, FUSE (night/club), STAX burger, Jack Daniels and more restaurants inside this convention center.  

I posted some photos.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: If you're on a student budget, read on for some information about a convention center. It is a large facility, spanning 5 miles wide and long. It can accommodate up to 2,000 guestrooms and had a conference with 6,000 attendees. The hotel rooms can be expensive, so booking early is important. The service and amenities, such as shuttles and lunch options, are excellent. The convention center is well-maintained, although the food can be overpriced, with an example of a $25 bento box. However, there are alternative dining options nearby, including Cracker Barrel, Applebees, Chillis, and McDonald's across the street. The writer stayed at a budget hotel, Days Inn, which was within walking distance of the shuttle pick-up stop at Marriott Hotel. Additionally, there are various restaurants and pubs inside the convention center. The writer has also posted some photos.

input: I took an 8 year old and a 14 year old for the lunch special pizza.  We have done this on several occasions, and the kids love that they each get their own personal pizza, made the way they like.   They both ordered their pizza with 2 items and wanted BBQ sauce as the base instead of tomato sauce.  (this is the only way they enjoy pizza).   I was told that they could only get tomato sauce, not BBQ sauce.   I explained that we have gotten it this way several times before.   We were told that they don't offer it this way any more.   I see that some of the pizzas offer BBQ sauce and pointed it out, but again was told that it couldn't be made this way for them.   I asked if I could pay additional to have it made with BBQ sauce, but once again told it was not possible.   Sadly, we left the restaurant and chose a different nearby restaurant for lunch.  I'm sorry to say I won't be able to take the kids here anymore.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I took an 8-year-old and a 14-year-old for the lunch special pizza but the restaurant no longer offered BBQ sauce as a base option, which the kids preferred. Despite pointing out other pizzas on the menu with BBQ sauce, they were still unable to accommodate our request. We ended up going to a different restaurant instead and I won't be able to bring the kids here anymore.

input: Super cute place! Employees are very nice! Cookie dough is delicious! This is a must & we are glad we found it (lost while in town).
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Adorable place, friendly staff, amazing cookie dough - a must-visit! So glad we stumbled upon it while lost in town.

input:
Tacos.....
The chips and salsa were pretty lame.....and the tacos were ok.....nothing special.....
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Tacos were average, while chips and salsa were disappointing.

input: Excited to have this place in Reno! Delicious matcha and ube flavors! Like authentic. Friendly staff, looking to get better but what they have as a base is solid. Soft serve, cake and the sauces aren't overly sweet.  Hoping they add more flavors!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: New place in Reno with delicious matcha and ube flavors! Authentic taste, friendly staff, and not overly sweet soft serve, cake, and sauces. Can't wait for more flavors to be added!

input: Delicious. So happy I Yelped for a restaurant closer to home and stumbled upon this. It's small and pleasant inside with some decent hip hop setting the mood. The menu is small, but packed a punch. We ordered the Duck Fries, which were heaven. Fries smothered in smoked gouda,  shredded duck, and scallions. For 8 bucks came a pretty large bowl that I couldn't stop picking at. I ordered one of the specials, the scallop and foie gras  tacos...wow...so good (then I read the origin of foie gras and hated myself, but aside that...). The person I was with ordered the pork roll burger, which I tried of course. It was incredibly juicy and cooked perfect. I will definitely come back here. Definitely.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I'm delighted with my Yelp find for a restaurant closer to home. The small and pleasant interior had a great hip hop ambiance. Despite the compact menu, the food packed a punch. We indulged in the heavenly Duck Fries, smothered in smoked gouda, shredded duck, and scallions. The generous portion for $8 kept me picking at it. I opted for the special, the scallop and foie gras tacos, which were incredibly delicious (despite my later guilt in learning about foie gras). My companion's pork roll burger was juicy and perfectly cooked. I will definitely be returning to this delightful place.

input: Went to Three Muses our first night in New Orleans. The plates are tapas style, small and meant for sharing. Between the four of us we got the blue cheese stuffed dates, the crawfish egg rolls, steak and cake, lamb sliders, feta fries and fish tacos. Everything was really good,i could have done without the tacos, but the lamb sliders and the steak and cake were AMAZING. The goat cheese paired with the lamb was to die for. And the crab cake was the best I have ever had.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: First night in New Orleans at Three Muses: tapas-style plates, meant for sharing. Ordered blue cheese stuffed dates, crawfish egg rolls, steak and cake, lamb sliders, feta fries, and fish tacos. Everything was great, except for the tacos. Lamb sliders and steak and cake were AMAZING. Goat cheese with lamb was to die for. Crab cake was the best I've ever had.

input: Great ambiance!  Loved the trendy and modern decor.  The presentation of the dishes was also great.  The food was just okay though.  The potatoes weren't cooked and the pancakes were a bit on the greasy side.  Would def. go back again and give it another try...french toast and omelette looked good!  I would also like to try their lunch. Service was excellent.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great ambiance with trendy and modern decor. Presentation of dishes was great. However, the food was just okay with uncooked potatoes and greasy pancakes. Despite this, I would go back to try their french toast, omelette, and lunch. Service was excellent.

input: This place is awesome the food is dynamite . Super friendly service. And the. Coup de grace was the flan made in house fresh and believe me I've tried flan everywhere, there's is exceptional. The price was right on point. My only suggestion to make this place go into the stratosphere is if they had a liquor license.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is amazing - the food is dynamite with exceptional, freshly made flan. The service is super friendly and the price is just right. The only thing that could push this place to greater heights would be if they had a liquor license.

input: Had breakfast with the family after a quick stopover. Great food and service (thanks Jonathan!), definaelty a good find that was busy but had no wait on a Saturday.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Had breakfast with family, quick stopover. Great food and service (thanks Jonathan!). Busy but no wait on a Saturday.

input: During the parents' visit,  dad wanted some southern food. We tried Willie Maes, but the line was long and they weren't crazy about the area.  So we waited a bit and went down to The Praline Connection. Dad was in heaven. He's been talking about the food since we left. Dad got the taste of soul platter pictured below. He said the fried chicken was the best he's had and he had not tasted red beans and rice like that since he was a kid and my granny used to make em. Mom got the meatloaf with cabbage and lima beans. I got the ribs with potato salad and mac and cheese. My ribs were good but hard to cut the meat off the bone. I could've ate em with my hands but I didn't want a BBQ face. The potato salad was good but my mac & cheese was a little bland. The cornbread was great.  I'm going back next time for the fried chicken!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: During our parents' visit, we tried Willie Maes for southern food, but the long line and area didn't impress them. So we went to The Praline Connection instead. Dad loved it and can't stop talking about the food. He ordered the taste of soul platter, which included amazing fried chicken and the best red beans and rice he's had since childhood. Mom had meatloaf with cabbage and lima beans, and I had ribs with potato salad and mac and cheese. The ribs were good but a bit tough to eat. The potato salad was tasty, but the mac and cheese was a little bland. However, the cornbread was great. I'm definitely going back for the fried chicken next time.

input:
Buddy Brew is a very trendy coffee shop based in Tampa. Their coffee is flavorful and their presentation is nice. I really liked the fact that their lattes and cappuccinos have beautiful latte art on top. The store has a beautiful modern design that reminds me of coffee shops in New York. 

This particular location is in Hyde Park Village. The benefit is that parking is free. The down side is that seating is limited. The store is also extremely cold, so it is uncomfortable to sit and socialize for very long. You may be better off getting your coffee to go and walking around Hyde Park Village instead.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Buddy Brew in Tampa is a trendy coffee shop known for its flavorful coffee and nice presentation. Their lattes and cappuccinos are topped with beautiful latte art. The shop has a modern design reminiscent of New York coffee shops, and is located in Hyde Park Village where parking is free. However, seating is limited and the store is uncomfortably cold, so it's recommended to grab your coffee to go and explore Hyde Park Village.

input:
A really nice place to get your hair did with as much of an edge as you want.  

In the East Loop, across from the Pageant, might be one of the most underrated salons in the city.  I first went into this place as a walk-in, and keep on going back.  Yes, I'm a guy, and since my hair is pretty coarse, grows weird, and I want a bit of style to it, I go to hair salons.  At V Vegaz I've never been dissatisfied with my cut. 

When you walk in you realize how spacious the place is, with a bit of a slightly modern, slightly baroque interior design.  There's a nice vibe there too amongst the employees, and you can see that the stylists are happy with the work situation.  Of course, happy stylists, to me, mean better haircuts.

I go to Callie, since that first walk-in, and keep on going back.  Yes, she's real friendly, which is a nice touch, but she's also a great stylist.  I'm a bit wishy washy when I look for a cut, usually changing what I want most of the time.  Callie's sensitive to that, and really understands how my hair grows and where it's going to move.   I think the biggest compliment to her is that, as I'm a once a month haircut kinda guy, my brother and sister told me they really my hair a full month after I had it cut with Callie.  So that's really a testament to her skills.

I've not gotten color there, but it is a full service salon, and not just a turn and burn place.  

I highly recommend this place.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: V Vegaz is an underrated hair salon located in the East Loop, across from the Pageant. The spacious salon features a modern, slightly baroque interior design and has a great vibe among the employees. Callie, the stylist I go to, is not only friendly but also skilled in understanding my hair's growth pattern and movement. Despite my wishy-washy preferences, Callie consistently delivers a satisfying haircut. Although I haven't tried their coloring services, V Vegaz is a full-service salon that offers more than just quick haircuts. I highly recommend this place.

input:
The lady who works here is a miracle worker! I came in with a couple pairs of pants that needed to be hemmed, and a suit jacket whose sleeves needed to be shortened (both of which are not quick and easy, since suits are normally lined and it's a lot of work). I also needed it to be done fast - I was leaving the country the next day. Not only did she do all of these alterations in a day, they were also excellently done - neat and professional - and now I have a beautiful suit that fits me brilliantly for my business trip! Plus, they take all credit cards - including Amex! - and have very reasonable hours. 

Definitely returning.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The lady who works here is a miracle worker! She hemmed my pants and shortened my suit jacket sleeves in a day, despite the complexity of the job. The alterations were excellently done, giving me a beautifully fitted suit for my business trip. They accept all credit cards, including Amex, and have convenient hours. I will definitely come back.

input:
Late one Saturday night, some friends and I made the mistake of trying to get drinks at Plough and the Stars and left very quickly. We were walking around trying to find somewhere else to go, noticed this unmarked bar and decided to check it out. We were so excited to see that there were so many great beers on tap, and there was a decent crowd there so we stuck around. It was a fun night! And after a few weeks of wondering where we had gone, we were able to find the Irish Pol on Yelp :D

I went back for happy hour recently and it wasn't exactly as I had remembered. It was pretty dark and dingy looking inside,  and the few people there were much much older. It just had a weird vibe. The beer was still great of course. The happy hour special was $3 drafts, but most of the beers I wanted weren't included. I won't be back for happy hour, but I would definitely stop in on a Saturday night!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Late one Saturday night, my friends and I left Plough and the Stars after a disappointing experience. We stumbled upon an unmarked bar and decided to check it out. To our delight, they had a great selection of beers on tap and a decent crowd. It turned out to be a fun night, and after a few weeks, we found the Irish Pol on Yelp. However, when I went back for happy hour recently, it wasn't what I remembered. The bar was dark and dingy, and the crowd much older, giving off a strange vibe. The happy hour special only included certain beers for $3 drafts, excluding the ones I wanted. While I won't return for their happy hour, I would definitely visit on a Saturday night for the enjoyable atmosphere and great beer.

input: Hands down the best spaghetti & meatballs I've ever had. The atmosphere here is so nice and cozy. It has just won out as my favorite Italian restaurant.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The spaghetti & meatballs here are the best I've ever had. The cozy atmosphere makes it my favorite Italian restaurant.

input: We arrived at Happy Hour, 50 cent oysters and half price drinks, so we had both, the ordered the beet salad (divine), mussels, and flammenkuchen (an appetizer I used for my entree),  All were excellent.  I first had flammenkuchen (or tarte flambe) in Strasbourg at a street fair, this was far and above that experience, with caramelized onions resting atop the cheese and hunks of bacon strewn around.  So good!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We went to Happy Hour where there were 50 cent oysters and half price drinks. We ordered the beet salad, mussels, and flammenkuchen (used as an entree). All the dishes were excellent. The flammenkuchen, which I first tried in Strasbourg, surpassed my previous experience. It had caramelized onions, cheese, and bacon, making it incredibly delicious.

input: Have eaten at this place 3 times. Every time was a good experience for me and the kids. No smoke No noise and good food good service. Maybe because it has always been on a late tuesday afternoon we have eaten there. I have always ordered something different and have been satisfied  and happy with what I got. Definitely will be back to eat there again.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I have eaten at this place 3 times and every experience was good for me and the kids. There is no smoke or noise, and the food and service are both good. Perhaps it's because we have always gone on late Tuesday afternoons. I have tried something different each time and have always been satisfied and happy with my choice. I will definitely return to eat there again.

input: Great pizza! The place is beautiful and the atmosphere is truly inviting. The service is very nice and fast.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The pizza is great, the place is beautiful with an inviting atmosphere, and the service is friendly and efficient.

input: Great dinner started with a wonderful fresh Caesar salad and bread followed by delicious cheese ravioli with pesto cream sauce. The pesto sauce was perfect, not overpowering the delicate pasta. I also enjoyed the Dunham cabernet. Delicious. Welcome to downtown, Richard's.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Had a great dinner at Richard's downtown. Started with a fresh Caesar salad and bread, followed by delicious cheese ravioli with pesto cream sauce. The pesto was perfect, not overpowering the pasta. Also enjoyed the Dunham cabernet. Welcome to downtown, Richard's!

input:
Had a great breakfast here last weekend before we headed out. You order at the front and they will bring the food out. I had the French toast (fruit on the side)  with an a la carte fried egg on the side. They dropped my egg when they got to the table but promptly brought out another one. I also had a vanilla latte which was yummy....no extra sweeteners needed. 

We sat outside on the patio which was just lovely. Even if you sat inside, like other restaurants in the French quarter, every door and windows are open, so fresh breezes flow throughout. Really nice experience.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Had a delicious breakfast last weekend at this place. You order at the front and they bring the food out. I had French toast with fruit and a side of fried egg. They accidentally dropped my egg but quickly replaced it. The vanilla latte was tasty without any extra sweeteners. We enjoyed sitting outside on the lovely patio. Even if you choose indoor seating, the fresh breezes flow through the open doors and windows. Overall, a really nice experience.

input:
We were early for church and wanted to grab a quick bite to eat. The atmosphere was really inviting and everyone on staff spoke to us at least once! 

The food was good, but not great. I had quiche and my guest had a croque madame. The crust of the quiche wasn't done and the bread on the croque wasn't that great. Otherwise these two dishes would have been perfect. The fruit was fresh and the coffee was great!

I will definitely return.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We arrived early for church and decided to have a quick bite to eat. The inviting atmosphere and friendly staff made our experience enjoyable. Although the food was good, it fell slightly short of expectations. The quiche had an underdone crust and the bread on the croque madame wasn't impressive. However, the fresh fruit and excellent coffee were highlights. Despite this, I still plan on returning in the future.

input:
Thoroughly enjoyed our visit to Salty's this evening.  As first time customers, it will be on our list of places to return when we make it back to town.  

They have a good kids menu, enough to keep the little ones content with options like burgers, Alfredo pasta, chicken, shrimp, quesadilla, etc.  

We started with the Crabby Dip which the whole family enjoyed but feel it was a little overpriced at $14.  For the main course I enjoyed a Salty Burger while she had the macadamia crusted grouper, both were excellent choices!  Service was spot on making this a five star experience for us!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We thoroughly enjoyed our visit to Salty's tonight. As first-time customers, it will definitely be on our list of places to return when we are back in town. They have a good kids menu with options like burgers, Alfredo pasta, chicken, shrimp, quesadilla, etc., which kept our little ones content. We started with the Crabby Dip, which the whole family enjoyed. However, we felt it was a little overpriced at $14. For the main course, I had the Salty Burger and she had the macadamia crusted grouper - both excellent choices! The service was spot on, making this a five-star experience for us.

input:
I guess the ingredients weren't as fresh today since my boyfriend threw up twice upon eating chili beef nachos.  We had a to-go order - I got a chicken burrito.  It gave me some stomach cramps and other issues.  Just a heads up.
