However, we keep coming back since I love your shredded beef.  I thought I would change it up today.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My boyfriend and I experienced some issues after eating the chili beef nachos today, possibly due to less fresh ingredients. He had vomiting twice, and I had stomach cramps and related problems after having a chicken burrito from a to-go order. Despite this, I appreciate your shredded beef and usually have a great experience when we dine here.

input: This place is awesome. A real throwback. Music is great, 4 stars (not 5) as they don't really offer seating beyond the first 15 ppl in line.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is awesome! It's a real throwback with great music. I would give it 4 stars instead of 5 because they don't offer seating beyond the first 15 people in line.

input: Really not even going to get into it go to Blue Fin or Masamoto
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: For a great experience, it's recommended to visit Blue Fin or Masamoto.

input:
Stayed here for a bachelorette party. This place got the job done. Unfortunately, all the hotels in Santa Barbara are pretty freaking pricey. A lot of the other hotels started at $400+ /night.  This ain't Vegas where you can get something pretty cushy for $250. This seemed like a decent option on the lower end. Our rooms were about $250 a night. A lot of the other hotels in the area were already booked for the weekend or required more than one night to book. 

Pros: 
-decently priced
-clean and cozy rooms
-charming exterior and grounds
-relatively comfortable beds
-bath and body works shampoo, body wash etc
-free water bottles and fruit waiting for you in the room

Cons:
-dated decor 
-toilet issues: The hook inside kept coming undone. I guess we decided not to get maintenance because we temporarily fixed it, but it kept coming undone so it wouldn't really flush. We were checking out that day, so we decided just to deal with it. 
- door was difficult to open without using a certain technique
-no hair dryer, so bring your own
-no complimentary breakfast
-a bit noisy in the morning, but I slept fine. I guess the window in the bathroom was open or something for some ventilation.

Overall, I still don't think I would've chosen to stay anywhere else in Santa Barbara, so BW Pepper Tree Inn was still a good choice based on the location of the bachelorette and price range.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Stayed at BW Pepper Tree Inn for a bachelorette party. Despite the high prices of hotels in Santa Barbara, this was a decent option with rooms priced at $250 per night. Pros include reasonable pricing, clean and cozy rooms, charming exterior and grounds, comfortable beds, and complimentary toiletries. However, the decor is dated and there were issues with the toilet hook, requiring a temporary fix. The door was also difficult to open without a specific technique, and there was no hair dryer or complimentary breakfast. Additionally, some noise in the morning, possibly due to a window in the bathroom being open. Overall, despite these drawbacks, this was still a good choice considering the location and price for the bachelorette party.

input: In my book you can never go wrong having a good old-fashioned meal a Johnny Rockets. I had their recent promo which was a barbecued pulled pork burger. It was a lot of food and a lot of flavor!! Top that with endless fries and I'm a happy camper. Have never had a bad experience at this location. They were recently moved from the casino floor level to the shopping level and since they did that they don't do the singing or dancing anymore which is a shame
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: At Johnny Rockets, a good old-fashioned meal is a sure bet. Recently, I tried their delicious promo item, the barbecued pulled pork burger, and it did not disappoint in terms of both portion size and flavor. The generous serving of fries only added to my satisfaction. Without fail, I have always had great experiences at this location. However, it is unfortunate that since their move to a different level, they no longer offer the lively singing and dancing, which is a loss.

input: This salon is filthy.  There are cobwebs and dust every where.  The equipment is old and in disrepair.  My nail technician was actually watching you tube videos while doing my nails!  I do not know how the health department hasn't shut them down.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The salon is dirty with cobwebs and dust throughout. The equipment is old and not well-maintained. I even noticed my nail technician watching YouTube videos while working on my nails. It's surprising that the health department hasn't taken action to shut them down.

input: I always am in favor of local businesses.  They have a big selection here and you get free popcorn.  Why go to the big boys and have to pay for popcorn when you can get it here for free?
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I prefer local businesses due to their wide selection and complimentary popcorn, making them a better choice compared to larger establishments where popcorn comes at a cost.

input:
I still love this place just as much as I ever did, and here's why:

1) Super friendly and knowledgeable staff 
2) Roomy, with lots of outlets and enough space to accommodate mid-sized groups (like the recent Yelp Office Hours)
3) Delicious tea, of course!

I've always loved their "Awake" Fizz Tea, but I've also broadened my horizons to include Pearl Tea (aka bubble tea). The taro flavor rocked my socks off. It did take a little getting used to though, as I had a mini anxiety attack every time I took a sip. Because I got it warm, it was in a paper cup and I never knew when a pearl was making its way into my mouth. As a result, I spent half my drink wondering "is there one in my straw?" It's totally worth the suspense, though.

The only thing that still troubles me is the music. It's just...not right. In fact, sometimes it's pretty distracting. It's easily avoided, however; just bring headphones and your own musical selection and all is well.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
I love this place for three reasons: 
1) The staff is super friendly and knowledgeable. 
2) It's roomy and has lots of outlets, making it great for mid-sized groups. 
3) The tea is delicious, especially their "Awake" Fizz Tea.

I also tried their Pearl Tea (bubble tea) and the taro flavor blew me away. However, it was a bit nerve-wracking as I never knew when a pearl would end up in my mouth. But the suspense made it worth it.

The only downside is the music, which is distracting. To avoid it, I recommend bringing headphones and your own music.

input: Yah Man was yah man! Go here and enjoy the atmosphere, the personal service and delicious Caribbean fare. The beef pie was yummy as was the chicken and island sampler plates. The bread pudding was to die for. We left full and happy. If you live in the Tampa area or are visiting you should go here! Nice people! BTW, this is the 3rd time I've posted on yelp just wanted to share this place, so good!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Yah Man is a must-visit spot in Tampa! The atmosphere is amazing, the service is personal, and the Caribbean food is delicious. Don't miss out on the yummy beef pie, chicken, and island sampler plates. And make sure to save room for the incredible bread pudding. Overall, we left feeling full and happy. Whether you're a local or just visiting, you should definitely check out Yah Man. The people are nice, and this recommendation is coming from a regular Yelp contributor who can't get enough of this place.

input:
Favorite place to go in New Orleans. Chill backyard bar with great local music options.

Smaller groups are better- seating can get tight. The wine and cheese bar up front services the live music venue in back. You can pick 3 or more cheeses and they put together a lovely cheese and accoutrements tray for you. You can also choose a wine to open up in the back. Wines have a great selection, mid-range price (almost all winces over $10-20 a bottle).

Great place to spend the night and have a wonderful time away from the packed tourists hot spots. (Mind you, this place is well known and a hot spot itself).
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Favorite spot in New Orleans: Chill backyard bar with fantastic local music options. Smaller groups recommended due to limited seating. The front features a wine and cheese bar, which caters to the live music venue in the back. Enjoy selecting 3 or more cheeses for a delectable cheese and accompaniments tray. Additionally, choose a wine to enjoy in the back, which offers a great selection at mid-range prices (most bottles priced between $10-20). Escape the crowded tourist hot spots and spend a delightful night at this renowned and bustling attraction.

input: Had a great lunch here. I ordered a chicken Caesar and my dining companion ordered a custom salad. Waitress had a great personality and did not rush us at all. Allowed us to linger. Great space which is hidden from the outside.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great lunch, ordered a chicken Caesar and custom salad. Waitress was friendly and didn't rush us, allowed us to linger. Hidden space with a great atmosphere.

input: Made reservation a over a week ago with request to be near band. On arrival they had no record of it. And we are stuck in the back next to the bathroom. 5 stars for cocktail,food, band and Atmosphere. 1 stars for utter lack of organization.  The woman who took it said she was new. Always call to confirm I guess. Completely disappointed esp since we've had such amazing experiences here in the past.  There open tables near front and were told they were for people with reservations
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Made reservation over a week ago requesting to be near the band. Upon arrival, no record of reservation and ended up in the back by the bathroom. 5 stars for cocktail, food, band, and atmosphere. 1 star for lack of organization. The woman who took the reservation admitted to being new. Lesson learned - always call to confirm. Very disappointed, especially considering previous amazing experiences. Noticed open tables near the front designated for reserved guests.

input: Great professional tat shop!! My husband and I are very happy with our new ink. Bryan did an outstanding job and I highly recommend him. All the employees were super nice and I can see why this is the city's #1 tattoo shop. Don't forget their new location is 1418 N. Clairborne, in Suite 5, upstairs.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Highly recommend this great professional tattoo shop! Bryan's outstanding job on our new ink left my husband and I very happy. The employees were super nice, and it's no surprise why this is the city's #1 tattoo shop. Don't forget to visit their new location at 1418 N. Clairborne, Suite 5, upstairs.

input: Love this place.  Best view in Santa Barbara.   Awesome wines.  My wife and I are industry, and always treated great.  Tom and Gillian are ALWAYS generous hosts.  My wife works @carrwinery and always refers customers to them.  The Conway cabs are the best SB has to offer.  One of their tasting room employees just gifted us a Conway 13 reserve Syrah.  Beautiful. ...  Thank you Tommy.   Rolos red is a bottle that any wine snob would love,  but a great bottle for those finding their pallet as well.  My son is 5 and always wants mom and dad to go wine tasting when we hit the pier. Never disappointed.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place has the best view in Santa Barbara and awesome wines. The owners, Tom and Gillian, always treat my wife and me well. My wife works at Carr Winery and often recommends this place to customers. The Conway cabs are the best in Santa Barbara. One of their employees recently gifted us a bottle of Conway 13 reserve Syrah, and it was beautiful. Thank you, Tommy. Their Rolos red is a bottle that any wine snob would love, but it is also great for those new to wine. Even our 5-year-old son loves when we go wine tasting at this place near the pier. We are never disappointed.

input:
Yo this draft latte is BS good. 

Also the guy at the register complimented my tie. 10/10
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Draft latte is amazing and the guy at the register loved my tie. Perfect experience, 10/10.

input: This place is amazing!!! There aren't enough words for how amazing the food is here. The BBQ shrimp are a must and if you're into truffle oil/butter flavors I highly recommend the truffle fries (more than enough to share) and the truffle butter filet mignon. For dessert the bread pudding and white chocolate brownie are both good options!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food at this place is incredible! Don't miss the BBQ shrimp and definitely try the truffle fries and truffle butter filet mignon if you enjoy truffle flavors. The portions are generous, perfect for sharing. Don't forget to indulge in the delicious bread pudding or white chocolate brownie for dessert.

input: Such a cool atmosphere and unlike anything I've ever been to. You walk into the wine and cheese shop, select a bottle (or 2!) and then select whatever cheeses and meats you so choose from a refrigerator. Once you have your items, you bring it to the counter to pay, they take your cheeses and meats, and deliver it to your outside (or upstairs inside in our case due to the rain!) and it's like magic. It comes back a beautiful cheese board with nuts and spreads and a delicious loaf of sliced artisan bread! Highly recommended! They also have a menu t order from the kitchen if you really need more, but two of us were full after our platter and wine!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The atmosphere at this wine and cheese shop is incredibly unique. Upon entering, you can select a bottle or two of wine and choose from an assortment of cheeses and meats from a refrigerator. Once you have made your selections, you bring them to the counter to pay. After that, the staff will take your cheeses and meats and deliver them to either an outdoor seating area or an upstairs location (in case of rain). The transformation is truly magical, as your order returns as a beautifully arranged cheese board accompanied by nuts, spreads, and a delectable loaf of sliced artisan bread. I highly recommend this place! In addition, they offer a menu if you desire more food from the kitchen, but my friend and I were satisfied after enjoying our platter and wine.

input: Seriously one of the most pleasant dining experiences I have had in a while. Smiley himself is a true gem and the food was DELICIOUS. Had so much that I am eating it for lunch again today - and I can't wait! Please recommend to everyone you know in Manayunk, don't want to lose this place!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The dining experience was incredibly pleasant, mainly due to the exceptional service provided by Smiley. The food surpassed expectations and was absolutely delicious. I enjoyed it so much that I'm having it again for lunch today and eagerly anticipating it. I highly recommend this place to everyone in Manayunk to ensure it doesn't get lost.

input: Above average steaks - great service - excellent wine list.  Comparable to Ocean Prime, Ruth's Chris.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Above average steaks, great service, and an excellent wine list comparable to Ocean Prime and Ruth's Chris.

input: My friend and I had dinner here on Sunday. I was surprised to be seated next to another party on the same table with just a small partition separating us. This is how some of the tables are if you are a party of 4 or less. The restaurant is small and can get loud. We had very good service. The food was ok, we got the Kale Ceaser and the Fried chicken with mac n cheese. They were out of watermelon so the salad that was supposed to come with the chicken had to be changed to something else. I was impressed with the soft egg that came with Kale ceaser, it was nicely encased in a crispy crust and the yolk was nice and runny.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My friend and I had dinner at a small and sometimes noisy restaurant on Sunday. We were surprised to be seated next to another party with just a small partition separating us. The restaurant typically places parties of 4 or less together. Despite the crowded seating, we received excellent service. The food, including the Kale Caesar with a delicious soft egg enclosed in a crispy crust, and the Fried chicken with mac n cheese, was decent. However, they were out of watermelon, so the salad meant to accompany the chicken had to be substituted. Overall, the experience was satisfactory.

input: Was rather disappointed in the service.  We found our own table as requested to do but wait staff continually walked by without even acknowledging us.  After ordering a flight of their beers, again it was a long wait.  Not impressed by any of the beers.  One even tasted like soap.  Have tried other flights at other breweries and find it a great way to pick a favorite.  But not here.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was disappointed with the service at this place. We found our own table as requested, but the wait staff continuously ignored us. It took a long time to receive our flight of beers, and none of them impressed me. One even tasted like soap. I have tried flights at other breweries and found it to be a great way to choose a favorite, but that was not the case here.

input:
I have been here twice for breakfast.  The set-up is really awkward and it's clear the people running it on Saturday mornings don't really know what they're doing.  It's stressful to hear them cursing under their breath and yelling at their line cook, Carlos.  

You are instructed to order at the counter....except ocassionally, for certain clients, they'll actually come to your table and take your order ...but it seems pretty random.  It's all self serve (shitty) coffee and bottled beverages.  After a long time with the sun beating down on you (there are no shades for front window), the food arrives and it's Ok.  there was a lot of grizzle in my pulled pork texas wrap,  but the cornbread pancakes were tasty.  

You then pay afterwards---why not just pay when you get it?  I would like to minimize my face time with the awkward people who staff it on Saturday A.M.s, but no such luck. 

I brought my out-of-town brother here for brunch and regret it.  it's somewhat tasty, but kind of a dive.  Don't go here if you expect a nice/traditional b-fast service (i.e. a waiter and people who fill up your coffee.)  That said, it's pretty cheap so, guess you get what you paid for.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I have been here twice for breakfast. The set-up is awkward and the people running it on Saturday mornings don't seem to know what they're doing. It's stressful to hear them cursing and yelling at their line cook, Carlos. You order at the counter, but occasionally they'll come to your table to take your order, although it seems random. The coffee and bottled beverages are self-serve and not great. There are no shades for the front window, so it can be uncomfortable sitting in the sun for a long time. The food is okay, but my pulled pork Texas wrap had a lot of grizzle. The cornbread pancakes were tasty though. You pay afterwards instead of when you get your food, which can be inconvenient. I brought my out-of-town brother here for brunch and regretted it. The place is kind of a dive and not what you would expect for a nice/traditional breakfast service. However, it is cheap, so you get what you paid for.

input: Great classic Greek diner. The Greek omelette with feta, gyro meat, tomato and spinach was super. Classic griddle home fries and outstanding service. We will seek it out when we return to the area.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Amazing Greek diner with delicious Greek omelette - feta, gyro meat, tomato, and spinach. Home fries cooked to perfection and outstanding service. We will definitely go back when we're in the area again.

input: Sat down over a half hour, only miso and drinks served. Waiting for actual food ordered or someone to cook it ....waiting ...
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Waited for over 30 minutes, but only received miso and drinks. Still waiting for the food to be cooked and served.

input: Great Doctor. Friendly . Attentive. Professional. Funny.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The doctor is great—friendly, attentive, professional, and also has a good sense of humor.

input: I was craving for Ramen when I found this gem, but it wasn't the Ramen that I'm rating here (it falls a bit short comparing to the Ramens I've had in NY). That Steven roll!!! That was one of the best rolls that I've had! Good thing I was pretty hungry and asked for roll recommendations. I was definitely not disappointed. I would love to come back once I visit Philly again.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The Ramen here didn't meet my expectations compared to those I've had in NY. However, the Steven roll was amazing and one of the best I've ever had. I'm glad I asked for roll recommendations because I was not disappointed. I look forward to returning when I visit Philly again.

input: Unless you have gray hair , are over 45 and appear wealthy , don't expect to get good service . My girlfriend and I sat there and witnessed our waitress cut up with many older couples in suits , then would check on us every half hour to 40 minutes , and didn't even check on our steaks and how they were prepared. The management never asked how our meal was ,(we witnessed them going table to table). VERY disappointed for spending $80, to get this poor of service .
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: If you don't meet certain criteria (gray hair, over 45, and appearing wealthy), you should not expect good service. Our waitress seemed to prioritize older couples in suits and rarely checked on us. She didn't even inquire about our steaks. The management also failed to ask about our experience, despite visiting other tables. We were extremely disappointed with the poor service, especially considering we spent $80.

input: The Paris Hair Salon is a warm, friendly inviting personal experience with people who really know hair. I have thick unruly hair and many don't take the time to carefully go through it. Paris Hair takes the time and makes it right, I am so pleased, and the price is right too. Cut, color and hilites all perfect, every time! -Maureen Kerfoot
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Paris Hair Salon is a welcoming and friendly place filled with knowledgeable hair experts who cater to individual needs. Unlike many salons, they take the time to properly handle thick and unruly hair, ensuring excellent results. Moreover, the prices are reasonable. From the perfect cut to flawless color and highlights, I am consistently satisfied with their services. -Maureen Kerfoot

input:
I love Chick-Fil-A so much and was so excited to get one down the street from me! No more sudden realizations that I'm in Rivergate or Cool Springs and should take advantage of a Chick-Fil-A. I could go any time!

But. What. The. Hell.

Apparently Nashvillians don't know how to use a double lane drive through.

And may I ask why the drive thru goes around the front of the restaurant instead of the back of the restaurant like every other damn fast food restaurant?

Though, kudos for the free WiFi that I can use on my phone while I'm waiting twenty minutes in line at the drive thru.

So I avoid this place like the plague. I'll wait til next time I'm in Rivergate or Cool Springs for some amazing waffle fries.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was thrilled to have a Chick-Fil-A near me, but I was disappointed with a few things. Firstly, it seems that people in Nashville struggle with using the double lane drive-through. Additionally, I find it strange that the drive-through goes around the front of the restaurant instead of the back like other fast-food places. On the positive side, they do offer free WiFi, which is helpful during the long wait times. Overall, I choose to avoid this location and wait until I visit Rivergate or Cool Springs for their delicious waffle fries.

input:
I was very pleased with my experience here!  Good, fast service--you can linger after your meal because you've paid up front. 

And, most importantly the food is fresh and tasty!  I loved my chicken taco salad and the plantains we got.  The drinks, especially the mojito, were good too. 

Will definitely be back to try more things.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great experience here! Good, fast service and the convenience of paying upfront allows for leisurely lingering after your meal. The food is fresh and delicious, particularly the chicken taco salad and plantains. The drinks, especially the mojito, are also enjoyable. Can't wait to come back and try more items.

input:
I worked with the Sultans of Schlep last week on a small move within center city. I had a great experience for a number of reasons:

-Tom is extremely attentive, responsive, and easy to work with
-They have fair prices
-The movers were on time and worked efficiently
-They provided wardrobe boxes at no extra cost
-They have a cool and funny name (don't you think?)

I would definitely work with them again!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a great experience working with the Sultans of Schlep last week for a small move within center city. Tom, who is extremely attentive, responsive, and easy to work with, led the team of movers who were punctual and efficient. They offer fair prices and even provided wardrobe boxes at no additional cost. Plus, their cool and funny name adds to their appeal. I would definitely choose to work with them again in the future.

input: Just got a pedi so I can't speak to the massage but my pedi was amazing. Place is clean and very nice, I did not have to wait at all and most importantly they know their stuff.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Just had a great pedicure - the place was clean, didn't have to wait, and they really knew what they were doing. Can't comment on the massage though.

input: Yats is the best Cajun Food that we have ever eaten and is quite economical to enjoy.  The menu is quite eclectic in that they cook each day what they want to cook and put it on a chalkboard.  You just never know what kind of tasty delight you will find on any one day.  This is a regular place to visit for my wife and I.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Yats offers the best Cajun Food we've ever eaten, at an affordable price. Their daily changing menu, written on a chalkboard, adds an element of surprise to the dining experience. It's become a regular spot for my wife and me.

input: I was impressed with this pizza place's selection.  I stopped in for a quick bite and ordered a roast beef sandwich (that was very delicious.)  The sandwich did take about 15 to 20 minutes to get out of the kitchen.  Seating is non-existent in the restaurant, but there is a community patio next to Castrillo's.  I am excited to try their pizza.  I've only heard good things.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was impressed with the selection at this pizza place. While I stopped in for a quick bite and ordered a roast beef sandwich, it took about 15 to 20 minutes to be served. The restaurant doesn't have seating, but there is a community patio nearby. I'm excited to try their pizza as I've only heard good things.

input: We came here on the holiday, July 4.  This place was great.  All the staff were so friendly and helpful.  My daughter had ear pain and the nurse we saw was very compassionate and patient with my daughter.  He tried to do his best to get the wax loose and out of her ear, but was unsuccessful after multiple attempts.  The doctor then came in to assist and immediately was able to remove a huge chunk of wax.  We were given prescriptions for antibiotics and went over to Target (in same shopping center) to get those filled.  The medication was cheaper at Target than what Med Express quoted us.   It was a great place for going to get immediate care while on vacation at the beach!  Thanks so much!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We visited on July 4 for our holiday and had a great experience. The staff were friendly and helpful, especially the nurse who treated my daughter's ear pain. Despite multiple attempts, he couldn't remove the wax, but the doctor quickly managed to extract a large chunk. We received prescriptions for antibiotics, which we found to be cheaper at Target than at Med Express. Overall, it was an excellent place for urgent care during our beach vacation. Thank you!

input: Hands down the best veggie wings I've had anywhere. Seriously. I can never stop thinking about them. Their fried pickles are also great, though I've found their drinks to be a bit weak. I'll stick to a Mexican coke whenever I'm here.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The veggie wings are the best I've had; I can't stop thinking about them. The fried pickles are great too, but the drinks can be weak. I prefer a Mexican coke when I'm here.

input: Neat diner, unlike other diners as it's quaint and has a good feel to it. I had the Yankee pot roast....which was ok....mashed potatoes were just ok and the meat was kind of bland. The veggies were excellent, fresh, not out of a can.  My wife had an omelette which she said was good. Service was excellent.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This diner is unique, with a charming ambiance. I tried the Yankee pot roast, but found it only average. The mashed potatoes and meat lacked flavor, although the vegetables were fresh and delicious. On the other hand, my wife enjoyed her omelette, and the service was exceptional.

input:
Zero stars for the Chicken Teriyaki Lunch Bento Box.  I have literally never seen a bento box come without rice before.  

Disappoint.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Zero stars for the disappointing Chicken Teriyaki Lunch Bento Box that lacked rice, a crucial component normally present in bento boxes.

input: Brooke's music needs to go. No more pop edm.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Brooke should stop producing pop EDM music.

input: Good price, great location and good accommodations with decently sized rooms. The bed is pretty firm though and the sheets are super rough but overall, I would stay here again!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Affordable, well-located accommodations with decently sized rooms. The bed is firm and the sheets are rough, but overall, I would choose to stay here again.

input: The pasta was cooked perfectly, chicken parm was delicious and pizza was good. What amazes me most is in a packed place this one cashier/waitress was able to do it all seamless and well. Impressed
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The pasta, chicken parm, and pizza were all delicious. Despite the crowded place, one cashier/waitress managed to handle everything seamlessly and impressed me.

input: First time eating here today, was fantastic! The food was great but the REAL REASON to go is view and ambience. Sitting outside right on the beach, enjoying your meal while listening to the soothing sound of waves crashing is simply sublime. Another plus, they sell beer! Lol. A must if you're in the area, even if you're not it's worth the drive. I'll definitely be back!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: First time eating here today - fantastic food. The real reason to go is the breathtaking view and relaxing ambience. Sitting outside on the beach, listening to the soothing sound of waves is simply sublime. Plus, they sell beer! A must-visit if you're in the area, or worth the drive if you're not. I'll definitely be back!

input: Attended a party there. They now have a private room with your own bar and bathroom. I really enjoyed it. The buffet was good, didn't have to wait for a drink and you were able to hear each other talk. I would have a party there!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Recently attended a party at a place that now offers a private room complete with a personal bar and bathroom. I thoroughly enjoyed the experience - the buffet was delicious, we didn't have to wait for drinks, and it was easy to hear each other talk. Definitely a great venue to consider for future parties!

input: I was a little nervous since this is my first time with LF and I didn't know what to expect. Tori was such a sweetheart. I showed her picture of the hairstyle I wanted, and she turned it into reality! At the end of my visit, she wrote down the products that she used. She also gave me some great suggestions about treating my hair type (fine & thin). The place was clean and modern. Parking was not an issue and I came on Saturday. It was a great experience!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was nervous for my first visit to LF, but Tori was amazing. I showed her the hairstyle I wanted and she made it a reality. She even gave me product recommendations and tips for my fine and thin hair. The salon was clean and modern, with easy parking on a Saturday. Overall, a great experience!

input:
WOW!! What A burger, terrific flavor. Well cooked very well seasoned and a healthy portion of sides with it as well. We had homemade potato chips and waffle fries sweet potatoes.  
The outside patio was great, just wish there was a law against smoking ANYWHERE people could eat! 
Out waiter Jesse was jam up and took good care of us! 
This place came on a recommendation from a friend and is off the beaten path just a bit but worth every single moment and delicious place and will return
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Amazing burger with great flavor and perfect cooking, complemented by well-seasoned sides like homemade potato chips and sweet potato waffle fries. The outside patio was enjoyable, although it would be better if smoking was prohibited near eating areas. Our waiter Jesse provided excellent service. This restaurant was recommended by a friend and although it's slightly off the beaten path, it's worth every moment and we will definitely be returning.

input: I've been going to Mark for at least 2 years now. I've gone to salons like Dominic Michael etc and am used to paying $35 plus tip for a cut. I learned about Blades and since I knew the owner had salon experience felt comfortable trying him. Mark is a great guy and I always love my cut.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I've been going to Mark for 2 years now. I used to go to salons like Dominic Michael and paid $35 plus tip for a cut. However, I decided to try Blades because the owner has salon experience. Mark is a great guy and I always love my cut when he does it.

input: The decor of this restaurant is pretty modern.  It seems great for people in their 20s.  I had the mahi mahi with pita chips and hummus.  It was really good.  The fish was tender and flavorful.  The service was good, too.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The restaurant has a modern decor that appeals to individuals in their 20s. I ordered the mahi mahi with pita chips and hummus, which was delicious and featured tender and flavorful fish. The service was also good.

input:
I wish they served a bigger menu of dim sum because it's amazing here! In my opinion, this is the best place for dim sum in reno (CaiE's oriental cafe seems like they serve pre-frozen dim sum). We order in advance and dine in. Whenever I'm craving chicken feet and siu mai, this is the go to. Unless we can go over the hill to Sac. 

They have a good combo meal. I enjoy their sesame chicken with fried rice. Hubby gets beef and broccoli or shrimp and vegetables. Comes with a nice combo appetizer and/or hot cup of soup.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The dim sum menu here is amazing, but I wish they had a larger selection. In my opinion, this is the best place for dim sum in Reno. CaiE's Oriental Cafe seems to serve pre-frozen dim sum, so I prefer this place. We always order in advance and dine in. Whenever I'm craving chicken feet and siu mai, this is my go-to place, unless we can go to Sac. They also have a delicious combo meal option. I enjoy their sesame chicken with fried rice, while my husband usually gets beef and broccoli or shrimp and vegetables. The combo meal comes with a nice appetizer and/or hot cup of soup.

input:
I came in for lunch, my group totaled eight hungry people.  There was no wait and after reading other reviews about the crowds, the stars must have aligned for us.  The parking lot was also relatively empty although I did happen to walk by the one car whose door opened just as I happened by, ouch my pancreas!
     The server was excellent although I cannot remember her name, which is a shame 'cause she definitively deserves the cudos for dealing with my rowdy group.
     Yes, I went and ordered the cheeseburger and fries (my kryptonite) and I must say it was perfectly cooked, the fries at the peak of crispiness and my glass never went empty.  Eight people, no complaints, all in all a great time was had by all!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had lunch with a group of eight hungry people. Surprisingly, there was no wait, unlike what we had read in other reviews about the crowds. The parking lot was also empty, except for one unfortunate incident where a car door hit me. The server was excellent, although I can't remember her name, but she definitely deserves praise for handling our rowdy group. Personally, I ordered a cheeseburger and fries, which were perfectly cooked. The fries were crispy, and my glass was always full. Overall, all eight of us had a great time with no complaints.

input: The bayou burger is literally the best burger I've ever had. Great staff also -definitely a big thumbs up.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The bayou burger is the best burger I've ever had with great staff - a big thumbs up!

input:
This review is for a corporate event in a private dining room with a limited food menu & bar. 

I was blown away! One of the best meals I've ever had and service was flawless, expert, courteous, and never intrusive. Passed hors d'ouevres were creative and tasty. Lobster consommé was delicious and filet was PERFECTLY cooked & seasoned, melted in my mouth, and a generous portion. And that view is just stunning! Actually a better view from our private room than the main dining room, where I've been for a happy hour event (which was less perfect since the space was very overbooked resulting in slow service). Highly recommend for an event and may be back here for a special occasion dinner.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was blown away! The meal at the corporate event in the private dining room was one of the best I've ever had. The service was flawless, expert, courteous, and never intrusive. The passed hors d'ouevres were creative and tasty. The lobster consommé was delicious and the filet was perfectly cooked and seasoned. It melted in my mouth and the portion size was generous. The view from our private room was stunning, even better than the main dining room I've been to for a happy hour event. However, the main dining room experience was less perfect due to overbooking and slow service. I highly recommend this venue for events and I may return for a special occasion dinner.

input: The pizza was the best we've had in the Fairmount/Art Museum/Brewerytown area and we've probably tried 5 or so.  The pepperoni was a little crispy (good thing) and the wings were, too.  That last one is really surprising since there are so many soggy wings out there.  Lazos does it right.  They gave me Sprite instead of Coke but otherwise this was a very good pizza+wing combo.  Will order again!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Lazos serves the best pizza in the Fairmount/Art Museum/Brewerytown area. We have tried around 5 different places, and Lazos stands out. The pepperoni on their pizza was pleasantly crispy, and the wings were also deliciously crispy, a rarity. Lazos knows how to make wings right, unlike many other places with soggy wings. Although they gave me Sprite instead of Coke, overall, it was a great pizza and wing combo. We will definitely be ordering from Lazos again!

input: Old school decor - dark woods and copper tile ceiling (real?)  I was there for the express lunch, a good deal.  You get a choice of soup with the entree of the day.  The gumbo and crab bisque were spot on. Gumbo - rich with the andouille sausage adding just a bit of heat. Crab bisque - flavored with old bay style seasoning but not overly salty and just a bit of shredded crab. The entree was a garganelli with roast pork ragu, mushrooms and creole tomatoes.  The sauce was light and blended the flavors well.  The roast pork highlighted the dish - fork tender, caramelized and left me wanting more.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The decor of the restaurant was old school, featuring dark woods and possibly a copper tile ceiling. I went for the express lunch, which was a good deal. The lunch included a choice of soup alongside the entree of the day. Both the gumbo and crab bisque were excellent - the gumbo had a rich flavor with a slight heat from the andouille sausage, while the crab bisque had a balanced seasoning with a hint of shredded crab. The entree I had was garganelli with roast pork ragu, mushrooms, and creole tomatoes. The sauce was light and brought the flavors together well. The roast pork was the highlight of the dish, being tender and caramelized, making me crave for more.

input: great hotel in a very good location. The staff was really friendly, and helped us out a lot. it's a 1-2 minute walk to the bars on Bourbon, 7-8 min walk to Harra's, 10 min walk to Jackson Square. The only downside is parking is $38 a night.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Excellent hotel with friendly staff in a prime location a short walk away from Bourbon Street (1-2 minutes), Harra's (7-8 minutes), and Jackson Square (10 minutes). The only drawback is the parking fee of $38 per night.

input:
Really liked this store yesterday. Great selection, I was impressed by Chloe and Marc Jacobs items and Chanel pumps for $87 (too small for me=(
I found their price range great (now they have summer sales on) but in general you get great value for money. I am not looking for $20-30 T Shirts, I am ready to pay $100 for a silky blouse (which can retail for $300+) so I guess this will be my go-to store. 
And! the lady at the store was super friendly and nice.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was impressed by this store yesterday. They had a great selection of Chloe and Marc Jacobs items, as well as Chanel pumps for $87. Unfortunately, the pumps were too small for me. The store has great prices and is currently having summer sales. Overall, you get great value for your money here. I'm willing to pay $100 for a silky blouse, which can retail for $300+. The lady at the store was also super friendly and nice. This will definitely be my go-to store.

input:
I was here a few times because my friends won free happy hours. When I won one, I sent in my guest list and tried to call them a few times to confirm. Neither of the people who answered the phone were friendly or helpful, and I never did get in touch with the woman in charge of happy hours. She never returned my emails or phone calls. When I showed up with my friends, they didn't have my name on the list and forgot that they even offered me a happy hour. It was irritating, and after some fighting, they eventually let me through.

There is a dress code (no sneakers, flip flops, hats, etc.), but I don't really mind. The bouncers and bartenders aren't very friendly and can be slow, and I never tried the food. The crowd isn't great either - attractive and douchey (maybe because, like us, they're just trying to get drunk and go somewhere else). 

Free booze is always good, but I wouldn't come here for any other reason.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
I visited this place multiple times after my friends won free happy hours. However, when I won, I encountered unhelpful and unfriendly phone receptionists who never responded to my attempts to confirm the reservation. On the day of my visit, my name was not on the guest list, and they had forgotten about my happy hour offer. Despite some disagreement, I was eventually allowed in.

There is a dress code that I don't mind, but the bouncers and bartenders lack friendliness and efficiency. I cannot provide feedback on the food since I did not try it. The crowd is unappealing, consisting of attractive yet pretentious individuals who seem to be there solely to get drunk and move on.

While I appreciate free drinks, I would not recommend this place for any other reason.

input:
I don't know this for sure, but my first impression of this place is that it is run by unscrupulous people. Come along with me, as I journey back in time -- all the way back to Wednesday...

I step foot in this 7 Eleven, and the first thing I think is: this is one of the nicest looking 7 Elevens I've ever seen. It is very clean, bright, and spacious. Very nice looking selection of prepared meals. There were many that actually looked like they'd be quite good. But I wasn't hungry this day. No. All I needed were a few items. 

First, some good old TP. And let me be perfectly clear (as clear as Barack Obama): I DON'T buy the cheapest toilet paper because I'm cheap. I buy it because I like the way the cheap stuff feels. The more like sandpaper, the better. I like to feel like its working. I don't need to or even want to feel like an angel is up there. Or some perverted freak named Scott. 

In any case, I got myself 4 rolls. And then I just needed one more thing - some plastic cups for a little party I'm having this weekend. 

I go ahead and drop my stash on the counter, begin to extract several singles from my wallet, when the cashier looks at me and says, "24.99."

I respond, "That's not right."

He points at a price tag on the plastic cups which reads 19.99. I begin laughing. I tell him the price is clearly wrong. He tells me he's got to talk to his manager. Meanwhile, I tell the folks behind me waiting in line that I'm just going to go run and get different plastic cups to hurry the process along. Before he got back from doing his price check, I already had another cashier ringing up my two sleeves of cups for 1.99 each. That's more like it.

At around that same moment, the first cashier comes back from his consultation with his manager. He tells me that the price was, in fact, incorrect. And that the price is actually 14.99.

THAT'S the unscrupulous part.

CLEARLY, THAT price is also far too high. His manager did no actual price check at all. He simply told the cashier to pretend that the real price was actually 5 dollars less, thinking that I'd be stupid enough to accept this. Why, because I'm white, and you're a racially superior Indian? You think white people are stupid don't you? We'll just believe what you tell us, and fork over our money.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My initial impression of this place is that it is run by unscrupulous people. When I visited the 7 Eleven, it appeared clean, bright, and spacious, with a nice selection of prepared meals. However, I only needed a few items: toilet paper and plastic cups. At the counter, the cashier tried to charge me $24.99 for the cups, but I noticed a price tag of $19.99 and questioned the amount. While the cashier consulted with the manager, I quickly grabbed different cups and had another cashier ring them up for $1.99 each. Upon returning, the original cashier informed me that the price was actually $14.99, which I found suspicious. It seemed like the manager falsely lowered the price without conducting a proper price check, assuming I would accept it. I felt this may be due to racial assumptions about white people's gullibility.

input: Worst nail salon experience ever. The guy said "what is wrong with you" to a customer who accidentally chipped her nail. When I was explaining how I wanted my nails filed he told me to do it myself. Really bad job. Everyone was rude and does the job too quickly. You would think after having such bad reviews they would learn..
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Terrible nail salon experience with rude employees. One customer was insulted for accidentally chipping her nail, while I was told to file my own nails. The service was rushed and poorly done. Surprisingly, even with numerous bad reviews, no improvements were made.

input:
Calories and diabetes be damned - fewer things could be better than gelati on days as brutally hot as the ones we've had this week.  Thanks for helping to cool us all down w your frozen treats.  Five stars for you.

PS - visit the website for a little Vanilla Ice.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Thanks for providing us with your delicious gelati to help us stay cool during this hot week. We really appreciate it and give you five stars! Don't forget to check out our website for some Vanilla Ice.

input:
All you can drink brunch? Yes please!

Sat and Sun they got brunch item and unlimited bloody marys or mimosas for $20. Perfect for some Sunday Funday. Enjoy!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Enjoy an all-you-can-drink brunch deal on Saturday and Sunday, featuring brunch items and unlimited bloody marys or mimosas for only $20. Perfect for a fun-filled Sunday Funday!

input: Good Chinese food and really nice beer selection.  Haven't tried the sushi yet, so I can't speak to that.  True, the staff isn't exactly the most cordial, but they're plenty nice enough for Chinese food take out.  This is not an expensive or fancy restaurant, so you should go in with reasonable expectations.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Chinese food is good with a great beer selection. Sushi is untested. Staff is decent for takeout, but not overly friendly. It's a casual and affordable place.

input:
The most amazing thing happened today.  I walked into Andres Richard Salon on Locust St for my appointment with Stephanie, a junior stylist at Andres.  We talked, I showed her pictures and the magic began.  I came in for a balayage, a fix from my existing washed out, brassy ombre.  Stephanie was so sweet, attentive and definitely catered to my request.  Hours later, my hair is exactly what I wanted!  I spent most of 2015 crying out of Salon after Salon.  This is will be the only person that will ever touch my hair again.
If you're looking for technical, creative, and expert hair care, you'll find it at Andres Richard.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Today, something amazing happened. I went to Andres Richard Salon on Locust St for my appointment with Stephanie, a junior stylist. We talked, I showed her pictures, and the magic began. I was there to fix my washed out, brassy ombre with a balayage. Stephanie was sweet, attentive, and fulfilled my request perfectly. After hours, my hair looks exactly how I wanted it to. In 2015, I spent a lot of time crying after salon visits, but Stephanie at Andres Richard will be the only one touching my hair from now on. If you want technical, creative, and expert hair care, go to Andres Richard.

input:
I like it. The atmosphere is festive and there is a nice variety of music in Spanish. Service is attentive and they got my picky order straight.

It was a boring salad made with iceberg lettuce that could easily be improved by using romaine or something darker. My more culinary friend ordered the chicken soup and swears it is one of the best he has tasted. And this guy knows food. He is the type of person that has a hog slaughtered and knows what to do with the meat.

So it's a great place to go for chicken soup, and I heard the queso fundido is pretty darn good as well. Although it was recommended you order just the queso, and if you want chorizo, ask for it on the side because otherwise it gets a little greasy.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The atmosphere is festive and there is a nice variety of Spanish music. The service is attentive and they accommodated my picky order. The salad could be improved by using a different type of lettuce. My culinary friend recommends the chicken soup, which he claims is one of the best he's ever tasted. It's a great place to go for chicken soup and the queso fundido is also highly recommended, although it is advised to order only the queso and request chorizo on the side to avoid excessive grease.

input: I went in when they had 4 people working, waited for 15 minutes for my tea latte which came out as basically water. Returned it twice but gave up when the barista offered some other iced tea latte they already had instead. It was still the same - water. The baristas should REALLY REALLY learn how to make their stuff... seriously Starbucks??!!! So disappointed!!!!! :'(
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I went to Starbucks when they had 4 people working. Unfortunately, I had to wait for 15 minutes for my tea latte, but when I received it, it was essentially water. I returned it twice, but eventually gave up when the barista suggested an alternative iced tea latte they already had. To my disappointment, it was also watered down. The baristas at Starbucks really need to improve their drink-making skills. I expected better from them. Extremely disappointed. :'(

input: We recently moved from Brooklyn, NY and have been in search of some really good pizza...and here it is! We were so happy to bite into a thin crispy crust! It was awesome, the service was amazing and we couldn't be more pleased. I highly recommend this place if you love great pizza and excellent customer service! They will surely get our business again and again.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We recently moved from Brooklyn, NY and finally found an amazing pizza place! We were delighted with the thin crispy crust and excellent service. Highly recommended for pizza lovers who enjoy exceptional customer service. We will definitely be returning customers.

input: This place might surpass me going to halal guys.Came in at 9:50, they close at 10; felt bad but this guy Jules was friendly throughout the whole ordeal, explained what I didn't know on the menu. Ordered the steak shwarma with rice with all the sauces. He even gave a sample of the Baba ganoush which was pretty good. The food however was.....ABSOLUTELY delicious!!! This had that healthy feel to it and was filling. Definitely coming back
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place exceeded my expectations. I arrived just before closing time and felt bad, but the friendly employee named Jules was helpful and explained items on the menu that I was unfamiliar with. I decided to order the steak shwarma with rice and all the sauces. Jules even gave me a sample of their delicious Baba ganoush. The food was absolutely delicious and had a healthy and satisfying feel to it. I will definitely be returning.

input: I loved the atmosphere here. It was quiet, but not too quiet. The waiters and waitresses made casual conversation, but still checked to see that the customers were satisfied. It's a small place, but there seems to be plenty of room. Everyone that worked there was friendly and happy to help. The food was also delicious. I had the Crabby Wife, which I'd definitely recommend (with fried eggs) while my boyfriend had the chicken & waffles (get it with hot-sauce, syrup, and the sauce they provide you - it was fantastic!). Overall, it was great.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The atmosphere was perfect - not too quiet, with friendly and attentive waitstaff. Despite being a small place, there was plenty of space. The staff was happy to assist and the food, especially the Crabby Wife with fried eggs, and the chicken & waffles with hot-sauce, syrup, and their provided sauce, was delicious. Overall, it was a great experience.

input: This place deserves a special mention.. it's not really on the heart of the city (for tourists), but it's definitely a place you should mark down for one brunch at least...shrimp n grits are hands down the best we've had in the city....the juices were fresh... and for a person who has a hard time eating Omelettes, Surrey's has converted me for sure.. the lump crab omelette with the sauce was just the cure for a dull grey rainy morning...! Word of caution-the place is always full, so make sure you get there at least 30 mins before you really want to eat, just to make sure you don't starve over the delish smells that keep on wafting out
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place deserves a special mention as it offers the best shrimp n grits in the city. Located away from the city center for tourists, it is worth a visit for brunch. The fresh juices and delicious lump crab omelette with sauce are highly recommended. However, be aware that the place is always busy, so arrive at least 30 minutes early to avoid hunger while being surrounded by mouthwatering aromas.

input: I do like this store. Its large and clean and they seem to have a large selection of everything. But I just returned from there and have the say the customer service is lacking. I took my french bulldog in to try on some sweaters. Just to be sure I asked if it was ok to actually try stuff on and they said yes. I began looking through the selection and trying stuff on. She is very hard to fit b/c she is short and stocky with a big head. So there I was 27 weeks pregnant with my dog, a purse and a carry cart trying to get her in and out of clothes. I was the only person in the store, while 4 people were behind the counter (and I was in plain view of them). At some point one of the cats in the store (free roaming) swatted my dog on the nose and she got away from me for a quick second. Still no one came to help. I imagine if I had asked for help someone would have appeased me but I don't think I should have had to ask in the first place. I left without buying any of the many things on my list. Very disappointed with today's visit. I expected better service and maybe that was my fault. I doubt I will be going back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I like this store because it is large, clean, and has a wide selection of items. However, the customer service was lacking during my recent visit. I brought my French bulldog to try on sweaters and asked if it was permitted. Despite being the only customer in the store, with four staff members behind the counter, nobody offered assistance. One of the cats in the store swatted my dog on the nose, causing her to briefly get away from me, but still no one came to help. I left without purchasing anything on my list and was disappointed with the service. I expected better and doubt I will return.

input: Hands down great guys, we have relocated to the area and have older cars. With that age comes quirks, I great appreciate their honesty, hard work and communication of the situation at hand.  Attention to detail is never messed and I highly recommend this shop for any service needs.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: These guys are great. We recently relocated to the area and have older cars that come with their own quirks. I really appreciate their honesty, hard work, and clear communication about the situation. They pay great attention to detail and I highly recommend this shop for any service needs you may have.

input: This place was nice, clean, and bright. It's your typical serve-yourself fro yo bar with several choices for frozen yogurt and a topping station. The cashier was very (berry?) nice and let me pay via credit card even though I was a few cents short of the minimum. I'd say my son enjoyed his time here.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The place was nice, clean, and bright, with a variety of frozen yogurt options and a topping station. The friendly cashier allowed me to pay with a credit card, even though I was a little short on cash. Overall, my son had a great time there.

input: We stopped by a couple of weeks ago for Sunday brunch.  The food was very good and filling.  Nice drinks, and we had a very pleasant server.  Cool cafe space.  Overall a good recommend.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We visited a few weeks ago for Sunday brunch and had a great experience. The food was delicious and satisfying, accompanied by enjoyable drinks. Our server was attentive and pleasant. The cafe space had a cool ambiance. We would happily recommend it.

input: First visit tonight. Nice, clean place. Reasonably priced. Friendly staff. Excellent presentation of extremely bland, mediocre food. I ordered the chicken fajitas. Onions and pepper base (warm) on a tepid fajita platter. Meat, room temperature. Pico, cheese, sour cream, tortillas were nothing special. I was underwhelmed. I don't think I'll be back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: First visit tonight. Nice, clean place with friendly staff and reasonable prices. However, the food was bland and mediocre, especially the chicken fajitas. The onions and peppers were lukewarm, the meat was room temperature, and the accompaniments like pico, cheese, sour cream, and tortillas were unremarkable. Overall, I was underwhelmed and don't plan on returning.

input:
This is my favorite place to enjoy gelato in St. Louis. 

Consider the... 

Coffee house-like atmosphere. 
Large outdoor patio with a fountain and surrounding foliage. 
Delicious gelato and baked goods. 

Yes, everything at Gelateria is pleasing.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Gelateria in St. Louis is my favorite place to enjoy gelato. It offers a coffee house-like atmosphere, a spacious outdoor patio with a fountain and lush foliage, and serves delicious gelato and baked goods. Everything about Gelateria is pleasing.

input: A friend of mine took me to this little jewel near Dale Mabry and it was a great time. Its a small place with under 12 tables and a sushi bar. The bar seems to be the place to sit for the entertainment value. The sushi chefs (and owner) are pretty chatty and always say hi to everyone that comes in. It has a very friendly feel. We ended up at a table because the bar was full. I had pretty average fare in a spicy tuna roll and a rainbow roll, a couple pieces of yellow tail, and 2 pieces of Wahoo. It was all done very well! Super fresh and tasty. The sticky rice wasnt all that sticky and I ended up with a bowl fill of soy sauce and rice by the end of it, but that Wahoo...whoa....that Wahoo!! Just try it and you wont be disappointed. I spent about $30 for dinner which was a fine price for what I got and I will certainly be back for more!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My friend took me to a small and friendly sushi place near Dale Mabry with under 12 tables and a sushi bar. The bar is a popular spot for entertainment and the sushi chefs (including the owner) are friendly and greet everyone. Although we had to sit at a table, the food was excellent. I ordered a spicy tuna roll, rainbow roll, yellowtail, and Wahoo - all fresh and delicious. The sticky rice was a bit loose, but the highlight was definitely the flavorful Wahoo. Dinner cost me around $30, which was worth it. I will definitely return for more.

input: Cheap food and large selection. Unfortunately, they forgot our order, we waited 15 minutes and they were not even sorry about it. Bad customer service.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Cheap food and large selection, but poor customer service as our order was forgotten and we were not given any apology despite waiting for 15 minutes.

input:
For a long, long time, Dallesandro's was my philly cheesesteak haven.  However, since their change in ownership, they've gone steadily downhill.  Chubby's and Mama's tided me over until I could find suitable replacement.  Thanks to Larry's Steaks, I've rekindled my passion for cheesesteaks.

Larry's Steaks, situated by St. Joe's University, offers the closest thing to the original Dallesandro's cheesesteak I've found.  The meat is sliced and minced into tiny little pieces, maximizing surface area.  Then the cheese is melted throughout so it covers most of the steak and ensures a heavenly consistency and flavor.  The onions and mushrooms are up to snuff as well.  It's greasy enough to slide down your throat but not so much that it's a mess to eat.  I can't attest to the other menu items, but that hardly matters.  If you are up for a real philly cheesesteak, skip pat's and geno's (and the whiz, i can't believe people actually eat that stuff) and pick up a Larry's steak.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Since the change in ownership, Dallesandro's cheesesteak quality has declined. Chubby's and Mama's were temporary replacements until I discovered Larry's Steaks near St. Joe's University. Larry's Steaks serves a cheesesteak closest to the original Dallesandro's. The meat is finely minced, maximizing surface area, and the cheese is melted throughout for a heavenly consistency and flavor. The onions and mushrooms are also excellent. It's greasy enough to be enjoyable without being messy. Skip Pat's and Geno's and try a cheesesteak from Larry's.

input:
I concur with the other comments that this place is awful.   The service here was about as bad as I have ever seen.   The food arrived cold and had to be sent back - which of course turned into a big ordeal.  

Until the management here shows some leadership and sets some higher expectations of their service and kitchen staff, I would avoid this place.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I agree with the other comments that this place is terrible. The service was extremely poor, and the food was cold and had to be returned. Unless the management improves their leadership and sets higher expectations for their staff, I recommend avoiding this place.

input: Well I did visit here a Year ago, long before the e.coli / colliform scare, so I have not been back out of concern for my health and safety. Darn shame too as I really did like this place, but I must admit that I still am not confident they have their act in order. My suggestion is they need to cook their meat longer and ensure it reaches optimum 165°F Temp, serve the food very hot temp to ensure bacteria are dead, and only source their greens and veggies from USA only sources. Avoid Mexico as they have big issues with water pollution cross-contamination.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I visited this place a year ago before the e.coli/colliform scare. Due to concerns for my health and safety, I haven't returned. It's unfortunate because I enjoyed the place, but I still doubt they have improved their practices. My suggestion is for them to cook their meat longer and ensure it reaches the optimal temperature of 165°F. They should also serve the food at a very hot temperature to ensure bacteria are killed, and only use greens and veggies sourced from the USA to avoid potential water pollution cross-contamination issues in Mexico.

input:
I can't believe I have to give a star.  Quick rundown.  I ordered:
single with no ketchup, mayo, or mustard with med fried and large unsweetened teas
double with everything lg fries large coke
2 5 piece nuggets
side salad
cheeseburger kids meal plain with oranges and vanilla frosty.
Ok now for what I GOT:
double with bacon, no ketchup mayo or mustard, lg fries, coke
single with everything, lg fries coke
hamburger kids meal with fries and coke
right around the time I said no ketchup a blank look came across the face of the employee.
This is not rocket science.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
Ordered:
- Single burger with no ketchup, mayo, or mustard, medium fries, and large unsweetened teas.
- Double burger with everything, large fries, and large coke.
- 2 5-piece nuggets.
- Side salad.
- Cheeseburger kids meal plain with oranges and vanilla frosty.

Received:
- Double burger with bacon, no ketchup, mayo or mustard, large fries, and coke.
- Single burger with everything, large fries, and coke.
- Hamburger kids meal with fries and coke.

Additional note:
- Employee seemed confused when I requested no ketchup.

The order should have been simple.

input: First time checking it out first breakfast as recommended by a friend! Service was quick and friendly. It was a busy Saturday morning but we got seated right away. I loved the veggie omelette with fruit and rye toast. Overall good selection to fit anyone's tastes. Reasonable prices for the amount of food. Will be back again!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Visited for the first time based on a friend's recommendation. Service was fast and friendly on a busy Saturday morning. Got seated immediately. Enjoyed the delicious veggie omelette with fruit and rye toast. Diverse menu options to meet everyone's preferences. Affordable prices for generous portions. Will definitely return.

input: Wells Fargo is a great atmosphere for all ages. Flyers host a great game every time I got no matter where you sit. I would recommend everyone to a game even if you don't like hockey!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Wells Fargo offers a fantastic atmosphere for people of all ages. The Flyers consistently deliver an amazing game experience, regardless of where you are seated. I highly recommend attending a game, even if you're not a hockey fan.

input: Place for latest night eats around and drive through is a must. New menu items and some veggie options etc. forgot to put my dessert order in the bag though so I was very bummed when I noticed far too late!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Looking for a place with late-night eats and drive-through service? Check out this spot for the latest menu items, including some veggie options. However, my only disappointment was that my dessert order was forgotten and I didn't realize until much later.

input: Try the spinach and feta hummus, it is amazing. I had the chicken caesar pita and if was wonderful. The caesar dressing was very flavorful and the greens (romaine, mixed greens, etc) were good quality and flavorful (not your typical bagged junk). Pulling up the the place I was skeptical (they're in an old garage) but give it a try, well worth it.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The spinach and feta hummus is amazing. The chicken caesar pita was wonderful with flavorful caesar dressing and high-quality greens. Despite being located in an old garage, it is definitely worth trying.

input: Love this place! Almost all of their menu items can be made vegan. They are super knowledgeable. The Pad Thai with tofu, veggies, and cashews is perfection. The avocado egg rolls are amazing too! A favorite.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love this place! They offer a wide range of vegan options on their menu and have excellent knowledge about them. The Pad Thai with tofu, veggies, and cashews is absolutely perfect, and the avocado egg rolls are also amazing. Both are personal favorites.

input:
I've often passed this swanky little place in Downtown filled with good-looking professionals laughing over drinks, appetizers and spilling over the sidewalk

NOM NOMS
Although you probably won't get full on the sizes, the food is like little art works of flavor. My bowl of mussels and clams was HUGE and I sopped up the buttery, faintly spiced broth with the accompanying breadstick. Well done. The other appetizers like Tuna Tartare and Coconut Shrimp each had awesome flavor surprises - fresh, melty tuna and a wasabi and jam sauce respectively - both excellent and plated beautifully.

My cocktail "The Tryst" didn't impress. Watery and a strange alcohol after taste. I'll forget it tomorrow. 

SERVICE
Thanks Yelp for introducing me here. It's easy to get overlooked at the bar, but once seated, our server was quick and helpful and was great at lowering my inhibitions by telling me what to expect in a "vegetable" beer they offered--spot on. 

SUMMARY
I'll probably stick to the drinks only here because the food prices are above my range... or go during happy hours. Cool, hip place to bring the girlfriends or if you're looking for impressive, gutsy art dishes with good taste.... and if you have cash to blow (but I won't let that subtract a review star)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: NOM NOMS in Downtown is a swanky place filled with good-looking professionals enjoying drinks and appetizers. The food, though not filling, is like little art works of flavor. The mussels and clams were huge and delicious, and the other appetizers had surprising flavors. However, the cocktail "The Tryst" was watery and had a strange alcohol aftertaste. The service, once seated, was quick and helpful. Overall, I will probably stick to drinks only or visit during happy hours due to higher food prices. It's a cool place to go with friends or for impressive dishes, if you don't mind spending more.

input: The great customer service that you get here, you won't find in another to-go Asian/Thai restaurant. I enjoyed the food! The curry had great flavor and consistency. The shrimp fried rice does not look appealing but it is flavorful and fluffy. I dropped it down to 4 stars because I paid an additional $2.00 for extra egg and it was NOT extra egg. I also called in my order and received a 30 minute wait time. Total wait time was an hour. With all that being said, the ladies won me over with their passion to serve those waiting and making sure each customer was happy!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This Asian/Thai restaurant stands out with exceptional customer service which is hard to find elsewhere. The food, especially the curry, is delicious with impressive flavors and consistency. Despite the unattractive appearance, the shrimp fried rice is actually tasty and fluffy. My rating is reduced to 4 stars as I paid an extra $2.00 for additional egg which turned out to be disappointing. Additionally, though I initially called in my order with a 30 minute wait time, the total wait time ended up being an hour. Nevertheless, the passionate efforts of the friendly staff, particularly the ladies, to serve and ensure customer satisfaction won me over.

input: Ordered fresh made pie, not reheated slices.  Some of the best pizza I've had in philly, because of the tasteful and crunchy crust and good amount of toppings.  Had a Cowboy steak with no BBQ sauce and couldn't stop myself at two slices.  Got the same pizza again with bbq sauce and it was just as good so now I do half and half.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Ordered fresh, not reheated, pie - one of the best in Philly. The tasteful and crunchy crust, with generous toppings, make it exceptional. The Cowboy steak, without BBQ sauce, was irresistible - couldn't stop at just two slices. Tried the same pizza with BBQ sauce and it was equally delicious. Now I go half and half.

input:
It's just a place to get my mail. 
It's about $250.00 per year for a little box.  it makes sense for us because we travel so much.  I don't want any important mail being delivered to my house.  
I have a door key to the store so I can access my letter box after hours.
My larger parcels are kept in the back.  I get a phone call every time I receive one.  
I would rather ship out my parcels using Fed-ex because they are cheaper and more reliable.   
My husband has used their printing services and is happy with them. 
I see packaging materials and other stationary goods for sale, but I prefer to use Canada Post for that.
No problem with the staff.  They are cheerful and helpful.  They know me well.
The strip mall location can be a little sketchy.  Some druggies and homeless people like to hang out at the neighbouring store fronts.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We use a mail service that costs around $250 per year for a small box. This is convenient for us as we travel frequently and don't want important mail delivered to our home. I have a key to access the box after hours, and larger parcels are stored in the back with notification when they arrive. We prefer using FedEx for shipping as they are affordable and reliable. My husband uses their printing services and is satisfied. While there are packaging materials available, I prefer using Canada Post for that. The staff is friendly and familiar with us. The strip mall location can be a bit sketchy with occasional presence of druggies and homeless people in nearby storefronts.

input: I just walked out of Heads and Tails and I can't  say enough about Jenne.  I was quite nervous to have a bikini wax and Jenne talked me though the whole process and it was not bad at all!  If you have sensitive skin and are looking for a clean place with an excellent staff - do not hesitate going here. Will be back!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I highly recommend Jenne at Heads and Tails for a bikini wax. She made me feel comfortable and talked me through the entire process, which was not as bad as I expected. If you have sensitive skin and want a clean place with an excellent staff, don't hesitate to go here. I will definitely be returning.

input: Ordered some food at 11:47pm after not eating all day due to airline issues. I was starving. 2 and 1/2 hours later my food was delivered after I called twice looking for it.  When it arrived, there was no utensils or napkins.  I ate my salad with my fingers.  The food is good, the service is horrible.  Never again!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Ordered food at 11:47pm after a day of not eating due to airline issues. Food arrived 2.5 hours later after two phone calls. No utensils or napkins included. Ate salad with fingers. Good food, but terrible service. Will not order again.

input: Delicious and very nicely presented. We had J Sushi and Fire Roll and fantastic. Excellent service and great value.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: J Sushi and Fire Roll were delicious and beautifully presented. The service was excellent and the value was great.

input: My wife and I just moved to town and where saddened to have to move away from our local beloved Mexican restaurant.  We passed by this place several times knowing that once we moved in we would have to try it.  And OMG we where floored, the restaurant had great traditional ambiance and the service was top knotch.  They served glass bottle sodas which personally is something I love.  The food was amazing, my wife had the Taco Sombrero and I had the Chimichanga.  Both where amazing.  This place is 6 stars if I could give it.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We recently moved to town and were sad to leave our favorite local Mexican restaurant behind. However, we were excited to try a new place that caught our attention. To our delight, the restaurant had a wonderful traditional ambiance and provided exceptional service. They even served glass bottle sodas, which I personally love. The food surpassed our expectations - my wife enjoyed the Taco Sombrero, while I had the Chimichanga, and both dishes were incredible. If I could, I would give this place 6 stars for its overall excellence.

input:
As much as I adore food I am, typically, pretty easy when it comes to food and I forgive a lot. SO...one star means a lot! I haven't been as livid as I was leaving this fiasco of a restaurant in a long while. Reasons:  The server was on her cell phone from the minute we walked in to the minute we walked out (about 90 minutes).
