She literally had it on her shoulder the entire time except to say, "Please hold" to take our orders. She was also the chef and cooked while talking on her bloody phone, as well. Service:  FAIL.
My pork leg was tender and good which constitutes the lonely little star you see above. My husband ordered the shrimp, which cost $18.99. He received 7 shrimp that would be in a bag of 31-35 count...the size worthy of a salad shrimp. Again, $18.99...and the plantain portion of the meal consisted of 2 plantains the width of a postage stamp. Ridiculous. I then ordered tostones because I knew he would never be full with that quantity of food. I had to get up and find our server to add to my order as she was nowhere to be found.  They were also ridiculously thin, were over salted with an almost breaded and deep fried consistency. Food:  FAIL.
I was going to order a Cuban coffee but the server was so non-existent that I just gave up, finally.  In retrospect, I'm happy I didn't order it because I'm sure it would have been just wrong.
I would not frequent this restaurant again even if I had a free coupon. Don't waste your time or energy.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This restaurant was a complete disappointment. The server was constantly on her cell phone, neglecting her duties, and even cooked while talking on the phone. The service was a failure. Although my pork leg was decent, my husband's $18.99 shrimp dish consisted of only 7 small shrimp. The portion of plantains was minuscule. I had to hunt down the server to place an additional order, and the tostones were overly thin, overly salted, and had a breaded and deep-fried texture. The food was also a letdown. The server was so absent that I didn't bother ordering a Cuban coffee. Overall, I would never visit this restaurant again, even with a free coupon. It's a waste of time and energy.

input:
Excellent customer service. I wish I could rent from there more often! Had such a great experience verses other car rental services. 

Rent if you can!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great customer service and a fantastic experience compared to other car rental services. I wish I could rent from there more often. Highly recommend if you have the opportunity.

input: Taking over in the spot of the original Benton Park  Cafe is Cafe Piazza.  The atmosphere is really nice and super ST. LOUIS.  The mural on the ceiling is a very eclectic work of art. Ask them how they did it and look under the bar. Great food. Different from your standard breakfast food.  Kinda fancy, but not intimidating.  I would highly recommend this restaurant for three reasons: decor, location, and good, creative food for the price.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Cafe Piazza has replaced Benton Park Cafe and offers a pleasant and authentically ST. LOUIS atmosphere. The captivating mural on the ceiling is an eclectic masterpiece. You can inquire about its creation and also explore under the bar. The restaurant serves excellent and unique breakfast options that are slightly upscale but not overwhelming. I highly recommend Cafe Piazza for its impressive decor, convenient location, and the delicious and innovative food it offers at a reasonable price.

input:
I am a groupie. He is amazing. I am sad that I got to have his dish only once. Now all construction on market I can't find him!!

His chicken is the most tender and smoky I've ever had. Side dishes are creative and awesome too. 
I hope he is back soon.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I'm a groupie and he's amazing. I'm sad I only got to try his dish once. I can't find him due to ongoing market construction. His chicken is incredibly tender and smoky, and the side dishes are creative and awesome. I hope he returns soon.

input:
Enjoyed a company corporate holiday party with 2K+ people in the Tuscany Ballroom with an overnight stay in the Tuscan Tower.  By far the very best resort in the area delivering a cruise ship like first class experience.  I don't smoke and didn't notice the typical second hand casino smoke.    

Bonus was eating breakfast in the coffee shop with the Peppermill CEO/GM John Hanson pulling up a seat next to me at the counter engaging in friendly conversation about my stay while enjoying his breakfast.   Doesn't get much better than this folks.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Had an amazing time at the company corporate holiday party with over 2,000 people. The event took place in the Tuscany Ballroom, and I stayed overnight in the Tuscan Tower. This resort is by far the best in the area, offering a first-class experience similar to a cruise ship. Despite not being a smoker, I didn't notice any typical secondhand casino smoke. A bonus was having breakfast in the coffee shop, where I had the pleasure of sitting next to John Hanson, the CEO/GM of Peppermill, who engaged in friendly conversation about my stay. It truly doesn't get any better than this.

input:
Wow.  I have to say incredible.  We've driven by the place several times and always had that "meh' attitude because of how the plaza looks.  Since the wife was craving some crispy duck it came up as having the best reviews for it.
  Walking in, was a great traditional indian/thai setting with a comfortable small raunt demeanor.  We tried the mussel appetizer, while the wife got the Tamarind Duck and I tried the Panang Curry with calamari.
  Service was prompt, quick and non invasive.  Mussels were tasty, but the Duck and Curry were to die for!  Portion sizes are definitely reflective of the prices so don't feel like you are going to get gyped.
  We will be back to at least try the sushi or get more duck seeing as they have at least 2 more styles of it.
  Happy tastebuds!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We were pleasantly surprised by the incredible experience at this restaurant. Despite initially having low expectations due to the appearance of the plaza, we decided to give it a try based on its excellent reviews for crispy duck. The interior had a charming traditional Indian/Thai setting, creating a comfortable atmosphere. We ordered the mussel appetizer along with Tamarind Duck and Panang Curry with calamari. The service was prompt and unobtrusive. The mussels were tasty, but the standout dishes were definitely the Duck and Curry, which were absolutely delicious. The portion sizes were fair for the prices charged. We are already looking forward to returning to sample the sushi or try more duck varieties available. Our taste buds were certainly satisfied!

input: Corropolese is a staples in these parts. If you're looking to get tomato pie, it's sacrilege to go anywhere else for it! Now I will admit, they do offer a variety of other items, but I couldn't tell you what they are. Whenever an event calls for a tomato pie, this is where my family goes. No one does it better!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Corropolese is a staple for tomato pie in these parts. When it comes to tomato pie, it's sacrilege to go anywhere else. They have a variety of other items, but when my family needs a tomato pie, this is our go-to place. No one does it better!

input:
Went recently for a birthday party and it was certainly worth checking out.   Was my first time there and I was pleased for sure.  

Was nice and quiet as it was a Tuesday and the service was good because of that.  I'm sure it normally is though based on the size of the place.  

I had beef n lobster which both were cooked well and I was happy.  Also the mashed and asparagus that came with it were both very good.  

I wasn't to stoked with the appy we had which was these crab and cheese balls as they were very bland with little crab taste and no real seasoning it seemed.  Maybe just not for me but I wouldn't recommend those. 

Also had Creme Brule which was solid and is get it again for sure.  

Overall I'd say four due to a couple things like the appy and the shaky table, seriously so stupid to have that at a place that nice.  

But I'd gladly go again and would tell friends to try it.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Recently went to a birthday party at a restaurant and it was worth checking out. It was my first time there and I was pleased. The place was nice and quiet on a Tuesday and the service was good. The beef n lobster dish I had was cooked well and the mashed potatoes and asparagus that came with it were very good. However, the crab and cheese balls appetizer was bland and lacked seasoning. I wouldn't recommend it. The Creme Brule dessert was solid and I would have it again. Overall, I would rate it a four due to the average appetizer and the shaky table. Despite that, I would happily go again and recommend it to friends.

input:
I don't give five star ratings very easily but my wife and I just had a fantastic experience. Debbie was our waitress and she was simply exceptional. Explained the menu and specials as well as answering all my questions. Food was very good, came out fast and hot. Prepared exactly how it was ordered. Will be back. 
Mac n cheese burger was dope fiend!  
Drinks were spot on as well. Whisky sour was great.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had a great experience with Debbie as our waitress. She was exceptional, explaining the menu and specials and answering all our questions. The food was very good, served quickly and hot, prepared exactly as ordered. We will definitely be back. The mac n cheese burger was excellent, and the drinks, especially the whisky sour, were spot on.

input: Fun independent store for holiday gifts. Pleasant staff. Hooray.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Fun store with great holiday gift options and friendly staff.

input:
Based this visit entirely upon previous Yelp reviews, which as usual we're spot on. Great atmosphere and feel to this place - Kind of an art house meets coffee house meets Animal House environment. Very unusual. In a good way. The service was relaxed, social and great. The beverages were delicious and the menu was quite interesting. 
I so wanted the food to be much better than it was. Tried the Bird and Pig, a specialty grilled cheese and a couple apps. Everything was good but not great. In truth, if I was judging on food alone, there would be three stars instead of four. But the atmosphere and the staff clearly deserved the extra star, and I'll head back to try some other items on the menu next visit.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Based on previous Yelp reviews, this place has a great atmosphere and a unique blend of art house, coffee house, and Animal House vibes. The service was excellent and the beverages were delicious. However, the food did not meet expectations, as it was good but not great. Despite this, the atmosphere and staff deserve the extra star, and I plan to return to try other items on the menu.

input: Joyce is awesome! Love that this does not hurt at all. We drive from palm harbor to her place, and it well worth the extra time. Her machine is high tech, and the horror stories my friends told me of their experience ,, makes me love this even more! Love it!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Joyce is awesome! Her place is worth the extra time it takes to drive from Palm Harbor. The high-tech machine she uses doesn't hurt at all, unlike the horror stories my friends have shared about their experiences. I love it!

input: As an avid knitter, I try to find a local yarn store pretty much wherever I travel. I was delighted to discover that The Quarter Stitch was walking distance from my hotel AND they had a special Mardi Gras yarn in stock. I ended up visiting the store twice while I was in NOLA, once to grab the Mardi Gras yarn and a second time because their selection was just delectable. Added bonus, the staff was amazing and super helpful. I would definitely visit this store again.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: While traveling, I always seek out local yarn stores as an avid knitter. I was thrilled to find that The Quarter Stitch was conveniently located near my hotel in New Orleans. To my delight, they had a special Mardi Gras yarn available. I visited the store twice during my trip, first to purchase the Mardi Gras yarn and then again because their selection was exceptional. The staff was incredibly helpful and friendly, making my experience even better. I would absolutely make a point to visit this store again in the future.

input: Great ice cream, absolutely terrible service. My son and I went in for ice cream on a Sunday afternoon, so maybe they have their worst staff working on a Sunday. We walked in and were ignored by both people behind the counter. The girl (who seemed drunk) was throwing screwed up napkins around and one of them flew over the counter and hit me. No big deal, but no apology, just more hysterically loud laughter and napkin throwing. The guy noticed my son eyeing the candy and yelled at him not to touch anything. I get it, no one wants sandy little hands in the candy. But he wasn't touching anything, so this was just rude. We stood at the counter and the girl begrudgingly served us, no smile, no greeting, she didn't even look at us. Perhaps she was annoyed we had interrupted her flirting. She ran my card and then turned her back to do some weird dance for her work mate while we stood and waited, more loud shouty laughter. I'm all about a great fun atmosphere and I know I sound like a bore. But when it comes hand-in-hand with a rude attitude towards paying customers, it crosses a line.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The ice cream was great, but the service was terrible. When I went with my son on a Sunday afternoon, we were completely ignored by the staff. One of the employees, who seemed drunk, was throwing screwed up napkins around and one hit me without any apology. The other employee yelled at my son for no reason when he was just looking at candy. The girl reluctantly served us without any smile or greeting, appearing more interested in flirting. She turned her back to us after charging my card and did a weird dance while we waited. While I appreciate a fun atmosphere, it becomes unacceptable when it's accompanied by rude treatment towards customers.

input: We visited this place because of its location on the wharf, and because my husband loves seafood. It's tiny, but we were there on a Tuesday evening, and only had to wait a few minutes. We ended up sitting at the bar; it would have been a longer wait for a table outside, since there are so few. Because of its size, it's a little noisy, but not bad. The service was very good. My husband had the crab sandwich, and wasn't impressed. It's served on very uninspiring white bread. I had the fried shrimp, and enjoyed it very much; it was not greasy or heavy, and the shrimp was moist and tasty. There is literally nothing but shellfish on the menu. So, the non-seafood enthusiast (me) was happily surprised to enjoy the shrimp so much (plus good onion rings), but the seafood enthusiast (my husband) didn't love the crab sandwich. If we tried this place again, he would order something else. The location is awesome, so if you like shellfish, definitely give this place a try.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We visited this small restaurant on the wharf because of its location and my husband's love for seafood. Despite its size, we only waited a few minutes on a Tuesday evening and opted to sit at the bar instead of a table outside due to limited availability. The noise level was moderate but bearable. The service was excellent. Unfortunately, my husband was disappointed with the crab sandwich, as it was served on plain white bread. On the other hand, I thoroughly enjoyed the fried shrimp, finding them moist, flavorful, and not greasy. The limited menu consists solely of shellfish options, which pleasantly surprised me, a non-seafood enthusiast. In addition to the shrimp, the onion rings were also quite good. Given the fantastic location, I recommend trying this place if you are a shellfish lover, but my husband would likely choose a different dish if we were to return.

input:
If I could give this place zero stars, I would. I had the worst experience when we went today for brunch that I've ever had in a restaurant since I moved to Tucson 7 years ago! First, before even going today, I called to find out what the brunch entailed and when Rosie answered the phone I told her that I had a few questions about brunch, she told me to hold and never came back to the phone. I stayed on hold for 8 minutes at which I called back and spoke to someone else who just seemed like "Oh Well." This brunch was organized by one of my friends, so choice in location was not something I had. We did have a reservation, but were pushed outside because apparently they only planned for one 8 person table and the other table got there a few moments before us and got to choose. The problem with this is that there were two people in our group that are allergic to bees, myself being one of them, and bees were flying all around our table, especially our food. At one point I had to get away from my seat and was not able to return to it for 5 minutes because the one been landed on my waffle and was not leaving. 

At this point my friend and I recognized the danger for the two of us and asked to be moved inside to which we were told "No." When I asked to speak with a manager, I was told "Well, what did you want?" That's when the manager came up, I explained the situation and he was going to put us at one table to which our waitress, gotten by the hostess came up and said to him "I already to her that they could not move in here." What employee talks like that to their boss! The waitress proceeded to run outside and tell the rest of the group that we were moving at which point they decided to stay outside, which was fine by my friend and I, but that meant having to be separated from our friends. This, to me, is deplorable behavior on the side of the the waitress and management. The waitress who was supposed to be our waitress inside as well, never arrived to the table and never checked up on us. Needless to say, I had to get another waiter and he was so appalled with the way that everything was handled he told my friend to not give him a tip. I was so appalled myself, that I did not eat because I just did not want to spend my hard earn money at this establishment any longer. I would never recommend this place to anyone even if they were starving!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had the worst experience at this restaurant during brunch today. I called beforehand to ask about the brunch but was put on hold for 8 minutes without any response. When we arrived, despite having a reservation, we were seated outside because another group arrived just before us and got to choose their preferred table. This was problematic for two of us who are allergic to bees, as bees were flying around our table and food. When we asked to be moved inside, we were initially refused and the waitress spoke disrespectfully to us and her manager. Eventually, we were moved inside but our original waitress did not attend to us and another waiter was appalled by the poor service. I eventually decided not to eat at this establishment due to the overall experience. I would strongly advise against dining here.

input: I like this place.  Unique sandwiches, and it's definitely the best place to go if you want a healthy option or have vegan friends.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place has unique sandwiches and is the top choice for those seeking a healthy option or wanting to accommodate vegan friends.

input:
Tried the Brew Bros. Burger challenge as a dare from friends. What are friends for? Though I came close to finishing all 4lbs of burgers, fries, and fixings, I fell short on time. Our server was kind enough to issue me a shirt for attempting and "coming the closest to finishing." Whatever that meant. The food was good, staff was great, and the challenge left me with a stomach ache for 3-days. 

I did not get a chance to sample their beer selections but from what my friends said, it's good. I would not recommend the burger challenge if you're going to drink beer. Otherwise for $24, it's by far the best deal on the menu; especially if you split with friends! (splitting the meal violates the rules of the competition)

If I'm ever in the Reno area again, I will be back to conquer that elusive challenge!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Tried the Brew Bros. Burger challenge as a dare from friends. Fell short on time but came close to finishing all 4lbs of food. Server gave me a shirt for attempting. Food was good, staff was great. Challenge left me with a 3-day stomach ache. Didn't try their beer, but friends said it's good. Not recommended with beer. Best deal on the menu for $24, especially if you split with friends (not allowed in the competition). Will return to conquer challenge if in Reno again.

input: Great Breakfast and service. Sunny side skillet (under $8) with a pancake was delicious! Atmosphere and store selections well above all other locations.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Excellent breakfast and service. The Sunny Side Skillet, priced at under $8, paired with a pancake, was incredibly tasty. The atmosphere is unparalleled, and the store offers a wide range of selections, surpassing all other locations.

input: Good and fast service....meat is always very juice ....BBQ sauce is great...prices are reasonable...if you this truck around stop and try you won't be disappointed
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This truck provides good and fast service with juicy meat, great BBQ sauce, and reasonable prices. If you come across this truck, don't hesitate to try it - you won't be disappointed.

input:
I really wanted to like this place and heard about it during lent when I had given up meat. I found myself in the area again and decided to give it a try. I usually don't write reviews until I've been to a place a few times but I think my experience was a complete one. I ordered the special and sampled each type of chicken, the modern BBQ sauce, mac&cheese (which the woman behind the counter was very proud of), 
a bananas foster pie, and the new hope birch beer. After finishing everything, I just wanted my $16.20 back. Individual reviews: 

The chicken: It was very average and that is being generous. It wasn't incredibly flavorful but it wasn't dry so it could have been worse. 

The sauce: It had the tang of a traditional North Carolina BBQ sauce, mustard and vinegar based. I can't eat mayo so I was limited with sauce choices but the mayo sauces were recommended. 

The mac&cheese: Salty and mediocre. It combines all of the things I like but makes a mess doing it. The pasta was well cooked but the cheese and bacon combo made it taste like I just licked salt off of my hand without the nice shot of tequila after. 

The bananas foster pie: The crust of the pie needs no improvement but the filling could use an overhaul. I use the term filling loosely because after biting into the flakey crust, I struggled to find the bananas. There was a thin layer of smashed bananas and cinnamon sugar at the bottom and 75% of the interior was empty space. 

The new hope soda: The birch beer (the actual name of the soda escapes me at the moment but it is birch beer) was the highlight of my meal. Everything you would expect from a Pennsylvania birch beer and very refreshing, which surprised me because I normally don't like fountain sodas and prefer root beer.

I gave this place 2 stars instead of 1 because nothing was horrible.  I think the concept works, the decor is nice, and the menu is good but they need to work on the quality of their food because it currently doesn't match the cost.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I wanted to like this place after hearing about it during lent. I ordered the special and tried the different types of chicken, the BBQ sauce, mac&cheese, bananas foster pie, and birch beer. Overall, the chicken was average and the sauce had a tangy flavor. The mac&cheese was salty and mediocre. The bananas foster pie had a good crust but lacked filling. However, the highlight was the birch beer, which was refreshing. I gave this place 2 stars because while the concept, decor, and menu are good, the food quality doesn't match the cost.

input:
The service is going to be slooooww. And the food okay. Do not come here if you are with a group more than 4 if you have to be anywhere because it will be slow. 

I came with a group and we were the only ones around and the service was still a mess. There were multiple servers around who watched one server struggle. I felt bad for her. She was making drinks, serving, and running food.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The service is slow and the food is average. Avoid coming here with a group larger than 4 if you have a time constraint as the service will be even slower. During my visit, our group was the only ones present and yet the service was still disorganized. Multiple servers were present but only one was struggling to handle all tasks including making drinks, serving, and running food. I sympathized with her.

input: Expensive but great service & food. The ribeye melted in my mouth. The burger was huge & delicious w/ every bite. The bread pudding is everything it's hyped up to be. Definitely go at least once & share some meals w/ friends.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Expensive but great service & food. Ribeye melted in my mouth; burger was huge & delicious. Bread pudding lives up to the hype. Definitely worth a visit, and try sharing meals with friends.

input: Excellent menu with locally sourced food that constantly changes. A delight for your taste buds. Reservations can be hard to get, so plan in advance.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Locally sourced food with an excellent menu that frequently changes, making it a delightful experience for your taste buds. Due to high demand, it is recommended to plan and book reservations in advance.

input:
Spot on!

I got "the veg" and the spicy fries.  "The veg" is a portabella burger, with grilled mozzarella, picked veg, arugula, and gauc.  Wholly non-cow is this thing spectacular for a bella burger!  The bella is on bottom, then the mozzarella is directly fused on top of that.  I actually thought the cheese was halloumi at first because it wasn't super melted (a good thing). The gauc and pickled veg are slightly citrusy and vinegary, but are contrasted by the bitterness of the arugula.  There's a nice bun to contents ratio, and for bonus points it's a potato bun.

Wasn't sure what to expect with the spicy fries going in - are they hot sauce fries, etc?  Turns out they are of the crab-fries variety with some subtle other spices added in.  Nice portion - not too big.

The atmosphere kind of reminds me of a dive bar - I think that's the best way to describe it.  It's pretty small, so I wouldn't choose to ever eat in most likely.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
I had "the veg" which is a portabella burger with grilled mozzarella, picked veg, arugula, and gauc. The burger is amazing, with the mozzarella perfectly melted on top. The gauc and pickled veg add a citrusy and vinegary flavor, balanced by the bitterness of the arugula. The bun to contents ratio is just right. 

The spicy fries were a pleasant surprise, similar to crab fries with some additional spices. The portion size was good, not too big. 

The atmosphere reminded me of a dive bar, which is not ideal for dining in due to its small size.

input:
Being a vegetarian while visiting New Orleans is no easy feat.  However, when I have found eats, they are usually very good.  Tomasito's was below the standard I have gotten used to.  Not to say it was bad, not at all.  I had the chips and a bean and cheese burrito. I would have gotten rice in my burrito but it was not vegetarian (really?).  Service was ok, and the flan was excellent (although "with berries" seems to mean one raspberry).
That being said, at least there was food to eat on the menu, and that is not assumes in New Orleans.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Being a vegetarian in New Orleans is challenging, but I have found some good eats. Tomasito's fell below my expectations, although it wasn't bad. I had the chips and a bean and cheese burrito without rice, which wasn't vegetarian for some reason. Service was okay, and the flan was excellent, although it only had one raspberry despite being described as "with berries". At least there was food on the menu, which cannot be assumed in New Orleans.

input: Best Mexican restaurant I've been to in a long time food was great drinks were great and prices are reasonable
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Best Mexican restaurant with great food, drinks, and reasonable prices.

input: Really loud live music...but a much more subdued bar on the second floor where you can actually hold a conversation.

input: Steve our Roto-Rooter tech saved us!! Thanks to Steve! We just moved into a new house and had sewer back-up a week later. It was coming out into the yard and not pretty. We are running free now and hopefully won't need to call back any time soon. If we do we will certainly call Roto- rooter again!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Steve from Roto-Rooter saved us from a sewer back-up that occurred a week after moving into our new house. It was an unpleasant situation with sewage overflowing into our yard. Thanks to Steve, we are now free from this problem and hopeful that we won't need their services again anytime soon. However, if we do, we will definitely choose Roto-Rooter.

input:
All I needed was a written estimate.  A rather simple task one would think.  I needed my factory navigation unit in my Denali replaced, and needed to know costs and in writing.  Now this is a normal standard procedure for an auto repair shop.  Let's just assume its bad (it is), so tell me how much it is to remove bad part, and put the new one in.

Jay Fatimo or something like that, said he was very busy, as were the other service writers, so he handed me his card, and said to just email him with what I needed.  Sounded like a good plan, I wasn't in a big rush.  So I did just that, sent a picture of my vin, and the appropriate RPO codes to know what part I needed, and emailed it all to him.  I never got a response.  I tried again about a week or so later, still nothing.  Made sure it is his email at the dealership, etc.  

I guess I have a hard time with taking my car in or trusting a place to do such repairs (3000 dollar job according to Winkel GMC) if they can't even respond to an email.  He knew I would email that day, and I did.  

I guess the GMC dealer right next door gets my money instead.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I needed a written estimate for the replacement of my factory navigation unit in my Denali. I was told to email Jay Fatimo with the necessary information, but despite two attempts, I never received a response. It is disappointing that a dealership cannot even respond to an email, so I will be taking my business to the GMC dealer next door instead. According to Winkel GMC, the job is estimated to cost $3000.

input:
I've been a fan of this place for a long time! Their hazelnut cake is awesome, as are many of their other cakes. I was 'sent' there years ago by recommendation for this signature cake and it more than lived up to it's reputation.

Their butter cookies are awesome -  absolutely love them. I frequently stop in to get cookie gifts to give to family and friends for special occasions - always a huge hit!

I think their prices are right in line with their products. They are always consistently great.

The people that work there are wonderful - friendly and helpful!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love this place! Their hazelnut cake and other cakes are amazing. I first tried their signature cake years ago after it was highly recommended, and it definitely lived up to its reputation. Their butter cookies are also fantastic, and I often give them as gifts because they are always a big hit. The prices are reasonable for the quality they offer, and the staff is friendly and helpful.

input:
First time for lunch.  Extensive and flavorful gluten free menu.  

Good lunch and friendly service.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great gluten-free lunch menu with friendly service for a first-time visit.

input:
Service here was excellent. They hosted us for an event and were awesome. 

However, I felt that is where the awesome stopped. The food I had (brisket) was mediocre at best, maybe it had been sitting under lamps all day? The bread it was served on was tough. The mac and cheese was pretty good. My glassware for beer was dirty, chilled, and they were out of everything on draft.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Service was excellent during our event, but the food fell short of expectations. The brisket I had was mediocre, possibly due to being left under lamps for too long. The bread served with it was tough, however, the mac and cheese was quite enjoyable. Unfortunately, the glassware for beer was dirty and chilled, and they had run out of all draft options.

input:
This tour is one to take when you want to have a lazy day, but you want to do a passive activity.  Me & my friends didn't wan the lunch, we just wanted to take a tour of the Mississippi.  The cost was average - around $28.00.  Con:  Remember it is a tour, so they have the typical tourist traps - photographer - me and friends declined that option.  

I would suggest if you aren't going to eat - to pull out your smartphone and research the Natchez Native American Tribe who inhibited the area prior to the colonization of the New Orleans area - interesting "tid bits of rituals", so that made the boat ride more fun because I became the secondary tour leader to my group.  If you are in the mood-go get a drink and this will comfort you as you learn more about the area on a steamboat.  Not a bad way to spend a few hours.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
This tour is perfect for a relaxed and passive day. My friends and I opted to skip lunch and just enjoy a tour of the Mississippi. It was reasonably priced at around $28. However, be aware that this is a typical tourist tour, with optional add-ons like a photographer, which we chose not to take. 

I recommend using your smartphone to research the Natchez Native American Tribe, who inhabited the area before New Orleans was colonized. Learning interesting tidbits about their rituals added more enjoyment to the boat ride, as I became the secondary tour leader for my group. If you're in the mood, grab a drink and immerse yourself in the area's history on the steamboat. Overall, it's a great way to spend a few hours.

input: Just visited The Fat Ham with my girlfriend about an hour ago. The place is small, but the vibe is nice. Music isn't too loud, the staff welcomed us and the whiskey display is impressive. We couldn't get a table, so we took the two empty seats at the bar. The bartender, Dan, greeted us immediately. Dan was effecient, quick and friendly. Great service. My girlfriend ordered a margarita, which was reasonably priced and tasty. To eat, we ordered the pimento cheese, skillet cornbread, shrimp & grits and the hot chicken. Everything was delicious. The pimento cheese had some heat, and the country bread it is served with gives it a nice touch of salt. The mollases butter on the cornbread was "to die for". The shrimp & grits was my favorite dish. Creamy grits, perfectly cooked and seasoned shrimp. As for the chicken, they do not lie to you. It is hot. The brioche and ranch dressing compliment it well. For desert, we ordered the raspberry cobbler and a coffee. The cobbler was underwhelming. It wasn't bad - just not as great as the previous plates. Elixr coffee was spot on. Overall, I'll be back. Decent price point, high end comfort food and great service.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Just visited The Fat Ham with my girlfriend an hour ago. Small place with a nice vibe. Welcoming staff and impressive whiskey display. Couldn't get a table, so sat at the bar. Bartender, Dan, greeted us immediately and provided efficient and friendly service. Girlfriend's margarita was reasonably priced and tasty. Ordered pimento cheese, skillet cornbread, shrimp & grits, and hot chicken to eat. Everything was delicious. Pimento cheese had a nice heat and country bread had a touch of salt. Molasses butter on cornbread was amazing. Shrimp & grits was my favorite dish, with creamy grits and perfectly seasoned shrimp. Hot chicken lived up to its name, with brioche and ranch dressing complementing it well. For dessert, had raspberry cobbler and coffee. Cobbler was underwhelming, but coffee was great. Overall, will definitely return. Decent price point, high-end comfort food, and great service.

input: When this place first opened we went. We loved the Greek salad and gyros. It was very fresh tasting and the place was cute. We went back last night- the tables were all dirty, lamps full of dirt and dead bugs- so that was a turn off. We got our food and the quality has gone way down. My salad had one bite of potato salad and two items in the salad - tomato and pepper tasted off. I had to spit them out. My daughter got a fajita bowl with chicken. Her tomato was also gross and the chicken was cooked into charred rubber. We ordered baklava and it was stale. I hope they clean and go back to the quality it was when they first opened. It was yummy and clean.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Initially, we were fans of this place when it first opened due to the delicious Greek salad and gyros. The food had a fresh taste, and the establishment had a charming ambiance. However, upon our recent visit, we were disappointed to find dirty tables and lamps filled with dirt and dead bugs, which was quite off-putting. Moreover, the quality of the food has significantly declined. My salad consisted of only a meager portion of potato salad and two ingredients, tomato and pepper, which tasted peculiar and had to be spat out. Additionally, my daughter's fajita bowl with chicken had a revolting tomato and the chicken seemed overcooked and rubbery. Furthermore, the baklava we ordered turned out to be stale. We genuinely hope that the restaurant rectifies these issues and reverts back to the excellent quality and cleanliness it had when it first opened.

input: So I hear whispers of a reemergence of brunch I truly believe this is the best brunch spot in New Orleans.  And they only do it once a year. Great local favors. Great service Their so called biscuits and debris should be called the "life changing flavorgasm" at that moment when you realize simplicity and perfection collide; dazed and confused you will awaken your senses at Carrollton market. The oyster good enough French omelet is everything I wanted in life and more. Thank you @Carrolltonmarket I am speechless. And that does not happen often
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: There are whispers of a reemergence of brunch in New Orleans. Carrollton Market is believed to be the best brunch spot, as they only offer it once a year. They provide great local flavors and excellent service. Their biscuits and debris dish is described as a "life-changing flavorgasm," combining simplicity and perfection. The oyster good enough French omelet is said to fulfill all desires in life and more. @Carrolltonmarket, thank you for leaving me speechless, which rarely happens.

input: Great beer selection. Service at the bar was a little slow.

input: Great food... Love the Fish tacos & Nachos are great  it's really a nice atmosphere for family settings and night or dates too.. Music beach bar, home made ice cream  & a little play ground - it's great
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food at this place is amazing, especially the Fish tacos and Nachos. The atmosphere is perfect for family settings as well as for nights out or dates. input:

The food was delicious and I can't wait to go back for more.

input: Wow!  I just wrote a scathing review about El Patron Pizza in Tampa for leaving unwanted and unwelcome fliers under the door of unsuspecting tourist here in Tampa.  I was going to use a lot of the same issues for this review of New York Pizza Grill, but now I'm not sure what to say, only to say it carefully.  I knew there was something not quite right about the greasy looking punk that was meandering in the hallway of the 4 star hotel where I am currently residing.  As soon as I saw the flier I grabbed my room key and went looking for this person.  In hindsight that was not smart, as soon as I got a look at the guy, I ran for the elevator.  Now, I am no shrinking violet, but this guy looked like he's slap his own mother.  After reading the other reviews on here, I guess I should be happy that this employee didn't turn around and attack!  My biggest issue with this business is that they litter the halls and rooms with these fliers.  They sneak into hotels, a place where you feel safe and after this, I don't.  It doesn't seem to matter where it is a 5 star hotel chain or a family run business.  I did call every one of the pizza place that do this, because I felt bad about complaining to the staff at the hotel, but after yesterdays run in with greasy guy for New York Pizza Grill, I had it.  I do not feel safe and I told management that, and the did call the police.  So, for the employee of New York Pizza Grill, if you get caught stuffing fliers under doors where you are not invited and do not belong, you are more than likely going to be arrested.  So when you are out and about making not enough to keep your car running, ask yourself if your boss will bail you out of jail.  I doubt it, they'll probably just get another less than intelligent person to litter, trespass, annoy and sometimes terrify, hotel staff and their guests.  There are numerous reasons not to eat at New York Pizza Grill, but I'm just tossing out a good reason not to work for them.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I recently had a negative experience with El Patron Pizza in Tampa, as they left unwanted fliers under the doors of unsuspecting tourists. I was hesitant to leave a similar review for New York Pizza Grill, but after encountering a suspicious employee in the hotel hallway, I decided to speak up. Seeing the flier made me confront the person, but realizing he looked threatening, I quickly retreated. It's fortunate he didn't become aggressive, based on other reviews. My main issue with this business is their habit of littering the halls and rooms with fliers, invading the safety of hotels, regardless of their star rating. I did contact all the pizza places engaging in this behavior, although I didn't want to burden the hotel staff. However, after the incident with the employee of New York Pizza Grill, I felt unsafe and informed management, who called the police. So, to the New York Pizza Grill employee responsible for trespassing and littering, be aware that you might face arrest. Consider if your employer will support you in such situations. Working for them seems to involve engaging in unlawful activities that inconvenience and frighten hotel staff and guests. While there are many reasons to avoid eating at New York Pizza Grill, this is a compelling reason to reconsider employment there.

input:
This was our first time here. I had a coupon so I thought I would try it out. Pulling into the parking lot I noticed it was very busy. I was worried that I would have to wait a long time. I pulled up to the attendant and asked how long it would be for a reg wash. She said each wash takes about 15 minutes. I was surprised since they were busy. I left the car there and proceeded inside. 

The building is huge inside. One side is all windows so you can watch your vehicle move through. They even have a "soap gun" the kids can use to shoot their car. That was a huge hit. 

The cashier greeted me as I walked up to the counter. She took my coupon and handed me a receipt. I walked around while I was waiting. They have drinks she snacks for purchase. They sell lots of greeting cards for every occasion. They have gifts and accessories for your car. The building was cool inside which was great because it was hot the day we came in. I waited about 10 minutes and walked outside. They have a large covered area to wait under. It has some seating so you can sit and wait. After just a few minutes they yelled out my car make to say it was done. I handed the attendant my receipt and tip and I was on my way. Total time was 18 minutes which I think is fair considering they were packed when I arrived. 

The car was clean and vacuumed. Overall they did a great job. The only thing they missed was the front window. It had that haze on it that you notice when the sun hits its. I wiped it off myself. I'm sure they would have fixed it if I noticed before I left. Also, they don't offer free air freshener with the wash like most other places. 

This place was fast and they did a great job. The price was fair and the staff was friendly. I will be coming back soon.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I tried this place for the first time using a coupon. The parking lot was busy and I was worried about a long wait. The attendant said each wash takes about 15 minutes. Inside, the building was huge with windows to watch the car and a "soap gun" for kids. The cashier was friendly and they had drinks, snacks, and greeting cards for sale. I waited for about 10 minutes under the covered area and my car was finished in 18 minutes. It was clean, but they missed the front window. No free air freshener was offered. Overall, they did a great job and I will return.

input: My go to place in IN when visiting family!  David does the most amazing pink and whites!  The shop is clean and the staff are professional and courteous.  The new management is outstanding (well three years ago but new to me).
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My favorite place in Indiana to visit family is David's shop, where they specialize in incredible pink and white designs. The staff are always professional, courteous, and the shop is spotlessly clean. Although the management changed three years ago, they continue to excel and impress me.

input:
Ordered curried chicken, teriyaki, and some eggrolls with soup...I never got that order

This was my first and last time ordering food from here. Delivery was quick, I'll give them that, but the order was wrong. When I called in they said I can have a free meal on them for the mistake.

I said, okay "I want that free meal now" (they also offer free delivery for orders over 12.00$) my food came out to 14.87$, 18.87$ with tip.


They refused multiple times (like it'll make a difference if they bring it now or tomorrow, either way it was a lie to get me off the phone). I informed her that if she didn't send her delivery guy back I'll dispute the amount paid to them with my bank, and they'll lose a new customer. 

Normally if one thing in my order was wrong I wouldn't mind at all. It's because my entire order was Wong...
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I ordered curried chicken, teriyaki, eggrolls, and soup, but I never received my order. Although the delivery was prompt, the restaurant made a mistake and when I called to inform them, they offered a free meal as compensation. When I requested the free meal immediately, they refused multiple times. The total cost of my order, including tip, was $18.87. Frustrated with their response, I warned them that I would dispute the payment with my bank and they would lose me as a customer. Typically, I wouldn't mind if just one item in my order was wrong, but in this case, my entire order was incorrect.

input:
A perfect afternoon in the gulch for me would consist of a shopping spree at Blush, a beer at Hops and Crafts and lunch at Turnip Truck.

I mean sure it's an interesting grocery store, but have you tried their ever rotating hot buffet or their made to order sandwiches? 
Tasty!! Or how about some of their all natural beauty products and lip balms? Score!!

You could spend half a day perusing aisle upon aisle of organic fair. This place makes Whole Foods look like Walmart. 

My only complaint: I just wish they would bring back a rewards program of some sort. Guess it was fun while it lasted. 

My usual lunch order; chipotle chicken salad wrap on whole wheat with chipotle mayo.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: A perfect afternoon in the gulch would involve shopping at Blush, grabbing a beer at Hops and Crafts, and having lunch at Turnip Truck. Turnip Truck offers an impressive hot buffet and made-to-order sandwiches, along with all-natural beauty products and lip balms. The store features an extensive selection of organic fair, surpassing Whole Foods in quality. The only downside is the absence of a rewards program. My go-to lunch order at Turnip Truck is a chipotle chicken salad wrap with chipotle mayo on whole wheat.

input: Great happy hour.  And brunch.  Only had dinner there once and it was only OK- probably because I ordered something I don't typically eat.  It'll definitely try it again.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great happy hour with delicious brunch. Dinner was only okay, but it could be because I ordered something outside of my usual preferences. I will definitely give it another try.

input:
Two co-workers and I came here after flying in from Chicago for an afternoon snack. It was almost 3, so we asked if we could wait until happy hour to order. The place was completely empty while we were there, but the space was well decorated and very open. 

We all ordered cocktails (I got the Mint Julep, which was not great, but then a gin drink that was fantastic), and they were all pretty and tasty. We also ordered Mac and cheese, fries, Brussels sprouts, and a pretzel. I didn't try the sprouts (I really don't like them), but everything else was so good! And the prices during happy hour were a great deal. 

I'll definitely be back next time we go to Reno!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Three of us co-workers flew in from Chicago and stopped by for an afternoon snack. Arriving around 3pm, we inquired about waiting for happy hour to order. Despite the empty space, the decor was impressive and the ambiance was airy. We opted for cocktails, with the Mint Julep being disappointing, but a subsequent gin drink proved fantastic. Alongside, we indulged in Mac and cheese, fries, Brussels sprouts, and a pretzel. While I skipped the sprouts, everything else was delicious, especially considering the reasonable happy hour prices. Without a doubt, I will return on our next trip to Reno.

input:
Trying to find a restaurant in The Big Easy that serves vegetarian is not an "Easy" feat

We've encountered many the restaurant who would tell us time & time again that they did not have or *would* not make something to accommodate veggie needs & it was such a letdown.....to this day I still remember 1 guy saying "Vegetarian?  Aww, you gotta get out earrrrrly for *that*".  We still laugh about it....

Well, over the last few years, we're noticing more & more places recognizing veggies like to eat Southern / Cajun comfort food & they are starting to open up their menus to us! ( YAY)

Seeing that Muriel's Jackson Square had such an offering, we made rezzies to ensure we veggies got fed - you'll want to do this too - veggie or not!  They were packed & quoting 2 hr waits & this was at 9pm!

Started w/ drinkys at the bar - Sazerac for the Mr & I had the uber-delish Honey Child cocktail: honey-infused vodka & muddled blackberries.  The Mr liked mine so well that he ordered 1 too, to go w/ dinner & just to be nice, I had another as well so he wouldn't have to drink alone

Their veggie appie had eggplant, of which I'm not a fan so we asked the waitress if they could make their Goat Cheese Crepe, veggie & she said sure.  Since the description said it was topped w/ crawfish, we thought, this would be easy..... but unfortunately, the roulade sauce was made seafood stock. ACK!  Wished you had told us this!  The Mr however, said the crepe was nice & plump, the goat cheese was creamy & smooth & he liked it, barring the sauce

Mains consisted of their Veggie Soiree - this was a sampling of little dollops of veggie tastes - some you'll find on their side dish offerings & some not

Divine beets & roasted acorn squash

Polenta topped w/ chickpeas & a basil sauce - flavorful though those beans were crunchy & could have used a bit more time in the cooker.... same w/ the crunchy wild rice

Yams were very flavorful & had lots of ginger - the Mr got to indulge in both our dollops of chard - I tried a bite & it triggered my dislike for cooked greens

Too full for dessert, we left w/ happy tummies & thankfulness for a nice veggie night out.  A-OK night!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Finding a vegetarian restaurant in New Orleans can be quite challenging, as many places refuse to accommodate vegetarian needs. However, there is a growing trend of establishments offering Southern/Cajun comfort food options for vegetarians. One such restaurant is Muriel's Jackson Square, where we made reservations to ensure we would be catered to. Despite being busy with a 2-hour wait, the bar was a great spot to enjoy drinks such as the Sazerac and the Honey Child cocktail. We requested a vegetarian version of their Goat Cheese Crepe, which was well-received by my partner, although the sauce contained seafood stock, which was not mentioned in the description. For the main course, we had the Veggie Soiree, which included various vegetable dishes, including divine beets, roasted acorn squash, polenta with chickpeas and basil sauce, and crunchy wild rice. The yams were flavorful and had a strong ginger taste. We left the restaurant satisfied and grateful for a pleasant vegetarian dining experience.

input:
I ate at Puckett's yesterday for lunch, and I have to say it was some mighty tasty food for an old-fashioned meat-and-three.  But I actually had a meat-and-two!  Definitely check out the squash casserole.  it was quite the tasty dish.  I'd also recommend their meatloaf, which is what I had.

My only complaint--and it's a minor one--is that they advertise cornbread.  Yes, it's cornbread, but not a slice of cornbread like you typically think of it.  People in the North would call it a corn fritter.  Being from KY, I'd call it a hoe cake.  It's cornbread but more like a cornbread pancake.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a delicious lunch at Puckett's yesterday. The food was tasty, especially the squash casserole and meatloaf. However, the cornbread is not what you expect - more like a corn fritter or hoe cake.

input: I usually stay at The Grand Sierra.  It is where I taught my son to swim years ago, so I have been biased to that property.  However, with it under construction recently, and after they took the horse statues out of the Valet area, and began major construction, I decided to try the Peppermill by a friends suggestion.  The Operations Manager, David Fuller went above and beyond to make my stay unbelievably excellent.  We were met at the hotel and "double" upgraded to a Tuscany Balcony Suite at check-in.  Needless to say, it had a balcony.  Very cool!  The room upgrade started my trip off on a perfect note.  Thank you Peppermill!  I will be back.  My experience was better than expected thanks in part to the staff going the extra mile for us.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I usually stay at The Grand Sierra, but due to recent construction and changes at the property, I decided to try the Peppermill on a friend's recommendation. The Operations Manager, David Fuller, provided exceptional service and made my stay truly excellent. We were upgraded to a Tuscany Balcony Suite upon arrival, which had a balcony and was very cool. This room upgrade set the tone for a perfect trip. Thank you Peppermill for exceeding my expectations and going above and beyond to make our stay memorable. I will definitely return.

input:
Hilton properties are some of the oldest,  most dilapidated properties in the hotel business.  Additionally,  the customer service is the very worst overall with a few exceptions. 
Made a reservation here for 1 bedroom suite.  Suite wasn't ready.  Had a 12:30 lunch mtg  Needed to shower and change but suite booked wasn't ready.  What I thought was a courtesy extend turned out to be bait a D switch.  They gave e me a 'courtesy room' with the understanding that upon my return,  I would get the suite I booked. 
I  returned just to be to told that 'the room I booked had been sold.' Really,???? 
The suite was $250. The downside graded room was $235. I couldn't cancel the room and all of the rooms at a lower rate were 'sold out'  How is that possible so quickly? 
Fake apologies we're given,  but no satisfaction when more could have been done.   Never again.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Hilton properties are old and deteriorated, and their customer service is generally terrible, with only a few exceptions. I made a reservation for a 1-bedroom suite, but it wasn't ready when I needed to shower and change for a lunch meeting at 12:30. They offered me a courtesy room instead, with the promise that I would get the suite upon my return. However, when I came back, they informed me that the suite I initially booked had been sold. The suite was priced at $250, while the inferior room they gave me was $235. I couldn't cancel the room, and all lower-priced rooms were suddenly "sold out." Fake apologies were given, but they did nothing to make things right. I will never stay at Hilton again.

input: Burger was OK, but not at all worth the price. I felt cramped sitting at the long table surrounded by people I did not know. Service was OK. If they brought the prices way down, it would be better. As it is now, it's a really expensive, mediocre burger. There are much, much better places in St. Louis (both in terms of taste and value).
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Burger was mediocre and overpriced. Uncomfortable seating at a crowded long table with strangers. Service was average. Lowering prices would improve the experience. Overall, there are far better options in St. Louis in terms of taste and value.

input: We had several quotes, with Pete and Ron's being the best of those I considered reputable. When i told Arbour Bay I was going with Pete and Ron they told me I would be in good hands. Had 2 very large oaks, one inaccessible from the front yard, one less than 2 feet from my roof edge taken down with a crane. I left for work in the A.M. and when I got home at 4 the trees were gone. Minimal damage from the heavy equipment in my yard. Will definitely recommend to friends and neighbors.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We received multiple quotes, and Pete and Ron's quotes were the best among the reputable options. When I informed Arbour Bay of my decision to choose Pete and Ron, they assured me that I would be in good hands. Using a crane, they successfully removed two very large oaks, one of which was inaccessible from the front yard, and the other perilously close to my roof edge. I left for work in the morning, and by the time I returned home at 4 PM, the trees were already gone. There was minimal damage to my yard caused by the heavy equipment. I will definitely recommend their services to my friends and neighbors.

input: I went back here and either I didn't remember the prices  (because someone else had paid last time) or their prices had gone up. It was almost $20 for 2 basic sushi rolls!! While the portions are big, they aren't filling enough to justify such a high price for 2 rolls for lunch. Will not be coming back at those prices.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I returned to the restaurant and was surprised by the prices, which had either increased or I hadn't remembered correctly from my previous visit. Two basic sushi rolls now cost almost $20. Although the portions were generous, they weren't satisfying enough to justify the steep lunchtime price. Due to this, I have decided not to return at these prices.

input: Great atmosphere and service! I don't know how often they have live music but the band playing the night we stopped in was very good. As for the food, it was good; I wont say it was the best burger I ever had but it wasn't bad; just not as great as I had hoped it would have been. All and all we had a good time and will be back!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The atmosphere and service were great. The live music was enjoyable on the night we visited. The food was good, although the burger didn't meet my high expectations. Overall, we had a good time and plan to return.

input: We had a 2 1/2 day corporate conference here in the middle of June. The service was excellent, the facilities were very nice and I was fairly impressed with catering. Great spot for conferences or small conventions. Close to the airpor with a complimentary shuttle and complimentary parking.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had a 2 1/2 day corporate conference in mid-June. Excellent service, nice facilities, and impressive catering. Ideal for conferences or small conventions. Convenient location near the airport with complimentary shuttle and parking.

input: Yum! This is a great place to go with a few friends to share their delicious and nicely portioned cheese while enjoying a beer from their extensive drink list. 5 stars purely because of how much I loved their cheese selection and appreciated the staff's knowledge of each cheese.  I'd happily go back although this is not a place I'd go to have inexpensive drinks.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is great for sharing delicious and nicely portioned cheese with friends while enjoying drinks from their extensive list. I give it 5 stars because of the amazing cheese selection and the knowledgeable staff. I would happily return, though it's not a budget-friendly option for drinks.

input: This is not Middle Eastern food. Side dishes were awfully tasting, including a warmed up rice, which I am sure came from a frozen bag few minutes before it was served.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Not Middle Eastern food. Side dishes, including reheated rice, didn't taste good. Rice seemed to be warmed up from a frozen bag right before serving.

input:
Loved this place, especially the Salmon. Only eaten here at Lunch and not a problem. Going to add this one to my Lunch rotation.
Spotless restrooms and the service is top notch.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Loved this place, especially the Salmon. Lunch is always great. Spotless restrooms and top-notch service. Adding it to my Lunch rotation.

input:
This place is top notch, with phenomenal service and such fantastic ambiance- how can you go elsewhere? All of the food looked and smelled amazing. I love how creative everything was.
I CANT STOP DAYDREAMING ABOUT THE FOOD. Hands down, best brunch experience of my life. I don't even like french toast usually and theres was by far the most delicious food thats ever entered my mouth. I am literally drooling while writing this.
The chicken and waffles were unreal and standout A++++. 
I love the "flinstones pushup-pop" drink so creative and clever.
Even the deviled eggs were the best I've personally ever had. They do everything right even when it comes to the music. It was super fun and such a great experience! Ignore any review thats not 4 stars because they must be delusional.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is top-notch. Phenomenal service and fantastic ambiance make it the best choice. The food is visually appealing and smells amazing. The creative dishes are absolutely delightful. It is hands down the best brunch experience I've ever had. The french toast, which I don't usually like, was the most delicious food I've ever tasted. The chicken and waffles were unreal and standout A++++. The "Flintstones pushup-pop" drink is a creative and clever choice. Even the deviled eggs were the best I've personally ever had. They excel in every aspect, including the music. It was a super fun and great experience. Ignore any review below 4 stars.

input: I'm so happy we came upon this place randomly. They have a happy hour 3-8pm everyday:  Half off all beers, $3-$4 glasses of wine & $8 hookah! Their hookah on non-happy hour is $13. They have a wide selection of shisha flavors and even options of an ice chamber or smoking from a fruit bowl (extra charge). They do have a food menu, but I didn't try anything from it. But the plates I saw coming from the kitchen look pretty good. Overall, a really chill place to come and relax with friends. It was definitely an enjoyable experience.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We randomly discovered this place and I'm thrilled about it. They offer a daily happy hour from 3-8pm, featuring half off all beers, $3-$4 glasses of wine, and $8 hookah. Normally, their hookah is priced at $13. Additionally, they have an extensive range of shisha flavors and the option of an ice chamber or smoking from a fruit bowl for an extra fee. Though I didn't personally try anything from the food menu, the dishes I observed coming out of the kitchen looked appetizing. In summary, it's a relaxed spot to unwind with friends, and my experience was thoroughly enjoyable.

input:
I absolutely love this hotel. It is certainly one of my favorites. Upon walking into the building, to your right you will enter the lobby. The lobby is adorable with eclectic decorations and 1 million places to sit that are very comfortable. They serve wine every day from 5 to 6 PM, it's nice to relax down in the lobby with a glass of wine and friendly staff..

Speaking of the staff, they are amazing. Checking in is fantastic, Jasmine and Kayla are the ones I dealt with and they are both wonderful. The hotel concierge Roshid is a very friendly and knowledgeable concierge, they are very lucky to have him on staff. The housekeepers are great, the rooms are immaculate. What I love most about this hotel are the fantastic bathrooms, I'm not sure about the regular rooms, but if you get a king spa room, the bathrooms are absolutely amazing. You have a freestanding tub, and a large shower and you can jump in between the two should you be so inclined ha ha. The decor is so attractive, incredible wallpaper, beautiful rugs, everything seems brand new and they keep it in perfect condition. This hotel is a must for anyone visiting Philadelphia. They make you feel right at home at the moment you step in the door. The pictures that you can get from inside the rooms are enough to make up your whole trip to Philly LOL. But if you want to get out and explore Philly you're only steps away from the Liberty Bell and a historical museum. Right in Center City or the old downtown area, you'll find lots of historical information about Philadelphia.  Definitely stop in and stay at the Monaco, you won't regret it!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I absolutely love this hotel. The lobby is adorable with eclectic decorations and plenty of comfortable seating. They serve wine daily from 5 to 6 PM, which is a nice touch. The staff, including Jasmine, Kayla, and concierge Roshid, are amazing and very friendly. The housekeepers do a great job, keeping the rooms immaculate. The king spa rooms have fantastic bathrooms with a freestanding tub and large shower. The decor throughout the hotel is attractive and well-maintained. The location is great, near the Liberty Bell and historical museums in Center City. Staying at the Monaco is a must for any visit to Philadelphia.

input: Love, Love, LOVE this store!!!  I admit, I'm an addict. But where else can you get a Bebe top, a Banana Republic skirt and a BCBG skirt for $4.13?????  The savings are ridiculous!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I absolutely love this store! I'm addicted to it because it offers amazing deals. Where else can you find a Bebe top, a Banana Republic skirt, and a BCBG skirt for only $4.13? The savings are insanely good!

input: So happy there is a family friendly place to watch football in Carp! Great atmosphere, fast service, delicious pizza.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Love the family-friendly football spot in Carp! Awesome atmosphere, quick service, and mouthwatering pizza.

input: It is what you expect in an Acme, the only thing I found a little different with this one is that it seemed the aisles were a little narrower than in other stores. Store is a little smaller than others so not as wide of a variety, but was fine, looks like they've upgraded some areas like the frozen/refrigerated food sections. Service was fine.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This Acme store meets expectations, with slightly narrower aisles compared to others. It is smaller in size, offering a slightly limited variety, but the frozen/refrigerated food sections have been recently upgraded. The service was satisfactory.

input: We're new to the area, so we're exploring restaurants every weekend. My wife has already proclaimed The Roost her favorite, and that's based on many years of breakfast dining, not just in this area. They bake all their own breads and pastries. Try the raisin bread or sugar-cinnamon toast. Yum! The cornbread casserole is another dish my wife and I highly recommend. And the service was prompt, attentive and very friendly. Enjoy!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: As newcomers to the area, we are excited to discover new restaurants every weekend. My wife, who has years of breakfast dining experience, has already declared The Roost as her favorite place to go. They have a wonderful selection of freshly baked breads and pastries, including delicious raisin bread and sugar-cinnamon toast. We also highly recommend trying their cornbread casserole. In addition to the tasty food, the service at The Roost is prompt, attentive, and incredibly friendly. Enjoy your meal there!

input: Small, crowded and hectic but boy the food was good and plentiful. Wait staff was right on top of the chaos. Great breakfast place.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Small, crowded, and hectic but with amazing and plentiful food. The wait staff efficiently handled the chaos, making it a great breakfast place.

input: Finally went in after walking by so many times. Glad we did. Small place but IR is pleasing to the eye. One wall cover with wood palates and subtle two tone gray walls. Started with the prosciutto fig arugula Parmesan flatbread appetites. Enough for two people and delicious. Nice mix of flavors. Main dishes were a burger grass fed beef with fries coated with truffles dusting. Burger was humongous!  Looked good smelled good and tasted good. I had a seafood soup with fish ( not sure what it was) shrimp and mollusks in a  coconut/ curry broth. Deliciously spicy but not enough to kill your taste buds. Overall I would recommend this place. We went early as we heard it gets crowded and they do not take reservations.  BYW great wine and craft beer selections
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Finally tried this small place after passing by countless times. The interior decor is pleasing with a wall covered in wood palates and subtle two-tone gray walls. We started with the prosciutto fig arugula Parmesan flatbread appetizer, which was enough for two people and absolutely delicious. The flavors were well balanced. For our main dishes, we had a huge grass-fed beef burger with truffle dusted fries. The burger looked, smelled, and tasted amazing. I opted for the seafood soup with fish, shrimp, and mollusks in a coconut curry broth. It had a deliciously spicy kick without overpowering the taste buds. Overall, I highly recommend this place. We went early to avoid the crowd, as they don't take reservations. Also, their wine and craft beer selections are excellent.

input:
Reading the reviews, I cannot agree with the others which tout the quality of the food. I had the dinner buffet and the food was mediocre at best. The selection was fine, though they do charge a higher price if you want crab legs. BTW- neither Easy Buffet nor Ginger Buffet charge extra for crab legs. The flavors were there, but the meats were dried out, concentrated, and fried foods soggy and tough as if the they hadn't been turned over in hours and were just sitting on the steam table.  

Service was very nice but slow, especially since there were only 3 tables going the whole time we were there.  I think they had him responsible for too many things other that waiting tables.  

There is a slim chance I'll come back since there are 3 other Chinese buffets in the area that I prefer over Dragon.  Perhaps if I do, there will be more guests to turn over the food and I can update my ratings.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Based on the reviews, I disagree with others who praise the food quality at Dragon buffet. I found the dinner buffet to be mediocre, with dried out meats and soggy fried foods. Additionally, they charge extra for crab legs, unlike other nearby establishments. Although the service was nice, it was slow, possibly due to the waiter being overwhelmed with other responsibilities. I am unlikely to return to Dragon buffet as there are three other Chinese buffets in the area that I prefer.

input: This is our "go to" place! The food is consistently good and we always have friendly attentive waiters to sometimes help with our decisions. One of our favorites is the pasta pockets with pear filling. Really delicious! It's also byob which is always a plus. This is a great restaurant with a real cozy, family atmosphere. Highly recommend.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This is our favorite spot with delicious food, consistently good and served by friendly attentive waiters. The pasta pockets with pear filling are a must-try and it's also BYOB. The restaurant has a cozy, family atmosphere and comes highly recommended.

input: To sum it up, it's an average bar with ties to a very well-known TV show - but that fact doesn't make the food or much else better. When I went they had $4 White Rascal's and on top of that I had the normal gravy fries. $11 for fries, steep to say the least. They were steak fries, covered in gravy and mozzarella cheese and while pretty damn good, I would be hesitant to say that they're worth the price. Service was good, sometimes a little slow, but still friendly.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: In short, this bar is average and has connections to a famous TV show. However, the association doesn't improve the quality of the food or overall experience. During my visit, they offered $4 White Rascal's and I tried their regular gravy fries, which cost a steep $11. The fries were steak cut, topped with gravy and mozzarella cheese, and although they were tasty, I'm not sure if they justified the high price. The service was generally good, although occasionally slow, but the staff was friendly.

input: I went here based on the Yelp reviews and found everything to be true. The staff is extremely helpful and willing to answer all questions. I will continue to bring my bike repair/maintenance needs here.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Based on positive Yelp reviews, I visited this place and discovered that everything said was accurate. The staff is highly helpful, answering all questions with willingness. I will remain loyal for my bike repair and maintenance requirements.

input: A very nice hotel and a good value. ($175/night) The king bed was primo, the room tastefully furnished. The  rotating Carousel bar is fun and the pool at the top of the building is a great way to cool off on a 95 degree day.We stay there given the great location in the French  Quarter, but our room facing Royal St. was very loud, especially on Friday night. Try for a room not facing the street if you are there over a weekend. Make sure they remove the extra $60 per night they tack on to your room charge for incidentals.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great value hotel priced at $175/night with a very nice and tastefully furnished room including a primo king bed. The hotel's rotating Carousel bar adds a fun element and the top floor pool is a refreshing escape on hot days. However, be aware that if your room faces Royal St., noise can be an issue especially on Friday nights. It's recommended to request a room away from the street if staying over the weekend. Additionally, ensure to have the hotel remove the extra $60 per night charge for incidentals.
