input:
I came here because of the higher rating and they accepted my insurance. My initial visit went well, no complaints on the staff or the doctor at that time. 

They switched my brand from Acuvue to Air Optix and about 2 weeks after using the contact I started to experience pain, redness and irritation. I took my contacts out that evening and had red rings around both of my eyes. I tried contacting them via telephone and left a message as well as email, I failed to hear back from them in a timely manner so I reached out to them again and got ahold of them. I simply wanted my contacts switched back to Acuvue and they tried to tell me that it was allergies causing my problems and were insisiting on me keeping Air Optix. Eventually I did get them to agree to switch my contacts back to acuvue. 

In march I had another eye irritation and I went to Vanderbilt Eye Institue, they told me it was a continued reaction to the Air Optix lenses because I did not give my eyes enough time to heal before applying my new contacts - which was I was not educated on by Music City Optical when I got my new set of contacts. I then reviewed them on facebook at that time. 

Today (8/30/16) I recieved a response to my review on facebook and a corresponding email stating that I was being slanderous and lying, which was not the case at all. I was simply explaining my experience with Music City Optical.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I chose this place based on its high rating and acceptance of my insurance. My initial visit was satisfactory with no issues regarding the staff or doctor. However, when they switched my brand of contacts from Acuvue to Air Optix, I started experiencing pain, redness, and irritation after about 2 weeks of use. I reached out to them multiple times via phone and email but did not receive a timely response. After finally getting in touch with them, I requested to switch back to Acuvue, but they insisted that my problems were due to allergies and wanted me to stick with Air Optix. Eventually, they agreed to switch my contacts back. In March, I went to Vanderbilt Eye Institute and they informed me that my continued eye irritation was a result of not giving my eyes enough time to heal before using the new contacts, something I was not informed about by Music City Optical. I reviewed them on Facebook to share my experience. Today, I received a response to my review claiming I was being slanderous and lying, which is not true. I was simply recounting my experience with Music City Optical.

input:
This wasn't my first visit to the Italian Centre, but my last visit was many years ago and all I could remember was the huge selection of charcuterie and cheeses. Slightly overwhelming to say the least, meats and cheeses (at the time) I had never even heard of. With some guidance from the staff I was able to select some delights. 

Fast forward a few years... 

My most recent visit was only for some pastries and a quick lunch, so I didn't have time to browse the huge selection of Italian delights. 

I decided to go with the Mossimo pizza. The toppings were fresh the cheese was bubbly! The crust was thin and baked to perfection. I wasn't expecting such a huge pizza- definitely big enough to share! And priced at just $14? A steal if you ask me!

For pastries we chose the Cream Horns; while they were quite pricy, they were certainly delicious. Likely made that day, they were fresh, creamy and flakey! Impossible not to over indulge! 

While visiting the Italian Centre I suggest enjoying a freshly crafted coffee beverage and a pastry. The perfect treat before or after shopping.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: On my recent visit to the Italian Centre, I was reminded of the vast selection of charcuterie and cheeses I had encountered many years ago. With the help of the staff, I was able to choose some delightful options. However, during my most recent trip, I only had time to quickly grab some pastries and have a bite to eat. I opted for the Mossimo pizza, which exceeded my expectations with its fresh toppings, bubbly cheese, and perfectly baked thin crust. The size of the pizza was generous and priced at just $14, it felt like a great deal. As for the Cream Horns pastries, although they were a bit expensive, they were undeniably delicious with their fresh, creamy, and flakey texture. While at the Italian Centre, I highly recommend treating yourself to a freshly crafted coffee beverage and pastry before or after your shopping experience.

input:
It saddens me to say this but I think I need a new nail salon. I have consistently come here for a few years now and the service has never been as bad as it has been the last few times I've been here. Here are my issues:

1) the girl at the front desk never once looked up from her papers while "greeting" me and asking me what I want. She mumbled under her breath to go pick out a color then yelled across the salon that I was getting a mani and pedi. 
2) once I picked out my color I went back to the front and someone who came in after me was seated in a pedi chair, water turned on etc. to get service. Once she saw that I was standing in the front she got a chair going for me. The problem with that is there were no more nail technicians available to work on me.
3) so now I'm sitting in cold water waiting for someone to come and do my feet. 
4) the pedicure started, she painstakingly dug into my toes (which I absolutely hate) and rushed through the Massage part of the pedi
5) after it was all said and done, I find out that their prices have gone up! 

I used to come here because they have later hours and are open on Sunday's but after a 3rd terrible experience here I am not coming back. In the last 3 months, almost the whole staff has changed and these folks are not meeting my needs.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
Unfortunately, I have decided that I need to find a new nail salon. I have been a loyal customer here for several years, but recently the service has deteriorated significantly. Here are my specific concerns:

1) The girl at the front desk paid no attention to me, remaining focused on her paperwork while barely acknowledging my presence. She muttered something about choosing a color and then loudly announced to the entire salon that I was there for a mani and pedi.
2) Despite arriving earlier than another customer, I was overlooked and someone who came in after me was seated and attended to first. Only when she noticed I was still waiting did she hurriedly arrange a chair for me. Unfortunately, there were no available nail technicians to assist me.
3) Consequently, I had to endure sitting with my feet in cold water, waiting for someone to attend to me.
4) During the pedicure, the technician was rough with my toes, which I strongly dislike, and rushed through the massage portion of the service.
5) To top it off, I discovered that the salon has raised their prices without any prior notice or explanation.

I used to be a regular customer here due to their convenient hours and Sunday availability. However, after experiencing three terrible visits in the past few months and witnessing significant staff turnover, it is clear that this salon no longer meets my needs.

input:
This place has a great location for the hungry tourist. It manages to be edgy yet chill at the same time. My reason for stopping in was to try the ahi fish tacos with avocado relish, which sounded awesome. At around 3 there was still a healthy amount of people attesting to its popularity and eatability. Somehow the chef decided that it was okay to put such a delicate fish in premade taco shells...enough to makes this SoCal girl wince a little and question whether I should consume. Luckily the flavor of the fish was great. I only saw one half inch cube of avocado, but at least the sauce was yummy! 
I got a glimpse of the brunch menu...looks pretty tasty I must say...
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place has a great location and a cool atmosphere. I came here specifically to try the ahi fish tacos with avocado relish, which sounded amazing. Even though it was around 3 o'clock, there were still plenty of people enjoying their food. They had a good selection of local microbrews available in bottles for those who wanted to try Philly beer. However, I was a bit disappointed when my tacos arrived in premade taco shells, especially considering the delicate fish. Despite that, the flavor of the fish was great. The avocado portion was small, but the sauce was delicious. I also saw the brunch menu, which looked appetizing.

input:
Not really the town you would expect to find a great Indian restaurant, but figured I'd give it a shot.
I'm picky about Indian food, and all I can say is WOW it's good!
The Naan with peach chutney was amazing.
The Lamb Korma was perfect. Perfect amount of spice (too many Indian restaurant set your mouth on fire and you can't enjoy the taste). Not too much, not too little.
The rice and lamb was perfectly cooked. Very authentic.

The decor is very nice (those chairs in the front are impressive) and staff very friendly. Service was also very quick.

I'm relocating to Tampa, and might actually have to make the drive from there a few times to come back. Very impressive!

I would definitely recommend this place, even if it's a bit of a drive.  It's worth it.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Surprisingly, this town has an excellent Indian restaurant. I decided to give it a try despite my picky taste, and I was blown away. The Naan with peach chutney was outstanding and the Lamb Korma was just right in terms of spice level - not too mild nor too overwhelming. The rice and lamb were cooked to perfection, offering an authentic experience. The decor is impressive, particularly the chairs at the front, and the friendly staff provided quick service. I'm moving to Tampa, but I'll definitely make the drive here multiple times because it's that good. Highly recommended, even if it requires a bit of a journey - it's definitely worth it.

input:

I also love the Athenian Chicken (half a rotisserie chicken). 

As a quick, casual, food-first restaurant, Greko has hit the sweet spot.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Have you ever tried Greko? I went there for lunch and loved it so much that I returned for dinner that same night and lunch the following day. The rotisserie chicken pita with fries is my favorite, but they also have great salads like the Horta Greens. You can substitute fries for the greens or have them on the side. Another must-try is the Athenian Chicken, which is half a rotisserie chicken. Greko is the perfect place for a quick, casual, food-focused dining experience.

input:
Brother Rabbit you are young, hip, and tasty!

Met friends for drinks and an early dinner. I was the first to arrive so I sat at the bar and ordered the house cider which is great and I followed that with the Oban 18 which is phenomenal so try it while you're there. 

Our dinner kicked off with the most amazing house biscuits and butter that will have you begging for the recipe.

The rest of our dinner was comprised of several selections from the First course menu. We had the daily oysters which were great. Followed by the Brussels sprouts, delicious but the crispy chicken skins were a bit of a let down, they needed more flavor. 

The smoked tuna tartar is great but the sweet chips can overwhelm the dish. Definitely get the marinated shrimp and jalapeño jus it is a wonderfully fresh and bright dish. 

To close thing up we had the dobeger cake with lemon curd and chocolate ice cream, as if that wasn't enough they pour this amazing chocolate sauce on it when it arrives that will have you just dying as you wait to dig in.

Overall Compere Lapin is a great addition to the New Orleans food scene, great for groups or date night with your significant other.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
Brother Rabbit, you're young, hip, and tasty! 

Met friends for drinks and an early dinner. Started at the bar with the house cider, followed by the phenomenal Oban 18. 

The house biscuits and butter were amazing, leaving us begging for the recipe. 

For our meal, we enjoyed the daily oysters, Brussels sprouts, and crispy chicken skins (which lacked flavor). The smoked tuna tartar was great, but the sweet chips were overpowering. The marinated shrimp with jalapeño jus was a wonderfully fresh and bright dish. 

We finished with the dobeger cake, accompanied by lemon curd and chocolate ice cream. The incredible chocolate sauce poured over it made waiting to dig in unbearable. 

Overall, Compere Lapin is a great addition to the New Orleans food scene, perfect for groups or a romantic date night.

input:

What bumps the stars up are the T-Ravs!  I was hoping for cheese ravioli but the staple is a meat mixture. Boy...do they do it justice. They were the bomb!  The sauce with it was too watery but still tasty. I would order just the ravioli next time!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: While in town for a convention, the hotel staff recommended Imo's as the best St. Louis Style pizza. I decided to have it delivered and it arrived promptly and still hot. I ordered a medium pepperoni pizza along with toasted ravioli. However, I was not impressed with the pizza. The cheese, which was provel, had a distinct taste that did not appeal to me, and the pizza was not cut all the way through, making it difficult to separate each piece. However, the highlight of the meal were the T-Ravs. Despite expecting cheese-filled ravioli, the meat mixture was delicious and well executed. The accompanying sauce was slightly watery but still flavorful. In the future, I would opt to only order the ravioli.

input: I have groen up eating Italian food and i have not come across a more legit place than Mazzaros! Love their sauce and meatballs.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I grew up eating Italian food and Mazzaros is the most authentic place I have found. I absolutely love their sauce and meatballs.

input: Okay, so it's a dance club. It's trendy and offers higher-end cocktails and beers while still offering your run-of-the-mill wells and domestic bottles. On certain nights, guys have to pay a door charge (but that's not really uncommon in the industry). There is a huge patio and, even in the winter, almost the entire patio is still available because they enclose it. The music is pretty hit-or-miss...sometimes you're dancing away to classic hip-hop, pop, and even rock, and other times you're standing there while the DJ spins out an un-danceable tune. If you're on the patio, you can chat...but if you're inside it's (not shockingly) too loud to really talk. If you're in the CWE and you're looking to dance, at least give the Mandarin a shot; it's not going to be for everyone, but it's pretty great if you're in the mood for it.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The Mandarin is a trendy dance club with a wide range of drink options, including high-end cocktails and beers, as well as more typical choices. Some nights there is a cover charge for men, which is common in the industry. The club has a large enclosed patio that is available even in winter. The music varies, with a mix of hip-hop, pop, rock, and occasionally less danceable tunes. It can be loud inside but more conducive to conversation on the patio. Located in CWE, the Mandarin is worth trying if you're in the mood to dance, although it may not appeal to everyone.

input:
Another gem on Frenchmen.  We made it in just in time to grab the corner tall table and enjoyed the piano player playing some nice tunes.

Order at the bar and they'll bring you the food.  What we had:
pork pot stickers - pretty good - $4 HH price
smoked hanger steak w/ chimichurri sauce on toastones - tasted much better than it looked - $4 HH price
lobster eggrolls w/ sweet chile lime sauce - $8 - didn't look promising but it was tasty
Hopitoulas - $4.5
UFO - $4.5

One of the owners/chefs is Korean, thus the Asian food.

HH everyday from 4-6:30pm, $4 tapas, $5 wines, $3 beers.

We will definitely return.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We found another great spot on Frenchmen Street. We arrived just in time to secure a table and enjoyed the piano player's tunes. The bar serves food, and we tried some delicious dishes: pork pot stickers for $4 during happy hour, smoked hanger steak with chimichurri sauce on toastones, which tasted better than they looked, also for $4 during happy hour, and lobster eggrolls with sweet chile lime sauce for $8. We also had Hopitoulas and UFO beers, both priced at $4.5. It's worth mentioning that one of the owners/chefs is Korean, so they also serve Asian food. Happy hour runs every day from 4-6:30pm, with $4 tapas, $5 wines, and $3 beers. We will definitely be back.

input: food is ok, felt rushed, too many tables and not enough space.  its very crowded and frequently had other servers and customers bumping into our chairs.

input: After always shopping at the Randall's off Jefferson, it was nice to see West County get their own Randall's. Staff here is uber friendly and helpful. The staff here is incredibly friendly and helpful, and they have a great selection of beers with a variety of styles to choose from. Their prices are competitive with other beer markets, making it a worthwhile and cost-effective choice.

input: Deseree has done my hair for over a decade and I wouldn't trust anyone else. From blonde to brunette, to long or short, she does it all. Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Deseree has been my hairstylist for over 10 years and I trust no one else. She has transformed my hair from blonde to brunette, and can handle any length. input:
Four of us had dinner at the Sockeye Grill this weekend.  Service was terrible.  Super slow.  Salads were warm and tasteless.  Dressing was watered down. 

Salmon was excellent.  Nachos were okay. Finger steaks were mushy and drab. 

Waitress  knew her beer. The dark lager was excellent.  The lighter beers we had were too warm. 

Looks like this restaurant need some fine tuning.  The atmosphere was like a warehouse, more like being in a barn than a restaurant. 

Tvs everywhere but the news was on. Huh? How depressing is that? 

We won't be back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Four of us had dinner at the Sockeye Grill this weekend. Service was super slow, and the salads were warm and tasteless with watered-down dressing. However, the salmon was excellent, and the nachos were okay. Unfortunately, the finger steaks were mushy and drab. On a positive note, our waitress was knowledgeable about beer, and the dark lager was excellent, but the lighter beers we had were too warm. The atmosphere felt more like a warehouse or barn than a restaurant, with TVs everywhere playing depressing news. Overall, we will not be returning to this restaurant.

input:
We had a very nice dinner here on St. Patrick's day, which happens to be my sister's birthday.  The server was super sweet and served the cake we brought to celebrate.  The bartender was so kind and gave my sister a complimentary St. Patty's cocktail, which was incredibly yummy.  

We ordered various dishes:  tri-tip, rotisserie chicken, pulled pork and a veggie burrito.  All was wonderful, except for the veggie burrito, which was lackluster (but who orders a veggie burrito at a rotisserie grill???).  My father-in-law has visited many more times, raving about the moist, flavorful rotisserie chicken.  

The prices were reasonable, portions adequate and service super!  We will definitely visit again, minus the resident vegetarian.  :)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had a great dinner on St. Patrick's day, which was also my sister's birthday. The server was friendly and served the cake we brought. The bartender gave my sister a complimentary St. Patty's cocktail, which was delicious. We ordered tri-tip, rotisserie chicken, pulled pork, and a veggie burrito. Everything was great, except for the veggie burrito, which was underwhelming. My father-in-law loves the moist and flavorful rotisserie chicken here. Reasonable prices, good portions, and excellent service. We'll come again, but without the vegetarian.

input: Went to see Anders Osborne play here & it was a highlight of my trip to NOLA.  Streetcar went straight down to Bourbon after the show but I wish I'd stayed longer! Food smelled awesome, drinks were very reasonably priced  & the crowd was mellow.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I saw Anders Osborne perform here and it was a highlight of my trip to NOLA. After the show, I took the streetcar to Bourbon Street but I regret not staying longer. The food smelled amazing, the drinks were reasonably priced, and the crowd was relaxed.

input: I have been told by numerous native philadelphians that Ralph's is one of the best Italian restaurants in the city and is a must to experience. We did not think so. We started off with a grilled calamari appetizer that was soaked in salty red sauce. The amount of sauce overwhelmed the palate to the point where we couldn't even taste the calamari. I got the pasta bolognese with filet mignon tips. Again, the red sauce was very salty. The filet mignon tips was really just average quality beef. My wife ordered the black lobster ravioli which were decent but overly salty. We expected much more from the oldest Italian restaurant in the country.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Many Philadelphians recommend Ralph's as one of the best Italian restaurants in the city, but our experience was disappointing. The grilled calamari appetizer was drenched in a salty red sauce that overpowered the flavor of the calamari. The pasta bolognese with filet mignon tips had an overly salty red sauce and the beef was average in quality. The black lobster ravioli, while decent, were also excessively salty. We had higher expectations from the oldest Italian restaurant in the country.

input: We get high on the beauty of this amazing high desert oasis! Nature's drama in the Catalina Mountains. We come here to run or hike. We're #MCLifeTucson - we love it in the canyon!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: As #MCLifeTucson, we are captivated by the stunning beauty of the high desert oasis in the Catalina Mountains. Whether it's running or hiking, we find ourselves energized by nature's captivating drama, and can't help but fall in love with the canyon!

input:
Beer service was lackluster. The first beer I ordered had an off flavor (sour). I ordered a taste of another similar dark beer to see if the problem was endemic but it wasn't. I would have appreciated it more if the bar tender looked into the off flavor when I sent my beer back. This tells me the bar tender doesn't know beer. I assume that particular draft line needs to be cleaned but maybe the problem was with the keg. 

Another thing that killed me was their use of glassware. They serve beers in the classic American "Shaker" pint glass and serve water in the far superior English Nonic Pint glass. I also saw the bar tender pour a white ale with normal ABV in a stemmed tulip glass.

The shaker pint glasses are kept refrigerated and are too cold in my opinion. I would much rather see them kept at room temp and rinsed in cold water (which they do here). 

All in all, the beer knowledge is not up to par for a place that advertises as a burger joint with a large craft beer selection (30 taps).
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
Beer service was disappointing. The first beer I ordered had a sour off flavor, but when I tried another similar dark beer, it was fine. It would have been better if the bartender had investigated the issue with my initial beer. This suggests a lack of beer knowledge on their part. I believe the draft line or the keg might be the cause of the problem.

Additionally, their choice of glassware was frustrating. They use the less preferable American shaker pint glass for beers, while reserving the superior English Nonic pint glass for water. I even witnessed them serving a white ale in a stemmed tulip glass, which is not suitable.

Furthermore, the shaker pint glasses are excessively chilled, in my opinion. I would prefer them to be kept at room temperature and rinsed with cold water, as they do here.

Overall, the bar's beer knowledge is below the standard expected for a place that boasts a large craft beer selection of 30 taps and advertises itself as a burger joint.

input: Love love live Orangetheory!! Best full body workout ever!!! And so many classes.... always convenient!

input: This is the worst. My first time at an Econo anything. Playing nice for group purposes. We get here. They check us in like the rooms are clean. The rooms are dirty. The lady comes to clean the room because apparently they dont have any others clean or available. Go figure. So the manager comes outside to look as if we are lying about dirty rooms. It's hot as hell outside, wasps everywhere and we're standing here. I asked about other clean rooms and he (a-hole manager) (neil Patel) sarcastically states check in is at 2. It's 1:45 though. If you're going to check guest in at least make sure the rooms are clean or let them know it will be a few. So I'm standing outside in the heat as they apparently clean the room.  They took no cleaner in to clean counters, bathroom, etc. Just nasty. Then they just looked in the microwave & fridge to see if it was clean. They didn't wipe nothing. input: Finally got to check out Cafe Soleil. One word: Delicieux!! Being from France, I had high expectations, I don't play with my pastries! Boy do they deliver, the croissants were buttery, nice and flaky, and melt in your mouth...even better then some of the ones I had in France. Not surprisingly, the baker "Nico" is french, and you could taste the difference in the food.  The fact that the products are imported does make a big difference in the taste, it's definitely authentic.  Nico was very personable and friendly, it was fun chatting with an ex-parisian :). The one negative thing is they are too far from me, 45 mins drive, but to satiate my sweet tooth, I will definitely be back! I highly recommend this bakery.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Cafe Soleil is absolutely delicious with its buttery and flaky croissants that melt in your mouth. The French baker, Nico, adds an authentic touch to the food with imported ingredients. Though it's a 45-minute drive for me, it's worth it for satisfying my sweet tooth. Highly recommend this bakery!

input:
Not mediocre at all IMHO.  Makes me wonder if Daniel O. went to the same place we did.

This is a great neighborhood byob place that provides welcoming service and excellent food at a reasonable price.  We started going here because numerous South Philly friends recommended it.  This is not foo-foo Italian.  This is not pretentious Italian.  This is "let's go back and work our way through the menu" Italian.  We found the specials to be good choices.  My husband's broccoli rabe and sausage was excellent, as was a grilled romaine salad with bleu cheese and pine nuts.  Both were generous enough to share.  Last time, sausage & figs was a hit.  If you are in the mood for a basic plate of macaronis with red gravy, you won't be disappointed either.  We had a great time with the waitress because my BIL brought a bottle of Great Wall wine from China (that was the 2nd bottle we opened) and that started a whole crazy discussion.  She didn't know us from Adam, but we left there feeling like regulars.

It's a very doable destination if you are on your way to a sporting event at the Linc or the Cit, or to the Spectrum or Wachovia Center.  For those who rely on public transportation, you can get off the subway at Broad & Oregon, then walk back a block to Broad & Porter.  Make a reservation, though because it can be a popular place.  You also want to make sure you have time to have a relaxing meal and make your event in time.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This neighborhood BYOB restaurant is highly recommended by South Philly friends. It offers welcoming service, delicious food, and reasonable prices. It is not pretentious but rather a place to explore the Italian menu. The specials are particularly good, such as the broccoli rabe and sausage or the grilled romaine salad with blue cheese and pine nuts. The sausage and figs dish is also a hit. Even simple dishes like macaroni with red gravy are satisfying. The staff is friendly and we felt like regulars. It is conveniently located near sports venues and public transportation. Reservations are recommended due to its popularity.

input: Can't go wrong with some Todd Cobell!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Todd Cobell is always a great choice!

input:
We are frequent patrons who enjoy their super fun bar, tv's and music selection.  The service is very good.  Nice, hard-working, mannerly people in a very cool atmosphere that appreciate the business.  Food is consistently fresh(seafood) and good.  Pizza is the best in South Jersey and my husband, the unofficial pizza 'officianado' makes me try them all, from NYC, to Trenton to Philly, Delaware, Chicago.  This is really the best pizza I've ever had. The crust is thin, crispy yet has a nice chew, and flavorful.

Last night I had a dinner special of chicken cutlet in a lobster, white -truffle oil, light cream sauce with asparagus, shallots and sundried tomatoes over angel hair pasta. On the Special's menu it is listed as a veal entree, but the kitchen was more than happy to substitute Chicken for me. The dish was so delicately seasoned with such a fine touch that I enjoyed smelling it almost as much as tasting it. In addition, it was such a generous portion that I enjoyed it two nights later for dinner and now want to go back tomorrow and order it again!!  What an absolutely fabulous recipe. Very fine, subtle flavor but also comforting and satisfying. 

Not to mention, Selena the Bar Manger, bartenders Jayna and Chris are just so pleasant, professional and helpful, it really is a great place to go!

Enjoy!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We love this bar for its fun atmosphere, great service, and excellent music selection. The staff is friendly and hard-working, creating a cool atmosphere that makes us feel welcome. The seafood is consistently fresh and delicious, and their pizza is the best in South Jersey. The thin and crispy crust with a nice chew is incredibly flavorful. We recently had a dinner special of chicken cutlet in a lobster, white truffle oil, light cream sauce with asparagus, shallots, and sundried tomatoes over angel hair pasta. The dish was beautifully seasoned and generously portioned. We enjoyed it so much that we had it again the next day. The bar manager Selena, along with bartenders Jayna and Chris, are always pleasant, professional, and helpful. This place truly is a great spot to enjoy.

input:

input:
Impeccable food and service! We figured if we were gonna do Sbraga, we needed the chefs counter 6 course with wine pairings. A pricy endeavor but no regrets. I loved having a front row view of the deliciousness about to be laid in front of me. The team behind the line on this particular Saturday night ran like a well oiled machine. 

The tone was set with the amuse Gruyere popover with foie gras soup. Heavenly! There were no duds on the menu, but other standouts were the saffron spaghetti with blue crab, the crispy Arctic char and the chicken liver mousse (btw I thought I hated chicken liver). The wines were matched very well. 

My friend was celebrating a birthday so I included that in the notes when making the reservation. To top off the experience, they gave her a note signed by Sbraga and a little goodie bag. Can't wait to return!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had an impeccable experience at Sbraga, opting for the chefs counter 6 course with wine pairings. The food and service were outstanding, and the team behind the line ran flawlessly. Standout dishes included the saffron spaghetti with blue crab, crispy Arctic char, and chicken liver mousse (surprisingly enjoyable even for someone who thought they hated chicken liver). The wines were perfectly matched. The birthday celebration of a friend was made special with a personalized note from Sbraga and a thoughtful goodie bag. We are excited to return!

input:
If you're looking for something different in this area, I highly recommend GlobalQ.  Their quesadillas and wraps are all very good, I've had at least half of the items on the menu and they've ranged from, at worst, just ok, to phenomenal.  The quesadillas are very big and are full of some pretty unique combinations.  The wraps are also huge, I usually only eat half a wrap and save the other half for the next day.  While they're all pretty good, I recommend going outside the box and getting the 'Montreal' or 'New Orleans'.  And their 'French Dip' quesadilla is also very good, but for some reason is not listed on their menu.  Check that one out if you like french dip sammies.  

Best part about this place: THEY DELIVER.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: For a unique dining experience in this area, I highly recommend GlobalQ. Their quesadillas and wraps are consistently delicious, with a range of flavors from good to outstanding. The generous portion sizes make for a satisfying meal, often leaving enough for leftovers. Particularly noteworthy are the 'Montreal' and 'New Orleans' wraps, which offer creative and flavorful combinations. An off-menu gem is the 'French Dip' quesadilla, a must-try for fans of French dip sandwiches. Additionally, a major advantage of GlobalQ is their delivery service.

input: Haven't eaten at Wendy's in a long time but these have really changed for the better. Fries with sea salt!  Really good quality for fast food. Normally I don't even rate fast food!!!

input: I legit just walked into Blaze being 9pm and as soon as I got to the line I was told that they are closed. I'm not sure if this is correct as the hours online and on the front door states that they are open until 10pm daily. I also checked the website before coming into Blaze. This pizzeria is new to the area so I was actually pretty stoked to check them out and unfortunately my first experience is not what I expected. It would have been courteous for them to give me an explanation for their time change on a Tuesday night.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I walked into Blaze at 9pm, but was informed that they were closed. However, both their online hours and the sign on the front door stated that they were open until 10pm daily. I had checked the website before coming in, so I was surprised by this conflicting information. Since this pizzeria is new to the area, I was looking forward to trying it out, but my first experience was disappointing. It would have been nice if they had provided an explanation for the sudden time change on a Tuesday night.

input: I could never go to another dentist! I had a traumatic experience with a dentist when I was younger and have always had bad anxiety when it comes to dental work. Dr. Dayley is not only personable and helps calm my nerves but is very good at what he does! I've had all four wisdom teeth removed by him, and trust him with my teeth. He is the best dentist I've ever been to! I highly recommend him to everyone I know. My entire family including my parents and younger siblings all go to him as well. The front desk and staff are very welcoming and sweet. Thank you for being the best dentist office!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I highly recommend Dr. Dayley as the best dentist I've ever been to. I had a traumatic experience with a dentist when I was younger, which led to severe anxiety during dental work. However, Dr. Dayley is not only personable and helps calm my nerves, but also very skilled at his job. He successfully removed all four of my wisdom teeth, and I trust him with my dental care. My whole family, including my parents and younger siblings, also go to him. The front desk and staff are welcoming and sweet. Thank you for being the best dentist office!

input:
I am a huge fan of P.F. Chang's, so when I found out that they made a fast food-type restaurant, I was excited.

The atmosphere isn't like P.F. Chang's; it's loud and it does have a more fast food feel to it. I did, however, love the way it was set up; you order your food at the bar, sit down, and they bring it out to you in 5 minutes (if that).

The food itself was absolutely fantastic compared to about of time it took to make and the price. I was very pleased and surprised with all of the flavors it had. I would recommend going there.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I'm a huge P.F. Chang's fan, so I was excited to discover their fast food-style restaurant. The atmosphere is different, more fast food-like and loud. However, I really liked the setup where you order at the bar and they serve your food within minutes. The quality of the food was excellent given its quick preparation time and reasonable price. I was pleasantly surprised by the delicious flavors and would definitely recommend trying it out.

input: I've been here for several blow outs and I highly recommend! The entire staff is talented and I love how you can book online. I usually see Krissy or Bianca, but everyone is great and super friendly. I also recommend getting a vital shot with your blow out. It is a deep conditioning product that doesn't add extra time to your visit but makes all the difference! I am blonde so I am always trying to keep my hair conditioned, and the vital shot lasts about a week!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I highly recommend this place for blow outs. The staff is talented and booking online is convenient. Krissy and Bianca are great, but everyone is friendly. Don't forget to try the vital shot for deep conditioning, it lasts about a week and makes a noticeable difference. Being blonde, I always appreciate keeping my hair conditioned and this product is perfect for that.

input:
I must say I'm very disappointed, my two stars are for presentation and prompt delivery. I ordered the rainbow roll, white tuna roll, calamari and chicken lettuce wraps. Where do I begin? ok with the bad. 

I strongly feel that when you are delivering food that should be served cold, you don't put it in a bag with hot food because that equals mushy, warm sushi, which is what I got. The rainbow roll, which normally is topped with raw fish was topped with mushy avocado????? which I ended up peeling off to salvage the sushi. The spicy white tuna roll was very good.

The calamari looked like chicken fingers all the breading was falling off and it was under cooked, I took one bite and tossed it. Now I've had lettuce wraps before but mines came with an actual head of lettuce in a bag and chicken filling in a plate. It was not described this way in the menu at all. All in all I don't think I'll be ordering from here again. I'll stick to Niji's on 5th.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I'm disappointed with my recent order. The presentation and prompt delivery were good, earning two stars. However, I have several complaints. Firstly, the sushi was served warm and mushy due to being placed in a bag with hot food. The rainbow roll, usually topped with raw fish, had mushy avocado instead. The spicy white tuna roll was the only highlight. Additionally, the calamari was undercooked and the breading fell off easily. The chicken lettuce wraps were not as described on the menu, as they came with an entire head of lettuce in a bag and chicken filling on a plate. Overall, I am unlikely to order from here again and prefer Niji's on 5th.

input: Terrible service from the bar tender. Unless you are a regular she did not serve us. I was standing at the bar with money in my hand and she just kept going to the same old people. Very irritating!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The bar tender's service was terrible as she only served regular customers, ignoring me even though I was standing at the bar with money in my hand. This was extremely irritating.

input:
I came in here the other night for a  post-show snack after seeing a ESO performance at the Winspear. The main reason we chose this location was because it was close to the Winspear, and open late (until 11:30pm on Friday and Saturday). I don't have any strong criticisms of the restaurant. I suppose, if anything, the menu may have seemed a little bit over-priced - at least for what I ordered. I had a Caesar salad with three 'jumbo' shrimp on it, which cost $15. The portion size did not seem to justify the cost and the jumbo shrimp were fairly average in their size, but the flavours were good and the ingredients were fresh. My friend had a soup, which looked and smelled absolutely amazing, and at $6 it didn't seem too unreasonable. She also had the smoked salmon Carpaccio, which looked very appetizing with its thick slices of dark rye bread and generous slices of smoked salmon and capers. The also had a couple of interesting beers on their menu that we were keen to try.

I think if you're going to a show in the area and looking for a spot to get a drink or a snack afterward, this is not a bad option. Their menu at that time of night had an interesting mix of appetizers and desserts that seemed to provide something to suit most tastes.

I'm assuming Normand's Bistro must be connected to the Normand's restaurant which is on Jasper Avenue. Of interest, I have heard that Normand's took over the brunch menu that had formerly been offered at the Glenora Bistro.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I came here for a post-show snack after an ESO performance at the Winspear. We chose this location because it's close to the Winspear and open late on weekends. The menu may seem overpriced, but the flavors were good and the ingredients were fresh. My friend had a delicious soup for $6 and the smoked salmon Carpaccio looked appetizing. They also have interesting beers on the menu. If you're in the area and want a drink or snack after a show, this is a decent option. Normand's Bistro seems connected to Normand's restaurant on Jasper Avenue. It also took over the brunch menu from the Glenora Bistro.

input: The people at the store amazing! We came in to exchange a shirt from a few days before they had had some damage, and the managers were so helpful with our situation. Tonya is the best. Without hesitation she is going to help us out.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The store staff were amazing! We visited to exchange a damaged shirt we had purchased a few days ago, and the managers, especially Tonya, were extremely helpful in resolving our situation. She readily offered to assist us without any hesitation.

input: My dogs and i love this place!   Always try to go when they have sales going on.  They have a wide variety of toys and are pretty well stocked.  They even allow your pets to come in with you.  The staff is very caring and friendly.  Whenever I have a question about a certain product, they give me a great answer or find someone who knows more about it.  Even though it's a chain store, I feel like it's a nice neighborhood pet store.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My dogs and I love this pet store because they have great sales, a wide variety of toys, and allow pets inside. The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and always willing to answer my questions or find someone who can. Despite being a chain store, it feels like a welcoming neighborhood pet store.

input: Gets two stars because the service was great and staff was very friendly, food was not very good.. maybe we came on a bad day. I ate there and ordered a togo item for my husband. I asked the girl working the counter to pick the most popular thing out of the German section for him and it was literally just a pretzel and a piece of sausage in a box.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Two stars for great service and friendly staff, but food was not good. Ordered a to-go item and asked for the most popular German option, which turned out to be just a pretzel and a piece of sausage in a box.

input:
I have been a fan of Charlie's for many years and I recently came back because I didn't have any jeans that fit.  I'm so happy I came back.

The girl who helped me was extremely attentive.  She pulled about 20 different pairs for me to try and explained all the nuances in the different fits and washes.  She was very patient despite my incredible indecision.  I ended up purchasing two pairs of Sebastian McCalls and I am really happy that I discovered this brand.  They are super cute and comfortable.  I love this place!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I've been a long-time fan of Charlie's and recently returned because I needed new jeans that fit. I'm thrilled that I came back because the girl who assisted me was incredibly attentive. She brought out around 20 different pairs for me to try on and thoroughly explained the variations in fits and washes. Despite my indecisiveness, she patiently helped me. Ultimately, I bought two pairs of Sebastian McCalls, a brand I'm delighted to have discovered. These jeans are not only cute but also comfortable. I absolutely adore this store!

input: Went there on a Tuesday with my minivan, which ended up being Senior Discount Day. They didn't tell me before I paid that they won't clean or vacuum 3rd rows on Senior days. I got the Super wash, which included wax. They handed it over with large dirt smudges on the side, like it hadn't been wiped at all. A couple cup holders were barely touched and Some not at all in the front. The rest of the vacuuming wasn't good, with paper scraps still on the floor. I talked with the manager about the 3rd row and why didn't they tell me upfront when I pulled in. He said, "I won't do your 3rd row on Senior Day. That's the way we've been doing it for 15 years." I said I was new to the area and he said, "That's too bad." What kind of customer service is that?!? I usually don't write reviews, but this place was that bad.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I visited the car wash on a Tuesday, which happened to be Senior Discount Day. I was not informed prior to payment that the cleaning and vacuuming of the 3rd rows is not done on Senior days. Despite purchasing the Super wash with wax, the car was handed over with noticeable dirt smudges on the side as if it hadn't been wiped at all. Some cup holders were partially cleaned or left untouched in the front. The overall vacuuming was subpar, with paper scraps still on the floor. I spoke to the manager regarding the 3rd row issue and questioned why this was not communicated when I arrived. The manager responded by stating, "I don't clean 3rd rows on Senior Day. We've been doing it this way for 15 years." When I mentioned being new to the area, the manager simply responded, "That's too bad." This level of customer service was highly disappointing and has compelled me to write this review, despite not being my usual practice.

input: i had the seafood combo-catfish (and im talkin like 5 pounds of it), red beans and rice and coleslaw.  the food was pretty damn good.  well, the real reason we walked in to this place was due to the big sign out front: "happy hour, mon-sat, 4pm-7pm, 2 for 1"  Now THAT is what im talkin about.  i ordered a margarita...and being that i'm from California, i have extremely high standards for marg's.  wasn't bad, but really wasn't great... but food made up for it!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had the seafood combo-catfish (about 5 pounds), red beans and rice, and coleslaw. The food was pretty good. We went to this place because of the sign: "happy hour, Mon-Sat, 4pm-7pm, 2 for 1". I ordered a margarita, and as a Californian, I have high standards for margaritas. It wasn't bad, but not great. However, the food made up for it.

input:
Have been here many times and always had a great experience. When we moved to Rita Ranch 6 months ago my husband and I did a lot of rehab work on our new house and would go almost once a week to recover from the week's "work-out". It's always clean, they never gyp you on time, take the time to work on problem areas. Felicia is the best. Highly recommend them! 

Update...neck really bothering me so I went in and had the best therapeutic massage with Felicia. It was amazing! She is truly talented.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
I've been here many times and always had a great experience. Ever since my husband and I moved to Rita Ranch 6 months ago, we've been coming almost once a week to recover from our rehab work on the house. The place is always clean, they never rush or cheat you on time, and they really take the time to work on problem areas. Felicia is absolutely the best. I can't recommend them highly enough. 

Update: My neck was really bothering me, so I went in for a therapeutic massage with Felicia. It was amazing! She is truly talented.

input:
The Sunrise Family Restaurant is an old style diner that has a very small-town, homey feel.   Service is prompt and super friendly.

I had a Monte Cristo sandwich per the waitresses recommendation and I won't lie, it was pretty disappointing.  Take a stack of turkey and a couple thick slices of ham out of their respective industrial packs, microwave them with some swiss cheese on top and serve on limp french toast.  Somebody out there might like it.  I didn't. 

It came with a salad and fries, both of which were good.  The fries were thick steak fries cooked to a perfect golden brown.   

I have a feeling there are some good items on the menu.  I would especially be interested in trying breakfast.  I'll be back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The Sunrise Family Restaurant is a friendly, small-town diner with an old style ambiance. While the service is prompt and friendly, the Monte Cristo sandwich I had, recommended by the waitress, was disappointing. The sandwich consisted of turkey, ham, Swiss cheese, and limp French toast, microwaved from industrial packs. However, the salad and thick steak fries that came with it were delicious. Despite this experience, I believe there are other appealing items on the menu, particularly for breakfast. I plan to return.

input: First time at Butcher & Bee with my husband who joined me and my co-workers for lunch one day. I love the place, it so cute with the farmhouse feel. It's really open and cute booths that offers some privacy. We had a group of 7 and it was a bit tight, but we were able to be sat right away. I ordered the pork belly gnocchi, and it was good, but not great. I felt it lacked texture. If the pork belly was crispy, it would have sealed the deal. My husband ordered the trout sandwich, unfortunately, he was disappointed that it was basically a 'tuna salad' sandwich. He did not enjoy it. For dessert, we ordered coconut macaroons, which were good. Co-workers had mixed reviews, but one ordered the KFC (Korean Fried Chicken) sandwich, and he liked it. Will definitely have to give this place another try. Also, the use books for bill holders, so cute!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: First time at Butcher & Bee with my husband and co-workers for lunch. Cute place with a farmhouse feel and open layout. Booths offer some privacy, but a bit tight for our group of 7. We were seated right away. I tried the pork belly gnocchi, which was good but lacked texture. Crispy pork belly would have made it better. My husband was disappointed with the trout sandwich, more like a 'tuna salad'. Coconut macaroons for dessert were good. Mixed reviews from co-workers, but one liked the KFC sandwich. Will definitely give this place another try. Loved the use of books for bill holders.

input:
This is a really fun event for those who enjoy beer in all its forms. The drinks themselves were relatively cheap ($2-4 for a 4 oz. sample. Most were $2, some were $3, and very few were in the $4 range), however the food was really over priced ($6 for a small cup of fancy macaroni and cheese? really?). For the beer lover, however, there is a wide variety of tried and true along with the new kids on the block from local, national and international lines. Also, if you like what you tasted, you can buy it on site, with a Sobeys/Safeway liquor store right on site doing specials on the sampled brews. 

We went VIP for this event, however I don't think it's worth it. What you get: a glass mug instead of a plastic one, a beer and food class ($2 value) and a beer seminar ($2 value). If you do it all, or really value the glass mug, go for it! But for me, who just did the beer and food class, it wasn't worth it. 

My only complaint is for the venue, but for an event that size, you need the space. $16 for parking on top of your entry fee (though I guess most people would cab or Uber it there so you don't have to have a designated driver), and then you have to buy sample tickets on site. It gets quite expensive.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This event is perfect for beer lovers who enjoy a wide variety of options. The drink samples are reasonably priced, ranging from $2 to $4 for a 4 oz. sample. The food, however, is overpriced, with a small cup of macaroni and cheese costing $6. On-site, there is a Sobeys/Safeway liquor store offering specials on the sampled brews, allowing attendees to purchase their favorite beers. Going VIP provides a glass mug, a beer and food class, and a beer seminar, but it may not be worth the extra cost for everyone. The venue is spacious but charges $16 for parking in addition to the entry fee, making it quite expensive overall.

input: I've been here a handful of times and it's always because I don't have time to go to VN Nails near Costco where I prefer to go (they get 5 stars from me).  Kiwi Nail has always done a cheap job trying to take shortcuts wherever possible.  But today I've had it and will never go back!  After getting the typical shabby job on a fill with French tips,  I accidentally smudged two nails really badly.  They needed to be repainted and I asked her to do so... I even offered to pay extra.  The nail tech came over to look and she pressed the clumps back down and painted right back over the mess (didn't even keep the paint in the lines) then slathered so much varnish over the train wreck that it was literally dripping down my finger. After my nails were dry enough to leave,  another tech rang me up and the receipt had no place for a tip.  When I asked,  he told me I had to pay tips in cash... Well it's lucky for me I didn't have any cash.  He said I will have to tip her next time.  NEXT TIME??!!  yeah right!  There will be no next time! Save yourself the hassle and don't bother with this d@mn place!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I've been to Kiwi Nail a few times because I didn't have time to go to VN Nails near Costco, which I prefer (they have 5 stars from me). However, Kiwi Nail always tries to cut corners and does a subpar job. Today was the last straw for me. I had a fill with French tips and accidentally smudged two nails badly. I asked the nail tech to repaint them, even offering to pay extra. Instead of fixing them properly, she just pressed the clumps back down and painted over the mess, not even staying within the lines. To make matters worse, she applied so much varnish that it dripped down my finger. After my nails dried, another tech rang me up and there was no option to tip on the receipt. When I asked, he said tips had to be paid in cash. Luckily, I didn't have any cash on me. He mentioned I could tip the next time I visit. Well, there won't be a next time. Save yourself the hassle and avoid this terrible place.

input: I'm not really into the fast food scene BUT Chick fil A is a step above. Great quality food! I don't feel like I'm eating a ton of fillers!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I'm not a fan of fast food, but Chick fil A stands out with their high-quality food that doesn't feel overloaded with fillers.

input: Square 1682 is a hotel bar I frequent. I've been there for lunch, brunch, dinner and happy hour. The food is great, the service is excellent, and the space is upscale. There is always a nice group of people that go there. Whether they are staying at the hotel or live or work in the area, you'll always find someone nice to chat with at the bar. The very best thing about the bar is the bartender that works on Mondays. His name is Dan and he is the man! He's my favorite bartender in the city and I've been to a lot of places. He always knows just what I want and remembers my name when I go there. The only reason I go to Square 1682 on Monday's is because Dan is working. If I walk by and he's not on, I keep going. He's that good! Love him and have so many great memories at this fine establishment.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Square 1682 is a hotel bar I frequent for lunch, brunch, dinner, and happy hour. The food, service, and upscale ambiance are exceptional. There is always a friendly crowd, whether hotel guests or locals, making it easy to strike up conversations. However, the standout highlight is the bartender named Dan, who works on Mondays. He is my absolute favorite in the city, always anticipating my drink preferences and remembering my name. Dan's presence is the sole reason I choose to visit Square 1682 on Mondays; if he is not there, I simply keep walking. I hold many cherished memories at this wonderful establishment, all thanks to him.

input: This is a must try, we come here frequent and we are never disappointed. Get there early so you get right in and don't have to wait. Decent selection of coffees, they have french press as well. Menu isn't huge which is nice so you can figure out what you want quickly. Food comes how in a decent time. I seem to always get the same thing (wilburt skillet) everytime I go cause it is amazing. Food just seems so fresh as well, friendly staff. You will leave full and a smile on your face.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Must try, frequent visit, never disappointed. Arrive early to avoid waiting. Decent coffee selection, including French press. Compact menu for quick decision-making. Food arrives promptly. Highly recommend the Wilburt Skillet dish. Fresh and friendly environment. Leave satisfied and happy.

input:
I tried to like this place... I really did. So much so that I went back to try it after a less that satisfactory first wax.

Wax 1- I had Despina, I think her name was. I waited a good 15 minutes after my appointment time for her to come and get me from the front. Ironic they have a 9 minute policy that if you don't show they'll cancel/charge you or whatever. Anyway, as for the experience with Despina, she did not speak to me. Like at all. Made me feel super awkward the whole time, and missed a fair few chunks of hair. She didn't ask me anything about myself, didn't tell me where to sit or how she wanted me positioned etc. Luckily I got this one half price as it was my first time at EWC.

Wax 2- I booked 3-4 weeks later with Amy Jo (based on previous Yelp reviews). She was a lot friendlier (literally the only reason why I'm giving this 1 star) BUT way too sloppy. I think it's safe to say this is the worst wax I've ever had. She left half of my hair on right before Valentine's Day! I understand they can't get all the hairs all the time but a lottttt of hair right on top was left clearly visible to my waxer. My apt was at 3.45, I walked out of the building at 3.53. Really. This includes the time spent undressing, redressing, and paying. 8 minutes is not long enough for all of this. It went so quick that when she said she was done I was actually shocked.  
I'm about to go to CVS and get some at home wax strips to finish the job... For $47+ I expect way way more. 

The staff- Another reason why I won't be returning. The ladies at the front desk are generally rude and disinterested in showing any glimpse of good customer service. ALSO, I don't like being asked if I'm going to tip - can't you give me the card machine so I can do it myself rather than make me announce if I would like to tip and how much? 

The hunt for a decent Brazilian wax in Philly continues- someone help me PLEASE!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had two bad experiences with this place. During my first wax, the technician, Despina, made me feel uncomfortable by not speaking to me and missing chunks of hair. My second wax with Amy Jo was slightly better, as she was friendlier, but she left a lot of hair and rushed through the process. It only took 8 minutes from start to finish. The staff at the front desk were also rude, and I didn't appreciate being asked about my tipping preferences. Overall, I won't be returning and I'm still searching for a good Brazilian wax in Philly.

input: Amazing and comfortable atmosphere with extremely unique flavor combinations in the dishes. The Cuban Lamb Frita is a must (add the egg! It's worth it). All of the side items are delicious, you literally can't go wrong. The staff is friendly and they are extremely efficient with the coffee refills. This has quickly become my new regular brunch spot!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The atmosphere is amazing and comfortable, with extremely unique flavor combinations in the dishes. The Cuban Lamb Frita, especially when topped with an egg, is a must-try. The side items are all delicious, making it impossible to choose wrong. The staff is friendly, and they are efficient with coffee refills. It has become my new regular brunch spot.

input:
This place is good. For the lofty prices the proportions were very small. However the drinks were cheap and the service was very good. The piano is a nice touch as well. 

The cheesecake is incredible, just get it and don't look back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is good with small proportions for the lofty prices. However, the drinks are cheap and the service is excellent. The piano adds a nice touch. Don't hesitate, the cheesecake is incredible.

input: If you beat the crowd you're in. Small but that's the only negative. Everything I've tried on the menu is AMAZING! They even have vegetarian/vegan items. I always get whatever french toast special they have. I always take people who stay with me for Mardi Gras here for breakfast before we hit the parades.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The only negative about this place is that it can get crowded. However, everything on the menu is amazing, including their vegetarian/vegan options. I highly recommend trying their french toast specials. It's a must-visit spot for breakfast before heading to Mardi Gras parades.

input: Butch did a great job. The tour was relaxing, informative but 2 good stops to eat and see the cemetery. I recommend going on this trip the beginning of your stay so you know where to go during your trip. He'a also pretty fun.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Butch did a great job on the relaxing and informative tour, which included 2 good stops to eat and see the cemetery. I recommend going on this trip at the beginning of your stay to familiarize yourself with the best places to visit. Plus, Butch is also a lot of fun.

input: I love this food truck. They have the tastiest street foods like their captain crunch tilapia burrito. Who would've thought of that? The fried fish is so flakey and delicious, paired with fresh cabbage, tomatoes, avocado and Sriracha mayo. I have also tried their katsu and curry chicken which are so rich in flavor. Their Thai tea is also on point! So much to offer from a small food truck. I live in Jersey and I have driven here many times just to get food. They are so friendly and provide great food at a great price.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love this food truck. They serve the tastiest street foods like their unique captain crunch tilapia burrito paired with fresh ingredients like cabbage, tomatoes, avocado, and Sriracha mayo. Their katsu and curry chicken are also flavorful. Additionally, their Thai tea hits the spot. Despite being a small food truck, they offer a lot. I frequently drive from Jersey just to enjoy their friendly service, great food, and affordable prices.

input: I was having an bad migraine and felt terrible. When woke up I had a sinus infection and my day was just going awful. I called a few places to try to get a massage in today because I knew indeed it badly. No one had any availability and I stumbled across massage envy on Google and thought to give them a try. Not only were they able to fit me in with the exact specific type I needed, but they also were able to fit my father in at the exact same time. Jen was understanding and nice, she asked me questions and checked up on me constantly. She even showed me some at home techniques I could use. She took her time, obviously did not rush. Carrie, I believe, was the name of the woman who did a foot massage on my father. He was very pleased and recommended I try it sometime. They also informed me about the membership program which not only is very cost-efficient, but also adheres to my busy schedule. I signed up on the spot with no hesitation. Friendly staff, great atmosphere, comfortable building and very calming environment! Would recommended! I feel so much better already and am going back in a month to get a 90 minute massage.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a bad migraine and woke up with a sinus infection, making my day awful. I called multiple places for a massage but none had availability. I found Massage Envy on Google and they were able to accommodate me and my father at the same time. Jen was understanding, asked questions, and gave me at-home techniques. Carrie gave my father a foot massage and he was pleased with it. They also told me about a cost-efficient membership program that suits my busy schedule. The staff was friendly, the atmosphere and environment were calming, and I signed up without hesitation. I already feel better and will be returning in a month for a 90-minute massage. Highly recommended!

input: This place is good~  The chicken is moist, the skin is crispy, the flavor is nice and smokey, this is the best kind of roast chicken I have tried. The smells (smokey, bbq) is so good and hypnotizing, just make my mouth water.  I got the double chicken family which is 2 whole chickens, literally a bed of fries underneath them, and cole slaw.  It was more than enough to feed a family of four.  The dipping sauces that come with it are also real good, i really like the mustard base one, its kinda mustardy with a chipotle flair, and there is also a green sauce that is like a salsa.  The fries are wedge fries and they make you real full because there are plenty to go around. We had leftovers because the meal was that big.  I would rather eat here than popeyes or kfc, because you get more, its healthier, and you get better service. The owners are real nice and friendly. I will be back because I know I will be craving this chicken.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place serves the best kind of roast chicken I have ever tried. The chicken is moist, the skin is crispy, and it has a nice, smokey flavor. The smells are incredibly good, making my mouth water. I ordered the double chicken family meal which includes two whole chickens, a bed of fries, and cole slaw. It was more than enough to feed a family of four. The dipping sauces are also delicious, particularly the mustard base one with a chipotle flair, and a green salsa-like sauce. The wedge fries are plentiful and filling. We had leftovers because the meal was so big. The service is better compared to Popeyes or KFC, and the owners are friendly. I will definitely come back because I know I will crave this chicken.

input:
This is as close to Japanese cuisine I get! I'm not a big fan of sushi, sashimi or maki, but I really enjoy their rice bowls and tempura. This location is not terribly busy so you won't have to wait in line for too long. 

They also provide catering options so you can have sushi and maki platters at your functions.

The service has always been good, for fast food. And I know I can keep somewhat on my eating plan when I go here. It's a fast lunch or dinner if you're in a hurry to.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place offers a taste of Japanese cuisine without sushi, sashimi, or maki, but their rice bowls and tempura are enjoyable. The restaurant is not very busy, so you won't have to wait long. They also provide catering options with sushi and maki platters for events. The service is good for fast food, and it's a suitable option for a quick lunch or dinner.

input: I was new to the Westchase area and I was in need of a new dentist.  After reading reviews and the location being on .5 miles from my place I made an appointment.  The entire staff is great. The entire staff is great, especially Dr. Creech-Gionis and Dr. Stern. They are both outstanding and make going to the dentist less painful. I'm 100% satisfied.

input:
Went to Amigos on our 40th anniversary citing the great reviews. Near to no atmosphere. Food was bleeeeah and the price was kinda high for what you get. Can't figure why people like their salsa so much as I think the stuff from "NEW YORK CITY!!" is as good and the chips are just the giant bag variety.

Gawd... all I want is some decent Mexican fare here in Boise!! Used to love Gloria's though not nearly as clean as one would like.  $47.00 with drinks and tip though I think one would do much better at one of the taco trucks as far as flavor goes.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We celebrated our 40th anniversary at Amigos based on great reviews, but the atmosphere was lacking. The food was disappointing and overpriced. I don't understand the hype around their salsa when I think the salsa from "NEW YORK CITY!" is just as good. The chips were nothing special. I miss Gloria's, even though it wasn't very clean. The total bill, including drinks and tip, came to $47.00, but I believe the flavor would be much better at one of the taco trucks in town.

input:
5 STAR FOOD! 
For sure one of if not the best place to get a sandwich on the beach anywhere between St Pete Beach & Clearwater Beach. All orders cooked to order. Super Size, gourmet servings and great very friendly service from the owner. Artison sandwiches for the price of Subway. Great cook with well seasoned sauces and dips usually. I always go for the daily special. Today was 3 Shrimp taco's for $6.00 The shrimp were cooked perfectly and served on fresh corn tortillas with a Kiwi sauce with some fresh peppers. Just enough spice and fruit with the shrimp. DELICIOUS. I could have had 6 they were so good. Only drawback is this place is walk up with only bench seating outside. Not a problem given the food quality for me personally but some may p[refer to sit at a table. It's on the bench or to go. A great place if you are staying at one of the local hotel to walk to. I hear they will start delivering soon. This is a local favorite for me.
The only reason I did not give 5 stars overall as the seating may be an issue for some.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: 5 STAR FOOD! One of the best places to get a sandwich on the beach between St Pete Beach & Clearwater Beach. All orders cooked to order with gourmet servings and friendly service from the owner. Artisan sandwiches for the price of Subway, with well-seasoned sauces and dips. Daily specials like 3 Shrimp tacos for $6.00 are deliciously cooked with a Kiwi sauce and fresh peppers. Bench seating outside may be a drawback, but worth it for the food quality. Perfect for walking distance from local hotels and soon offering delivery. A local favorite.

input: Beautiful modern place, they have a nice view, the only thing is that is close to the train and you may hear it if you are on that side of the building, other than that it's great and has a yolk on the corner!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Beautiful modern place with a nice view, but close proximity to the train may result in occasional noise disruptions from that side of the building. Apart from that, the place is great and conveniently located near a yolk on the corner.

input: Went in for full set, request long showed picture. Nails were cut short no big deal, the issue came when I pointed out a crooked nail and was told it hadn't been filed, acrylic was put on nail still crooked. It was filed and getting shorter and shorter. This wasn't my first visit however it will be my last.

However, things took a turn when I noticed a crooked nail and informed the technician. They acknowledged that it hadn't been filed, but proceeded to apply acrylic over the misaligned nail. As they filed it down, the nail gradually became shorter and shorter. Although I had been to this salon before, this experience has convinced me that it will be my last visit.

input:

input:
We had dinner here after a long day at the convention center.  We asked to sit in a quieter area, and they found us a nice table in a side room.  Service was attentive and professional.  Our waiter recommended the aged ribeye steak--"best steak ever."  I didn't think I wanted an entire 18-ounce boneless, so he suggested we split it.  We did--certainly one of the "best steaks ever"--cooked perfectly medium rare and it was plenty for both of us.  Of course, we also had the signature shrimp cocktail (horseradish) and the iceberg lettuce wedge with crumbled bacon (very pancetta-like).   OK, iceberg wedge isn't the most exciting salad, but it's great when done well, which this was.  
   My only disappointment was a wine list that had a very limited choice of medium-priced wines by the bottle, so wine selection took a while.  A small complaint, so I would rate H & I  4.5 stars if possible.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: After a long day at the convention center, we had dinner at this restaurant. We requested a quieter area and were accommodated with a nice table in a side room. The service was attentive and professional. Our waiter recommended the aged ribeye steak, which he claimed was the best steak ever. Since I didn't want the entire 18-ounce boneless steak, he suggested we split it. We agreed, and it turned out to be one of the best steaks we've had, cooked perfectly medium rare and plenty for both of us. We also tried the signature shrimp cocktail with horseradish and the iceberg lettuce wedge topped with crumbled bacon, which had a pancetta-like flavor. While the wine list was limited in terms of medium-priced options, it was the only disappointment. Overall, we would rate H & I 4.5 stars if possible.

input: The worst Italian food I have ever tasted!!! I'm far from Italian, but I can make a MEAN lasagna & spaghetti myself compared to this place. 1st of all, we waited 45mins patiently w/ a hungry Hubby, 2yr old, 7yr old, & myself. When we finally got seated, the waitress was very polite, but forgetful at times. Didnt drink any alcohol or sodas but the lemonade was very tart & the garlic bread was not-so-fresh...had to request for some fresh bread after my family devoured the 1st basket from starving & waiting for so long. I ordered the stuffed shells & chicken parmagiana. The salad was very tasty; however, they only have Italian dressing...no ranch or anything else. I am not a picky eater & rarely complain, but the stuffed shells & parmagiana chicken tasted HORRIBLE!! The chicken was very bland & the stuffed shells were hard & overbaked. The meranera sauce tasted like it was old or aged too long (if there's ever such a thing, lol). I could not bring myself to eat my entree. I had to send it back. I heard the lady at the table next to ours say the salmon was good, so I figured the salmon might be safe. It was actually very good! I was still very disappointed after this restaurant was referred to me by many. I felt like they got an easy $50 bucks out of me. I would have rathered gone to the olive garden or macaroni grill. If u r looking for an awesome authentic Italian cusine restaurant in Tucson, I highly recommend Contessa off of Ina Rd. The only reason we didn't go there is b/c it was out of the way from where we were going.  It's pretty far from where we live but always worth the drive. Everything is freshly made & u can definite tell the difference! I'm sorry Caruso, but I don't think my family will be coming here ever again!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Terrible Italian food! Waited 45 minutes with hungry family. Polite but forgetful waitress. Lemonade was tart and garlic bread not fresh. Had to request fresh bread. Ordered stuffed shells and chicken parmagiana - both horrible. Chicken was bland and shells overbaked. Meranera sauce tasted old. Sent back my entree. Salmon was good, but still disappointed. Regret spending $50. Would recommend Contessa for authentic Italian cuisine. Will not come back to Caruso.

input: I tend to stay away from strip mall bars, that being said my buddy John is a bar back here and raved about it so we decided to give it a try. The food is very good, I will try their pizza next time, they also have a killer craft bar they just added, prices are very reasonable too
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite my usual aversion to strip mall bars, I was convinced by my friend John, who works as a bar back, to check this one out. Surprisingly, the food exceeded my expectations, and I plan on trying their pizza during my next visit. Additionally, they recently introduced a fantastic craft bar with reasonable prices.

I opted for the Buffalo chicken salad with romaine lettuce and blue cheese dressing. I was amazed by the quality!
