input:
My son and I went in for burgers after a long day's drive returning him to Nashville for the upcoming semester. We were in need of immediate sustenance after a long fast. What we found was a busy place that actually knew how to operate with a full house. Our need were quickly satisfied with courteous and reasonably priced service. 

Since we were just two, we were quickly seated. We started off with a couple Highland stouts. It was a nice drink and at a reasonable price. Before our entree, we shared a large garden salad. It was fresh and flavorful. The dressing was a bit on the heavy side for a vinaigrette. 

For entrees, I had the Black and Blue burger with fries. The burger was just incredible. It was perfectly cooked. The blue cheese was not overpowering. The bun was soft and fresh. The side of regular fries were crisp and lightly salted. Even better, they went perfectly with the homemade ketchup. I'm not a fan of ketchup, but theirs is very nice since they seem to avoid adding too much sweetness. My son had a basic burger with sweet potato fries. I tried the sweet potato fries and think they might be some of the best I've ever eaten. The burger looked as good as mine and my son concurred. 

The burger was well made and consumed within minutes. No words were spoken as we ate. Always a good sign. We shall return.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My son and I had burgers after a long drive back to Nashville. The place was busy but had great service. We quickly got seated and had Highland stouts as a drink. The garden salad we shared was fresh and flavorful, though the dressing was a bit heavy. I had the Black and Blue burger with fries, which was incredible. The burger was perfectly cooked and the blue cheese was not overpowering. The bun was soft and fresh, and the fries were crisp and lightly salted. The homemade ketchup was also impressive. My son had a basic burger with sweet potato fries, which he loved. We ate in silence and will definitely go back.

input: Nothing more to say than this is the BEST donut place ever. I literally wished they shipped their products. When I moved to Florida, I missed it so much. It's only in New Orleans... sad face!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This is the BEST donut place ever! I wish they shipped their products. I missed it so much when I moved to Florida. Unfortunately, it's only in New Orleans... sad face!

input: Katie's is a neighborhood restaurant that has existed in one form or another for a few generation.  It's classic New Orleans fare with an Italian-American slant.  Great meatballs.  You'll see all types of classic New Orleans old people dinging before 8pm.   You won't be disappointed if your expectations aren't too high.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Katie's is a long-standing neighborhood restaurant in New Orleans that serves classic Italian-American cuisine with a New Orleans twist. Their meatballs are highly recommended. It's popular among elderly residents who prefer dining early. While it's important to manage your expectations, you will not be let down.

input: Excellent service! They were super fast, friendly and professional.  This is now my go to place for oil changes
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: They provide excellent, fast, friendly, and professional service for oil changes.

input:
If you're a Latino, you're best staying away from this place.
The lady that cut my hair was rude and very unprofessional.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Avoid this place if you're a Latino as the hairdresser I encountered was both rude and unprofessional.

input: This place should be on Restaurant Impossible. It's run down, the decor is tacky, beaten up, miss-matched and cheap. It's really dark...probably to hide how dingy it is. Everything was sticky. I ordered a burger medium and got a charred, tasteless hockey puck. My mom and aunt got the baked crab soup, which before we ordered, we misheard each other and called it baked crap soup. It turned out to be a better description. The crab stuffed mushrooms were heavy on the stuff and light on the crab.  The servers were super nice though.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is a good fit for Restaurant Impossible. It has a run-down and tacky interior with worn-out and cheap decor. The restaurant is dark, possibly to conceal its dinginess. Additionally, everything felt sticky and unclean. I ordered a medium burger that turned out to be charred and tasteless like a hockey puck. My mom and aunt ordered the baked crab soup, which we mistakenly jokingly called "baked crap soup." Unfortunately, it lived up to that description. The crab stuffed mushrooms were overwhelmingly filled with stuffing and lacking in crab. Despite all of this, the servers were very friendly and accommodating.

input:
What can I say?  I'm a sucker for new american.  The owner is a very nice gentleman who really enjoys food.  

The service was impeccable and the food was Ridiculously good.  We ordered a mixed berry waffle, huevo rancho, traditional breakfast bagel with grits, and best sandwich with fresh fruits.  

I highly recommend the huevo rancho and best sandwich.  The grits was very good as well. 

If you decide to visit this restaurant, say hi to the owner.  He's a great guy.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love new American food and the owner of this restaurant is a friendly gentleman who is passionate about food. The service was excellent and the food was incredibly delicious. We tried a mixed berry waffle, huevo rancho, traditional breakfast bagel with grits, and the best sandwich with fresh fruits. I highly recommend the huevo rancho and best sandwich, as well as the tasty grits. Don't forget to say hi to the owner when you visit - he's a great guy!

input: Great place for happy hour. Oysters were deLISH! My friend and I had 2 dozen and we had some cocktails! The riverbend and champagne au poir we quite tasty. I had a side of fries and she had a side a grits. Best grits I've eaten. Definitely coming back. The server was great too. Just the right amount of attention!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great place for happy hour, delicious oysters, had 2 dozen along with cocktails including the riverbend and champagne au poir. The side of fries was tasty, and the side of grits was the best I've eaten. Will definitely come back. The server provided just the right amount of attention.

input:
The crew at Bella Vista Designs are FABULOUS.  From start to finish, they are professional, conscientious, and innovative (and affordable!).  They never cease to amaze me with their can-do attitude and absolutely gorgeous and creative design. 

The events at Santa Barbara Historical Museum and Goleta Valley Historical Society that I produce attract generous donors and they always say the same thing when they see their work, "Wow!!"  

I can't thank them enough for the hundreds of successful events (and the many magical moments we've seen)!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The crew at Bella Vista Designs is amazing. They are professional, conscientious, and innovative, while remaining affordable. Their can-do attitude and stunning creative designs never fail to impress. The events I produce at Santa Barbara Historical Museum and Goleta Valley Historical Society consistently attract generous donors who are always amazed by Bella Vista Designs' work. I am incredibly grateful for their countless successful events and the countless magical moments they have helped create.

input: Moved to Tucson and needed a new dentist, everything went great here!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great experience with a new dentist in Tucson after moving there.

input: Highly, highly overrated.  The food was a C minus at best.  And the service was so bad that I may never go back.  They screwed up my order completely and my no apologies.  There are a lot of other options around State Street.  Avoid this place like the plague.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is highly overrated with a C minus food and terrible service. They completely messed up my order without any apologies. With plenty of other options around State Street, I strongly recommend avoiding this place.

input:
Couldn't say it better than the below poster. Excellent food, service and prices.

Located where Mugshots used to be (RIP), one of my coworkers had been raving about this place, in particular the falafel and of course the very kind owner.

Went with my pre-wife and we shared beef gyro (carved) pita, falafel pita and hummus plate. Everything was extremely fresh (I concur on the crisp lettuce) well seasoned and just plain delicious.  A lot of food as well and complimentary baklava. We took our leftovers home (I wrapped the two remaining bites of my gyro - it's that good)

I highly recommend this place and you'll definitely walk out with a smile. I think this spot is still relatively unknown and I very rarely post reviews. This is a unique spot to Manayunk and I will be referring all of my friends as I really want the restaurant to succeed - because the owner deserves it and of course for my selfish appetite!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is excellent with great food, service, and prices. The location used to be Mugshots. A coworker recommended it, especially the falafel and the owner. We ordered beef gyro pita, falafel pita, and a hummus plate, all of which were fresh, well-seasoned, and delicious. The portions were generous, and they even gave us complimentary baklava. We had leftovers because the food was that good. I rarely post reviews, but I highly recommend this place, as it's relatively unknown and unique to Manayunk. I want the restaurant to succeed because the owner deserves it, and I also selfishly want more of their delicious food.

input: Great food and excellent service. Only knock I would give them was they brought out our entrees about 10 minutes after our apps came so we were still eating that, otherwise great experience
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great food, excellent service, only minor issue with entrees brought out while we were still eating apps. Overall, a great experience.

input:
This is a very mediocre place.  The location itself is in the same dirty strip mall as Mozzarella Pizza. The inside has that "we don't really care about the looks" feel to it.  It's not dirty, per se.  It just doesn't look very clean.  Everything looks like its falling apart.  It probably gets its business from suburbanites like me craving what we think of as Chinese food.

All that said, the food I had was palatable.  Nothing outstanding or amazing: it was just all right.  I won't recommend against it, but it's nothing that you would think of as that great either.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
This place is average, located in a dirty strip mall alongside Mozzarella Pizza. The interior has a neglected appearance, not necessarily dirty but far from clean. Everything seems to be falling apart. It likely attracts customers like me, suburbanites craving what we perceive as Chinese food.

Nevertheless, the food I tried was decent. It was neither outstanding nor amazing, just alright. I wouldn't discourage anyone from trying it, but it's not something you would consider as exceptional either.

input: Phenomenal place to eat. I has the Hickory burger, that was so damn delicious!! Will be coming back for sure!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Amazing place to eat! The Hickory burger was incredibly delicious. I will definitely be returning!

input: After having been here, I would say that the food had great flavors for the taste buds and it was a unique experience.  Our server, Brian was no doubt a foodie... I've never seen anyone get so excited about food and discuss the ingredients in such detail with so much passion.  The food really was different and had unbelievable flavor.  Anyone who calls themselves a foodie should try this place.  I'm thinking they would be pleased with this place.  But, the portions were small.  And I really didn't like the interior of the restaurant.  I'm more of a booths girl.  Booths can be classy, you know?  All in all, I would say this was an interesting place and I would come back, but the dishes were too complicated for me to want to come back beyond once a year.  Speaking of timing, the chefs change the menu every year.  And these guys really are good at what they do.  The owners actually own the Red Pony and two other restaurants all on the same street!  And they're all doing well.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food had great flavors and was a unique experience. Our server, Brian, was a passionate foodie who excitedly discussed the ingredients in detail. The portions were small and the interior of the restaurant was not to my liking. Overall, it was an interesting place to try, but the complex dishes may deter me from returning frequently. The menu changes annually and the owners have successful restaurants on the same street.

input:
Solid improvement since last visit.  

Service- much improved.  Kid named Dillon gave a great service.  

Ambiance is very casual.  Order and sit, they bring food to you. 

Food- tasty and lots of options.  Not fancy.  Very affordable.  

Family of four for about 30$.  That's a great deal w today's prices. 

If you are looking for a fast, casual Asian option, give this place a try.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Improved service, with Dillon providing great service. Casual ambiance where you can order and sit. Tasty and diverse food options that are not fancy but very affordable. Family of four can eat for around $30, which is a great deal considering current prices. If you want a quick and casual Asian dining experience, give this place a try.

input: Use the yelp app to get on the waiting list, we went on a Saturday morning and it was very busy, but the waiting list was cut down significantly by using the app. The menu is expansive, a lot of options. The cinnamon French toast was very good. The traditional breakfast foods were on par with most breakfast joints, but the extras on the menu can keep you busy for many visits trying new things. The strawberry orange juice was excellent so I recommend trying it. It was a little hot in the restaurant, could have been cooled down a lot for a more comfortable experience. The service was very good. There were two places to pay at the counter which I thought was a nice way to speed up the leaving process.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Use the Yelp app to save time on the waiting list. The menu offers a wide variety of options, including delicious cinnamon French toast. While the traditional breakfast dishes are average, the extras on the menu are worth exploring. Don't miss out on the excellent strawberry orange juice. The restaurant could improve the temperature for a more comfortable experience. The service is top-notch and there are two counters for quicker payment.

input:
Visited Shaving Grace on Friday for a hair cut.

Same vibe as my old Barber Shop in Philly. 
Big TV in the waiting area. Plush couch to relax in. Young lady checking me in asked if I wanted water, soda or a beer.
Beer? Need I say more. 

Great cut. Great bunch of guys discussing current events, sports, and what's happening around town.
Found my new spot. 

Will be back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Visited Shaving Grace on Friday for a hair cut. Similar vibe as my old Barber Shop in Philly, with a big TV in the waiting area and a plush couch to relax in. The young lady checking me in offered water, soda, or even a beer. Was impressed by the great cut and enjoyed engaging in conversations with the friendly guys there discussing current events, sports, and local news. Definitely found my new spot and will be back.

input: Not only was the food excellent, but the people here are beyond nice-and genuine. I had eggs Benedict. The poached eggs were good but the toast they were sitting on was excellent. We were given a cream pancakes to taste test by our awesome server, Tina. I can honestly say it was the best pancake I've ever tasted. So full of flavour-vanilla, and soft aa pillow.  They melted in my mouth. I didn't even use syrup. Stellar!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food was excellent and the people were beyond nice. I had eggs Benedict, with good poached eggs on excellent toast. Our server, Tina, gave us a cream pancake to taste test, which was honestly the best pancake I've ever had. It was full of flavor and melted in my mouth. Stellar!

input: Great service. My husband ordered a cheese and bacon burger and I got the crawfish sausage por bo both well made and great tasting.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great service. Husband ordered cheese and bacon burger, and I got well-made, great-tasting crawfish sausage Po' Boy.

input: Had a wonderful experience with JT and Ashley Furniture store!! He was helpful even when I had to change my order.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Had a great experience with JT at Ashley Furniture store! He was helpful and accommodating, even when I needed to make changes to my order.

input:
While at Drexel University, I decided to try a new food truck and go for something that wasn't the typical food truck.  My girlfriend and I always noticed this place was crowded around lunch but never knew why.  After being recommended to try it by a friend, we decided to go ahead and order lunch here.  Cucina Zapata is at the end of the food truck row at the center of Drexel University's campus.  The truck has a graffiti style design which can be easily distinguished from the other food trucks here.

I decided to order (2) thai short rib tacos while my girlfriend got the cap'n crunch tilapia burrito.  The food has a good visual appearance which made us more eager to eat it once we got inside the building.  I really enjoyed the thai short rib tacos even though they put hot sauce on it.  They were definitely better than the typical taco bell food and left me with a 5 star review feeling inside.  My girlfriend also really enjoyed her burrito.

Overall, this food truck provides very good food at a good price.  I recommend this place to anyone looking for a good lunch.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
While at Drexel University, my girlfriend and I decided to try Cucina Zapata, a popular food truck with a unique menu. Located at the end of the food truck row on campus, its graffiti-style design sets it apart from the rest. Upon the recommendation of a friend, we ordered lunch from here and were impressed by the visual appeal of our dishes.

I opted for the flavorful Thai short rib tacos, despite the added hot sauce, and found them to be a step above the usual fast food fare. It left me feeling satisfied and ready to give it a glowing 5-star review. My girlfriend, who ordered the Cap'n Crunch tilapia burrito, also thoroughly enjoyed her meal.

In conclusion, Cucina Zapata offers delicious food at a reasonable price. I highly recommend it to anyone in search of a satisfying lunch.

input: got my haircut here for the first time Jessie Becker took the damaged ends off. She's so sweet and does only what you ask of her. She's also great with kids. come see this place and come see her.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had my first haircut here by Jessie Becker who removed my damaged ends. She is sweet, listens to your requests, and is great with kids. I recommend both this place and her services.

input: Great ramen! I'm really happy to have found this place! The service and food are both wonderful!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Amazing ramen! Found an incredible place with outstanding service and delightful food. Truly thrilled!

input: Cute place, nice servers and good food but dish sizes are waaaaay too small. I left unsatisfied. I don't like it when restaurants are cheap with portions, especially neighborly ones!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The place is cute with nice servers and good food, but the dish sizes are far too small. I left unsatisfied and feel that it's disappointing when restaurants, especially neighborly ones, skimp on portions.

input: Just recently ate here for the first time. The hype was real. My girlfriend had the Greek Salad while I ordered the Chickpea Vegetarian Pita and they were kind enough to allow for some substitutions. The food was on point and portions were very filling and satisfying. Great staff and environment. Will definitely be back again!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Recently tried this place for the first time. The hype was real. My girlfriend had the Greek Salad, I ordered the Chickpea Vegetarian Pita with substitutions. Food was amazing, portions were filling. Staff and environment were great. Will surely return!

input: First time here. Great bar and restaurant area. Open floor plan with plenty of TV's to watch the game. Attached to their O'Fallon brewery (in Maryland Heights, Missouri, a suburb of St. Louis). They ranked 2nd in the St Louis area last year for volume of beer sold by a micro brewery. Today, I tried the House Special IPA...a wonderful IPA, not too bitter, just right. Look for Troy behind the bar! (The only reason for 4 stars is no desserts....)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Brand new spot with a fantastic bar and restaurant section. Spacious layout featuring numerous TVs for game viewing. Connected to the popular O'Fallon brewery in Maryland Heights, Missouri, a suburb of St. Louis. Impressive record of being the second-highest selling microbrewery in the St. Louis area last year. Had the pleasure of trying their House Special IPA today - a delightful, well-balanced IPA with a perfect level of bitterness. Keep an eye out for Troy, an excellent bartender. Only slight drawback is the absence of desserts, hence the four-star rating.

input: This is a neighbourhood dive bar on the eastern part of Whyte Avenue.  It's in a strip mall on a one way eastbound side street.  I was there on a Saturday night to check it out. Very average decor with a couple pool tables and a foosball table. It's definitely a younger crowd here.  They had a band and a doorman.  Drinks were reasonable.  A few tv screens.  The wings are always really cheap and come with a carrot and celery stick.  They make pizzas which looked good and cheesy but I did not try. Servers were quite young and pleasant.  The owner gal behind the bar was fine.  I gave it an extra star because I found the previous review a little harsh.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This is a neighbourhood dive bar on Whyte Avenue's eastern part, situated in a strip mall on a one-way eastbound side street. During my visit on a Saturday night, I discovered that the bar has average decor with a few pool tables and a foosball table. The crowd here tends to be younger, and there was a band playing with a doorman present. The drinks were reasonably priced and they had a few TV screens. The wings are always inexpensive and served with carrot and celery sticks. Although I didn't try them, the pizzas looked delicious and cheesy. The servers were young and friendly, and the owner behind the bar was satisfactory. I personally rated it slightly higher due to finding the previous review excessively critical.

input:
Came here tired of going to buffets and other buffets like locations. This was a few minutes walk from the Peppermill too.

The place was next to a few auto repair places and most likely are patronized by them. The food is but a low-quality Chinese food. They couldn't get our orders right the 1st time around and the 2nd time ordered a simple dish that tasted completely nasty.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place, located just a few minutes' walk from the Peppermill, was a disappointing alternative to the usual buffet experience. It is situated near some auto repair shops, suggesting that it is frequented by their customers. The food here is of low quality, specifically Chinese cuisine. Unfortunately, they messed up our orders on the first try and even the second time around, the simple dish we ordered tasted incredibly unpleasant.

input: I had a small snafu with the Yelp coupon but after that? Food....and it was excellent.  The chicken caeser salad was great and heavy on the chicken.  The subs were fresh and tasty.   And, yes, they have beer!   But I had an old-fashioned Dr. Brown's cream soda because they have all their flavors.   Nicely located.   Just a mile from the Wagon Wheel flea market.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite a small issue with the Yelp coupon, the food at this place was excellent. The chicken caesar salad had plenty of chicken and was delicious, while the subs were fresh and tasty. They also offer a variety of flavors, including an old-fashioned Dr. Brown's cream soda. The location is convenient, just a mile from the Wagon Wheel flea market.

input: I had an amazingly positive experience here. Dr. Neel and Robin were friendly, knowledgable and exceptionally helpful. They were patient in answering all my questions, helped me pick out some cool Lucky Brand frames and fitted me for contact lenses. The best optometrist I've seen. I highly recommend them.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Dr. Neel and Robin at this optometry clinic provided me with an amazingly positive experience. They were incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and exceptionally helpful. Their patience in answering all of my questions was greatly appreciated. Additionally, they assisted me in selecting some stylish Lucky Brand frames and ensured a proper fit for my contact lenses. Without a doubt, they are the best optometrist I have ever encountered. I highly recommend their services.

input: By far the best breakfast I have had in a while. Huge pancakes. Simple home fries with not all the extras. The owner is super sweet and really generous. Deffinetly a new favorite.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Best breakfast in a while. Huge pancakes, simple home fries, generous owner. Definitely a new favorite.

input:
Stayed here with the family for six nights on a trip to the Big Easy. A beautiful and charming place to stay. The staff from the doorman to the wait staff for brunch were  friendly and helpful.  The Carousel Bar is a must. 

Great location, will be going back there for sure next time we are in New Orleans.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Stayed here with family for six nights on a trip to the Big Easy. Beautiful and charming place with friendly and helpful staff. The Carousel Bar is a must. Great location, will definitely return next time we are in New Orleans.

input: I ordered the chicken stew, it was Tasteless chicken, it was a fried chicken possibly a leftover, that was thrown into a pot and made it into a stew.  If I wanted leftovers, I would have eaten at home.  Gross, still feel like I have to throw up.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The chicken stew I ordered was tasteless and seemed to be made from leftover fried chicken that was simply thrown into a pot. It was not what I expected and made me feel nauseous, as if I had eaten leftovers at home.

input:
I've been having a terrible time in St Louis finding a decent Chinese place that is within delivery or easy take out range of our house. This time I tried Wei Hong. I told my partner it can't be any worse than the other mediocre places we have been going. I was wrong.
The take out service was fast for a Sat night. We were there within 20 minutes of ordering and it was ready. But the dining room was empty. For a Sat night that should have been a big clue. The rest of the places in the neighborhood were busy.
The steamed dumplings could have been great. The tasted homemade and the filling was good. However, they were so doughy with a really thick wrapper too thick that it detracted from the good filling. Everything else went downhill from there. 
The beef and broccoli was inedible. The beef had an awful weird texture. Like it was boiled and was gelatinous.  The sauce on it had off flavors. We literally scraped it off our plates and threw the whole thing out.  The meat in both the general Tao's chicken and the orange beef also had weird textures. It was mushy and the coating was thick on those as well. The flavors in the sauces would have been fine, but they were gloopy.  The fried rice was fair but nothing memorable.
We won't be going back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a terrible experience at Wei Hong in St Louis. Despite the fast takeout service, the dining room was empty on a busy Saturday night. The steamed dumplings had a good filling, but they were too doughy with a thick wrapper. The beef and broccoli were inedible due to weird textures and off-flavored sauce. The meat in the general Tao's chicken and orange beef had similar issues and the sauces were gloopy. The fried rice was average. We won't be returning to Wei Hong.

input: Big shout out to Cecile for helping us load our plywood as we got ready for IRMA. Thanks so much!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Thank you Cecile for assisting us in loading our plywood for IRMA preparations. Your help is greatly appreciated.

input: The food was outstanding.  I got chicken tagine, with the delicious tender meat falling off the bone, and carrot salad, flavored with mint and cumin.  Service was good, and the inside of the restaurant is cheerful and well-lit.  Total cost was around $13.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food, including a chicken tagine with tender meat and a flavorful carrot salad, was outstanding. The service was good and the restaurant had a cheerful and well-lit interior. The total cost for the meal was approximately $13.

input:
After reading a lot of positive reviews, we were really excited to try this place. We were extremely disappointed in the food. I'm going to give the place the benefit of the doubt that it is not always like this as we came in at 10 PM, but if you cannot offer quality food at that hour then don't have your kitchen open. 
All of our food came out within 5 to 10 minutes of ordering which leads me to believe it was not made fresh. The Caesar salad was room temperature and overdressed. The hush puppies were flavorless, and the chicken wings (3 full wings is a serving) were undercooked and barely warm. The only redeeming food item was the chicken and biscuits, which had a nice flavor profile- the biscuit was again, cold in spots. 

On the positive side the place has a nice hip atmosphere and the service is friendly. 

Unfortunately, the food was so sub par we would not consider dining here again.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite reading positive reviews, our experience at this place was extremely disappointing. We arrived at 10 PM and, although we want to give the benefit of the doubt that it is not always like this, the quality of the food was below par. All the dishes we ordered came out quickly, indicating they were likely not made fresh. The Caesar salad was overdressed and at room temperature. The hush puppies lacked flavor and the chicken wings were undercooked and barely warm. The only decent item was the chicken and biscuits, though even the biscuits had cold spots. On a positive note, the atmosphere was trendy and the service friendly. However, due to the subpar food, we would not dine here again.

input: For the time and effort I put into ordering online 30 minutes before my pickup, I was pretty disappointed to skip the long line only to be told they 'didn't have anything' in their system. Thanks for nothing.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was disappointed after ordering online 30 minutes prior to my pickup, only to find out they had nothing in their system. All the time and effort I put in was for nothing.

input: If you have not had their cream filled donuts then you simply have not lived, my friend! Incredible! I came to Philly to visit my sister and she brought us here on our second to last day. The cream filled doughnut was so incredible that I drove all the way back here on our way home to get a half dozen of them for the drive back to Michigan! And if you're wondering...yes, yes I crushed all 6 of those delicious pieces of heaven and I won't apologize for it!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: If you haven't tried their cream filled donuts, you're missing out! During my visit to Philly, my sister brought me to this place and it was amazing. The donuts were so good that I made a special trip back before heading home to Michigan and got six of them. And yes, I devoured all six of those heavenly treats without any guilt!

input:
STAY AWAY from this place unless you want to possibly be hit by a "drunk gambler "coming from there.  It's no wander this Joe Bob's is never busy.  The only thing that the owners and bartenders care about are the gamblers that get over-served and gamble there daily.   I'm definitely gonna stay away from that part of town after 4ish as that's when the "heavy hitters" come in to support the greasy, dirty, place that really only cares about their gamblers.  The kitchen has some kinda mold issues that literally smells like a sewer plant.  The 2 gals that have made a career outta this dump rely on the drunkards to tip them "big" if they win on the slots.  This is a very sad version of any kinda chicken joint or sports bar.  The greed that the owners share is obvious as flat screens are cheap these days and these guys can't even loosen their hands on the "gambling profit" to invest in to this dump.   Is sad as the original owners did a great job and these new guys don't care about anything except the profit from the slot machines, including the nasty food they serve.  The bartenders are high-strung and anything but friendly, unless of course, you are gambling big and they have a chance at a big tip.  
Your better off going to the fast food chicken joint across the stree t"El Pollo Loco" and guessing the kitchen is cleaner and the staff is friendlier and you won't be subjected to the daily drunks that drive to and from this place daily.  VERY SCARY!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Avoid this place unless you want to risk being hit by drunk gamblers. Joe Bob's is often empty because the owners and bartenders prioritize over-serving gamblers. It's best to avoid the area after 4 PM when heavy hitters arrive to support this greasy, dirty establishment that only cares about its gamblers. The kitchen has mold issues that create a sewer-like smell. The two employees rely on tips from drunkards who win on the slots. This place falls short as a chicken joint or sports bar, and the owners' greed is evident in their failure to invest in improvements. The bartenders are unfriendly unless you're gambling big and they expect a generous tip. It's better to go to the fast-food chicken joint "El Pollo Loco" across the street, where the kitchen is likely cleaner and the staff friendlier. You won't have to deal with the daily drunk drivers associated with this place. It's a very intimidating environment.

input:
1st time here. We were headed to Terakawa with the family on a cold Friday night, but they had a line out the door so we went here. Glad we did...

Excellent service & friendly staff. Waitress helped my wife take off her jacket as her hands were full with our baby, as I was tied up with the 3yr old.

I had Chicken Katsu Curry Ramen, Sister had Shrimp Katsu Ramen & Wife had Shoyu Ramen. Everything was excellent, I loved mine. Curry soup was tasty &I the fried chicken was done just right. Same for my sisters shrimp, fried just right with good quality shrimp. My wife lived her Shoyu Ramen.

We also got the pork buns which were excellent, but not your traditional porkbun. 

Great, great experience.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: First time here. Went to Terakawa with family, but they had a long line so we went here instead. Glad we did. Excellent service and friendly staff. Waitress helped my wife take off her jacket while she had our baby and I was busy with our 3-year-old. I had Chicken Katsu Curry Ramen, sister had Shrimp Katsu Ramen, and wife had Shoyu Ramen. Everything was excellent, especially mine. Curry soup was tasty and fried chicken was cooked perfectly. Sister's shrimp was also cooked well with good quality shrimp. Wife loved her Shoyu Ramen. We also tried the pork buns, which were excellent but not traditional. Overall, a great experience.

input: Where do I start? Brew D Licious has the very best coffee in town. Hands down. I have tried them all and can say that there isn't another coffee house that even comes close. The minute I met the owner, I knew she was not only very well informed about how to brew a great cup of coffee, but also knows how to make the toughest of customer a repeat patron. This coffee is so good that I buy 5#s at a time from Brigitte. It is always fresh and she has even delivered coffee to me while she is under construction of her new place. Personally, I cannot wait until she opens her new location. I never did care much for the Hollander Hotel and I often felt that she was being stifled by the cramped space she worked in. Also, the hotel has a funky smell (sort of like old socks) so I will be glad when she is at her new location and I can sit and enjoy a good cup of coffee without trying to filter out the bad smell from the hotel. I know it will be a long line at the new location but it will be worth the wait.... Thanks Brigitte for showing St. Petersburg what real coffee tastes and smells like!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Brew D Licious is the best coffee house in town. The owner, Brigitte, is knowledgeable and ensures customer satisfaction. The coffee is exceptional, so much so that I buy 5#s at a time and it's always fresh. Brigitte even delivered coffee during the construction of her new location. I can't wait for the new place to open as the current space in Hollander Hotel is cramped with a funky smell. Despite the anticipated long lines, it will be worth the wait. Brigitte has showcased what real coffee tastes and smells like in St. Petersburg.

input: Finally! Great pizza & knots at the beach!!! Excellent location with a cool street presence. These guys know what they're doing.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great pizza and knots are now available at the beach with an excellent location and a cool street presence. These guys really know what they're doing.

input: This is only a review on their oysters because that's all I ever eat from here. They have the freshest, best tasting oysters ever! I asked our server what type of oysters they were and she didn't know but said she would ask someone. She never came back with the answer but that was ok. Oysters, D-E-L-I-C-I-O-U-S! I promise you you will not be disappointed!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This is a review solely focused on the oysters at this place. They are incredibly fresh and have the most delicious taste. The server was unsure about the specific type of oysters, but that didn't affect the overall experience. These oysters are absolutely delightful and I assure you that you won't be disappointed.

input: Just tried the food. It was excellent, the best  I have had in the area. Had kung pao beef and basil shrimp with the pork fried rice all very good. Delivery was fast as well
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Food was excellent, the best in the area. I had kung pao beef and basil shrimp with pork fried rice - all very good. Delivery was fast.

input: Much more than a deli! Wife and I had the Philly and the club. Both were tasty and a good deal. As our total check for four bags of chips (2 kids) and two sandwiches were just over $20. Also, come hungry. It's yuge
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: More than just a deli! We tried the Philly and the club sandwiches, which were delicious and reasonably priced. We also bought four bags of chips for the kids. Our total bill came to just over $20. It's a large portion, so make sure to come with a hearty appetite!

input:
I don't know what some of these peoples problems are with this place (other than veiled racism) but taking a wedding dress in to be fitted 7 months out is idiotic, regardless of how secure you are in your sizing.

Anyway, I've never had a problem here whatsoever. They aren't all warm and fuzzy, but I'm paying for competence, not smiles, and competent they assuredly are. They got out decade old blood stains out of a ball hockey jersey and have an average turnaround of 2-3 days, even during the holidays and wedding season. 

I can't recommend them enough. When we move, we will most certainly still be taking our clothes in here for dry cleaning and alterations.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite some people's issues with this place (potentially influenced by veiled racism), I find it ridiculous to bring a wedding dress for fitting seven months in advance, regardless of one's confidence in sizing. However, personally, I have never had any problems here. While they may not be the friendliest, I value competence over friendliness, which they definitely possess. They successfully removed decade-old blood stains from a ball hockey jersey and consistently provide quick turnaround times of 2-3 days, even during busy periods like holidays and wedding season. I highly recommend their services and intend to continue utilizing them for dry cleaning and alterations, even after we relocate.

input: Bigger than the Rittenhouse location & there's actually street parking! Server was super friendly and happy to tell me her favorites. Got a taste of the Groothie and I'm glad I did because it was too sweet for me. The Udon Noodle Salad was great.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Larger than Rittenhouse, with street parking available. Friendly server recommended her favorite dishes. Tried the Groothie, but found it too sweet. Udon Noodle Salad was enjoyable.

input: Came for the first time today with family and Bailey was excellent, she was friendly and attentive and THE FOOD was incredible. We had the hummus plate (which was very generous portion), the pretzels, mozzarella sticks and caprese salad. Everything was fresh and I was impressed with the food as I had never been here before. We will be back!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: First time visiting with family. Bailey provided excellent service - friendly and attentive. Food was incredible, including generous portions of hummus plate, pretzels, mozzarella sticks, and caprese salad. Impressed by the freshness as a first-time visitor. Will definitely return.

input:
I think I would've given this place a 4/5 star rating if not for the lackluster service and attitude. The entrees were good, the prices were spot on, and the breadsticks were delicious.

Ahh, the breadsticks. This is where the attitude part kicks in. These things are advertised as "as much as you want for free." However, my buddy heads up to the front counter to request enough for our table of three only to be given a hard time from the manager that we're eating more breadsticks than what we ordered. Give me a break. Don't advertise what you don't want to deliver.

Even ordering was a chore. It seemed as if they had a new hire manning the register during the lunch hour rush. She was placing orders as to-go for people looking to dine-in and had to have the manager place orders for her. Not a good idea for a Friday lunch rush.

If this Fazoli's location can improve upon these things minor inconveniences, it'd be a great place to grab a quick bite.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I would've given this place a 4/5 star rating if not for the lackluster service and attitude. The entrees and prices were good, and the breadsticks were delicious. However, the advertised "as much as you want for free" breadsticks turned into an issue when we were given a hard time by the manager for requesting enough for our table. Additionally, ordering was difficult as they had a new employee manning the register during the lunch rush, causing delays. If these issues are addressed, it could be a great place for a quick bite.

input:
was on an errand-running run and remembered how ashamed i was at the state of my car the last time i looked at it - five minutes earlier, as i entered said vehicle.

saw the sign as i was about to turn into riverside plaza to make my groceries and decided it was time.  got the basic $12 tchoup and even though there were about 5 cars in the vacuum line ahead of me, my car was ready before i was done checking out the waiting area.  iguanas, parrots, ms. pac man ($1 a game?  the price of nostalgia, i guess).  not to mention the windows that look out into the auto wash system - which is really entertainment enough for me.  i'm not picky.

but then my number was up and i went out and inspected the results.  still some bird poop remnants on the hood and a few bugs didn't give up the ghost on the grill...maybe i am picky after all.  

don't get me wrong - it was better than nothing (which was what my car got in terms of washings since mid-january), but i'm missing my favorite car wash right about now.  their regular automatic wash with vacuum and window cleaning (i.e. the tchoup treatment) is $14, true, but those dudes are much more thorough with the elbow grease post-assembly line washing.

but that place is in los angeles, alas.  which is perhaps the best gauge of how pricey this place is: 85% as expensive as l.a., but 66.67% the quality.  worth it?  you do the math.  i'ma try a completely touchless system next time.  i reckon i'll get about the same results, but with no parrots or ms. pac-man.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was on an errand-running run and noticed how dirty my car had become since I last checked, just five minutes earlier. As I was about to turn into riverside plaza to get groceries, I saw a sign for a car wash and decided it was time. I opted for the basic $12 wash, even though there were a few cars ahead of me in the vacuum line. Surprisingly, my car was ready before I finished checking out the waiting area, which had iguanas, parrots, and a Ms. Pac-Man game. The windows offered a view of the auto wash system, which was entertaining enough for me. However, upon inspection, I noticed some bird poop and lingering bugs on the hood and grill. It was certainly better than no wash since January, but I still longed for my favorite car wash. They offer a more thorough clean for $14, including vacuuming and window cleaning. Unfortunately, that car wash is in Los Angeles, so I had to settle for this one, which is 85% as expensive and 66.67% as good. I contemplated trying a touchless system next time, expecting similar results but without the parrots or Ms. Pac-Man.

input: Update. The large, live turtle tank has been replaced with a colorful fish aquarium. I don't know what happened to the turtle. Still recommended. Highly.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Update: The turtle tank has been replaced with a vibrant fish aquarium, although the whereabouts of the turtle remain unknown. Nonetheless, the recommendation for this colorful upgrade remains highly intact.

input:
Most of the time I go through the drive thru here.  While sometimes the line is a bit long I have to say these guys move in record time.  The line moves fast and my coffee is waiting for me when I get to the window.  How much more can you ask for? 

Inside there is a decent amount of seating and there is quite a bit of outdoor seating too.  Overall this is a great Starbucks.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This Starbucks has efficient drive-thru service, with quick-moving lines and prompt coffee delivery. It also offers ample indoor and outdoor seating, making it a great option overall.

input: I have straight hair and it turns out best if it's done with scissors . I said I want my hair to be cut with scissors down the side and blended and and she said no clippers and I said now I can go somewhere else and get a scissor cut it's fine no I do a good job was the response I got I can do it with scissors and what are you now she grabbed the clippers and cut 90% of my hair with clippers I get one and ethene clipper cut I told her specifically I get not want my hair cut with clippers I would go somewhere else if I were you to get your haircut unless you want it high and tight whether fade with clippers
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I prefer my straight hair to be cut with scissors as it yields the best results. I requested a scissor cut with blending, but the stylist refused to use clippers. I mentioned that I could go elsewhere for a scissor cut, but she responded by saying she does a good job. I explicitly stated that I did not want clippers used and advised others to find an alternative salon unless they wanted a high and tight fade with clippers.

input: Excellent food, ambiance and location! I ate there for lunch during this trip to NOLA with my friend. I had the artichoke and crab salad - it was SO good! My mouth waters thinking of it now. My friend ate the grilled and roasted vegetable platter and everyhing was excellent! I highly recommend!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great food, ambiance, and location! Ate there for lunch in NOLA with a friend. Had the amazing artichoke and crab salad. Friend had the grilled and roasted vegetable platter, also excellent. Highly recommend!

input: Great lunch recommended by someone at Nashville airport.  Funky eclectic atmosphere. Great and healthy food choices. Sweet potato casserole with coconut and dried cranberry was fantastic.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Recommended lunch at Nashville airport with funky eclectic atmosphere, offers great and healthy food choices. Don't miss the fantastic sweet potato casserole with coconut and dried cranberry.

input: Whenever we make the trip over from Orlando.. We usually end up here.  I am a big fan of smaller intimate venues and this one does the trick.  Staff is great and the service is on point.  If you get a table.. request #4.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Whenever we visit from Orlando, we always choose this intimate venue. The staff is great, the service is excellent, and if you can, request table #4.

input: Great food, great atmosphere, great service. I've been here twice, and neither was a disappointment. The food is always fantastic (if a bit on the pricey side) - maybe it's because I'm a sucker for Nutella, but the Belgian Waffle topped with Nutella is Heaven for your mouth.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The restaurant offers great food and atmosphere with excellent service. I have visited twice and both times were highly satisfying. The food is always fantastic, albeit slightly expensive. I highly recommend trying their Belgian Waffle topped with Nutella, as it is absolutely heavenly.

input:
This is a great late brunch option during the weekends when the big morning rush dies down after 1 pm. Usually there is no wait or 5 minute wait at this time. One big complaint is that they don't have an organized system for seating guests. The servers don't always greet incoming patrons (which should be required Waffle House-style) and they sometimes tell you to seat yourself (which can lead to one or two people taking up tables for 4) or they'll seat you (whenever they get around to talking to you). 

I've ordered a several different dishes at this point and they have varies from ok to awesome. The chicken wings and onion rings are just ok. The wings are either lightly dredged in flour or not at and then fried whole. They aren't really seasoned so the wings are pretty bland. The "onion rings" made of formed, chopped onions that are breaded. The chicken fingers were a bit over battered and dry. The smashwich (or whatever it's called) was pretty good: your choice of breakfast meat with hash browns and eggs in a hoagie roll, but unspectacular. The club sandwich is classic diner fare that is very well executed. The egg and omelette platters are a very good deal and dang tasty. The best thing on the menu is definitely the waffle. It's gently sweet, very crispy and covered in butter. So good!

The service is generally pretty attentive (once you're seated), the restaurant and bathrooms are very clean, the food is a good, tasty value
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This late brunch option is great for weekends after 1 pm when the morning rush subsides. There is usually little to no wait at this time. However, the lack of an organized seating system is a common complaint. Some servers don't greet guests promptly and may ask them to seat themselves, resulting in potential table hogging. The quality of dishes varies from okay to awesome. The chicken wings and onion rings are just okay, lacking seasoning. The chicken fingers are over-battered and dry. The smashwich is decent but not extraordinary. The club sandwich is well executed and the egg and omelette platters are tasty and affordable. The standout item is the waffle, which is sweet, crispy, and buttery. Service is generally attentive once seated, the restaurant and bathrooms are clean, and the food offers good value.

input:
I would give them 5 but I was disappointed by their reuben.  
For some reason, I have to order reuben if it is a new place and the place has a reuben on their menu. 
but the reuben's rye bread was disappointing considering that companion is all about the bread.  

However, my fiancee's sandwich(forgot the name) with chicken, bacon, avocado on french bread was amazing!

had their spice chicken soup with their corn bread.  It was great! the soup had tons of vegetables and chicken, just the right amount of heat and the corn bread is pretty big and delicious.  

their chi latte was not impressive.. do not get it. lol 

little pricey but, it's a great place to have a wonderful breakfast/lunch and the workers are nice and friendly. 

check this place out, let me know what you guys think.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The reuben at this place was disappointing but they have a delicious sandwich with chicken, bacon, and avocado on French bread. Their spice chicken soup with cornbread is great too. However, their chi latte was not impressive. The prices are a bit high but overall, it's a great place for breakfast or lunch with friendly staff. Check it out and let me know your thoughts.

input:
Probably the best thing about Target is that it isn't Wal Mart.

Target is awesome because it has everything from clothes to toys to electronics to makeup. 

I usually stop in here (if I remember) to pick up my makeup, because it's at least $2-3 cheaper than other stores.  They have a great grocery section and their selection of household items (microwaves, etc.) is fantastic.

They are always good about having enough registers open for the number of shoppers in the place, and I rarely have to wait in a line.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Target offers a wide range of products including clothing, toys, electronics, and makeup. It is known for having affordable prices, particularly for makeup. Additionally, Target has a great grocery section and an impressive selection of household items. The store is efficient in managing registers, ensuring minimal wait times for shoppers.

input:
I would give it 5 stars but I when I look at my rating dispersion I realize I might be a little generous.  While all I had here was Oysters they were spectacular.

Ask for Kentrelle at the Oyster Bar and have him make you the "firecracker."  It will blow you doors off.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I would give it 5 stars but I might be a little generous considering my rating dispersion. However, the oysters at this place were spectacular. Ask for Kentrelle at the Oyster Bar and try the "firecracker" he makes - it will blow your doors off.

input:
This is the biggest and best location for HMV in the city. The prices aren't any different from other stores but they do have a larger selection of gifting (figurines,mugs,blankets etc) as well as the largest collection of titles that don't fit into what is new and hot at the moment. Anything that they don't carry can actually be ordered in for you but I have to say staff here are not always the best at phoning customers to let them know when their titles are in so one should definitely keep their number by the phone to check in with them after a week or so.

The biggest selling point for me here besides the selection has to be the staff at the tills. It can get a little busy here but lines are always dealt with quickly and I appreciate that they don't push as hard as other locations to try and sign you up for a pure card. F.Y.I to anybody considering the pure rewards program the redemption items are not that great. It took me about a year of collecting just to accumulate enough points for a true blood key chain and when I got it it was placed in a bubble mailer and not even in it's original packaging. Needless to say when it came time to renew the card I opted out.

Anyways to sum it all up I will say for selection and speedy service these guys get five stars but the prices as well as the sometimes slow ordering process drop it down to a 3. Still worth checking out though if you have been on the hunt at smaller stores for a particular movie or cd.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This HMV location is the biggest and best in the city, offering a large selection of gifting items and a wide range of titles. They can also order any items they don't carry. However, the staff may not always notify customers when their orders are in. The staff at the tills are efficient and there is not as much push to sign up for a pure card compared to other locations. The redemption items for the pure rewards program are not impressive and it takes a long time to accumulate enough points. Overall, the selection and speedy service make it worth checking out, despite higher prices and a slow ordering process.

input: Wow is all I have to say. Must try the friend oysters!we ordered that and crawfish bisque and shrimp with grits. All the dishes were delicious. Make sure to make reservation.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Wow, must try the fried oysters! We also ordered crawfish bisque and shrimp with grits, and all the dishes were delicious. Don't forget to make a reservation!

input: Was on a mission trying to find the perfect coat for the Holidays. Found my idea of the perfect coat at Burlington but they did not have my size. Went to Target, bought a coat but ended up taking it bath. Was not my dream coat. Next stop Ross. The only coat in my size was a beautiful Bomber style jacket made of pleather. Bought it right before Christmas. Now it's a few days after Christmas and my husband Guy points out to me that the coat is really wrinkled. I go on line and look up every possible hack to get wrinkles out of pleather. They all fail miserably. I just went back to Ross with that coat, no receipt, no tags and asked to speak to the manager. The manager is a young male with dark hair and black framed glasses. I tell him of my plight. He literally says go find what you need, no problem. WOW! You won't believe it, but there was my Camouflage coat, in my size, hanging there waiting for me. Oh the irony! They exchanged my coat and after all that I ended up with my Dream coat after all. Thank you Ross Dress for Less. You will forever be my first choice for now on!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was on a mission to find the perfect coat for the Holidays. Found it at Burlington but they didn't have my size. Bought a coat at Target but didn't like it. Went to Ross and found a beautiful Bomber style jacket made of pleather in my size. Husband noticed it was wrinkled after Christmas. Tried online hacks but failed. Went back to Ross, spoke to the manager. He told me to find what I needed. Found my Camouflage coat in my size, exchanged it. Finally got my Dream coat. Thank you Ross Dress for Less, my first choice from now on!

input: You honestly can't go wrong here. My favorites are the Udon Noodle Salad (a-ma-zing) and the Crispy Hipcity Ranch (so, so good). Friendly staff, fast service. Oh, they deliver too!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: You can't go wrong here. Favorites include the amazing Udon Noodle Salad and the so good Crispy Hipcity Ranch. Friendly staff and fast service. They also offer delivery.

input: Philadelphia, I love you.  Places like this remind me why.  We sat at the counter and watched the guys make the pizzas.  Our son hates cheese on a pizza and they had one already on the menu for him: The Marinara (oregano, crushed san marzano tomatoes, garlic, olive oil).  It was simple... but delicious. If you like real wood-fired pizzas that char the crust (a little blackened... in a good way), this is the place to go to.  Our other favorite pizza joints that rival this place are Lombardi's (NYC) and Grimaldi's (Brooklyn).  We all had a slice and were shocked at the lovely simplicity of it. Razor thin slices of garlic dotted the fresh tomato sauce.  My husband and I shared the Salsiccia (fennel sausage, roasted fennel, tomato sauce, mozzarella).  Roasted fennel on a pizza?  Brilliant. I cried a little.  No wait... I REALLY cried when we shared this cocktail: The Brooklyn (Dad's Hat rye, Luxardo cherry, white vermouth).  It says it serves one, but they brought it out in a cute little bottle and gave us each a glass...each with a hand- crafted giant square ice cube (hipster-cool) and Luxardo cherries.  Perfection.  We also shared a Rotolo (pizza dough, mortadella, ricotta, pistacchio pesto).  Those are crazy amazing.  I kept saying my husband could eat the rest... then freaking out and going back for another bite. He's lucky I didn't stab him in the hand with a fork to fight over the last bite (to be fair, he was the smart one who ordered it).  I could've eaten several of those and forgotten the pizza (although that was wonderful too!).  We finished with a little dessert... perfect little Italian cookies ("Cookie Jar" - pignoli, almond cookies, chocolate biscotti, pistacchio gnocchi) and I got an Affogato (fiordilatte soft serve with a shot of espresso).  The soft serve is Italian sweet cream... decadent and lovely... with rich espresso in a pretty little Italian mug.  I'm in Heaven here.  I know nothing about Vetri's other restaurants, but I'm checking them out next time I'm in Philadelphia!  By the way... service was great and friendly.  5 stars all around!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love Philadelphia. Watching the pizza making process at the counter was a great experience. They had a cheeseless pizza on the menu called The Marinara, which was simple yet delicious. If you enjoy wood-fired pizzas with a slightly charred crust, this place is a must-visit. Lombardi's and Grimaldi's are also great pizza joints. The Salsiccia pizza with fennel sausage and roasted fennel was amazing. The cocktail called The Brooklyn, served in a cute bottle with a handcrafted giant ice cube and Luxardo cherries, made me cry. The Rotolo with mortadella, ricotta, and pistachio pesto was crazy good. The dessert options included Italian cookies and an Affogato with fiordilatte soft serve and espresso. The service was excellent and friendly. I can't wait to try Vetri's other restaurants in Philadelphia. Overall, a 5-star experience.

input:
This a really price store with great clothes. Mostly high end stuff, everything here is designer. 

The workers here are really friendly and not pushy. They will leave you alone if you just want to be left alone, they are never breathing down your neck trying to make a sale. They carry casual clothing but I think it's much better place for suits and dress shirts and fancy clothing. I think this place stands out in West Edmonton Mall in terms of service and dressy clothing for men. They really do everything to make your shopping experience better. 

Be prepared to spend some coin here, although you won't be disappointed.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This store offers high-end designer clothes with a great selection, particularly for suits, dress shirts, and fancy clothing. The workers are friendly and non-pushy, giving customers space if desired. It stands out in West Edmonton Mall for its exceptional service and dressy clothing for men. Although it may be pricey, the quality and shopping experience make it worth it.

input:
The food was pretty tasty. Nothing outstanding though. It reminds me of any Mediterranean food truck that I've been to. It's a nice late night spot. Definitely hits the spot at the end of the night. To me, the amount of food you get for the price could be improved but I would not say that I feel ripped off. The amount of food you get is fair but I think it'd be easier to justify if you got a little more. 

There's plenty of seating. Despite being near a whole bunch of bar/club scenes, once you're inside it's easy to take a break and have a nice conversation. It is all very clean and well kept. The servers are quick and friendly. When I went there were only two guys working but they weren't busy so it didn't take too long. The entire restaurant is very dimly lit and the atmosphere is a bit of a hodgepodge of things. On one wall there is a mural of outer space and the music that plays seems to have no rhyme or reason to it. 

It's a bit of a strange place but I would definitely go back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food is tasty, reminding me of a typical Mediterranean food truck. It's a good late-night option, hitting the spot. The portion size for the price could be improved, but it's fair. There is ample seating, providing a break from the nearby bar/club scenes. The place is clean and well-maintained, with quick and friendly service. The atmosphere is dimly lit and eclectic, with a space-themed mural and random music. Despite its strangeness, I would definitely revisit.

input:

Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This shop is awesome! The staff are really nice and always give helpful suggestions on productive areas to fish. The bait is always top-notch and they have a great supply of tackle at the best prices I've seen. I used to buy my tackle at Walmart and Dick's, but after realizing my mistake and discovering this shop, I exclusively buy from here. input:
