input: If you are shopping for any kind of Italian food product, you need not bother going anywhere but Claudio's.  First, you must understand the culture--Claudio's is old school.  They are family.  There is a reason everyone lines up and tolerates standing in line.  The product is THAT good.  These folks know their cheeses.  They know their food.  If you have a question, they will bend over to help you.  Other customers will too!  I'm "medigan" as they say, American....ie  I am not Italian.  Hanging in Claudio's makes me want to be!!  Going to Claudio's isn't like running to the Acme for a box of pasta----this is an EXPERIENCE.  Everyone should have an experience!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: For the best Italian food products, go to Claudio's. It's an old school, family-owned place known for its exceptional quality. People line up because the products are that good. The staff is knowledgeable and helpful, and even other customers are friendly. Hanging out at Claudio's makes you want to be a part of the Italian culture. Going there is not just a quick trip for groceries, it's an experience everyone should have.

input:
This hotel was so terrible and I can narrow it down to 4 things:

1. The price: Expect to pay a lot of money from the second you arrive. They charge $35 per person for a round trip shuttle ride to the airport. Our room was roughly $275 a night. It's an incredibly large hotel that offers a nail salon, a Godiva Chocolate store, about 9 restaurants and a few bars. But you'll pay dearly for any of those things - like $2.50 for a small bottle of soda. The hotel is designed to keep you in there and they charge you $15 for a round trip shuttle ride to the downtown Nashville area. 

2. The service: We called the front desk and were on hold for 20 minutes. We went to the front desk and waited in line for an hour. We waited around to ask the concierge questions. And each time we got, "I don't know" as the usual response. The cleaning staff was extraordinarily loud and they actually shouted as they went down the hall at 6:30 a.m.

3. The name: They call this place a resort but that is, by far, a misnomer. This place is a convention hotel, period. It's horrifically loud at all hours of the day because they host about 3 conventions at one time. Our windows faced one of the courtyards and there is music pumping there 24 hours a day. The walls are thin and you can hear *everything* happening in the neighboring rooms. (eww!) If you want to relax at a resort, don't stay here because with all those convention people, loud cleaning staff, 24 hour music and thin walls you will only end up with more stress.

4. The size: It's no joke that you will get lost in this hotel. It's inexplicably large. And when it hits noon, you should already be in one of the few restaurants because they fill up FAST. With several conventions happening at one time, getting a "quick bite" is not possible here. And there's not really any place close by, either. You can walk over to the mall for some fast food but plan enough time for your walk - getting out of the hotel takes at least 5 minutes.

I'm sure glad I was there for a convention and didn't pay out of my own pocket for this ridiculous hotel.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
This hotel had several major issues:

1. Price: The hotel charges exorbitant prices for amenities and services, such as $35 per person for a round trip airport shuttle and $2.50 for a small bottle of soda. They also charge $15 for a round trip shuttle ride to downtown Nashville. 
2. Service: The front desk was unresponsive, with long wait times on the phone and in person. The concierge staff was unhelpful, often responding with "I don't know." The cleaning staff was loud, shouting early in the morning. 
3. Misleading Name: Despite being called a resort, this hotel is actually a convention hotel. It hosts multiple conventions at once, leading to constant noise and music. The thin walls make it easy to hear everything happening in neighboring rooms. 
4. Size: The hotel is extremely large, making it easy to get lost. The few restaurants fill up quickly, especially during peak hours when several conventions are happening. The hotel is not conveniently located near other dining options. 

Thankfully, the reviewer did not have to pay for the hotel themselves, as it was for a convention.

input:
I waited a long time to finally try this place and I have to say I was let down a bit. I tried the mandatory Dan Dan noodles. They were very flavorful and not too spicy. Nothing mind blowing here just a really good lo mein or spicy pasta dish with virtually no protein more or less. Also had the scallion pancakes. I was just in Chinatown recently at a place I also reviewed (first person from Yelp to do so) and they were way better there. ( I highly recommend you try that place) These were more like quesadillas laying flat where as the other ones jumped off the plate and were so much more crispy and substantial. The last appetizer I had was the Wontons in Chilli oil. These were just not good to me at all and one bite was all I needed. Basically it is steamed Wontons in a bowl with the soup being the chilli oil. Just heavy heavy choking heat with very little substance or taste. Take those same homemade wontons and pan fry them with some chilli peppers and a nice light sauce and you have could a real winner but I digress. Finally we tried the Talapia Medallions . These were fried to perfection but there were some greens mixed in that I could not chew through and had to discard via the old napkin trick which to me is a bit of a deal/star breaker.

The service was very good and the atmosphere very nice but I wouldn't go out of my way to eat here again. All I could think about was how much more I prefer Cantonese style where its all about flavors and you can add heat as you like it. I'm sure I could find better authentic Szechuan cuisine that better suits my taste just not here. It feels very commercialized and Americanized. I prefer the hole in the wall places where I am the only caucasian in the place a heck of a lot more.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was disappointed after waiting a long time to try this place. The Dan Dan noodles were flavorful but lacked protein. The scallion pancakes were not as crispy and substantial as ones I had at another Chinatown restaurant. The Wontons in Chilli oil were too spicy and had little substance or taste. The Talapia Medallions were fried perfectly but had greens that were difficult to chew. The service and atmosphere were good, but I wouldn't go out of my way to eat here again. I prefer authentic Cantonese style and more hole-in-the-wall places where I am the only Caucasian.

input:

input:

I recently bought an external hard drive dock that works with both laptops and desktops, with support for both SATA and IDE, for just $60. It's been working perfectly. Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love the Clue game-themed appearance of this hotel. The bell boys and valet drivers are respectful, and the bartenders promptly deliver drinks to our rooms. The phone etiquette is excellent with friendly customer service. My girlfriend and I plan to revisit this hotel next year due to the fantastic service. The location is great, although the downtown streets in Boise can be a bit busy. Compared to California, the service here is phenomenal. Thank you to the staff. However, be mindful of your spending as the expenses can add up. It might be worthwhile to explore cheaper food options by walking around. One downside is the lack of air vents in the bathrooms, especially in our room.

input:
This review is based on the location in Atlantic city.

Got the strawberry flavor and O.M.G!!! I was not expecting it to be that good. It is not as sweet as others but it's perfect. It had little bits of strawberry in it. The price is really good also $2 for a small I believe. My only regret is not trying all the other flavors. Next time I'm in Philly/AC I will def be getting this!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Review of Atlantic City location: Tried the strawberry flavor and it was surprisingly amazing. Not overly sweet and had small bits of strawberry. The price is also great at $2 for a small size. Only regret is not sampling other flavors. Will definitely get it again next time in Philadelphia/Atlantic City.

input: I went there for lunch yesterday. It was really good! The staff was very friendly and the portions are almost enough for two people to eat. The recipes are from Mrs. Doll and one of her son's is carrying on the legacy.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Yesterday, I had a delightful lunch at a place with friendly staff. The portions were generous, almost suitable for two people. The recipes, created by Mrs. Doll, have been passed down to one of her sons who continues the legacy.

input:
I have only ever gotten take-out at the Bridgeport Rib House, so I can only comment on that.  After numerous visits, the short story is that the food is pretty good, the prices are fair, and picking up one's order in the bar is poor.

Barbecue on par with this can be had elsewhere in the area, without the weak service experience.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The take-out food at Bridgeport Rib House is pretty good and reasonably priced, but the service for picking up orders in the bar is poor. There are other places in the area that offer equally good barbecue without the same service issues.

input: Please, this place makes a semi-new menu and raised their prices. The food is very mediocre. i just started cooking and i make a couple pasta dishes which include spaghetti and lemon chicken piccatta.  As a beginner in cooking I can judge this place's food is horrible. A day after the food looked like it had been out for weeks. Good food can last for a day or two.When i went in there to eat the hostess was nice. first, we ordered a glass a wine. he poured the wine, missed the glass and some spilled on the table and he just ignored it. hello. idiot. waitressing 101. go back. well needless to say. not worth your money at all. ive been there during happy hour with girlfriends and its fine. not a 'high end' restaurant by any means even though they try to make it that way.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place has a semi-new menu and raised their prices, but the food is very mediocre. As a beginner in cooking, I can say their food is horrible. A day after being served, it looks like it has been out for weeks. Good food should last for a day or two. The hostess was nice when I went in, but the waiter spilled wine on the table and ignored it. It's not worth your money at all. It's fine for happy hour with girlfriends, but it's not a high-end restaurant despite their attempts.

input: I had acquired a watch when my Grandfather passed and dropped in to get the battery replaced. They noticed one of the pins was missing and went ahead and fixed it on site for free. The wait was a bit for a battery change, but I can't complain because they were extremely nice and didn't charge me for the battery all while fixing the pin. I would definitely look there if I was in the market for some bling.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I received a watch from my Grandfather after he passed away. While getting the battery replaced, they discovered a missing pin and fixed it at no cost. Despite a slight wait, I'm grateful for their kindness and free service. I would consider returning for future purchases.

input: Everything great about a jewish deli, southern comfort joint and a bit of mexican dive restaurant all mixed together. Brisket is good, but don't expect a tomato based sauce. Latke is not a normal round one, but super delicious. I also took the Jewish Apple Cake to go and despite being a little too brown on the bottom, it was delicious even 3 hours later on my flight back to LA.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The blend of a Jewish deli, southern comfort joint, and Mexican dive restaurant combines the best aspects of each. The brisket is exceptional, though the sauce is not tomato-based. The latke, while not traditionally shaped, is incredibly tasty. I even took the Jewish Apple Cake home, and despite being slightly overcooked on the bottom, it remained delicious even after a 3-hour flight back to LA.

input: The food is probably one of the more mediocre Chinese food I've had, but the main appeal of this place is renting a karaoke room for a large group of people and BYOing. The restaurant is exceptionally capable of dealing with huge and rowdy groups, and the food comes out to be a decent price and comes out quickly. The karaoke machines all have pretty up to date songs in a variety of languages.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food is mediocre, but the main appeal is renting a karaoke room for large groups where you can bring your own food. The restaurant excels in handling big and lively parties, offering reasonably priced food that is served quickly. The karaoke machines have a wide selection of up-to-date songs in various languages.

input:
This update (and upgrade) to my review of Khyber is long overdue!

I think the most ringing summary is that I have since moved ~1 mile further away from the Khyber, and I still go there just as often.  I have now sampled most of the menu, but the truly excellent Southern barbecue is what usually calls to me.  You can't go wrong whether you pick the brisket, the ribs, the chicken, the pulled pork or a combo of the above.  Their mac and cheese remains my favorite side, and the addition of the very good coleslaw rounds out the experience.

I love the vibe of Kyber.  It usually pretty full, but they usually seem to have a table available for me (Yay!).  It is often loud, but never quite so loud that I wish it were quieter.  The staff is very knowledgeable, and happy to provide beer recommendations and taste tests of drafts.  They Khyber also manages to hit that sweet spot where I never end up being the most or least intoxicated person there!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
This update to my Khyber review is long overdue! Despite moving further away, I still go there often. The menu offers a variety of options, but the Southern barbecue, including brisket, ribs, chicken, and pulled pork, is consistently excellent. The mac and cheese remains my favorite side dish, and the coleslaw is a great addition.

The vibe at Khyber is enjoyable. It is usually busy, but I have never had trouble finding a table. The noise level is manageable, and the staff is knowledgeable and helpful with beer recommendations. Khyber strikes the perfect balance, ensuring that no one is overly intoxicated.

input: Great  breads especially the German rye. My favorite breakfast is the poached eggs, cooked perfectly. For lunch, I go for the eggplant panini or  Laurie's salad.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love the great breads, especially the German rye. My favorite breakfast is perfectly cooked poached eggs. For lunch, I usually choose between the eggplant panini or Laurie's salad.

input: Tony's really has surprisingly good Mexican food, which you wouldn't expect to find out here in Chalmette.  It's actually the best Mexican food I've had in Louisiana.  Everything I've tried there is good.  My favorite so far is the chiles rellenos, which are large and excellent.  They also have Mexican Coca-Cola, which is sweetened with actual sugar, rather than the high-fructose corn syrup in the American version.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Tony's in Chalmette offers unexpectedly excellent Mexican food, surpassing any I've had in Louisiana. Every dish I've tasted there has been enjoyable, particularly the remarkable chiles rellenos. Additionally, they serve Mexican Coca-Cola, sweetened with real sugar rather than high-fructose corn syrup found in the American version.

input: Awful business model it took forever to even figure out where to order. on top of that the workers actually are not professional at all. on top of THAT my other half sandwhich didn't even have sausage covering even half of the bread. easily worst place i've been in a while
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Terrible business model; difficult to locate ordering area and unprofessional workers. Additionally, my half sandwich was poorly made with insufficient sausage coverage. Overall, one of the worst places I've visited recently.

input: The staff are friendly and attentive.  They offer a wide variety of quality dancewear products at a decent price, but don't have many options for any one kind of product, at least not for men's dancewear.  The location's convenient if you live in the city, and I always stop by here first if I need something new, but three out of four times I don't find what I'm looking for.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The staff is friendly and attentive. They offer a wide variety of quality dancewear products at a decent price. However, their selection, especially for men's dancewear, is limited. The location is convenient for city dwellers. Although I always visit this store first when I need something new, I usually don't find what I'm looking for three out of four times.

input: I went here off of a referral. It was great I was done in five hours. I had individuals done, medium size and they cost 150 the hair included. There were three women that are on your head at one time. I will go there again! There very nice as well.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was referred to this place and it was great. I was finished in five hours with individuals done, medium size, which cost $150 including the hair. Three women worked on my head simultaneously. I'll definitely go there again as they were very nice.

input: Love the lamb gyros plate. It's a distance for me to drive, so sometimes I get an extra order to take back home.  The tiramisu is very good too. The dolmas are good but more vinegary than I prefer.  The Greek salad that comes with the entree' is good also.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love the lamb gyros plate. Sometimes I get an extra order to take back home because it's a bit of a drive. The tiramisu is also delicious. The dolmas are good but a bit more vinegary than I prefer. The Greek salad that comes with the entree is tasty too.

input: Love the yum yum club and macaroni salad is awesome too!! Sometimes service could be a little more friendly but besides that I continue to go back because price is right and good tastes great
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I enjoy the yum yum club and their macaroni salad is delicious. The service could be friendlier, but the affordable prices and delicious food keep me coming back.

input:
This is my husbands and my first time here in Reno. Wow what a great hotel to stay in for your first time. We had a great room with a spa and the shower had a steam room feature. The hotel also offered many places to eat and relax. The casino was very clean and a joy to be in even if you don't gamble like myself. However I did win 41.00 with a 1.00 slot machine :)  we decided to venture out finally to see Reno. However, we weren't impressed with anything else but our great hotel.  Easy checkout right from the room was a time saver. Well now off to explore Reno some more.
If your considering a hotel that is nice, clean, up to date this is the one.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My husband and I had a fantastic first time in Reno at this great hotel. Our room was amazing, with a spa and a steam room feature in the shower. The hotel had plenty of dining options and relaxation areas. Even for non-gamblers like myself, the casino was enjoyable and impeccably clean. I even won $41 on a $1 slot machine! We weren't particularly impressed with the rest of Reno, but our hotel made up for it. The easy checkout from the room saved us time. If you're looking for a nice, clean, and modern hotel, this is the one to consider.

input: Studying previous  yelp reviews, we decided to take the kids to hibachi and sushi.  This place did not disappoint. The sushi was amazing and the hibachi was awesome. The dessert of fried bananas and ice cream ended a great experience. The service was great and attentive.  Will definitely return for more!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: After researching Yelp reviews, we chose a hibachi and sushi restaurant for our family outing. Our experience was fantastic – the sushi was amazing, the hibachi was awesome, and the fried bananas with ice cream for dessert topped it all off. The service was excellent and attentive. We will definitely be returning for more!

input: I Love it here. The pizza is fantastic,  and the staff is very friendly. It's a great place to hang out with friends and family.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I adore this place for its amazing pizza, friendly staff, and being the perfect spot for quality time with friends and family.

input: Went here the other day with some friends for a bite and a drink. Service was great as where the drinks ;) Will definitely be back!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Had a great time here with friends, enjoying delicious food and drinks. The service was excellent as well. Will definitely return!

input: This place was on my list for all of the great reviews. The lamb was very flavorful, but the garlic Naan is just frozen from Trader Joe's. Also, the lamb was fairly expensive for the amount you get. Lastly, despite saying they take American Express at the door, the owner would not accept Amex. I will likely not return.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place had great reviews but I was disappointed. The lamb was flavorful, but the garlic Naan was frozen from Trader Joe's. The portion of lamb was small for the price. Additionally, despite claiming to accept American Express, the owner refused to take it. I don't plan on going back.

input:
This little unassuming shop is tucked away in a strip mall full of furniture stores. Had it not been for Yelp, I would never have known it was here. Now, I won't be taking a trip to Brentwood without stopping for a scoop!

The flavors are quite varied and innovative. I had pumpkin and some sort of whipped cream cheese flavor--both were divine--which when mixed tasted just like pumpkin pie! The owner, Michael, is absolutely a sweetheart and is generous with the samples and the recommendations, and he's always coming up with new flavors to whip up. I can't wait to see what he concocts next!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This hidden gem of a shop is located in a furniture-filled strip mall. Thanks to Yelp, I discovered this place and now it's a must-stop when I visit Brentwood. They offer a wide range of unique flavors that are truly delightful. On my visit, I tried the pumpkin and whipped cream cheese flavors, which combined, tasted like a heavenly pumpkin pie. The owner, Michael, is incredibly kind and generous with samples and recommendations. He constantly creates new flavors that I am excited to try.

input: Great food and good coffee. Wish they had more of an espresso bar with coffee options, but food and baked goods are spectacular!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Food and baked goods are spectacular, although I wish they offered more coffee options and an espresso bar.

input:
holly grove is the best. I'm consistently impressed with their selection of produce. you can basically get everything (plus more stuff they don't have at the normal grocery store) except it's all local. we are so lucky to live in a place with a year round growing season, and we should really take advantage of that! (I will get off my high horse now lol). 

they also have locally raised meats, bread from local bakeries...it's just a great place to support local growers and makers. also there are always people wandering outside tending to the garden. it's a nice atmosphere. the only thing I dislike is the location - because I'm allll the way across town. that's not their fault, though.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Holly Grove has the best selection of produce, including items not found at normal grocery stores, all sourced locally. They also offer locally raised meats and bread from local bakeries, providing great support for local growers and makers. The atmosphere is pleasant, with people tending to the garden. The only downside is the distant location, which is not their fault.

input:
We tried this place for the first time last night. Being a Saturday night during March Madness the service was a bit slow. The complimentary chips took longer to get to the table than my husband's salad did. Thankfully they had one of the nearby televisions playing a kid's movie to keep my 3 year old happy. Back to the chips, they are home made and were fantastic. I went the safe route and ordered a burger with seasoned fries. It was wonderful. My husband ordered the blackened chicken and while it was good it was a little over seasoned making it a tad too spicy. My daughter had the kid's macaroni and cheese. It looked wonderful but she couldn't stop eating the chips, LoL. The seating inside was a bit weird. There is a table about 2ft from the door to the women's bathroom. Maybe I'm weird for thinking it's weird but I ended up waiting until I got home to go. They offer a 15% military discount which was great. 

Overall I'd definitely recommend this place. I would have given it 5 stars if the service had been a little better.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We tried this place for the first time last night. The service was slow due to it being a busy Saturday night during March Madness. The complimentary chips took longer to arrive than my husband's salad. However, the homemade chips were fantastic. They had a kid's movie playing on one of the nearby televisions which kept my 3-year-old entertained. I ordered a burger with seasoned fries, which was wonderful. My husband had the blackened chicken, which was good but slightly over-seasoned and spicy. My daughter enjoyed the kid's macaroni and cheese, although she couldn't resist the chips. The seating inside was a bit strange, with a table located too close to the women's restroom door. I decided to wait until I got home to use the restroom. They offer a 15% military discount, which is great. Overall, I would definitely recommend this place, although I would have given it 5 stars if the service had been better.

input: Decent hotel in downtown Tampa. Stayed in the suite with the fold out couch.  This place has a happy hour with FREE drinks, which we missed, but how cool. The complimentary breakfast was awesome.  Made to order omelets, fresh fruit, cereal, toast, bacon, sausage, home fries, juice and pastries.  Did I mention it was complimentary?   Easiest the best free breakfast I've ever had.  Room was nice and modern with two TV's etc.  Clean and a strong shower.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great hotel in downtown Tampa with a suite that had a fold-out couch. They offer a happy hour with free drinks, although we missed it. The complimentary breakfast was amazing, with made-to-order omelets, fresh fruit, cereal, toast, bacon, sausage, home fries, juice, and pastries. The room was modern and clean, with two TVs and a strong shower.

input: Very nice restaurant in the heart of downtown St. Petersburg with a nice homey feel to it. The burgers full of flavor and the arugula is a fine touch to the chicken and potato gratin meal.  I was not a fan of the cheese used in the potatoes gratin but will definitely be. Ack for the burger. Wine was a little high priced so I didn't get any. The atmosphere is very nice and so was our waitress.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Nice downtown St. Petersburg restaurant with a homey feel. Delicious flavorful burgers and arugula adds a nice touch to the chicken and potato gratin meal. The cheese in the gratin wasn't a favorite, but overall enjoyable. Skip the expensive wine. Great atmosphere and friendly waitress.

input: I have been coming to Cd Roma's for over 10 years. I love this place! The old locations was a bit more home style feeling and cozy and the new spot has a more modern vibe to it. I applaud the change in style with the change in times. Too many places get stuck doing the same thing over and over again. I am glad to see that the food is still delicious. The Chicken Parm, Eggplant Parm, house salad and Alfredo are some of my favorites and they have great pizza. The alfredo sauce is made to order and taste amazing with their breadsticks. Some appetizer items leave something to be desired like the frozen cheesesticks or calimari. I would love to see these replaced with better quality items. Overall, I still love this place and would choose it over Olive Garden any day. I do miss the homey old school vibe from the old location but I also miss the good old days when people talked to each other, fragglerock ruled and hip hop was Wu Tang Clan. Oh well....
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I have been a loyal customer at Cd Roma's for over 10 years and I absolutely love this place! The old location had a cozy, home-style feel while the new spot has a more modern vibe, which I appreciate. It's refreshing to see them adapting to the changing times instead of sticking to the same old routine. What hasn't changed is the delicious food they serve. Their Chicken Parm, Eggplant Parm, house salad, Alfredo, and pizza are all amazing. The made-to-order Alfredo sauce pairs perfectly with their delicious breadsticks. However, I feel that some appetizer items like the frozen cheesesticks or calimari could be improved in terms of quality. Despite these minor drawbacks, I still prefer Cd Roma's over Olive Garden any day. I do miss the old location's homely atmosphere, as well as the times when people actually conversed with each other and the music scene was dominated by Wu Tang Clan. But times change, and Cd Roma's remains a great choice for me.

input:
The Waffle House has consistent quality wherever you go. I'm not really fond of their business model with their yelling and very small dining area, but I get it. 
I still look forward to going for breakfast.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The Waffle House offers consistent quality despite their unique business model with yelling and a small dining area. Nonetheless, I still eagerly anticipate my breakfast visits there.

input:
Henry was a rock star  getting us into a storage locker. He was knowledge, professional, courteous and extremely personable. They were gracious to our four legged girl "Marley" who had to check them out, too.
Great experience in obtaining a storage locker!
We recommend!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Henry, a knowledgeable and professional rock star, helped us secure a storage locker. He was courteous, personable, and even went out of his way to accommodate our four-legged friend, Marley. Overall, it was a fantastic experience and we highly recommend their services.

input: Phenomenal restaurant. Great location. Great ambience.  Great food and most of all great drinks. If you go, grab a seat at the  bar. Jared is a true mixologist and has created all of the cocktails on the menu. Don't be afraid to challenge him. As for food, I have never had a bad meal and I have had 100's at this point and pretty much everything on the menu. You won't go wrong with anything on the menu. Listen for the specials...they are always wonderful.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Phenomenal restaurant with great location, ambience, food, and drinks. The bar is highly recommended, as Jared, the talented mixologist, has created all the cocktails on the menu. Don't hesitate to challenge him. The food options are all exceptional, as I have had countless meals and tried almost everything on the menu without disappointment. Additionally, make sure to listen for the specials, as they are always delightful.

input:
I know people RAVE about this place, but frankly I find it A-OK. 

It is a great location, the food is fresh, and they have a great variety of vegan options. But I find it pretty blah otherwise. I've had the crispy ranch and the curry tofu and enjoyed both of them, but I feel like I expect more out of a specialty vegan place. I did really like chick'n in the crispy ranch. The fries are pretty good too. My green lemonade was way too sweet and lemonade-y for me. 

If I were you, I would try it because people love it so much and you get some unique items. But for the $10 range for a lunch item, I wouldn't  say it's nothing AMAZING.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: While some people praise this place, I personally find it just decent. The location is great and they offer fresh food with a good variety of vegan options. The crispy ranch and curry tofu dishes were enjoyable, especially the chick'n in the crispy ranch. The fries are also tasty. However, as a specialty vegan restaurant, I expected more. The green lemonade was too sweet and lemonade-like for my taste. Overall, I suggest trying it for the unique items and popular reputation, but for the price range of around $10 for lunch, I wouldn't consider it exceptionally amazing.

input: Guy at the counter was rude, the place was filthy, and all around horrible! Would/will not recommend this place at all!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The counter staff was rude and the place was filthy, making it an overall horrible experience. I strongly advise against recommending this place.

input: My last full day in New Orleans and I HAD to come here!! Came in the pouring rain too!! I really wanted some authentic New Orleans style food (yes... it's still authentic if it's vegan, I don't care what you say! Lol!) Jamone was nice enough to give me a little taste of everything, so I could pick. That just made it harder, because I wanted it ALL!!. I'm telling you,  there is no bad choice here. Everything was SO good and flavorful!! And the bread pudding was the topper for me! I would be a regular if I lived out here! Do yourself a favor and come try this place. Come hungry too, so you can have it all, like me!  Oh...and the other great thing.  This is one vegan place where they give you a TON of food without emptying your wallet!!! Amazing food and service!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had an amazing last day in New Orleans, despite the pouring rain. I couldn't resist trying some authentic New Orleans style food, even if it was vegan! Jamone kindly let me sample a little bit of everything, which made choosing even harder because it was all delicious! There are no bad choices here, everything is flavorful and satisfying. And the bread pudding was the perfect finishing touch. If I lived here, I would definitely be a regular at this place. You should come and try it for yourself, and make sure to come hungry so you can enjoy it all. The best part is, this vegan place offers generous portions at an affordable price. The food and service are truly amazing.

input:
Magical vegan heaven. My wife and I stopped here on a detour from our route back home to Boston and she (a non-vegan) devoured their Philly steak. I literally had to pry her away from ordering more; I don't blame her at all though because the food was damn good. I had the curry tofu wrap and it was delicious. The place is pretty small with limited seating so a lot of people were taking (and I'm assuming regularly take) their food to go, so I'd be wary of this if you're wanting to sit in. 

But yeah this place rocks. Their kale lemonade alone is worth the 5 stars. Next time we're in Philly this place will be among the first in which we stuff our faces.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Magical vegan heaven in Philly is a must-try for both vegans and non-vegans. My wife, a non-vegan, couldn't resist their Philly steak and wanted to order more. The food was delicious, especially my curry tofu wrap. The place is small with limited seating, so takeout may be a better option. Their kale lemonade is remarkable. We will definitely visit again on our next trip to Philly.

input: My wife and I LOVE this place. The management is always very attentive and the service is excellent! Things to try: Tiger Roll, Pink Lady Roll, Tornado Roll. Ask for Billy he's our favorite. I highly recommend this place of others in the same area. Enjoy!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We absolutely love this place! The management is attentive, and the service is excellent. Highly recommend trying the Tiger Roll, Pink Lady Roll, and Tornado Roll. Ask for Billy - he's our favorite. Overall, we recommend this place over others in the same area. Enjoy!

input: Great place for lunch in NOLA. Love their fried chicken, and the red beans and rice is yummy too. It's a staple on our trips to town. Staff is friendly and attentitve and prices are great.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Awesome lunch spot in NOLA with delicious fried chicken and mouthwatering red beans and rice. The friendly and attentive staff, along with reasonable prices, make it a must-visit during our trips to town.

input: I live in the neighborhood so I try to frequent Mint as much as I can. No choice is a bad choice! Also the Taro Tapioca Smoothie is the perfect cure for a sweet tooth.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: As a local resident, I make it a point to frequently visit Mint in my neighborhood. Every choice available there is a great one, so you can't go wrong. Additionally, the Taro Tapioca Smoothie is an excellent and satisfying option for those with a sweet tooth.

input: The salsa and guacamole is. Made fresh daily. The chips are home made as well. The shrimp burrito was huge but was tasty and fresh. The wait staff was just average.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The salsa, guacamole, and chips are made fresh daily. The shrimp burrito is huge, tasty, and fresh. However, the wait staff was average.

input:
To be honest, I was kind of disappointed with this place. I really wanted to like it, and it has gotten so many positive reviews, so I thought it was a sure thing, but it was just a little underwhelming. Not bad, just not amazing. I had the costanza, and the fillings were tasty, but the crust was disappointing. It was way too bread-y, as opposed to doughy, and when I think of a calzone, I think of dough like pizza dough- this was not that. The calzones are a good size, but they were a little skimpy with the meat fillings. Probably the most disappointing part was the dessert- we got the apple pie calzone, and it just had a really weird spice to it- something other than cinnamon that I couldn't put my finger on. It also didn't have that many chunks of apples inside- it was almost pureed apple. Meh. 

I like the vibe of this place and it's close and convenient to where i live, so I really want to like it, but I just wasn't thrilled with it the first time. Perhaps I'll give it one more shot, but it seems a little overhyped!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had high hopes for this place due to its positive reviews, but I was ultimately disappointed. The calzone's fillings were tasty, but the crust was too bread-like instead of the doughy texture I expected. The portion of meat in the calzones was also lacking. The apple pie calzone had an odd spice taste and lacked substantial apple chunks. Despite its appealing vibe and convenient location, I was underwhelmed. It may warrant another visit, but it seems overhyped.

input:
An amazing view, impeccable professional service great fare,don't  skip a visit to this Philadelphia gem. Nick, who is a stellar, incredible server, recommended a lovely 2010 Bordeaux-Chateau Font Merlet which complemented the Tuna Tartare and Steak Tataki.

This is a must see in Philadelphia. After witnessing a fabulous nighttime view, I can't wait to return to check out the spectacular sunsets.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Enjoy stunning views, excellent service, and delicious food at this Philadelphia gem. Don't miss it! Stellar server Nick recommended a perfect wine pairing with the Tuna Tartare and Steak Tataki. A must-see spot in Philadelphia, with breathtaking nighttime views and unforgettable sunsets.

input: The food is very good but the ability to turnover the tables is a huge problem on busy days. Waited over an hour to be seated today and about an hour to get food. I just do not have 2 hours available to get breakfast. They do not have the proper staffing to quickly get the food out and clear tables in a timely fashion. There were many upset people there due to the time to wait. While we were eating there were 2 empty tables for at least 15 minutes that they did not seat anyone at yet when we left there was a longer line than when I arrived which we waited an hour to be seated. The workers were trying but were simply overwhelmed. Management needs to do a better job handling the staffing schedules. I will not be coming back due to this experience.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food is good but the long waiting time to be seated and served is a major issue. I waited over an hour to be seated and another hour to get my food. This is not feasible for a quick breakfast. The restaurant lacks proper staffing to efficiently serve customers and clear tables. Many people were upset due to the long wait. Even during our meal, two empty tables remained unused for at least 15 minutes. When we left, there was an even longer line than when we arrived after waiting an hour to be seated. The workers were overwhelmed and management needs to improve the staffing schedules. Based on this experience, I won't be returning.

input:
Aside from the occasional Eggs Benny, whenever I go out for breakfast, I always order the same...eggs, bacon, hashbrowns and wheat toast with a side of salsa if they have it. 
And that's exactly what I ordered today.
The hashbrowns were undercooked for my taste, so next time I'll ask for them to be crispy/well done. Everything else was quite good. Better than the Cajun Kitchen on Chapala, but not as good as the CK in Goleta.

Thankfully all of the special requests that I DID make were taken care of.

I'm super picky about my breakfast. 
Who am I kidding...I'm super picky about everything, lol.

Large portions(leftovers for tomorrow), super affordable(more so than CK), and loved sitting on their well shaded patio(no patio at CK).
There was one server taking care of 5 tables, she was great and very cheerful. No complaints about the service.

Terraza means balcony/terrace in Spanish and that's exactly why I would come here instead of other breakfast places that don't have one.

Next on the agenda...
Check out their lunch items.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I always order the same breakfast when I go out: eggs, bacon, hashbrowns, wheat toast with salsa on the side. Today, the hashbrowns were undercooked, so I'll ask for them crispy next time. Despite that, everything else was good. It was better than the Cajun Kitchen on Chapala but not as good as the CK in Goleta. Thankfully, my special requests were taken care of. The portions were large and affordable, and I loved sitting on their shaded patio. The service was great, with one server taking care of 5 tables. I prefer coming here because they have a balcony/terrace. Next, I'll try their lunch items.

input:
This is an all you can eat place that at $27/adult isn't bad.  But if you ordered from the regular menu, you come to realize just how mediocre the quality is.  Maki rolls are OK, but mine were so cold they had clearly been premade and sat in the fridge.  Oyster ponzu was missing the ponzu and the coating was really heavy - like an A+W onion ring. 

So if you are really hungry and want to eat several plates of rolls and greasy tempura then this is for you. Granted sometimes that is just what you're craving. But avoid the squid.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This all-you-can-eat place is priced at $27 per adult, which is reasonable. However, the quality of the food from the regular menu is mediocre. The maki rolls are decent, but mine were cold, suggesting they were made in advance and refrigerated. The oyster ponzu lacked ponzu and had a heavy coating reminiscent of an A+W onion ring. If you're extremely hungry and enjoy rolls and greasy tempura, this place will satisfy you. Just be cautious with the squid.

input: I called them after calling another locksmith who was rude to me on the phone. Anyway I called them in the morning and they sent someone out in 20 min. they were done in less than one hour and I received 4 free keys too. their service can't be beat.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I contacted them after a negative experience with another locksmith. They promptly sent someone within 20 minutes after my morning call. The job was completed in under an hour, and to my surprise, I also received 4 complimentary keys. Their service surpasses all expectations.

input:
This place is VERY crowded and not in a good way - unless you enjoy smelling other people's BO while you eat and drink. Gag! I guess the smell of the patrons matches the smell of the bathrooms which are also gag worthy and dirty. 

The prices aren't really great for the meh food available. Service was also meh. A few times we wondered if our server was every coming back. There are so many better options in Philly as a foodie city to try, so why waste your time and money here? Pass and head somewhere else.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is extremely crowded, but not in a pleasant way. The overwhelming smell of body odor from other patrons can ruin your dining experience. Additionally, the bathrooms are disgustingly dirty. The food is mediocre and overpriced, and the service is average at best. Considering Philadelphia's reputation as a foodie city, there are much better dining options available. It's not worth wasting your time and money here; go somewhere else instead.

input: Good beer selection, knowledgeable staff. Had I not ordered food here it would have an enjoyable experience. Some how received undercooked inedible Fries, one well done burger and one burger medium rare.... both burgers were served on buns that felt straight out of the refrigerator, slightly hard and cold. If you're drunk the foods good, don't eat it sober, plus add in service that was lackluster at best. We couldn't even eat the food and left it untouched. We told the the bartender no we didn't want it and what was wrong with it. Charged us full price.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The beer selection is good and the staff is knowledgeable. However, the experience would have been enjoyable if we didn't order food. We received undercooked and inedible fries, one well-done burger, and one medium-rare burger. Both burgers were served on cold and hard buns straight from the refrigerator. The service was lackluster, and even though we couldn't eat the food and explained the problem to the bartender, we were still charged the full price.

input:
My first experience did mot go well due to the heavy accents of the employees. I called ahead so my order would be ready for me to pick up and it was, it just was not what I ordered. They are nice people and corrected my order but instead of simply picking up my food I had to wait 20 minutes To get my original order. When all was said and done, the food was good.

I was nearby and decided to give them a second chance. This time I ordered a pizza steak and I was really impressed! I need to have a couple more before I can declare them my new favorite pizza steak. Plenty of mozzarella cheese and the roll is stuffed with meat and just enough sauce. It's looking like this place is a lot better than my first impression.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Initially, I had a negative experience with the restaurant as the employees had heavy accents and my order was incorrect. Despite their good intentions, it took an additional 20 minutes to receive the correct order. However, after giving them a second chance and ordering a pizza steak, I was pleasantly surprised. The dish had an ample amount of mozzarella cheese, a well-stuffed roll with meat, and just the right amount of sauce. This experience has made me consider the restaurant in a more positive light, and I may even declare it my new favorite pizza steak place after a couple more visits.

input:
The longest bar in the City!  For as crazy busy as the Happy Hours are, the Friday and Saturday late night crowds are really relaxed and there's always a place to sit.  This is the perfect place on a Saturday night after a show at the Troc if you don't want to go to Chinatown or a Dive bar.   I've been walking over after shows at the Electric Factory lately and it's THE place to unwind after standing up for 3 hours.  

IBP has all kinds of sports packages so it's a great place to go to watch that out of town football or baseball game.  The upstairs bar has pool tables and a separate jukebox.

edit:  RIP IBP
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The longest bar in the City, IBP, is a popular spot for Happy Hours. However, the Friday and Saturday late night crowds are relaxed and there's always seating available. It's the perfect place to unwind after a show at the Troc or Electric Factory. Additionally, IBP offers various sports packages and an upstairs bar with pool tables and a separate jukebox. Sadly, IBP is now closed.

input:
Four stars for the beer, atmosphere and usually service. There is a reason this place is always packed! Half price beer during a generous happy hour, a huge deck that welcomes dogs, and delicious key lime pie.   Sadly, said deck allows smoking, and there is usually lots of it. I wish they at least had a nonsmoking side. 

If giving a review just based on the food, I would give it a two. The pretzels are ok, but the cheese dip is Velveeta nastiest. As a native Wisconsinite, I take offense at plastic cheese. Then, there's the pretzel bun sandwiches. I've sampled the chicken, brat and Italian sausage. It's pricey, considering it comes with potato chips (seriously guys?! Get a fryer!) and just ok. The buns were kind of soggy and the overall experience underwhelming, especially knowing the epic sandwiches for sale next door. I wish the Village pub would focus on what it's best that, serving beer, and let us bring Mitchell's sandwiches over.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is usually packed with a four-star rating for beer, atmosphere, and service. They have a generous happy hour with half price beer, a dog-friendly deck, and delicious key lime pie. However, the deck allows smoking, which is a downside. If reviewing based on food alone, I would give it a two. The pretzels are okay, but the cheese dip is made with Velveeta which I find unpleasant. The pretzel bun sandwiches, including chicken, brat, and Italian sausage, are pricey and come with potato chips instead of fries. The buns were soggy and overall underwhelming compared to the neighboring sandwich shop. It would be better if the Village Pub focused on serving beer and allowed customers to bring sandwiches from Mitchell's next door.

input: Could not be more pleased with this establishment. Always clean and has a good feel, like the employees there actually enjoy their job. I didn't think I could like this place anymore and then I tried their fluff and fold service. Immaculate, absolutely perfect. All my clothes were returned perfectly folded and clean like I had just bought them. They even use environmentally friendly detergent! I'm sold! Thanks Modern Laundry now laundry is just one more quick stop on my laundry list of errands.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I am extremely satisfied with this establishment. It is always clean and has a pleasant atmosphere, with employees who genuinely seem to enjoy their job. I had a great experience with their fluff and fold service, as my clothes were returned immaculately folded and clean, as if brand new. I was especially impressed by their use of environmentally friendly detergent. Thanks to Modern Laundry, laundry has become a quick and hassle-free errand on my to-do list.

input: Food and atmosphere is nice. As one should expect in the CBD. Sometimes the back room can be stuffy on a busy day. I recommend the raw oysters and burgers. A few dollars on the high side for lunch.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Food and atmosphere in the CBD are nice, as expected. However, the back room can feel stuffy on busy days. I recommend trying their delicious raw oysters and burgers. Keep in mind that lunch prices are slightly on the higher side.

input: Great choice in a small shop. Worth the drive. The wine cakes are excellent! Just went here for first time based on yelp reviews and will definitely be going back
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Excellent small shop worth the drive, with great wine cakes! Based on positive Yelp reviews, I visited for the first time and will definitely return.

input:
I am not known for favorable restaurant reviews.  Most of them below my radar.
The Love is different.  
  We had a Father's Day lunch that was exceptional.
There is little left off the menu and we were hard pressed to make a choice from the wonderful selections listed.  Our waiter was professional and accommodating.  Lovely atmosphere, light and bright.  I was amazed that the inside of my omelet was HOT. A little surprise thrown in with my Potatos..........roasted peppers, and onions.
Greens on every plate. Mine had warm spinach salad as well. My husband had the Belgium waffles made with corn meal and garnished with Blueberry butter.  They use our favorite La Columbe coffee.
Nothing left to wish for.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Usually critical of restaurant reviews, but The Love is an exception. Our exceptional Father's Day lunch had an extensive menu, making it difficult to choose. The professional waiter and pleasant atmosphere added to the experience. The omelet surprised me with a hot interior and the potatoes were accompanied by roasted peppers and onions. Each plate also had greens, including a warm spinach salad on mine. My husband enjoyed the Belgian waffles garnished with Blueberry butter, made with cornmeal. Additionally, they serve our favorite La Colombe coffee. Overall, there was nothing left to desire.

input:
Not bad. Sushi roll was good but options were limited. Hibachi grill: i got steak...chef asked me 2x how i like mine-medium...Still ended up with well done. Rest of my group had chicken which all voiced lacked seasoning. 

Beware they DO NOT have a late happy hour 8-11 as advertised on their website. We asked the staff about it and they claimed 8-11 was for a different location. Their website nowhere indicates the happy hour is for a specific location nor does the website indicate they have multiple locations at all.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The sushi roll was good but there were limited options. I ordered steak at the hibachi grill and the chef asked me twice how I liked it cooked, medium, but it ended up being well done. The rest of my group had chicken which we all thought lacked seasoning. Beware that the advertised late happy hour from 8-11 is not available at this location. The staff claimed it was only for a different location and their website does not specify the happy hour is location-specific or mention multiple locations.

input:
I saw a deal on Groupon for Lee How Fook recently and after I read the reviews on Yelp, I was really excited to check this place out.  Unfortunately, I just didn't enjoy this restaurant and was pretty disappointed.

Lee How Fook is pretty small, but that didn't make it lose any points in my book.  I could see it getting really busy (especially since there are only about 10 tables available), so I would definitely suggest making reservations if you're going on a weekend.  The service wasn't bad, but when I asked some questions about some dishes on the menu, I had a hard time understanding what she was trying to say.  

Okay now to the main course - food!  For appetizers, we ordered the pan seared pork dumplings and sui mai.  Both appetizers were delicious and the dipping sauce was really good.  For the entrees, we ordered the sweet & sour chicken, pan fried noodle with shrimp, and pan fried noodle with beef and black bean sauce.  The sweet & sour chicken was awful - more sweet than sour - and the vegetables in it were really undercooked (pretty much raw).  (I do have to admit that I like things spicy, so maybe this dish just wasn't for me.)  For both pan fried noodle dishes, they were blah with a side of blah.  The beef dish was supposed to be spicy, but I just didn't taste any heat.  I left here full, but unsatisfied.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was excited to try Lee How Fook after seeing a Groupon deal and reading positive reviews on Yelp. However, I was disappointed with my experience at this small restaurant. It is advisable to make reservations as it can get busy with limited tables. While the service was decent, I had difficulty understanding the server when asking about the menu. The appetizers, including pan-seared pork dumplings and sui mai, were delicious with tasty dipping sauce. However, the sweet & sour chicken dish was disappointing, being overly sweet and with undercooked vegetables. The pan-fried noodle dishes lacked flavor, and the supposedly spicy beef dish had no heat. Overall, I left feeling full but unsatisfied.

input: The hot chicken is probably one of the best fried chickens I've ever eaten, and I'm from the South/NC and have had quite a bit of it. However, the price for the small portion size is really expensive. The drinks here are fantastic too.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The hot chicken is amazing, even for someone from the South/NC like me who has had a lot of fried chicken. However, it is quite expensive considering the small portion size. On the bright side, the drinks here are fantastic.

input: I could write a lengthy review, persuasive and layered to hit all the right points. But why do that when Lee How Fook makes food that does it for you? Long story short they have some of the best general tso chicken I have eaten to date. Try it for yourself and get back at me. - Coolie
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Lee How Fook makes amazing food, particularly their general tso chicken. Instead of a lengthy review, just try it yourself and let me know what you think. - Coolie

input:
Thank you Chef John Besh!  My husband and I stayed at the Hilton hotel on St. Charles. One of my main goals was to find some delicious New Orleans grinds.  I was starving when we arrived and didn't want to do any research on Yelp for a place to eat.  Thank God Luke was connected to our hotel!!!  We ended up eating here 3 times over 5 days.  It's usually full of business suits, but that doesn't bother me when the food is so good.

All the traditional dishes were good, but the huge surprise was the burger.  I was against ordering a burger while I was in New Orleans, because I wanted to try as many local eats as possible... and you can find burgers anywhere.  I overheard this lady raving about how delicious her burger was, so I had to order it the next time we ate there.  She was absolutely right!  It was one of the best burgers I've ever had!  It was huge, juicy, and packed with flavor.  I also highly recommend getting their bread pudding a la mode.  It was mouth-watering good and straight out the oven!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Thank you Chef John Besh! My husband and I stayed at the Hilton hotel on St. Charles and wanted to find delicious New Orleans food. Thankfully, Luke was connected to our hotel and we ended up eating there three times over five days. It's usually full of business suits, but the food is so good it didn't bother us. The traditional dishes were all good, but the burger was a huge surprise. I initially hesitated to order it, wanting to try more local eats, but after hearing someone rave about it, I had to try it. And she was right! It was one of the best burgers I've ever had - huge, juicy, and packed with flavor. I also highly recommend their bread pudding a la mode, it was mouth-watering and fresh from the oven.

input: Came down here for some of their tasty fish tacos to find out that they have closed this location.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I came here for their delicious fish tacos but was disappointed to find that this location is closed.

input:
Thanks SO much to Jacob... 
A beautiful day spent skiing at Squaw ended with my realization that I had lost our car keys somewhere on the mountain. I had Security call every lift we'd hit and they took my name in case the keys were turned in. Do I call Toyota? Do I have to tow my car back to SF? I looked up "locksmith" on my phone's Google Maps app and Alpine came up (their Truckee office). Jacob had obviously dealt with the situation before. He gave me a price quote in about 30sec and gave me an accurate time frame as to when he could get to Squaw. He even called when he was running a few minutes late. We enjoyed a nice happy hour in the meantime and when he got to the parking lot, I think it took him less  than 4min to get our key code and create us some new keys. Thanks for saving the day! Honest, quick service. Hope I never need to call them again under the same circumstances, but they'll be the first I call I make if I lose another set of keys. (Alpine accepts AAA).
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Jacob from Alpine Locksmiths provided quick and efficient service when I lost my car keys while skiing at Squaw. Despite my initial panic, Jacob calmly gave me a price quote and a time frame for when he could arrive at the mountain. He even called to inform me of a slight delay. When he arrived, Jacob swiftly obtained our key code and created a new set of keys in less than 4 minutes. I am grateful for his honest and efficient service, and while I hope to never be in the same situation again, I would not hesitate to call Alpine Locksmiths in the future. (Alpine also accepts AAA).

input: Service was so poor we didn't even get to the food. New Years Day 2017 around 7:30 and we get seated. It's 8:15 now and we still don't have water and multiple waiters have introduced themselves to us saying they're going to be our server for the evening. After wasting 45 mins and repeated attempts to get water for the largest party in the small restaurant we walked out and went across the street to Dat Dog and were blown away by hot dogs. Thanks Dat Dogs!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The service was extremely poor at the restaurant on New Year's Day 2017. Despite being seated at 7:30, by 8:15 we still hadn't received any water. We encountered multiple waiters introducing themselves as our server for the evening. After wasting 45 minutes and multiple failed attempts to get water, we decided to leave and went to Dat Dog across the street. Dat Dog impressed us with their hot dogs. Thank you, Dat Dog!

input: My order was 75% wrong and when I got home to divvy out the food I had ordered, items were missing including a burger
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My order was 75% incorrect and I discovered missing items, including a burger, when I returned home to distribute the food.

input:
I finally made it to Farmhaus last Saturday, and it was worth the wait.  

As expected for a weekend, it was crowded.  We arrived about 15 minutes early and had to wait on the bench back by the bathrooms for a few minutes.  However, as I said, we were earlier than they anticipated, and they got us to the bar as soon as seats opened up.  They wisely gave us a copy of the menu to be prepared once we were seated, and we did indeed plan our entire meal in advance.  This was helpful, because we were actually seated about 20 minutes late, and I was about to eat the menu itself as I drooled over the descriptions!  

The smoked fish dip and escolar with prawns were fantastic- the standouts of the meal.  The mushroom salad and tapenade were also very good.  The meatloaf was good, but a little on the dry and bland side.  I wanted to get the nachos, but there were no other takers in my group....next time....

Service was good.  It was a bit shaky at times, but it was slammed the whole time we were there and that small space must be tough to work in.  

I would love to go back and check out their blue place special lunches...I have heard amazing reviews.  I think I will head back for dinner when there is outdoor seating, as I think that would add to the experience.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I finally visited Farmhaus last Saturday and it was worth the wait. Despite the crowded weekend, we were seated about 20 minutes late. However, they provided us with a menu beforehand, allowing us to plan our whole meal while waiting. The smoked fish dip and escolar with prawns were the highlights, while the mushroom salad and tapenade were also delicious. The meatloaf was decent but a bit dry. Service was good despite the busy atmosphere. I would love to try their blue plate special lunches and plan to visit again for dinner with outdoor seating.

input: This restaurant is seriously lacking in customer service!  We have dined many times at Dish.  We like the food.  We made a reservation two weeks ahead for 3 people.  When we arrived we were seated at the smallest table in the restaurant which barely fits two people.  The table next to us had an extra person added at the end, his back was literally a couple of inches from our table.  We asked for a table that would accomdate three people and not involve eating with someone's large back at our very tiny table.  We were rudely informed that it was a take or leave it situation.  It was very frustrating since we booked this as a special night out weeks earlier.  Unfortunately, we are writing this restraurant off our list.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The restaurant, Dish, is lacking in customer service. Despite having dined there multiple times and enjoying the food, our recent experience was disappointing. Despite making a reservation for three people two weeks in advance, we were seated at a small table meant for two. Additionally, the table next to us had an extra person squeezed in, resulting in their back being inches away from our table. When we requested a table suitable for three people and expressed our discomfort, we were rudely informed that no other options were available. This was frustrating, especially since we had planned this outing well in advance. Regrettably, we have decided to remove this restaurant from our list.

input: This restaurant was pretty good; i'll admit it! I went here in the late evening with my boyfriend to have a nice date! He insisted on us ordering a milkshake and i'm SO GLAD that he did. The milkshake was probably one of the best ones i've had in my lifetime. The food was pretty good and so was the service but something was a little off. I couldn't tell what it was but i just got a really strange vibe from the restaurant. Maybe i'm just being crazy!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This restaurant was good, especially for a late evening date with my boyfriend. We ordered a milkshake, which turned out to be one of the best I've had. The food and service were also satisfactory, but I couldn't shake off a strange vibe from the place. Maybe it's just my imagination!

input:
I was so disappointed when this opened; I was hoping for Nashville's first real authentic Greek restaurant (Athens notwithstanding).  This isn't Greek; it isn't even Mediterranean. It's pseudo-Americanized versions of Mediterranean classic cuisine. The corporate chefs got so many things wrong:  Skordalia is a classic Greek dip made out of potatoes and garlic (not bread).  Avgolemono is chicken soup with egg, lemon and rice -- not this thin, awful broth they are currently serving. If one wants true Greek cooking, one should go to Greektown in either Detroit or Toronto. 
Just say no.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I was disappointed when this restaurant opened as I was hoping for Nashville's first authentic Greek restaurant. Unfortunately, it is not Greek or even Mediterranean cuisine. It offers pseudo-Americanized versions of Mediterranean classics. The corporate chefs made several mistakes, such as using bread instead of potatoes and garlic for skordalia, and serving a thin and unpleasant broth as avgolemono. For true Greek cooking, I recommend visiting Greektown in Detroit or Toronto. My recommendation is to avoid this restaurant.

input: Best meal in New Orleans!!! I was in a group of 4 and we were served by Travis, Susan & Caroline. I had the set price menu: strawberry salad appetiser, chicken entrée & chocolate cake dessert. The salad was fresh and a great start. The chicken is the best chicken I have ever eaten anywhere. It had crispy skin, but was the meat was extremely moist and the corn bread stuffing was superb. The cake was yummy, but very rich. One of our party is vegetarian and she LOVED her vegetable selection plate. The other 2 members had the pork with sweet potato mash and said it was excellent. The staff were wonderful and very attentive. Excellent location and definitely the best meal we had in New Orleans.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had the best meal in New Orleans at a restaurant served by Travis, Susan & Caroline. I had the set price menu which included a strawberry salad appetizer, chicken entrée, and chocolate cake dessert. The salad was fresh and delicious, while the chicken was the best I have ever had with crispy skin and moist meat. The cornbread stuffing was also superb. The cake was yummy but rich. Our vegetarian friend loved her vegetable selection plate, and the other two members enjoyed the pork with sweet potato mash, finding it excellent. The staff were attentive and the restaurant was in an excellent location. Overall, it was definitely the best meal we had in New Orleans.

input:
I believe the gentlemen at the front desk name was Kris? He was great, the rain was coming down so hard and he went above and beyond and walked me as well as Leo with an umbrella to the car! 
I have taken Leonidas there for about two years now, unfortunately he is a nervous Nelly, but we started seeing Dr. Deutsch and he has been the best with Leo! He is thorough and takes his time to ensure Leo is comfy.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The front desk gentleman named Kris was extremely helpful. Despite the heavy rain, he went above and beyond by providing both me and Leo with an umbrella and walking us to the car. I have been taking my dog, Leonidas, to this place for two years now. Unfortunately, Leo is a nervous dog. However, since we started seeing Dr. Deutsch, he has been the best with Leo. Dr. Deutsch is thorough and takes his time to ensure Leo is comfortable.

input: Although the term is often overused, "farm fresh" truly applies here. Inventive, flavorful dishes and just-right portions amaze. A cozy dining room, friendly atmosphere and attentive service make it the perfect setting to catch up with friends and loved ones (BYO, so grab a good bottle). Try the Bloody Beet Steak!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: "Farm fresh" truly applies here with inventive, flavorful dishes and just-right portions. The cozy dining room, friendly atmosphere, and attentive service make it the perfect setting to catch up with friends and loved ones. Don't forget to bring your own bottle and be sure to try the remarkable Bloody Beet Steak.

input:
Bomb. I go for the island bowl, always.  

"For your health!" - Dr. Steve Bruhle
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Prefer island bowl for health - Dr. Steve Bruhle

input:
Dayum, that was a good burger. Juicy, glistening melting with cheese - simplistic yet tastes completely different from other burger joints due the quality of the ingredients. Bacon looks good in pictures, but it was a too thick of slice of puuuure white fat, if it would have melted in my mouth it would have worked but it didn't therefore just felt sinful, in a bad way. 

Unfortunately, this communal table trend has got to go. 
I hate it, it's a crap shoot on who your going to get to sit next to and basically listen to a complete strangers stupid conversations. Terrible idea.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: That burger was amazing with its juicy, glistening cheese and high-quality ingredients. However, the thick slice of pure white fat bacon was disappointing as it didn't melt in my mouth and felt sinful in a bad way. Unfortunately, the communal table trend is something I despise. Sitting next to complete strangers and hearing their stupid conversations is a terrible idea.

input:
i've been a member of this gym for a couple of weeks now, and i'm enjoying it.  conveniently located, very reasonably priced, and all the basic amenities -- plenty of cardio machines, plenty of weights, a lap pool, a spin class room, and a big aerobics studio.  the staff are all really nice as well, and you get a free personal trainer session when you sign up.  and your membership fee allows you to use all of their area locations for no extra money.  and if you have kids (i don't), they offer babysitting for limited hours.

the only things i'm a bit bummed about are:  1. they don't open until 8am on the weekends (i'm an early riser and would prefer to go a bit earlier than that), and 2. the only group fitness class they offer before work is a 5:45am spin class (i'm sorry, i just can't do spin that early in the morning).

this isn't the gym for you if you want all sorts of foo-foo stuff like a smoothie bar and massage and lots of high-tech equipment.  but if you just want a place to come and work out with nice people on good equipment, then you'll save some money by joining LA fitness.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I've been a member of this gym for a couple of weeks now and I'm enjoying it. It's conveniently located, reasonably priced, and has all the basic amenities including plenty of cardio machines, weights, a lap pool, a spin class room, and a big aerobics studio. The staff is really nice and you get a free personal trainer session when you sign up. Your membership fee also allows you to use all of their area locations at no extra cost. They offer babysitting for limited hours if you have kids. The only downsides are that they don't open until 8am on weekends (which might be too late for early risers) and the only group fitness class before work is a 5:45am spin class. This gym may not be for you if you're looking for extras like a smoothie bar, massage, or high-tech equipment. However, if you just want a place to work out with nice people and good equipment, joining LA Fitness will save you money.

input: I'm very picky when it comes to Sushi. Quality of the fish and ingredients are very important but so is the chef, maybe the most important. Hiro San is absolutely amazing at what he does. His skills are hands down the best and he's also a really great human being to talk to. If you are in the Santa Barbara area looking for a great Sushi experience come here and sit in front of the master, you won't regret it.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Hiro San is an exceptional sushi chef in Santa Barbara known for his outstanding skills and high-quality ingredients. His expertise and great personality make him the best choice for a memorable sushi experience. Visit him for an unmatched sushi experience that you won't regret.

input: This theater is dated but you can't beat the cheap prices.  Staff is always very friendly and that alone keeps me dividing my time between here and the Loft.  It is never even close to being crowded and you can always see any of the major movies on top of lots of Indie films they show here and hardly anywhere else.  I would much rather wait out a movie til it comes here.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The theater is dated but has unbeatable cheap prices. The staff is always friendly, and that's why I divide my time between here and the Loft. It's never crowded, and they show major movies along with rare Indie films. I prefer waiting for movies to come here.

input: Fun place, inviting interior and a pleasure to hang outside with the couches, etc. brunch food was very good, and beer selection exceptional.  Waiter, however, was a disaster.  Was jerky to us from the beginning, (we were all sitting around asking each other why he was being such a jerk to us), did not know the menu at all, constantly disappeared on us, and was argumentative when he brought out the wrong order (twice)...and there were only 2 other tables at the time). Otherwise, would have gotten 4 stars.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Fun place with inviting interior and outdoor seating, complete with comfortable couches. Brunch food was excellent, and they had an exceptional beer selection. However, the waiter was a disaster. He was rude from the start, leaving us questioning why he treated us poorly. He lacked knowledge of the menu, frequently disappeared, and even argued when he served us incorrect orders multiple times, despite the restaurant being relatively empty. Overall, would have given 4 stars if not for the waiter's behavior.

input: Great restaurant, and creative menu. We also love La Mulita next door, which shares the same kitchen. The only downside is that they do not take reservations, so it can be a bit of a gamble on a weekend. You also need your whole party to sit, so if you have a late friend, you could be stuck for a bit.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great restaurant with a creative menu. La Mulita, located next door and sharing the same kitchen, is also highly recommended. The only downside is that reservations are not accepted, making weekend visits a gamble. Additionally, all members of your party must be present to be seated, which may result in a wait if someone is late.

input: For Cool Springs on a Thursday when Bonefish grill was packed this place had a comfortable wait of 15 minutes. Also the food is always amazing, but that's a given
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Cool Springs on a packed Thursday at Bonefish Grill had a comfortable 15-minute wait, with consistently amazing food.

input:
Yum-O! We spend the day in Tarpon Springs, and headed here around 3:45 for lunch / dinner. We waited for about 10 minutes for our table and were seated. 

This restaurant has a TON of staff and they are always running around. Our waiter was nice and quick.

We ordred:
Gyro - yum
Chicken Slouvaki - yum
Spanokopita - YES (this is what I ordered, good, but the top filo dough crust was a bit harder than I like)
Hotdog (this is what the 5 year old got)

We also got an order of the cheese, opa!

Yes, this will be our go to spot when we visit Tarpon Springs.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had a great dining experience at a restaurant in Tarpon Springs. Despite a 10-minute wait, we were seated and promptly served by a friendly and efficient waiter. The gyro, chicken Slouvaki, and Spanokopita were all delicious, although the top crust of the Spanokopita was a bit harder than desired. Our 5-year-old enjoyed a hotdog. Additionally, we highly recommend trying the cheese, opa! Overall, this will be our favorite spot to visit whenever we're in Tarpon Springs.

input: Simply put, the Grypon Cafe makes me feel infinite.
