It's about two minutes away from the Wayne Starbucks, but believe me when I say that all the cool informed coffee connoisseurs flock to Gryphon Cafe.  Its setting is quiet and intimate.It exudes a chill and serene vibe, from its very dim lighting and small (in a good way!) space.  The lattes are very good- made with strong espresso.  In addition, it provides various baked goods, although I've had a really dry, stale brownie from there (A big no-no! As a result, I don't care too much for the baked goods).  In addition, Gryphon supports a lively local music scene; music begins at 9 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The Gryphon Cafe, located just a short distance from the Wayne Starbucks, is a magnet for coffee enthusiasts seeking a cool and informed atmosphere. With its quiet and intimate setting, it exudes a serene and chill vibe through its dim lighting and cozy space. The lattes served there are exceptional, made with strong espresso. However, there have been instances of subpar baked goods, including a dry and stale brownie, which is a disappointment. On a positive note, Gryphon Cafe is a proud supporter of the local music scene, hosting lively performances on Friday and Saturday nights starting at 9 p.m.

input:
Its a rarity that i give five stars for anything. But in comparing this tattoo shop to the others around Indy and how they've jacked me around i decided its simply worth it to give 5. The other places have cancelled on me at the last moment, even when i was en route to go get the tattoo, one guy didnt even remember me when i called the day before to make sure we were on schedule for the tat and yet another had the inks set out and asked me to sit down when he got a call that he needed to go pick up the kids at school - all of these places i scheduled months out in advance as well. So, here we are back at Metamorphosis where they actually like to run a business the way it should be. Honestly i have only had one tat done here by Trevor and at the time it was the most fun 4 hour rib tattoo experience i could have had. They act professional, not like the rock star wanna be's i tried to check out at other places. Just cool chill people who want your business here. Trevor gave me the tattoo i wanted in the place i wanted it even though i feel he would have given me honest advice if it were needed. When it came time to get the tat, he held his appointment and i was treated with respect and as though a customer should be treated. Honestly i dont think this place cost more than any other place where youll get good work. Prices are about average in my opinion for the quality of work done. Dont waste your time going to the other places and getting jerked around - ive already done the work for you. Its a shame too that they may have good artwork at other places but youll feel like less of a human going anywhere else. The artists are just as good here and youll be respected for your $.  And by the way, yes they do ask for a non refundable deposit so they know your serious which is no different than any tattoo place ive ever been to.
Hopefully they dont change up anything, especially their roster as i believe they have a good thing going here. Yes its in hoity toity popular town but its a diamond in the rough and there are no rock star attitudes here. Cant wait to go back to Trevor again.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I rarely give five stars, but this tattoo shop deserves it. Other places in Indy have disappointed me, cancelling appointments last minute and not remembering me. However, at Metamorphosis, they run their business professionally and treat customers with respect. Trevor, the artist, gave me a great tattoo and held his appointment. The prices are average and the artists here are just as talented as at other places. Don't waste your time elsewhere, go to Metamorphosis. They may be in a popular area, but there are no egos here. Can't wait to go back to Trevor again.

input: Had the lengua burrito. It was non greesy and plated neatly. Simple food that was easy on the wallet. Think I will try the flan next time
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Enjoyed the non-greasy and neatly plated lengua burrito. Affordable and uncomplicated, with plans to try the flan on the next visit.

input: Poor lighting very dark can't even see your food all the food was average. Sorry I really wanted to like it more.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The poor lighting made it difficult to see the food, and unfortunately, all the dishes turned out to be average. I had hoped to enjoy it more, but I couldn't due to the above reasons.

input: Banana pudding is amazing. You can get the extra toppings but just plain no nana is great. They care about their customers and are always welcoming. I love supporting their shop and hope it's around for years.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Banana pudding is delicious, whether with extra toppings or plain. The shop is known for its excellent customer service and welcoming atmosphere. I enjoy supporting them and hope they remain in business for many years.

input:
I mistakenly left my organizer/wallet on my table when eating at Shepard's yesterday (6/24/12). I realized the mistake early this morning and called Shepard's. I was told that no one turned in anything resembling my organizer. 

I called back a few hours later to try and determine who bussed my table and what management was on duty and was told that my organizer had indeed been found and was in the "safe". I asked about the contents of the wallet and discovered that everything was present except for a $100 bill that I had just gotten the night before. I have witnesses to the $100 bill being in the organizer. 

I went today to retrieve the organizer and met with the assistant manager, who told me it was not their responsibility to keep track of guests belongings and would not investigate the issue whatsoever. She would not approach the server, would not ask who turned the organizer in, would not ask who stored it in the safe and essentially told me it was not her problem. 

This is customer service at it's worst... I have no recourse at this establishment to even try to get my money back. I am incensed that they won't even conduct an investigation for me.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
Yesterday (6/24/12), I mistakenly left my organizer/wallet on my table while dining at Shepard's. This morning, upon realizing my mistake, I called Shepard's to inquire about it. I was informed by the staff that no one had turned in a similar item.

A few hours later, I called again to find out the identity of the person who had bussed my table and the manager on duty. Surprisingly, I was informed that my organizer had indeed been found and was being kept in the "safe". However, when I asked about the contents of the wallet, I discovered that everything was intact except for a $100 bill, which I had received the night before. I can provide witnesses who can attest to the presence of the $100 bill in my organizer.

Today, I visited Shepard's to reclaim my organizer and discussed the situation with the assistant manager. To my disappointment, she stated that they were not responsible for guests' belongings and refused to investigate the matter further. She refused to approach the server or inquire about who had turned in the organizer or stored it in the safe, essentially dismissing the issue as not her concern.

I am extremely dissatisfied with this level of customer service. Unfortunately, this establishment offers no means for me to seek reimbursement for my lost money. It is frustrating that they are unwilling to conduct a proper investigation on my behalf.

input: As usual, this restaurant doesn't seem to heed the bad reviews and fix the problems. Dinner here last night was abysmal. The prime rib was 40% fat with tons of gristle. My dog wouldn't even eat the left overs!  Who wants cold fries? I asked for regular butter (not cinnamon) and never got it. Hey, Jeanne, do you not even TRY to fix your problems?
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This restaurant consistently ignores negative reviews and fails to address underlying issues. During my dinner last night, the prime rib was excessively fatty and filled with gristle, to the point where even my dog refused to eat the leftovers. Additionally, the fries were served cold, and despite requesting regular butter instead of cinnamon, it was never provided. It is disappointing to see that they make no effort to resolve these issues.

input:
I'm only giving them 4 stars because I haven't tried out enough of their menu. But in regards to previous reviews saying the pizza was soggy, they must have listened! The pizza I ordered today was a personal specialty pie. Vegan general tso's pizza. It was so good! No skimping on the "chicken" either. The crust was crisp and fluffy, not greasy at all but still packed with flavor. The chicken had that delicious general tso's sauce coated on each piece, as well as a slight kick at the end. 

I will definitely be ordering from there again. When I called to see if it was possible to veganize an online order, they instructed me to simply write vegan in the comments section. And they called me back to iron out a pricing discrepancy as well! The delivery came within the time they quoted and was hot. I'd definitely recommend giving them a try. They make the seitan themselves and wow, it is good.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I'm giving them 4 stars because I haven't tried enough of their menu, but their pizza was amazing. The vegan general tso's pizza I ordered today had a perfect crust, not greasy, and packed with flavor. The "chicken" had a delicious general tso's sauce and a slight kick. They also have excellent customer service and make their own delicious seitan. I'll definitely order from them again. Give them a try!

input:
This restaurant is attached to the Drury Plaza hotel, so it was conveniently located for dinner when you're not really familiar with the area. There were 20+ in our party each night and the service was pretty good. Only a few forgotten drinks, which was to be expected with such a large group. 
Portions are huge and food was good. I had the Cuban sandwich one night and it was massive but delicious. The shandy is good. The margaritas are not and I don't recommend their patron one. I forget the name but it wasn't that good. Their shrimp tacos have a kick but they're good too.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This restaurant is conveniently located next to the Drury Plaza hotel, making it a convenient option for dinner, especially if you are unfamiliar with the area. Despite a large party of 20+, the service was generally good, with only a few forgotten drinks, which can be expected in such a large group. The portions are generous and the food is tasty. One night, I tried the Cuban sandwich, which was massive but delicious. Additionally, their shandy is enjoyable. However, I do not recommend their margaritas, especially the patron one, as it was not good. Lastly, their shrimp tacos have a spicy kick, but are still delicious.

input:
You know how those 5 stars mean, "Woohoo!  As good as it gets!"?

Each one of those stars is well deserved by Tanti and the rest of the crew at Papertini.  They specialize in wedding flowers but these aren't just your clump of red roses.  These are creatively and artistically designed masterpieces speckled with striking elements like papers, wires, luxe fabrics, and more.  As an added bonus, they're just great, friendly people.  A true asset to your wedding team.

If you want traditional wedding flowers, Papertini can do it but I think it would kill their soul - go elsewhere.  If you want something more unique without being artsy-fartsy, I can't recommend them highly enough!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Tanti and the crew at Papertini truly deserve each of those 5 stars. They specialize in creatively designed wedding flowers that go beyond the norm. Their masterpieces feature striking elements like papers, wires, and luxe fabrics. Not only are they talented, but they are also friendly and a great addition to any wedding team. If you're looking for traditional wedding flowers, it may not be their specialty, but if you want something unique without being overly artsy, I highly recommend them.

input:
Looking for a delicious New Year's Day brunch was hard this year in New Orleans. We didn't want to wait in line and wanted instant gratification. Although we may have felt tired, my bf and I were appropriately dressed to go to Mr. B's. As soon as we walked in, I felt transported into a different world. Jazz music was playing and I felt at home. 

First of all, I could not have been more grateful for the fresh loaf of bread we were given. We devoured it in a matter of minutes. Then came the gumbo ya-ya. It was spicy and savory and everything I expected from a gumbo. Finally came the bbq shrimp. We had been warned that these shrimp did come with their heads and tails on. Bibs were placed around our necks and we were off. The shrimp were some of the most rich and delicious ones I have ever tasted. The sauce they were served with was divine. Although it was messy, there is no other dish on the menu I would have traded for this.

Overall, service was friendly and quick at Mr. B's. The food was delicious, although a little pricey. Definitely try the brunch if you are able to.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Looking for a delicious New Year's Day brunch in New Orleans was tough this year. We wanted instant gratification without waiting in line. Thankfully, we found Mr. B's. We were tired but dressed appropriately and as soon as we entered, we felt transported into a different world with jazz music playing. The fresh loaf of bread was heavenly and gone within minutes. The gumbo ya-ya lived up to expectations, being spicy and savory. The bbq shrimp came with heads and tails on, but they were incredibly rich and delicious, paired with a divine sauce. The service at Mr. B's was friendly and quick, although the food was a bit pricey. If you can, definitely give their brunch a try.

input:
Nice Steakhouse in St. Louis. We went here for a client dinner and was pleasantly surprised. You get a nice view of the arch on the way in to the restaurant as well. 

The Apps were OK. We ended up getting the Carmine's trio (crab cakes, scallops and toasted ravioli). Crab cakes were above average. The scallops were a little saccharine for my tastes but the ravioli was good; and let's face it...one doesn't come to St. Louis for the scallops. Thankfully the filet mignon was exceptional. It was the perfect size, not too salty and rare just like I had requested. 

This was partnered with an above average wine list to make a great night out.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Nice Steakhouse in St. Louis with a pleasant surprise. Offers a nice view of the arch. Apps were okay, particularly enjoyed the crab cakes. Scallops were too sweet, but the ravioli was good. However, the filet mignon was exceptional - perfect size, not overly salty, and cooked rare as requested. Overall, a great night out with an above average wine list.

input: Three from my office had lunch delivered from San Antonio Taco today.  It was our first time from there.  The food did not live up to the reviews.  Three of us ordered sides of refried beans and rice.  All 3 thought the beans were much too salty and the rice was clumpy.  I had beef enchiladas.  The beef was cut with the grain instead if against it so it was stringy and inedible.  I will generally give a restaurant a second try but not sure I will this time.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My office ordered lunch from San Antonio Taco today, our first time trying it. Unfortunately, the food did not meet our expectations as per the reviews. All three of us ordered sides of refried beans and rice, but found the beans excessively salty and the rice clumpy. Personally, I had beef enchiladas which were disappointing as the beef was cut with the grain, resulting in stringy and inedible portions. While I typically give restaurants a second chance, I am unsure if I will do so this time.

input:
Cousin's is the place to go if you live in North Philly. I take this joint any day over Fresh Grocer. 

The only complaints I have is with the produce (which is expected considering it is COUSIN'S after all) and the hours (like many others have said, they have awful and inconvenient hours post-5pm).

That being said, I can get most essentials here and for much cheaper than anywhere else. 

This is only a two minute bike ride from my apartment so there's no reason not to shop here. Matter of fact, I'm headed there tomorrow.

When it's too cold or you're feeling to cheap to go to Trader Joe's, Cousin's is the place to head to.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Cousin's in North Philly is the go-to place. It beats Fresh Grocer any day. The only drawbacks are the produce and inconvenient post-5pm hours. Despite that, it offers affordable essentials. Being just a two minute bike ride from my apartment, there's no reason not to shop there. In fact, I'm going there tomorrow. When you don't want to go to Trader Joe's, Cousin's is the perfect alternative.

input:
I've been here twice now and sampled a bunch of what they have to offer - I feel like what you order will really dictate how much you like this place.  i.e. they do some things great and other things just so-so.

The two things I will surely go back for more of is the Sausage and Pepper Pizza (capitalized - because I mean business) and some sort of puff pastry that has a white cream in the middle - I'm sure it has a name but it escapes me.  The pizza was perfectly flavored and the sausage/peppers had a nice kick to it.  Im sure it would make for great leftovers but unfortunately (fortunately?) for me it was gone well before it found the refrigerator.  The cream puff cream was just awesome - couldn't pin-point the flavor (vanilla?) but I would prefer it to top every dessert I get from this point forward.

I also got a bunch of the other sweets (salted brownie, blondie, red velvet crumb-cake) and a few bagels.  All were good, but not great.  Was pleasantly surprised by the wheat everything bagels - whole wheat bagels usually suck.

What I didn't really like was the pepperoni pizza.  It was pretty bland for my liking - in complete contrast to the sausage and pepper pizza - and the pepperoni was pretty sparse. I also didn't like being told 25 minutes, showing up in 25 minutes and then standing there for 25 minutes waiting for the pizza.  The small shop + no chairs = awkwardly standing there for almost a half hour.  

Since it's close to me and has so many tasty looking treats yet to try - I'll surely be back.  Hopefully I'll get more 'great' than 'so-so'.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I've been here twice and tried a variety of their offerings. Your experience at this place will heavily depend on what you order. The Sausage and Pepper Pizza and a cream-filled puff pastry are the highlights for me, with great flavors and a nice kick. The pizza would make excellent leftovers, but it disappeared quickly. The cream puff cream was amazing and would elevate any dessert. Other items like salted brownie, blondie, red velvet crumb-cake, and bagels were good but not exceptional. Surprisingly, the wheat everything bagels were surprisingly good. However, I wasn't impressed with the pepperoni pizza, finding it bland and lacking in pepperoni. The waiting time for the pizza was also inconvenient without any seating available. Nonetheless, due to its proximity and the remaining tempting treats, I will definitely return, hoping for more great experiences than mediocre ones.

input:
It is an actual speakeasy! Very cool and chill place. The ambience is classy but the vibe of the place is casual. Highly recommend if you just want to have good cocktails/drinks with good music. 
Warning: They literally serve one dish of appetizer (which is not that tasty). Don't go empty stomach and with expectation of good food (or any food). As I mentioned, it is true to its speakeasy status.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Genuine speakeasy with a cool and relaxed atmosphere. Classy ambience, yet casual vibe. Great spot for enjoying quality cocktails and drinks accompanied by good music. However, be warned that they only serve one average-tasting appetizer. Don't go hungry or expect great food, as it stays true to its speakeasy identity.

input: Spent way too much money to get actually spoiled food delivered to us. Ordered a huge order, over 50% of it was incorrect. Will never return to this location.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We spent a lot on spoiled food delivery. More than 50% of our order was incorrect. Never going back to this place.

input: This is actually a 3 1/2 star review for me. Only because everything that I wanted they did not have or weren't willing to do. Firstly, I came here specifically for the chicken slider because from the picture it showed that you can get it on a biscuit and when I told the lady taking my order, she said they don't do that -__-. Then I wanted that buttermilk bites and they weren't available, however, my brother ordered the brown buttered cream sundae and got the buttermilk bites in that!! Oh yes, and the glazed donuts are so thick and dry. I liked the sliders I had though: fried chicken, beef belly and catfish(okay). And the sundae is pretty tasty. Good for a first try but not to continue coming.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This is a 3 1/2 star review for me because they did not have or were not willing to provide everything I wanted. I specifically came for the chicken slider, which I saw in the picture you could get on a biscuit, but they said they didn't do that. Additionally, the buttermilk bites I wanted were not available, although my brother ordered the brown buttered cream sundae and received the buttermilk bites in that. The glazed donuts were thick and dry. However, I did enjoy the sliders (fried chicken, beef belly, and catfish) and the sundae was tasty. It was a decent first try, but I would not continue coming back.

input: A short walk from my apartment I was told about a small, welcoming cafe very popular for breakfast and brunch. It did not disappoint! I had a salmon scramble with egg whites the first time i went. The second time i went i got the tofu with brown rice breakfast plate. Both meals were great!! And i was seated quickly
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I discovered a popular cafe for breakfast and brunch, just a short walk from my apartment. It didn't disappoint! The first time I went, I tried their delicious salmon scramble with egg whites. On my second visit, I opted for their satisfying tofu with brown rice breakfast plate. Both meals were exceptional, and I was promptly seated.

input: Went for Dinner at 6pm on a Friday and expect it to be packed, luckily for us, it wasn't. The staff is very friendly and the atmosphere is straight out of Magnolia Journal. The food was pretty dang good and drinks are too. The only reason I left off a star was the fact it took a little while to get our cocktails and our appetizer came at the same time as our food. But, they're new and I've been in hospitality before, so I get it!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Went for dinner on a Friday at 6pm, expecting it to be crowded, but fortunately, it wasn't. The staff was friendly and the atmosphere had a Magnolia Journal feel. The food and drinks were delicious. I deducted a star due to the slight delay in receiving our cocktails and the appetizer coming with the main course. However, considering they are a new establishment, and having previous experience in hospitality, I understand.

input: This is a great quiet place to eat very 1960's business style.  You can have the food of Tony's or eat off the bar menu.  I had the Risotto which was excellent.  Other people at the table had the special, linguine with shrimp and lobster, and strip steak.  Everyone loved their meals.  Of course the service here is fantastic.  They are not overbearing but attentive as well.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This 1960's-style eatery offers a peaceful ambience for dining, with the option to choose from Tony's menu or enjoy items from the bar. I personally had the excellent Risotto, while others at the table delighted in the special dishes of linguine with shrimp and lobster, and strip steak, all of which received praise. The service here strikes a perfect balance of attentiveness without being intrusive.

input: My go to place for sushi rolls! Their rolls are huge and the service is excellent. My favorite is heat attack appetizer( korean style jalapeno poppers) sapporo roll and honey roll. They also have a section of deepfried rolls on the menu! Their food always look so  fresh and appetizing. Great presentation. Try the spicy sashimi bowl if you wanna try something new!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This is my favorite place for sushi rolls! They have huge rolls and excellent service. I highly recommend trying the heat attack appetizer (Korean-style jalapeno poppers), Sapporo roll, and honey roll. They also have a selection of deep-fried rolls on the menu. The food always looks fresh and appetizing with great presentation. If you want to try something new, give the spicy sashimi bowl a try!

input:
Ok. I am not the type to complain, but I have been here twice and both times I have had terrible service at the bar. The first bartender served me but acted as if I was bothering him.  This second time, with a completely different bartender mind you, it was worse. I am not dressed like a street person or anything, and I am not pan-handling. But you would think that I was the way he acted. First, I sit at the bar and I am waiting for service. So, the bartender walks by me, pours a glass a water, turns in front of me, puts the water down, gives me some stupid half-grin then walks off. Not one audible word of greeting or a grunt passed between his lips. Then, he gets a menu, drops that down and walks off again! Not a sound. Is it me, but when a customer enters an eating establishment, shouldn't they be greeted in some manner?  Not looked at like "why are you here. I have better things to do"?  I am not looking for a royal salute or anything. Just "Hey man, what can I get ya?"  or something to that affect.   Anyway, I start to look at the drink and food menus. Then, a group of anywhere from 10-15 people come in behind me and say, to what looked like a manager, "We don't want to eat, is it ok if we just have a few drinks at the bar?". The manager says "Sure." The guy then says, "Can we get few beers down here"? (paraphrasing). The bartender says "Sure!" and proceed to service this group, one-by-one, as they order drinks. Ok, fine technically, I was looking at the menu when this started. But still, he walked back and forth, right in front of me, for about 10-12 minutes. Not once did he say, "Hey, just shout and I will get you something", or "Hey man, just give me a few minutes and I will be right with you". Nothing!  It was obvious it was a big group, but I mean, he gave no acknowledgement to the fact that I was sitting there waiting! 

Long story short - after this 10-12 minutes of waiting, I just walked out and went somewhere else. Now this place has about 4\5 stars with around 500 reviews. So, I guess people like it. But their bartenders are as unfriendly as I have ever encountered.  Maybe if you get a table it's different.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I've had terrible service at this bar twice. The first bartender acted like I was bothering him, and the second bartender was even worse. He completely ignored me, didn't greet me, and served a group of people who came in after me without acknowledging my presence. After waiting for about 10-12 minutes, I left and went somewhere else. Despite the overall positive reviews, the bartenders at this place are unfriendly. Maybe the experience is better if you get a table.

input:
Love it here

The atmosphere is great the options are more than average and the lunch bento boxes are great.  If you have the opportunity always try the boba as well.

Those complaining are just picky and should go back to eating at home.  

Try their beef braised soup as it is hearty and delicious.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great atmosphere, diverse options, and delicious lunch bento boxes. Don't miss the boba! Ignore the picky complainers and try their hearty and delicious beef braised soup.

input: Beautiful decor, great atmosphere, amazing food! My husband and I were thinking how it's NY prices but better quality than most we have had at this price point. He had udon noodles and I had a few rolls (Spicy Salmon is a must!) Flavors were great- not too strong but tasteful! :) We enjoyed our experience!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Beautiful decor, great atmosphere, amazing food at reasonable NY prices. The udon noodles and rolls, especially the Spicy Salmon, were delicious. The flavors were balanced and enjoyable. Overall, we had a great experience.

input: Hotel is lovely. The front desk staff is extremely friendly and helpful. We were lucky enough to get a room away from the club so we had no problem sleeping. If you are looking for quiet stay somewhere else if you looking for fun this is perfect!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Lovely hotel with extremely friendly and helpful front desk staff. Our room was away from the club, ensuring a peaceful night's sleep. If you're seeking a quiet stay, consider other options, but this hotel is perfect for those seeking fun and excitement.

input: I loved loved loved the pizza here. I returned and got their gnocchi and it was amazing as well. Really fresh ingredients nice variety on the menu. Really felt like a small family restaurant in Europe. Best pizza in middle Tennessee.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I absolutely loved the pizza here and the gnocchi was equally amazing. The menu offers a nice variety of options with fresh ingredients. The atmosphere gave me the warm feeling of a small family restaurant in Europe. Definitely the best pizza in middle Tennessee.

input: For a $16 haircut, I was expecting an OK-looking trim (all I really needed was some damage control - just someone to lop off my split ends and maybe add a few layers).  What I got was a very professionally looking haircut that works well with my face shape and made my hair a lot healthier and happier.  My expectations were far exceeded - and it definitely surpassed my last 'professional' hair salon experience.  Plus, the shampoo smelled amazing and the girl was really thorough.  I wish I had brought more cash to tip her!!!  The only thing you should keep in mind before going is time.  I had to wait an extra half an hour and it was the longest haircut I've ever had.  I would much rather have the student take the time to make sure it looks good, however, than have someone do a half-ass job.  I think it's important that the school has a series of steps and checklists their students have to go through to ensure they are giving you the best experience possible.  Just make sure you have a decent block of time in your schedule to relax in the chair!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a $16 haircut that exceeded my expectations. It was a very professional-looking haircut that suited my face shape and improved the health of my hair. The shampoo smelled amazing and the hairstylist was thorough. I wish I had brought more cash to tip her. The only downside was the wait time, as it was the longest haircut I've ever had. However, I appreciate that the student took their time to ensure a good result. It's important that the school has steps and checklists to provide the best possible experience. Just make sure you have enough time to relax in the chair.

input: My daughter was married at the Presidio Chapel in May, 2015. The wedding was magical and we were all treated really well by Rain Longo(she coordinates special events in the Chapel). She was very patient, supportive and enthusiastic. The chapel itself made for an outstanding and very authentic venue. My daughter and bridesmaids were able to get ready in a beautiful adjoining room. The rental of the Chapel included use for 6 hours and it was very affordable. Thanks to all for making this special day so perfect. Thanks!!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My daughter's wedding at the Presidio Chapel in May, 2015 was a magical experience. Rain Longo, who coordinates special events at the Chapel, treated us incredibly well. She was patient, supportive, and enthusiastic. The Chapel itself provided an outstanding and authentic venue. Additionally, my daughter and her bridesmaids were able to get ready in a beautiful adjoining room. The six-hour rental of the Chapel was affordable and made the day perfect. Thank you to everyone involved in making this day so special! Thank you!

input:
I'm not a regular waxer, but went in for a pre-vacation treat. The wax specialist Miriam was prompt and knew what she was doing. She spent much of our hour together telling me why my regular shaving is bad and waxing is good, and seriously marketing the EWC products to me. 
Brows and lower legs were done well. Underarms were left with a decent number of stray hairs which she told me I could tweeze out later. Little bits of wax were left on my skin here and there. Overall I felt like I did not walk out of there ready to hit the beach.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I visited a waxing salon for a pre-vacation treatment. The wax specialist, Miriam, was prompt and knowledgeable. During our session, she emphasized the drawbacks of regular shaving and the benefits of waxing while promoting EWC products. My eyebrows and lower legs were well-done, but my underarms had some stray hairs left which she advised me to tweeze later. Additionally, I noticed small remnants of wax on my skin. Overall, I didn't feel fully prepared to hit the beach after leaving the salon.

input:
The food was very good. The reason for the three stars is the noise level. I was with three other people in a corner table and we had to shout to hear each other. If the restaurant could work on the noise level, it would absolutely get more stars. The pad see ew got great reviews from the person who ordered it. I got The King and I (veg/chicken/shrimp stir fry) and it was excellent. Nice heat and curry flavor. The pad thai was a bit sweet I thought, but the person who ordered it really liked it.

Portion sizes are not enormous. We had some leftovers but also didn't come in starving.

Good service, very attentive. The noise level was the only negative.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food was excellent, with the pad see ew receiving great reviews. The King and I stir fry had a nice heat and curry flavor. However, the noise level was a major issue, as we had to shout to hear each other at our corner table. If the restaurant could improve on this, it would receive more stars. The pad thai was a bit sweet, but still enjoyed by the person who ordered it. Portion sizes were moderate, leaving us with some leftovers but also not leaving us hungry. The service was good and very attentive, with the noise level being the only downside.

input:
***Please note that if you lose something valuable you may not get it back. The person who may clean the vehicle may be a thief. I left in the car my radar detector complete with a case not logged in to their lost and found. When I check in my rental on 12/21 and returned 01/02/2018 to visit the counter they told me nothing was found. They also told me that for something with a case go missing was very unlikely. Yet they found nothing. Hmmm, I wonder how it can go missing when it was the only place I left it? I filed a lost ticket with them; Reference Number: 4355421, Reported: 12/21/2017.

They may think their employees may be honest but my $300 radar detector is nowhere to be found at their location. So? Yes, one of their employee's stole it. 

I'm a fan of the concept of picking your car. As someone who has been using the same rental place in St. Louis Airport for 8 months and counting. I can tell you they do lousy job at cleaning the cars. I'm always finding plastic bottles underneath the back seats.

I'm also finding a lot un-wiped of front seat and dashboard areas full of sticky substances. The cars are never fully clean as someone who rents from them weekly.

This location does a shitty job of making cars ready for travel. As someone who has access to the execute cars due to the amount of travel I do. They fail to meet some simple travel requirements you expect when you rent. 

Next time you rent look underneath the seats in the passenger areas and you may find plastic bottle under them.

I would love for them to review the cameras and see who cleaned the car so they can fire them on the day I returned the rental! I brought them thousand of dollars and I do expect a refund for the stolen item.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Please be aware that there is a possibility of losing valuable items, as individuals who clean vehicles may potentially be thieves. On 12/21/2017, I left my radar detector, along with its case, in the car without logging it into their lost and found. When I checked in my rental on 12/21 and returned on 01/02/2018, the counter staff informed me that nothing was found, despite the improbability of a cased item going missing. I filed a lost ticket with reference number 4355421 on the same day. It seems likely that one of their employees stole my $300 radar detector. I have noticed that the rental place in St. Louis Airport, where I have been a regular customer for 8 months, does a poor job of cleaning the cars. I frequently find plastic bottles under the back seats and the front seat and dashboard areas are often unclean and sticky. As someone who rents from them regularly, I have come to expect better cleanliness standards. I urge future renters to inspect the passenger areas for any hidden items, such as plastic bottles under the seats. I request that the rental place review their security cameras to identify the person who cleaned the car and take appropriate action. Considering the significant amount of money I have spent with them, I expect them to provide a refund for the stolen item.

input: This place is so great. I love the laid back atmosphere. Walked right in with our dog and were seating on the cozy wrap around porch outside. We ate here the last morning of our trip and it was the perfect ending. I stayed full long enough to get me through and 8 hour car ride home! I had the bananas foster French toast which was amazing but super rich. I couldn't eat it all because of the portion size and richness. My fiancé opted for the healthier choice of a vegetable omelet which was delicious as well. I can't wait to come back here and try something else on the menu. I will definitely try one of their famous juices next time.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is amazing with a laid back atmosphere. We walked in with our dog and sat on the cozy porch. It was the perfect ending to our trip. The bananas foster French toast was incredibly delicious but rich. The portion size was big, so I couldn't finish it all. My fiancé had a tasty vegetable omelet as a healthier option. I look forward to coming back and trying something else from their menu, specifically their famous juices.

input: The food here is delicious and the portions are amazing for the price.  The girl who works behind the counter is an absolute sweetheart.  Always smiling and happy.   I wish I worked closer so I could come more often.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food is delicious with generous portions for the price. The girl behind the counter is always friendly, smiling, and happy. I wish I could visit more frequently if I worked closer.

input: Nice scenery of nature. Great trail for running, walking, hiking and biking. Plenty of places to sit for a short break along the way.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Beautiful natural scenery, ideal for running, walking, hiking, and biking, with ample seating areas for quick rest stops.

input: Really truly slow service.  Not the waitress. The kitchen. 40 min to get a pasta and salad.  Recommended if you want to really drag that date out.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The service was incredibly slow, specifically in the kitchen, resulting in a 40-minute wait for a pasta and salad. This experience is recommended for those who want to prolong their date.

input: This place is wonderful! Obviously the chips, salsa and beans are yummy, but get the guacamole too! The chimichanga bites are fantastic, whatever the sauce is that comes with them is super good! For dinner, the street tacos are amazing, so are the enchiladas. They don't have a full bar, but you can still get a real margarita, and they pack a punch! They make them at their other location and bring them over, which is clever, because this location doesn't yet have its liquor license. Overall 4 out 5 stars because it's a good Mexican restaurant, but 5 stars is reserved for my most favorites only. Close second though, and we love that it's right downtown. Oh, and the service... very good! We usually always have the same server, and she is very nice and attentive.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is wonderful! The chips, salsa, and beans are yummy. Don't forget to try the guacamole. The chimichanga bites are fantastic, especially with the delicious sauce. For dinner, the street tacos and enchiladas are amazing. They offer real margaritas that pack a punch, although they are made at their other location since this one doesn't have a liquor license yet. Overall, it's a good Mexican restaurant, earning 4 out of 5 stars. The location is right downtown, which is convenient. The service is very good, with a friendly and attentive server we usually have.

input: Holy _____! Good rolls. Great service. Good prices. Lots of healthy options. Try the sushi. It worth every penny!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Amazing rolls. Great service. Affordable prices. Abundance of healthy options. Don't miss out on the exceptional sushi - worth every penny!

input: We had an excellent lunch here. The food was great and the service was fantastic. Great Gumbo Ya Ya, great BBQ shrimp, delicious crab cakes. Everything we tried was good. I highly recommend this place.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Highly recommend this place for excellent lunch with great food (including Gumbo Ya Ya, BBQ shrimp, and delicious crab cakes) and fantastic service.

input:
Wow! What a workout you get in 20 minutes. 
I didnt believe it until I tried it. Now I'm hooked and feeling better than I have in a long time!!!
Ask for Chelsey. She is great to work with!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Wow! In just 20 minutes, you get an amazing workout. I was skeptical at first, but after trying it, I'm now hooked and feeling better than ever! Chelsey is an excellent instructor to work with too!

input:
Atmosphere is adorable (5 stars!) and location is outstanding (5 stars!) but since food is likely why you would venture to a restaurant, they get an overall rating of 3.  Got a smoked turkey club and it was mostly good (loved that it came with 2 sides)... the meat just wasn't awesome. The creamed spinach was good, but the mac n cheese was kind of dry and bland (disappointing since it was an upcharge).
Not giving up on this place yet, I'm determined to go back and try something else because I want to love it.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Highly rated atmosphere and location (5 stars each), but an overall rating of 3 due to mediocre food. The smoked turkey club was alright, although the meat wasn't impressive. The creamed spinach was good, but the mac n cheese was dry and bland, despite being an additional cost. Despite this, the person is not giving up on the restaurant and plans to try something different in order to potentially develop an affection for it.

input: Had brunch on NYE weekend. The decor is wonderful, you feel cozy the my minute you walk in. Ordered the Eggs Veney and didn't regret that decision because the whole plate was devoured in a matter of minutes. Great food, and a great experience!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Brunch on NYE weekend, with amazing decor and a cozy ambiance from the moment you enter. The Eggs Veney were ordered and devoured within minutes due to their deliciousness. Overall, a great food and dining experience.

input: As a fan of the late night kabab, shwarma or gyro in nyc, I made a stop through Ali ba ba's on one occasion and ended up here again near the end of the trip as it hits the spot!  They are bigger in size of the ones I get in NYC and double the price ($6) but I can imagine the cost is a factor of limited demand (small lines) and pallets in NOLA for a gyro vs a po boy.  They only have rooster sauce for hot sauce which is a knock and they can be slow to serve but the gyros are better than the $5 slice next door or the $5+ lucky dogs on the corner.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I'm a fan of late night kabab, shwarma, or gyro in NYC. I visited Ali ba ba's once and ended up going back near the end of my trip because it satisfies my cravings. The gyros here are bigger in size compared to the ones in NYC but they are also double the price at $6. I believe the higher cost is due to limited demand and the fact that gyros are not as popular as po boys in NOLA. The restaurant only has rooster sauce as hot sauce, which is a downside. The service can be slow, but the gyros here are better than the $5 slices at the neighboring pizza place or the $5+ hot dogs on the corner.

input:
Great food!
Amazing customer service!
A hidden gem within the community, and great location.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great food, amazing customer service, hidden gem within the community, and great location.

input: This place is amazing. First time I have tried Turkish coffee and LOVED it here. The veggie wrap and cheese steak is also great. This place gives off great vibes, there is an entire cafe section within the restaurant. I will definitely make sure to come back to this place if I am in West Philly ever again. 5 stars.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had an amazing experience at this place. Tried Turkish coffee for the first time and absolutely loved it. The veggie wrap and cheese steak were also great. The restaurant has a wonderful cafe section with great vibes. I will definitely return if I'm ever in West Philly again. 5 stars.

input:
I LOVE JONES. Honestly.....

I was introduced to Jones at the YEE earlier this year. The food was divine. Comfort food to the max. Mac and Cheese that I could've eaten with a ladle, sliders, pigs in a blanket, delicious cocktails. Yum yum gimme some.

We came back with my mother and fell in love again. The calamari is the best calamari I've had in quite some time. Perfectly crisp, not rubbery, full of flavor. Yum.

For dessert? I had the Duncan Hines slice of yellow cake and glass of milk. Genius.

We came back AGAIN a few weeks ago when a friend was visiting from LA. I had the Seared Ahi Tuna. The husband had the Halibut. Our friend had the Roast Beef Dinner. Our friend won when it came to food selection. My belly was so warm and happy after one bite of his roast beef. The meat was succulent, juicy, the perfect medium rare. The mashed taters were creamy with a slight hint of garlic. Mmmm.

I preferred my husband's halibut over my tuna. The tuna was good, but the halibut had more flavor, IMO.

Can't wait to go back again. Yum yum yum.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love Jones. YEE introduced me to their divine comfort food - mac and cheese, sliders, pigs in a blanket, and delicious cocktails. The calamari was the best I've had in a while, perfectly crisp and full of flavor. Dessert was a slice of yellow cake and milk, genius. On another visit, I had the Seared Ahi Tuna and preferred my husband's Halibut. Can't wait to go back. Yum!

input: The Penang chicken with the chicken flavor infused white rice will always be one of my favorite meals. Wether in Boston or in Philly, the quality is the same and I am a huge fan. When we came in the line was very long but surprisingly we were sat in about 15-20 minutes. The service was fast from start to finish so I didn't have to wait long before I could start eating the juicy amazing chicken. I was planning on getting an order to go to drive back to Virginia to eat but that seemed greedy so I didn't. I regretted that decision the second I got back home so next time, I will be greedy!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The Penang chicken with chicken flavor infused white rice is always one of my favorite meals. Whether in Boston or Philly, the quality is consistently excellent. Despite the long line, we were seated surprisingly fast within 15-20 minutes. The service was efficient, allowing me to quickly enjoy the juicy and amazing chicken. I initially considered getting a takeout order to enjoy back in Virginia but decided against it, which I quickly regretted. Next time, I will satisfy my craving and be a bit more indulgent!

input: To long of an unnecessary wait, especially when all your tables and areas are not filled.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The wait is too long, even though there are empty tables and areas.

input:
Awesome I can't wait to go again next year best attraction around.
Almost feels real in some of the houses.
Haunted hayride was spectacular with fire torches machine guns chainsaws Churches demonic preist.
Walking in the woods with a little glow stick is awesome and scary.Very real feeling.
FORGET bush gardens howl o scream and haloween horror nights all you need is screamagedon.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Screamagedon is an incredible attraction that I can't wait to revisit next year. Some of the houses are so realistic, it feels like you're actually there. The haunted hayride is especially spectacular, featuring fire torches, machine guns, chainsaws, churches, and a demonic priest. Walking through the woods with just a glow stick adds to the awesomely scary atmosphere. Forget about Bush Gardens' Howl-O-Scream and Halloween Horror Nights; Screamagedon is all you need for a thrilling Halloween experience.

input:
Excellent service. Sent a request online and within 30-45 mins had a call back. Got the spot scheduled. Shanna was Prompt on arrival, very informative with prevention and such.
Checked both mine and my daughters head. Full treatment on both. 
It is a bit pricey but I already had one round and was over it all. The off the shelf stuff just doesn't work. 
The comb they use is not available in stores and gathers the nits way better. 
Only complaint is the comb should be included in the session not extra. I bought it cause I wanted to have the proper tools in case of a next time.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Received excellent service after submitting a request online and receiving a call back within 30-45 minutes. Shanna was punctual and provided informative prevention advice. Both mine and my daughter's heads were carefully checked and treated. Although a bit pricey, previous attempts with over-the-counter products were ineffective. The specially designed comb used by the service is not sold in stores and effectively removes nits. My only complaint is that the comb should be included in the session instead of being an additional fee. However, I purchased it for future use.

input:

input: Took forever to deliver and I am just blocks away. They claim one driver had ten orders to deliver, ridiculous! After the almost two hour wait, WHAT A DISAPPOINTMENT!! input: Ok yeah, the service can be a little high falutin', and the wait is painful but this is THE BEST BURGER EVER.  That's all you need to know.  The BEST.

Disregard the untrue comment from OTTIS B., who may have had a personal issue. The owners strive to ensure customer satisfaction.

input:
I purchased a used 09 Rav4 from Glanzmann Subaru last month. Coming from TN, I chose to purchase this vehicle from Glanzmann due to its limited availability and attractive price. I communicated with sales on numerous occasions before committing to purchase from Glanzmann nearly 1000 miles from home.

The process was overall quite simple, though I felt we could have gotten alot more done regarding interstate complications prior to completing travel plans to purchase the vehicle. My only actual complaint stems from the vehicle's description. As an out of state buyer, I was at the mercy of the sales team to accurately describe and depict any conditional issues that might be of interest to a prospective buyer. Unfortunately, none of the issues with this vehicle were highlighted, depicted, described, or otherwise demonstrated throughout the entire sales process. I even asked the sales agent to, while on the phone, inspect the vehicle and describe any possible imperfection so that I could have no surprises upon arrival. I spent several hundred dollars in travel expenses to collect this vehicle, only to discover there were a number of aesthetic defects that deserved attention (large dents, cracked paint, cuts in leather). I had limited time and opportunity to react to these conditional flaws and purchased the vehicle - I had already flown from Nashville to Philadelphia! 

This is obviously a small family-owned dealership. I expected a considerably more honest and direct interaction and was disappointed with the outcome. The automobile is a fine machine, but the defects certainly take away from the value. Mr. Jeff Glanzmann, I implore you to make honesty your #1 policy.  I had the opportunity to purchase the same vehicle, with honestly similar defects, from a dealership in Atlanta for the same price. I opted to purchase yours, incurring not-insignificant travel expenses, because of it's immaculate description.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I purchased a used 09 Rav4 from Glanzmann Subaru last month after choosing to buy from them due to limited availability and attractive price. Despite communicating with the sales team multiple times before committing to the purchase, I feel that more could have been done to address interstate complications prior to finalizing travel plans. My only complaint is regarding the vehicle's description, as none of the issues with the car were accurately highlighted or depicted during the sales process. I even asked for an inspection over the phone to avoid any surprises upon arrival, but when I collected the vehicle, I discovered several aesthetic defects such as large dents, cracked paint, and cuts in the leather. As a result, I had limited opportunity to address these flaws and still purchased the vehicle after spending a significant amount on travel expenses. I expected a more honest and direct interaction from this small family-owned dealership and was disappointed with the outcome. While the car itself is fine, the defects greatly diminish its value. I urge Mr. Jeff Glanzmann to prioritize honesty as their #1 policy, as I had the chance to buy a similar vehicle with similar defects from a dealership in Atlanta for the same price but chose Glanzmann Subaru because of their supposedly impeccable description.

input:

input:
My girlfriends and I ate at the Creole House for dinner. Our decision to dine here was largely based on the fact that it was pouring raining and this restaurant is next door to our hotel. We started with the bacon garlic oysters and jumbo buffalo wings. The bacon garlic oysters were average, at best. The oysters were overpowered by the cheese and bacon, which was disappointing. The buffalo wings were pretty good and seasoned well. For entrees, we ordered: 1) jumbalaya pasta, 2) blackened red fish and 3) canal street red fish. The jumbalaya pasta lacked flavor and was our least favorite (would not order again). The blackened red fish was just okay and the skimpy side of sautéed veggies (spinach, tomatoes, mushrooms) were VERY salty (would order again as a LAST resort). The canal street red fish wasn't great but my friend would order it again. Her biggest complaint was that it had very little garlic sauce. We also ordered paddle boat drinks, which tasted good but were more juice vs alcohol (had to order an extra shot).

So, overall, we were underwhelmed with the food, making it a solid 3 stars. On a positive note, our server, Alexander, was great...very hospitable and tried his best to make sure we were satisfied.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My girlfriends and I ate at the Creole House, basing our decision on its proximity to our hotel during a rainstorm. We started with bacon garlic oysters and jumbo buffalo wings. The oysters were disappointing, overpowered by cheese and bacon. The buffalo wings were good. For entrees, we had jumbalaya pasta, blackened red fish, and canal street red fish. The pasta lacked flavor and was our least favorite, while the blackened red fish and its salty sautéed veggies were okay. The canal street red fish wasn't great, lacking garlic sauce. We ordered paddle boat drinks that tasted good but had little alcohol. Overall, we were underwhelmed with the food, rating it 3 stars. Our server, Alexander, was hospitable and tried his best to ensure satisfaction.

input:
Okay, don't jump on me for this, but its partially my fault because I held them to such high expectations (due to the hype and anticipation of them opening up here) before actually eating at this location. I read so much about it on Facebook and the likes......so reading and seeing the yummy pics; well I just knew it would be all that.....untill yesterday.....

Me and my bf Vince went to BlackFinn for Sunday lunch yesterday. The atmosphere was cool and it was really nice inside. The staff was pleasant as well, so I'm thinking "hum...I like...". We ordered  a couple of mojitos and we also had another drink, which was okay.  Time to order; I ordered the Cuban sandwich, hold the mustard, and add mayo instead....with Black Finn fries and my bf ordered the Prime Rib sandwich with au jus and the same fries.  We got our order, which took a bit of time but it was okay. Everything looked so yummy and I knew they were going to meet my expectations. Now mind ya, my bf put off going to BlackFinn since they day they opened and I've been on him to go here. So anyway, the fries were a bit salty, but good. I had a choice of two dipping sauces, which I believe were ranch and barbeque. Delicious! I bit into the sandwich and what did I taste? A mouth full of mustard!!! Eeewww!! Okay, did I not say "hold the mustard"? So lo and behold, my food had to be returned while my bf ate his food. His beef about his sandwich (no pun intended) was that there was more bread than meat. I looked at it and I noticed the same thing. Also, the au jus was a bit low as well and wasn't enough for the sandwich.  So I'm like the little old lady from the back-in-the-day commercials saying "Where's the beef?" LOL. Wow! 

Finally, after he finishes his sandwich, my food finally comes out and guess what? They left the swiss cheese off the sandwich. WTF! Okay, so at this point I'm like "forget it, just take it back." How many times must I send my sandwich back to get it right? Now I must say that the manager on duty was accommodating and she took care of the check and apolgized for the errors. So for her professionalism and the fact that the staff was very polite, I give them two stars. Will I go back....yes I will give them another chance to redeem themselves, but all in my ear is my bf saying that there must have been a reason why he hesitated to come here and this is why.  Oh well......
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had high expectations for BlackFinn based on the hype and anticipation, but I was disappointed after finally eating there. The atmosphere and staff were pleasant, but the food had some issues. The fries were salty, my Cuban sandwich had mustard despite my request to hold it, and my boyfriend's Prime Rib sandwich had too much bread and not enough meat. Additionally, his sandwich was low on au jus. My sandwich had swiss cheese missing. However, the manager was accommodating and took care of the bill. I give them two stars for their polite staff and the manager's professionalism. Despite this experience, I will give them another chance to redeem themselves.

input:

input:
I have to start out by saying, why do those who like hookah not know about this place?! It was such a wonderful experience! Please hear me out!

My mission on this review is to get the word out! A friend and I went spur of the moment and I'm glad we did. From the outside of the building you wouldn't know it was a hookah bar (except the giant sign of course lol). The moment you open that giant wooden door, the decor and paint color gives it that authentic look. Warm yellow paint with evil eyes and giant metal wall lamps with cutouts shining red surrounding all the walls.
When you go up a few steps there's a gift shop, a table, and the register. They ask you to take a seat upstairs and they follow you shortly after. (There's even another upstairs that I barely peaked at).
This is the amazing part: cushions on the floor with giant metal mandala tables!!!! It was so authentic I could barely handle my excitement. They have a menu with drinks, food and hookah. Water was only a dollar which was amazing because hookah bars are usually pretty pricy.
We smoked "sex on the beach" flavored shisha. It was smooth! Very smooth! We even brought bubbles for the trip to have a little fun :)
What I like about this place compared to other loud hookah bars is that it wasn't even close to being hectic. I felt like I should have whispered at first, but after awhile I was more comfortable. Only one other couple was there and they were very nice to talk to as well. The older man and the young guy was extremely nice. The younger dude checked in on us and was sociable which was really kinda nice but not overbearing. 

If you want a low key, quiet and chill hookah bar, this should be at the top of people's lists.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I highly recommend this hookah bar for its authentic and cozy atmosphere. The place is beautifully decorated with warm yellow walls, metal wall lamps, and a giant wooden door. The menu offers a variety of drinks, food, and hookah options, with water priced at only one dollar. I especially enjoyed the smooth "sex on the beach" flavored shisha. Unlike other loud hookah bars, this place was calm and quiet, creating a low-key and relaxing experience. The staff was friendly and sociable, without being overbearing. If you're looking for a peaceful and enjoyable hookah experience, this should be your top choice.

input:

Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I tried takoyaki for the first time and ordered the original. I was served 6 deep fried balls which were tasty but doughy and left a greasy feeling. I needed to be drunk to really enjoy the grease. Worth a try for a first timer, but they are heavy. The curry chicken was disappointing as the roux was too rich for my taste. It's worth another trip for Japanese fast food, but not the best I've had.

input:
3.50 stars.  

Gabby's wasn't open.  I knew that.  Neither was Rotier's.  But my handy Yelp app had assured me that Fido's was open.  Imagine the disappointment when I realized there was a very real possibility that no burgers would happen on this trip down to the Deep South.  Would I really have to wait two more weeks when I would find solace in East Texas?   

"We can try Burger up," I mentioned.  

"Why don't you just call them?" hissed the appropriately nicknamed Viper.  

True.  We didn't have to keep driving around aimlessly.  So I call Burger Up, and a very pleasant, sweet voice assures me they are indeed open.  

Viper: "What was her name?  She sounded hot."
  
Me: "Paige."

Viper: "Yeah, she's definitely hot.  Have you ever met an unattractive Paige?"

Me: "Good point.  At least we have that going for us."

Paige was indeed attractive, but this review isn't about a photogenic individual who happens to work at Burger Up.  It's about what ended up being a visit to our fourth choice for burgers in Nashville.  

Burger Up follows a national trend towards upscale burgers.  My particular order consisted of a medium rare patty served with aged cheddar, Benton's bacon (very good), and ketchup served on an artisan bun.  Basically, it was a gussied up bacon cheeseburger, but it was a rather tasty one.  My major complaint is that I wish the actual meat itself exhibited more flavor.  Having said that, the burger was cooked properly and the flavors worked well together.  I ordered some wilted spinach on the side (mediocre) and truffle fries.  Let's talk about those truffle fries for a bit.  I know more people are apparently into the sweet potato fries here, but I think they are missing the boat.  Burger Up's truffle tries have pleasant aroma, taste great, and are the perfect texture for soaking up oil.  If you are on a diet, it is true you should skip these delightful fries.  But if that were the case, why are you at a burger joint in the first place?  Seriously, if you get nothing else out of my review, please do yourself a favor and order the truffle fries.  

Burger Up also boast an interesting beer menu with semi-obscure breweries from the Deep South included in the list.  I tried a pecan-infused amber from Mississippi - not bad.  I could imagine Burger Up could be a decent place to drink for a bit after eating.  

If I attended Vanderbilt, I would probably go here on a moderately frequent basis.  If you want a change from the dive bar hamburger, Burger Up is a decent change of pace.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Burger Up in Nashville, with a rating of 3.50 stars, was our fourth choice for burgers. They offer upscale burgers with flavorful toppings, although the meat itself could have had more flavor. The truffle fries are highly recommended, and they have an interesting beer menu. Overall, Burger Up is a decent option for those looking for a change from traditional dive bar hamburgers.

input:
I went to my first BarreAmped class at the Music Row location (I've also been to bounce class - on a trampoline - at the Nations location), and it was a great class: definitely a better workout and a better experience than some of the barre classes I've taken in town since moving to Nashville in July. Had a very family vibe - everyone knew each other in my class except for me (a Class Pass-er trying it out for the first time). Great instructor - very hands on. 

The room is TINY, but luckily there were only six or seven of us in the class (it was a random class in the middle of the day on a weekday). The room is oddly shaped and very small, so if the class was full, I'm sure I would have been hitting everyone else with my arms and legs every 30 seconds. Another frustrating thing? BarreAmped is located within a house on 16th that is also a gym. The building does not say BarreAmped on it! No sign at all! It was my first time coming to this location, and I drove right past it and had to circle around to find it. Then, when I walked inside, no one was at the welcome desk, so I wasn't even sure I was in the right building! Finally someone came in (looked like something using the gym rather than working there), and she told me the BarreAmped room was the up the stairs. A bit confusing. I wish that information had been on Class Pass and that they had a sign on the building.

Still it was a great class, and I think I'd go again!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I attended my first BarreAmped class at the Music Row location and compared to other barre classes I've taken since moving to Nashville in July, it was a better workout and experience. The class had a friendly atmosphere and the instructor was very attentive. Although the room was small and oddly shaped, there were only six or seven people in the class so it didn't feel cramped. The location itself was a bit confusing as BarreAmped is within a house on 16th with no visible signage. Finding the entrance and the check-in area was a bit challenging, but overall it was a great class and I would consider going again.

input: Muriel's is a great stop in NOLA. The goat cheese and shrimp crepes are by far the best food I ate in the city (perhaps anywhere ever) and the rest of the meal lived up to the appetizer. Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Muriel's in NOLA is a must-visit. Their goat cheese and shrimp crepes are the best food I've had in the city (possibly ever). The rest of the meal was equally impressive and the service was great. The venue has a wonderful French Quarter vibe. Despite being a bit distracting to have ghost tours outside the window during dinner, the delicious food makes it worth the slight distraction. While there are rumors of Muriel's being haunted, the only otherworldly experience I had was with the cuisine.

input: Went to this Taco Bell last night.  It was 1 30 and it said 30 minutes to close.  All the lights were on.  We backed up and forward twice and no one would wait on us.  We gave up and pulled up young man was at window closing  register.  Taco Bell was happy to serve us.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Last night, I went to Taco Bell at 1:30 am, and saw that they were closing in 30 minutes. Despite all the lights being on, we couldn't get any service when we tried going through the drive-thru. Feeling frustrated, we decided to leave. However, as we were about to pull away, a young man appeared at the window and happily served us.

input: Cute place to eat at. Ate breakfast here and was dissappointed after seeing such good reviews. Breakfast menu is very limited. The omlet was just OK.  Biscuit didnt have much flavor to it. We were able to be seated really quick (during the week) but i imagine it getting really crowded during the weekends.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Cute place to eat at, but disappointing after reading good reviews. Limited breakfast menu; ok omelet and bland biscuit. Quick seating on weekdays, but likely crowded on weekends.

input:
Probably the most expensive game in town. But totally worth it for me. I upgraded myself to the executive locker rooms because that gives me zero excuses for why I can't go to the gym before work or after if I am going out later that night. I always have my makeup, hair stuff, etc in my locker. Just getting back to the gym after a long absence due to health issues so I'm taking it slow. I've seen one or two machines that are not quite working right but the facility as a whole is pretty sharp & welcoming. You have tons of options of what to do classes wise, equipment wise...
My only 2 down sides are that I wish they were open a little later on weekends, but that's just me moving slowly on my time off. I wish there was a bit more ritation with the class schedule. There are classes I'd like to take but they always run mid day, never really early, after work or weekends. So no option to try them. I'm sure it's an instructor issue so not likely something that will change. Overall I'm super happy that I joined.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The gym I joined is probably the most expensive in town, but it's worth every penny. I upgraded to the executive locker rooms, which eliminates any excuses for not going to the gym before or after work or social events. I always have my makeup and hair supplies stored in my locker. I recently returned to the gym after a long absence due to health issues, so I'm taking it easy. Some machines need fixing, but overall, the facility is impressive and welcoming, offering a variety of classes and equipment. My only complaints are that the gym should have longer weekend hours, and I wish the class schedule was more flexible. However, these issues are likely due to instructor availability and are unlikely to change. Despite these minor drawbacks, I am extremely happy with my decision to join.

input:
A++ 
I have to say, this place is great and one of the biggest reasons why is their bar staff. There is a bartender named "Ally". She is always kind and attentive. Everyone can be crammed at the bar, and the employees running around like their hair is on fire, and Ally still treats you like you're her only customer. 
Cool vibe, great indoor and outdoor seating. Great addition to the Funk Zone.
Definitely go!!
PS: Say hi to Ally for me :-)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: A++ - This place is great! The bar staff, especially bartender Ally, is always kind and attentive. The atmosphere is cool, with indoor and outdoor seating. A wonderful addition to the Funk Zone. Definitely worth a visit! PS: Say hi to Ally for me :-)

input: Not to bad. I sat at the bar and the bartender was awesome. The lunch menu here is very decent and the beer is ice cold.  I usually come during lunch when it isn't to congested. So, to get consistent service,  go when it isn't to congested. I will definitely go back?
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The bar was great, with an awesome bartender. The lunch menu is good and the beer is cold. Going during less busy times ensures consistent service. I will definitely return.

input: The only knock on this place is that they didn't have all the pools open during Memorial Day weekend. Other than that the hotel provides a very friendly environment that's good for adults and families as well plenty of places to eat inside the resort and the atrium was amazing and really fun to explore. Little far from town but a good middle point between music row and the airport. Hotel staff was top notch and the place was clean while still having that old charm. I'd stay here again in a heart beat next time I visit Nashville.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The only issue at this place was that not all the pools were open during Memorial Day weekend. However, the hotel is known for its friendly environment suitable for both adults and families. There are plenty of dining options within the resort and the atrium is a fantastic and enjoyable place to explore. The location is a bit far from town, but it serves as a convenient middle point between music row and the airport. The hotel staff is excellent and the place is clean, while still maintaining its old charm. I would definitely stay here again without hesitation on my next visit to Nashville.

input:
Great treat to beat the heat! I stopped in during the Manayunk Arts Festival yesterday to get a cold refreshing treat and I was very pleased with the service and the quality of the fresh frozen yogurt and toppings.

It is a self service fro-yo establishment with countless options of flavors and toppings. I enjoyed the toasted coconut yogurt and topped it with rainbow sprinkles, fresh strawberries, blueberries and raspberries. The fruit was very refreshing but it was hard to select what to put on it because everything looked so yummy. If you are a chocolate lover there are plenty of candy toppings to add to your fro-yo too. 

If you are not sure what flavor you will enjoy best you can sample them with small paper cups that so you don't have to find out if you like the flavor or not after you already purchase! 

Another plus is that the establishment is kept very clean and it still looks as new as it did when it first opening on Main Street just a couple of years ago!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a great experience at a self-service fro-yo establishment during the Manayunk Arts Festival. The service was excellent and the fresh frozen yogurt and toppings were of high quality. There were numerous flavor and topping options to choose from. I particularly enjoyed the toasted coconut yogurt and various fresh fruits like strawberries, blueberries, and raspberries. The establishment also has a wide selection of candy toppings for chocolate lovers. Additionally, they offer sample cups to help customers decide on their preferred flavors. Lastly, the place is well-maintained and still looks new despite being open for a few years on Main Street.

input: I think the trendiness of this chain, in general, has sort of faded and what you have left is the basis of this chain, which is over-priced food of a questionable quality. I wouldn't call it bad, but it's a whole lot of fried food and most of the breadings, whether it's fried pickles or okra or calamari or shrimp, are the same across all of that. The batter is fine, but it gets wearing. The coconut shrimp and hush puppies were definitely overcooked, which was kind of disappointing. Coke Zero on tap, but the mix could be better. For the price, it is also worth nothing there is a ton of food here, definitely quantity over quality. Décor is pretty cool and this is parked right along the Boise river, though it's a bit tucked away and has to be more or less sought out...probably worth hitting at least once, but there are far better local places that are more worthy of attention.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The trendy appeal of this chain has faded, leaving behind overpriced and questionably quality food. Most of the fried dishes have the same breading, making it monotonous. The coconut shrimp and hush puppies were disappointingly overcooked. The mix for Coke Zero on tap could be improved. While the portion sizes are large, the overall quality doesn't match the price. The decor is nice, located by the Boise river, although it's somewhat hidden and requires effort to find. It might be worth trying once, but there are better local places deserving of attention.

input:
There are bars you can still smoke in?! Yuck. Sorry smokers (I used to be one so I get it) but yuck. The stink of smoke in my hair woke me up in the middle of the night after stopping in here and was so bad I had to get up to wash it before I could get back to sleep. That's not good.

Definitely a dive, this bar is very dim and smokey. The bartender was friendly and came to take my order as soon as I walked up to the bar. The bloody mary I ordered wasn't that great or strong, though.  That's not good either.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: There are still bars where smoking is allowed. I personally find it unpleasant due to the smell of smoke. I used to be a smoker myself, so I can understand it. The stench of smoke in my hair woke me up during the night after visiting one of these bars. It was so bothersome that I had to wash my hair before I could go back to sleep. This bar is definitely a dive, with dim lighting and a smoky atmosphere. The bartender was friendly and took my order promptly. However, the bloody mary I ordered was not impressive or potent. That's quite disappointing.

input: Got there mid-morning today, the early rush was over. Two tables were full, each with three people. The family in one of the tables had just walked in ahead of me, so they were being attended to first. Still, I was immediately welcomed, and in a couple of minutes a friendly lady brought the breakfast menu and asked if I wanted coffee. A cup appeared a few moments later, and was kept full throughout my visit. Radio playing golden oldies from the 70s, my kind of music.
