Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Average bar/restaurant with typical menu offerings. Food was satisfactory, while service was exceptional.

input: We came here based on the recommendation we received and from the street it doesn't look like much. But when you sit down and you scan the menu you will come to realize that this place serves nothing but home-cooked comfort food. We had the BLT and it was packed full of flavor, they didn't scrimp on the bacon and the vegetables for very fresh. With the sandwiches came some of the best french fries that we've had, and some of the best coleslaw that I've had in the state of Florida. We took a couple of pies home and they were delicious. We will definitely come back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite its unimpressive exterior, this place is highly recommended and serves delectable home-cooked comfort food. The BLT sandwich was bursting with flavor and generous with bacon and fresh vegetables. The accompanying fries and coleslaw were exceptional. We also tried their delightful pies and will definitely return for more.

input: I was greated by a nice friendly staff. There wasnt a long wait for my food. I ordered a chicken bacon croissant with chipolte sauce. They cut it in half as requested and was served in maybe only 20 seconds after the time it took to cook. Food taste great
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Staff was friendly and efficient. No long wait for food. Ordered a chicken bacon croissant with chipotle sauce, which was promptly served after a quick cook time. The food tasted great.

input: Excellent food! I am a Thai food junkie, and have travelled to Thailand and throughout Southeast Asia several times. There is ok Thai food in Nashville and then there is Great Thai food. This place was GREAT! The decor is a little dated but who cares...I was there for the food, which is fabulous!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food at this place is excellent and the best Thai food in Nashville. Despite the slightly dated decor, I highly recommend it as the food is fabulous.

input: This place is absolutely fantastic. I honesty really don't even like sweets and am not all that into donuts but this place will make you a believer. The apple fritter is amazingly delicious and you can't go wrong with a chocolate long john. Don't even bother with any other donut shops in stl.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is amazing, even if you're not into sweets or donuts. The apple fritter and chocolate long john here are delicious. No need to try any other donut shops in St. Louis.

input: Of all the restaurants we tried in New Orleans, this was by far our favorite. I had both lunch and dinner on two separate occasions. The service was wonderful, the ambiance is cozy but alive. Make sure to call ahead and get a reservation over the phone if opentable looks booked. Their lunch special spicy fried chicken is a must have! If you are a party of two or three, ask for the corner booth by the window. Best table in the house.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This was our favorite restaurant out of all the ones we tried in New Orleans. We had lunch and dinner on separate occasions. The service was excellent and the ambiance was cozy yet lively. Be sure to call ahead for a reservation if opentable is full. Their lunch special spicy fried chicken is a must-try. For parties of two or three, request the corner booth by the window, it's the best table in the house.

input:
City Parkの近くにある激安かき氷屋さん。シェーブドアイスっていったほうがいいね！
特に夏のニューオーリンズはジメジメして暑いから、公園に行った後にここでかき氷とか最高だと思う！

味の種類は半端なく多いです！50以上はあったはず！
そしてなんといっても安い！ぼくは一番安いチョイスのレギュラーかき氷のスモールを頼みましたが、スモールでも結構十分だと思います。そして値段はたったの$1.50. 安い！！

トッピングをしても５ドル以上はいかないはず。
夏のうだる暑さには、最高のチョイスだと思います！
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: City Parkの近くにある激安のかき氷屋さんがあります。シェーブドアイスって言った方がいいですよ！特に夏のニューオーリンズはジメジメして暑いので、公園で遊んだ後にここでかき氷を食べるのが最高だと思います。味の種類はたくさんあります！50以上あるはずです。そして何より安い！私は一番安いレギュラーサイズのかき氷を頼んだけど、スモールでも十分お腹いっぱいになると思います。しかも値段はたったの$1.50！とても安いです！トッピングをつけても5ドル以下になるはずです。暑い夏には最高の選択だと思います！

input: Mr. X has amazing flavor and overall a pretty friendly staff. The wait time for carry out is on average about 20 minutes, which is way better than a 45 minute wait at chain pizzerias. I get the hand-tossed crust comparable to traditional NY style pizza, and has excellent flavor and texture!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Mr. X offers delicious flavors with a friendly staff. Their carry out wait time is only 20 minutes on average, much faster than chain pizzerias which can take up to 45 minutes. The hand-tossed crust resembles traditional NY style pizza, delivering excellent flavor and texture.

input:
First time being here.  It was a nice place but empty.  Had one old man sitting in there, then us two 40 somethings, then another old man.  That was it.   We came during happy hour, basically waiting for Snake and Jakes to open up so we came here to kill some time.  

Beer selection was nice, Magic Hat, Fat Tire, Blue Moon, etc.  Prices were ok too.

Lotsa dark woods and a few TVs and a lonely but attractive bartender that was very nice.  

Nothing bad to say about this place other than it was kinda dead.  It was very clean looking and nicely decorated, just kinda boring.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: First time here, nice but empty. One old man, us two 40 somethings, and another old man. Came during happy hour, waiting for Snake and Jakes. Beer selection was nice (Magic Hat, Fat Tire, Blue Moon, etc.) and prices were okay. Lots of dark woods, a few TVs, and an attractive bartender. Very clean and nicely decorated, just kind of boring.

input:
i dont know what has happened to the in store service in this place!  We have been down here for a few weeks now and have been here 6 times.Only once was the order completed without a screw up!

Today 2 tall decaf coffees took close to 20 minutes.By then our bagels were cold.First i was told the decaf was "brewing' and then i was told there was something 'wrong" with the brewer? After 15 minutes i was offered a decaf americano.
Before we left i politely told a fellow behind the counter the service was abominable and he said 'well we can only store 2 vente size decafs at a time? HUH? I asked if the management knew about this and he just shrugged.
Clearly this staff has never been trained to make it right for the customer.No apology.No coupon.Just a convoluted story.
 
Amazing how you can have numerous people running around a store but you cant get the simplest order straight My next visit to a Starbucks will certainly not be this one.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The in-store service at this place has been consistently poor. In the few weeks we have been here, we have visited six times and only once was our order completed without any mistakes. Today, it took almost 20 minutes to get two tall decaf coffees, and by the time they arrived, our bagels were already cold. Initially, we were told the decaf was brewing, and then we were informed that there was a problem with the brewer. After 15 minutes, we were offered a decaf americano instead. Before leaving, I politely expressed my disappointment to a staff member, who nonchalantly mentioned that they can only store two vente size decafs at a time. It is evident that the staff at this location lacks proper training and fails to prioritize customer satisfaction. There was no apology or compensation provided, just a convoluted explanation. It is surprising how a store can have multiple employees but still struggle with getting a simple order right. Needless to say, my next visit to Starbucks will not be at this particular location.

input:
As a double date with a good long lost friend for a relaxing evening dinner, we were surprised in early august to not get reservations until 8. 
So we arrived an hour early and had drinks in the lobby while the piano man played beautifully. The bartender was a bit slow at first but kept us well tended. 
Our table in the corner against the glass was ready early and we enjoyed watching the rays chase fish around the bay as the sun set.  
I started with the tasty crab and corn chowder but was a bit disappointed with al dente potatoes in the bowl. 
Wife ordered the scallops which were superb as was my crab stuffed grouper. But my rice was also inadequately cooked. 
Creve brûlée was excellent as was Tim's attentive service. 
Worth going again, but they need to get all the parts of the dishes correct to get 5 stars.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had a double date with a long-lost friend in early August. Unfortunately, we couldn't get reservations until 8, so we arrived an hour early and had drinks in the lobby while enjoying the piano music. The bartender started off a little slow but eventually took good care of us. We were seated at our table by the glass, which gave us a beautiful view of the bay and its lively fish. The crab and corn chowder was tasty, although the potatoes were a letdown. My wife's scallops were superb, and my crab-stuffed grouper was also delicious, except for the undercooked rice. The creve brûlée was excellent, and our server, Tim, provided attentive service. Overall, it was worth another visit, but they need to improve the consistency of their dishes to earn five stars.

input: My wife and I visited this hidden gem today and were not let down. The shop was clean, bright, colorful, and comfortable. We were able to sample all the flavors, listen to the story of how they came about, and walked off with many bags of deliciousness. The owners there were so kind. They took the time to understand exactly what kind of foods we enjoy to match us up with the perfect popcorn. Definitely coming back soon!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We had a great experience at this hidden gem today. The shop was clean, brightly colored, and comfortable. We got to sample all the flavors and learn about their origins. We left with several bags of delicious popcorn. The owners were kind and took the time to find us the perfect match for our taste preferences. We will definitely be returning soon!

input: A really cute new coffee shop in town. We stopped here in the morning to get a much needed caffeine break. Who's warm day so we opted to get an iced coffee. We had many options on the type of milk and sweetener is available. They had limited food items available being mostly donuts this morning. We opted for a piece of the vegan banana bread to share. Iced coffee came out quickly and are banana bread and we went outside to sit with and realize there is no area connected to this restaurant for outdoor seating. The restaurant next-door however was not yet open so we sat at one of their tables thinking no one would mind. It would be nice if the coffee house itself had its own outdoor seating. Are iced coffee was very good and hit the spot. The vegan banana bread was good but seemed very dense to me. I'll be back another time to try some more of the fancy coffee they have available here. I'm hoping that they will add to the food menu as well as a try to not eat donuts most days. Maybe a breakfast sandwich or some other option than a pastry would be good.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: A cute new coffee shop in town provided a much-needed caffeine break on a warm day. We enjoyed various milk and sweetener options for our iced coffee. Although the food options were limited to mostly donuts, we shared a piece of vegan banana bread. However, we discovered there was no outdoor seating connected to the shop, so we sat at a neighboring restaurant's table. The iced coffee and banana bread were satisfying, but the bread was a bit dense. We plan to return to try more of their fancy coffee and hope the menu will expand to offer alternatives to pastries, such as breakfast sandwiches.

input: I went here after a recommendation that this is "the best coffee place in philly" and I'm so glad I checked it out! The cafe area itself is super nice & clean. They also offer tap and sparking water to customers which is awesome. Prices are very reasonable and the staff is super friendly. My friend and I chatted with one of the baristas for a few minutes and he gave us some pro-tips on how to make a killer espresso. I will definitely be coming back here again soon!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I visited this coffee place based on a recommendation as the best in Philly. The cafe area is clean and nice, with the added perk of offering tap and sparkling water. Prices are reasonable and the staff is friendly. We had a great conversation with one of the baristas who shared some valuable tips on making a great espresso. I will definitely be returning soon.

input: It's a college-town bar, what do you expect? Lol. Alcohol, pub/bar food, good tap selection, good atmosphere and specials. A Villanova tradition. It's not an upscale bar, or a great place to grab lunch. It is what it is, a bar!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This college-town bar offers alcohol, pub/bar food, a good tap selection, and creates a great atmosphere with specials. It is part of Villanova tradition. While it may not be upscale or suitable for lunch, it remains true to being a bar in every sense.

input: Great customer service! Mary was a great help- helped me pick out frames and she was extremely personable! From the time I walked in the store, I was greeted with smiles and hellos! I will be back in the future!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Mary provided excellent customer service by assisting me in selecting frames and being personable. The store staff greeted me with smiles and hellos when I entered, creating a positive experience. I intend to return in the future.

input:
Simply stated...They are true to their word as it relates to having discounted furniture that is less expensive than your name brand furniture stores. The staff was friendly, they definitely don't follow you around the store, however, they get a ding for customer service because they don't seem to be as knowledgeable about the furniture products.

Furniture quality is a mix ranging from low to moderate quality.  

At the end of the day, if you are looking for less expensive furniture or to get a good deal or to find a unique accent pieces this is the place to be!  I mean...I saw "the same" sectional for $1,000 less than the name brand store.   Now that's a deal!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Bottom line, this store offers discounted furniture that is cheaper than name brand stores. The staff is friendly but lacking in furniture knowledge. The quality of the furniture varies from low to moderate. Overall, it's a great place to find affordable furniture and unique accent pieces. A standout example is a sectional for $1,000 less than the price at a name brand store, making it a fantastic deal.

input: I have been here numerous times for brunch, dinner and take out during lunch time hours. Staff is always friendly and the food is delicious.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I frequently visit this place for brunch, dinner, and lunch take-out, as it offers friendly staff and incredibly delicious food.

input: Amazing dinner.  What a unique menu.  The service was top notch.  Adrian was our server and she was a delight.  I had the endive and beet salad - lovely.  And then the tongue.  Not what my grandmother made and that's okay.  This was spectacular.  Good wine list and yummy dessert.  The meal was wonderful and I'll be back next time I'm in town.  Bravo!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Incredible dinner with a unique menu. The service was exceptional, particularly Adrian, our delightful server. The endive and beet salad was lovely, and the tongue dish surpassed expectations. The wine selection was great, and the dessert was delicious. Overall, a fantastic meal that will definitely bring me back next time I'm in town. Bravo!

input: Do not waste your time and money on this place. The "food" is what you might expect from a small town Chi-Chi's.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Avoid wasting time and money at this place as the "food" resembles that of a small town Chi-Chi's.

input:
Cozy and family friendly restaurant. I came here for a private engagement party, where the bride and groom to be had arranged for special menus and baked all of their desserts. There were a few booth tables reserved for presents, wine, and desserts. No room for side tables like in an actual special events space.

The wait staff was nice. From the limited menu, I picked the Penne Fellini, which has prosciutto di parma, peas, onions, and light cream sauce. The whole dish was literally this pasta swimming in sauce. It may have had a light cream flavor, but it was ladled heavily onto the pasta. I didn't have a desire to consume an entire meal of this, so I ended up not finishing.

It was a fun celebration, and we were really there for the friends and family, not the food. Oh, and we also had the bruschetta and salad, neither of which was very memorable. I wouldn't be thrilled to come back here, but I think it's awesome that they turned the whole restaurant into a venue for such a special occasion!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Cozy and family-friendly restaurant with limited menu options. Attended a private engagement party where the couple arranged for special menus and desserts. Booth tables reserved for presents, wine, and desserts, no side tables like in a dedicated events space. The wait staff was nice. Opted for the Penne Fellini dish, which was generously soaked in a heavy cream sauce, making it difficult to finish. The bruschetta and salad were forgettable. While not eager to return for the food, the restaurant's transformation for the occasion was impressive.

input: We are having a recall fixed on our 1999 Nissan Pathfinder. The staff is very friendly and they keep you updated. We were treated the same as somebody buying a new car. Highly recommend!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Highly recommend the friendly staff at the Nissan service center for their excellent recall fix service on our 1999 Pathfinder. They kept us updated throughout the process, making us feel just as important as new car buyers.

input:
This place is the epitome of a great hole in the wall find.  From  the  70s vintage floral upholstery  to the back entrance off the alley, it undersells it self and sets you up for a great surprise.  The food is good -- not fancy, not at all pretentious - but good. 

A group from work made the trek on the coldest day of the year and we were rewarded for our efforts -- the chicken hot pot was the best example this dish I have ever had.  The seafood dish with shrimp, scallops and squid was very generous for the price of about $10. The beef in black bean sauce was nice and spicy.  

I will certainly return, but only with adventurous companions.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place is a great hidden gem. With its vintage upholstery and back entrance, it sets you up for a pleasant surprise. The food is good, not pretentious, just simply good. A group from work visited on a freezing day and were pleasantly rewarded. The chicken hot pot was the best we've ever had, and the seafood dish was generous for its price. The spicy beef dish was also enjoyable. I'll definitely return, but only with adventurous companions.

input:
I k ow looking at the description, this may seem like a festival you wouldn't want to go to.  But trust me, you really really are missing out on a fun weekend afternoon.  I really enjoyed watching the dances performances - some of the dances were absolutely breathtaking.  This year was the first time I visited, but I'll make a point to go every year I am in town.

The best part of this place was the food - yes the lines are long.  but it is definitely worth the wait.  I remember standing in line waiting in anticipation to be able to order the gyros.  My hungry stomach told me a full eternity had passed before we got to the front, but my watch said it was only a few short minutes.  They serve the food very quickly, so do not be discouraged by a long line.  Also, they have menus that tell you exactly what they serve at each of the stalls.  So make sure you double check because you got end p in a line that only has a couple of options.  My two favorite foods from this place were the gyros and the spankopitas.  Another thing I would suggest is coming with a group that is willing to share - that way you get to try a little of everything.  Definitely a great way to spend Labor Day weekend (and an activity that I think the little ones would enjoy).
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Despite initial expectations, this festival is worth attending for a fun weekend afternoon. The dance performances are breathtaking, and I plan on going every year. The food is the highlight, although lines are long, it is worth the wait. They serve the food quickly, and menus are available to help choose from the variety of options. I recommend trying the gyros and spankopitas. Bringing a group to share is a great idea, and it's an enjoyable activity for Labor Day weekend, especially for kids.

input: The food here is tasty - love the brisket and the cheese grits. BUT - we have had terrible luck with take out. Tried it three times, and an item was missing every time. A disappointing blemish on an otherwise fine restaurant.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Food is tasty - love the brisket and cheese grits. However, take out experience has been consistently disappointing with missing items each time. It's a regrettable flaw in an otherwise fine restaurant.

input: Provi is such a wonderful person I came here because of her. The chipotle chicken avocado sandwich and chicken noodle soup is just to die for.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I'm here because of the wonderful person Provi. The chipotle chicken avocado sandwich and chicken noodle soup are absolutely amazing.

input:
FOOD REVIEW

If you're looking for quality meal that is quick and affordable, the Fountain has you covered. The menu isn't extensive, but it's got a good amount of inexpensive sandwiches, salads, and soups.  

Their Cuban Sandwich ($10 w/ side) was pretty excellent.  The bread wasn't the traditional panini-style, but a French baguette...it was still great and had a little crispness to it.  All the main ingredients (meat, mustard, pickles, cheese) were in good balance.  As a Florida boy who loves his Cuban sandwiches, I would definitely recommend this.

I also tried a bit of their Royal Grille, a grilled-chese sandwich with several cheeses, as well as apple slices, on whole grain wheat bread ($8.50 w/ side, extra to add ham/turkey).  It was damn good and hit the grilled cheese craving just right.  A side salad was also done well.

For my side, I chose their "spicy carrots" which sounded unique.  It consists of sliced raw carrots that have been marinated in a tangy dressing with crushed red pepper, served in a cup. The carrots were cold and crisp and the flavors were fantastic.  The spice was just enough to be pleasant.  I would definitely get these again.

Our food came out super quick and our service was great.  I'm looking forward to trying a couple more items and bumping this up to 5 stars.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The Fountain is a great place for a quick and affordable meal. Their menu offers a decent selection of inexpensive sandwiches, salads, and soups. I highly recommend their Cuban Sandwich, made with a French baguette and perfectly balanced ingredients. The Royal Grille, a grilled cheese sandwich with multiple cheeses and apple slices, was also delicious. The side salad was well-prepared. I chose the "spicy carrots" as my side, and they were cold, crisp, and full of fantastic flavors with just the right amount of spice. The service was excellent and our food came out quickly. I can't wait to try more items and give this place a 5-star rating.

input:
Burger Up is, by far, one of our favorite restaurants in the Nashville area.  It has a cool hipster vibe, without being annoying :)  The burgers are outstanding, and there are endless options, whether you prefer beef, chicken, seafood, or veggie!  I would recommend the Woodstock - the Jack Daniels Maple Ketchup is out of this world, and Benton's bacon is always delicious.  Upgrade to the truffle fries; they're to die for.  Or, if you're a vegetarian, the troyathalon is a great option.  Filling, with great texture and flavor.  As far as drinks go, 12 South Lemonade.

The customer service is also great.  They've always been attentive, but not "on top of you", and they're very knowledgable about their food.  Parking can be a bit difficult at certain times of the day, but it's worth a short walk if necessary.

I would definitely recommend checking it out!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Burger Up is one of our favorite Nashville restaurants with a cool hipster vibe. Their outstanding burgers offer endless options with beef, chicken, seafood, or veggie choices. We highly recommend the Woodstock with Jack Daniels Maple Ketchup and Benton's bacon, and don't forget to upgrade to the amazing truffle fries. Vegetarians will love the filling and flavorful troyathalon option. For drinks, try the refreshing 12 South Lemonade. The customer service is attentive and knowledgeable, and though parking may be challenging at times, it's worth a short walk. Definitely check it out!

input:
I have mix feelings about this place. First, I didn't make a reservation and we waited about 50 minutes to be seated when they told us it will be about 15 to 20 min wait. I probably should'v left and tried the next time since I was not happy when I was seated due to the waiting.

I knew I couldn't eat the full-course meal so we decided to get cheese fondue and one of their entrees. Cheese fondue was delicious. If I go next time, I would probably just get the cheese fondue. =]

And the entree we had.. was some chicken, meat, shrimp, mushrooms, etc. We decided to go with oil instead of broth because that's what our waitress suggested and I didn't really like it. I think I will try the broth next time if I do and see if I like it any better. Except the mushroom with stuffing, others were ok.

We had this private booth which was very romantic and nice. I think this place would be good for people who want privacy and have plenty of time for dinner. We stayed there for 2&1/2 hours excluding the waiting time.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
I have mixed feelings about this place. We waited for about 50 minutes to be seated, even though they initially told us it would be a 15 to 20-minute wait. I probably should have left and tried again another time, as I was not happy when we were finally seated due to the long wait.

However, the cheese fondue we ordered was delicious. If I were to visit again, I would probably just stick to the cheese fondue.

As for the entree, it consisted of chicken, meat, shrimp, mushrooms, etc. We decided to go with oil instead of broth based on our waitress's suggestion, but I didn't really like it. Next time, I might try the broth instead to see if I prefer it. Apart from the mushroom with stuffing, the other items were just okay.

On a positive note, we had a private booth, which created a romantic and pleasant ambiance. This place would be suitable for those seeking privacy and have plenty of time for a leisurely dinner. In total, we spent around 2 and a half hours there, excluding the waiting time.

input:
Great Mexican BYOB! I went to Las Cazuelas for the first time for my birthday.  We had a wonderful time.  I was looking for a fun and festive place to go with friends.  This was the perfect choice. We brought our own bottle of tequila, and they made tasty margaritas for the table.  Those were a big hit with my friends, and a cool twist for a Mexican BYOB.  The restaurant is cute.  Plus, the food here is delicious. 

I'm surprised this place doesn't have higher reviews on Yelp, because it far exceeded my expectations... 

The guacamole appetizer was fresh and yummy.  I ordered the shrimp entree with rice and vegetables, and asked for it spicy.  My entrée had an attractive presentation on the plate (i.e. looked classy), and was delicious, well seasoned, and very fresh. On my suggestion, my partner ordered one of their mole sauce dishes (i.e. a sauce usually made from unsweetened chocolate and pureed pumpkin seeds), and it was tasty too. 

I should also note that the waitress was very attentive.  When I placed my order, I explained to her that I have mild lactose intolerance and can't eat much butter or cream (but am okay with cheese), so she had the chef cook the veggies in olive oil, rather than butter.  Thanks for being so cool about accommodating that request!  

The prices are extremely reasonable for fancy and unusual Mexican food, and I love the fact they're a BYOB.  The chef serves creative and inspired cuisine, which has a traditional flair and style to it.  In other words: Don't come here for regular tacos or burritos.  Come here for a fun foodie experience at a reasonable price, and bring tequila for the perk of BYOB Margaritas!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Las Cazuelas is a great Mexican BYOB with delicious food, a cute atmosphere, and attentive service. The restaurant offers a unique twist by making margaritas using customers' own tequila. The guacamole appetizer is fresh and tasty, while the shrimp entree with rice and vegetables is well-seasoned and presented attractively. The mole sauce dishes are also recommended. The staff is accommodating, as they adjusted the cooking method to accommodate dietary restrictions. The prices are reasonable for the fancy and unusual Mexican cuisine offered. Las Cazuelas is a recommended spot for a fun and affordable foodie experience, especially for those looking for something beyond regular tacos or burritos.

input: This was one of the greatest meals I have ever had.  The food was delicious and the hospitality was second to none.  The lamb was cooked to perfection, the rice had the perfect amount of spice.  The ability to easily describe the amount of spice made this meal perfect for spicy lovers, but also easy for those with a milder pallet.  All of this is from someone who has historically not been a fan of Pakistani/Indian food.  I would recommend this restaurant to anyone and would encourage a trip to St. Louis just for the food here.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This meal was absolutely amazing, with delicious food and impeccable hospitality. The lamb was cooked to perfection and the rice had just the right amount of spice. Even for someone who hasn't typically enjoyed Pakistani/Indian cuisine, this restaurant surpassed all expectations. I highly recommend it to anyone, and it's worth a trip to St. Louis just for the incredible food here.

input: Amazingly awesome! Tried a couple of different things, everything was delicious! Their Bloody Mary was one of the worst I've ever had, but I didn't go there to drink, and besides that not what they are known for. Their mojoto are good tho.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Tried various things, all delicious! Bloody Mary was disappointing, but not what they're known for. However, their mojitos are great.

input:
I'm not really sure why I bother going to other restaurants. 

Every Valentine's Day I try to find some cute, new little BYO for me and my boyfriend to try out and I spend weeks scouring menus and Yelp reviews. 

Every year SOMETHING goes wrong and I get frustrated and pissed off and he always says "Let's go to Jones".

This year was no different. We went out last night (2/12/11...the weekend before Valentines Day) to the BYO I picked out and when I made our reservations, no mention was made that they had a special fixed menu that night consisting SOLELY of seafood, which I am allergic to. As I started to get upset at our table, my boyfriend said "Let's go to Jones".

We got there, were told there was a little bit of a wait, so we sat at the bar for a drink. About 5-10 minutes later they came and got us and sat us at our table. Our waiter (who was WONDERFUL and looked like Jared Leto - extra bonus-) came over and took our order and the food came out perfectly (as usual) and right on time.

We both got the filet, done rare and the spinach it came with was fantastic. The mac and cheese is also an app we get every time and is one of my favorites. I got the deviled eggs for the first time and holy crap they were amazing. I'm gonna say, possibly the best ones I've ever had (sorry, Dad). 

Everything about this restaurant leans towards comfort and it's always done so well. The atmosphere, the staff, the decor, the food, hell even the temperature. I've never had a bad experience at Jones and I don't think I ever will. 

Next year....we'll just go straight to Jones.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I always try new restaurants on Valentine's Day, but something always goes wrong. This year, the restaurant I chose had a fixed seafood menu, and I'm allergic to seafood. Frustrated, my boyfriend suggested going to Jones, our go-to spot. We had to wait a bit at the bar before being seated, but the service was great. We both enjoyed the filet with spinach and the delicious mac and cheese. I tried the deviled eggs for the first time and they were amazing. Jones offers comfort in every aspect - atmosphere, staff, decor, temperature, and most importantly, the food. From now on, we'll go straight to Jones on Valentine's Day.

input: I held my husband's surprise birthday party for about 35 people in the basement bar at Black Sheep. I couldn't have asked for a better experience. From the first call I placed to inquire about hosting the party and spoke with James, the owner, to the night of the party where Adam, our bartender, made sure all went smoothly, everyone I dealt with was fantastic. Overall, a great experience.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I hosted my husband's surprise birthday party for 35 people at the basement bar in Black Sheep. From my first call to inquire about hosting the party, James, the owner, was fantastic. On the night of the party, Adam, our bartender, ensured everything went smoothly. Overall, it was a great experience.

input: Quack & Cheese is where it is at! We were there for the lunch menu. The duck fries are so delicious. It was my first time there & I ordered the portabello burger. They didn't have the right mushrooms & asked if a substitute was ok. I said sure. But I couldn't eat it. I asked for some kind of sauce & instead they let me order something else. That was so nice. I don't usually complain about anything. I felt like they really catered to our whole party. I would definitely love to come back for a date night.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Quack & Cheese offers mouth-watering dishes, particularly their duck fries which are absolutely delicious. During our visit for lunch, I decided to try their portabello burger. Unfortunately, they didn't have the required mushrooms and offered a substitute. Although I couldn't finish the burger, they kindly allowed me to order something else and even provided accommodating service throughout the dining experience. It was evident that they prioritized the satisfaction of our entire group. I look forward to revisiting Quack & Cheese for a romantic date night in the future.

input:
The family and I ate here on Labor Day, 2015.  We wanted to go to another restaurant, but it was closed, so we stopped at Casa Garcia.  The inside of the restaurant is very pleasant.  The fountain is a nice touch.

The chips, salsa and bean dip were very good.  We greatly enjoyed them.  We also all agreed that the tortilla soup was excellent.  It was when the entrees arrived that things went down hill.

The sour cream and guacamole were fresh, but the entrees were just average at best.  The quesadillas had too much cheese and not much else flavor.  

The meal was not bad, but there are better options close by.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My family and I dined at Casa Garcia on Labor Day, 2015 after our initial choice of a restaurant was closed. The interior of the restaurant was pleasant, and we particularly liked the fountain. The chips, salsa, and bean dip served were delicious and we thoroughly enjoyed them. The tortilla soup received high praise from all of us. However, we were disappointed with the entrees as they were only average at best. The quesadillas had an excessive amount of cheese and lacked flavor. While the overall meal was not terrible, there are better dining options nearby.

input: Joe's is the place for great seafood! Service was fast and friendly! Clam chowder was great and of course the crab is always amazing! Eat at Joe's!! Love this place!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Joe's is the place for fast and friendly service with amazing seafood like great clam chowder and crab. Eat at Joe's and love this place!

input: Nothing makes my busy day easy like my iced coffee at Starbucks and this location botched it up for me:( see my photo yup those are coffee grinds at the bottom a whole bunch of coffee grinds:( yuck yuck!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My busy day was not made any easier by the Starbucks location I visited. They made a mistake and my iced coffee was filled with coffee grinds at the bottom. Please take a look at the photo I took. It was quite unpleasant and disappointing.

input:
Get off the phone and serve your customers.  Also throw out the donuts that are clearly rock hard and inedible.

 This was my first time in a Dunkin and probably my last if its common for employees to be on the phone obviously talking to a friend while making a vague attempt to take someones order. It was also the worst donut I ever had mostly because it was as hard as a rock. No quality control!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Employees at Dunkin should prioritize serving customers instead of being on the phone, and should also discard donuts that are clearly rock hard and inedible. This experience, being my first and likely last visit to Dunkin, was disappointing due to an employee's apparent distraction while taking orders and the poor quality of the donut.

input: This place was awesome. Clean, beautiful and the food was outstanding. The staff was lovely, very attentive and accommodating. I brought my 11 month old there to meet a friend for lunch and we had a great time and a great meal. This is my new favorite joint.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This place was amazing. It was clean, beautiful, and the food was outstanding. The staff was extremely friendly, attentive, and accommodating. I brought my 11-month-old to meet a friend for lunch and we had a wonderful time with a delicious meal. Without a doubt, this is now my favorite place to go.

input: Awesome experience! Just ate here for the first time and wow it was good. Our meals came very quickly and tasted great! Our waiter, Lyndel, was very amazing and made our experience memorable. The restaurant felt a tad bit cramped, but other than that everything was awesome.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great first-time dining experience! Food arrived promptly and tasted amazing. Lyndel, our waiter, was fantastic and made our visit memorable. The only downside was the slightly cramped restaurant space. Overall, it was an awesome experience.

input: I started coming to Moreno when I moved back to Brandon and had an itch for Alessi Bakery but didn't  want to drive too far. Someone told us about Moreno so we gave them a shot! A great, small, FAMILY-OWNED (love it!) bakery right in the heart of Brandon. They make a HUGE variety of baked goods from fresh bread to huge cupcakes to flan and cookies! They also have the best freshly made cuban sandwich with their own special sauce spread! My favorite thing to get here are the almond sticks. I am a huge fan of anything almond, but these are so fresh with loads of almonds and almond flavoring! If you have a sweet tooth, this is DEFINITELY the place to go!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I started coming to Moreno when I wanted Alessi Bakery but closer to home. Moreno is a great, small, family-owned bakery in the heart of Brandon. They offer a wide variety of baked goods, including fresh bread, huge cupcakes, flan, and cookies. Their freshly made cuban sandwich with a special sauce is exceptional. Personally, I love their almond sticks, which are packed with almonds and almond flavoring. If you have a sweet tooth, Moreno is definitely the place to go!

input: I wish I could give this zero stars, this gave my husband and kid a really really bad stomach ache after eating here. This used to be our favorite Chinese restaurant but not anymore. Never eat here. Also on another note the delivery really slow.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: This restaurant has caused severe stomach discomfort for my husband and child, making it impossible for me to rate it any higher than zero stars. Despite previously being our favorite Chinese restaurant, we can no longer recommend it. Additionally, the delivery service is considerably slow.

input: I called to get a price on getting a flat fixed $35.99WTH! Is this price legal... Smdh in a city where they don't EVEN pay livable wages.... #tragic ..smdh
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I called to inquire about the cost of fixing a flat tire, and was shocked to hear it was priced at $35.99. This seems exorbitant, especially considering the low wages in this city. It is truly unfortunate.

input: Good food, great milkshakes!! Loved it! I will definitely be back next time I am in town!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Great food and amazing milkshakes! Loved it and will definitely return when I'm back in town!

input:
I absolutely LOVE the convenience of having a groomer come to me instead of dragging all my dogs to a groomer.  The price of grooming is very competitive to other groomers in the area, if not a bit better.  So, how can you beat that!?!

I pay $60 for my 65lb dog, and $40 for my smaller dogs.  This includes a bath, ear cleaning, nail grind, and anal gland expression if needed.  All of my dogs are short-haired, so nothing too fancy.

My only drawbacks are:  no teeth cleaning; the price is the same regardless if the dog is 5 lbs or 40 lbs; and the feeling of judgement for not taking better care of my dogs (but that could just be me).
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I love having a groomer come to me instead of taking my dogs to a salon. The prices are competitive and even better in some cases. For my 65lb dog, I pay $60 while for smaller dogs it's $40. The services offered include bathing, ear cleaning, nail grinding, and anal gland expression if needed. Although there is no teeth cleaning available, the only drawbacks are that the price is the same regardless of the dog's size and there can be a feeling of judgment.

input: Thursday night and wonderful life music --- James Taylor style. Food is great and service friendly. Yummy red Sangria too!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Thursday night at Wonderful Life Music offers a fantastic James Taylor-style ambiance. The food is delicious, and the service is friendly. Don't forget to try their delicious red Sangria!

input:
I came here for lunch and was very disappointed.  Bland and expensive for the amount and quality of food we received.  Lukewarm, nearly tasteless (how can Mexican food be tasteless???) and a total waste of my lunch hour.

Meh.  Do yourself a favor and support the many authentic, locally owned, non-chain Mexican restaurants.

I was wishing that I had gone to Mi Pueblo instead.......

input: Awesome place. Great beer selection, music and friendly service. Check it out!

input: I foresee this bar becoming a new local fav, great spot for amazing cocktails and you must try the bar burger, it's the best burger in town! Brunch is also delicious. I would recommend to anyone, whether you're a local or just passing through!

input:

input: Good food excellent service, everything was delicious. input: The atmosphere was nice and small. Very busy for brunch, expect at least a 30-45 minute wait. input:
I was just passing through Tuscon. Native American inspired breakfast food? I just had to have some :-).  Basically I ended up with amazing and unique food that I wish I could have everyday! Five stars!

It took me while to decide what I wanted because there was so many things I wanted. 

Finally, I ended up with the pueblo, which basically is the green corn waffle with eggs the way you want it and a choice of a side (I got chorizo). The waiter told me how to eat it: put the syrup + hot sauce on the waffle and enjoy. But, instead, I ended up making an awesome syrup, hot sauce, egg, chorizo and red sauce tower on my waffle for each bite. It was delicious - try it!!!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: While passing through Tucson, I couldn't resist trying some Native American inspired breakfast food. The selection was overwhelming, but I finally settled on the pueblo dish. This delightful meal consisted of a green corn waffle topped with eggs cooked to my liking and a side of chorizo. The waiter suggested pouring syrup and hot sauce on the waffle, but I took it a step further and created a mouthwatering tower of syrup, hot sauce, egg, chorizo, and red sauce with each bite. It was a unique and amazing culinary experience that I wish I could enjoy every day. Definitely a five-star meal!

input:
Another wonderful stip mall ethnic restruarant!!! This was my first time at a Veitnamese restuarant and I will say that pho is a little bowl of heaven. It was warm and fragrant and with all the condements they bring on the side, easy to customize. We also got BBQ pork sandwiches and they were very tasty. The meat was tender and flavorful and they had fresh herbs on them and some kind of yummy sauce. They only take cash, so make sure you hit the ATM before you go. The food is very reasonably priced though.

This restuarant started my love affair with pho, but I haven't had any as good anywhere else in Nashville.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I had a wonderful experience at a Vietnamese restaurant at a stip mall. The pho was heavenly - warm, fragrant, and customizable with condiments. The BBQ pork sandwiches were delicious, with tender meat, fresh herbs, and a tasty sauce. Remember to bring cash as they don't accept cards. While I haven't found pho as good as this place elsewhere in Nashville, the prices are reasonable.

input:
This shop is a slice of Disney beauty and magic hiding on the edge of Broad Ripple, and a MUST stop of sweets, treats, and dreaminess. Your Instagram needs this place. Hands down the ~best~ red velvet cake of my life.

Appearance: The Cake Bake Shop is a beautifully decorated, small white house with a captivating design. The flowers around the sign make it an #instaworthy post for sure, and when the weather is nice, the outdoor seating must be gorgeous.

Inside the Cake Shop will take your breath away, light airy colors and flowers and twinkling lights. This isn't the kind of cake shop you do take-out at, you'll want to sit and enjoy. 

Food: I wanted to try the Raspberry Champagne cake, unfortunately one wouldn't be ready for a little while, so I ordered a slice of the Red Velvet  Cake. The floral icing work was so perfect I didn't want to touch it, but I had to because come on it's cake. What I assume must have been cream cheese filling in the middle was decadent and I never wanted the cake to end. ***I felt one slice was plenty for two people, it's HUGE

I was torn between the Rose Cappuccino and the Lavender Latte. I went with the Lavender Latte, hot, and it was stunning, it was a creamy, smooth, not-at-all bitter latte and the hint of lavender was enough to taste but not over powering, it was probably the most perfect coffee I've ever had in my life. 

Price: the coffee is pricy, $6, so not a regular coffee stop for me, but for #treatyoself it's the way to go. The slice of cake was $12 but like I mentioned, it was enough for two people and for how amazing it was, I think it's so worth it.

Customer Service: I mentioned Disney initially because the friendliness, care, and attention of the staff felt just like Disney. They were kind, they helped me decide what to try, and the barista even offered to make me the rose cappuccino if I didn't like the lavender latte after trying it - how sweet! 

I will most definitely think to come here if anyone visits and wants something sweet. This place has my heart and is a hidden gem to anyone who has a sweet tooth!

Check out my #FirstTimeFriday highlight of my visit to The Cake Bake Shop on my Instagram @jordanqjordanq for pictures of everything mentioned above!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf:
The Cake Bake Shop in Broad Ripple is a must-visit for its Disney-inspired beauty and magical atmosphere. This small, beautifully decorated white house is perfect for an #instaworthy post, especially with the flowers around the sign and the lovely outdoor seating. Inside, the shop is adorned with light, airy colors, flowers, and twinkling lights, creating a breath-taking ambiance that will make you want to sit and enjoy.

When it comes to the food, the Red Velvet Cake at The Cake Bake Shop is unparalleled. The floral icing work is so perfect, it's almost a shame to eat it, but the cream cheese filling in the middle is decadent and makes every bite heavenly. A slice of this cake is huge and can easily be shared by two people. Additionally, the Lavender Latte is a must-try. It's a creamy, smooth, and not at all bitter latte with just the right hint of lavender. The coffee is on the pricier side, at $6, but for an occasional treat, it's worth it. The slice of cake costs $12, but considering its incredible taste and size, it's definitely worth the price.

The staff at The Cake Bake Shop is exceptionally friendly and attentive, offering Disney-like hospitality. They are kind, helpful in choosing what to try, and even willing to accommodate special requests. The level of customer service adds to the incomparable experience at this hidden gem.

Overall, The Cake Bake Shop is a place that anyone with a sweet tooth should not miss out on. It has a special place in my heart and I will definitely recommend it to anyone visiting. For a visual tour of my visit, check out the #FirstTimeFriday highlight on my Instagram account @jordanqjordanq.

input:

input:

input:
Western cycle is a huge store and sells everything to do with bikes. They've got your $150 kids' bikes with training wheels and your $5,000 racing bikes for triathletes. The staff are knowledgeable, and they've got a mixture of older, more mature and younger people, all of whom seem into biking. 

The one aspect I've enjoyed most about coming here over the years is how they keep returned, out-of-package stuff in a drawer and will sell it to you on discount. I once got $200 pedals for $60 just 'cause they were sitting in a drawer without their proper package. The guys work really hard here to keep their customers loyal, and it works. They're honest and well-trained. You're never left wandering without help. This and United Cycle are pretty much the only two bike places I'll shop.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Western cycle is a large store that sells a wide range of bikes and accessories. They offer bikes ranging from $150 kids' bikes with training wheels to $5,000 racing bikes for triathletes. The staff consists of both older, more mature individuals and younger people who are all passionate about biking. One of the highlights of the store is their practice of keeping returned, out-of-package items in a drawer and selling them at a discounted price. This earned me a $200 pair of pedals for only $60. The dedicated and knowledgeable staff value customer loyalty and work hard to ensure customers receive assistance at all times. Along with United Cycle, Western cycle is my preferred bike shop.

input: My husband and I go here often and we have yet to have a bad meal.  Love this place! Wonderful service, wonderful food, wonderful everything! Worth your time!!

input:

input: A fantastic spot with amazing Sno-balls. So many great flavors, including many that are all natural. As an added bonus, the service is super friendly.  Can't wait to go back soon!

input: Really enjoyed the meal here. I had the General Tsao chicken and it was delicious. My wife loved her Curry Chicken as well. The portions were reasonable as was the price. The customer service was all very good. We ate there and they brought the food to our table. There is not a lot of seating, but there is some for eating in. I am sure that we will be back again.

The portions and prices were reasonable, and the customer service was excellent. Although the seating area is limited, we appreciated that our food was brought to our table. We definitely plan on returning.

input: Top notch food. I ordered the 3 course meal and everything was beyond super deliciousness!!! Our waiter Jenna was amazing, knowledgeable and fun. She made our experience sheer perfection. I can't thank the staff enough for making my birthday dinner heaven on my taste buds.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: The food was top-notch, and the 3-course meal exceeded my expectations in terms of deliciousness. Our waiter Jenna was exceptional, being both knowledgeable and fun, which added to our overall experience. I am incredibly grateful to the staff for making my birthday dinner a heavenly delight for my taste buds.

input:
My hubbie likes to think of himself as a pizza connoisseur they serve pizza, he's probably eaten there. We go to Mellow Mushroom about 3x/month and this place has the best pizza in the bay...hands down!

We enjoy the Maui Wowie...pesto, chicken, bacon, pineapple, and banana peppers. The crust is always cooked to the perfect crunchy texture and there's a great beer selection here. 

Staff is always very friendly and have never had to wait for a table.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: My husband considers himself a pizza connoisseur and has likely eaten at every pizza place in town. But in our opinion, Mellow Mushroom is the absolute best. We frequent this place about three times a month, and their pizza never disappoints. Our favorite is the Maui Wowie, which includes pesto, chicken, bacon, pineapple, and banana peppers. The crust is always perfectly crispy, and they also have a fantastic beer selection. The staff is consistently friendly, and we've never had to wait for a table.

input: Love the food- wait staff is attentive to allergies and very accommodating. The drink pours are paltry at best. The bourbon tasted watered down...disappointing aspect to the dining experience.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Food is great, wait staff is attentive to allergies and accommodating. However, the drink pours are inadequate, especially the bourbon which tasted watered down, leading to a disappointing dining experience.

input: One of the best donuts I've ever had. The dough is perfect & the icing is not so sweet it cuts your teeth.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Amazing donut with ideal dough and mildly sweet icing.

input:
We've been meaning to stop in, and tonight, we finally did. And glad we were!

There isnt much different to say that everyone hasnt already said, so I will just reiterate some of the reasons why Taste of Havana will become a regular spot for us. 

I had the Pan con Bistec, and my wife had the Cuban. We loved the bread (and everything between it). Usually we take home half our sandwiches to eat for a second meal, but I just wasnt ready to stop eating for the night, so alas, I dont have another meal. Guess I'll just have to go back! 

And the company was just as inviting. We chatted with Diana (Dayana?), for quite a while after we ate, and she told us how she and her dad opened the restuarant, and how it really is a labor of love. 

Try it out. Order a sandwich, have a seat, chat them up, and enjoy! I'm already looking forward to our next visit, and thinking about who else I want to bring with us.

Thank you for a wonderful evening!
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: We finally visited Taste of Havana tonight and we are glad we did! The Pan con Bistec and Cuban sandwiches were delicious, and we couldn't resist finishing them entirely. The bread and everything in between was amazing. We had a pleasant conversation with Diana (or Dayana), who shared the story of how she and her dad opened the restaurant out of love. We highly recommend trying it out, ordering a sandwich, chatting with the staff, and enjoying the experience. We are already excited for our next visit and can't wait to bring others along. Thank you for a wonderful evening!

input:
***YES***YES***YES***I***LOVE***LOVE***LOVE***

Oh yes,
the scorpion bowl, the piña colada (as I never drunk it before), fried shrimp taco and the Jell-O-Shots/gummy tiki cocktails ( which is an ounce of distilled spirit or any cocktail converted into a gummy bear) we had the pineapple and rum one. :-) :-) :-) all orders were delicious !!!
........ All served by a very friendly bar mixer!

The interior is fun and has its own interpretation of a Tiki bar, my two girl-friends and me had a fantastic evening.
there is no more to say then: 

YES YES YES I LOVE LOVE LOVE!!!!!

Perfect for a group of friends or a romantic date. Everything is right!!! Don't miss it if you are living in New Orleans or visiting. 

The French Quarter Tiki bar is small enough to keep an intimate ambience, and big enough to party with your friends. 
Beautiful-Non-Commercial!!!
Tiki Tolteca would become one of my regular hangout, if I were a New Orleaner :-)

Enjoy!!! :-)
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I absolutely loved my experience at Tiki Tolteca! The scorpion bowl, piña colada, fried shrimp taco, and Jell-O Shots/gummy tiki cocktails were all delicious. The bar mixer was also very friendly. The interior had a fun interpretation of a Tiki bar, and my friends and I had a fantastic evening. This place is perfect for both groups of friends and romantic dates. It's a must-visit if you're in New Orleans. Tiki Tolteca has a small, intimate ambiance, but it's also big enough for a fun party with friends. It's a beautiful, non-commercial bar that I would definitely make a regular hangout if I lived in New Orleans. Enjoy!

input:
I eat at Sukho Thai quite a bit, and I don't really get the negative ratings. Is it the most authentic thai place in the area? No. Sometimes I would say they sometimes substitute certain ingredients. It is however usually pretty consistent as far as quality of food and service. 

I usually get the red or green curry, and almost always get it "native thai hot". I have tried other things on the menu, but they are not quite as good. So I stick with what tastes good and works for me. 

The lady that owns the place is very kind and always very gracious to my wife and I. She always recognizes us and serves us promptly. She not only owns the place, but she waits all of the tables most of the time(which I think is pretty impressive). 
The place is beside a go-cart track, so that makes it a little quirky, but it's something I have grown accustomed to. 

The only thing negative I would say is that I wish they had Kee Mao on the menu, because that's my favorite. I usually go to Siam Cafe or Thai Star for that.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I frequently dine at Sukho Thai and don't understand the negative reviews. While it may not be the most authentic Thai restaurant in the area and occasionally uses substitute ingredients, the overall quality of food and service is usually consistent. I personally enjoy the red or green curry, especially when ordered "native thai hot", and find other items on the menu not as good. The owner is a kind and gracious lady who always recognizes us and provides prompt service. It is impressive that she not only owns the place but also waits on the tables most of the time. The location next to a go-cart track adds a quirky touch that I have grown accustomed to. The only downside is that Kee Mao, which is my favorite dish, is not available on the menu. For that, I usually visit Siam Cafe or Thai Star.

input:
When you dine at Muriel's, check to see if the 2nd level is open for visitors. If so, you can briefly tour the lounge area upstairs (red couches, decorative pieces). There's a wrap-around balcony where you can get a great view of Jackson Square. 

If you're curious, learn why Muriel's is haunted and find out the story behind why there's a table that is always set for two located near the stairs. 

There are two main dining rooms, a middle section (indoor patio dining area) that I personally prefer because it is quieter, and a bar area located at the back near the restrooms. I love the indoor patio dining area because it brings a bit of the outdoors in a quiet indoor setting. 

On my first visit, I ordered from the dinner pre-fix menu which is a great deal (appetizer or soup + entrée + dessert = $40). The seafood gumbo soup was hearty and delicious. The dijon mustard encrusted salmon was cooked perfectly. The bread pudding was a great way to end a delicious meal.

I returned to Muriel's for lunch on another NOLA trip and tried the wood grilled pork chop. The pork chop was flavorful, tender, and moist. I was not too crazy about the red beans and rice it was served with as I found it a bit bland. The entrée was served in a bowl but should perhaps be served on a plate since it was difficult to slice the pork chop since it kept sinking into the bed of red beans and rice. 

Muriel's is one of the places I would love to return to because of the ambiance and the great food.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: When dining at Muriel's, check if the second level is open for visitors for a brief tour of the lounge area with red couches and decorations. Enjoy a view of Jackson Square from the wrap-around balcony. For those interested, discover the haunted history of Muriel's and the story behind the always-set table for two near the stairs. The restaurant boasts two main dining rooms, with the middle section being quieter and preferred by the speaker. The indoor patio dining area brings the outdoors in, creating a peaceful setting. The dinner pre-fix menu offers a great deal, including an appetizer or soup, entrée, and dessert for $40. The seafood gumbo soup is hearty and delicious, while the dijon mustard encrusted salmon is cooked perfectly. The bread pudding serves as a delightful conclusion to a satisfying meal. On a separate visit for lunch, the wood grilled pork chop stands out for its flavor, tenderness, and moisture. However, the red beans and rice served with it are found to be somewhat bland. Serving the entrée on a plate rather than a bowl may improve the experience. Overall, Muriel's is a highly recommended destination due to its inviting atmosphere and exceptional cuisine.

input: Had a wonderful lunch of fried green tomatoes and vegan barq. Excellent! Nice beer selection and great vibe. Staff was super friendly and attentive. The tunes were easy on the ears. Definitely will go back.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: Had a great lunch of fried green tomatoes and vegan barq. Excellent beer selection, friendly staff, and great vibe. The music was enjoyable. Will definitely return.

input:
I like to make a stop at this Walmart since it's located in Meadowlark where my doctor's office is.  It's smaller than  the supercentre but I find it has a decent selection of items in the food section where the prices are cheaper than the nearby stores.  The produce section can have limited items though with just the basics in stock.  I find the snacks and canned food section are fine with good prices.

As for the rest of the store and items, well it's hit or miss.  I was looking for lightbulbs and they only had one brand of the type I was looking for and it was a energy efficient so pricier than others if they had in stock.  However, the price I paid for the item was probably cheaper than other stores.  

Don't expect much help if you need help finding an item.  Associates seem to be difficult to find unless you count some of the younger staff who like racing shopping carts in the store as they were on my last visit.  

The check outs can have at most 5 cashiers working but I find the time in the line ups is never too long so that's good.
Concise this for me and keep all the inf: I prefer this Walmart in Meadowlark for its convenient location near my doctor's office. It is smaller than the supercentre but offers a decent selection of affordable food items. The produce section may have limited options, but the snacks and canned food sections are fine with good prices. However, the store's overall inventory can be hit or miss. For example, when I needed lightbulbs, they only had one brand available, which was pricier than others. Nonetheless, the item's cost was still cheaper than other stores. If you need assistance, finding associates can be challenging, except for some younger staff members who engage in cart racing during my last visit. The checkout lines usually have a maximum of five cashiers, but the waiting time is generally reasonable.
